comments: The host had a property manager bring by the key. The listing description was accurate and the neighborhood is very upscale.
The location is fantastic and it’s a lovely bright airy apartment. Minimally furnished but has all that’s needed. Great restaurants all around and public transport system right on door step.
Marc’s Place is Fantastic... Best Location,Stylish Space and Definitely Recommend it to anyone looking for the right spot to stay in Berlin

Great location, very stylish. Sleeps 3 very comfortably.
Good value. Handy to the U and the S. Lots of good food and shops in the neighborhood.

Lovely light and spacious apartment, with good transport links, plus many local restaurants.  We used it as a space to explore the city with our 3 year daughter.  Apartment is on 4th floor, so we used the lift within the building.  The kitchen had the basic facilities, enough to prepare simple meals.  Would recommend.

the location was fine, but the apartment was quite bare and not very cozy. It had hardly any curtains, and there was, for example, a kettle and hooks missing in the bathroom. Another apartment I rented before for about this price was really much better. Hence my not very positive opinion
It was a great stay. A beautiful and clutter free space. Quiet and clean too. And Erik, who assists  Marc, was very responsive. Highly recommend.

Among the best AirBnBs I have ever stayed at. There were four of us - two teens, two parents. There was one room for the teens, each had their own bed, and a room for the parents with a balcony. The apartment is right on a main street in a great neighborhood, so you can totally feel the vibrancy of city life right outside the door. The place is spacious, open, clean, and bright. The only challenge was the shower - the water flows out into the bathroom and it's hard to keep the floor dry. But that's a small matter. The hosts were responsive and helpful before and during our stay.

Great apartment, really spacious. The lift was broken but this wasn’t an issue for us but may be for others. The place was super clean. We arranged specific time for entry which was great. Really good location.

This is a beautiful, spotlessly clean apartment in a great part of town. It’s huge, much bigger than it looks in the pictures. The second bedroom only has a single bed (though it’s easily big enough for a double) but it was still comfortable. My son and I had a wonderful stay here.

Me and my 5 friends had a very nice stay here! Everything in the apartment was good and the neighborhood is very great to! Dieter, who managed the apartment for Ramfis, was very nice and helpful. I would definitely recommend others to stay here.

This apartment might have the best location in Berlin. Just step out of the door and you have restaurants, cafés and shopping. Still it is a very calm and quiet place with a nice terrace where you can relax,
Dieter, who manages the apartment, always gave promt answers and was easy to communicate with. He offered bikes to rent and let us store our luggage in the apartment the day we checked out.
Very centrally located on Kastanienallee with Trams stopping right outside the apartment building door. Good clean apartment in a very nice neighbourhood.

We were greeted at the agreed upon time and Deiter was very helpful in acquainting us with the neighborhood and with the flat.  The neighborhood was great.  Right near the tram, wonderful bakery next door, restaurants and shops nearby. The flat was accurately described  and spacious.  Kitchen was in excellent order.  All plates and cutlery were clean and serviceable.

We stayed at Ramfis's/Dieter's place only for two days, and we enjoyed every moment spent in the apartment. Prior to arrival, we had an easy and very helpful communication with Dieter, suggesting best ways to get to the flat. The flat was very clean, everything was ready for us prior to our arrival (bedding, towels), and Dieter was very kind and took the time to share what to see in the city. Location was great, very easy to get around the city, tram stop right in front of the house. Kitchen equipped with all you need for a dinner 'at home'. Would def recommend and stay next time when in Berlin!

We had an lovely stay in this apartment. The location is great in a very nice area of Berlin - Prenzlauerberg. With lots of restaurants, bars en shops in the same street. Yet, the apartment is very quiet en big enough for 5-6 people. We felt very at home. When we arrived Dieter was waiting for us. He showed us around and shared information with us about supermarkets, transport and things to do. The apartment was clean, the beds are good (4 in a separate sleeping room and two in the living room ), the kitchen well equipped. Tram stops in front of the street and the underground is just a block away. The communication with Dieter + Ramfis before we arrived was also very good! They responded very quick to mails and questions and gave us information of how to get there from the main station.We highly recommend this place for a visit of Berlin
We come late, but it was no problem to get the keys – perfect service, thx for it.

It was very comfortable and relaxing staying thanks to Ramfis.
Everything is equipped and convenient. Best staying Mitte! I'd like to visit again.
Ramfis was very nice, gave us plenty of information about the city and how to use public transport. We had a very nice stay in Berlin & in Ramfis house.

We had a great stay at Ramfis’ place. The tram was right in front of the house, which was convenient, and the neighborhood was lively but not loud. The place was spacious and provided ample space for our family of 4 adults. A close walk to Prater Garten and grocery market. Overall very much enjoyed our stay!
It was perfect for us. Very good situation and very nice apartment. I would recommend it for families

This apartment was brilliantly located with a tram stop just outside. Although it was on a main road, it was surprisingly quiet. Excellent amenities and all spotless. In warm weather the terrace would be wonderful.

Location is everything and this was perfect for our stat in Berlin. Shops, cafes, playgrounds and restaurants on every corner, bus and tram and u-bahn nearby.
Perfect space for me and three kids!
Note that there is just the one bedroom, the other room of the two is the combined living room/kitchen. Great with a tiny garden (though no grass, when we were there) and the place is quit at all times.
The apartment appears to be a “full time airbnb”-place, so don’t expect personal decor or “private home ambience”. It is just a great place to shower, sleep and explore Berlin from.

Good location!
Do not go there is you want to make noise after 10pm, quiet place

Very nice and clean apartment. Ramfis is very friendly, and answered my messages very quickly. Big apartment, nice facilities, great beds and a nice neighborhood, with good restaurants and easy transportation. Would recommend!

Lovely Apartment and a lot of hospitality.
Ramfis is a very kind Person. Location also great a lot of shops restaurants and bars around. We will come back again

Hi Ramfis, once again thanks for everthing even the possibility to get your bikes. Unfortunately we didn‘t use them often due to the bad weather. We will Return for sure once again 😉 we do not miss  anything in your cosy Appartement

The perfect place for a perfect visit in Berlin. The location was awesome with lots of cosy cafés and shops. The apartment is very quiet with nice furniture and comfortable beds and the little garden is lovely. Ramfis was easy to communicate with and made our stay very pleasant. Hope to revisit again.

Absolutely my favourite Airbnb to date. Communication was excellent and so helpful. Very easy and friendly check-in. Wonderful neighbourhood with so many delicious restaurants and local shops near by. Super clean and spacious space with wonderful decor. Extremely happy to have found this spot and stayed. Will definitely try to stay again in the future.

Clean, nicely decorated and very well situated in Berlin.
Ramfis is welcoming , flexible and a very friendly host.
Would very much recommend!!

This was a top place for our stay in Berlin! Truly nice neighbourhood, with lovely stores and dozens of restaurants and cafés, that got filled with people every night. In a nice way that was - all lively and a really cosy atmosphere.
The location is really really good - easy to take the tram from Hauptbahnhof, and close to walk to nice areas, such as Mauerpark or Hackescher markt with it’s surroundings. Also easy to take the tram right outside the door and out in the city.
The flat is clean and nice and surprisingly quiet, we didn’t hear a thing from the nightlife outside.
When we come back to Berlin, we would absolutely love to stay at Ramfi’s again! :)

We LOVED staying at this perfectly-located Berlin AirBnB. Ramfis is an exceptionally helpful, friendly, welcoming host. Be sure to read the folder of information - lots of helpful info on how to get Metro passes and find nearby attractions. This AirBnB was perfect for our family of four, plus our friend who was traveling with us - five people total, five beds. We would love to stay here again. Thanks!

Highly recommended!
Nice spacious ground floor apartment. Super comfortable beds. Nicely furnished. Very clean.
Great location for the tram into the city.
Great restaurants along the street for hundreds of metres. Nice safe area at night.
Ramfis was flexible when our flight was changed and we had to arrive at the apartment at midnight.
Separate bedrooms. Washing machine.
A great place to base yourself if you are staying in Berlin.

Ramfis' place was fabulous. The location was perfect as it was walking distance to nearby attractions and right by a tram stop for anything further a field.
The place itself was comfortable and so warm! The rooms, bathroom and kitchen were all great.
Overall I would absolutely recommend. Thank you Ramfis!!!

The four of us (parents of 13- and 11-year old kids) enjoyed the stay at Ramfis' apartment. The rooms have a practical layout for a family like ours, with a separate, spacious dorm for our kids, and a nicely sized bed in the also spacious living room. Clean and cosy place, has all one needs for a nice stay, bathroom, kitchen and it is quiet too, the apartment is situated on a lively street but in a 'back building' as they are built in this area of Berlin, accessible through a hallway and interior square.
The location is superb.
We recommend this place.
Ramfis had a very nice place and it was very specious. It was very convenient having the tram right outside the apartment.
Great location to get out and explore Berlin on foot. Ramis kept the place very clean, waited outside for us on arrival, and was quick to respond to any queries we had. Thank you.
We had an incredible stay at Ramfis’ apartment. It was big, clean and in an incredible area. Ramfis was super kind and we felt super at home. We’re definetly coming back!

The place felt really nice and cozy, also the tram is right outside the apartment so you can easily reach every place in the city.
Thank you

Staying at Ramfis’ place was excellent. The place is comfortable, quiet te very well located. We were four people and found it very convenient with everything we needed.
Ramfis is a very friendly and easy.
5 stars without doubts!

Fantastic accommodation, very central location.
Apartment was spotless and very well maintained. Provided with all facilities.
Would definitely stay again and recommend to anyone.

Ramfis was a fantastic host and his Airbnb is a great place to stay. This was my first visit to Berlin but the location was perfect as the M1 tram stops right outside or you can take a very short walk to the U-Bahn station. You also have some great restaurants and bars nearby so I couldn’t have wished for more. We were able to drop our bags off early which meant we could go and explore the city prior to check in. The only downside was that our flights got cancelled and so we had to fly back early meaning we couldn’t spend more time in Berlin. Would definitely recommend this place!
Marine was a really nice host and very accommodating. Great apartment and in a lovely location. Would stay there everytime I come to Berlin.

The Apartment was fantastic. Its large windows allow for a lot of light and for great views over the streets and parc below. It was quiet at night even though the bedrooms face the street and there are several restaurants downstairs opposite the apartment. The beds were large and comfy. The apartment is very well equipped and tastefully furnished. Everything seems very new and it was spotlessly clean.
Marine was a very pleasant host. She was very responsive and flexible with the arrival and departure time. And she generously allowed us to park our car and bycicles in the parking garage.
There are plenty of nice Restaurants in the area, especially on Gleimstr.

Awesome apartment, the view from the living room is spectacular. Very modern furniture and clean.Marine was very helpful during the whole process. Perfect location: only 10mon walking distance from s-bahn and u-bahn which bring you directly into the Mitte. A lot of different reustarants in the area and 24hrs shop for all your needs. I would definitely recommend it and choose it again.

Marine was a very attentive host. She was there late at night when we arrived and early in the morning when we left. The apartment was exactly as described and clean. The kitchen was well equipped and all appliances worked properly. The neighbourhood is nice, with a park and a few restaurants across the street. A few blocks away there are cool small stores and cafes. The closest public transportation (tram) is 650 meters away. We were a party of 4 with kids and would definitely stay there again.

This apartment is lovely and much more spacious than the photos suggest.  We stayed here with 2 couples and a 2-year-old.  There was plenty of room for us all and Marine provided a baby bed and high chair.  The kitchen was very well-equipped, the beds comfortable, and the decor very nice and stylish.  The apartment is close to Mauer Park and has a great view of the park and neighborhood.  There are lots of wonderful restaurants, coffee shops, gelato shops, and playgrounds nearby.  Marine was an excellent host and communicated clearly.  Overall, a great stay and we would definitely recommend this apartment!

We had a lovely sunny week in Marine's apartment in Prenzlauer Berg in October.  The apartment is very comfortable and is very light and sunny with floor to ceiling windows looking south over the MauerPark.  All superb modern amenities.  Our flight from Bristol was very late but Matthias met us to let us in at 2200 without a problem. The location is excellent and U and S Bahn connections are really good from Schonauser Allee station 10 minutes walk away.  There is also a tram to the centre.  Plenty of good cafes and restaurants in the area.

For a wonderful place to stay in Berlin, look no further. The apartment is spacious and beautifully decorated.  The comfortable beds ensured a good night’s sleep. The huge windows that brought in lots of light added to the positive vibe. There are lots of places to relax within the flat. We loved staying at Marine’s. It was so well equipped with everything we could possibly want…..plus more. The place is very generous with basic staples for meals at home. Prezlauer Berg is a delightful and charming neighborhood with excellent restaurants and close to public transportation. We highly recommend Marine’s place. Excellent and quick communication too. Thanks, Marine

Marine was excellent and welcomed us personally on arrival. She was also extremely responsive to any questions we had during our stay.
The apartment is quite large and very airy and light. We had hot weather for our stay, there was no aircon but the fans kept us cool.
There are many eateries close by. The train and tram are about a 10 min walk away.
I would highly recommend this beautiful apartment.

Very friendly (French) welcome. Really large appartment with very nice big bedroom and ensuite bathroom. The second bedroom has a separate bathroom. Quiet location next to Mauerpark. Everything was spic and span, the kitchen has everything you need. Nice interior with cosy corners and nice and original lights. Highly recommended!

Great place to stay!  One of the days we stayed was on New Years Eve and you could see all of the fireworks… it was amazing!  There’s a cute bakery next door that was an every stop.  The apartment is so welcoming and our host was great to work with.

We were very pleased with all aspects of our stay in Marine's apartment. She made special arrangements for our entry because of our later arrival time.
The apartment is beautiful, very comfortable and spotlessly clean. The location is excellent for getting around Berlin and we appreciated the easy access to the delights or Prenzlauer Berg.

This stylish corner apartment on a quiet street near the Mauer Park is fabulous. It's very modern, well equipped with everything you need in the kitchen and bathrooms.  The bathrooms are large and everything works well. The beds are very comfortable with high quality linens. Marine is a communicative and generous host. She has many interesting books and guides in the apartment and the furnishings are stylish and functional. It wasn't too hot when we were in Berlin, but in case it was she has fans available in each room. The apartment is also very comfortable with two balcony's and many seating areas. It's also well located, an easy walking distance to shopping, restaurants, and cafe's, and several S and U Bahn trains as well as trams and buses. I hope to stay again sometime!

Mr. Haselberger's apartment in Berlin is very spacious, lighted and located conveniently in Mitte. We have enjoyed it very much, as well as Mr. Haselberger's hospitality and assistance. These made or visit to Berlin a wonderful experience.
Tzipi and Sachi Gerlitz

Amazing apartment with great energies which definitely enhanced our Berlin experience.
Two bathrooms are a big plus.

I'd recommend it to small group of friends or couples.

Great location with public transit, restaurants, and a park all within a half block. The apartment was spacious, modern, and well appointed.
Winni was a fantastic host, providing recommendations on local venues and helped troubleshoot travel issues we encountered. Would highly recommend!

Very well presented place. Location was amazing as it was walking distance from all the amenities. Youth was an amazing host and very kind with us. I will recommend 100% this place to anyone thinking on visiting Berlin

Nice flat, very well located, next to a subway station. The apartment is calm, not the best place to go out every night but perfect for sightseeeing. Ruth is ver nice but doesn't speak english at all (german or spanish).

She didn't contact even I tried a lot of times.. and she didn't know about exactly schedule. She just asked me why we didn't go even before.
stay was good and warm except to relationship with her.
Had a wonderful time staying at Frau Miller’s. The location is fantastic, transportation right outside the door. The space was lovely, clean and bright. Would happily stay again!

The apartment was clean, nicely decorated and situated in a beautiful neighbourhood directly across from a subway stop. All major sites are within walking distance. Ruth was very hospitable and it was a pleasure to communicate with her.

Perfect location for our visit to Berlin.
Easily reached via the underground and directions shared when we landed in Berlin.
Comfortable and secure surroundings which was perfect to be our base for all we needed to do. It had all we needed!

- good location
- walkable
- right next to a subway station
- clean
- only drawback is no freezer compartment in the refrigerator for ice-cream and no parking
We couldn’t have imagined a more perfect place to stay for our trip to Berlin. Dirk and Anke were super understanding and helpful! We would definitely come back again! :)
We liked our stay in Pankow very much; it's a great penthouse in a green, nice and quiet neighbourhood not too far from the city centre and very friendly hosts!
It is very nice house and good location, Alke is a very nice and friendly host.

What an amazing apartment. Funky, spacious (incredibly spacious!), fabulous bathroom, huge kitchen: just perfect.

Anke and her lovely husband made us so incredibly welcome, and we all want to return as soon as possible.

Pankow's a beautiful district in the suburbs, but we could walk to the Berlin Pankow S/U-bahn station in about 5 minutes, and then be in the centre of Berlin in about 15-20 minutes. Yes, all was definitely perfect!

Very special place. Such a surprise when you push the door for the first time... Top floor flat, spacious, bright and quiet, ideally designed for families or friends/family group like us (8 persons). We have all really enjoyed Alke's interiors taste and even more her artworks. Alke was very welcoming, very well organised and flexible for the keys and left a few useful tips about the neighborhood are available on the table. For sure Alke's flat has been part of the success of our week-end in Berlin.

Alke's apartment is great, so spacious and in a really good area with easy walks to tram and train stations into the city. We enjoyed using it as a base whilst we stayed the weekend in Berlin. The facilities are really good, there is a great shower and bath and the kitchen has everything you need. There is a park down the road and a restaurant on the street below and local shops close by. We loved the design and style of the rooms with big art works on the walls. We had a nice time there, thanks Alke!!
Superb! We had a great time and it was the perfect place to base ourselves. Everything we needed was there and plenty of space for us.
Great stay in Berlin! The flat is spacious and atypical, communication with the hosts was very easy.

Great place! with lots of room. We were four adults and two Kids. The appartment has an awesome playroom which the kids enjoyed. The location is great, near shopping, train and busses. The host is quick at reponding and very kind in her answers. Over all great stay!

The apartment was clean and comfortable located in a quiet neighbourhood. Garden and outside terrace was beautiful. Ursula responded fast and answered all our questions. Definitely was worth the money and advise this AirBnB to others!

Pretty and quiet area, near to the palace. Great location for walking and running! The bus 109, U-Bahn and S-Bahn are all within a walking distance, so it's easy to get around Berlin.
The apartment was clean and stylish, very quiet and larger than it looks. The big TV in the living room was a huge plus. The host was really friendly and the communication was great! I definitely recommend staying at this place.

The apartment was clean and located very close to several subways stops. The Bellevue stop which is just a few blocks away has a couple of neighborhood restaurants as well. The owner was waiting for me on the street as promised and even allowed an early morning check in, which really helped out after our long flight. Initially I felt I might be too far away from the action, but because of the subway access it was nice to be in a quiet neighborhood at night and still only a short distance from everything. Also, the price was very reasonable for Berlin. My wife and I would stay here again.
The apartment is very well equiped, everything was perfect, the area very well connected to the city allowing us to visit without any problem ……we will be back!.......

This Berlin studio is perfect. We stayed for a week while I was attending at course at HKW - which was in walking distance along the river. The studio is lovely, clean and relaxing. It has everything you need - and all directions on internet, washing machine ect. are clear. It is a bit far from some of the tourist sites of Berlin, but very close to all public transport and the airport. Definitely recommended!

Very nice compact apartment which was very clean and conveniently located for rapid transport to the city.  Even in the very hot weather the ceiling fan kept us cool at night and the balcony was nice during the day.  We will be back!

Annika’s place was GREAT! It was the absolute perfect location to reach everything in the city. The balcony was fabulous and the train stops are a super close walk! She also had a bottle of champagne waiting for my boyfriend and I when we got there. Thank you Annika! :)
The place was perfect for my stay in  Berlin, very close to public transport and markets, and a relaxing spot after a bust day!

Cosy studio, well equiped, with a lovely view from the balcony, what you see in the photos is what you get. Great location, close to public transport and supermarket, in a quiet neighborhood. We definetely recomend it.

Johannes was very good host and everything went perfectly fine! The apartment was just like I expected and the location was very good. The neighbourhood was peaceful but it didn´t took too long to go the citycenter.

Few minutes from main metro/train lines, supermarket, nice cafe and just 15 min by slow walk to huge park.
Rabbits and squirrel are in the yard))
We enjoy it a lot :)

Annika's flat is nicely located in the leafy Hansaviertel district, on the edge of the Tiergarten. It's just 4 blocks from the Bellevue S Bahn station and the Hansaplatz U Bahn station. There's a market at the U Bahn, a bakery and an excellent Croatian restaurant at the S Bahn station, and an Irish pub just down the street.
The balcony is wonderful in the evening and the morning. There's a Getränk markt next door for wine or beer.
In the summer, it can be hot, and the flat faces west, so, even with the drapes closed, it can be warm in the afternoon. The ceiling fan was welcome.
The bathroom was small, but functional. However, the faucet only delivered a trickle of actually cold water. It would have been nice if there were a hook on the back of the door to hang a towel.

Really pleasant moment in this flat. Really calm, 15min of walk/train from the center. Really clean, there was everything I needed in this place.
Best place to chill after a long city-walking day.
I would recommend

I had a fantastic experience at this airbnb! The host was incredibly kind, meeting me upon arrival and providing helpful tips. The location is excellent with close proximity to both S and U-bahn, and a beautiful park nearby. The apartment is well-equipped for cooking, which was convenient. Overall, I thoroughly enjoyed my stay. If there's one suggestion, having a washing machine would enhance the experience for longer stays.

A really cool place, surprisingly big, with high ceilings, and in an old-style building with lots of atmosphere and a great courtyard. The location was also great, with plenty of nice places to eat and drink within a few blocks (recommend Mutter Courage at the corner of Schönhauser Allee), and very easy subway access. Henrik and Sven were quite nice, too. All-around good experience.

The apartment was very cosy and everything was working. It was also very clean. The location was also great close to metro station.
Henrik was also a great host! I have nothing to complain about.

Henrik's building was an excellent location for us. We especially appreciated being met at the street by Sven (very easy to contact him for coordination) and his help in holding our luggage briefly as we had arrived rather early.

We enjoyed this perfectly situated, comfortable and quiet flat. Easy to get to with great access to public transit - even though most of Berlin's interesting sights are only a pleasant walk away. As well there is easy walking access to groceries and excellent restaurants and cafes.

Very comfortable and quiet. Recommended.

We loved staying in this apartment!  It was clean and nicely located and had everything we needed including nice hosts.  They went out of their way to email us a long list of sights and good restaurants, music venues, etc.  Thank you Sven and Henrik!

As usual for our city destination, we choose first an area, then we build from it.  Prenzlauerberg was a perfect choice in Berlin and Henrik's flat a great asset to our stay.  That was another flawless experience from booking to leaving. The flat - located on the 2nd floor, is actually bigger than how it appears on the pictures (fantastic high ceilings).  It's arty but cool, it is cosy but with an edge, in the end it is perfectly gemütlich.  It was also very quiet (double insulation & courtyard), clean and super warm (November).  A comfy bed, a spacious bathroom, candles in the kitchen... all contributed to a great, long weekend in the city.  The organic supermarket nearby, the bars (Scotch & Sofa for cocktails!) and the restaurants... all was so convenient that we did not leave the area at night!

My stay at Henriks Apartment was lovely. He is such a sympathetic, friendly and helpful host. The garden in the backyard is beautifull and perfect to relax.
The Apartment is embraced by many restaurants, bars and supermarkets.
I would definitly love to come back. Thanks for this nice experience

What a lovely place. I could live in this apartment. So nice to be greeted by someone who lived in the building and obviously took pride in their home. Fantastic abnb. Excellent area if you are looking for something slightly more upmarket and the urbane street wear shopping close by is world class.

Henrik and Sven were the most wonderful hosts. They went out of their way to make our arrival and departure as convenient as possible, and they are just about the kindest hosts you will meet. The apartment is lovely and very well kept up. Not to mention that it is a fabulous location. We would most certainly stay again if we are back in Berlin!!
Henrik was very nice and helpful. The flat is great, in a calm district, we enjoyed all the time spent there. All the highlights are easy to reach with U-Bahn. It was a fantastic experience.

Sven and Henrik are the best. The flat is beautiful, light and tastefully decorated. The neighborhood is lined with trees, cafes, cobblestone streets and interesting shops. It's so close to the center of Berlin but you may not even want to venture further from home.

The space is spacious, well decorated and very very clean which we highly appreciated.
The location of the apartment is close to the city centre and in a very nice and quiet neighbourhood. There are two main metro stations nearby which are easily reachable within walking distance.

Henrik was super friendly and the communication with him was perfect before and during our stay. On our departure day he offered us to leave one bag at his place and to pick it up later, so we could enjoy Berlin the whole afternoon.

During our stay there was just a small glitch with the Internet Connection.

Very pleasant stay and highly recommended!

What a gorgeous stay in Berlin and a huge part of this was the wonderful accommodation! We received a warm welcome and had the flat and amenities explained to us. The flat itself is beautiful with everything one could possibly need. It was clean and spacious and set in a gorgeous block. The area is accessible to the heart of Berlin but is also calm and stunning. We spent many of our evenings strolling around the cobbled streets and eating out locally! Wonderful! I couldn't recommend this place enough! Henrik and Sven are doing a brilliant job!
I just spend one day in Henrik's flat but everything was ok. The place has everything you might need and is well connected with public transport. Great ;-)
Henrik and Sven were very nice and welcoming. The apartment is beautifully furnished and located in a very central yet quiet area. Highly recommend for a stay in Berlin!

Truly enjoyed the flat...conveniently located in a very cool part of X-berg, close to great restaurants, and the Wasserturm, which has a charming park. M8 tram got me everywhere, it's a block and a half away.
Two metro stops also close. Lots of light in the room, clean and comfortable.

This apartment was the perfect place to explore Berlin. It was much bigger than it looked in the photos and had all necessary amenities. The building itself is so charming and really makes for a special stay. The location is also great, as the immediate area is very up market, but it's close enough to get to the centre of the city and all the sights!

Well cultivated, kind and ready to help is Mr Henrik, the host.
The apartement is better in reality than on pictures. Very clean, central, near transport and places we needed to visit.
I would definetely recommend this place!!!

Henrik's place surrounds a quiet, pretty courtyard in a block off the road just a few minutes' walk from the Rosa-Luxemburg-Platz U-bahn in one direction, and the cool bars and restaurants of Prenzlauer Berg in the other.
The flat was clean, comfortable, stylishly decorated and quiet, and it also stayed really cool during our stay which was much appreciated during the heatwave we had while there!
Communication was excellent, and we took advantage of Henrik's suggestion to try the Italian restaurant Osteria Fiorini a few minutes' walk away – it was top notch!
I wouldn't hesitate to recommend Henrik's place to any couples looking for a comfortable and calm retreat that's walking distance from all the excitement that Berlin has to offer.

My boyfriend and I were traveling through Europe and had 3 nights in Berlin. Henrik's apartment was wonderful for our stay. It is located in a great area with lots of really cool restaurants, bars and cafes within walking distance. The area is also very safe so we were able to explore by foot both day and night. The apartment is a great size with high ceilings and lots of windows. The bed was unfortunately two twin beds that were separated which was kind of a bummer for us as we were expected a bed, but other than that the apartment was a lovely place. I definitely recommend staying at Henrik's for two people traveling to Berlin!

Henrik is a great host. He is incredibly friendly and easy to communicate with. His place is spacious, clean and located in a great neighborhood. He made the whole process incredibly easy. When I had to unexpectedly stay in Berlin for an additional day, he without hesitation allowed me to keep my bags at his place until I could find new accommodation, even though he had new guests coming in immediately after me.

We loved this apartment, especially the massive plant!  The location was good for roaming around Berlin and the apartment was very clean and quiet.  Henrik was great and very accommodating, thanks for a wonderful stay.

Such a perfect, charming place and location for our time in Berlin! Hosts were great with communication and helped us with logistics and local tips before we even got to Berlin. Walkable to boutiques, cafes, and the city center, and a subway station a couple blocks away made it super easy for us to get around. Would definitely recommend and stay again!

Quiet, comfortable, cozy, and a great location. Henrik is prompt and considerate with communication. Perfect spot for a light sleeper. Location is excellent. One note, the beds are 2 separate singles in two single frames. They cannot be fully pushed together to make a double. Other than that, the place is perfect. Would highly recommend. Thank you Henrik!
Awesome location. Beautiful clean place to stay. Henrik and Sven gave great tips on where to go and were quick to respond to any questions. Would definitely stay here again!!

Great place, fab location with a funky vibe.
On qualms were it was two single beds instead of a double! Thanks, was a lovely visit
A lovely quaint apartment in a great location. Though we never got to meet Henrik, the check in experience was super easy and he was very helpful and easy to communicate with.

The appartment is located in a residential building in a vibrant area of Berlin. Strassburger Strasse itself and the neighbouring streets are quiet and peacefull with a lot of cosy and trendy bars and restaurants on walking distance. The place itself is really quiet as it is situated at the inner courtyard. The bathroom is a bit outdated but everything is in working order and - bonus! - the water heats real quick. Pick up and drop off of the key is straight forward and real easy.
We definetely recommend this place for a great visit to Berlin!

Henrik is very helpful and reacts quick to any question. The apartment is nice and perfect located in Prenzlauer berg. I can be reached easily by public transport. We can really recommend this apartment

Henrik is so nice, very enthusiastic to help solve my problem, and also made a guide to the surrounding shops and restaurants, the apartment is also very good, very close to the city center, the transport transfer is also very convenient, I’m satisfied, excellent impression :))
We had a lovely stay in Henrik’s small and colourful apartment. The house was clean and very central in the city.

Fantastic neighborhood for walking around. Lots of local restaurants and shops within a short walk. The room layout was interesting (hard to imagine living there full-time), but worked well for our stay. We really liked pretending we were locals.

Henrik’s place was the perfect place for us! So easy to find and access, Henrik’s instructions were super helpful and easy to follow. Everything was clean and comfortable, very good value for money. Would definitely recommend!!

Great location, within walking distance to the tube and metro. It is also just a few steps away from a traditional German pub, so worth going the food was delicious. The flat is very quiet and has impressive high ceilings. I would recommend this place!

Henrik is a great host. The apartment is easy to find,clean and enough for two people.You can go everywhere by walking.
Thanks for your kindness Henrik.

I stayed 5 nights in Henrik's place and it was the perfect home base while visiting Berlin - close and walkable to many things, and on the edge of Prenzlauerberg with all its cute shops and restaurants.

We enjoyed our stay in Henrik's apartment very much. It was very tidy and it has a cosy feeling. It was equipped with everything one could need.
Its location is perfect, with walking distance to a lot of sights if you visit as a tourist. The neighbourhood is also very nice and the apartment was actually very quiet.
We can recommend this to anyone visiting Berlin!

Great location, apartment was really cool and trendy. The apartment was super clean and there were a few basics in the kitchen and bathroom left for us to use which was really useful! I would definitely recommend staying here and would go again, also super conveniently located by bus and tram stops
Henrik's place was just what we were looking for during our trip to Berlin. Walking distance to great food, as well as things to see, plus close to transit.

This is the perfect base to explore Berlin, Henrik is super helpful with his instructions , the apartment is spacious with everything you need to cook, as well as this it's close to the Tram and metro. Peaceful in the evening to relax after a day's exploration.
The appartment is easy to access, it is close to several busy public transport areas. Thomas preapared a brochure to the appartment and the city which was very useful!  "Alles in Ordnung"

Thomas place was great, it was clean and has all the necessary things. Is good connected to the city center with a bus and has a lot of supermarket close. Me and my family had a good experience there.

Thomas was very helpful, he provided all the necessary information, he came too greet us upon arrival. We also had no trouble finding the apartment, as he gave us directions that we could easily follow.

Thomas’ apartment was located very close to the centre and had all the basic amenities we needed for 4 people. It was very clean and the host replied to all our messages instantly, even coming to the apartment to meet us himself when we checked in. Thanks for a wonderful stay! Highly recommend!

Thomas is a great host! Easy communication, clear information and prompt support! I needed to reach him late at night because I got confused on how to open the door, and he was fantastic! Highly recommended!

The apartment is really lovely, the lift works well and had no issues getting to the apartment. The apartment is really clean and there's a lot of space. It does come with the usual amenities. One thing that was unexpected was that the bed came with two single duvets instead of one large one. There's lots of light in the apartment and the kitchen is also stocked with crockery and cutlery. There are lots of supermarkets nearby as well as great transport links. As a tourist however I did find myself travelling about an average of  1 hour each way to different touristy spots. I did really like this location however as it is a lot quieter and it made me feel more like a local. I would recommend this place and I would stay here again.
This apartment was nice and it was quite easy to travel around, because there were bus stops and tube station nearby. There were everything we needed.
Very nice and comfy place, the location is close to the city center, the neighborhood has a lot of stores around.

"We traveled with two young children and had a wonderful experience! We highly recommend this place to others!
Here are the highlights of what we loved:
Comfortable bed
Quiet apartment
Public transportation conveniently close by
Great dining options nearby
Grocery store within walking distance
Playground right by the tram stop
Only 20 minutes by metro from the zoo
Excellent communication with the host
Overall, our stay was fantastic and we would definitely stay here again on our next visit. Thank you for providing such a welcoming and family-friendly environment!"

This was a very comfortable stay. The surrounding area had a lot of different takeaway restaurants and also cafes. The room was warm, the bathroom was clean, and the host was very friendly and helpful.
I wouldn’t suggest anyone to stay in this place it was unpleasant and very noisy and dim light full of depression
We had a really nice stay in Annas apartment. It was located very near to the city centre, in an amazing area with many cute, small shops. Would definitely recommend the apartment.

Very nice place to stay! Good location, very clean apartment, flexible for check in and out, located in a quit street an plenty of maps.

Thank you Anna!

We stayed here for one night and it was perfect for what we needed. The place was just like in the pictures. Anna was quick on the response time and had our keys waiting which meant we didn't have to wait out in the cold like some other AirBnB's until someone shows up. Just a heads up that linens and towels are not included and are extra- I missed that but Anna was very accommodating.

Our experience in Anna's house was great! The environment is very confortable. The location is strategic and very close to the center and to the main connection points. We had 3 perfect days in Berlin! Anna was always available to answer to your questions. We strongly recommend this beautiful place!
Enjoyed our stay. Great location. Clean and quiet though we weren't there at a weekend.
Booked because of location and flexible checkout. Location and amenities were great but communication regarding arrival and check out did not go as smoothly as planned.

We stayed at Anna's place in dec 2016.  The place is exactly as described; spacious, clean and well stocked.   The location is great, located on a quiet residential area steps away from great restaurants and easy access to train stops.  Highly recommend

Our stay was very pleasant at Anna's appartment. The indications were very clear and our late arrival was no problem since we picked up the keys at a hotel very close to the flat. The apartment is clean and spacious.

Great location. Nice flat with basic amenities. Very clean. In a safe neighborhood close proximity to train station and many good restaurants. There isn't an elevator which wasn't a problem because my kids can carry their own luggage. We had a very enjoyable stay.

The apartment was nice and spacious. Also location was good and there were many good restaurants nearby. Only things we didn’t like was that apartment was bit dusty and floors very squeaky. But definitely would recommend it.

Had a lovely time in Berlin despite the cold and really enjoyed staying at Anna’s flat. Very spacious and warm,well furnished  andin quiet neighbourhood. The flat is in a great location very near the S bahn station Nordbahnhof and if you like walking most of the main sites are within half hour walk. Lovely restaurant Neumond literally 2 minutes across the street. Other amenities e.g supermarkets also close by. Really recommend this flat and would stay here again if we return.

Excellent location for Berlin centre. Near a U Bahn, but also well within walking range (15-20 mins). Good living space in the apartment and clean, though perhaps needs some TLC / modernisation. Arrangements all fine and a map and some recommendations provided which was useful. Restaurant Neumond just down the road was excellent

Anna’s apartment is even better than it looks on the website. Lovely large spaces within short walking distances of many Berlin attractions, fantastic bars and restaurants. We had an absolutely fantastic time and could not recommend it more highly.
Great appartment, nice big rooms with modern kitchen. Really handy to metro, s-bahn and trams. Great Syrian food just around the corner. I highly recommend Anna's appartment. It was perfect for us.

Great apartment in quiet street but in close walking distance to everything you need. Bright and airy, lot of space and we'll appointed. The host Anna is quick to reply to any communication. Recommended.
Anna’s place is in a great location. The apartment was clean, comfortable and had everything we needed to enjoy a great weekend in Berlin!
The place is spacious and clean, in a good location. Anna is very easy to communicate with and responsive. I stayed there for more than a week and i appreciated the well equipped kitchen.

Anna was a great host with a great property. Clear instructions and always responsive. The apartment was perfect for our needs, well equipped and in a perfect location to explore Berlin. We had a great stay.

My friends and I LOVED our stay at Anna's place. The apartment was spacious, clean, and in a great location. I would definitely stay here if I go to Berlin again, and recommend it to others. Thanks again, Anna!
Nice stay at Anna’s place. It’s close to nearby transit, restaurants and major sights in Berlin. The apartment is spacious and had everything we needed for our stay.
Great apartment in good location for exploring Berlin. Lovely neighbourhood with a good selection of restaurants and cafes nearby. We loved our stay here

Had a lovely few days at Anna’s place. It’s spotlessly clean and conveniently located for public transport access. The flat is very bright and airy- it felt so fresh.
I would definitely stay again.
Thank you Martina for welcoming us straight from the Airport. It was very convenient. We had a good time in this extremely well located flat.

Martina's apartment is in a great location. Easy walking distance to a lot of the major sights in Berlin. It was plenty of space for 3 people. It was cozy and comfortable. There is a 30 euro city tax that we were told to pay and unaware of, so just be prepared to provide that on arrival.
Very nice apartment in a perfect location. The only problem was that we found a little water leak in the bathroom.

The neighborhood seemed totally safe, it was near the river and museums, very near the S Bahn Friederichstr. The location was really quite perfect. The apartment itself was very comfortable with large rooms, very usable kitchen and a cozy balcony.  Best of all, it was quiet.

Excellent location. 5 minute walk to U-bahn and S-bahn as well as tram. Quiet building and plenty of space including an eat in kitchen and two large bedrooms: one for adults and one for kids. Price was very good and grocery store was nearby. Our host was very attentive to helping me sort out sim card issues (above and beyond the call).  Nonetheless - unrelated to this stay - worth sorting out your phone before arriving in Germany as makes communication about places much easier.

We had a great stay at Martina's place. The location is just perfect, great shops and restaurants close-by. And it was so easy to get to the theatre venues and other turistic attractions. It's big enough for a bigger group or a family. Martina was a very helpful and kind hostess.
The place is amazing! The location couldn’t be better and it totally accompanied our berlin experience. The house has a really cool vibe and had everything we needed. We will definitely come back!

Very nice and interesting place, I would love to know when the building was built and some history! (during a river tour the building near by was used by the military). The location was key, close to major attractions like Alexanderplatz, Gendarmenmarkt, and the Brandenburg gate. many places to eat and for late nights a Kebab place near the station. we rented a car so the parking garage wasn't too far, just on the other side of the tracks. your view is of the courtyard area so there's no light from the streets coming in and very very quiet! You most likely will be asked what time is your check out and if it changes make sure to let Gabi know

The flat was perfectly located within easy walking distance of brandenburg gate and very close to train station. A few issues which we have flagged with the owner but all in all a lovely venue. We didn’t use nearby restaurants but seemed a good selection. Also close to art museums

We enjoyed our stay at Martina's apartment. It was spacious and comfortable and quiet. It had easy access to transport and was very close to museum island. We would happily stay there again and Martina was a good host

Martina place is right in Mitte which is a great location to walk to Brandenburg gate, and museaum island.  it is also close to the river, great for cafes and restaurants.  train station is close which makes it easy to get around Berlin.  would definitely  stay here again.

Peaceful as it is situated within a private courtyard.
The apartment size is good for a group. Quite an eclectic place which makes the apartment interesting and a tad sterile.
Close to public transport.

The apartment was really nice, clean, quiet and situated in a neighborhood with great little restaurants (vietnamese, Korean, Indonesian, Italian). It is easy to get to U train and bus. We rented a bicycle just around the corner. Everything you need was present in the apartment.  A lot of clean towels, wifi, brochures about Berlin. Would defenitely recommend it to other people.
thank you very much, we had an excellent stay in your very nice apartment. Would stay here again!!!
A bare-bones-apartment with a few prettifications... located in the back house, next to a school and kindergarten with the associated noise level, especially in summer.
Nice place, clean, pretty quiet and close to restaurants. Hosts responded very quickly. Would recommend staying here.
Great host and great flat! Very pretty, comfortable  and centrally located in a beautiful neighborhood. Even nicer than it looks in the pictures.
Great place with great location. Quiet place with u-/s-bahn in a walking distance makes it easy to get around Berlin. Easy and fast communication. Recommend.
The appartement is a nice space in the back of the building and has a beautiful main room, perfect for a city trip. It was equiped  with everything I needed.

Jörg's place was very well equipped (pans, basic cooking ingredients, extra towels, etc). It was close to many restaurants with different cuisines, so there is sure to be something you like nearby. The bed was very comfortable and the place was spacious. The fact that there was both a washer and a dryer in the apartment was nice. It isn't within comfortable walking distance to many attractions but there are metro and bus stops close by. Overall great stay!

My daughter and I loved staying at jorg’s place. It was perfect , felt right at home, location is amazing and the place is even more beautiful in real life. When we will come back to Berlin, we will definitely stay there again.

Nice, spacious apartment. Strong WiFi. Subway station is just few steps from  the entrance. Would be better if living room windows can be opened to get fresh air. Also, it needs fan for hot summer.   Both  bathrooms  have showers which was excellent. Check in instructions were sent late by a contact person through WhatsApp,  so be aware as our Airbnb messages got no  response from the owner. We were provided with two sets of keys that was must appreciated. The fridge wasn't working properly.

The apartment is very nice, particularly bright and with optimal spaces. The kitchen has everything you need. The bathroom has perfect spaces. The bed is particularly comfortable. A nice balcony also convenient for lunch or breakfast. I am very happy to have been to Ute’s apartment. She was very kind and helpful.

Ute’s apartment is very comfortable and cosy with a fantastic view from the 6th floor over the square and such an ideal location within footsteps of the U Bahn and supermarket and shopping all in easy walking distance. Such a wonderful space and a perfect base from which to explore Berlin. A great stay… thank you!
Very nice appartement on perfect location. All what you need is there. Nice and perfect communication as well. We will come back :-)

The apartment is exactly like the pictures, spotless and tidy. It has all the furniture and utensils for a very comfortable stay. The receptionist was very friendly and received us very well! He made us feel welcome, offered us help with our bags, and gave us advice on the rules of stay. Chat communication was quick and efficient. Nothing to complain about, everything was good.
I really loved this place and would definitely recommend it!

Great location. Nice place. Easy to check in. Easy to check out. Communication was quick and responsive. Location is accessible to grocery stores, transportation,  restaurants, coffee shops, bars, and historical sites. A great experience.

the appartment is sweet and cosy, and the hosts did everything to make our stay nice and comfortable. we travelled with kid (15 month), and it was a  perfect location, both place and location in berlin. i can only recommend  it.

Henriks apartment was our first airbnb booking and it was just perfect! The apartment is very clean, cosy, central, quiet and spacious enough for two people. Public transportation, bars and restaurants are all very close and a lot of sight-seeing places are just a few minutes away. Henrik and Sven are very friendly and helpful. Thank you for everything!
I highly recommend this apartment to everyone who wants to visit Berlin. We will definitely come again!
Great location in Berlin Mitte, beautiful and clean flat! Close by are many pubs, resturants, shopping, sightseeing... ! Henrik and Sven are really friendly and nice! I realy reccomend this flat :)
Great place - clean, comfortable and well located. Very easy to make arrangements with the friendly hosts. What more do you need? I can only recommend this place.
Lovely appartment, near U-Bahn, for 3 days in Berlin (or more!) it's perfect ! Thks to Henrik & Bruno

Henrik and Sven were gracious, helpful, and incredibly accommodating hosts to my girlfriend and I. We had never been to Berlin, and when we arrived at the flat, we were thrilled with the location. Sven and Henrik provided us with suggestions, i.e. Best curry wurst, which proved to be a valuable commodity in such a massive city. We could not have asked for a better situation or two better hosts

Lovely little apartment in a really good location which had everything we needed, it was clean and tidy and just as described! The hosts were really relaxed and very helpful, making suggestions for things to do that day and and throughout our trip. We wouldn't think twice about staying here again!
This place was hands down the best airbnb we have ever stayed at. It is very charming and comfortable, and perfect for a stay in Berlin.
Lovely flat in a very vibrant and interesting area of Berlin. Henrik made me very welcome for my short visit. I intend to come back soon, so that I have more time to explore this wonderful city.

The apartment is very well located.
We received great pointers tours and restaurants.
We Talked a lot with our host and we highly recommend the hotel safely.
Thanks for everything!
Also love meeting the dogs.
Luizana and Junior

Great place in excellent location, great owner, very glad to met.
Got great rest and comfort conditions, owner gave us best service!

What a great little gem. The apartment was in a very central location and had everything you needed for a nice weekend trip. Henrik and Sven were easy to get in touch with and were very kind in sharing tips and recommendations for our stay. Great experience!
Henrik's place was a great place to stay. The location is excellent and Henrik provided a lot of tips for eating etc in the neighbourhood.

This stay was great! Scenes and Henrik were great hosts, both with regards to flexibility on arrival/departure as well as amble information both before and during our stay. We got a great bunch of tips and followed several of them. All in all we felt very welcome! Prenzlauer Berg is perhaps the nicest area of Berlin and the apartment is perfectly situated close to shops and cafés - and equally in walking distance from Alexanderplatz, from where you can take the train to/from the airport. We would definitely stay here another time!

Very nice and cosy appartment and nice and friendly host.The appartment is situated in Strassburger Strasse with very little traffic so no noise and is the area where Mitte and Prenzlauer Berg meets so very close both to Mitte and Prenzlauer Berg.Will be very glad to go back there and recommends highly

The flat was perfect for our short break: in a very peaceful area (when we first arrived we managed to sleep for almost 12 hours), but also within a few minutes of a supermarket and the U2 underground line. We cooked breakfasts and dinners ourselves, prepared sandwiches for the day and could then get to the main points of interest in Berlin very easily, saving a lot of money that would usually have been spent eating out. Much better than a standard hotel room!
We had a really great stay, the apartment is perfect for a holiday in Berlin. Sven was really friendly and helpful and we had a lot of nice meals and coffees in Prenzlauer Berg.

The small apartment was absolutely incredible, the interior is classy and stylish, the apartment super clean and really cosy! The small kitchen is fully equipped and the bed really comfortable.

I enjoyed my stay at Henrik's very much and was welcomed very kindly when I arrived late in the evening. I can highly recommend his apartment for a trip to Berlin.
Thank you very much!
It was a great experience  for a stay even only one night. Simple but elegant... you can find all the things you need as a traveller.

I had an amazing time in Berlin, and Henrik's flat was the perfect place to stay!! Just a short walk to the underground and easy, fun walking in the neighborhood. I only wish I had a little more time to stay. Henrik and Sven were wonderful hosts. They gave some great recommendations of things to do, places to go & eat. Really enjoyed my dinner at Osteria fiorella!!
Thanks for the wonderful hospitality. Loved the flat. Perfect Berlin experience.
We had an incredible stay at Henrik's place! The appartment had a great location, it was super clean and cosy! I can do nothing except recommend this!!

Lovely flat! Surrounded by cafes,  bars and restaurants and a quick metro ride to the main tourist attractions in Berlin.  Really enjoyed staying here.  Henrik was welcoming and helpful and this cozy apartment made our stay even better!
Great little apartment, perfect for our needs, very cosy, clean and tastefully decorated. Great location and good value. The hosts were helpful and informative. Would certainly stay again.

Henrik and Sven were fantastic! We enjoyed the flat and them very much. The flat was a great little place and the location was good and in a quiet neighborhood. Their communication was awesome and they held our bags so we cold check out at a later time. The place is old but that was what made it so special and very nice to stay in!! We highly recommend staying here. They are truly great!
Great location! Near subway station and super market. Quiet place to sleep as well. I had a really good time there.

This apartment was a lovely place to enjoy our Berlin stay. The character of the building was gorgeous, we loved it here, great neighbourhood, lovely safe streets to walk around, close to many restaurants and a bio supermarket. Also the Wall Museum was within walking distance. But if you have had a busy day on your feet the underground was very close by. Henrik was great, lots of info provided and one of his recommended local Italian restaurants Osterio Fiorello was a definite winner for us, ate their on two out of three nights. Highly recommend this apartment.
Henrik's place was amazing.  He met us right when we arrived and gave amazing recommendations.  The location was perfect for exploring and close to transit.  We look forward to staying there again.

Henrik's place is great! It was spacious, very clean, and had a comfortable and large bed.
I loved the neighborhood; there's lots of delicious restaurants to try nearby and close to the metro to get about anywhere in Berlin.
I would definitely recommend Henrik's place to any friends traveling to Berlin!

This apartment is in a wonderful location.  The area was quiet and residential but still close to many restaurants, bars & shops.  You would not have thought you were in a major city and Berlin is so easy to get around that location is irrelevant.  The apartment was spacious and comfortable.  It offered everything we needed.  Henrik is a great host, his communication was spot on and he was there to greet us, as arranged, with lots of information and tips.

Absolutely LOVED it! The neighborhood is fantastic, Henrik was a host above and beyond, the place is super cute and has everything you need. I only wish we could've stayed longer! Don't hesitate, book today!

This flat is perfect for exploring Berlin! It was easy to get to from Tegel and it is within walking distance of a few stops for mass transit which allows one to easily reach the city's main attractions. Henrik was very helpful and the flat is very clean and has a great charm/character. Would absolutely stay here again.

Henrik and Sven are great hosts. They gave us some really good recommendations for the area. The apartment is lovely and well decorated. It's close to a lot of great shops and cafes and easy to get around the city. Would definitely recommend staying here!

It was nice and quiet on our street but just a 5 minute walk to Senefeld where the grocery store, Ubahn, and lots of restaurants were. Our favorite restaurant was Mama India. Their food was delicious and so were the cocktails. We also had a great experience booking 2 local tours with "with locals.com". Our guide was Isabel! We had a fabulous time in Berlin!
I loved Henrik place. It was stylish and central to many eating areas as well as the subway.

Great little apartment in a nice area. Perfect location for exploring Berlin. Sven was really friendly to meet at check-in and then we didn't need to get in touch as we had no issues. The flat was clean, comfortable and decorated well. It had everything we needed for the week. It was really quiet and the area feels really safe to walk around. If you're staying as a couple, just note that the bathroom has no sound proofing, which it's fine as long as you're comfortable with each other! Would definitely recommend the flat to stay in!

Let me strat by saying how nice it is when you first enter the apartment and feel this very pleasant smell and then discover that host left you tulips, in January.
The apartment itself is great, easy entry, nice neighborhood, has everything you might need and more. It's minutes away from transport, has a couple of stores near by and you can walk to the center in just a few minutes.
What can I say about communication with a host when he replies to your messages within minutes at 5:00am? 5 stars!

An excellent place to stay - clean, quiet, amazing location, comfortable bed, spacey (the apartment is bigger than it looks on the pictures). Great communication with the host. Next time in Berlin I will stay there again!

Thé  apartment of Henrik was exactly as we dreamed. Deco and lighting warm atmosphere! everything was there! with this touch of conviviality: small beer in the fridge and bathroom with all comfort and several towels!

The location was great - we love the neighbourhood with so many great food, cafe, and beer options, great parks around, and very well connected to all transit options. The apartment we a good size for 2 people, quiet and well taken care of. Very unique and cool style! The check in was very easy and communication with the hosts was quick and helpful. Great tips from the hosts too for activities and restaurants! We would stay here again for sure.

This place was great. Great location to many of the local attractions. Easy to get to and has everything you need for a stay in Berlin. The host was always quick to respond (general inquiries we had no issues) and polite. Check in/out was easy and convenient.

We absolutely loved this place. The apartment and surrounding area were both beautiful. Close to a train station and supermarket but also walking distance to the city. There are some great restaurants nearby plus a fantastic farmers market on Saturdays. We would stay again in a heartbeat.

Perfect, hassle free and most pleasurable stay. Bed was very comfortable and quiet surroundings. I thought the location was perfect and offered ease to transport and many attractions within half hr walk. Many good places to eat and drink and a nice neighbourhood to stay.

Beautiful, quiet location in very easy walking distance of the museum island and other attractions. The place is stylishly decorated and larger in person than it appears in the photos. Would gladly stay again.

This is such a wonderful experience! The location is great - surrounded by cafes and organic markets and very close to Alexanderplatz. The room is very cosy with a kitchen. Decoration is very cute. I had a very great time here in Berlin. Thank you!!!

Perfect place for two people to stay and explore Berlin. Clean, beautifully decorated and comfortable.
The location is excellent, we walked in and out of the city every day. There is also lots to do in the local area.
We recommend What Do You Fancy Love or Allens Breakfast Club for breakfast/brunch. Also loved the flea market at Mauerpark on Sunday.
In short we had a fabulous time, both Henrik's place and Berlin are highly recommended!

This flat is everything you could want and need! It made our experience 100% better, not just because it is super cute, homely and in a great location but because Henrik is so welcoming and friendly too! Would stay again in a heartbeat!

Henrik was a great host. He was there for us if we needed him, but also gave us our private space. The rooms were clean and warm during winter time. The apartment is very central and in a safe area, metro and tram stops are in close walking distance, as well as several cafés and restaurants. Would definitely stay here next time! :)

This is the absolute perfect place for spending your time in Berlin. The place is gorgeous, cozy, extremely well kept, and even provided supplies such as bathroom amenities and coffee/tea. I would recommend this place to anyone and would definitely stay here again!

We had a comfortable stay at Henrik’s place. Great location with plenty of bars and restaurants nearby. Communication with Henrik was prompt and easy. He was very accommodative of our requests. We highly recommend Henrik’s place and would definitely stay there on our next trip.
beautiful apartment in a fantastic area.  Henrik is very helpful and hospitable. I will definitely come back!
Great central location, very clean and well kept. Lovely high ceilings and an enormous bed. 10/10, will be staying again.
Nice little flat located in a lovely area of Berlin. As first timers in Berlin, it was an ideal choice to stay at Henrik’s place
Great location and the host responds fast. The room is a bit old, but it adds to the experience.

Good location and easy to walk to important landmarks. Took a bit long to heat up and never quite achieved the temperature we wanted, probably because of the high ceilings, but otherwise a good place to stay that I would recommend.
Lovely Apartment situated close to public transport, quiet and comfortable area. Good amenities. Host very friendly and responsive.

Henrik’s apartment was perfect for our stay in Berlin. Check in was easy, and the apartment itself was very comfortable for two people. Public transport is minutes away, as are plenty of restaurants and cafes.
A fantastic place! Very clean and has everything you may need. Perfect location around many restaurants/shops and very close to public transit. Henrik was an incredibly helpful and friendly host!
Lovely few days in Henriks apartment. Cozy living space in a nice, central neighbourhood. Definitely recommend!

Henrik’s apartment was very nice and cosy.
The location was perfect, quiet and very close to two big supermarkets and public transport.
Good communication with Henrik.
I would like to come back someday.
The apartment was in a really nice area, close to restaurants and cafes. It had a quirky 1950’s feel. Quite small but all you need for 2 people. I loved the cute little kitchen.

Wonderful apartment in Prenzlauer Berg. A very nice building. Nice and quiet neighborhood but at the same time lots of bars and cafes around.
Totally worth the price.
Henrik is a great host.

Henriks gorgeous spacious flat is just want you want for a Berlin trip, I found the location amazing for a walkable stay, great restaurants nearby and a homely atmosphere. I would absolutely recommend this Airbnb. Thank you henrik, we loved our stay
Franks place is perfect. It is located in a wonderful area and Frank is a perfect host and very helpful. I can highly recommend staying at Franks place.

Frank is a great host and made our stay in his apartment absolutely comfortable. It was equipped with all what we needed and he was available to help us with local information, calling up taxis and even kept left luggage until we collected the same after checking out and going out of Berlin for a day. He lives in an apartment very close and that helps him to provide a immaculate service to his guests. Look forward to come back again.

I really enjoyed staying 5 days in Frank’s  apartment. It is beautiful, cosy, calm and well equipped. Public transportation, restaurants and nice shops are very near.  Frank is very kind and kept my luggages until my evening flight. When I come  back to Berlin,  I will try to stay here again. Thanks for all, Frank.
Everything at the flat was very nice! I was very happy to be there and would stay there again.
Franks place is fab , gorgeous apartment, nice decor , convenient location, lovely area . Everything you need and Frank was very pleasant and helpful .

Frank’s apartment is beautiful and really spacious. It has everything you need and is in a great location with lots of cafés, bars and restaurants nearby and easy access to trams and trains. We stayed with our 1 year old daughter and Frank had provided a cot, high chair and toys which was great. I only wish  we had stayed longer!

Frank's apartment is the perfect place to stay in Berlin. It is spotlessly clean and he has provided everything that you could need during your stay. I would highly recommend a stay at Frank's apartment and hope to visit again soon!

We had a great time at the apartment , the location is amazing , the apartment is clean and equipped with everything we needed . We stayed with our 4 children for two weeks and it was fantastic and frank was extremely helpful with everything we needed . We will definitely stay there again
Absolutly worth staying at Franks place.. The location is in a such beautiful area.. Frank was so Nice and Kind and we would definetly recommend staying at his place.. We surely Will come Back again!

Franks excellent and modern apartment is located in wonderful Prenzlauer Berg surrounded with hip and delightful restaurants and shopping.  A park is across the street and metro access a few short blocks away. The P’ Berg area is an absolutely wonderful area to stay in massive Berlin with easy access to all the sights. Frank provides exceptional hospitality with everything you need to enjoy your time in Berlin. We will not hesitate to return to Franks wonderful apartment soon.

Highly recommend. Franks place was exactly as advertised. Wonderful touches throughout, very well stocked for all that you may need. Located in a peaceful street close to transportation and many shops and restaurants

Staying at Frank’s house was a breeze! Quick communication and Frank made sure I had everything I needed.

I’d absolutely love to stay at Frank’s again when I’m back in Berlin!
Great location! We enjoyed our time in Berlin. For those working online, you should know that the internet connection is not stable and cuts off now and then.

Amazing apartment in a quiet location
Everything is great ---I cannot even find a suggestion for improvement
Frank is very reactive in communication ...and alway willing to help
In fact felt I was home
I will come back ....
beautiful apartment in quiet, family-oriented neighbourhood. close to great shops and close to many great area. Also has an elevator which is super helpful.

The apartment was quite charming and clean! Plenty of space for a couple. We loved the high ceilings and usable space. The neighborhood had plenty of restaurants, cafes, and bars but the apartment still felt private and quiet.  Neighborhood was quite walkable, offered easy access to public transportation, and we felt safe. Frank was a great host, friendly and responsive.

We really enjoyed our stay at Frank’s apartment. It was well-located, spotlessly clean and spacious. Perfect size for our group of two adults and one teenager. Frank was welcoming and provided us with recommendations for the area. We would definitely come back.
Awesome location and host. Frank’s space was even bigger than it looks in pictures and it’s in a beautiful neighborhood.

Frank’s place was perfect for our first trip to Berlin. The neighborhood is filled with great restaurants and cute boutiques. The apartment is very charming and clean. Frank was a wonderful host. We had every thing we needed and more. Highly recommend!
A very nice Berliner Wohnung in a very nice quarter of Prenzlauer Berg. Quiet and spacy. very recommendable.

Frank and Dirk were such gracious hosts, meeting us at check in and showing us around. The neighborhood is in the perfect location, super family friendly, with lots of restaurants and trams within walking distance. We would definitely stay here again!

Frank's place was a wonderful stay in a great neighborhood. There's a beautiful park right next door and lots of cute stores and places to eat all around. His home was cozy, spacious, and tastefully appointed. It got nice sun in the day and was bright and cheerful. Easy check in and easy check out. Comfortable bed. I felt at peace and at home. Frank himself was an excellent host. Furthermore, he's an excellent masseuse - took advantage of his masseuse practice right across the hall - it was extremely relaxing - can highly recommend!

We had a fantastic time at Michel's place. Thanks for this lovely decorated (family) home away from home. Will def try to stay there next year again! Lisa, Florian, Antonia (3years) & Jonathan (1year)

Superb stay in a superb apartment. Michel & Anne have a truly beautiful apartment in this family friendly district of Berlin. The apartment is spotlessly clean and perfectly presented. The location is good, with an easy 10 minute walk to the nearest U-Bahn station to see more of the city. We would not hesitate to recommend the apartment or the area to future visitors.

We spent (2 adults and 2 kids) 4 nights in Michel's appartment in Prenzlauerberg. The appartment was perfect. Bright. Cozy. And ideally located. We had some difficulties to join Michel. however he made all was necessary to solve this communication problem. So I recommend this apartment.

Many thanks to Michel for helping to make our stay in Berlin so great. The apartment was wonderful and the neighborhood was perfect. We very much appreciated how the host accommodated our early arrival. The children were really grateful to be able to take a nap after their long flight. Would definitely stay here again.

Michel & Anne's flat is brilliant! Very spacious, warm (we stayed in winter) and bright.
Location on Kollwitz Str is great. Loads of good eateries close by and small shops for supplies. Tram stop very close and train a 5-10min walk.
Would stay again.
We stayed Four days in the apartment. Spacious and lovely place. Recommendable 👍☺
This is a beautiful spacious apartment in a great location. We loved being so close to everything, whilst also having lots of space to cook and relax as  a family.
Amazing!!! It's a great place. Even better than in the photos. We loved the flat and we loved the meighbourhood. Highly recommendable

Thank you for a great stay! I highly recommend this apartment, in a safe and quiet part of Berlin, close to coffee shops and restaurants. Easy to get to the city centre by tram. The apartment has everything you need - a good kitchen, washing machine and heating! The host was great, met us and helped us to the taxi at the end of our stay. Thanks again.
A very nice apartment in a great neighborhood with many restaurants and shops. The apartment is well furnished and comfortable. I highly recommend the apartment.

Great, spacious apartment in a wonderful neighborhood. Communication and check-in with Martina was easy... couldn’t check in early, but she let us drop off our luggage in the morning and explained everything to us. Highly recommend this apartment!

This was the perfect place to stay. It's very spacious, with large windows on an upper floor on a quiet street. The apartment itself is thoughtfully furnished and comfortable. This is a great neighborhood for kids, with several nice parks nearby, and it's an easy walk to grocery stores, restaurants, and public transport.

Michele’s apartment is fantastic. So well located in the best area of Berlin with tons of cafes and restaurants . The apartment is spacious and has absolutely everything you need even a cot and baby feeding chair which was much appreciated.

We had a lovely stay at this airy and spacious Prenzlauerberg flat. The neighborhood cannot be beat. Close to great restaurants, shops, and near tram and rail stations.
