Everything we needed was there.
We really enjoyed our stay and would recommend highly!!
Good ambience and peaceful neighborhood. There was no elevator so was slightly hard for elders to walk up and down.

Absolutely lovely apartment! Beautifully decorated, we felt at home with our small kids. The area is nice and lots of cafés and restaurants nearby, but the street is still not too busy or loud. Also close to tram and train. Will come back to this nice apartment! Highly recommended.

Martina and Michel were very helpful  in answering questions and giving recommendations. They booked us a taxi for our early morning departure and even let us know that the taxi was on its way, at 6:30 a.m. Martina made an extra trip up to the apartment, after she had checked us in, to let us know that the food store would be closed the following day due to a national holiday. Had she not done that, we would have been stuck with no food! They were both very thoughtful, and excellent communicators.

Great apartment in a lovely location. Martina couldn’t have been anymore helpful when she welcomed us to the apartment.
We stayed here as a family of 4 including a 10 month old and a 6 year old. There was toys, highchair and a few toys which made the whole experience much easier.
Thanks so much for a great stay
A nice little cosy appartment with everything that two travellers need (even a dishwasher!) and very friendly and helpful owners. I can really recommend it!
We're in Berlin for 6 days, and we had a great staying in Heinrich appartment. Very useful services, busses and trains included! Strongly suggested! :)

I had a lovely time in this flat, it's very comfortable, easy access to local grocery shops and metro/train stations.

I'll recommend it.

Communication with the host was great, Tina came in minutes when we arrived and was very plesant showing us the apartment and the transport map. Apartment is squeaky clean, with clean sheets and towels, bathroom was shining clean, small but very convenient. Kitchen is equipped with everything you need for cooking. First few days was really bad, last few days wasn’t working at all! Highly recommend!

Communication with the host was great, she came in minutes when we arrived and was very kind showing us the apartment and the transport map. Lovely clean cosy little flat with great transport links
We really enjoyed neighborhood, we recommend Lucas, a pub in the street nearby! Highly recommend!

The apartment was very clean, and was exactly as described in the posting. It is an a quiet part of the city but is very close to the bus and train. The host was very friendly and we had no issues contacting her when we arrived. As others have mentioned, the wifi could have been a little better. Overall a very pleasant experience.

The apartment is just like in pictures. 10min walking from metro station and with all services nearby. It really made our stay comfortable.
The host is very kind and flexible as well. Perfect refuge to explore the city! Loved it!

Spotlessly clean, well equipped and comfortable, we had a great stay here at Heike & Heinrich's place. Spending Christmas in Berlin was a great and made extra special having the apartment decorated when we arrived, this was a nice touch. The accomodation is very well situated within walking distance to public transport and supermarkets. Would highly recommend.
Very clean and super nice! The place is close frome bus and s-bahn all the comforts are close!! Perfect for young and couples!! The host is kindly I suggest this place!!!
This is a great apartment, only small but perfect for couples spending a few days in Berlin. Easy to get into the city centre by public transport and it is close to amenities such as supermarkets.
A lovely place, everything was very clean. It was around a 20min journey from the centre but there were very good travel links close by.

Wonderful little apartment, within 20-30 minutes on public transport of all the sights in Berlin and lots of lovely restaurants within walking distance from the flat. My boyfriend and I had a great time here exploring Berlin and the apartment had everything we needed during our stay.

Our stay in the beautiful apartment of Heike and Heinrich was short, but so pleasant! The apartment is small but extremely cozy, bright and clean. It is located in a awesome neighberhood close to a train station, were we could easily go to the city center. We really appreciate the hospitality of Heike and Heinrich, and we sure hope to come back!

Visit at Heike & Heinrich were was nice and pleasant. Apartment was clean, quiet and wery well equipped. The train stop was 5 minutes by walk and in next 15 minutes in city centre. Heike can also speak very well English. Thank you very much we could stay. Leona
Nice room, fully equiped and very clean. Supermarket and bakery around the corner. Good acces to public  transport. Communication was nice and fast. I recommand this place!
This is a great apartment with easy access and everything you need for trip.Berlin is really an amazing city if you want to come Berlin that you can booking here ：）

This was my first trip to Germany and Heike and Heinrich’s place was perfect! We arrived a bit earlier than the official check in time but they allowed us to come early which was super helpful. The space itself was very clean and perfect for two people. Very close to the train and subway stations which made getting around town convenient and easy. I would definitely recommend!
Everything was great! Location, space, and hospitality were all fantastic. Definitely a place to book!
Good experience, though there was a small tax we had to pay on check in. (Less than 10 euro) other than that it was great!

Heike and Heinrich’s place is located in a quiet beautiful neighbourhood. There is an amazing bakery across the street and a conveniently located grocery store. The bus is right around the corner and gets you into Mitte quickly! I would definitely recommend staying here.

This is a small but comfortable and convenient flat in a quiet residential neighbourhood in southern Berlin. My son and I stayed for three nights and had a great time. The flat was spotlessly clean and had everything we needed to enjoy our stay. The flat is close to some nice cafes where you can grab breakfast if you don't want to cook and close to various public transport stops meaning you can get almost anywhere in the city within half an hour or so. Perfect!
We had a great stay at Heike and Heinrich’s air B&B. The place has everythubg what you need. We recommend this place!

We had a very nice stay. Nice and clean apartment, great location (quiet neighbourhood, good commute connections). The host was great - helpful and very nice.
A week we spent there was trurly a pleasant time.
We didn’t meet them but everything was good with the place, good neighborhood, nice neighbors, close bakery and mart, only note: bring your own shampoo if you book.

Heike and Heinrich have a beautiful AirBnb that is very clean and has everything you need for a comfortable stay! They were super generous and accommodating of all our requests - including flexible checkin/out times and helping us with our laundry. There is plenty of public transport around so it is easy to get anywhere you need to go in Berlin. I would recommend this AirBnb to all my friends!

Really nice apartment. Well connected to the city centre, there's a bus station just around the corner, and a tram station within the walking distance. The host was helpful and answered all the questions. Parking place and possibility to park for free by the nearby streets are great amenities, if you plan to travel by car!
Very clean apartment in newer building. Quiet neighbourhood close to food shops and with good bus service to central Berlin. Well equipped kitchen with dishwasher.

A nice apartment in a lovely part of Berlin. The hosts were not in Berlin when we checked in, but we were greeted by a lovely neighbour who showed us around. The apartment was very clean and well presented, apart from the fridge which we had to clean ourselves due to an unpleasant smell. We did have a little trouble communicating with the hosts however.
There is a bus stop nearby, so access to the center is not bad. There is a supermarket called REWE 5 minutes walk away.

Everything was five-star about the property and our stay except the fact that only one toilet roll was provided and offered for our 7-night stay.
Given that every supermarket in the area only sold toilet rolls in packs of 12 or more (we checked), this seemed very weird to us. Never in more than 150 previous Airbnb stays have we had to deal with a host who doesn't provide more than one roll of toilet paper PER STAY. This information was not provided in the listing, although we did find mentions from previous guests' reviews about this peculiarity. In the end, we purchased a single packet of moist toilet paper (similar to wet wipes) that are meant to be water soluable, but there are never recommended to be flushed down toilet bowls. We hope the host changes their policy and the property would be perfect.

Situated in a quiet residential area, this is the perfect base from which to explore Berlin. The apartment was super tidy and clean, and the hosts very helpful and friendly. A couple of supermarkets nearby and a functional kitchen meant cutting down on food costs too. Highly recommended.
Hans' flat is in the heart of Berlin and allows for easy access to both the metro system and walking around the city. Highly recommend it for anyone visiting Berlin

Brilliant, venue, near to shops, historical sites, S and U Bahn, restaurants nearby. Warm and well furnished appartment, well equipped and welcomed by friendly colleague of owner to organise tourist tax and show us what was where on the maps. Great venue. Highly recommended.
We were very well received by Ute, she was very nice and helpful, she gave us good recommendations. The place is well furnished with a very central location.

The apartment was great, very spacious and close to a number of metro lines. It is located in a very cute area, close to cafés and such. Communication with the hosts was easy and simple. Would definitely recommend!

Hans apartment is excellent for a stay in Berlin. Just a short ride on the tram/metro into the centre but also walkable in 10mins or so. Apartment itself was very clean and well resourced. Can't fault it really, thanks for having us!!

Hans and Ute were great hosts. They gave us lots of information on how to get to the apartment and check in was a breeze. The place itself was great, had what you need and was in a great location. Definitely a great place if you want to see Berlin with lots of public transport near by.
Good location with lots of restaurants near by. The noise volume was low and the hosts are great.

The apartment is in a good location, in a clean and safe area of Berlin, close to good restaurants, 2 lines and 1 tram line. The room (American kitchen) is big enough for 3-4 people.

Hans and Ute have provided instant support whenever needed. Thanks for everything.
Situated in a cute neighborhood and true to being in central Berlin, Hans and Ute’s place did not disappoint. We enjoyed our stay.

We had a awesome stay in Berlin. Ute went out of her way to assist us and provided us with detailed directions, maps, etc. She was very helpful and friendly, and went out of her way to make us feel welcome. The apartment is very central and within walking distance of shops, restaurants and public transport. Everything was clean and tidy and exactly as advertised. I will recommend this apartment to anyone!

Hans and Ute’s place was great! Situated about about a 20 minute walk from most (if not all) if the sights! I’d definitely recommend walking over metro as there are a vast number of great shops and restaurants along the way!
We travelled here in summer and the place was cool, they had a fan on for us but really with the top windows cracked it was perfect!!
There were a few minor things; the shower didn’t drain well and often flooded the bathroom if you took a shower longer than 5 minutes. The apartment is also essentially right on the street so you hear every car and passerby quite clearly. It didn’t keep us up but just a heads up!
These didn’t stop hinder us at all and overall we had an amazing stay at Hans and Ute’s apartment in Mitte! We would definitely recommend!
Had a fantastic trip. Ute is a great host, extremely helpful and patient. I would absolutely recommend it to a friend.

The apartment is spacious for two people, very clean and comfortable and has a well stocked kitchen. The location is great with easy access to the train station, public transportation and a good grocery store just around the corner.  I would stay here again!

The place was bigger than I thought, and very well-located at walking distance from the metro station or even to some important tourist points. The hosts provided me very clear and extensive information about how to reach the apartment, and they were very easily reachable. I totally recommend this place!

My friends and I really enjoyed our stay here. The apartment is tidy, cute, well-located, and Ute (Han’s wife) made check-in simple! She was extremely welcoming and offered us many recommendations taking into account our interests. I highly recommend this apartment!
Stayed here for a city trip to Berlin and the apartment was at a great location, was neat and the communication with Hans was very quick! I would recommend staying here!

Very good place to stay in Berlin, spacious &clean, with very easy access to public transport and all the sights. The area directly around the apartment was quiet, but still few gems (coffee shops& restaurant) within walking distance.

We had a great stay at this place two weekends in a row. Loved the location, close to the tram and train and the city. Lots of cute places to eat nearby. The bed was very comfortable and it such a nice big space. Check in was easy, the host friendly, and a binder full of local tips gave us lots of ideas of what to do.

Ute welcomed us kindly and was flexible with our arrival time.  We enjoyed our stay very much and will come back. The room is spacious, well equipped and was beautifully cleaned when we arrived. The only downside is that it is on the ground floor and the curtains do not protect very well from the light. Thanks again to the hosts and see you soon!
A lovely apartment, fully equipped and perfectly located ! Ute is such a lovely guest who is flexible and of good advice concerning what to do in Berlin ! We recommend !!!

Great staying! The place is simple but has everything you need. a
Amazing location! you can walk to Alexander Platz but you also have the metro just 5 minutes from the house. Hans and his wife were very helpful. The apartment is on the ground floor but there isn't noise at night or during the day. Definitely recommend it 😊

Apartment is functional and pleasant. In case of problem, Ute and Hans are available.
We had a good stay
It was great to stay at the apartment again. As good in 2022 as it was in 2018. Many thanks Andy

The place is very cozy, clean and the location is perfect. The host was waiting for us and was very nice, helpful and friendly although we were not able to check in on time due to delay at the airport and we arrived at 1am.

Hans and Ute are great host, very friendly and warm, the place is excellent very easy to find and with all the necessary amenities, the neighbourhood is beautiful and super quiet during night, recommended 100%!!!
We absolutely loved staying at Hans and Ute’s place. The location and set-up are just perfect. They are wonderful hosts. Thank you again for everything!

We had a fantastic time in Berlin. The hosts were extremely helpful and great communication. Ute even dropped off a fan as it was a very hot weekend. The location is brilliant, loved the powerful hairdryer. We would definitely recommend to anyone

Fabulous location with easy access to public transport.
Good local supermarkets and restaurants.
Flat was well equipped - we found everything we needed. The decor is a little tired and outdated - but that is reflected in a very fair price.
Great location! The apartment had everything we needed for our short stay! We’d definitely recommend to stay here!
Nice small appartment in a great location. Kitchen has everything needed and beds and bathroom are confortable for a family of 4. A bit exposed to the street but still quite silent.
Hans was amazing, very attentive and the apartment is very comfortable with a GREAT location. Thanks.

A perfect apartment. I stayed for 8 days in late november. The apartment is super clean and lives from its very cool vintage design. Norbert put a lot of love and time into designing it and the "feel-comfy-factor" is 100 %. The location is also perfect as you can reach the motorway just around the corner and public transport brings you to all important sites. The neigbourhood is very friendly and stylish but as well down to earth. Norbert is a VERY caring host and a great guy! I would definitely come again any time!
Norbert was a great host! Ans the apartment is realy nice, with lovely lights. I can recomend this place to everybody. It's also close to te metro, a great spot to discover Berlin.

Norbert was great - very helpful and provided really great instructions on how to get to his place! It was in a nice little neighborhood that was close to a lot of cool areas and very close to the metro. It was perfect for my family and I and we're so glad we stayed there! Highly recommend this place! You will love the decorations - very cool.

Norbert is great! He's very friendly and always ready to help. He helped me with great directions from the airport and around the area and everything else i asked him.The apartment is amazing. Everything you need. And i mean everything that you can think of. And very clean.It's exactly as in the pictures. The locatio is really good. It's a 15 min ride with S bahn to Friedrichstraße which is the central area but you have other means of transport to the city too as a big station is around the corner just a five minute walk.Really recomend Norbert's place. Have fun!!!

An absolutely beautiful apartment, stylish, fun and as camp as can be which is apt, given the building's history.  The owner, Norbert, could not have been more welcoming or  helpful. The area itself is a beautiful part of Schoneberg, a little way away from Nollendorfplatz, but filled with lovely cafes and bars. I can't recommend this place highly enough.

Our stay in Norbert's apartment was great! The apartment itself was lovely, exactly how it looks in the photos. Norbert was very welcoming and helpful. Very close to public transport. I'd definitely recommend

Such a fantastic place to stay! Very comfortable and effortlessly cool in every way plus well situated and easy to get to all of Berlin's main attractions.
Norbert himself was super friendly and accommodating allowing us to check out late. We loved our stay!

Frank was great at communicating before and during the trip. He made some really great recommendations on things to do and places to eat that gave us some insider knowledge for out stay. The apartment is one of a kind, it is extremely stylish and well finished. The location is perfect for all transport links and it is a walkable distance to lovely restaurants and cafes. We would definitely recommend this place to anyone wanting to see Berlin!
Frank  was ver responsive and respectful and clear. We spent 3 confortable nights at his psychedelic apartment full of beautiful lighting. Thanks Frank we will be back.

Frank's place is beautiful, comfortable and so conveniently located  in a historic and beautiful neighbourhood in Berlin. What a treat to stay in the Marlene Dietrich building! He is a great host who is a quick and helpful communicator.  The apartment is clean and stylish and has such interesting furniture and lighting set-ups! We highly recommend Frank's place for your stay in Berlin.

Frank let us in early, and showed me around and ensured that I knew how everything worked. He had excellent advice about local venues. The apt. was very comfortable for two people and the tub was great! There is lots nearby in this quiet residential neighbourhood - a grocery store, a pharmacy, and the S-Bahn for transportation. It was a great place to stay!
The apartment is amazing and full of nice details. It's in a nice and quiet neighbourhood and it's a 5-10 minute walk to public transport. Frank is a great host!
The apartment is awesome and unique ! It’s close to the train station and the neighborhood is very nice. I really recommend this apartment :)

Great host very friendly and informative. The apartment is nicely place in a nice area not far from the train station. The apartment is also furnished to a great standard and has a top designer feel, the led lights are a great touch to change the mood as well. All in all great trip to Berlin.

The place is nicely maintained and gives you a classic feel.
Only problem in the apartment building is absence of a lift.
Frank's place is funky! it's very well placed on the bus route to Tegel airport and has a great cafe a few doors up which does excellent brunches. The multi coloured LED lights were fun  too.
Great apartment in a great location and could not recommend it enough it you are looking for a clean, quiet and very cool stay in Berlin, well done Frank!!

Franks place is really worth visiting. Perfect location in a very nice neighborhood in Schöneberg. Nice bars and restaurants plenty in the street.
The apartment is really something. Take your time to see all the small details Franks has put in it. And if you like special lightning, take an hour or two to test them all.
More than five stars for the host: flexible check-in, super friendly and willing to help you with pretty much everything!
Thanks again Frank! 👍🏼

Frank’s place is awesome!! Great location- less than a 10 minute walk to two different train stations. There is also a corner store across the street, and lovely restaurants and cafes in the neighborhood. Frank was a wonderful host. Very communicative and gave us lots of great recommendations.

What an amazing apartment! This is a real gem; it’s in a brilliant location, with so many cool little places within walking distance. Fantastic links to buses and trains so you can move around the city easily. Frank is an exceptional host who went out of his way to be helpful and gave great advice and made our stay superb. I couldn’t fault this apartment. Highly recommended!
A fun and stylish Airbnb with a great neighborhood close to the Sbahn. Great place. Frank is great host and is always on stand by to help.

Fantastic experience! Huge thanks to Frank and Anne for everything. The apartment is quirky and homely all at once. Perfect location for a great few days and wonderful Berlin experience. Thanks again!

I couldn’t be more happy staying at Frank‘s place. He was there the minute I arrived to give me a full tour with instructions. He was friendly and responsive. The place was exactly what I needed for a solo traveler who need a restful place to come back to each day after playing tourist throughout Berlin. I‘m saving this in my memory bank for my next visit to Berlin. Danke Frank!

Brilliant stay at this apartment, exactly what we needed. Getting to the city centre was super easy via the local train station which was a 5/10minute walk away. Frank was very welcoming and was more than happy to answer any questions that we had. Would definitely stay again.
A unique character apartment which is located in a very quiet residential area close to cafés and public transports. Extremely clean. Highly recommended.

My cousin and I stayed there for a month and found the apartment very nice and clean. there was everything there: towels, soap, ...
it is quite small but still nice and it is situated in a very nice place. the only con is transport: there is a bus which takes you to the metro station, but on weekends and at late times you have to walk for about 15-20 min to the station.
but carola was very nice with us and we enjoyed our stay there.

We had good days and happy times in Berlin, especialy with Davide as host and guide. If you love live music and culture, Davide knows particular places which we would never found on our own.
Friedrichshain is the perfect district to start your citytrip in Berlin. There are lots of nice pubs, bistros and shops and the East Side Gallery is within walking distance. In the summer you will be amazed of al the street artists playing their music at metro station Warschauwerstrasse until late.

We will be back for more Berlin. Of course we'll be staying at Davides stylish apartment.
We had a very nice Week-end amongst friends in Incanto's flat! And the host was very nice! Thanks a lot!

Amazing space in a cool part of Berlin. Great restaurants all around. Well connected by public transport to the center. Super spacious apartment, beautifully designed. If you are very sensitive to noise one bedroom is on the street. Host is super nice and welcoming. We really enjoyed our time there!
Extremely friendly and very responsive. Nice apartment decorated in eclectic flea market style. Recommendable stay even though a bit loud at Warschauer Straße.
Amazing place. You will not be disappointed by its charm. Very bohemian and could be from a movie set. Easy communication. Would stay again.

A truly stunning accommodation that matches both the pictures it shows and the reviews it has already received. It's a gem in a beautiful part of the city: close to Frankfurter Tor and Warschauer Strasse, it is very large, wonderfully atmospheric, comfortable and with a great host. Book it when you have the chance: out of the dozen or so times we've been to Berlin, we would have loved to have found this accommodation earlier!
Great apartment with the best Berlin vibe in a great neighbourhood.  The place is a dream of taste and vintage charm.  Davide was very accommodating to our needs and generally a great host.

Davide's place is an amazing, charming, special, clean, cozy accommodation in the most dynamic area of Berlin.
Communication was always very effective and the host did everything he could to grant a fantastic stay at his place.
We all thank you so much for letting us share this experience.
Till next time =)

We had an amazing stay at Davide's place.  The apartment is so interesting with loads of lovely original features.  The location is great, lots of food, coffee, shops on your doorstep.  Davide is a really helpful and friendly host and we would love to come back one day!

Spacious apartment in a busy area. Cafes, bars and restaurants just around the corner and public transport super close. Traffic a bit hectic. 24 hour open convenience store in the building.
The only issue was the very high loft bed in the shared bedroom as the ladder was a bit unsafe, especially in the night.
Davide was super fast to respond and made everything easy for us. Great host.

Davide’s apartment is fantastic, a lot of space and very unique and interesting decoration. Location is really good. We loved the neighbourhood which was full of good restaurants. I would definitely stay here again!

Off the beaten tracks! Spacious, tastefully and charmingly « outdated » apartment (with all the required equipment) with a somewhat-at-home feeling. Ideally situated for those wanting to avoid the too strict Mitte.
Definitely recommend.
Many thanks to Davide for his attention and his hints!
Davide’s place is perfect for a group visit to Berlin. Very central with a lot of great restaurants and shops around. Creatively decorated and well equipt. Can recommend staying there.
Oksana was great with this last minute booking. Met me at an early hour to accommodate. The apartment is nice and as described.
Oksana gave me nice apartment where I could feel myself very comfortable and cosy. Thank you!!
Oskana was friendly and awaited us in the street. The flat is sunny and clean and everything necessary was there.
Nice house in a quiet district. Oksana was helpful, no problem with check in and check out!

We arrived late at night at Berlin. The host welcomed us with a smile. We got a small private suite all to ourself. The place is super clean and just like in the pictures. There's a lift at her place. Parking is also free here. Highly recommended!

The house is near the U Bahn and the atmosphere was fantastic. My friends and i had an enjoyable time there.
We could get the food just near the apartment and the price is cheap.
It's one of the best apartments i've ever been in.
Really thx.
Great space, with easy access to the metro to get around. Oksana was great and rovided everything for a comfortable stay.

We had a really lovely stay in
Oksana cosy apartment. Communicating with Oksana and Check in was very easy. Oksana was very accommodating when we asked if we could check in early. The flat is perfect for a comfortable stay and has everything you need including a beautiful balcony where you enjoy the evening sun. Thank you for a great stay. We will definately be back:) best wishes
Good appartement, comfortable and in a calm neighborhood. The metro station is in less than 10 minutes by walk. So you can easily move within the city. Nice to discover the city in a few days ;)
This was a last min booking after missing a flight, I was able to book this very fast which was a great help. Nice apartment with a kitchen including oven. Very good!

Nice place. A bit far from the city and there is a construction going on in metro so it takes a little longer than usual to get to the city center keep that in mind. House is big enough for 3 people, Oksana was friendly and communicative. She provides towels, kitchen equipment and tea etc. but it would be better to have a hair dryer in house.

Apartment is located in calm area, close to metro station and shop Carrefour (4minutes by walk). Possibility to park a car. Apartment is "old fashioned" but clean and equipped very good. Contact with Oksana was very good and we were happy to stay there.
It was a stylish place, although on the 3rd floor without a lift. Its an old building, with high roofs and big rooms. The room was very good. Its 20 minutes to the center. Amazing experience!

It was an awesome and uncomplicated stay with Undine. Like the last time. She is very open, interested and gives you the space you need. I am looking forward to stay with her in June again. Thank you for everything!

Very friendly, relaxed living environment, all kitchen utensils are available, everything in this home feels very comfortable! I like the big window in the room very much. There is plenty of sunshine in the afternoon. Highly recommended!

Our stay stay in Kirsten's apartment was without any complications. The apartment was great and even better than we had imagined from looking at the pictures! Kirsten made us feel very welcome with small post it notes in the apartment and a feeling that we could always contact her if needed. The area is also great! Very close to everything and the street itself is very cosy with small restaurants, bars and a food market. I can definitely recommend this apartment (and the sleeping sofa as well...!)

This flat was nicely decorated and spacious in a convenient neighbourhood. There is lots to do and transportation nearby. I only needed a place to sleep for one night, but this would be a great spot for a longer stay. The bar downstairs was super busy and it was fun to sit outside on the balcony and listen to the excitement.

everything worked perfectly well. the location is awesome, in front of the cosy markethalle. you'll find one of berlin's coolest bars downstairs, the personnell and the music is fab! Kirsten was a perfect host!

Great host, Kirsten was very quick to respond to any emails, even when she was on holiday!
Apartment is so lovely, in such a great old building, it is decorated very stylishly and was very clean with a well equipped kitchen.
It was very cold while we were in Berlin but the apartment was kept very warm and cosy.
The only comment I'd make is I think it could benefit from having another mirror, apart from the one in the bathroom, but that's just me being picky.
Would very much recommend this place to anyone and I would definitely stay here again.
The bar below is also great and so many lovely restaurants within walking distance too.

The experience at Kirsten's appartment was perfect. The apartment is beautiful, clean and in a very nice quiet area. Everything was ready for us when we arrived, and the communication was very good. I recommend!

The apartment was lovely and had a very nice atmosphere. Everything was as promised. Great location, lots of nice places to eat / drink in the neighbourhood. There's a really lovely bar in the ground floor of the building. There can be a little bit of noise from there, but nothing that bothered us. In fact, we liked the bar so much, so we hung out there instead.

I went with my girlfriend and we had a great stay in Berlin. We can absolutely recommend staying here.

We had such a lovely stay at Kirsten's apartment when we recently visited Berlin. The surrounding neighbourhood is full of restaurants and bars (one of the best being right below the apartment). It's located a 5 minute walk from a subway stop which makes getting anywhere in Berlin very easy and fast links to the airport. The flat itself is a great space with high ceilings, huge window, balcony and everything you would need during your stay. We hope to visit Berlin again soon and will definitely booking our trip round Kirsten's availability so we can stay in this place again.

My husband and I really enjoyed Kirsten's apartment in a really fun part of Kreuzberg, Berlin. We loved getting to go directly next door to Markthall on a Thursday night for some amazing street food and drinks. Kirsten also made it very convenient to access the apartment upon our arrival which is nice when traveling without a data plan!
We we're in the appartement for the weekend. It is very easy to go sightseeing, out and find nice restaurants in a quite close range from the appartement. We enjoyed ourselves!

We use air Bnb a lot and have to say this is by far the best place we have stayed. Right from the start communication with Kirsten was excellent and she went out of her way to provide lots of recommendations based on questions I asked as we were celebrating my husbands birthday. The location of the apartment was excellent..a lovely local non touristy area with a great bar under apartment and fab restaurant across street oh and amazing must visit cocktail bar a short stagger away. The apartment was clean and excellently equipped for our stay..loved the decor. The balcony is lovely too for morning coffee. I would highly recommend this place and if in Berlin again will stay. Thanks Kirsten.

Kirsten's apartment is great! Very comfortable and well located. The kitchen is fully furnished and has everything one may need. Kreuzberg is a great area to stay, and the apartment is really close to the metro station.
Everything as advertised. No surprises. Kirsten was very warm and welcoming. Very nice host! Thank you!
Kirsten's place is amazing! Well decorated, clean, and classic. Fantastic art. Safe and comfortable and right in the middle of an amazing neighborhood. Would certainly book again!

Kirsten is a good host. Every time available.
It is a nice and cosy apartment, but looks like a "only rented for airbnb"- flat. I assume the neighbors love her for that. All in all it´s great to stay there to enjoy Berlin and his nightlife. Only 30 sec. walk to the Markthalle 9. Just keep in mind, that the sleeping room is directly over the main room of the bar (open until 3 -6 in the morning during the week).
This is a great flat in a hip neighborhood that has the feel of  Williamsburg Brooklyn. So much food and drink right at your doorstep.

This was my second stay at Kirsten's and I had deliberately re-booked with her because everything had worked before - an easy relationship, a great altbau apartment in Kreuzberg, minimalist in a good way with original features and stylish furniture; with a hip bar next door and a great covered market just up the street. And everything worked again, so thank you Kirsten, I really enjoyed my weekend!

This flat is in the best neighborhood in Berlin, located right above a cute bar. We were able to walk or take the U bahn anywhere we wanted to go from here. The space is huge and beautiful. We really loved ending our days by sitting on the little patio and playing cards while watching the street come alive. It’s a little noisy at night but if you have a set of earplugs for light sleepers you’ll be just fine.
Great neighborhood. The little bar downstairs was perfect and stayed open later but wasn’t noisy. Found a breakfast place just a block away.

Very nice neighbourhood. Some noise from bar downstairs, but all this was to be read in the descrition before hand and we had no trouble sleeping. Very clean. And Kirsten very quick to respond online. Recommended

lovely apartment in a cool area of Berlin. Lots to see and do within walking distance. The apartment is clean and even bigger than it appears in the photos.
The bar downstairs is fun and does a pretty nice espresso martini. The market next door on Thursdays is also a must do.
Would definitely stay here again!
Amazing AirBnb.  It was close to so many good restaurants, bars, and food markets.  Very spacious too.

Kirsten was a great host and her apartment was so cute! We loved the area and how walkable the place was to everything - Markthalle Neun is a few steps away! Only recommendation is to read the note she leaves for guests to figure out the shower/hot water situation. Great stay nonetheless!
This was the second time we’ve stayed at Kirstens place, just as good as before. Feel like I never want to stay anywhere else when I’m Berlin :)
Great space in a quiet neighbourhood. Comfortable bed and everything was needed for what we needed which was a base in which to sleep whilst visiting the city. Would stay again!

We love the apartment, this is the second time I’ve stayed here and everything was great both times. The location is fantastic with many restaurants and bars, and the market hall just down the street.
Amazing location, lovely place to stay in Berlin. Me and my two friends had a great time staying here, thanks

Beautiful appartment in my one of my favorite areas.
Some would may find the noise from the bar downstairs a bit desturbing, but it's a really good bar, and we loved it.
The communication with Kirsten was smooth and helpful
great appartement, great location! spacious, clean, trendy place to make your stay in berlin that much better. we enjoyed it greatly and will be back.

Easy check-in and check-out.
Slight smell of smoke in the bedroom, but this could be from the bar below.

Kirsten’s apartment has everything you need for your stay in Berlin. It is located in a cool and vibrant neighbourhood with lots of bar, cafes and restaurants. The apartment itself has some cool retro vibes which really fits with the overall character of the neighbourhood. The bed is confy and the kitchen has everything you need. The communication was also great. One recommendation - if you are a light sleeper bring the earplugs. There is a bar open till 5 a.m. just outside the windows.
The apartment is beutiful with a really good atmospere. The kitcken is very well equipped.  The balcony is nice. And in the neigbourhood there are lots of places to eat and drink.
Very nice place and wonderful location. The host was also very flexible and responsive when I had questions!

Everything was great! Beautiful place. Only thing is if you’re a light sleeper it might be hard to sleep. I didn’t have any issue, but my bf had hard time due to the noise from the bar. Overall great, clean and I will stay again.
Lovely light space in a great location. We really felt like we lived there for 2 days. The appartement is very minimalistic but has all you need. Would come back!

We had an amazing stay in Wrangelkiez. We were already in love with Long March Canteen, but the area is packed with little gems. There’s noice from the bar downstairs, but it only bothered us on the first night. I would def stay again!

I loved Kirstin's apartment, it is beautifully furnished and decorated, very clean with great location. The only thing that someone might have problem with (I didn't) is the fact that there is a bar right beneath the flat so, if you have light sleep, this might be a problem cause it the music and voices can be heard in the sleeping room.
Otherwise, perfect place, I would definitively come again, Kirsten is very friendly and helpful.

Beautiful old apartment. Recommended if you want to experience an old Kreuzberg building.
The area is vibrant and there’s an amazing market nearby
Such a great space and location. We loved the area, convenient to transport and great food choices. The apartment was a relaxing space.
Cosy and cute apartment with all the amenities you need. Surrounded by plenty of restaurants. Would recommend to others visiting Berlin!

Kirsten’s place was very lovely. It was spacious and had many helpful amenities. The place was very clean and tidy. There was a slight smell of smoke but this was due to the bar downstairs and is not a huge issue at all. The noise from the bar was very minimal and actually made the surroundings feel safer. At times we did feel a bit unsafe at night outside but the apartment itself was a lovely haven.

Arzu and Tom were very friendly hosts. Their appartement was cosy, modern, spacious and clean. With all the comfort you need.
Just a two minute walk from the underground.
We felt at home straight away. What more do you need?
absolutely great apartment! comfortable located, calm, clean, friendly for kids. Tom and Arzu are hospitable and ready to help. Thanks a lot again!

A great place to stay. I was warmly welcomed and everything I could need or hope for was provided.  The apartment was warm, clean and quiet. Lots of good amenities and a close U bahn. Would recommend easily.

Great place to stay! We were four adults and the space was perfect for us. The flat was clean and quite, Tom extremely kind and helpful. Location is also good, well connected to everywhere. Absolutely recommended. To improve: internet connection.
We had a very pleasant stay at Arzu & Tom's! The apartment was clean, spacious and well located with only a few minutes away from the airport.

Great location! Real people live in the neighborhood. Cafes etc. Easy parking too.

Tom and Arzu were extremely helpful. They provided expert advice. The flat was immaculately clean and well equipped. HIGHLY recomended.

Great hosts offering a comfy, clean apartment in a nice neighbourhood. Arzu and Tom were amazing hosts, providing all the information we needed for a great stay in Berlin plus the reassurance of a friendly contact incase you need advice. They provide lots of useful things like local maps, menus to the best restaurants and visitor guide books in both english and german. Wedding is a really nice district with many good cafes, shops, bars and restaurants within strolling district. Toms recommendations for the best restaurants were all spot on. Easy ride on the underground to central Berlin sightseeing.
We had a great visit and really enjoyed staying in the apartment. I would not hesitate to stay here again on my next visit to Berlin.

The apartament is absolutely stunning! Two spacious rooms, totally equipped kitchen (pans, pots, cutlery, table setting, coffee maker, even suger, salt, pepper and olive oil available) and very nice bathroom provided with hair dryer ;) In the neighborhood you can find shops, bakery, bars and restaurants. The apartament is located near by U-Bahn station, so it's perfect when you prefer to use public transport rather then driving by car.
Tom is a brilliant host- helpful, kind and is always there for you if you have any questions or problems.
If you travelling to Berlin you should definitely stay at Tom&Arzu's place :)

Arzu and tom's place in Berlin was great. It is very close to berlin's well connected metro and has plenty of shops within walking distance for shopping, food and more. It has a nice kitchen and bathroom, a bedroom and a living room (which also has a bed) with a balcony. I stayed with just 1 friend and there was more than enough space.
Tom is an excellent host, he gave us recommendations for Berlin, helped us do our washing and was very easy to communicate with. They live on the floor above which was very convenient for communication but they also gave us good privacy.
I would love to return to this apartment if I go back to Berlin!

We received a lot of information about the apartment and neighborhood from Tom and Arzu before arrival. The information was very detailed and turned out to be very accurate. The apartment was very nice as spacious and perfect for our needs. It is close to a subway station and there are both good restaurants and some shops in close walking distance.  We got some recommendations from Tom and we tried both a Café for breakfast and an Italian restaurant for dinner. Both recommendations were very good. If we come back to Berlin we will try to book this apartment again.
Lovely apartment and great, friendly hosts! All went smoothly, no problems whatsoever. Would book it again in a minute.
Great spot in upcoming Wedding. All you need just around the corner: U-bahn, restaurants, shops and a great park to take my morning run... We felt very welcome and at home...!

This is a great place to stay. Tom was very kind and helpful before and during our stay which made it totally stress-free. The apartment itself is lovely looking, relaxing, clean, light and quiet. It is near to a supermarket if you want to cook and also near a restaurant called Funf which was super nice :) we had a great stay

It was the first time we visited Berlin and we had a perfect time at Tom and Arzu's flat ! A nice place and a friendly greeting. Tom is a perfect host. The information he sent us was really clear and useful. He gave us some advice so we could discover easily Berlin.
Regarding the flat, it was clean and near from everything. We didn't use the kitchen, but it was clean as well and well fitted. I would recomend it to my friends !
Good place, Tom was great, very knowledgeable and answered our questions. Washed our laundry for us. Place is near metro, once you figure that out you are golden. Highly recommend.

Tom was such a helpful host! My family and I had some trouble finding our way around Berlin, but Tom gave us some excellent directions and recommended destinations to check out! He even let us keep our luggage with him after check out until our departure. The apartment was very clean and matched the photos perfectly. I would most definitely recommend this place.

A spacious apartment with everything you need. It was clean and tidy, and the guides and books provided by the host were helpful.
It is a few minutes from a few good places to eat, and about 3 minutes from an underground station. It takes about 15 minutes to get into the more central part of town from the station.
Tom was an excellent host. He was quick to communicate, gave a detailed tour of the apartment and area, and explained how to get about.
He explained that there are some illegal air bnbs in Berlin (his isn't), so be cautious when you are looking about.
He also mentioned that someone else left s review saying the pull out bed was a bit uncomfortable - we found both beds fine- and that he was going to buy a mattress topper to improve it. His honesty and efficiency is great.
clean and Bright  appartment. Quiet and secure location. easy for transports.. I recommand it.

Arzu was wonderful checking in on us during our stay. The apartment is great and very accessible to the sights with public transit. It is located in a quieter neighbourhood which we appreciated after the hustle and bustle of the Christmas markets and tourist sights. It's a full kitchen should you opt to cook for yourself and a grocery store is close by. Wonderful experience for a first time Airbnb'er. Danke Arzu und Tom.

Great place. Very clean. Comfortable beds, in fact one of the most comfortable sleeper couches I've ever slept on. Super responsive communication and very friendly reception.  Good location close to Leopoldplatz. I highly recommend it.

a nice, comfortable apartment in a quiet and well served by public transport. quality / price, great!
the very kind owner to give the details for our arrival and stay.
good choice if you do not want to stay right in the center.
only negative point in that area are not found many useful things, such as super market, some restaurants etc.

What a great spot! As advertised, it is clean and cozy and we thoroughly enjoyed our stay! Our 2 year old daughter was quite happy in the baby bed provided, and it is close to transit, shops, parks, etc. Arzu & Tom were very helpful and the apartment had all sorts of guides and information! Thank you for making our stay in Berlin a great one!

Highly recommend this huge, airy, super-clean and bright apartment in a cool neighborhood. It's close to public transportation, local restaurants and beer gardens. Tom is an awesome host, quick with suggestions and offers of help. We enjoyed our stay and look forward to coming back.

The apartment was very clean and a good amount of space for 4 people. The place was also conveniently located for transit by bus or by U-bahn, and on a weekday it is quite fast to Berlin's central station. Wifi in the apartment is serviceable.
Overall we thought it was good value and a pleasant stay for our time in Berlin. Tom and Arzu gave helpful recommendations and transit tips, and also did a load of laundry for us. We had a bit of miscommunication with the check-in but Tom and Arzu made an effort to match our schedule and were great hosts during our stay.

The apartment was very clean, Tom and Arzu were great hosts, location was close to U-Bahn making it easy to get around, Tom went above and beyond to offer suggestions on where to eat and things to do. I highly recommend this apartment for anyone looking to stay in the Berlin area.

Very spacious apartment close to the U Line (Subway for those who don't know) and very clean.
Tom and Arzu are quick to reply and are always happy to help. They were helpful in helping us get around Berlin too.

Tom is a very kind person, he gave us many useful tips. everything went smoothly and with no problems.
Recommended :)
Great hosts. Very helpful and accommodating. The place was exactly as described. Would recommend a stay here if in berlin

Tom’s and Arzu’s place is exactly like in the pictures. Very nice, clean and in great location,close-to the public transportation .
Tom was very helpful giving us information, doing our laundry and very fast to communicate.
We had a great experience.
Thanks Tom.
Arzu and Tom were very responsive with all communications. Their place was beautiful and well appointed. The balcony was an added perk-

This is a very stylish space. The hosts are incredibly accommodating and quick to respond. It is a very well-suited space for people who want separate bedrooms. The WiFi, however, is finicky in parts of the apartment and the location felt a bit secluded.

Easy check-in, good communication, and the apartment is equipped with all the essentials.
The main Street however tended to be a little noisy in the evening, not so much due to traffic, but mostly due to people chattering loudly.
Everything was just so perfect! The apartment is bright and well designed, the communication with the owner; the metro station is in walking distance about 5 min.

We were in town for the Berlin Marathon and were fortunate to find this Air B&B. It was close to the airport and close to the U-bahn subway for easy travel to downtown Berlin. The place was very clean and our host Tom was helpful with advice on a nearby restaurant that we loved and gave us good suggestions for sightseeing.
We were very happy with our visit and would stay here again our next time in Berlin.

Arzu and Tom were great hosts and responded very quickly to all of our questions and communications. The flat was clean, quiet, comfortable and convenient for public transportation, both in relation to Tegel as well as all the main sights in town. They made some great recommendations for things to do and local places to eat. For a few days in Berlin, this was a great base for our family.

Very helpful hosts, both before and during our stay. Nice and clean flat, well connected by subway. I would rent it if you're visiting Berlin, Arzu and Tom give lots of recommendations and tips to move around the city and visit it.

We strongly reccomend Arzu´s and Tom´s place due to their hospitality, the location and all the nice restaurants in the neighborhood. Just a couple of minutes walk to public transport, and located quite close to Tegel airport, which made the transport from the airport to the flat both fast and cheap by cab.
Arzu and Tom’s place was amazing! Very close to public transportation and great restaurants in the area. We would stay again in his place it was perfect. Would highly recommend their place to anyone!
Short bus ride away from Berlin hbf. Tom met us upon check in to give a quick tour of the house. Everything that we needed were there. Thanks for the great hospitality, Tom!

Arzu and Tom’s flat is one of the most beautiful buildings I’ve ever stayed in. It’s a real gem on AirBnB. It has the right distance from the centre that everything is easy to get to, but also just far enough outside that food is cheap if you’re on a budget while dining out. As for the hosts themselves, they’re delightful and a real help around the city for anyone looking to visit. We felt safe during Covid and any issues we had were helped with immediately. Couldn’t recommend more!

Fantastic stay with great hosts! was initially worried on first arrival due to some graffiti on nearby walls (it was dark as well) however the area was completely safe. We saw children being sent out for errands for their parents!
With regards to the amenities, the rooms were rather plain, the exception being the large master with a balcony.
The bathroom likewise was on the smaller side, but perfectly functional.
Towels were provided, but you are expected to reuse (which is fine)
Tap water is safe and fine, though be aware that some of berlins water is hard water and can cause throat irritation.
Only real complaint we had is there is no light outside the door. There is a motion activated light on the floor below, which helps going up, however going down you are sometimes in complete pitch blackness.
Over all though, fantastic stay!

We came by car and brought our bicycles. The car was kept just few blocks away on street for free. For bicycle storage there is a nice courtyard in the block. Apartment as descibed - with comfortable matrasses and bed linen.

It was such a peaceful and comfortable stay.
Everything was so clean and organized. Also i was really surprised that the apartment is largen than you see oh the photos.
There was supermarket really close from the apartment also subway station is near by so it was so easy access to everything I need.
I’d definitely recommend also I’d definitely love to comeback at Arzu & Tom’s apartment if I have chace to travel in Berlin again!

Great communications and directions. Host very responsive. Place as pictured. Gave 4 stars because the washing machine was out of order and I have been traveling for the last 3 weeks and needed to do laundry. Host offered to pick up the laundry and wash it at their place for a charge of 5 euros. I didn’t feel comfortable with this arrangement and had to deal with the situation with dirty clothes or buy underwear. Also, no dishwasher. Lots of steps, but this was clear. Location is good, close to bars and subway.
Berlin was great and so was the house.  Appreciated their tips on the neighbourhood. Lovely beergarten and nice restaurants to end  a day of siteseeing in.

Very nice and clean apartment, feels like home right away. It is very spacious and has everything you might need for a short stay. We had no problems with checking-in and throughout our stay. Arzu and Tom were very friendly and responsive, gave very clear instructions. We enjoyed our stay a lot! :)

I came to Berlin to attend a conference with some friends and we’re SUPER happy to have stayed at Arzu and Tom’s!
Arzu was super friendly, responsive, flexible, welcoming and helpful throughout. She also went above and beyond to help us with a package delivery as well - to which were super grateful!
Their place is exactly as pictured and we loved staying in the neighborhood! It’s so lovely, full of restaurants and bars and overall just really charming!
We already spoke about coming to conference again next year and staying at their place again, as the experience was just perfect!
The apartment is beautiful and in such a great location! Mala’s communication is top notch as well. We couldn’t have been happier and will definitely stay here again!!
Mala’s place was absolutely perfect. Ideal location, beautiful home - and she was a very helpful and friendly host. Would highly recommend!
We really enjoyed our time at Mala’s place. Truly getting away from the hustle  and bustle of the busy streets to this quiet oasis was great.
This place is really solid.  We had a great stay.  Location is fantastic and the apartment was very comfortable.

The flat was amazing; bright, open, clean and overlooking a great court yard. The only downside was the internet - I couldn't connect all of the time, and when I did it wasn't strong enough to even download my email.

Other than that, the flat was amazing.
Such a beautiful space, location is superb! Nice kitchen, fully equiped. Balcony is so wide and the view is terrific. Averall, it was a great stay, thank you!

The flat was lovely and bright with a great view over the courtyard. The restaurant below is great, well worth a visit. Set in the heart of Mitte, there are super restaurants, cafes, shops etc all within walking distance. I highly recommend it!

The flat looks exactly like in the pictures
Really cosy and bright, very quiet area and very close from supermarket and subway station
A bit "minimalist" if you want to cook- only one pan and nothing in the cupboards (we had to buy everything but salt and pepper)
All in all good start to sightsee in Berlin!

The apartment is in a fabulous location for experiencing Berlin life and the building is beautiful. There is also a lovely restaurant downstairs which is convenient (it doesn't stay open late and enjoys polite clientele so noise is no issue at all). We had a fantastic stay and would highly recommend it!!
The apartment is in a very residential are. The sofa bed was broken. This made our stay very uncomfortable. Little amenities were provaided.
Brilliant apartment, looks exactly like the pictures, amazing Cafe and Restaurants in the area you can walk to.

This is a gem apartment. It's super minimal and chic. The location is amazingly close to everything. It's a prime location near restaurants, shopping, cafes, and the supermarket. There's an awesome restaurant right downstairs that has the best food with a lovely interior. There's a mini fridge to put in groceries or drinks. The best part is the HEATED FLOORS and full ceilng to floor windows. Lots of natural sunlight in the morning as you wake up. I would stay here again if I ever came back to Berlin. Klaus was an amazing host who stayed in communication with us whenever we needed, even when he was on vacation!  Very caring and responsive. I definitely recommend this place.

This is a lovely bright apartment in a lovely part of Berlin. We stayed 4 nights in total and found the accommodation very comfortable and it helped to make our visit to Berlin a very memorable one on the weekend the World Record for the Marathon was broken!

Great location, nice and clean room.
Only there are some difficulties contacting the host during our stay.
Apart from that, it is a great flat
We had a lovely stay here at the old brewery. The apartment is amazing and the location is beautiful. Highly recommend.
Everything was great. Would have loved another fan or air condition during 34 degree heat wave but over all we enjoyed our stay a lot. Great location!

A lovely, modern, light and airy apartment in a great location with loads nearby and great transport links. Bed was very comfortable and kitchen was well stocked. Would highly recommend staying here if you're visiting Berlin!

Klaus was a very helpful and responsive host. Location was ideal for further trips and was very peaceful when settling in for the evening.
The apartment was exactly as shown and very comfortable to stay in. Overall apartment provided an excellent base to explore Berlin and would be very happy to stay there again.

Very spacious apartment with all the needed euipment. Flexible and nice hosts that guided us to near by things to do, where to find S-bahn etc.
Very good beds, good kitchen and bathroom facilities.
The apartment is in the outskirts of the city but close to S-bahn and therefore really good vallue.

This is a great apartment in the perfect location. Roi has been very helpful and the time for key exchange was on time.
The apartment is brand new refurbished and one feels just like in a 5 star hotel but with the privacy of your own home. I love to stay there again on my next visit to Berlin.

I would definitely come back to your place Roi! :) You're the best host ever and your cozy flat was truly perfect to have a great time in lovely city Berlin...
Many thanks indeed for your kindness and cooperation..Roi's Apartment is a home...
This flat is a-five star one! Even much better than a-four star Hotel...:) Trust me :)
Everything is well-provided and you can cook..U should also try Hasir Restaurant located just two blocks away, so delicious :)

Best of luck and let's keep in touch..
-H-
There were no flaws with this apartment. I can not wait to book another flight to Berlin soon and stay there again. The host was super friendly and helpful, as mentioned by multiple guests.
This place is incredible! Great location, great features, and super attentive host. It's the perfect place!!! When we come back to Berlin, we will be staying here.

Roi's apartment felt better than a hotelroom. Incredibly nice. It's trendy, comfortable, luxurious, the bed is sssooooo nice and you feel at home right away. I took pictures to remember it! Besides that it's perfectly located, central but also very quiet. And on top of that, Roi is the best host imaginable, very warm, polite, kind and easy to communicate with and he offered all the possible help. Would definately book this apartment again!

The apartment is amazing!! such a great location, it's right down the road from KaDaWe with great links into Mitte. Roi was a great host, easy to get hold of and so helpful. I'll definitely stay here again if I come back, I can't recommend it enough.
Roi has impessivly low response times and the appartment was in a perfect condition!
The apartment is great and in a fantastic location. Despite our early arrival Roi accommodated us and was also very helpful and responsive in giving us some good advice on the neighbourhood

A great studio on a wonderful tree lined street which is very close to a U-Bahn station as well as a very large shopping district. It's about an hour walk to Mitte - Alexanderplatz & around 20 minutes via the U-Bahn. All the appliances (which I used) are in excellent condition. The washer and dryer make it so you can bring less clothing and return home with a clean suitcase. The bed is very comfortable and the sheets are very nice. My only warning would be that the shower is a bit on the small size - if you're a large person it maybe a tight squeeze. Overall, a great apartment in a great location.

A gorgeous modern apartment furnished with all the amenities and a fantastic style, nestled in the heart of Berlin. We had a wonderful four days and Roj and Mayaan were on call always if we needed them. Will most definitely be coming back to stay here again in the future!

Exceptional apartment and fantastic to deal with. Very comfortable place and very close to shopping and city centre is easily accessible. Maayan the welcome lady was very helpful and the welcome drink was a nice touch. If you are a larger person then the shower might be a bit cosy but I'd definitely stay here again.

My friend and I had an amazing time at Roi's place. Everything is just like the pictures and the bed is super soft, we slept really good. We had some trouble with the key of the apartment but Roi helped us out immediately. Super friendly, nice apartment, very central, just perfect!

Roi's place was incredible. Great location, close to u bahn, s bahn stations, shopping, restaurant, bars. Check in was really easy and convenient we even got some champagne as welcome. Host was available any time for questions and help. The place was clean and comfortable. Perfect for our first time in Berlin. I would definitively look for this place if I come back! Absolutely loved it.

Wonderful apartment and a very helpful host. Superfast answers and always very helpful. The apartment is very calm during the day and the night, you don't hear any noise from the street. Definitely recommend it!!

It’s exactly as described. Tom was waiting for us at the apartment and explained everything to us. The apartment was spotless and had lots of thoughtful touches. We had everything we needed to feel at home. The apartment is very close to everything and even though it’s a stones throw away from all the shops, it was very quite at night. Roi was very helpful in storing our luggage even after we checked out. He was a perfect host. I’ll definitely be returning.

Here are a few of the features of Roi's modern studio/loft apartment that make it a great place to stay:  king size bed, big screen tv, fully furnished user friendly kitchen,  big bathroom with a washer AND A DRYER, elevator, location, proximity to public transportation (U bahn, S bahn, taxi's), grocery shopping, Victoria-Louise Plaza, high end neighborhood, bakery next door and more.  You will love it.

The apartment has a perfect location on a quiet residential street. It is close to transportation, fine dining, and great shopping areas. We love the big airy windows and the Nespresso machine! Roi is a super responsive host. We would stay here again without thinking twice.
Great apartment, ideal location. Spotlessly clean, very helpful and responsive host. Would recommend and would book this apartment again.

Roi’s place is fantastic - all new and extremely clean, and exactly as described.  The listing indicates clothes washing facilities in the building, which I thought meant a shared machine - there is actually a brand new washing machine and a drier in the bathroom which is great. A great space for one person or a couple wanting base in Berlin, and only a few minutes walk to the U-bahn and plenty of restaurants.
This is my new fav place to stay in Berlin! The location is perfect, it’s spotless, updated and easy to work with Roi. Will be staying here again.

My stay in Roi's home was absolutely delightful - quiet, clean, & absolutely beautiful. I really enjoyed the art deco style with little vintage touches, especially the beautiful silver framed mirror at the entrance. There were tons of small, thoughtful amenities provided, like detergent pods for the washer ashtrays for smokers (even though I don't smoke cigarettes) that show that the host actually cares for the comfort of their guests. I can't say enough great things about the location. There were tons of restaurants nearby to grab a bite to eat, & lots of cute boutiques for those interested in shopping. The bed was also very comfortable, especially after 12hrs of running around at a conference all day! I very much enjoyed my stay. Thank you so much for a lovely visit to Berlin.

We had an amazing time here - the apartment is furnished well with all the amenities you need and the location was excellent too (easy U-bahn access or 45 min walk to the town centre). The hosts Roi and Tom were very helpful throughout our stay giving great recommendations. Would definitely recommend to others.

We loved the location! So easy to get around town using the subway. Roi was communicative and helpful throughout booking and our stay.  Incredibly clean. Super comfortable bed. Good blackout shades. We highly recommend !

Stylish apartment paired together with a great host. A great place for two, convenient location for those who wants to visit KaDeWe.
Though we never met Roi in person, we could easily reach out and get a super quick response from him.
What else to add? Nothing. Great is great.
This place exceeded our expectations. Spotlessly clean, great area, and Roi is very responsive. Would stay again.
Very nice and clean place. Close to the train, food carts, and the mall. Would stay here again.

Can confirm other positive reviews here. Spotless clean apartment, fast communication with Roi, no problems with key hand over. , received  immediate help when I faced some emergency. Perfect experience
Apartment with huge windows on a pretty quiet street. We slept with windows open most nights in July. 5 min walk from underground station. Very comfortable bed.
Great apartment for exploring Berlin. Communication was excellent, check in and check out was easy, and the space was perfect for a long weekend stay.

Awesome flat! Very well located, 6 minutes walk to the train station. Equipped with everything needed for a pleasant stay. Balcony is a great plus to enjoy breakfast and a cup of coffee. Great stay and great host!
Roi has great communication with us, the place is located close to the mall, grocery store, among others. Great place to stay

Very comfortable apartment in a great area.  Kitchen well equipped and washer/dryer very good.  Host was very responsive and dealt with a minor issue (my mistake!) immediately.  A great place to stay.

We enjoyed this place. The apartment was spacious and clean, check-in was super easy, and when we had even a little problem, Roi was helpful and responsive.
I will definitely be glad to come back next time to Berlin

This is a wonderful location and is near to many great restaurants, bars, and coffee houses. It was very easy to self-check in and the space was great.
Klaus was a great host, provided easy-to-follow instructions, and information on getting into town from the airport was very helpful.
I would definitely stay here again.

Very nice apartment which was clean and tidy. All extra baby equipment we had asked for was in place.
Nice rooftop terrace and good location with nice cafes and supermarket in the neighbourhood.

Our host was very prompt in responding to our request. We booked last minute and he was at the apartment within 15 minutes to let us in. He was SUPER accomoding, even sending over an iron and ironing board for us. The space is large and in a great location comparative to food and transportation. I have to say that given the price I expected a little extra attention to detail, but if you're traveling with more than 2 people like we were it's still totally worth it. We'll stay again next time we're in Berlin.

Great location in Mitte.  Very convenient to public transportation and lots of casual great restaurants and nooks nearby.  The apartment is nice and bright and quite big for a one bedroom.  All the other reviews are very accurate about noise from the restaurant below.  While it wasn't a problem in October as we would close the windows at night, during the summer it could be a problem.  We'd definitely stay here again in 3 of the 4 seasons.

We had a fantastic week in this lovely and comfortable flat in a quiet central area. Klaus was really helpful, responding quickly and positively to our questions. It was our first visit to Berlin, and already looking forward to returning.
Nice place, the neighborhood is great filled with a lot of great restaurants from all over the world. Kreuzberg is awesome!
We had a great stay at Vincent's place. It's nice, well situated, clean and communication was made easy by Vincent and Ina who handed us the keys.

Cool apartment in a buzzing neighborhood, very close to a subway stop. The Sudanese restaurant is a gem as is the chocolaterie. Since it is a basement apartment, air movement is going to be less, but it wouldn't stop me from booking again.

Great place, near to metro station and Postdam Platz. This part of Berlin is fabulous, Kreuzberg is all day living, very exepcional quarter!!! Connection with Ina was perfect. There wasn't any problem with my arrival or departure. Apartment could have a little bit better ventilation. But I dearly recommend this place.
We had a great time at Vincent's place the apartment was really nice, the only bad thing was the beds they were really uncomfortable.

This is a great place to stay-cannot recommend it highly enough. Communication with us before our stay was excellent- Vincent also recommended a cycle hire place for us that was just around the corner which really made our trip:) It is in a great location and the flat itself has everything you'll need, is super cosy and very clean.

Great quirky little apartment/ art gallery in a fantastic area. The apartment was cosy but had everything we needed for a short stay. The apartment is in a basement, and it great to return to a nice cool apartment after exploring Berlin in 30 degree heat. 2 Ubahn lines couple of minutes walk away made it easy to navigate our way around.
Vincent was very helpful before our stay answering any questions we had and collecting the keys from Ina was easy.
The area itself has a nice feel to it and is full of bars, good restaurants, breakfast places and vintage shops.
We loved our stay and would love to stay again to explore the parts of Berlin we couldn't fit in

Great apartment, with lots of interesting art on display! Very comfortable and very easy to arrange key collection etc. On a quiet street, but really close to lots of excellent cafes, bars & restaurants, as well as the nearest u-bahn station. Perfect all round! Loved it, thanks!
This apartment is in the perfect location for a weekend in Berlin. The apartment is interesting, has great artwork and is very comfortable. Highly recommended!

Such a unique airbnb, filled with art and such fun lighting. The location is amazing, steps away from one of the hippest Berlin neighbourhoods just filled with interesting shops, bars and restaurants. Would absolutely go back!
Lovely charming artistic appartement in a typical Berlin quarter that is ideally located. I highly recommend this place to anyone who wants to visit Berlin.

Lovely, quirky apartment. Situated very well, with easy access to u-bahn. Some good restaurants, bars etc nearby. Didn’t realise it was a studio apartment and all open plan, but fine for a short stay.
Amazing apartment in an amazing location.  the apartment is very stylish, clean and is also in a great location. Would highly recommend and wouldn't hesitate to stay again!!

Great apartment in lovely Kreuzberg. Much better than staying in typical tourist areas like Mitte. Really lovely hosts who helped us out a lot! Very stylish flat filled with their art, very modern central heating and other appliances like the hob and good shower. Perfect for a couple exploring Berlin, also really close to the underground and good restaurants like Umami.
Really cool place to stay and look around in Berlin. Close to many restaurants and bars and U-bahn. Amazing decor and lovely service!
Great location near Victoria park in Kreuzberg. Market Hall, restaurants, U bahn all within 5 minutes walking. Quiet street with in a lively neighborhood!

Great GREAT location!  The place is small and cozy but works well for three people.  Toilet/shower are cramped together into a small space but it works.  A bit pricy but it was well worth it for the location.

Vincent’s place was amazing and we had the best stay there. So many amazing places around to eat at and great coffee places. The place was clean and tidy and Vincent was amazing with communication! Would definitely visit this place again

Great location and very interesting apartment full of cool art. Quirky and original but not always enough hot water for two showers! We enjoyed the great choice of food (especially vegan!) in Kreuzberg and how close the apartment was to the U-bahn.

The apartment is in the very attractive Bergmannkiez - "Bergmann neighbourhood". It is my favourite part of Berlin. So, the location is great. 50 minutes to the airport by public transport in a very easy way. U7 and X71
It was clean, the design is good and the bed was comfortable.
The apartment is a par Terre, which means it is partially basement and the windows are high. The bathroom is very small, but practical and works fine. The heating is good and in the bedroom you do not hear the street.

Great location close to public transit that made sight seeing incredibly easy. The neighborhood was family centric with lots of good shops and food nearby.  The art was fun and interesting, beds were comfortable and amenities were as described. Would recommend and stay again.

Amazing location, right next to the subway and bus. Very fun apartment with great interior design. Would 100% come back!
P.S. Get the kebap next to the subway station
Had a lovely stay, was in a great location by the u-bahn and absolutely loved the art and style of the airbnb!
An unique artistic place with its soul. Great area to stay. Vincent is responsive and provides clear communication. I will come back def:) Thank you Vincent

We really enjoyed our stay. Appartment was close enough to be able to walk to the main parts of Berlin and was very nice and colourful and spacious just like the photos. Was perfect for a couple nights :)

Great location with the U-Bahn station just around the corner and a food market near selling home made and organic.
Also, nice and quiet of a morning as it’s just off the main street.
Thank you for the stay. I felt central to all my outings and was able to escape the noise back in the apartment. Will definitely stay there again!

Great place, with an excellent location close to bars, restaurants and shops. The neighbourhood is wonderful and there are parks and several metro stations in the near area. The apartment is cozy and it has everything needed for a short stay and it is quite well decorated. There was no problem at all. The communication with the hosts was fluent and they brought us a lot of help. Totally recommended!
This place is so beautiful! The design and touches to place make this one of my favorite places to stay.
Lovely apartment, exactly as described, good location with easy access to U-Bahn and within walking distance of many central attractions
It’s a great location and a classy space.  Definitely for a multiple party situation. Easy access to Berlin!  Def must keep neighborhood hours and quite due to residential surroundings.

Very proactive host that sent information about the local area and ensured that we were comfortable and had everything that we needed. We were met once we had arrived, again to ensure we were OK.
Very clean, lovely apartment completed with fresh cut flowers, a lovely touch.
