Traveling with my wife, son and 2 nephews - this place was perfect, wonderfully historic and more like a hotel than and air-b-n-b - Our host was very thorough and not at all fussy - a super friendly host and was there if we needed.  The location - perfect - most everything was walkable but if you have a car, you can secure a parking spot for a small fee.  Five americans who like our privacy, there was more than enough space.  All in all a great experience.  Thank you so much

The host was extremely nice and very helpful throughout our stay. The apartment was well-equipped with everything we needed, and in a convenient location with supermarkets and various restaurants nearby. We truly enjoyed our stay and hope to come back again next time!

I can honestly say this has been the best airbnb I have stayed in so far. The flat is amazing, clean and very well located in the centre of the city with easy access to everything.
Frank is an amazing host very polite and kind and ready to help with anything you may need the directions were accurate and the check in and out was easy.
If you look for a place were to spend few days in Berlin dont doubt to book this flat !!!
Excellent flat with plenty of space in a good central location. The host was excellent and the place was incredibly clean when we arrived.

I have spent 3 nights in Berlin with my friends. Frank's appartment was exactly the same as it is described in the announcement. It is very well situated, very clean and well equipped. We could easily agree on our arrival, how to get the keys etc. Frank was very cooperative and helpful. I would suggest the appartment to anyone staying in Berlin.
Very nice flat near to many famous Berlin monuments and public transports ! It was really easy to get the keys and Frank was a really nice host ! Thank you very much for this nice weekend !
We stayed at Frank's for 4 days and for 5 university students this place was really everything we could've wished for. Would recommend this place any time of the day! :)

Frank's place was perfect for a chrisas trip to Berlin. Centrally located, walking distance from central points and subway-supermarkets-cafes.
The apartment itself was very clean and very comfortable for a group of two young couples.
Would visit again happily!
Very well situated quiet flat, ideal for visiting the city. Franck is a friendly host, very reactive.

Frank is really helpful in every way: check-in and check-out schedule is no problem with him! His best quality is to try to make everything comfortable for the guests and he does it perfectly :) I'd definetly choose him again!
The place is real clean and stylish and has more than everything you need. Frank is super helpful, proactive and kind. A superhost indeed. No false advertisement here so feel safe to book.

Very happy with our stay at this place, clean place, very pretty (better than in the pictures!), close to Potsdamer Platz and Alexanderplatz is a few metro stops away, Frank was super hospitable and attentive, if you're 2 or 3 people I can't recommend the place enough

Frank is super host! We are very greatful for such a warm welcome. Flat is situated in a very convenient place close to many sights.
Also we’d like to mention cool feature that allows people to share food and things like shampoo with future guests.
Frank is one of the best hosts we have ever met.

very nice stay in this cozy apartment 🥰
bery nice and good hosting!
i recomended this host! 😎

Frank’s Bell’alloggio has everything you need for an amazing stay in Berlin: Alexander Platz and, more in general, any monument in the Mitte area is reachable by foot (when we wanted to stay in the area we barely used public transport). If you like comfortable, clean, curated, and centre-located apartments, then this is the one you should book. Supermarkets and all facilities (including bus and metro stops) are very near the flat, and the area is safe.
This is, in every sense, a BELL’ALLOGGIO.
We will definitely come back!
Appartment close to almost everything. Appartment had what we needed. Space good for 4 persons - five would be crowded (we booked for five persons but only came four). Can only recommend!

The location of Frank’s place is conveniently located in Mitte, which is pretty much easy walking-distance to public transportation points and many tourist attractions.
Easy self check-in and check-out process with detailed instructions in a letter. Frank was efficient and helpful with communication when we had questions. The size of the place is perfect for two of us. We especially loved the “ From guests for guests” Drop-boxes in the kitchen and bathroom where we found stuff we could use. The ambience and decor (blue color themed) were nice and thoughtfully coordinated.
Anyway, it was a lovely place for a pleasant stay.
Frank was nice and responsive. Check-in and check-out were easy. The place is in a great location. A Lidl is right down the street and the metro is a few minutes walk.

Apartment is in the great location. Room was well prepared for us. I also loved that Frank has a baby cot available for us. Unfortunately the dishwasher was broken during our stay but we didn't cook much, so it was okay.
Great place, safe location and close to some good clubs. Frank is an excellent host and the added bonus of toiletries and food from past guests was much appreciated. Would highly recommend!

Great place. Berlin tends to be spread out, but this apartment is conveniently located within easy reach of most Berlin museums, historical sites, and interesting neighborhoods.
Frank was a very accommodating host, communicated reliably, and the check-in process was flexible and easy.
I would definitely come back.

Location location location. Most tourist attractions are within walking distance (20 minutes or less)
Apartment had more than the "bare essentials" that many Airbnbs seems to offer. Made for a very comfortable stay (I was working remotely each day from this place).
Host was very responsive and flexible.

The location of this apartment is wonderfull. All interesting parts of Berlin are within (public Transport-) distance. The apartment has all services you need, but it needs some extra maintenance. Frank is also very repsonsive.

Super nice host. Nothing fancy but all the basic facilities are there. Extensive from-guest-to-guest on city guides and all the annoying small things if you had to buy it for your own use (oil, salt, spice, soap,...).
I recommend to try the TimeRide Virtual Reality experience as the virtual busride takes you on Leipziger Strasse and passes the building.
I will use Frank's apartment again.
Really great location, Frank was very helpful with good communication. everything is walkable from the apartment and we had a really enjoyable stay.

Everything was fine, Frank is a very helpful person. He gave us the opportunity to leave luggage over check out time.
The house is very pretty, in the picture does not make it good enough. I recommend it to everyone
Thank you Frank for this appartment in Berlin, ideally located in the city centre. Bright, spacious, ideal for spending a few days in Berlin, transport nearby, good value for money.

Great location near Berlin's Center. There are many grocery stores nearby and there's a bus stop very close to the building.
Frank is a very attentive host. Any problem or suggestion he's always there to help.

very nice place to stay to discover Berlin. really city center with lots of opportunities around. U-Bahn is very close as well as restaurants, supermarket... Frank was very friendly and helped us to discover. 2 days is not enough. we will have to come back!

The house of Andreas and Peter is nice and warm. We were eight persons from a masters course in a visit to Berlin for a week and we had a good experience in the house. The thing is that some slept really confortable in the queen bed but others slept in the mattress. When we arrived to the house we had a bit of difficultly with the code system to open the doors of the entrance, kitchen and rooms, but then it was fine. The only moment we say the host was when peter stopped by the house one of the nights at 11.30 o'clock at night to say hi. At that moment most of  the group were asleep because we had to wake up very yearly next moment. It was nice to meet him!

We were 10 guys spending a weekend in Berlin, and we found the Ferienremise a very convenient place to stay. The appartment is placed in a very nice neighborhood (Schöneberg) with plenty of restaurants, cafes, food markets and subway stations nearby.

The hosts Peter and Andreas were very helpful and quick to answers questions before and during our stay.

If you are a large group of people planning to spend a social weekend in Berlin, go for the Ferienremise!

This is an excellent place for a group. We had 11 family members here for 4 nights and enjoyed the apartments and group facilities. The fooseball table was very popular with the children. The cafe Linds is delicious and the staff is helpful. The S-Bahn is very close and took us to all of the major tourist destinations.

We stayed in Peter and Andreas place in juli 2015.  We were three familys staying here and it was a perfect home for a group of people. The neighboorhood was nice and the home was clean and simple. Andreas was really nice and helpfull as well. We will recommend this place and would like to come back soon.

- Nice and convenient neighborhood. (Very short distance to the s-Bahn stop Julius Leber-Brucke).
- Clean, spacious and nice Apartments.
- A good commonroom, quite sound proof.
- The hosts were easy to contact, flexible and helpful.
I will definately recommend staying at the Ferienremise to other groups travelling! In total, a very good stay.

The apartment was perfect for what we needed.  We were a group of 16 in Berlin for a 30th birthday.  The place was clean and the listing described the apartment accurately.  We were provided with clean towels and linen for a modest amount.  The entry codes were so handy for such a large group as we could all come and go as we pleased.  The floor mattresses were comfortable for two nights.  The common area was awesome as well - the foosball table was a hit, and the kitchen was well equipped.  The apartment was right near an S-bahn and walking distance to a U-bahn, there were great cafes nearby and was close enough to the main parts of Berlin.  Peter and Andreas were very easy to communicate with and very responsive.  I would definitely recommend staying here!
Amazing weekend trip to Berlin. The rooms were clean, spacious, light, comfortable and the common room area was very well equipped. We hope to make a return soon.

Very good location, in a calm street just 2 minutes to the s-bahn, bus, taxi and supermarkets and restaurants. Rooms and the common place are in perfect shape and equipped with WC/shower. We stayed comfortably as a family of 10adults and 3children. Guides were provided in several languages.
A brilliant place to stay as a group. We went as 12 people, lots of space for everyone, the common room was great. A 2minute walk to the S-bahn and so easy to get to the airport. Would def recommend.

Everything went well and we had nice weekend at Peter's and Andrea's place. Apartment gives you own privacy because there is so many rooms, with own toilets also. And that common room with fire place and perfectly equipped kitchen is awesome! 5/5!

A group of 12 of us stayed for two nights and it was just perfect! There was plenty of space for everyone, the beds were all super comfy including the additional beds & the communal space and courtyard were ideal. Peter and Andreas were so incredibly helpful both before and during our stay going above and beyond and the ladies in Café Linds were also great. They hosted a private dinner for us on the Friday and it was delicious!
great and clean 4 rooms for 14 people. good location nearby metro station, Super market, cafe, etc.
Nice place and very comfortable for our group. Peter and Andreas replied very fast for every kind of our request.

Peter and Andreas have a wonderful place, it's the perfect 'base camp' to explore the city. Ideal for large groups, and the level of communication and details was perfect.
We were a large group of 16 and every single one of us would highly recommend this place.
Thank you both again, for such a lovely few days. Ben

Myself and my five siblings - all 40+ years - have had a fabulous visit to Berlin. The  accommodation was the perfect  base for the trip and spending time together. The rooms and facilities were perfect for us - it was warm, clean and spacious. The beds were extremely comfortable. Having our own shared open space dining/kitchen room with additional toilet facility leading into sweet little courtyard provided an excellent space to prepare for and share our experiences in Berlin. The location is fantastic, 25mins by taxi from airports and close to excellent amenities, including underground. Our hosts had responded to communication quickly and helpfully. I would strongly recommend it and would gladly stay here again.

Absolutely amazing place, had everything our group needed and was very clean and tidy when we arrived, great location as it was very close to a train station that took us to wherever we needed to go. Would definitely book again when travelling to Berlin!!!
Good communication, good location, beautiful spot..super comfy beds! :) We had a really great time!

It’s so difficult to find a place that can host 10+ people comfortably however here was amazing with all the space provided! Perfect for a large group with multiple couples who can spend their own time together if they want too.
Had an amazing stay here, would recommend to any large group travelling to Berlin - exceeded all expectations!

Great place. We’ve rented the place with a group of 10 and occupied the whole building. Felt like a friends-block. The U-Bahn is just 100m away and there are a lot of shops and restaurants in the area.

For 10 to 12 persons looking for a central place in Berlin this is perfect.
Nice and quiet, lots of space, nice bathrooms (4 of them), very nice and cozy courtyard.
Many good restaurants close by. Also very close to public transport (S-bahn and buses).
We enjoyed our stay very much and will definitely come back next time visiting Berlin that many people.

Location was perfect for us. Nice flats, clean. We  we’re a group of 12 and the separate flats with the large common room/kitchen was a perfect arrangement for us. Would absolutely recommend the flat to others!

Fantastic base to explore Berlin. the accommodation had everything we needed with plenty of space ( 8 of us staying). make sure you explore the local area- we found some great restaurants and bars. The owners were very helpful too and  always quick to respond.

Friendly host, great location close to train station and enough space for our large 10 person group. Only downside is that we had to pay $100 for use of towels and linens which I haven’t seen at any other Airbnb property.

Great location, lots of space. Fit 13 people comfortably and was able to explore Berlin thoroughly the weekend of the marathon! Perfect for a large group to stay in and hang out together while still having the privacy of separate units of apartments. Highly recommend
A great place to stay for a large group, right next to the train station which makes it very easy to explore Berlin from here.

We were two families staying together and it was terrific for us across the four connected apartments, especially for the kids who appreciated their own space. A somewhat simple but comfortable setup, extremely well located in a vibrant area for both local eating/food shopping and best of all with the S1 line literally metres from the front door. We had a couple of minor problems through our stay but the hosts were always very quick and responsive. A great stay.

We had a great stay here. The accommodation was perfect & the location was great. The tram station right next to the apartment made is easy to get around the City.
Every time I sent a message to Isabel, Peter & Andreas they responded very quickly with an answer to our questions.
We would definitely recommend this place & would stay again.
Perfect accomodation with large rooms close to S bahn. Not all was proper but still OK and because of the winebar we were unable to sit outside with very nice weather. Good to go 👍

Great stay with a big group of friends. Nice rooms, multiple bathrooms, cleaned very well and a lot of space in a quiet setting. Easy to reach as the public transport is 100 meters away. Would recommend this one!

Really impressed with Peter and Andreas’s place and 100% recommend it. It comfortably slept 12 of us, and we each had our own bed and a bathroom between 3 people. Beds were comfy and spacious. Linen and towels weren’t included as standard but could be added for a small fee which is well worth paying.
We also had access to a common room on the ground floor which has a fully equipped kitchen and extra WC. While we didn’t use the cooking facilities during our stay (just the glasses and fridges) it had everything you needed if you wanted to buy your own food and cook it at the property.
Finally, the property is well located, with excellent transport links to the centre of Berlin (there is an S-Bahn station 1 min walk from the property, ~15 mins to the centre) as well as bus and taxi stops. I’d definitely return here if I come to Berlin again!

We greatly enjoyed our stay in Berlin over Christmas and New Years. The apartment is spacious and light, and well suited for our family (two children in their early 20s). The apartment had everything we needed, and the location is close to shops, restaurants, parks, and many Berlin attractions. We used the apartment as a base to explore Berlin, but also took advantage of the comfortable space and fireplace for long evenings together. Watching the fireworks from the balconies on both sides of the apartment on New Years Eve was spectacular.
One thing to be aware of is that two bedrooms are furnished for young children. Our young adult children slept on mattresses on the floor.

This home is very comfortable, vast, stylish and has everything you need for your stay in Berlin. Watching the sunset over Berlin from this apartment is fantastic and the equipped kids’ room and outdoor space kept our children happy. It is in a great neighborhood with lots of local places to eat and grab a drink. Annette was very accommodating. We had a wonderful time and would love to come back.
We (family of 4) have travelled to many AirBnBs, all over the world. I would say this was one of the best. A superb time. Thank you!

Annette ‘s place is superb, the best Airbnb we ever stayed at. We thoroughly enjoyed our time in the house. Annette is very nice and responsible, she always responds to  my questions asap, she also offers us a very convenient check in and check out time, which is a great help to us. Highly recommended 👍

Beautiful huge apartment with everything you could possibly need. There are two floors: the first floor has three bedrooms (one is the parents’ suite) and two full bathrooms. In the parents’ suite there is a balcony with a sauna. In the upper floor there are big living room and a kitchen, and two balconies with outstanding views. There is a sweet sand box in the building, which was very successful among our children. The apartment was overall clean, communication with Annette and her husband was good and easy. The location is just perfect: walking distance from many attractions and restaurants, as well as many playgrounds in the area.
The only minus for us was that while in the pictures it seems like an apartment for young children, the pictures were not updated to show that the rooms now are suitable for teenagers. The rooms are still comfortable, but weren’t the perfect fit for our energetic young kids…
Still, overall a great experience! We recommend.
Absolutely fantastic apartment with magnificent sunrise and sunset views from the two big terraces. Best neighborhood in Berlin.

This was an amazing Airbnb. Annette’s home is in a great location and it looks over the whole city. It is very comfortable and beautiful. We had a great family trip; the house was perfect for a family of 4 with two young kids.

Light, bright and serene apartment in the coolest part of Berlin. We really enjoyed our stay. Very easy to find and the key pick-up process was very straightforward. Very spacious, the photos do not show how big it is. Great kitchen facilities if you want to stay in and cook. Plenty of excellent food options right on your doorstep.
Highly recommend staying at Julia's beautiful apartment.
Super nice and comfortable flat and a reactive host. The area also had enough restaurants and places to go for a drink. Would recommend it.

Julia's apartment is very clean, very spacious and beautifully appointed. The location is ideal, close to both U and S Bahn stations and surrounded by local restaurants and bars (lots of them to choose from).
I highly recommend it!

Julia's place is my favorite Airbnb that I've stayed in.  It is large, clean, comfortable, and in an amazing location.  There are tons of interesting stores and yummy restaurants nearby.  It is a short walk from her place to 4 different public transit stations, so you can get to anywhere in Berlin quickly.  And anytime I had a question, Julia responded to me within 30 minutes.  I hope I can stay here again next summer.  Amazing!

Staying in Julia's apartment was a pleasure in all aspects. Communication went super smooth, check in & check out was easy peasy, the location is amazing (near public transportation, close to restaurants & shops) and the apartment itself is just gorgeous - larger and even prettier than the pictures show. Also, the apartment is spotless clean! Perfect.
Thanks so much, Julia!

With the great reviews Julia and her apartment have received I expected it to be good but it exceeded my expectations.  The apartment is bright and airy and features so many lovely little personal of touches.  It was an oasis of calm at the end of a busy day touristing.  Also, the neighbourhood itself was amazing!  I was there for a month and towards the end I rarely left.  Special thanks to the young men who own the wine bar right next door (Noble Rot Weinbar) - it was a great place to finish a long day before heading up to bed.
Julia's flat is very spacious, central and beautifully appointed.  Glad I chose this airbnb for my Berlin trip!

I just got back from five days in Berlin and couldn’t be happier with my choice! Julia’s apartment is lovely; thoughtfully decorated, homely, clean, comfortable and in a fabulous location! I couldn’t recommend it more and will definitely book again if I ever make it back to Berlin.

Friedrichshain is one of the most local and best neighborhoods in Berlin and Julia’s apartment is just in the middle of it all. The apartment is actually biggest than you see on the pictures. Sparkling clean, well decorated and incredible cozy. For sure will be my home again when back to Berlin.

A wonderful, stylish and meditative home filled with lovely touches, good books and light. The bathroom is spacious and had everything you need. The bedroom is peaceful and faces to the courtyard away from the street. The living room is perfect for reading and relaxing. Cozy kitchen. Great balcony for breakfast or an after dinner drink.
Julia's place is wonderful with all the perfect touches.  This is my second time staying here and loved it just as much as the first time!  Look forward to staying again in the future!
The flat was really very nice and the host couldn't have done any more to make us feel welcome and comfortable for our stay. Thank you!

The emails from the host were good - plenty of detail and easy to follow. I didn't meet them but they checked up to make sure I'd got in ok and that everything was fine with the apartment.

The location is on a busy street but the windows are very good and keep the noise out. Lovely apartment with a fab shower (very rare in Berlin!) and close to areas with restaurants and bars, and to the fab Gleisdreieck park.

It was a wonderful stay at the flat in Kreuzburg. The flat is very stylish with moldings on the ceilings and absolutely brilliant play of the space. Everything modern that you need at the kitchen you will find there. We just wish it was not a business trip and not only for four days in order to stay longer in a new area of Berlin for us to explore parks and restaurants around. We would recommend it with no doubts.

This is a wonderfully comfortable studio apartment in a convenient location in Kreuzberg. The apartment is as it is pictured but it's definitely bigger. Despite it being a studio, they have a 3/4 high wall separating the living and sleeping area which gives it a bit more privacy. The kitchen is fully equipped even with a washer and dryer and the bathroom shower is nice and big with a huge shower head and lots of hot water! The apartment is conveniently located on the ground floor so for people like me with huge suitcases, it's great. There is one step up into the kitchen area from the living and bedroom. There are plenty of places to eat and the Yorckstr. station is about 300 meters away so traveling by train or subway is easy. I felt very comfortable in this apartment and would definitely stay there again in the future. Thank you Suites and More!

We had the most incredible weekend in Berlin which was only made better by staying in this apartment. It was absolutely stunning! It is much more spacious than it looks and is spotlessly clean. The location was ideal for us, just a five minute walk from the metro and a short walk to all the amazing bars and restaurants in the area! I managed to get some shopping in a nearby Kreuzberg vintage market which made be very happy! I stayed here with 2 of my friends and we had more the enough space and some much comfort and our host was super attentive and always available when we had a question. I highly recommend this property and if I go back to Berlin I will absolutely try to stay here! The perfect place for a perfect weekend!

Great place to stay - lots of nice little touches. Well described, newly refitted all the mod-cons you require and kept clean and in working order.

Location was great and we had an excellent holiday with a fun place to come home to each night.

This is a smart and comfortable apartment and is a short walk from the Yorckstrasse I and S Bahn stations as well as the shops, bars and restaurants of Kreuzberg. The apartment is next to a fairly noisy road and this is a bit of a problem if the windows need to be open - which they do in hot weather as there is no aircon.

This apartment is lovely. Nice high ceilings, wood floors, great shower. The hosts have a great manual in the space to answer your questions and they communicate right away with you as well. Quiet and great location near markets and cafes. Good neighborhood. I'm recommending to friends.
Very professional, easy, communication and check-in. It's a great apartment in a very nice part of town. Would stay here again in a heartbeat.

Great place, solid host. If you don’t mind a little walking (or biking, taxis) the location is excellent. The broader neighborhood has a lot to offer.
The place itself is very nice. Very clean, well appointed, stylish, comfortable. As a tall, large man, the bed was a bit short and the blankets were a bit narrow. The shower drain was clogged and flooded the bathroom and kitchen. There was no coffee in the apartment. The washer and dryer are in great shape and work well.

We really enjoyed our stay in this apartment. The bed is super comfortable!! It’s in a great location, within walking distance to the station and many restaurants, bars, cafes and parks. It  was nice and clean, with everything we needed and great communication from the hosts. Also some very unique qualities, such as various colour settings for the lights and quirky rocket ship pictures on the walls. I highly recommend.
Wonderful apartment in a very nice area full of interesting spots and two wonderful parks just around the corner. The communication with the host was very smooth and fast. I will come back!

Just returned from a 6 night stay here. Very nice apartment, in a great area, with all supermarkets, shops, bars, restaurants only a very short walk away. In a lovely area, and close to U-bahn. We had an early flight in to Berlin, and a late flight out, so luggage storage for us was an issue. We did however avail of Simón's suggestion of www.nannybag.com and it turned out that the Kiosk shop opposite the apartment was on their list, and they stored our bags for the day, at €6 per bag (not open on Sundays).

I highly recommend stay here while in Berlin.
The space is gorgeous, with all the amenities and comfort you need. The location is amazing — public transportation just around the corner.
You can expect a super clean, stylish, quiet and confort at your home, and an easy check-in. It definitely exceeds the expectations from the pictures :)

Great design elements and perfect location. I was pleasantly surprised at the spaciousness and detailed furniture.
One block away from Victoria park which was lovely and close to transportation. Overall excellent stay here.

Impeccable space!
Stylish, modern mixed with classic scandinavian design furniture. The bed is extremely comfortable. The blinds make for a sleep of the gods! I can only recommend this space to anyone.

Simón is a really friendly and helpful host! I had to make some changes to my booking and had several questions and Simón was always available and ready to help. The location is really central within walking distance two beautiful parks (Victoria Park and Gleisdreieck). Also very close to the lively Bergmannstraße and to the metro station. The apartment is also super clean and cozy, with many little details which made my stay very pleasant. I can highly recommend this host and his apartment!

This was such a nice stay, good clear and fast communication for booking and check in, good location with plenty of travel options (trains and busses) and with some nice touches around the apartment :)

Wonderful host with a very nice apartment exactly as described and pictured. I liked the simplicity while maintaining attention to detail. Street access is great. The shutters closing for pure darkness at night is amazing. What’s most important is that the hosts are incredibly attentive and responsive to communication.

specious apartment with everything in and on it. also very clean. it's very close to public transportation and supermarkets. an abundance of restaurants nearby. although a busy street during the day, at night it was quiet. as the weather was quite hot, also in the apartment, I would suggest installing a mobile airconditioner
Neat, clean well equipped. Great location for us.  Would happily stay again.  Great communication from the host.

Very charming older apartment with new features. Very close to restaurant, train stations and food and coffee stores.
Felt very safe in a busy city. Wonderful sized bathroom and excellent shower after a long day of sightseeing. Would definitely stay again!

Flat was very easy to navigate to - ended up being able to take the same train into city center every day, and didn’t feel that I missed out on anything!
A few blocks down were plenty of restaurants and coffee shops, and many grocery options nearby. Easy to stock up on your way back from the city.
Instructions were very clear for checkin and checkout, and I felt very safe even being right off the street. Beautifully, there was also a portable fan, which helps when you’re used to air con! Shower pressure was great, and washing machine worked quickly.
Overall, very happy with my stay, and will look forward to staying here again next time I’m in Berlin.

A wonderful apartment in a really nice area. Convenient for shopping and restaurants as well as being walkable to a lot of sights. The interior was very tastefully decorated with all the amenities you could need. Really excellent place to stay

Very cozy Apparment with very classy /tastefull furniture.
And the hosts are very responsive.
I know where i will be staying next time im in Berlin :)

We had a lovely stay in Doerthe's apartment. Everything worked well and the neighbourhood is great to explore. Doerthe was really accomodating of pour arrival tome and it was greatly appreciated. Don't miss the local markets open every day!

A fantastic place to stay when visiting Berlin! It's close to the A6 and A7 subway lines and close to fantastic food and drinks!  The apartment itself is cute and quaint. Yea, it's in the bottom floor, but it let's in plenty of light and it's spacious.  Doerthe was prompt and helpful when we arrived!

The space was a little smaller than expected from the pictures, but it was very cozy and clean. The host prepared everything perfectly for our arrival! The neighborhood was great! Lots of good restaurants all within a five minute walk from the apartment. Theres also a taxi stand right around the corner, which was very convenient.

Döethe's place in Berlin was perfect in all respects for us. It's in a lively area but offers an oasis from calm after a day or night in the city. Spacious and with everything you could want or need - we're already wanting to come back! Döethe is a great host and was flexible on key pick up and drop off and told you all you needed to know about the apartment.

This little flat is very spacious and extremely comfortable. We had a wonderful stay and were delighted to discover how many great things were an easy walk away, including an undercover food market, an excellent Vietnamese restaurant Umami, two train lines and many great cafes and bars. The bed is huge and the flat has everything you could need for a happy stay in Berlin.

Dörthe's apartment is an excellent option to stay in Berlin. It is comfortable and clean. Plus, its location is close to the subway and in a place with lots of restaurants and shops. I will definitely repeat if I come back to Berlin!

This place is perfect. Very clean and well laid out for two of us. The pretty apartment has all the amenities you could need. A bottle of wine and crisps was left for us and was very welcome. The area is great with plenty shops and excellent restaurants. Doerthe was very helpful and kept in contact with us to answer any questions we had. We will be back :-)

¡Great place! The location is fabulous, near to many restaurantes, markets, subway, etc and Doerthe was ver comprehensive when we arrive later and have some beatiful details that make us feel very welcome.The aparment is just like in the pictures, very clean and comfortable. Totally recommend the place.

There were four of us that stayed at Dörthe's apartment for a long weekend away. We all agreed it was one of the best Airbnb's we've stayed in - it was clean, in a great location, very comfy beds (even the pull out bed!) and great value for money. It was a great size and had all the essentials and more! Nearby are lots of cool bars and restaurants within easy walking distant. The main sights were a bit of a further walk but again not too far. The apartment is also really close to the U-Bahn which was an excellent and cheap way to get around. Also very easy to reach from the airport. I would highly recommend this apartment and will be back on our next visit to Berlin! Thanks Dörthe!

Perfect location for a family. Central but quite apartment. A lot of cafés, restaurants, and supermarkets nearby. A really clean apartment with all the facilities you could need. We really enjoyed our stay.
we enjoyed this lovely flat so much everything was nice clean and inviting, the location was great,and Doerthe was very helpfull. we would love to return in the future

Best Airbnb stay yet! In a great location, and a perfect apartment! Doerthe is also amazing and responded quickly and helped us when needed, as well as leaving us fruit and wine upon our arrival. Would absolutely stay here again!!

Though being on the mid-underground level, the appartment was very spacious, nice and clean.
Thanks !

A great apartment in a very interesting and safe part of town. Spacious and clean, and very quiet. Kitchen facilities excellent, plus lovely hot shower. Plenty of towels. Very easy check-in. I will be re-booking.
The apartment is located is a  very nice area and it was perfect for our stay. It was easy to find thanks to the description and pictures that we got beforehand. Thank you!

Doerthe was really helpful and came around at short notice to help us put up the travel cot. The flat is perfectly located for exploring the lovely Bergmannkiez. Despite being in the basement (or Souterrain), it feels light, spacious and comfortable.

The apartment is located in a quiet inner courtyard of old buildings, in a very dynamic and pleasant neighborhood. The kitchen is fully equipped with all necessary utensils. We enjoyed our stay in Berlin and our host is very helpful and welcoming.

Elisa's place is simple and the location is great! Could have been cleaner, but we made it work. She was very kind and accomodating to our needs before and during our stay. As others have noted, it's a basement / below ground unit, so it does not get much natural light, especially when it's cloudy! All in all a functional place to stay in a very lovely area of Berlin.
Nice and very cosy place , there apartment is in the middle of everything but  quite and peaceful 👍

Very nice basement flat, with all you need to have a nice moment in Berlin. Comfortable beds, very nice shower room, and a kitchen having all is needed. Great host, with clear instructions and responsive! I truly recommend this place.

The location is great. Close to U-bahn, many nice restaurants and close to very authentic communities. It is exactly as the picture shown BUT...the apartment is very spacious, wasn't much equipped. The Hofe style building has loud echoes if the neighbors have party. Howey is very easy going and easy to deal with.

This place has the absolute best location in Berlin. I loved the minimalist modern feel to the flat. It is pretty sparsely equipped but that wasn't as issue for me. I would recommend this place for sure. Also super good wifi.

The flat was welcoming and worm. Howy was a great host and I enjoyed my experience very much.
One of the best locations in the city, close to everything, in specific, one of the best Ramen restaurants in my eyes.
I really recommend staying over Howy's flat if you visiting Berlin

This guy really tries hard to please his guests.
There was very minimalist furniture (obvious from the pictures). I actually like this, but there is no couch or tv if that is what you are in to. Personally I found it very zen.
I will be staying at this place again. Great location, comfortable and clean and Howie is nice.

Howy is a very kind person!
He solved the trouble.
I also want to stay at his house when I go to Berlin.
thx!Howy

Howy was kind enough to wait for my arrival (even though I was a little late).He was very communicative and when a problem with the bath drain occurred, he resolved it within 24h. The apartment was centrally located close to the Barn cafè, Cocolo ramen and Spirit Yoga. A metro station was near by (walking distance). Basic amenities were offered with the exception of a hair dryer. Overall, recommended!

The apartment was just as promised, Howy was responsive and helpful.
short walk to tram and trains, very convenient.
It was so great staying in Berlin. This place is in the perfect location to walk or take the train to everything you would want to do.

The location of the apartment is perfect!
It's in the city center and yet it's really quiet.
The apartment was confy and exactly like the pictures!

The flat was in a great location. Walkable to many places and, very importantly, close to public transportation. I was surprised at how quiet it was, but it makes sense because it faces the courtyard, not the street. I was also very impressed by how clean the flat was. And the WiFi worked GREAT, which was very important to me.

The Airbnb and location in Berlin was a great spot. Good amenities and close to train stations, local shops and restaurants. The big issue I had was checking in. Having PRE BOOKED this Airbnb 2 months in advanced AND messaging him hours before arriving to the city, he still somehow managed to only give me the address and check in instructions hours after my check in time due to his emergency dental appointment (had to call Airbnb support line to get in contact with him, had to wait around hour/half). I  am 100% understanding with the emergency dental appointment, but not sure why I wasn’t give the check in instructions in the MORNING or even DAY BEFORE. Regardless after this he was responsive and in good contact but this lack of communication left me outside in freezing temperatures, unsure of my location and having to deal with airbnb support line. It was also stated on his listing that he would meet me at the door which he obviously did not.

Awesome!!!!!!!!!!!!!!! Great location, nice neighbourhood and well communicated. The flat just perfect, newly renovated, spotless, lovely decorated -cool, functional, minimal-  really sunny and with beautiful views to the trees and a park. And Rachel and Michael are definitely the perfect hosts... welcome chocolates, some juice and milk in the fridge, good recommendations. The perfect  place if you want to spend some days in Berlin!

Amazing apartment! Really  light, airy and minimalistic in a good way. The location is super between Mitte and Prenzlauer Berg. Rachel is attentive and got to us helpful tips about local places. We will recommend this flat for our friends who going to Berlin.
Lovely simply decorated flat in great location not far from Mitte and Alexanderplatz. Quiet surroundings. Host was great. Will definitely check it out when back in Berlin.
Beautiful appartment in a very nice area of Berlin with lots of shops and restaurants. Cosy bed and everything you need. Very easy communication.

Lovely bright apartment, beautiful and modern furnishings. High quality facilities. Everything was in order and worked well. There are many good restaurants and cozy cafes in the neighborhood. There is a short distance to Alexander Plz., and there are near to tram, U- and S-bahn.
Verda has been very flexible and quick to response. It has been a wonderful stay.

We really enjoyed our stay in Verda's apartment and can highly recommend staying there. It was in immaculate condition - looks as good as, if not better than, the photos in real life. Verda made our stay really welcoming - she even bought me some flowers for my birthday. We loved the area the apartment is located in, our street was quiet but it was a short walk to find the nearest bars and restaurants and it's a short walk from various parks. A great apartment and a great host. Thank you!
Gorgeous apartment, amazing location. Loved staying in Berlin and can't wait to stay here again! Thank you!

Verda's apartment in Berlin is amazing! With the modern bathroom & kitchen, balcony & large loving area it's probably one of unhealthy best airbnb apartments I've stayed in!  Just a a short walk to the underground & with many cafes, bars and restaurants nearby it's easy to find anything you need! I highly recommend Verda's apartment & would stay here again
Verda has a very nice apartment in a beautiful location. It is clean, quite, relaxed and she left 2 cans of prosecco for us to celebrate our arrival.
Verda's apartment was great. It was large, clean &  in a great location & had everything you required as a traveller. Communication was great & check in went smooth. Highly recommend.

Verda's place is perfect for a break in Berlin. Located in a lovely area, super cool shops and cafes nearby and within easy distance to the subway. She also provided a great dining recommendation booklet, with Google maps accompanying as well. Would recommend to anyone going.

The apartment was very beautiful and comfortable. The location was perfect!!
Verda was a great host! The suggestions she made were great and helped us have a lovely time in Berlin.
We would definitely stay here again the next time we visit Berlin :)

My wife and I had a great stay at Verda's apartment. The location is just wonderful, the apartment is beautiful - clean, modern, stylish, light filled and warm (it was 2 degrees outside!). Verda was very helpful from the outset and this continued during the booking period and throughout our stay. We would highly recommend the apartment in every way. Thank you Verda - we will be back! Rod & Sandy

My expectations were exceeded in every aspect of my stay... Communication was perfect, arrival/departure was extremely accommodating, and the apartment was beautiful!  The flat has everything one needs for a memorable and comfortable stay in a lovely area in Berlin.  My only regret is that I had to leave!  Thank you, Verda!

My wife and her sister stayed at Verda's place three nights in April 2016. Verda was very nice and helpful; flexible about the arriving-time and helpful about finding free parking nearby. The appartement was clean and nice, just as the pictures showed. And the neighborhood is perfect for anyone who wants interesseting shops and a variety of places to eat and drink.

Contact was flawless and very accurate. Verda made sure we were welcomed by a friend of hers. The place is spacious and light, neatly decorated and has all the amenities. I stayed in many places in Berlin, but this one certainly is in my top-3, also because of the location.

The apartment was beautiful and light. We had heaps of room to spread out and relax after travelling for a week. The balcony was lovely to sit on in the evenings and have dinner. I would definitely stay here again. Great area with lots of different restuarants and bars to head to.

Verda's place is wonderful; a classic Berlin altbau, cleanly and crisply renovated. I slept like a baby in the bed and enjoyed having a well stocked kitchen to make real meals after several weeks on the road. Verda was helpful and communicative and no complaints. This is a terrific central location too.

We were thrilled with how great Verda's place turned out to be.  The neighborhood is ideally located to all sorts of public transport, restaurants, cafe's, bars, basically anything and everything you need for a visit in Berlin.  Verda was super helpful getting us checked-in and always a quick email away.  The apartment itself was perfect.  Nice open plan with a balcony on the back, luxurious bathroom.  Planning on going to Berlin, I definitely recommend Verda's place.

Communicating and organizing with Verda was a breeze. She even sent me a welcome message after I landed in Berlin. Apartment was beautifully presented, very clean and Verda left gummibears on my pillow. Great folder with all necessary info about apartment and neighbourhood. Very comfortable bed :)
Verda is an amazing host. Her apartment is very nice, perfectly located and very clean. I can only recommend this place which is also perfectly located.

We really enjoyed our stay at Verdas apartment which is clean, modern, bright and spacious with a nice balcony. You will find everything you need in the cupboards and drawers. The 4 flights of stairs left us breathless at times, but it was good training :-) The apartment is centrally located, in a nice neighborhood and close to public transport. Communication with Verda was easy and she was always ready to help. Thanks again!
We absolutely loved this apartment. Verda was terrific and the neighbourhood was superb--chockful of restaurants and shops. We would love to come back!

The apartment was great - just as posted. Very modern and very clean with a few vintage touches which I really appreciated. The location was super convenient - a very easy walk to 2 underground stations. There was a delicious place for coffee and breakfast at the end of the block and a late night convenience store around the corner. Verda was great host, easy to communicate with, friendly and accommodating. Overall A+.

Great location and excellent for the pricing. Bed very confortable and super  quiet. The appartement is at the 5th floor, not problem for us but you need to know. Great stay overall and loved Berlin !

Verda's place is a beautifully renovated, very clean apartment with wood floors, a lovely bathroom, and a charming little patio off the bedroom.  The location on Zionskirchestrasse is fantastic--just northeast of Mitte, very close to streets loaded with excellent restaurants and cafés, yet quiet and residential.  Verda was an excellent host and responded quickly to our few questions.  My wife and I would definitely stay here again when we come back to Berlin.

Was greeted by Verda herself with free fresh cold beers!!! The apartment has everything you need, in an awesome spot for cafes, restaurants and entertainment and it was only a 20 min walk to the Berlin Cathedral, Berlin Wall Memorial and the Pergamon Museum!!!
Verda let us know about the bar that she owns (15 min walk away from the apartment) so we went there on our last night! And it was awesome!!
The apartment itself is stunning, clean and has beautiful views from the windows and the balcony. But ultimately, Verda was so nice and helpful throughout our entire stay and really helped make our Berlin experience a great one!!!

Very happy we chose Verda’s place. It’s a good size for a couple, beautiful space and location, lots of light and air,  very clean, excellent facilities. We shopped local and cooked some meals, and enjoyed having options to eat out within easy walk. Transport close by, nice quiet street, lively neighborhood. Verda’s place was perfect for us and made our Berlin stay memorable. Recommend 100%.

Super apartment and host, in all aspects. The only thing we were missing was a 'Nespresso' coffee machine. Since the apartment is in 5th floor you try to limit the times to go up and down. This was really the only thing we were missing.

Great location and super clean place.  Really loved the location (1 block from the tram ).  Nice neighborhood with good coffee shops, restaurants and grocery stores within walking distance.  Liked the balcony very much.  Would definitely stay here again.
Verda's place is as advertised. Clean and located in a great area. We enjoyed our stay.

Verda's place is great. Super clean well built apartment in a great area. Has everything you need including a complete kitchen. Quiet street and quiet neighbors. All in all a flawless airbnb experience.

A magical place in a magical city, Verda’s place is perfectly located to explore everything Berlin has to offer. The apartment is spotlessly clean, spacious and has everything you would need for a great stay. The drinks on arrival were a welcome start to the weekend. I would highly recommend Verda’s place and Berlin. Danke 🙂

Verda is a really sweet woman, willing to help you with everything! The apartment is really good, spacious, comfortable, with all the things you might need for cooking & coffee. It is very close to the city center ( 20 minutes walking or 5 min with the tram) and all the main stations! Many cafes, restaurants, supermarkets and parks are at the neighborhood! Definitely would recommend!
Verda is a very communicative host. The apartment is beautifully decorated, perfectly located in Berlin, nice restaurants and bars in the neighbourhood, good links to transport.

Verda was a wonderful host!  Her flat is located in the perfect area. We were close to everything we wanted!  It was very clean, spacious & comfortable. Her communication with us was quick & we appreciated the clear directions from the airport.  We loved the neighborhood & all the great tips on places to eat & see provided by her awesome tour binder. We would absolutely stay here again & 100% recommend it if you want a fabulous Berlin experience!

I absolutely loved my stay at this AirBnB. The neighborhood is lovely and very convenient in terms of exploring & enjoying the city. There are wonderful cafe, bar, bakery, grocery store & restaurant options within a few blocks yet the apartment is quite for sleeping. There is also a great bike rental place around the corner. The apartment itself was very clean & charming - kitchen, bed, shower, & washing machine all exceeded expectations. Verda was also fast & helpful with communication. I hope to visit Berlin & stay here again!

Live like a Berliner. Great flat in a great location with good restaurants and shops. Lovely host, good communication and everything we needed.
We’ll be back!

Ideal place to stay in Berlin!
Great location, beautiful space, super comfortable bed and full equiped kitchen)
I could only recommend Verda as a great host!

We had a great stay at Verda’s apartment. Lovely place and in an excellent location. Close to bars, restaurants, spatkauf, Edeka, tram, Pratergarten and short walk to Prenzlauer Berg. We will be back.

Hey Verda, I had a great stay. Just a couple of suggestions… a blanket in the living room would be nice, as it gets a bit cold at times. Also, there was no coffee stocked. This would have been nice. I also think with the holes and stains on the couch, the price for the apartment might be a little high. But overall, I really enjoyed my stay. Thanks :)

Great location! Central and easy for public transport. Friendly and flexible check-in. This is a 4 story walk-up which was not a problem for us, but folks who may have mobility or fitness issues, this could be a problem. Excellent space. Great balcony, multiple living spaces with private bathroom in between. Full kitchen if you like.

Verda's flat is located in a fantastic neighborhood in Berlin. Prenzlauer Berg is vibrant, interesting, and very walkable. The flat was a large one bedroom with a nice balcony for two people to sit outside. verda was responsive, helpful, and willing to accommodate our needs. Highly recommended and if we get back to Berlin we'd definitely return to this flat.

Wonderful, wonderful, wonderful. See here! The rooms are large and beds are very comfortable. The WIFI is great, the city is close, the neighborhood is safe and calm. Great place to bring children, great place to spend with more than one couple. Try the Haus Berlin restaurant, great food!

Welcome was great despite our late check in. we got an "apartment introduction tour" by our host and an orientation to neighborhood - supermarkets, transportation and etc..
Apartment is fully equipped, very convenient and perfectly located.
The apartment was really nice and the neighbourhood was relatively central. Close to Alexanderplatz and Kreuzberg.

This place is within walking distance of several train stations and only 10-15 minutes from Alexanderplatz, so well located. The lady who checked us in didn't speak a lot of English but enough, and she was very welcoming and thorough in making sure we were shown everything.
However, while much of the apartment is nice, some of it is in need of repair - the shower/bath in particular is in urgent need of attention.
We also did not have any sheets on our bed and only one pillow. We found some sheets that sort of fitted in an airing closet and a pillow, but no pillowcase.
But overall we got by okay and it was well located down a quiet suburban street. Hopefully Benjamin will fix some of the issues we encountered soon!

1. Has a great kitchen that I can peepare a meals.
2. 2 big rooms and 1 big living room that great for my friends to have a dinner.
3. Comfort environment surrounding. Just need 10 mins to station.

You cant beat this location, even in a well connected city like Berlin, we barely used the Public commute, instead we just walked everywhere. U bahn and s bahn stations are 3 mins away from the house if needed.  Place was clean and felt cozy. Thanks for hosting us.

We were a group of 5 staying at Benjamin's for Berlin marathon weekend. We had a smooth commute to the start line on race day and, for spectators, the apartment is so close to mile 8 (12km) on the course! S-bahn, U-bahn, and a bus stop are all close to the apartment. We were also able to comfortably walk to further neighborhoods as a means to sight see. Drugstores and grocery stores are also close by. The decor in the apartment is dated, as some have mentioned, but it wasn't an issue for us. Beds were comfortable. The shower might take a little getting used to as there is no curtain or full shower door. Some of my friends had trouble not getting water outside of the tub. I had trouble pulling the plug up to activate the shower head instead of the spout on the first night. Water pressure was good. Lots of shampoo in the cabinets behind the mirrors. Overall, we enjoyed our stay!
Benjamin's place is clean, comfortable, and perfectly situated to enjoy what Berlin has to offer.

The perfect place for a visit to Berlin.  Clean, spacious, and with all of the little comforts you would only hope to have.  7 - 10 minutes walk to public transportation, 250 meters from a supermarket, close to AlexanderPlatz.  What else could you look for ?

A nice flat in a quiet area. Easy to get around using local transport. The flat is super clean and well equipped.
We throughly enjoyed our stay and have no problem recommending it to other travellers.
Such a great host, and their pride in ownership of this space really shows. Thank you for sharing your home with us, we will definitely recommend to others.

Everything was good but internet is not stable enough and slow. The couch is moving while you sit on it and the beds are squeaky. Very close to U-bahn and S-bahn and also close to city centre. Almost every places to visit are 20 to 30 minutes away. Calm and nice park near by the apartment.
Beautiful place with comfy bedrooms, nice bathroom. The place is a bit noisy. The park next to the apartment is very nice. We enjoyed it and more than anything it was clean.

We were 5 friends spending a weekend in Berlin exploring the club scene, and Benjamin’s place was perfect for us. The location is excellent, with spacious rooms and all the comforts you need. There’s a supermarket and a great kebab spot just around the corner. We’ll definitely come back next time!

This was a very good experience. Roy welcomed us upon arrival. The appartement was perfect - almost "over-equipped"! We enjoyed the luxury. The appartement is placed in walking distance from KaDeWe, which is very convenient. Just around the corner is a fantastic bakery - easy to pick up breakfast. We have already recommended this appartement to a couple of friends who got quite interested. Many stars from our site!
It is a great apartment. The traffic is convenient. For summer, the air condition is useful. We will recommend to our friends.

i booked the host for 5 days. the apparment had a high standart and had a beautiful bath and sauna. the position from the host is very central, 5 mins to the kadewe and kurfürstendamm, i will be come back. everything was perfekt, thanks for the Great Time in your host ;)

The apartment and Roi are both amazing. Everything me and my boyfriend needed, was no problem. Coming early, staying late you name it, Roi's got it covered. The apartment itself is incredible, better than the pictures. Perfect location, best shower, comfy bed. 100% staying there again if we come back :)

Roi was a fantastic host - He greeted me very nicely upon arrival and offered to be of help any time I needed anything while I am in Berlin.

The apartment is greatly located - a few minutes away from great shopping & restaurants. Parking is great right in front of the building as well.

I will be back soon!

Our first impression of Roi's place was lovely,
The apartment was immaculate from top to bottom and it had a welcoming touch to it. Overall, it was totally what we had expected. Anything we needed he was on the case and did his best to make our day enjoyable! Thank you Roi!

We did not meet Roi directly, Maayan who we met upon arrival was lovely and incredibly helpful.
Roi however was always easy to access via email, very quick to reply and helpful providing info before our arrival.
The apartment was absolutely beautiful, and very luxurious (the sauna was amazing) photos accurately depict the apartment.
The location is incredible very central with train station very close making exploring Berlin easy, can walk to many places.
A quiet, well equipped and and clean appartement with a special bathroom. Kind introduction from the room maid. We liked it. Everything worked perfectly.

Loved this apartment! Really well decorated with lots of personal touches. We went for New Years and there was even a magnum of champagne waiting for us! Location is also great and Roi answered any questions I had extremely quickly.

Definitely recommend this place.

What a great stay...wonderful neighborhood, close to U bhan, grocery stores and restaurants. Roi was a great host and everything in his studio apartment was incredibly clean and modern - beautiful bathroom! I would definitely stay here again if I get back to Berlin. Definitely stop at the Fritz & Co., the currywurst stand just by the U bahn station!
This was our second stay. Meaning: if you return to a place, it means everything was just perfect. As Baudelaire would say: calm, luxury and pleasure.

We really enjoyed staying at Roi's studio.
It is fully equipped and the details of the entire space make you feel very relaxed and comfortable.
The view on the building garden it is a plus. We enjoyed making breakfast with roses, grass, trees and squirrel view.
Roi was very precise in welcoming us even though we did not have the chance to meet him directly.
We did not spend long time in the neighborhood since we were visiting other parts of the city but the area where the apartment is located is nice, quite and very well connected with subway, trains, bus. It is really behind KaDeWe.
The only "small concern" we had is that the double bed is made by 2 single mattresses and the mattresses are very soft and normally e are used to other type of beds. Nevertheless we had a beautiful experience!

This apartment has s a gem. It’s perfectly located for West Berlin and is very quiet with a nice small balcony looking over the garden. The furnishings are to a high standard and there are many nice thoughtful touches which. Make the stay even more memorable. Roi was extremely helpful and responsive and everything with arriving and departing was smooth and problem free.
I would highly recommend this apartment to anyone wanting a quality stay in the heart of West Berlin. Excellent!

Expect everything!  Fabulous apt. Lots of towels, great hot water and upgraded appliances   Super wifi.  If you are going to Berlin and want a truly local experience with all the comforts of home, stay here.

A great place. Very close to the centre of Berlin and lots of good places to eat near by. The apartment is very stylish and presented to a very high standard. The only small thing was a lack of a good seating space. Great communication as well. We always got a very fast response to any question.

We really enjoyed our stay!! Roi is a great host and was very helpful with information on the area.
The place is amazing and I’ve been recommending it to all my friends and family should they ever go to Berlin in the near future.
The sauna is a lovely touch and everything is fitted to a high standard in the apartment. The location is great and is very handy for the U-Bahn.
The only thing that I think would need improving is some thicker duvets or blankets as it did get a bit chilly in the evening. It did snow while we were there, so it was very cold anyway! Other than that, spot on! ☺️
Thank you for our lovely visit

Roi’s place is perfect for people looking to explore the city and be out and about. The location is good, the beds are comfortable, the sauna is awesome, the space is super clean and stylish, the washing machine worked great, I so appreciated the Nespresso machine, and the hosts were so responsive. It was perfect for our visit. There’s no couch or desk, so it’s not really an apartment you’ll want to spend lots of time lingering in, but given that the Berlin, I imagine that’s not the plan anyway.
Place was beyond perfect! Amazing stay for the price!!! I was so sad to leave! Thanks Roi!

A great place to stay especially for those looking for a cozy, luxurious place to return to after a long day exploring the city. The location is good and the host replied always quickly to my messages.
Roi’s place was very clean and well put together! It is in a safe part of town, we enjoyed staying there very much!
We had an excellent stay at Roi's place! It's ideally located, very clean with a cutting-edge decoration.

We had a great time in Roi‘s cozy and beautiful appartement with the sauna being the best part of it. Roi is a great host who was answering to questions very fast and giving us a great recommendation for dinner: Saigon right around the corner. All in all we would fully recommend Roi and his appartement. Thank you!

Really amazing place to spend the weekend or escape for a staycation. The sauna is such a wonderful addition and amazing amenity. The balcony is also very nice and quite private. Roi's communication and instructions make the whole process seamless :)

its a quiet place at the heart of a residential area. it’s quite far from the touristic area but easy accessible by train, round 32 minutes. its one stop to the berlin zoo and easy access to postdam and berlin central station. its walking distance to the biggest mall Kadewe. The apartment is good for 2 people but not for family. its a well designed apartment with everything you need. the balcony is a bonus.

We enjoyed our stay here! The location is close to a train station and the zoo. It was easy to get to the Brandenburg Gate as well as other major attractions via the U-Bahn. The apartment was very clean and modern and had all the amenities we needed.
Very nice place. Quiet with very comfortable bed. And sauna in the room ads this fine bit especially after a long day. It is also easy to find a parking space in the area
Wonderful apartment. Very clean and has everything that you need. Also great communication with the host.

One of the best places I’ve stayed, while in Berlin. Great price as well.
Steps away from the Ku-damm and u-bahn. Quiet and safe.
Roi's Airbnb is very close to the KaDeWe and other Berlin attractions. Overall, we had a great stay and would recommend this Airbnb; it's ideal to explore Berlin.
The photos don't do this place justice! Roi has thought of everything you could possibly need for a break in Berlin. Roi is a genuinely fantastic host. We would certainly stay again.

Roi's place was great from start to finish. It was easy to find from the instructions, and he was kind enough to let us check in quite early, which was so appreciated, as we had a very early flight. The place is exactly like the photos, and with it being 30° when we were there, the aircon was perfect. From the amazingly comfy bed, refreshing shower and awesome bathroom and Netflix shows in the evening, to the Nespresso in the morning, it was such a treat. We didn't use the sauna, purely because we didn't have time, but was a lovely addition. The little terrace was great, we sat out in the mornings with our coffees, and the church bells were so lovely. I'd highly recommend this place and would definitely stay again when back in Berlin. And, Fatoush restaurant round the corner, wow, it's amazing!!!

We had a fantastic 4 night stay at Roi’s property. He was very responsive and we were able to store our luggage before checking in. We did not have any issues during our stay and the location was very good. We would love to stay again

Very Quick response from the host, Great location near kastaniealle, shops, bars, restaurants and the s and u-bahn. There is a great organic supermarked just around the corner! And the kitchen is nice for cooking. Very nice apartment in a quiet backyard. Easy check in and check out with katja, Gabriel and julias friend. A little Early checkout, but I'm guessing that if the apartment wasn't rentet out just afterwards it could have been flexibel. Katja was very nice and helpful. Because of the translation on the airbnb website we had a little misunderstanding. It says '4 beds' whitch in danish would mean that it are in fact 4 whole beds not 2 beds with room for 4. Whitch is importent when your a traveling with colleaques:-) Katja help out with additional covers and our stay was perfect!

This is a place to be recommended! The loft is a large open living space, very quiet away from the streets of trendy Prenzlauerberg. It contains all things one expects, and more, like a welcoming bottle of wine. Special requests were granted with a smile.
The area is full of good and cheap restaurants (try Wuu and Leibhaftig), supermarkets, bike rental (10 euro or less) and ice cream parlours where people line up on sunny days.
Gabriels artist loft was silent and we slept well in good beds. The flat has modern furnitures, was well cleaned. A good place to stay.
Terrific place!! Very welcoming and would love to return! Gabriel even had a bottle of wine waiting for us. We really felt at home in Berlin, and our stay there is what made it.
The loft was fantastic! We had a great time in Berlin, the loft was situated in a very lovely neighborhood. Everything was well taken care of by Gabriel and Katja. We'll be back next time!

Gabriel's flat was the perfect place for us to stay at. It's very central but also in an area with more locals which is a great way to experience Berlin. The flat is really spacious and comfortable. Couldn't have wished for a better place!

Great place to stay!

Restaurants, shops, bars and public transportation all just a stones throw away.
This a fantastic place to land while visiting Berlin! We felt like we were the luckiest tourists in town! Highly recommend this lovely flat.
ps~leave your mark on one of the dining chairs, I did...may love surround you always.
Cheers!

The place is a gem. The neighborhood is absolutely stunning but the apartment itself is hidden from the vivid bars and you are awaken by singing birds in the morning. The flat is spatial and clean. High ceilings are great. Gabriel provided us baby chair which was very handy. Loved the place.

Wonderful stay in this gorgeous property. It had everything we needed and is in a fantastic area. Gabriel was a great host; arranged for us to get the keys even though we arrived early. Thoroughly recommend this property.

The apartment is very stylish and in a nice neighborhood with plenty of cafes and restaurants around. You’ll see a lot of young school children riding their bikes and young families live around this area. We felt safe and our host even assisted us resolving my parking ticket and also invited me for a cup of coffee and croissants! Gabriel is an excellent host and very accommodating. I highly recommend his place!

Great place in a great location! A lot of different cafes, shops nearby but very quiet and cozy. Very iteresting design, fresh flowers, everything was clean and in a good condition. Gabriel is very nice person. We were late because of flight delay and he was waiting for us till midnight. Despite that he was very nice and helpful. Definitely would return back here to spend the weekends!

This space is one of a kind! Open, clean and bright, this loft is tucked backed from the street but just steps away Berlin is at your finger tips. The subway, tram and bus stop a couple blocks away but there are shops, restaurants and grocery stores within easy walking distance- we loved it
And Gabriel was quick to answer questions and made sure we had all we needed
Great location for public transportation, shopping for food etc. and restaurants. We had a great time. The apartment is nicely decorated and comfortable. We had everything we need for our family.

We spent Christmas at Gabriels apartment and thoroughly enjoyed our stay. The apartment is very stylish in a great location, very quiet and comfortable.
Gabriel was a perfect host he helped us with restaurant reservations and we had a very warm welcome.
Communication was very good we really recommend this apartment to anyone looking to explore Berlin.

The place is a treasure hidden among Berlin streets. Spacious, stylish, fully-equipped, with a wonderful artistic atmosphere. This place contributed so much into our short but rich Berlin experience. Gabriel was prompt in our communication and perfectly flexible with check-in and check-out time. Thanks for such a lovely place to stay and feel the city vibe.
Incredible space. Easy communication and has all the amenities you need in one of the best neighbourhoods in Berlin. Would definitely stay here again. Thank you!

Gabriel was so hospitable!! It was the perfect stay - such a good location, so clean and new, and well equipped. We would definitely stay there again and recommend to anyone. Communication was also great even when we were slightly delayed. Thanks a lot!

This is a great place , in a wonderful location. Lots to do in the area and easy access to the rest of Berlin by public transport. Hosts were very responsive and flexible. We had an extended stay and the place was perfect. Would definitely recommend to anyone , and particularly someone doing ‘slow’ travel.
It is a beautiful, quiet apartment in a perfect location. I would definitely stay here again on another visit to Berlin!
i had a wonderful stay at this apartment. gabriel was always responsible and flexible. the location is the best. would loce to come back here!
Felt like home. Perfectly equipped, clean, cozy. Gabriel was very friendly and understanding. Best stay in Germany!

This is the area to be- walkable, local, lots of restos and shops, great crowd. The loft located in a secluded area and feels very private in such a great part of Berlin. Host was flexible with check in and check out - much appreciated.

Expensive for what it was
Bedding minimal especially the sofa bed
No extra pillows
Towels need replacing or extra provided
Toilet flush broken

This appartment is perfect and is extremely well situated with everything from metro station, restaurants and grocery stores right next door.
The flat is very clean and cosy. The transaction went smoothly and communication with Matthias was very easy and he made sure to follow up with us to make sure everything was fine when we got there. We were greated by Matthias' daughter, Constanze, and she was very friendly.
I would highly recommend this appartment to anyone considering it.

The apartment was even better than it appeared in the photos. It was warm, spacious, comfortable, secure and new, and having a washing machine was a bonus. The balcony was lovely, with a very peaceful outlook over the garden. The apartment accommodates two couples easily, although the sofa bed in the lounge room is quite firm, which will suit some people. The hosts very thoughtfully left supplies available for us to use. The location was great and very quiet. We would definitely recommend this apartment to any visitor to this lovely city.

This sweet house is located in the center of city, Mitte, where you are very near to subway station. So location was perfect. The house was so clean, tidy and sweet that you can even pass the rest of the day in it. Being just near to local market was also a big plus for us. You won't miss your home's comfort in this house. Thanks for everything.

Matthias and Fritz were very helpful and provided lots of information regarding the apartment and what we could do in Berlin. The apartment had everything we needed and more and was very well located. The interior is calm and restful and there is a spacious balcony. Just what you need after a tiring day! I would definitely recommend to others.
We had a great stay at Matthias' place. The apartment is spacious, clean, and very beautiful, just like the pictures, and very conveniently located.

Matthias and his daughter Constanze are the greatest hosts expected ! Welcoming and very available at any time. The apartment was amazing. Spacious for a couple, bright, clean, with a big shower, and well located in city center.
Discover Berlin has been very lovely and pleasant !

Matthias was very welcoming, his sister met us at the door and showed us around. She was very nice to us and was able to communicate perfectly. They both answered our questions right away and were easy to talk to. The flat is beautiful, and looks exactly how it does in the photos. The beds are very comfortable, and the kitchen is well-equipped. It would have been nice to have a microwave, but the oven works well. The neighborhood is nice, the flat is near a lot of good restaurants (and next door to a supermarket) and is a short drive away from many historical sites. Great to come back to after a long day sightseeing. Overall, it was a wonderful stay and I would definitely like to stay in Matthias' house again when I come back to Berlin.
We recommend this spacious, tasteful, comfortable flat. The hosts were very friendly and thoughtful. Would love to live there next time we are in Berlin:)

This place is excellent: well located, comfortable, clean, very spacious for two and probably just as good for three or four guests. As seen in the pictures provided here, the place is tastefully arranged, with very comfortable bed and bathroom. The location proved to be truly amazing, with public transport and one of the best museums in walking distance.
Matthias was very communicative and provided us with all the info we needed.
We would definitely recommend this place.

The apartment was large, modern, and spacious. Location is great, right near the Naturkundemuseum and station, where a number of major transport lines intersect. The host, Matthias, was super friendly with prompt communication. Check in was very easy and welcoming. Thanks for inviting us to stay Matthias we had a great time in Berlin.

This apartment is in a fantastic location, close to all forms of public transportation and some of the best restaurants in Mitte. The apartment itself was clean and well equipped. You will not disappointed!
Fantastic, central location. Perfectly appointed apartment with many thoughtful touches and welcoming hosts that will make you feel at home. Would highly recommend.

Nice hosts, comfortable apartment, great location!!!))) We had really wonderful time at Mattheus apartment in Berlin )))
We hope that we will able to come back.
Thanks a lot!

This is a tremendous apartment.  All amenities taken care of,  very clean and comfortable and an  excellent location.  The host was always quick to communicate and provided detailed instructions.   The apartment felt like home right away.  The space is generous and all amenities are thought of.  Our 11 year old daughter enjoyed spending time on the balcony.  It's location allowed us to walk everywhere we wanted to go.  There is a very good and reasonably priced Italian restaurant just down the street.    This proved to be a tremendous apartment for our stay.  We cannot recommend this apartment enough.
Amazing apartment! very stylish and cosy , location is great, lot of good restaurants just few steps from apartment . It was pleasure for me to stay  at Matthew place . Fully recommended

This apartment is as beautiful as on photos and was most important in a great location with really good restaurants and bars.
