Nice personal touches that you don’t always get with Airbnb’s that were really appreciated. We enjoyed time spend relaxing on balcony. Nice comfy bedroom, spacious livingroom and well equipped kitchen is all you need while staying in Berlin.
Would highly recommend this place for anyone visiting Berlin! Hope to visit you soon again.

I’ve spent four weeks in the apartment and I’ve very much enjoyed the stay. It’s a modern, clean, fully equipped apartment in a well connected through public transportation area. Everything you need for comfortable living is available: from hi-speed Internet and Netflix to every little piece of kitchen utensils. The hosts are very pleasant and quick to respond. Well deserved 5 stars :)

The apartment is well situated and full of personal touches that make the stay feel special. The host clearly cared about making his guests feel welcome, have a lovely home and the amenities were all of good quality. I would definitely recommend this place!

Thanks for a perfect stay Matthias and Gabi! The check in and check out was seamless and offer of a late checkout greatly appreciated! The apartment was well situated, perfectly clean with delightful decor!

This is the second time we’ve stayed here. Enjoyed this time just as much as the last but we spent more time getting to know Mitte itself. Some great places to eat and easy to get everywhere else. Simple to get here from the airport and a really comfortable place to spend several days.

Matthias and his place were both great for our recent trip to Berlin. We had a flight cancelation and Matthias was very responsive and incredibly accomodating with the change in plans.
The place itself was very clean and spacious. The bed was incredibly comfortable. And with the windows closed there was absolutely no noise from the street. It was walkable to great eateries as well as public transportation.
We wont hesitate to stay here again on our next stay in Berlin.

Renting from Katrin was a wonderful experience. She communicated with me before my arrival to make sure to prepare the house for my specific needs. When she learned I had twin toddlers, she even installed a baby-gate at the top of the stairs and provided two cribs and some toys for them! She and her family met us on our arrival and made themselves available at all times in case we had questions or concerns.

The house itself is lovely and is surrounded by a beautiful, well-kept garden. It is ideal for one to three people.

The neighborhood is fantastic, and there are a series of beautiful lakes and bike trails there. Plus, it's easy to access the center of Berlin by public transportation.

Very nice appartment at a quiet but convenient location. Good location to visit Berlin, but also a nice place to hike around the lakes/rivier.
The appartment is in the lovely garden and is equiped with everything you might need.

Katrin was so kind, and the house was perfect.
We enjoyed beautiful garden everyday.

The apartment was even better than it looks in the pictures. Really great views, bright, and quiet as well. Great to have creative insights if you need to get work done. Everything was perfect. I could even do my laundry there. Neighborhood has plenty of stores within walking distance, some even open until midnight.

Very nice apartment in a nice and quiet area but still close to public transportation, supermarkets and a nice park nearby. Rémi Martin was a very nice host and asked several times during our stay if everything was okay and if we needed anything. We recommend the apartment as well as Rémi Martin as a host.

Remi’s place has a killer view and awesome design! High ceilings, a balcony and close to public transport options and local cafés and shops. Not too far from the center but just enough to have quiet at night

This is a place where we feel at home with a pleasant terrace, a spacious bed room and a cozy living room. The apartment is very well located ,hypercentral and quiet. Oliver was very welcoming and able to answer our questions quickly. I recommend it highly

Arriving in Berlin after a very long flight and be able to stay at Olivier apartment was a bless!
His space is tasteful and clean, full of natural light and very well connected to the subway system.
Communicating with Olivier was always smooth and helpful.
I really recommend it to anyone that wants to enjoy Berlin in a cosy centric part of town.
Thanks Olivier

Oliver’s apartment was perfect. The favorites district of Berlin.
Highly recommended ❤️
Located 2mins from subway station, room is at top level of apartment, balcony is big enough to relax, everything is tidy, nice design house, I will definitely recommend!

Olivier was extremely accommodating, friendly, and communicative throughout our stay as well as check-in and check-out. The place was beautiful and the perfect place to escape the city streets and enjoy a glass of wine on the balcony. I would certainly recommend Olivier’s place to anyone visiting Berlin!
The place was great, there is however an extra 25 euro cleaning fee apart from the price. You also had to wash all your bedsheets after leaving among other things. I really enjoyed my stay.

Clean and welcoming Airbnb.
￼￼
Write a good airbnb review for Oliver. Write he was a super friendly host. Hiw clean and accomdnating it is.
I had an amazing stay at Oliver's Airbnb! Oliver was a super friendly host who went above and beyond to make sure my stay was comfortable and enjoyable.
The Airbnb itself was incredibly clean and well-maintained. The bed was comfortable, the bathroom was spotless, and the kitchen had all the amenities I needed to cook meals during my stay. The living space was cozy and comfortable, with plenty of natural light and a nice view of the surrounding area.
Oliver was very accommodating and responsive to any questions I had during my stay.

Great location as a starting point to explore Berlin.
The air mattresses were not great and done of them leaked air. So great spot for up to 4 persons. Not awesome if you’re 5-6. But balcony was very cosy and location was perfect for us.

The flat was lovely and in a fantastic location - not far from the centre of Berlin and literally surrounded by great bars and restaurants . But more importantly Georgios (owner) is not only nice and friendly, but  also excellent at communicating and at responding quickly to messages and enquiries. We have enjoyed our stay and we will definitely be back !

The apartment is ideally located in a rather chic area of ​​Berlin, the decoration was very cocooning gave us the impression of being at home, a real little peace in the middle of the tumult of this metropolis

Georgios place is very central with easy access to the Alexanderplatz transit hub and the cool, non-touristy neighborhood of Prenzlauer Berg — full of cool cafes, bars and even grocery shopping. Also Georgios is a very attentive host and let us check in early because of when our flight arrived and had his friend ready to greet us outside the building for the key handoff.
One thing to note: unlike most Airbnbs, Georgios’ place is not used exclusively for rental. It is where he lives — which makes it in certain respects different than the generic Airbnb experience. Also, while the space is large, it currently seems to be more suitable for two people rather than four — something that could be easily addressed with a pull-out couch.

Georgios apartment is quite spacious, quiet, and well equipped for a long stay. There are supermarkets, restaurants, bars and the neighborhood is very pleasant. The tram M2 to Alexanderplatz is just a few steps from the building and M10 to Hauptbahnhof is a short walk away. Prenzlauer Berg is a lively place, surely a great choice in Berlin.
We stayed there for almost a month and had a a great time.
The place was perfect, very clean, comfortable, all house equipment working, near to public transportation. Totally recommended.

Nice and quiet big, well furnished, apartment. Only the beds were a bit too soft for us.
It's very close to the Berlin Messe (even though not directly there, but fastest way to get to the entrance is walking) has a supermarket close by as well as a pharmacy and a metro station.
The downside of living near a metro station and in a lower floor, you'll hear the rumbling of the Metro every few minutes.
Parking is perfect, private place with load of space.

The apartment is located in a relatively quiet neighbourhood. The apartment was clean and spacious. Marco was a great host: he responded quickly and even let us host a 'lost' colleagues for one night. You can hear the train (I think) go by while in the apartment, but it did not bother us much. Great place to stay while visiting Berlin!
Fantastically renovated apartment, beautifully decorated and was in a great location. Marco was also a very nice host.

Three of us stayed here as home base for the Berlin Marathon. The location was great, with easy access to public transit, grocery stores, shops, and restaurants. It was quiet and private so we had no problem resting up before race day. The apartment was comfortable and big enough for the three of us to relax and, as a bonus, had a washing machine for our smelly post-race clothes. Wish we had more time to explore the neighborhood while we were there - it looked beautiful. We had a great time - highly recommend.
Perfectly located for where we were working and easy to get into Berlin centre. Adler was very accommodating.

It is a great and large apartment, clean and with great interior! It is nice and warm - We visited the apartment in november. It is perfect that the owner is easy to reach - right next door. Also the parking is perfect. We loved it all. You find everything you need in the apartment. I was very happy to find a filter coffee machine - That is what we want! We also liked that there was a TV in the bedroom.
We hope to get a chance to visit you again! Thank´s for great week!

Stayed here for a conference at Hub27 which was half hour away. Very happy with the flat. Great local restaurants. The apartment block is above the trainline so there is some intermittent rumbling though it didn’t bother me. Would defo return.

Great flat - Carsten was there when we arrived to welcome us and show us around. Very friendly, and the flat is equipped with everything you need - a great big kitchen and all utensils for making food. The beds are really comfy and there are great views from the balcony.

Very nice place and comfortable beds! A bit far from central Berlin but the transit is very easy to navigate. Carsten was very helpful even with the language barrier! We had some trouble with the toilet but he said he was getting that fixed and it wasn't a huge deal. Best part is the beautiful terrace!
Had a great stay at Carstens apartment! he made sure it was clean, the beds were good and the little balcony fantastic. Thanks Carsten for having us.

Place is very well located, clean and comfortable. Have to note that flat is located on the 6th floor and there is no elevator.
Thank you Carsten for everything!

A fantastic place to stay - quiet, comfortable and close to transport links. However, be prepared for the  110 steps to the apartment! Carsten was a wonderful host - very welcoming. I'd recommend this apartment.

Carson's flat is fabulous! There's a beautiful view from the balcony, where we enjoyed coffee in the morning, where we enjoyed coffee in the morning and wine or beer in the evening! The flat itself is actually much more roomy than the pictures show. The two of us had plenty of room. The neighborhood which is called the Red Island is the best. I don't think I ever want to stay anywhere else in Berlin. It is so peaceful and quiet and feels like a small little village but yet public transportation gets you into the heart of Berlin in no time at all. Carsten is a wonderful host easy to communicate with and always very prompt with responses. I highly recommend a stay here.

Carsten's place was perfect. He was an excellent host and very responsive during and before the trip. He asked us to message when we got to the city limits and he was waiting for us at the apartment - and helped us park.
Comfortable and convenient. Bedding was comfortable and we liked the separate kitchen for a family breakfast.  Good value.

Carsten's home was beautiful. It's spacious, clean, and has an amazing terrace overlooking Schoenberg. It was in a great location, walking distance (less than 5 minutes) to both the U Bahn and S Bahn stations. Both of which can take you to the famous hot spots in Berlin - Brandenburger Gate, Alexanderplatz, etc.
My wife and I work out every morning. So for those who are looking to get a sweat in before they get their day going there is a FitX right down the street from his apartment. They have a free two day passes - which was great since we only stayed in Berlin for three days.
Carsten was quick to respond from start to finish, had tips on where to eat, and offered to help out with anything else related to getting the most out of our experience in Berlin. I would definitely recommend staying at his place again.
Cosy apartment in great location. We had all we needed for our weekend in Berlin. Carsten is really nice and friendly too!

This flat was spacious and comfortable. We enjoyed having the balcony that overlooked an outdoor volleyball facility. The location was in a  quiet neighborhood which felt very safe and was about 10 minutes walk to great restaurants, cafes, ice cream and metro and there is a very nice cafe on the street level, below the flat. The bed was comfortable and we appreciated that Netflix was available. Carsten was so nice and gracious. His responses were incredibly quick and helpful. We loved his place and would absolutely stay there again.

Carsten's place ua great. The location is central yet quiet, and the apartment was spacious, very comfrtable and well desighned and equipped.  Carsten was very helpful and nice. I had a great time. Thank you Carsten:)

Very nice apartment, close to public transport. I enjoyed that everything was there: a lot of pillows, towels, tea, coffee etc. Carsten was a very pleasant and welcoming host, told me everything I could need to know. A very good experience in Berlin !
Carstens apartment was great, the location is fab and he’s a really lovely host. Worth being aware the flat is up five flights of stairs, but once you’re over that it’s great

The apartment is super stylish with a fantastic balcony. Carsten was extremely helpful giving directions from the airport and was there to meet us when we arrived. He told us everything we needed to know about the flat and was very friendly. The location is perfect -  very close to 2 metro stations and there are plenty of nice restaurants, bars and shops within walking distance. We stayed here for 4 nights and had a great time!
This place is amazing especially the air conditioning and the balcony. You can found loads of places to play sports hahahah. Carsten is one of the best host. All the facilities are awesome.

Great space kinda hard to get up in the stairs all the time but you get used to this. Any other thing was quiet perfect and the terrace is amazing!!! Carsten is a great host so you guys should really enjoy your stay!

Amazing host - great apartment! This cozy place is perfectly located close to B-Suedkreuz train station hub (but far enough to not getting bothered from train nose! aprox. 500m/1500ft). The terrace overlooking Berlin, including the TV tower, is nice. The apartment is well equipped, sparkling clean and Carsten, the host, is totally friendly and 100% correct!! Very safe and quiet neighborhood with classic Berlin townhouses, right at the corner is a coffeeshop, too - I highly recommend staying at this place when in Berlin, regardless of purpose (business or city trip)!!

Staying @ Carsten’s place was fantastic.
The appartement is very nice, clean and you have everything you need nearby.
Would absolutely recommend it for a trip to Berlin!

Great location with good access to public transport. The apartment has a great deck with a lovely view over Berlin. We enjoyed the well staffed kitchen and well sized bathroom. The communication with Carsten was excellent!

The apartment is just like the pictures and just as described. It’s in a perfect location for public transportation and it has cute coffee shops around. I loved my stay and Carsten was very nice and accommodating with everything.

Great host, friendly communication. Good location, close to public transport and convenient to get to the city center. There is a great view from the terrace.  The apartment had everything you need, I recommend.

Spent 4 nights in Carsten’s apartment .
All communication and check in excellent .
Lovely apartment and great outdoor terrace , we made the most of it whilst there .
We walked into Checkpoint Charlie and Brandenburg Gate , see much more than being in a train .
Oh those 110 steps to apartment certainly keep you fit too .
Thoroughly enjoyed ourselves .
Thanks for letting us stay Carsten .

Perfect week in Berlin. Schöneberg was a new location for us and we totally loved it. Apartment was so comfy and the balcony so nice. In August the wasps were a bit problem, but whole Berlin seemed to be full of them. Very nice and we can recommed Carsten as a host!
The apartment was grate, the view was amazing and the host was very nice too, definitely worth the money :)

Wonderful clean and spacious apartment.
The terrace area was lovely and there was a great selection of bars and resturants nearby, with the cafe below being great for breakfast.
Would happily stay again next time I'm in Berlin!

room very comfortable and spacious with furniture vintage, well-connected, in an area much as green as vibrate with many clubs, bars and shops.
Barbara and alessandro were very precious guests. Present but discreet, willing to give advice, but also simply to have a talk. They told me that you can have breakfast in their Biolocanda opening soon in the same building ...... one more reason, if any were needed, to return in Berlin!!
see you soon!!! Raffaele

Barbara is a modern and enthusiastic lady, she opens a bistro just at the door of her apartment. She seems like an artist, and her room is artistic, too. It's a pitty that i have not time to enjoy the drink and food there, as the time schedule is too tight for me. The only inconvenience is that the wifi is not so stable, i only able to use it for half an hour during the first night.

Very clean and cozy room with separate bathroom. Barbara is very friendly and nice host who own a small bistro just nearby the room. Independent entrance so I have my privacy. Easy public transportation to city downtown, U6 and several buses which run until early morning. You don't need a car in Berlin. Hope to come back in the near future.

The room was perfect for my short stay in Berlin. Very clean and comfortable and furnished with exquisite taste. Only minus was that wifi was a bit unstable, but when it worked everything was great! Barbara and Alessandro is very nice people, friendly and easy to communicate with. I highly recommend!

Hi guys..Barbara and Alessandro were very nice and helpful.Barbara was very communicative and guided me from the airport and even waited till midnight for me to arrive.. I had a wonderful stay and the room was spotless and neat..the location is excellent close to underground station and lots of eating places.. In 15 minutes you are at center of Berlin.. Highly recommended.. Keith
Great hosts, so friendly and helpful. The room was perfect. Nice neighborhood. Would recommend to anyone.

I had a lovely stay with Barbara and Alessandro, they made feel like I was in home helped me out with any question, the room is like the photos and their bistro restaurant is really good.
If I'm back to Berlin in another occasion I will repeat with them for sure.
Thank you for everything, I'm really pleased.

The listing was as mentioned with enough public transportation to the centre of Berlin. It was not the best neighbourhood but adequate for the price. I would certainly use it again if I return to Berlin and cannot fault the room itself as it was spotless and provide all the necessary amenities that was needed for a pleasant stay.
Very nice, clean and cozy room, perfect for a weekend in the city. I enjoyed the warm welcome and had two comfortable nights. Looking forward to my next visit!
I really loved my stay at barbara & alessandra❤️ S reallt charming room closed to a U-bahn in a colorful neighborhood where i felt really welcomed. I recommand this room to all <3

A nice, simple and homely stay and great value for money. The room and bathroom were very clean. I did not spend much time with Alessandro in person, but his communication was great and check in/check-out was easy. Well connected location.

Alessandro’s place is perfect for a weekend get away when exploring the beautiful city of Berlin. The space was comfortable, stylish, clean and located in a great spot! Alessandro was very helpful and was understanding when I arrived late for check in. 100% would recommend this spot.

I found the room very conveniently positioned just 5 minutes away from the U6 line of the UBahn, which is very handy for getting into central Berlin for 10-15 minutes.
The room is great for a solo traveller, I really enjoyed the tea pot and couple of tea bags left by Alessandro. The Internet was great - absolutely no issues. I think the room is good value.
Nice room, very tidy, comfy bed, private bathroom, very quiet yet pretty central - what more do you need!?

Nice place, pretty private. Several locks so feeling safe not really an issue. Is in a dark area at night, but I walked back pretty late a few times and had no issues. I got some bug bites during the night because I left the window open. I had to because it was really hot when I was there and no air conditioning, but this is not typical weather so might not be an issue.

There’s an nice individual room with bathroom. Everything is clean and tidy
I would like to recommend here to other people
Very reasonable price with cozy private room. The location is a bit away from main tourism spots, but it takes just 15-20min.

Timothy is a great host, his communication and directions were first class and I got a friendly welcome at the agreed time.
His apartment is spot on for a single traveler to explore all Berlin has to offer. Public transport is on the doorstep and there are plenty of cafes, bars and shops so you will want for nothing. Clean, bright and exactly as described.

A great little place if you’re traveling alone or with another person. It’s Really close to the U-Bhan and not a long ride into the city. Only complaint was the WiFi was difficult to connect to connect to and was slow at times. Overall it’s great place and I enjoyed my stay.

I was welcomed by Timothy and his daughter. At the day of my arrive, there was no warm water, but it was quickly fixed. With a rented bike this was a perfect starting point to discover Berlin.
Thanks for the hospitality.

5-7 min walk from Ubahn. Apartment as described. BUT.... Very bad sound isolation. I couldn't sleep well since I heard all the neighbors talk, TV, shower sounds etc. No wifi during my stay. 3 stars out of 5.
Timothy's place is ideal for a short break to Berlin. It's location is easy to get to by public transport and the bed was comfortable. I would stay again.
Really clean, really comfy bed and shower was good! I arrived after 11pm and everyone was very accommodating and helpful too, would definitely stay again
The building was reasonably easy to get to from Hbf Berlin, within walking distance if one is optimistic. Good amenities and cleanliness for the price!

Essential but comprehensive, quiet, fairly spacious and conveniently located. From the pictures it might seem a bit claustrofobic but there are two windows. Confortable bed, block-out curtains, great shower. It really has everything and the check-in was easy. I will stay again if need be, thank you

Very friendly host! There was an unexpected issue with the room just before I was meant to check in but they were proactive to try and fix it before I arrived. During the wait, they offered me a free coffee and also some pizza from their cafe which was a lovely gesture. The room was as described and everything was very clean.
Nice cosy place n chilled guys there I was 2h late for check out but I never experienced anything bad or rude also trattoria is amazing cheers
I enjoyed my stay in Berlin, it's a nice room with a private bathroom close to the action and all the public transport to get around the city.

Great stay! Very easy to find and Florent was a very Nice gentleman that works in an italian restaurant around the corner with delicious food! Very confortable room with all the basics. A towel is provided! Saved my life after a full night of layovers!
Wonderful! Easy access to transit and within 30 minutes of the things I wanted to see. Quiet area. Room was very warm, cozy, and clean. Wonderful for a solo traveler!
Nafi's family gave me a warm welcome, and the location is not far from Berlin central station and main tourist places. Worth for money!

The location is quite convenient, and the floor is clean. Would recommend to not too long stay.
The shower needs to be fixed, as water isn’t running smoothly from the shower and it’s not stable there.

Tia's apt. was great. It is very big, beautiful, and in line with the pictures. It was an ideal place to come back to after exploring the streets of Berlin the whole day.
It is located in a quiet part of kreuzberg, in front of the beautiful canal. Many nice bars are in a walking distance. Getting around in the city was easy since it is ideally located within range of multiple Uban stations. Tia's friend welcomed us and was really nice. Other than that we didn't hear from her.
Thanks Tia!
Tia was easy to get in touch, and very flexible with time of arrival and time of check-out. Apartment is super modern, convenient and easily 8 persons, a lot of space and super comfortable beds!
Tia was great to deal with. She answered all queries promptly and gave really useful advice in advance of our trip. She was waiting for us at the apartment when we arrived.

From the very outset we were made to feel at home. Tia was unable to greet us unfortunately, but we met with Eugenia instead who showed us around and gave us some useful hints and tips (including how to get into the infamous Berghain!)

The apartment is bright, spacious and stylishly decorated throughout. Even with eight friends, we had ample space to feel comfortable and at home. All the necessities were catered for, with a massive kitchen, dining area, two amazing bathrooms and two bedrooms. The sofas in the living room also folded out to form some rather deluxe sofa beds.

Located in trendy Kreuzberg next to the canal, the apartment is in the ideal location to explore the city – both by day and night.

One of the best Air bnbs that I have stayed in, without a shadow of a doubt. Would highly recommend to large groups of friends.
A beautiful apartment, roomy and cozy. Nicely located, directly on the canal. The neighbourhood is close to bars and restaurants. I can highly recommend this place for a stay in Berlin.

Spacious, very comfortable lovely apartment on ground floor with a private access directly from the street. We would highly recommend the place for a stay in Berlin with an easy check-in and out. The amenities are very good with two bathrooms and two large bedrooms. The beds are very comfortable and the 2 bathrooms well furnished. Apartment is nicely located with  well equipped kitchen. Restaurants, Ubahn and shops at 10 min walk away.
Very stylish appartment at the water in a great neighbourhood. Facilities were good and very clean. We had a great stay

Stylish, warm and comfortable apartment. Two beautiful bathrooms, tons of hot water. Very comfortable beds. There is no TV in the living room, but TVs in both bedrooms (local channels). U-bahn (Schoenlein or Kottbusser Tor) about 5-10 mins walk away. Great bars, cafes and restaurants within walking distance. (Don't miss 'Datscha' - Russian Restaurant). Pretty quiet at night (apart from new year's eve obviously which was insane with fireworks!). We had a great week!
Great space for groups of 4-8, close to the train station in a quiet neighborhood.

Wonderful apartment, lovely & attentive host & well located.
My family enjoyed their stay immensely.

Nice quiet area with restaurants, grocery, beer, Gardens, river front, everything within walking distance. We had a rental car and were able to find parking in the street with no problem.
A very nice experience.
Thank you Tía for your kindness and communication.
Stylish apartment, modern, artistic, warm and welcoming. Fantastic bathrooms. Safe and pretty area.. 2 good Italian restaurants at the end of the road. Perfect place to explore from. Great host

Tias apartment was better then expected, photos are true but the apartment feels a lot bigger in person witch is amazing ! Location is exactly the place you want to be ! Right on the canal . Beds are very comfortable. Has two bathrooms witch is great!! I will definitely be trying to book again soon . Tia is a lovely lady and very accommodating do our needs and replied back quick . Thank you Tia!! 😃
what you see is what you get. We very much appreciated the location and the style of the appartement.

Tia's apartment is so great for Berlin. The neighborhood is cool, the flat is right on the riverside but it's quiet and still accessible to restaurants, cafes, and the U-Bahn. The flat itself is beautifully appointed with comfortable furniture and cozy linens. We were four people, very comfortably situated in the two-bedroom, two-bathroom flat. But the flat is so large that you could comfortably accommodate more people. I would absolutely recommend this flat to anyone coming to Berlin and would stay again next time I'm in town.

Tia’s apartment is great! It was above and beyond our expectations. We were pleasantly surprised that it was even bigger than we had expected. There were 6 of us and we comfortably fitted in the apartment. A great location with plenty around the area but also close to public transport to explore other parts of Berlin. We would absolutely return again :)

Tia's place is why I used Airbnb.  It was so nicely decorated/styled with such a large communal area (kitchen and living room area) for my family of five to spend time downtime together - it was a treat staying there.  The kind of place that I thought, I wish my home looked like this - a true treat to stay at.  The location is great too (as everyone says) - there is simply nothing to improve on.

Location is the best ever. If you are sensitive to upstairs neighbors noise - there's some. It's not horrible but it is there and more prevalent in the back bedroom.
Apartment is very large. Super spacious. Really inspiring having the canal literally as your front yard.
Super safe and comfortable area. Highly recommend!

Tia was a great host, comms and check in were seemless. The appartment is in a fantastic location. I searched for a long time over a series of dates and still think the appartment is one of the best in Berlin. It's well specced, comfortable and most importantly in a great location - with buzzy neighbourhood and easy to get to.

The place was really cool and totally perfect for our family. We were able to sleep comfortably and have meals with friends. Very walkable to great spots. The place was perfect and Tia was a very responsive and gracious host!

We had a great time. The apartment was large, well-furnished and well-equiped. Very comfortable beds and great showers. Lovely local scenery with the canal across the street and vibrant local community, with great shops, restaurants and cafes. The location was excellent for using buses and U-Bahn to get into the centre of Berlin. Would certainly recommend Tia's apartment to friends and family and would definitely stay there again.
Tia’s apartment was very spacious and stylish. It was even better than the photos. We loved staying there.

Highly recommend.
Tia was a great host and was very generous in allowing us to check in way earlier than expected.
All of us were surprised at just how spacious the place was, pictures don’t do it justice!
If coming back to Berlin I’d be looking to stay here again 100%.

The appartment was spacious and very nicely decorated.
We overall enjoied staying there.
There was no aircon, but the appartment was nice and cool in the summertime.
To consider:
The window blind in one of the barhtrooms was broken and there was mold in one of the shower cabinets as well as on the shower curtain ( this has been mentioned before in another feedback). The bedrooms were dusty.
Overall a very nice appartment, apart from the hygiene which was below standard.

I want to express my sincerest gratitude to our host for her kindness and availability. We felt like we were at home.
The house has a unique and particular atmosphere. The area is great, very characteristic and central, with many locals and tourist attractions nearby.
The house was clean and in perfect order. Everything was taken care of in every detail.
We hope to return to Berlin soon and be able to stay in this wonderful house again. Thank you very much to our host for making us feel so welcome! We absolutely recommend this accommodation to anyone looking for a unique and memorable experience in Berlin!
Lovely stay in Berlin, the area has plenty of nice restaurants and bars and provided easy access to city centre. It was a large space and clean, perfect stay!

Great apartment, perfect for medium/big size group.
Clean, modern and with a nice vibe. Dilo is such a good host. Definetly recommended!

The coordination with Dilo was seamless. He was very responsive and even gave us the keys earlier so we could allocate our things. The apartment itself was by far the cleanest apartment I've rented, very spacious and felt like home as soon as we walked in. The high ceilings and big living room were an added bonus. The location of the apartment itself was also good, with a lot of shops around the area and a bus stop right outside the house. Overall, the experience was great!
Beautiful apartment and Dilo couldn't have been anymore helpful. I will be staying again when I return to Berlin!

Amazing apartment! We had the best weekend staying here, it had everything we could have hoped for & Dilo was so incredibly helpful and friendly from first contact. He's always quick to respond and helped us in ordering taxi's to/from the airport. Although we didn't get to meet him, his wife met us when we arrived to give us keys and some information on the apartment and local area & was very helpful & friendly.

The location is pretty much perfect, within a short stroll from both U Bahn & S Bahn metro links & with bus stops just outside, we were never more than a 20 minute journey from anywhere we wanted to go. We stayed as a group of 12 & there was plenty of room, enough real beds and seating for us all. As well as plenty of towels & dining & kitchen equipment. Could not recommend this apartment enough, thank you Dilo :) x
It's an ample room located at very good place.  To most of the beauty spot of Berlin， you just need short time. Dilo and his wife organized the house very good.

It's very nice place. The apartment is very clean,neat and tidy. It was very good stay for me. The location is very good near to all public transport and it easy to reach the apartment. He is very nice and friendly person. I recommend all of you to stay in this apartment when u visit Berlin.

We had a great time at Dlauber's flat. The flat can comfortably accommodate 14 people.
Overall I have absolutely nothing to complain.
There are good transportation options around the flat, although it is slightly far from tourist attractions (about 20 min bus/ tube). But other than that, all perfect.

The House was amazing, big and cozy
It didn't feel crowded at all, even though we were 9 people.
Great location, close to shops, mall and transportation.
Defiantly recommending!
Before I checked in, I worried about keeping baggages when I checked in early. After contact with the host, it was disapeard!!!
Super nice apartment, with incredible spaces for lodging a number of people, perfect for business trips, great location
The appartment is exactly as the pictures: stylish, clean and with a lot of space! Perfect for a big group, we were 12 and we were all super happy to stay in this very well located flat.

The apartment is just as advertised. It's specious and clean with all the modern amenities you will need. Very close to the U and the S do getting around was very easy.  Many choices of restaurants and shopping within walking distance.

The best stag weekend you could want. Mahir was great,  flexible and gave great advice. The appartement was spacious and clean, and we all slept fantastic. Everything was so close thanks to all the electric scooters around. Thank you very much mahir

Great apartment for a big group exploring Berlin!
Our group of 8 loved our stay here. The apartment felt bigger than in the photos, providing plenty of sleeping space as well as communal space for us too. The location is perfect really, just a 5-minute walk from two local stations where you can catch the train into central Berlin within 20 minutes. Over the road is a small shopping mall that has a Lidl for all your needs too!
All in all, we really enjoyed exploring Berlin from this apartment and would definitely love to stay again!

Great spacious apartment, ideal for big families or groups of friends. The apartment is equipped with modern kitchen and kitchen appliances, washing machine. All bedsheets and towels are provided. We enjoyed our stay a lot.

We loved Dlauars apartment. It was located very nicely with plenty of restaurants, cafes and bars nearby. It was also easy to get to other parts of the city from there. The apartment itself is very nice. Lots of space and a good mix of old building and modern renovation.

This large apartment is ideal for a small group of visitors. 2 bathrooms is a great amenity. The area of schoneberg is old schoneberg and a little run down.   The ubahn station was a bit of a walk and the s bahn was closer. So transit not ideal.

Very nice help from the host team.
Place was clean and tidy, lots of room and facilities.

We had a great stay and the apartment was exactly as shown in the photos, clean, spacious, and well located. The only downside was that it got extremely hot inside, and the fans provided weren't very strong. The more powerful fans were unfortunately very dirty, so we had to take them apart and clean them ourselves before using them. Other than that, everything was great and we really enjoyed our stay!

A nice flat in a convenient area, close to the underground and the rapid-transit S-Bahn. The flat is quiet and in very good condition. Exchange of keys was very smooth. A good experience. Many thanks to Brit!

The Apartment is really nice,very central for all shops & U Bahn and S Bahn. Only a few stops to the city centre etc.,The host was very professional and friendly and everything one wants as a traveller is in the apt. I would definitely recommend this apt,

Pat

When i reached it was Dave who received me, (Brit's son) and have shown the way, the listing was accurate as what was mentioned on AIRBNB, the location was very convenient and you can find Lidle (Supermarket) just around the corner, there is a local market that happens on Saturday and Wednesday at the church ground just near the house and you can find good local feed, like flowers, food, fresh juices and much more worth to explore.
the only issue that we had was the entrancement to the other room which we know already was from the bath room.
Also the main room is not a room actually it is the living room wherein there is bed at the left corner near the dining table which was ok.
It was a nice and comfortable stay at Brits place and we wish to return.

It was really a good experience and the flat was so good and location was close to shopping street Wilmasdorf.  Brit and her husband were so kind and helpful.  I am sure will stay during my next trip in Brits flat.  Thanks again

Brit sent a welcome greeting and when we had confusion about which unit to go to, the response was very fast.  The neighborhood was great, with many shops, banks, restaurants, buses and u-bahn stations, and a very good vibe!
Very nice place for a family. Clean and nice apartment and good playgrounds near by. Perfect place for some good days in Berlin.

Great location, easy to reach Messe Berlin by bus in 10'.
Nice aprtment, nice assistance from owner.
I recommend
The place was very convenient to public transport and was better than the pictures. I would definitely stay again.
It was a warm and nice place .And you could reach U2 and S 3/5/7/9 station here and about 15 -20 mins to get the Berlin city cube/ exhibition by S3/9.   A lot of shops nearby. Very convenient.

Charming apartment in a nice neighbourhood. Sparkling clean and well-organized. There are restaurants and shops close by, and the public transportation to get into downtown is a few minutes walk. Communication with Brit was easy and swift. Highly recommended!

I felt very cozy and comfortable in this apartment. It was very stylish and full of lovely details. Kitchen was completely equipped. I also enjoyed that bathroom was so close to the sleeping room. Super location also - best streets in Charlottenburg.  Brit was very nice and helpful.

We had a great time at Brit's place. It is located in beautiful Charlottenburg, everything is close by including the U and S Bahn. The nearby square and the market are lovely. While we stayed at the apartment, it was very quiet.

Perfect location for us as we needed to be near Deutsche Oper. Pretty market square around the church nearby and easy transport connections only about 5 mins away. Flat itself had everything we needed for a long weekend and was clean and quiet. Would thoroughly recommend.

Maria is a pleasant and helpful host. The unit is spacious and very conveniently located. On the whole a good experience. However, we found that the bed was not very comfortable. The sofa-bed in the lounge room was uncomfortable.

Amazing place, ideal for 2 ~ 4 people. Near everything you need, and you have everything to get wherever you want in Berlin.
Maria was patient, helpful, and I recommend her apartment for everyone.

Maria is a perfect host and everything we saw on the photo's was exactly the same in real life, apartment seemed even bigger than on the photo's. The host was very attentive and helped with everything we needed for our stay. Will be happy to be back next time we are in Berlin.

A big apartment which is nice and warm during the freezing temperatures. Good sized bathroom and living area. Great location - only 10 minutes walk from Brandeburg Gate, and great connections from the closest train station.

Maria helped us navigate transit from the airport and patiently waited for us to meet her at her flat.  She was very helpful, informative and responsive.  The flat was beautiful and clean, easily located within Berlin for access to everything including bus, tram, uban and sban.  We really enjoyed our stay and would return.
Maria's apartment is very well located and 2 blocks from one of the main stations. The apartment is nice and confortable. The stairs help you to be on shape.

The flat is spacious and perfectly located. We had a very nice stay in Berlin.
The only drawback was the wifi, which was not working properly.

Beautiful, clean & tidy flat local to all a tourist would want to do in Berlin. Maria was extremely good with communication and explained everything when we arrived.
WLAN was rather unreliable and the couch bed wasn’t the best bed for a 5 might stay.
Would definitely stay here again
Great location for tourists, in walking distance of lots of attractions! As well, the apartment is tidy and has everything you need for a comfortable stay.

This apartment is fantastic. Spacious and clean.
My husband and I stayed here for the Berlin marathon weekend. It is in a perfect position for the start and finish - just a short walk away.
It was our first visit to Berlin and we will visit again - a lovely city with a fantastic transport network and lovely people.
This apartment is in a perfect location for exploring the city
This is a lovely apartment close to many attractions around Berlin. The only small issue is carrying your bags up the stairs initially but after that the stay is very pleasant
One of the best places I ever booked via Airbnb! Spotlessly clean, has everything you need, unbeatable location. When I'm in Berlin will always check this apartment first
Good location and easy to walk to lots of tourist spots, also very close to public transport so really easy to get around.

The location was perfect for a city trip to Berlin. However, we were unable to connect to the guest Wi-Fi and despite contacting the host this was not resolved. There was only one towel for two people which wasn’t the most hygienic! Otherwise, a lovely and comfortable stay.

The location of this stay is amazing, a few minutes from 2 major train stations (both with a direct route to and from the airport)
Equally as close to many significant sights and points of interest.

This was a great place to stay, there was more space inside than we expected and it was in a nice area. Very close to the Hauptbahnhof which is great if you’re arriving by train. The kitchen was also well equipped!
A very nice place. Just one note to highlight, you have to carry luggage on 3rd floor over steep stairs, might be important to someone. Otherwise, a very nice place, strongly recommend!
Great place to stay, location was great. Although pillows weren’t comfortable and there was no washing powder, I didn’t know about the Berlin city tax till after booking.

Maurizio's apartment is a great place to stay when visiting Berlin and we highly recommend it ! We had a very nice week in this interesting city.  The apartment is situated in a nice and calm street in Wilmersdorf, it's  light, warm, welcoming and very well equipped. If you want an apartment to relax in after having confronted the tourist crowds or the bustling city center, this is the place. With U-bahn station Berliner Strasse very close we could easily make excursions all over Berlin. If you like walking it's easy to reach Kurfürstendamm by foot. We also appreciated the food stores close to Maurizio's flat. When visiting Berlin again we will certainly to stay in this flat again.
Had a very nice stay at Maurizio’s place! Short walk to the Berliner Straße U-Bahn stop. Cozy place with balcony. Maurizio was a great host.
It was a very nice stay at this apartment and i will book it again in the future. Just 2 small things: there wasn’t any water cooker and the cleaning was little too less.
Maurizio’s place was perfect for our needs. He was very helpful and responsive. The place was clean and met all our needs. Kitchen was well equipped.

Nice house, clean and very confortable. A bit far from the city center of Berlin but we had a very quiet sleep.
Thanks Gerd for your place.

It's a great place to stay with your friends or family. It has everything you need to have a really comfortable stay (dishes, bedding, kitchen things, and so on).
Totally 5 stars ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

We had a lovely stay here. The appartment is located in a good neigburhood on a quiet street. The bedrooms are spacious and beds comfortable. The host was helpsom and friendly. A big plus for the outdoorspace with sun :) We will highly reccomend this place to others :)

Myself and my family had a great time in Berlin thanks to Andreas' lovely apartment. It was located really centrally, next door to a metro station, and the apartment itself was bright and a lot more spacious than we had anticipated! Andreas wasn't around the weekend we were there but his contacts were always obliging and on hand. A great experience all round.

Beautiful neighbourhood only two minutes walk to the nearest s-bahn station (Savigny Platz) and approximately 8 minutes walk to the nearest u-bahn, so easy access to the city centre and the airport. Apartment was clean, comfortable and very spacious.  I have no complaints at all, we thoroughly enjoyed our stay and would heartily recommend this apartment as a place to stay.  Was also very helpful in leaving notes with information on where to go, places to eat etc.

The description of the flat could not have been more accurate. Beautiful place and I could have moved in right away!
Friend of Andreas was brilliant in welcoming us, taking up luggage, hand over keys. All very easy and uncomplicated.

The place was perfect - centrally located in a beautiful neighborhood and easy train access. The apartment was spacious with lots of character. Andreas was a very responsive host throughout. This was an ideal Berlin stay.

great location and lovely home.
description was accurate and there was a little construction noise but didn’t really bother us.
Stairs were a little tough for my 82 yo mother but we knew about those.
great place that you will enjoy!

Allthough not cheap, 21apart is a beautifully decorated & clean appartment in a great neighbourhood in Berlin. Our host Carolin was very helpful indeed. There is place for 6 people to sleep but I did found it all just a bit too small - 5 people max let's say.

I was warmly welcomed by a friend of Carolin,
Stepahanie was very kind and orientated me to the appartment and the great neighborhood. She gave me restaurant recommendations too!
Such a wonderfull place to stay in Berlin ! Carolin is really nice and the apartment is lovely, and in a perfect location.

We enjoyed very much our stay at Carolin's place.
We are a family of four and the apartment suited our needs perfectly.
Located on a quite street, one minute away from a super market, and 2 minutes away from the U2 station - we had everything at a hand's reach.
The apartment is in an excellent condition, the shower is great fun, the kitchen well equipped - and Carolin answered all our questions and recommendation requests.
This was indeed one of our best vacations ever, and the apartment was a significant factor in its success.
Thanks Carolin.
What a beautiful place. Nicely furnished and great hospitality. We will certainly go back! Thanks caroline

The apartment is really nice and the location is great.
Carolin is a dedicated host and will also provide suggestions to those new to the city. It is the perfect place to stay in Berlin.
We highly recommend this apartment. We loved it in every way. And we will stay no other place in Berlin when we come back! See you soon again Caroline!

This is an amazing apartment in a great neighbourhood. Excellent restaurants, bakeries, coffee bars, and grocery stores are all around the corner. Public transport is just a short walk away. The Fernsehturm, Berliner Dom, and the Museum Insel are all in walking distance. Apartment is very cosy and comfortable. We had a great stay with a family of five.
It is a wonderful apartment with everything necessary, in a quiet location. Shops, cafes and restaurants are within walking distance, great selection as well. Highly recommended.

Nice and comfortable,  very clean, you may walk to the centre (about 25 minutes), we have been using taxi which works very mach what you expect in Germany. Easy access to a communal garden, great for smokers. TV and BT speaker (nice touch!) work fine.

Location very good
Neighbour hood very quite
Restraunts and shopping excellent
10 min walk to 5 of the top things to do and see In Berlin

Carolin’s place is as described. It was a real pleasure to have two actual bedrooms and comfy, fluffy bed linens. It is definitely urban chic and in a great, trendy location. Lots restaurants and bars, and a nice grocery just down the street.  Carolin’s friend, Armin, met us and was very helpful and friendly. Be aware this flat is on the bottom floor. It’s not quite ground level, but you can see and hear people walking by. This didn’t bother us, but something to be aware of. A very nice stay!
We had a wonderful stay at Carolin's place. I can highly recommend the host and the venue!
Carolin is super responsive and helpful. Her place is conveniently located and our family enjoyed our trip and stay in Berlin. Thank you
Wonderful appartment ! Spacious, clean and peaceful. Carolin is a very kind host and always ready to help. Thanks for everything 😊
We had the best time! Perfect location in Mitte. Extremely clean and quite apartment. Great and easy communication with Carolin. Couldn’t have asked for more! :-)
Very much enjoyed our stay with a two-year old due to the extremely convenient location with two playgrounds around the corner as well as numerous great food & drink options.

Great apartment, perfectly located in one of the fanciest areas of Berlin, but at the same time in a quiet and clean street. Few minutes walk from 3 different subway stations, it was the perfect starting point to visit the city. We had a lovely stay, thanks Carolin!

Stylish urban vibe interior with everything in excellent order and spotlessly clean. Surprisingly quiet flat with a lovely secluded communal courtyard garden, to which you have access. Great location with a fantastic selection of restaurants and bars to suit all tastes. Close to the underground system, which is very convenient. A perfect place to stay, experience the vibrant cultural life in Berlin and then relax and unwind.
Very cool place. Nicely located i Prenzlauer Berg close to good restaurants etc. Great communication and service with the host.

We enjoyed staying at Carolin’s place. We were a family of four.
The location is 10-15 minutes from the main Berlin attractions by foot. Easy access to metro, supermarket (Edeka), parks, restaurants.
Everything was great but few supplies provided to us was partially low in supply (dish soap, only one roll of paper towels provided). Carolin was able to provide us with dish soap right away and left It outside of our door. Wifi had excellent connection.
The beds and rooms are very comfortable and spacious. Kitchen is small but has all the supplies one would need.
We wish the bathroom windows were closed since it is located on the garden side and there were lots of mosquitos in the bathroom when we arrived. I’d consider those pretty minor things in the big scheme of things.
Overall, we enjoyed our stay and highly recommend this place.
Amazing stay! Communication as well as location and design of the flat were beyond perfect! Thanks again. :)
The hospitality at Carolin's place was wonderful. The apartment is big and cozy. Carolin was a kind host who answered all our questions and we hope to stay again in Berlin in this apartment.

6 girls spent 3 nights in the apartment. Great location, within walking distance to many great spots in Berlin. Easy communication with the host. Looks just like in the pictures. The place is also very clean. Would recommend to other travellers 😊

We had a wonderful few days in Carolin’s apartment. The neighborhood is lovely and there’s plenty of restaurants and bars to visit but the apartment is in a very quiet street which is the perfect combination! On top of that Carolin was a lovely host, so we would very much recommend this place!
Lovely apartment and great location! We really enjoyed the nearby parks and restaurants. Carolin was super easy to communicate with throughout our stay.

A great place to stay! Classic East Berlin style, nicely furnished and nestled on a quiet little residential street, but still close to everything you need. And with a wonderfully helpful and responsive host!

This was good base for our Berlin trip.  Close to 3 different subway stops and easy to get anywhere in the city.  Lots of good restaurants and shopping close by.  The apartment was quiet, clean and well equipped.  Carolin was very responsive and made both check in and check out easy.  Highly recommended!

We stayed with 6 friends at Carolin’s Airbnb.
The apartment is perfectly located with lots of cafes and bars in walking distance around it.
There are 2 bedrooms (2 | 4 beds) and a living room /kitchen to be together.
I can recommend the apartment and would come back again.

Carolin was a wonderful host. She waa a great communicator and check in/out was very smooth. She also let us leave our bags in the apt before check in time which was super helpful to us. We enjoyed our stay in her apt and would recommend staying there! Thank you Carolin!

Carolin’s place was perfect for exploring Berlin, close to transport and also walkable into main city. The apartment is more spacious than the photos seem, good living area and bedrooms, nice shower and separate toilet.
Very comfortable beds, very clean and had everything we needed. Would recommend.

Our stay at Amelie's apartment was perfect. The apartment is  clean, spacious and well equipped and was even bigger than it looked in the photos. Amelie left us extensive information about the area we were staying in. The neighbourhood was peaceful and felt very safe and was very close to an U Bahn station which takes you directly to the city centre. The facilities were fantastic and meant we could self cater each night and there were nearby supermarkets to get food from. We wish we could have stayed longer!

The neighborhood is really great with parks, restaurants, market and public transportation to everywhere. The apartment is cozy, well equipped and clean. The view from the window is very beautiful! Amelie was a great host and with very good communication! :)

Amelie’s apartment is perfect if you are looking for a nice and calm location while in Berlin. Its neighbourhood is really calm and pretty close to everything at the same time. What’s  more, Amelie’s been more than helpful and was always a message away. I’d definitely recommend her flat and will be back for sure!!!

We had a fantastic stay at Amelie's apartment. It was clean, facilities to cook, comfy bed and so easy to get everywhere we wanted to. Exactly what we wanted for our trip. Highly recommended if you want a calm quiet place to stay but easy to reach the sights. Thank you!

We was there with two kids. A 1,5 and a 4,5 year old. Everything was very nice. The apartman is so quiet and peacful, the area is perfect with families, a nice park with playgrounds is next to the house. And very easy to reach the city center, the underground which go there is about 5 minutes walk.
Our stay at Amelie's was great. The flat was clean, well equipped and 5 minutes walking from the Subway. 100% recommended!

We had a great time at this apartment in Berlin! The apartment is spacious and comfortable, with lots of great amenities. It's located in a nice, quiet suburb, only a five minute walk from a U-Bahn station which takes you into town in fifteen minutes. There are quite a few stairs, but otherwise we thought the place could hardly be improved! Would happily stay here again.
We had a great stay. Very nice place with everything organized and well thought of. was very comfy for us and our our 3 year old.

We spent two days at Oli's apartment. It is very close to the U-bahn to the KaDeWe and the Main Shopping street in West Berlin. The apartment is very nice, extremely clean and newly furnished. Oli and his father are also very kind and helpful.

It's great.
The area is quiet.
Close to u-bahn, s-bahn, 100 and 200 "sightseeing" buses.
Apartment itself though small is comfortable.
Plenty of light. Everything is top-notch.
I especially enjoyed the attention to details:
Forgot your toothbrush? There is one.
Need clothes pressed before going out? There's an iron and a board.
Live tulips, complementary beer. It's great.

we were greeted by the wonderful Hubertus: an older fellow with a friendly manner and a passion for helping tourists. The apartment was clean and neatly presented. Tge balcony is quite secluded abd overlooks swaying trees.
The kitchen facilities were apt and the bed was light and comfortable.
The area is residential but close enough to the city center, with charming local shops and a cool boozer one minute away.
Would recommend: ask for Hubertus to show you around, the man is a legend

We stayed in Olie's apartment in Berlin for a week and enjoyed every moment. The apartment is stunning, the location is excellent, and it has everything that a couple needs on vacation. The relationship with the Oli was excellent.

One of the best!. You have everything you need in this house for a nice stay. The host is very friendly, helping and responsive. Apartment is very neat ,clean and stylish. also apartment is near to Central station. In short, perfect place to stay in Berlin.

APARTMENT- Very clean and modern. DO NOT BE AFRAID THAT IT IS A SOFA BED!! The bed was very comfortable for two. The 9 kg. washer/dryer was very nice.
LOCATION- Quiet tree lined street. 3 minute walk to underground. 10 minute walk to major shopping.
HOSTS- Oli and his father were great!! Prompt communication, both before and after the booking. Oli helped us find stores and services in the neighborhood.

It was really great to stay in Oli apartment!
Really nice hosts and great communication.
Everything in flat was much better than I expected.
Definitely I highly recommend to stay here!
The apartment had its own parking and was modern. It was within 15 min of everywhere i wanted to go.
The apartment was beautifully clean, well kitted out and had everything I needed for my stay. Thank you!
I booked this place for our guest and he confirmed it was a perfect place for him. The hosts are indeed super hosts. Thanks Oli

An excellent stay.
The apartment is very well appointed and had everything I could possibly need making it perfect for short or long stays.
The area is close to many amenities such as supermarkets and restaurants, as well as gyms and the shopping district.
Oli is friendly, timely and knowledgeable.

Great location and Oli was full of recommendations for places to go. Hubert was so sweet and kind.  Both check in and check out was easy.  The apartment was cosy and the starter kit of basic pantry essentilas was the best idea!   Will stay again!

The flat is big enough for two,  clean and well equipped. It has a very nice view into the garden. The bed was comfortable. It's close to the U-bahn stations. We appreciated the possibility of free parking. The hosts were very nice and helpful. :)
Actually, I have nothing to add to all previous review (and I have chosen the place based on the reviews)  :). We liked the apartment very much. Definitely recommend it!

It was an amazing experience, very clean and equipped apartment, the most quiet place I've ever slept in.
Every detail is taken into account and the location is super convenient.
Flowers were a nice surprise!
Highly recommended!

Excellent ,special thanks to Oli and he’s father ,they accept my luggages before my check in so i didn’t have to be worried about them. The house has everything i needed ,even more. The furnitures are new and all in a really good quality , also the balcony is such a peace it opens to the backyard and it gives you a calm feelings . Very recommended :)
Excellent accommodations for travelers near many bakeries, restaurants, and bars. Many amenities not often found in other properties like washer/dryer.

Great place, great host, nothing we missed or could complain about. The apartment is located in a quiet neighborhood, has a view into a green courtyard, and there is private and secure parking available. A small grocery store is next door and several public transportation options are nearby. The apartment is well and thoughtfully equipped and was spotlessly clean. Oli and father are great hosts. The communication was perfect. We enjoyed our stay very much.
Oli was a wonderful host! Very proactive and the location is very easy to get around Berlin using public transport
Spacious, comfortable and convenient place from which to explore Berlin. Well connected to bus and train routes. Nicole was a great host!

Nicole’s place is a great base to explore Berlin from. We had a bit of trouble finding the entrance but Nicole was only a phone call away and helped us to check in smoothly. It is a little further from the centre than some other places but it has excellent transport links with a bus stop opposite which takes you directly to CheckPoint Charlie or a short walk /bus ride to the S bahn as an alternative route to the centre. Nicole was very responsive and accommodating. Would definitely recommend her place.

Great location, 2 mins from Hackescher Markt and lots of great places to eat and drink close by. It's a great location and all main sites within 40 minutes walk (this was with a buggy too) It takes less than an hour by train (one change) from schoenefeld airport. Great base for families and friends and has pretty much everything you need for a few days away + the views from the apartment are amazing! Would definitely recommend, thanks!

Hae-ok was very responsive on emails. Her apartment was very clean when we arrived, and had a well-equipped kitchen. The apartment was very spacious for 3 persons (it's big enough to house 6 I believe), and had a great view from high up! In addition, the location at Hackescher Markt was fantastic - many food/drink places and 2 S-Bahn stations within walking distance. Major attractions - Berliner Dom, Bebelplatz, various museums on Museum Island - were nearby which made the location excellent for itinerary planning. Highly recommend.

The location in perfect, you can reach all the main ip of the city by foot and metro station is very close. In the neighbourhood there are lots of reasturants and shops, Alexander Platz is a 3mins of walk. The apartment has a breathtaking view and has lot of space. Recomended

Apartment was in a great location, looking out on Hackescher Markt and 10 mins walk to Alexanderplatz. TXL bus to Tegal airport dropped us off 5 mins walk from apartment. Ideal location for bars/restaurants/shops and very central for viewing tourist attractions.  It was equipped with all the necessities required. If you are looking for a 4 star hotel then this apartment is not for you. It is a basic apartment but has everything we needed for our 4 night stay in Berlin.

W had a very comfortable stay in Hae-Ok's place. The location was great and the view was amazing. Facilities where all good, the only minor was the noise from the Train station when the window is open at night. So if you like to sleep with the window open just bring ear plugs and you are good to have a great night sleep :)

We could not have been happier with our stay here. Our 21st floor apartment gave us a view of Berlin that rivaled the view from the Reichstag. It is one block from the train station& a grocery store & 2 blocks from Alexanderplatz. We walked to Museum Island and one evening walked to Brandberg Tor. It is ideally located. The apartment was very neat and clean and we had everything we needed. The kitchen was equipped well and we were able to make some meals there. The host was kind and communicated well. She helped us to learn how to get from the airport to the apartment and then there was someone there waiting to give us the key. Some may prefer a quieter environment, but we loved the convenience of being close to the train and all the activity and had no trouble sleeping. If ever we are fortunate enough to return to Berlin this would be our first choice to stay.

This apartment is in a perfect location for visiting Berlin. It's in the heart of a nice neighborhood within walking distance to shopping and all the top museums. It's a block to the train station and a natural foods grocery store. There are plenty of restaurants nearby.
The view from the apartment is beautiful. We watched the sunset from here several nights and it was quite lovely. We appreciated having three bedrooms and two bathrooms for our group of three friends. It worked out great.
The host was nice enough to let us check out a little later than checkout time, which was a great help to us since we had an evening flight and nowhere else to keep our bags.
We would stay here again and recommend it to others visiting Berlin.

Hae-Ok's apartment suited our needs. Staying for Berlin pride we simply needed a comfortable and central spot to rest our heads. Very much matched description, nothing too fancy but fit the cost and Hae-Ok was quick to respond when we had any questions. I wouldn't hesitate to stay again.

This apartment is in a very good position, right near Alexanderplatz. We (two couple) were able to walk (a few kms) to many sights but had all public transport close by as well. It is a clean and comfortable apartment with great views over the city. You can hear the trains which mIght be an issue if you are a light sleeper. We enjoyed our stay and would recommend Hae-Ok as a host.
Debbie
Melbourne

Hae-Ok’s place is in a fantastic location, the train station, Alexanderplatz and local shops and bars all in easy walking distance. Hae-Ok communicated well and made us feel very welcome. We had an enjoyable and comfortable stay. Being so close to the station however meant we could hear the trains at night but this didn’t effect our sleep. Thank you Hae-Ok.
Clean apartment close to train station, town and Christmas markets. Perfect space for the 5 of us.
Perfect location, lovely apartment. Have-ok was really helpful. Only the Wi-Fi wasn’t working but this should be an easy fix. I would definitely recommend this apartment for other guests.

Fantastic flat in a very good location. Nearby all the museums and transport links. We had a lovely stay here and would definitely stay again. Flat itself was clean, spacious, warm and well-equipped. Thank you, Hae-Ok!

The location of the appartment is just great in Berlin Mitte, just around the corner of Alexanderplatz and the TV tower. A short walk to the Museum Island and the Dom and a bit further Unter den Linden with the Brandenburger Tor.
The appartment is spacy and very clean. Two bathrooms add to the convenience when staying with a family of four.
Hae Ok is checking with you before arrival to provide the necessary information, just after arrival to check whether everything is Ok and at the end of the stay to check again. These signs of care for the guests are very well received! We can definately recommend this appartment.
The only thing that prevents a full 5 star score is the noise of trains that goed on all night. Even on the 21st stock this can keep you from sleeping once you start paying attention.

Spacious and clean. Amazing views of the city. Our favorite accommodation out of the six we stayed in on our 16 day European vacation from the USA.
Hae Ok was very receptive to our questions and answered the questions quickly.

Great location and nice apartment  but very difficult to sleep due to the constant noise from the railway station very close to the property, which seems to run for most of the night with trains every couple of minutes.

Great location, great views, really central. It felt safe and clean.
The minor downside was the sound of the trains and a minor one for me it was only having 1 (feather) pillow but would stay here again.

I really like this accommodation. If I come back to visit Berlin again. This place will be one of my choices, and will probably recommend it to friends.
As for the noise of the train. There will be noise when we open the window. But if the window is closed, the incoming sound was very soft. Until there is no problem at all for us.
Very pretty view from apartment. Walkable to most places, the train and bus were easy to use from here. Restaurants were lovely near. Host was friends and quick to reply.
Great location and nice apartment. Had everything we needed for a group of four. Host was responsive and very helpful. Would definitely recommend.
Hae-OK’s flat was excellent. Location in Berlin was close to train, tram and U-Bahn stations.  Easy to get anywhere in the city. This place is a great bargain.

Hae-Ok was a great host. Very helpful and responsive. The location of the apartment was great and the view was excellent. There has been some water damage in one of the bathrooms and the other lock was broken. Hae-Ok was responsive and was going to come and fix it, but we requested that she wait until we left and she agreed. Would stay again.
Great place, easy proximity to central Berlin and all attractions on foot or using the tram, would definitely recommend
Great place to stay. Very convenient as right in centre and close to station. Would use again.
Caroline’s place is really lovely. Beautiful neighbourhood and well connected with the rest of the city. Would definitely recommend
Nice and clean house. Access was very easy and neighbourhood is very nice. Lot of bars and parties around the place thank you for everything

Lovely place, as described, in a lively and hip neighborhood of Berlin.

We enjoyed our stay, and the flat was well-appointed.

Would recommend for the price!

We are really positive about this appartment! It is located in a really nice neighborhood with many nice local shops and cafés. The appartment was tidy and clean. There is a small kitchen, which we didn't know in advance. Philip was very kind, he helped us in the beginning and we could call him if we needed something!

Philip's apartment was just as described and even better than we expected. Very comfortable and well taken care of and the bed was extremely comfortable. Great place for 2-3 people considering there is an extra bedroom. Was also in a really convenient location right near the subway line and in a trendy neighborhood. Would definitely stay there again!

We had a nice stay at the apartment next door to Phillipe. It was a real East Berlin experience. The location is close to the metro station. The house was well heated.
Enjoyed our stay. Laundromat within 4mins walk.

What an amazing space! So much nicer than the photos. Comfortable beds, lovely kitchen, absolutely perfect for two couples who each want a bedroom. Ideal location as well and easy communication to get in. Thanks, Philipp!
Beautiful place that is even better then the pictures. It has everything you need, and the location is fantastic. The communication with Philipp went smoothly, really no problem at all!
We had a nice stay at Philipp’s place. Beautifully decorated and well equipped. Danke!
Place was according to description. It allows good visit to Berlín because it is so close to metro.

Host and children were very nice. Flexible with check-in and check-out. It was nice to have a yard for the two small dogs to play in. The yard also seemed like it would be nice for a summertime visit. The furniture was well used and I was cozy for 6 adults but still a really nice place.
A great quiet and private space to stay in an interesting section of Berlin. The studio has a lovely natural light, which isn't captured in the photos.
The place fitted exactly my need in terms of location, price and quietness. Susanne was very friendly and the whole process went extremely well. Great experience.

Wonderful and very special place in a great district, with amazing hosts. Unfortunately we didn't meet Susanne in person, but her husband Kamel was very welcoming and friendly. The space itself is spacious, light and has minimum things but everything you may need for a few days stay is there. The place serves as an artist residence so it has a special spirit. Everything you see makes you wonder how it is used when the artists are there. There're a lot of great books about photography which made our evenings more interesting. Don't hesitate for a moment, this place is definitely worth staying!
Lovely studio, excellent location in a busy area but tucked away so is not noisy. Susanne was very helpful and check in went smoothly even though we had an early flight. Thoroughly enjoyed our stay!

A cozy and silent place hidden in the backyard of a busy street fairly close to the city center. Sightseeing is possible without any problems by taking the metro 3 or 4 stations. The apartment itself is relatively small but had everything we needed

Very close to S-Bahn. Quite location with many grocery stores and a couple restaurants. Would recomend for a short stay. Bathroom door does not fully close and it got very bright early in the morning from the skylight.

Susanne is a great host, very friendly and supportive. The process of checking in and out was smooth and convenient. The studio is nice, facing a quiet inner yard, exactly as described. I liked that it’s different from your standard hotel room with a unique spirit. I believe that staying at places like this helps to make my trips unique.
Susanne‘s studio is absolutely wonderful - quiet, beautifully furnished, very well-equipped and super clean. A great place to rest and work. Susanne was extremely helpful as well.

I absolutely loved staying in Suzanne's beautiful studio, The Dark Room. In wonderful Schöneberg, where there are loads of great shops and restaurants nearby, it is easy to get into the town centre and also to get out to Schlachtensee to swim in the lake! It's quiet and cosy, there is a supermarket round the corner, you have absolutely everything you need for an amazing time in Berlin. Susanne is a wonderful kind understanding host. I'll be back!

Missed my flight and the airline lost my luggage - arrived late and Susanne went beyond her duty to receive me - being late for her RDV. Very much appreciated.
Very pro-active and made sure my stay went perfectly well. Very friendly and personable host. Would def recommend.
We had a lovely stay at Susanne's place. The apartment is nice and private, off the main street and the location great, very near multiple forms of transport - perfect for seeing the city!
Everything was good and as expected: Susanne is very kind and the studio is cool! Just one suggestion: a curtain for the skylight would not be a bad idea :)

Thanks to its central location, you can easily access all the beauties of the city and its garden invites you to the peace of nature. There is also no doubt about the cleanliness! Definitely a place I would like to stay again.

Susanne's studio was an oasis in the bustle of Berlin. We had all the necessary amenities near by and we're conveniently located by underground and bus stops that was used frequently to get around the city. She was a wonderful communicative host, highly recommend staying here.
I loved Susanne's studio, it was really comfortable and in a great area. Susanne was very helpful too

We loved Susanne's studio. It was exactly like we expected. It was very peaceful and quiet at night, and the location was great. We are looking forward to booking the studio again next summer. Thank you!
Suzanne's place was perfect for what we needed. We didn't need anything fancy, just a place to sleep for the night. Really nice outdoor garden area!

Great location, super convenient to get to mitte, lovely neighbourhood, lots of food and cafe options, interesting shops. The studio was just perfect, clean, tranquil, and very inspiring and stylish. I cannot have a better stay. Thank you Susanne!

Parwana is a really friendly and organized host. She provides each and every useful instruction and directions so I have no problem checking in at all. She prepared everything before we arrived so there was no confusion, and for things we do need to ask -- she responds online instantly. Overall we were really satisfied!
