Location was easy access to the nearest train station and everything was as describe on the page. The only downside was that the room is facing the road so noises can be easily heard but otherwise, a nice experience.

Parwana was a great host! Her instructions on how to check in/out were extremely thorough and accurate and she was available by phone for any questions I had. The room was impeccably clean and cozy as was the entire apartment. Best of all her place is closely located to major transit lines, shopping and tourist attractions. I would definitely recommend her place to anyone!
Parwana's place is greatly equipped and in an accessible part of the city. She is also friendly and prompt with communication.
this room is clean and comfortable! there is near by road and kitchen is next to this room.

Parwana is a lovely host! Everything was very nice here. Although we didn't use the kitchen, it would have been an amazing alternative. Clean, big and comfortable room! Only one thing annoyed us: the bed was squeaking all the time, even if you only moved your leg or arm or something. But all in all I would recommend everybody to stay here! Thanks Parwana ❤

Parwana was a great host, very easy to communicate with. We loved the room: great size and comfortable bed. The bedroom was very clean as was the bathroom. The neighborhood is lovely but a bit of a commute to touristy sports. Definitely worth it, though, would recommend to anyone or visit another time!

Parwana's place is great, super near to transport, quite and super clean.
In my case I went to Berlin for working and it was more than perfect. Highly recommended
I highly recommend the Parwana rooms, I found myself very well. They are clean and the area is' quiet
The place is really nice, very clean, very quiet. Parwana was a great host and was very responsive to messages.

Had a comfortable night. Everything as described. Everything you need is close like supermarket, bakery, cafes, restaurants, etc.
Thank you!

This room was perfect for my business visit to the Berlin trade-show: clean comfortable spacious, good tv/channels, wifi, AND walking distance to the show. The self checkin was very convenient. The room has its own key and the kitchen and bathroom are shared. I only ran into the other guests in passing, everyone keeps to themselves as it is more of a guest-house than staying with a host. I will definitely try to book this room again next year if its available! Thanks again Parwana!
Furniture quite uncomfortable (bed as well) and kitchen very sparely equipped. Rest was good and apartment was very clean. Good communication by host.
Good location - easy accessibility to public transport & food outlets. Quiet neighbourhood. Comfortable, clean spacious room as well as an adequately equipped kitchen.

Very friendly, quickly responding host. The apartment is very simple yet nice and cozy, located not very far away from the city center, so can go there by one or two underground metro. close to the home is a good food store which is very convenient.

Parwana is a very kind host, she replied everything so fast also with very good communication!!
I strongly recommend her house to everyone!
Great cosy rooms, close to U-Bahn and easy to find. Would recommend and would rent again anytime.
Clean, nice, the only problem is that  the door lock in each room needs repairing. A little unsafe
We had a lovely stay here. Instructions were very clear and the location is very nice, with a park, restaurants, super markets and a u bahn stop being around the corner.

The room is perfect for a couple, located near the metro station that leads to the centre of Berlin. The neighbour's that shared the common space with us were really quite and polite. Parwana is easily reachable and provides useful information in due time.
Nice place to stay in a good location. Definitely good value for money. Parwana is super friendly and answers everything quite promptly.
very clean, easy check in and out, had a problem in communicating with the host.. i think the room is a little bit pricey for the facilities and place

The flat has 7 different room and i think one of them has own toilet and it has 2 different bathroom for other 6 rooms and on kitchen for your all needs. we stayed here 2 nights and enjoyed our stay. The place is 5-8 min walk distance to u-bahn(metro). the neighborhood is pretty quite but has some cafe shops supermarkts and "späti" which is open till 2-3 oclock in night you can buy some alcohol or water etc.
the place was just little bit far away from where we wanna visit but all other things was good.
Very good location. Underground station is nearby, bus station is nearby. Silent place. Communication was kind. Instructions was clear.

The experience wasn't satisfactory. The host had issues with my guest staying over, and I could hear noises from the bed whenever I moved. Additionally, the host communicated excessively because of my guest, a problem I haven't encountered with other hosts. Their detailed description of my guest in a towel made me feel uncomfortable, as if I was being watched. I expressed my displeasure to the host over the phone. They didn't mention it was a 7 room (which I don't have a problem with) A few more to say, but with a little maintenance, it's will fit perfectly with their description. Next time I hope there'll be no next time with them.

Everything was very clean and organised. The room had a nice and tasteful decoration with lots of space for storage and sitting, also a nice and comfortable bed. The neighbourhood was lovely, very charming and with restaurant and supermarket options. It’s a bit far from the center but it’s very close to the U line that connects all the city, it also has easy access to buses and trains.

It was a short stay for me. The shower area is pretty basic and the standing water has to be removed to the drain with a long window cleaner. Couldn't get the 2 burner induction stove to fire up maybe its just me? so didn't do any cooking. Fyi for future guests, arrive at the latest on saturday morning so you can buy food as most grocery stores are closed on sundays.
My room was facing the street and unfortunately there was a perrinial idiot on his cell outside my window. Eventually had to yell through for him to leave.

Zito and Zohra ´s appartment was very nice, if you love music don't hesitate !
We were nearby every acomodation.
Even if we didn ´t meet Zitonand Zohra were very helpful !
We reallu enjoyed our trip and we highly recommand this appartment !

Apartment is very quiet, you will sleep undisturbed by any (street-) noise. It has enough of space for two people. We even could put our bicycles in the room and had plenty of space left. Apartment also has a kitchen with fridge and microwave. Area has two supermarkets around the corner and numerous restaurants.
Zito and Zohra are very friendly and kind hosts. Nice to be in his rehearsal studio with all the different percussion instruments around.
We met Zohra when we arrived, she was very nice and helpful. The place is quite small but we only stayed for 2 days so it was very nice.
Zito and Zohra are excellent persons, very kind, they recommend you lot of activities in Berlin to use the room just to sleep.

Excellent stay in Berlin. Zito and Zohra are great, very nice welcome although I could only see Zohra.
However Zito give precious advices to discover Berlin and activities by Airbnb message. The appartment is conform to the ad. I recommend !!
Thank you Zito and Zohra !!

Very convenient location, near metro and bus station. The apartment is clean and big enough for two people. The hosts were really helpful, providing us with all information needed. I hope to have this apartment available for my next visit to Berlin.

I can not recommend Zito’s place more. Not only is it ideally situated, with extreme ease to get anywhere in Berlin, but also down to his hosting skills. I myself missed the messages he had sent me regarding where the spot was located, as well as not letting him know when I would arrive. Yet still I was greeted at the door, where his girlfriend had waited for hours until our arrival (even without knowing would we show).
Zito also provides so many things to do during your stay, both locally and in the city. His hospitality and quick replies were second to none and I can say with confidence it is here I will stay on my return to Berlin.

Had a great stay at this place.
Very friendly host with open and clear communication. Location is great and close to public transport. Neighborhood is cozy and feels safe.
The apartment was ok. Everything appeared to be clean and well taken care of.
The only downside was that the toilet didn’t work properly, the host was aware and only told us after checking in. Wouldn’t have booked this place for so many nights if I was aware of this issue.

Great place for the price you pay, short walk to the U-Bahn, Host was very friendly and always responded to questions. The studio apartment had a real soul and was very cozy.
The area around was quite calm and quiet during days and night which was a nice contrast to the livid streets of other places.

zito is a very nice and helpfull guy.
the room was clean and obe of the cheapest we had found. perfect für travelers who are just there to sleep and spend the most time with exploring the City. we would come back
Accommodations were perfect. Katja was great and very helpful with everything - beautiful apartment in a very charming area of Kreuzberg. The best pizza I can remember is around the corner.

Top location, experienced and capable host, a nice room. Great overall. Small drawbacks: in the bright summer mornings I found it difficult to sleep, as the curtains are very light. The bedroom and bathroom are not completely private, as the corridor is very occasionally (probably really rarely) used by someone else.

Katja's place was possibly the best Airbnb I've ever stayed at. The neighborhood is great with cafes and restaurants close by and the accommodations were fantastic. A big comfortable bed in a nice clean, large room with tall ceilings. The bathroom was large and clean. We had total privacy the whole time.
Katja was a very welcoming host. She was always available to help and even arranged for us to use her washing machine to do our laundry.
I highly recommend staying at this Airbnb.

I had a great time at Katja's appartement. Just a few minutes walk to the U-bahn. The appartement has it's own entrance and a private bathroom. Everything was very clean and cosy.
I would difinitly go back on my next trip to this great city.

I only can recommend to stay in this beautiful, bright room just around the corner from the beautiful Landwehrkanal and Paul Linckeufer. The room is big and bright, with a good bed, a good tv and good working wifi. The bath in the bathroom was a very nice extra surprise. Host Katja is very friendly and communicating with her, as I arrived and left but also in the days before about the time I would arrive, was very easy. The neighbourhood is beautiful and has everything you need voor a nice stay: nice cafe's and restaurants just around the corner, and the feeling is also very save. When you visit Berlin, please stay at Katja's place!

Awesome place, right in the heart of Kreuzberg... so many cool spots nearby to eat, drink and explore. I would definitely come back here!
Katja is very helpful and the room was exactly as described.
Thank you Katja :)

A great room in a lovely part of Berlin. If you don't want a typical tourist experience, this place is perfect. The room is just like the pictures, however a little cold in the evenings.
Would definitely stay again, thank you Katja!
Great stay in katja's place, the location is perfect, and the room is awesome with a private bathroom! I recommend it!
Really nice room in a quiet area of Berlin not far from everything. Katja is really nice and friendly.

Katja's place is central, comfortable and well equipped for a fantastic stay. The room was bright and airy; there was shelves and hanging space so we could get settled in straight away and it was spotlessly clean.
We rented bikes from a nearby shop and the room was perfectly located to visit everything we wanted to see, from the Reichstag to Tempelhof park, Friedrichshain to Liquidrom, everything was an easy bike ride away.
I recommend the cafe downstairs for breakfast, the perfect place to pick up on the flat's wifi and plan your stay.
Thank you Katja!

Katja's place is a perfect combination of quality room, privacy, silence and perfect location.
If you are looking for a nice place to stay in kreuzberg with good connections to public transport to visit and to go out, you cannot get a better deal! In addition, it is located just in front of a nice park and bridge where people gather to have a beer.
Great flat in a great area :) Katja was very hospitable and helpful. A little noisy due to the popular Italian restaurant downstairs but that's due to the lively area. Would definitely recommend
Lovely space in a very central location that is close to restaurants and public transportation. I would definitely stay here again when in Berlin.
Amazing place, awesome host, 5 stars all around! If you have a chance to stay here I highly recommend it!!

I spent 3 days at Katja's place and it has been a really good stay. The room is spacious, quiet and very clean as well as the private bathroom. The location in Kreuzberg is pretty good with easy access to the Ubahn and the comunication with Katje very nice and smooth. I strongly recommend to stay in her house.

Lovely large, bright room, modern but with character. Private bathroom was very clean and modern, had lots of towels, shower gel, handwash etc. Hairdryer was a really helpful touch as was the sparkling water and sweets! No facilities to make drinks but there is a convenience shop and nice little coffee shop right next door.  Location was great, very close to lots of great cafes, bars and restaurants yet quiet and safe in the evening. Short walk to two train stations and Turkish market. Katja was a great host, good communication and very friendly. Let us leave later as our flight was not until the afternoon which was a great help. Would definitely stay again when back in Berlin!

The room is huge, clean and a pleasure to stay in. The design is really nice & modern with big windows and lots of light, the bed was very comfortable. Katja was super responsive and helpful. The area is full of places to go out to eat and drink. definitely would recommend it to a friend.

Nice clean place in a pretty neat neighborhood. Katja is very prompt with her responses, so I had no issues co-ordinating since I had a late check in.
It is around 10 min walk to the closest public transport options

Katja is a great host. The apartment is in a great neighborhood (one of my favorites in Berlin) with lots to see and do, and right on the canal. The windows face the interior courtyard, so it was very quiet. The apartment building also has a elevator so if you have heavy bags, you don‘t have to haul them upstairs.

This is a top location for visiting Berlin. Katja is a Sweet perfect host. Clean, light and quite room. With own bathroom lots of privacy..
Close to a lot of breakfast and dinner place. Rent a bike in the Mariannestrasse nearby with good bikes.

Located in a charming and happening neighbourhood of Berlin, the room and bathroom were nice, sparkling clean and we certainly could have passed more time there if we had had the option. Check in and communication with Katja was prompt and easy. We had a great stay (despite the heat wave in Berlin)!
Amazing space, super stylish and impeccably clean! Loved the massive windows overlooking the quaint courtyard. Felt like an entirely separate apartment.
Perfect location. Artsy district the cafe below is amazing. We walked so much and had a fantastic stay these were excellent host and total privacy!

Katja’s place is super stylish and comfortable, right in the middle of plenty of bars, restaurants and the lovely canal. Most importantly the room is super quiet which means we were not bothered by the noise in the street. Katja was adorable, we definitely recommend!
The apartment was perfect. Quiet and clean. Location was very good. Katja was very friendly and helpful. We recommend.

Amazing room, very clean and cozy. Close to restaurants, cafés and night clubs. Extremely close to Admiralbrücke, a cool point to meet friends and have a beer. I really recommend this place and want to stay there again.
Very clean, beautiful room with high ceilings, and in a really cool location next to the canal. The bathroom is very clean with a nice hot shower, and there is a lot of privacy too.

We had a lovely stay at Katja’s. The room is big and bright, well located, with lots of nice cafes and restaurants. Katja’s has always been reactive and willing to help. Definitely a great place to stay in Berlin !

Perfect little place at the perfect location to stay in Berlin. Close to bars, restaurants, the canal.. and still quiet enough to have some rest and quality time. Katja is a friendly host, knows the neighbourhood and offers the perfect balance between privacy and a warm welcome. Highly recommend!
Katja’s place was lovely and she was an incredibly friendly and helpful host. Extremely tidy, great bathroom and excellent location, highly recommend!

Katja could not have been nicer and more flexible with our arrival and departure. The location of her flat is unbelievable! Amazing walking distance from most things in Kreuzberg and absolutely charming in summer! Wish we had more time  - thank you Katja :)
Had a wonderful stay at Katja’s - the room is so spacious and light! Katja was super friendly and gave great recommendations!

I'm 100% satisfied with my stay in Berlin at Katja's place. First of all, the place is located in a very authentic and charming area of Kreuzberg. There are a lot of beautiful streets in walking distance and it was also accessible to anywhere in Berlin for sightseeing. The flat is exactly looking as shown in photos and it was kept tidy in general. The response of the host is quick for any need and she was very kind and flexible. Highly recommended!!

Very vibrant neighborhood. Love it.
The bathroom is very maintained and supplied. You can literally find everything here.

A cozy room in a calm, yet vibrant area of Berlin. There are many small cafes and restaurants around, specifically the Italian restaurant next to the apartment is authentic. Katja was very helpful and replied fast.

The place feels like you’re in a private apartment. It has its own entrance and bathroom and it feels really private. The apartment has very high ceilings, so the room feels even larger.
The neighborhood is a very good choice, friendly, communicative, lively, full of many good cafes, shops and even a market every Tuesday and Saturday.
Katja told us about that, so not only that she’s super nice, she has some very good recommendations!
Such a wonderful stay in a fantastic area! We didn't want to leave. Katja was so hospitable and went above any other Airbnb host I've had before. Very present.

Katja was a lovely and welcoming host who waited for us downstairs upon our arrival the first night in Berlin. The place was extremely clean, very spacious and comfortable. The highlight of the place was the location being extremely well connected and a beautiful lively neighbourhood with lots of restaurants. Thank you Katja ❤️
Fantastic stay and location - we loved our time! When we come back to Berlin we know where to stay!
A tasteful apartment with helpful hosts, I would recommend this apartment fully. In a great neighborhood, blocks from the metro. Clean, bright, and beautiful. Just be ready for lots of stairs!
Perfect flat, perfect host. Superb located near downtown Berlin, and just a few steps from the metro station. Very clean and nicely decorated apartment.

Hallo, we had a great experience here. Location was right near a train station which allowed us to go EVERYWHERE around Berlin! The apartment is beautiful even more so than the photos show. It's at the top of 4 floors of stairs which was Alitalia tricky some nights.
It's has everything you need for a comfortable stay we will be back so DANKE X

Rainer and Nikola was very helpful in getting us to the loft. our train was delayed, and he was patient, buzzed us in, helped us with our bags, and showed us around the place. ryanair lives right next door, where he informed of us a lot of local spots. Nini e Pettirosso (pizza and pasta) was a great recommendation, and he also directed us towards the old airport, templehofer field. on a very hot day he came by with watermelon. on top of the amazing hospitality, it is also only a few blocks from both the s and u bahn (local transit).

Rainer was a great host, and his place was exactly what we needed! Rainer was very quick to respond to questions leading up to our stay, and also offered advice on the best ways to get around the city, as well as restaurants, things to do, etc. The location is great - it's only a few blocks walk from the train station that will get you anywhere you need to go in the city. We had a wonderful stay and would highly recommend Rainer's place to any traveler. It was a wonderful experience!

Rainer's loft became our little home during our time in Berlin. It's a bit of a trek to the 5th floor but once you get up there it's nice and peaceful. Everything was clean and worked as described. Rainer's communication was flawless. The area is pretty grungey but has lots of little cool restaurants, bars and galleries if you know where to look (be sure to check out Ranier's list of things to do). All in all, we'd definitely recommend Rainer's place, as long as you're not too old to climb that many stairs :)

Very nice apartment in an eclectic location. It's not a very touristy area which was great for us but there is still plenty to see. Our host Nico was very friendly and helpful.  We hope to return soon!
Great location close to public transport. Perfect spot for a couple. We had some issues with hot water but they were sorted.

Rainer's place is lovely - perfect for a trip with a few pals. Really clean, comfy bed and cosy little studio. Close to train station and a nice part of town with plenty of interesting places to eat. Would recommend!
Enjoyed our stay. It's a very nice apartment and it was very useful to be able to park for free in the street of the apartment.

Great location in Neukolln, great neighbourhood with a few nice bars right around the corner. Close to the metro too, only 30 mins to the airport. Rainer is a very responsive host who made it all so easy for us to check in and check out. Clean.

What a fabulous place! In such a cool and we'll connected area of Berlin. You get a true Berlin experience at Rainer's place. Take all of his restaurant recommendations too - he never led us astray ;) the apartment was clean, comfortable,  very quiet at night, just perfect. Highly,highly recommend!

We had a lovely stay at Rainer’s place- it was such a warm and cosy loft space with a very comfortable bed! Perfect combination of quiet and relaxing flat within really easy reach of cool areas of berlin and the centre. Would recommend :)
Absolutely lovely! Clean and super easy to find. Be prepared for a hike up the stairs, but if that doesn't bother you than it's nothing to worry about.

Thank you Rainer for your hospitality and direction, we spent three beautiful days in Berlin.
The apartment is nice, clean and comfortable.

The appartment is very cosy, well located (very close to transports) and well-equipped. The neighbourhood is lively yet quiet and there are loads of coffee shops and groceries nearby. Rainer is a great host : well organized (the instructions sheet was of great help) and always available to answer our questions. Se highly recommend his place for a great stay in Berlin !

We liked this apartamneto. Sleeping by observing the sky through the windows above the bed was a unique experience. We have indicated this apartment to our friends.  We spent a week as locals. Really very good . Thank you !   Mônica

Nice cosy little room. Facilities were great, with everything you need. I struggled with the WiFi, the bandwidth available was really low, and so I wasn’t able to do some work that I needed to do. That might have been a temporary problem though.

It’s was a pleasure to stay in Rainer’s apartment. Interior was nice and cozy. We had everything that we needed - from blankets to coffee. Location is near U-Bahn and S-Bahn stations, so it took us about 20 minutes to get to city center.
However, there were problems with hot water (Rainer helped us to fix them) and it was cold in the apartment - heating didn’t work.
Despite that, we really enjoyed our stay :)
well located near an S and U  bahn station, supermarkets and coffee shops. Great base from which to explore Berlin.
Absolutely great space! Super stylish, very comfortable bed. Check in was super simple, Rainer provided really amazing stepby step instructions.
The apartment is exactly like the pictures, very clean and cozy! The host is very helpful and friendly. We recommend this place!
A perfect airbnb for a short stay in Berlin. Everything looked neat, a small problem with the shower head got fixed immediately and the communication went perfectly smooth. Thanks Rainer!

Rainer was really responsive and helpful, the apartment itself was good and had everything we needed the only downside were the stairs but we knew about that before hand! Got slightly easier as we got used to it haha. Lovely wine bar round the corner and easy public transport.

The apartment was very clean and nice, matched the description and pictures. Good location close to public transport, restaurants, grocery stores and Tempelhofer feld. Everything went smoothly, thank you! 😊

A great place to stay in Berlin in a quiet part of the neighbourhood. Rainer is a great host and is very attentive. The black-out blinds in the flat make this a great place to rest after you've explored the Berlin nightlife! I would stay here again for sure
Everything was great! Rainer was very responsive, and the house itself was exactly as described. The location is excellent, as it is very close to both the S-Bahn and U-Bahn
A really comfortable, bright and airy apartment. The stairs, as described in the listing, are not for the faint hearted.
Beautiful flat in a perfect location. Close to transport and park, loads of beautiful restaurants nearby. Loved it.

Really cool apartment in the mixed area of Kreuzberg. Close to U-bahn and other transportation. Nice welcome and not impossible to negotiate the hours and such. The pictures are real and self explanatory.

A nice place when you are with friends but unfortunately I wouldn't recommend this place to families as the area has some "shady elements"...

I stayed in this spacious apartment for 3 nights with a friend.
A couple of negatives: firstly, the floor felt sticky/dirty - we had to walk around in our shoes instead. Secondly, it was unfortunate that there was a house party upstairs during one of the nights and even though I was very tired, I couldn't sleep until 4plus am due to the loud music and people constantly walking up and down the stairs.
Do also note that, as mentioned under the 'Description' section, the toilet is located outside the apartment - which can be a bit inconvenient. Other than that, a pretty pleasant experience.

Had a lovely time in this spacious apartment. We found a market nearby and enjoyed cooking on the gas range stove to save a few Euros. We even managed to make use of the ping pong table during our stay. I would recommend this space for anyone looking for an affordable open space in Berlin!

Everything went very smoothly, the apartment was very nice and we really enjoyed our stay in this studio. The place is in very good location, everything is close.  I would definetly recommend Floccuses studio to others!
Perfect location, communication and setup. Incredible amount of space for just two people. Would totally recommend to anyone and we'd likely stay here again if in Kreuzberg.
Great space and matches the images online. Be aware the toilets are located outside in an ice box. Communication pretty poor from the hosts.
This is a fantastic base for a Berlin holiday. We stayed here with our 2 teens. And everyone enjoyed it.

Lovely quirky loft in a quirky neighbourhood. There's a high chair but I'd say it's much better for adults than families. Great to hear they're refurbing with a new inside toilet - it being on the public landing was a bit of a shock especially on cold nights! Host was lovely though initial comms / check in had some hiccups. Very friendly and adaptable though when we reached him. Handy location and highly recommend friendly coffee shop across the road who gave us great local tips and insights!

Our stay at Traktor's flat was very pleasant. The space is simply great, it's large, equipped with beautiful furniture and a fully equiped kitchen. At night the flat is quiet as it does not face the street but is located in the patio. The communication with the host and the check in were straight forward. The U-Bahn stop is only about 3 minutes (on foot) away. I can heartily recommend this loft to anyone who wants to visit Berlin!
Great location in Kreuzberg, modern/upgraded clean apartment. There are two showers and bathrooms which are nice, I would highly recommend for groups 4-6.

The flat was spacious, bright, airy, clean and had all the amenities a group of friends would need while staying for a few nights in Berlin.
The landlord was very friendly, provided quick and accurate responses to all our questions and was flexible in regards to check in-out times.
I highly recommend this flat and would definitely stay there again in the future.
The flat is as the pictures show it, lots of light, great decoration and design. Additionally it is well located and very confortable. And Léonie is just lovely!! 200% recommendable!
Our stay in Berlin has been complicated, but thanks to Leonie, we found comfort at the apartment, which was perfect for cocooning and relaxing. See you!!!!

Fun apartment with a lot of light. Great to enjoy Berlin Kreuzberg. Anyhow,  the photos over promise the quality of the furniture. Additionally, building,  patio and stairs are not taken care of and somewhat dirty.  A bit overpriced

Thank you so much for having us - the space was awesome, perfect for our group of six! Very spacious and we loved the flexible furniture, and the two bathrooms!
Thanks again for the flexible check out time - much needed after a weekend exploring Berlin's nightlife ;)
Amazing place - would highly recommend.
xoxo

The place was okay, but nothing very exciting. We stayed at the apartment 2 nights in total. They nights were quite chilly and I messaged to the host about the heating, which wasn’t working. I asked the host, if she could tell where I can find the button to turn the heating on. The host said to turn the radiators on 5 and to be patient, because the building is old. We been patient enough but the heating hasn’t started to work at all. I messaged if she could fix it, but than I haven’t receive any messages back at all. I am disappointed, because she could tell the truth about it. Instead of saying to be patient she could offer an extra heater or some extra blankets... instead of that we all got very ill.
It is a nice place to stay, and the landlord being super nice and easy to communicate. But there's a small noise when you step on the floor

Great location, large and cozy apparent, perfect for group of friends
Host was very communicative

This apartment is great! We enjoyed every moment. 6 of us stayed here and it was ideal (as long as you don't need to much privacy because there aren't separate rooms as such). The apartment is really bright with lots of natural light and has various amenities that can be used. It was also a super nice touch to provide coffee tokens for the coffee shop across the road.
The only reason I did not give 5 stars is because the floor is really creaky but otherwise, it's great.
Will definitely stay here again!

Very cool design warehouse style apartment, great for a group of friends. Fantastic location near a lot of the action. Only caveat was that there are no ‘rooms’ only wooden partitions so very little privacy in the whole place.
Key was a great home base for a quick vacation in Berlin. Close to the metro, good restaurants, and a short taxi to all of the good bars and clubs.
Awesome apartment to spend a weekend with friends. Apartment is just exactly as shown on AirbnB. Would recommend 10/10.
Stayed here for work with a colleague and was perfect - great location, great facilities, perfect working space. Will definitely stay here again.

very good stay. location great, style perfect.. very cool. awesome to have good social areas
one thing is noise within the flat, e.g. whilst usng bathroom / kitchen and others sleeping. for us this was no problem though !

Looks exactly like the pictures. Great neighborhood, absolutely loved the area. There were lots of food and bars nearby. Located ~5 minutes away was a train station. This line connected easily with the rest of Berlin and the airport.

Spaceious loft in the middle of a bubbly quarter of Berlin. Crowdy area but quietly located loft (we love that!). Great restaurants of all flavour and cultures at walking distance. Free parking in the area of the loft. Close to two metro-stations. City-life as we like it!

I recently stayed at Key Loft 02 for three days, and it was an exceptional experience. The booking and check-in process was really quick and easy, making the start of my trip hassle-free. Although I did not meet the host in person, they were incredibly responsive and flexible via Airbnb’s chat.
The space itself was amazing and well-kept, matching the property listing description perfectly. The amenities provided, including Wi-Fi, a kitchen, and a TV, were great. However, the Wi-Fi coverage was spotty in certain areas of the Airbnb, which was a minor inconvenience.
The location of the property was ideal, being pretty close to the metro station, which made it easy to get around. The neighborhood was quiet and close to a couple of grocery stores and cafés, adding to the convenience.
Overall, I would definitely recommend staying at this place. I give it a full 4.5 stars!
This tastefully and creatively designed apartment is very comfortable, and a great atmosphere. An inspiring place in a lively neighborhood!

Great location. The appartment was ideal for a group of friends. Great decoration lots of amenities, super easy to check in plus allowed to leave luggage and also check in earlier. Also super clean, warm and stylish place. All in all value for money totally recommended for a group of 4+
Nadine provided a fun well presented loft, with character quirks. Great communication from Nadine. Handy with supermarket close by. Great Middle Eastern restaurant around tweaks.

The flat is gorgeous and nicely decorated. Can‘t complain about anything really. Nadine was very responsive and helpful.
I can absolutely reccommend this place.

The apartment was roomy, very clean and comfortable. The kitchen had everything we needed for our stay. The neighborhood is very quiet and close to restaurants, shopping and underground. Brendon and Marvin were helpful and quick to reply when we had questions.
I highly recommend this apartment.

A cool, minimalist, comfortable, convenient apartment, greatly liocated near local shopping area and several metro stops, fast internet, great heating, good kitchen and coffee-maker. Highly recommended. Check-in well-organisdd and stressfree.

Overall communication and checkin-out process was simple.  Juan personally welcomed me at the flat and showed me around.  This was very nice after a long journey.  Flat was very clean, bed and living area were quite comfortable.  Good location to grocery stores, restaurant/coffee shops.  Public transportation was convenient.  Enjoyed me stay and would recommend.

We have an amazing experience in Brendon's apartment. It has all that you need for a comfortable stay.
The location is great - a lot of public transport so you go anywhere without the problems.
Highly recommended!

Thanks Simon for being such a great host. My mom truly enjoyed staying at your place. She said it was spotless and very well cared of. Communication and handover went smoothly. Will recommend again. Cheers

This flat was just fantastic, i've been to Berlin several times, and this was hands down the best listing i've stayed at. The host was very helpful with all the information and check-in and check-out was super smooth. I will definitely recommend this place to anyone visiting Berlin and will make sure to book it again next time i'm there myself. The place itself is very spacious, modern. comfortable, and close to restaurants and public transport.

Awesome Berlin pad, very comfortable and everything provided , even laundry liquid and coffee pods! A great pad to stay in and really close to public transport and awesome cafes and restaurants. Highly recommend to stay here. Great hosts and communication.

Communication was excellent with the host. Photos depict the apartment accurately. Bed is really comfortable and because the bedroom faces the interior courtyard it is really quiet. Great location in Kreuzberg - fun neighborhood. Easy access. Everything you need for cooking meals in. Good kitchen space. It is right at street level so the front windows (which go floor to ceiling) are decoratively covered so natural light still gets in. Good location, plenty of living space for my daughter and me.

Wonderful location, close to many restaurants and shops.  Short walk to mass transit connecting easily to all parts of the city.  The apartment was spotlessly clean, and quite spacious for two people.  One slight quirk -- bathroom door is somewhat see-through.  Some traveling companions might find that awkward.  We had a wonderful time in Berlin and would definitely recommend this apartment.

Excelente!!!
As usual It was a big pleasure to be hosted by s&m. This is a super nice apartment with a very special original art decoration situated in the most cool area of Berlin. The apartment itself is very well equipped with all you could need including a good washing/drier machine and a small terrace. I totally recommend it!

Adorable place, stylishly decorated. Very cozy and comfortable with all the basics one needs. Communication with host was fast and clear and they always did what they could to accommodate my various needs. Excellent location near great restaurants, several subway lines, and shopping. Staying here really enhanced my experience in Berlin!

This is a great place.  Very roomy.  Lots of good local facilities - for food and other shopping - restaurants  - with good transport links for the whole of Berlin.  We really enjoyed our stay and look forward to the opportunity to return.

Check in was easy and we were closer to public transport which made exploring other areas of Berlin a breeze.  Apartment was on ground floor with Windows directly on the street but the frosted glass and blackout curtains gave us enough privacy for our comfort.
Wonderful apartment in a very trendy area. The place is very nice and comfortable with all the necessary for small or long stays. Totally recommended!

easy access from street, that made me feel like I were in a house. The backyard is also excellent and charming. Communication and check In were smooth. The bathroom is very efficient but too small for tall persons like me. The sink in the bedroom helps a bit.

This apartment was exactly as advertised. Great communication, clean, amazing location near many small, interesting, shops and restaurants. So many nice touches in the apartment like Berlin themed DVDs and lots of guidebooks to use while we were there.

Decent and clean apartments. Modern interior. Convenient to metro, restaurants, shops, Park all nearby. The apartments have a courtyard with a Playground, which is a plus for those with children. We liked everything. The only thing that spoiled our stay, is that the kitchen stove broke and we could not cook to eat, and with us was a daughter who is two years old. The owner arrived quickly, but unfortunately he did not solve the problem and did not offer an alternative, such as buying the cheapest and simplest electric tile. This is the only thing that disappointed us. Everything else was great and we recommend these apartments to other guests.

Spacious and comfortable ground floor apartment with a garden out back in the hof. Roll down shutters on all windows and doors make it feel very secure.
Well located, a stone's throw from Hassenheide park, the metro many cafés, restaurants, bars and bakeries. A great choice on the edge of Kreuzberg and Neukolln.

Really nice apartment. It was big and well maintained. The location suited us perfect: close to restaurants, bars, shops and u-bahn as well a really nice park.
Would stay here again, and hope to do so soon.
Nice place, especially if you’re looking to work somewhere — fast internet and it’s a really quiet area. Host was super communicative. Cheers!

Quiet apartment right around the corner from a amazing vegan/veg restaurant: Con Tho and Coffee Shop with amazing Coffee ( Heart space) Even though its right at street level its super quiet if you let down the shutters at night. The pullout Sofa Bed is very comfortable! Communication with Simon was fast,friendly&easy.  Thank you!

We loved the place.  It was in a neighborhood we love, it was clean, spacious, and secure.  It is a genuine pleasure to deal with professionals who love hosting their guests.  We look forward to staying at this place again when we are back in Berlin.  Thank you!

Beautifully appointed apartment situated 5 mins from Hermannplatz U station and many bars, restaurants, parks and shops. We stayed as a group of 3 using the sofa bed in the living/kitchen area and was really helped by having the outside terrace in the rear courtyard. All in all, a great apartment in a great city!
Amazing stay! Beautiful location and the hosts were so sweet and responsive. 100% book your trip here!
Loved the location in Kreuzberg and found the apartment a fantastic base for Berlin! Quiet street but great transport access with plenty to see and do nearby.
The location was great, the place was nice and clean and easy to find. Host where very responsive to messages and were very clear with the instructions.
Great and really big apartment.  bed was so comfy and place was really quiet. would definitely stay again
My third time here and it just reinforces how great of a place it is. Fast and friendly communications, great area and everything you need for a Berlin stay.
Ok, unpersonal housing in a great area of the city. Unfortunately at ground level, so expect general street noise etc.

I had a superb three week stay in Berlin. The apartment was a brilliant location to be able to experience life in a Berlin neighbourhood. Great location to explore both Kreuzberg and Neukölln easily on foot. There were also good transport links to all central locations and places of interest across the city.
I was really impressed by how spotlessly clean the apartment was on arrival. The instructions for checking into the property and the manual for how everything works in the property were very clear.
Simon was a brilliant host. Very kind and friendly. He made me feel welcome at all times. He responded promptly to questions that I had with clear advice. I would highly recommend staying in this apartment or any others that he owns in Berlin. Thanks so much!

We had a great stay!
The host was super responsive and accommodated both an early check-in and a late checkout. The apartment was really nice, and super central as well.

The cottage was lovely, super clean and nicely furnished and has a fantastic view to the water! We stayed three nights and would return any time. The hosts were always fast in responding, very flexible for hand-over and return time of the keys and we felt warmly welcome. Also, the location of the cottage in Köpenick is nice if you are looking for a calm neighborhood with plenty of restaurants, cozy cafes, or if you just want to enjoy nature along the river/lake. Being by car, we were lucky to always find a parking spot very close to the house.

Amazing little house by the lake in a family friendly neighbourhood, that looks exactely like the pictures. The familie Roch's house is perfect for tranquility and peace while still enjoying Berlin's particular lifestyle. There's great little restaurants near the house with reasonable prices. A tram station is reachable within a 5 min walk. Gorgeous view from the house at any given time of the year. We were two students looking for a timeout from stress and this lakehouse felt like therapy ! We went back home feeling resourced !

Brilliant place. So good to experience the local area and also so close to Berlin and the major attractions. The Kopenick castle and local pubs are a must. Including the Washhausen at the end of the street. Awesome hospitality.

What a fabulous place to stay in !
Perfectly located for us to connect on trams to my nephew and have an adventure into Spandau. Pretty and peaceful with opportunities to eat out, drink locally and facilities to make ourselves simple breakfasts to eat in and watch the activity on the river.
Thoroughly enjoyed our stay , thanks for allowing us early check in xx

Very friendly hosts. The place is idyllic and beautiful, well kept. The only downside: My partner and I were really banking on the wifi working. I would double-check with the host if they've gotten a router in/closer to the apartment since, and to run a speed check if that's something you care about.

We had a great stay. The house is perfect for families with children: large and bright living room, modern and well-equipped kitchen, and comfortable bedrooms. Also, the house is a great base from which to explore Berlin. The subway and train stations are a short walk away from the house, and once there it's a quick ride to the city. You can also rent bicycles near the house and easily ride to the city and back. Highly recommended!

An apartment that feels like a house. Large windows, lots of light, in a very quiet and airy place. We liked to spend time downstairs, the open space kitchen, the dining area and the living room all together make you call friends and cook at home :) we were also impressed by their collection of vinyls. a great family.
Best flat to stay in Berlin with family, comfy, big spaces, great light and easy to access the city from. By far one of the most beautiful flats I have ever stayed in!

Wolfgang and Ester were very helpful and friendly and went out of their way to make sure our arrival and settling in to their flat was smooth. Their flat is in a lovely, leafy quiet neighbourhood within 2-3 minutes walk to a bus stop and 10 minute walk to two transport hubs with S-Bahn, U-Bahn and trams. All the neighbours within the building were helpful and friendly and there is a reasonable selection of cafes, shops, restaurants and a supermarket within easy walking distance. The flat itself was cosy and comfortable and perfect for our group of five! We would definitely recommend Wolfang and Ester's flat as a great base to  explore Berlin, with its easy access to all the central tourist sites and great neighbourhood to stay in.

Cozy apartment, large space. For five - very convenient. The kitchen had everything you need. Communication with the owners was very pleasant and fast! Sometimes the neighbor's cat looked into the yard for a visit :)

Met by Carmen ( the owners representative ) as planned at the apartment. She showed us around the apartment but seemed to have only a limited knowledge of the bars / restaurants / cafes in the immediate area recommending instead a trip into the city centre. In fact there is a perfectly acceptable Italian restaurant less than 100 metres down the street and an excellent café by the metro station, just a short distance away.
Great space!  Open and comfortable.  The location was wonderful and close to everything.  A little loud with the construction outside. Nice apartment with character.
Great place, nice neighborhood and really pretty. Near public transport and nightlife is only a walk away.

The apartment was spacious, impeccable and super Berlin-trendy. It was only a few blocks from the subway and the location is great, I was close to everything I needed. Sounds like a silly thing but I really liked that it had cabled so I could listen to the news in the morning. This apartment is great also if you need to spend some time inside. It is spacious, has a big table and space where you can sit and work. Wifi also worked very well. I would stay here again.

Very much enjoyed this comfortably and stylishly decorated apartment in a conveniently located part of this fascinating city.  Close to major sites and lively districts but thankfully quiet at most times.  Green courtyard in the center of the building is an added plus!  Highly recommended to all (but especially so to dog owners bring their pet).
Fantastic Location! Great check in and response from Carmen. Great decor and very spacious. A short walk to museum island and great restaurants.

Great looking apartment in a central location. Not a particularly functional layout with the second bed dominating the living room with an uncomfortable couch that is falling apart.
Everything else is fine.
Great place to stay in a good location. Daniele and Patrizia are very helpful. Easy to find parking place, but it cost 2 euro pr hour in daytime.

Incredible spot. We could not have been happier to rest our heads here in this stylish, and accommodating apartment. It's huge - lots of room (probably enough for 2 couples and a 5th to crash to the couch!) - and our hosts were endlessly accommodating to everything we needed. Close to public transportation (bus, the U subway station). The coffeeshop directly across the street was a bonus - very easy to snag breakfast every morning. Relatively quiet, only thing one might consider is that it used to be a storefront on a street that sees some morning commute action during weekdays - so if you sleep in the front room - maybe bring earplugs if you are on vacation and want to sleep in. We thought the infamous "kitchen shower" was hilarious, and it never posed an issue with our group's dynamics (someone taking a shower, and someone needing something from the kitchen). This place is awesome and will book again, and recommend to friends.
Outstanding location, we thoroughly enjoyed our stay at this stylish, spacious apartment. It reflected Berlin very well!
Don't expect any helpful tourist information in the apartment and don't expect privacy when using both bathroom facilities.

The location for this apartment is great. There’s tons of food options at every turn and a few beer gardens very close by. It’s less than a 20 minute walk to some of the main attractions in the heart of Berlin and has easy access to all modes of transportation.

Absolutely great spot. Location is perfect with easy access to transit in any direction. The apartment has plenty of room with plenty of privacy. We were traveling as a couple with another friend and we had plenty of our own space and having two full bathrooms is a luxury. As a bonus the amenities are all updated and beautiful. I would definitely recommend it!

Daniele's place was great! The location was central, with many restaurants and fun areas nearby. The apartment itself was very clean and had all the amenities. Upon check in, we were missing towels but Daniele was extremely swift to provide us with the necessary items. Overall, it was a great place and we would definitely live here again during our next visit to Berlin!

Great place to stay, close to the U-Bahn which makes exploring the city very accesible! The appartment is quiet, the beds are comfy and the kitchen is spacious enough to cook. Will definitely come back when visiting Berlin again!

Natalie was such a great host. Her apartment is beautiful and in a great location - a 5 minute walk from the metro stop. She provided welcoming treats, like chocolate, water, and champagne, and even provided us with some pasta to make. There is plenty of space in the apartment, and if I had to travel to Berlin again, I would definitely be looking to book with Natalie. Awesome place, and awesome host. Couldn't have asked her to provide or do anything more, our visit was great.

We had such a fantastic stay at this amazing apartment in the heart of Prenzlauer Berg. Natalie's daughter Kati met us on arrival and was very welcoming to this homely Airbnb.
The beds are very comfortable and the renovated bathroom has a lovely warm shower. We had a blackout whilst there and Natalie was very responsive and helpful in helping us reset the hot water system.
The apartment is a short walk from both the train and trams, and is in a safe and vibrant neighbourhood. The pubs nearby are accommodating and it's super easy to get into any part of Berlin from the place.
Definitely recommended and a massive 5/5. Thank you Natalie and Kati!

This is a nice, clean place in a convenient location. Good guide books were available.
Host threatened to charge us an extra €50 for being "late" in spite of the fact that I had sent her my plane arrival times and sent someone to meet me even before I had landed.
Nice touch having fruits and goodies. An enjoyable stay.

The host was so nice and welcoming. She's available if you need her. The apartment was nice and clean. We maybe close to 30 but we were pretty excited about the bunk beds. Lol. Comfortable atmosphere.

We had a pleasant stay at this flat. First we were greeted by the host when we arrived, She was extremely nice and welcoming. She provided us with fruits, drinks and a great amount of local information. She thought of everything, she provided all essentials needed in the flat.   She was easy to communicate with and was always available when needed. She even met us when we checked out. Great host!!! The flat was exactly as described. Very new and clean.  The area is a great area, there is everything near by (restaurants, local markets, bus and train stations).  Will need to take public transportation to all major tourist attraction. close enough to all the tourist attractions but far enough from the mess.  Would recommend this flat and will stay again .

The place is wonderful. Very clean, fully equipped, brand new. All ingredients are there for a wonderful stay in Berlin. Public transport close by, nice restaurants in the direct vicinity. Natalie is a very friendly host. We felt welcome right away.

Natalie's place is a perfect place to discover Berlin with your family.
It is located in Prenzlauer Berg, near the S-PrenzlauerBerg and the tram (M2), only 15 minutes far from AlexanderPlatz.
The place was perfectly clean and totally the same as seen on the pictures. It was really confortable and totally adapted for a family of 4.
The communication with Natalie was fluid and perfect, she made everything to make us feel at home.
I highly recommend Natalie's place !

Natalie was an excellent host! She was quick to communicate and warmly greeted us at check in. The apartment is beautiful, both modern & cozy! It’s in a residential neighborhood which was nice to get a feel for living there. It is also located very close to public transportation. I will absolutely stay here again should I return to Berlin. It’s THE best Airbnb my husband and I have stayed in. Thanks Natalie!

Great apartment, and very well located. Natalie was a good host.
Only problems were we only had a single key and a very early checkout time

Stylish, clean and comfortable. A lovely place to stay in a trendy part of Berlin, with some great bars and restaurants within walking distance, but also very close to S Bahn, Tram and Bus stops if you want to travel to other parts of the city.

Natalie’s home was everything we expected and more! The location is about a 5 min walk to the train station and the home is sparkling clean! It really had a special feel and the interior was very nice. We would love to visit again someday! We also really appreciated the little snacks and drinks as well! Thank you

Couldn’t have asked for a better homebase in Berlin. Prenzlauer Berg has so many amazing restaurants, cafes and shops to offer just steps away from the apartment. There are many public transit options within a couple minutes’ walking distance as well. With the Ringbahn directly accessible from the closest S-Bahn station, I had such an easy time navigating throughout the rest of the city.
The apartment itself is quiet, cozy, and well-equipped. Natalie was the perfect host and provided great recommendations, responded quickly, and left thorough guidance. Would recommend a thousand times over!
A perfect, tidy and peaceful flat in a lovely part of the city.  Host was extremely responsive and friendly.

The apartment was perfectly clean and has all the necessary facilities. We really like the entrance through the private backyard, cozy vibe in the apartment, and quiet street—you can comfortably sleep with open windows. Natalie was very friendly and responded very fast. Thank you!

Great local neighborhood, and apartment is only 1 block from tram and trains so great starting location for exploring entire city. Natalie was able to accommodate our early morning arrival and provided helpful information and excellent local restaurant tips.  Very comfortable unit with superb bathroom. We thoroughly enjoyed our 5 night stay!

What a great apartment in Berlin! We felt right at home and loved the easy access to Berlin’s fantastic transit system.
Loved exploring the local restaurants as well as easily getting around to Berlin’s myriad sights.
The apartment was the best provisioned AirBnB I have stayed at. From spices (and coffee!) in the cabinet to diapers and an assortment of shampoos and shaving cream, we felt like we had walked into a fully stocked home.
One note - being 6’4” (193cm) tall, I was a little worried about the bed being too short (it has head and foot boards and someone else commented on it), but I found it fine for two. Another 2” (5cm) taller, and it might get noticeable, but it was fine for me. Comfy mattress, too!
Natalie was super responsive - a model host.

The location of Natalie's apartment was very convenient, since we spent most of our time in Prenzlauer Berg with family.
The apartment was cozy and had all necessary amenities. We loved it and will be back in future.

An outstanding apartment and an outstanding host — we had the perfect stay for two weeks. It’s a super-convenient location with subway, tram, cafes, restaurants, bars, grocery stores, bakeries, ATMs, parks, flower shops so close by. The apartment is modern, spacious, quite well-equipped, and just like the photos. Natalie was very responsive and helpful.

Excellent room and excellent host! Would definitely come back here. Parwana was very attentive and welcoming. The floor mattresses are quite uncomfortable though, but for a quick stay they’re more than fine!

Excellent price during fair in Berlin. Clean functional room with big TV.
Unfortunately it's a bit noisy, but the location is perfect and close to exhibition place.
A bit pricy. Probably due to the fair ITB. It is a bit noisy towards the street so bring ear plugs. Otherwise all fine and clean and a big TV.
The air bnb is really beautiful and you have a lot of space and a huge TV. The flat is next to a street and therefore a little bit noisy but it didn't disturbed me.

Nice place but just next a psychiatric hospital so there are some noises at night.
The apartment is nice but some equipments are a bit decrepit (towels, cookware..).
There's also no possibility to open most of the windows so quite hard to evacuate the smells.
Also it's pity that the owner doesn't really have the airbnb mind as we didn't met him.
Fantastic place. I've stayed in many Airbnbs in Berlin - and this one is by far the best.

It is a very simple place, but all you need is there. Quite big. The shower is fine. I believe the place, especilaly the bed was clean, but it is hard to see with dark blue bed linen. I did not use the kitchen, so I cannot say anything about that. The neighborhood is not exiting, but ok. Berlin is exiting and interesting, and the U-Bahn line 7 is almost on the door step (Mierendorfplatz) .It looks like it is the host´s actual apartment, and not one of those places people buy to rent out, so there are all the things you would expect to find in someone´s home (i believe, i did´t check).

The apartment is super cute and close to a U-bahn station.
The neighborhood isn't exactly where all the sightseeing are, but from the U-bahn station you can go anywhere and reach everything within 20 minutes.
Communication with Benedikt was fast and effective.
Thank you!

The apartment was as described, in a quieter neighborhood outside of the busy city center. Spacious rooms, and clean facilities. The host was friendly and arranged a flexible check-in and check-out for us. Overall a nice experience!
A value-for-money-apartment very close to the U-bahn. There is a nice Ethiopian restaurant across the street. The apartment didn't feel very clean.
Great place to explore Charlottenburg. Benedikt's apartment is one of those with its own character. This is why I love staying in apartments and not in hotels.
Great place. Cosy, clean and very warm, it had underground heating! Martin was also very nice.

Perfect host. Martin has been very nice and helpful.
Le apartment is exactly as described and conformed to the pictures : very clean and full-equipped!
I warmly recommend this apartment.

The apartment is super clean and close to anything you need: places to visit, subway etc. The host is great and super friendly. Absolutely choice number one for families, couples and friends to party!
Appartment was great, clean and on a topspot. Would certainly recommend Martin's appartment.

Great value for money. Martins place is very nice,
clean and comfortable. Close to U-Bahnhof and situated in a quiet area fiber minutes walk from Potzdamer Platz. Martin is a nice guy, helpful and service minded. Next time I go to Berlin I will try to stay here.
Fantastic place and perfect location to explore Berlin! Martin was a great host, very helpful with directions and top places to go to. I absolutely recommend his studio! Thank you!

We had a great stay at this apartment. We arrived into Berlin quite late in the evening so it was so great for Martin to meet us there without any troubles. He gave us heaps of information and some great recommendations to try! Great location as well! Would Recommend to people looking for a place pretty central but not in the complete tourist "Hub" :)

Martin is a fantastic host!!  He was very helpful in explaining where attractions are in the city, and answered all of our questions. Martin's apt is in a good location and fit my group of 4 perfectly. I highly recommend staying with Martin

Martin was a top host and went above and beyond to make sure we had a great stay. Location was good for places to eat and it was only a short underground trip to get to nightlife and clubs. A great, comfortable apartment!

Martin, greeted us on arrival. Was very friendly and provided us with loads of information on best attractions and places to eat.
We had previously stated that we could be arriving earlier than the checking time and he was was there to meet us ( nothing was too much trouble)
The apartment was very clean and exactly like the description and photos.
Cannot recommend his accommodation enough, absolutely 100%

Stayed in Martin's place for a week. Location was exactly what we were after, close to transport and amenities but itself quite quiet.
Martin was a lovely host and gave us some top tips.
Flat was great and the heated bathroom floor was very welcome those cold mornings!

The studio apartment is awesome. There were only two of us but it can potentially sleep four comfortably. The wifi works well. It has everything you'd need to self cater and is great value for money. Martin was available to show us how everything works and answer any questions we had about the area and Berlin. Finally, the location is fantastic - walking distance from several conveniences and attractions. Doesn't get much better than this. Thanks Martin!

Everything was perfect in Martin's flat! Just as described, clean, comfortable bed, strong water pressure in shower. Martin was very accommodating with our late check in and even provided us a map of the town as well as useful tips. He was available 24/7 to help with any questions we had. The location to the flat is superb, just off the busy Potsdamer Platz in a quiet residential area. We would highly recommend it to anyone!
Martin the host was very helpful and easy to get hold of. His place is very clean and tidy and in a good location.
Martin's apartment is very well located, near Potsdamer platz. It's a lovely place, it's clean and there's everything you need! Thanks again.

Great spot right in Potzdamer Platz. Martin is a great host with a good knowledge of Berlin. Very short walk to the U and S bahns. We were also walking distance to a lot of cool buildings, museums, and memorials. Martin is great a communicating during your trip if you need anything. Would recommend this place to anyone traveling to Berlin.

Both the place and Martin are fantastic. Martin is so kind. The place is located near metro station and you can go directly everywhere. Also you can walk to many places because the home is located in good place. I recommend this place.
Martin is a fantastic host, super friendly and easy going. The room was perfect, and in a great location central to most historic and popular areas of Berlin at an awesome price.
Martin's flat is very clean, the position is central and close to the metro station. Martin was waiting for us when we arrived and also came to ask if everything was ok before we were leaving.
Walking distance to potzdamer platz and the brandonberg gate was really nice to stay at Martin's place. Would definitely recommend.
Martin's place is close to EVERYTHING!  We walked to see all the major sights in the area and never had any problems. It was just wonderful.

You won't be disappointed with this super little apartment in a great location in Berlin. Only minutes walk from several of the major attractions, including the Brandenburg Gate, Holocaust Memorial, Checkpoint Charlie and Tiergarten, this apartment is the perfect base to explore Berlin. Martin was a great host and made sure we had everything we needed for our four-day stay. We'll definitely be back.

If you are looking at this posting, book it immediately! Martin is awesome and the place is in a great location. Very close to public transportation and Martin truly went the extra mile for us during our stay. Would highly recommend!!!

Great location, major tourist spots are within walking distance, trans stop is very close to the apartment.
Matin is great host, very helpful, he even arranged a taxi for us on our way to airport.

We're been traveling and staying in Airbnb's for a month and martin is our favorite host! Super friendly. Took time to get us oriented to the city and transportation, recommmeded a great place to eat, answered all'our questions and was available.
The place was in a great location, a few steps from the U. Easy to get anywhere.
Roomy, comfortable space. The biggest we've had - highly recommend. Julee
This is a great apartment that felt very good value for money. Has all the amenities you’d need, and was lovely to come back to after a busy day. Recommended!

Martins place was perfect for us.  It was quiet and peaceful but within walking distance to train stations and many of the tourist attractions.  It was great to have cooking/food heating facilities after almost 2 weeks in hotels.  The unit was well equipped and it was good to meet Martin on arrival. Would recommend!!

Great apartment.  Martin was always available and always obliging.  He even printed our boarding passes for us, and offered tips and suggestions throughout our trip.  The apartment itself is centrally located and within walking distance to shops and all amenities.  Great place to stay for a trip to Berlin.
Martin's place was very clean, central to Brandenburg Gate, and he had amazing hospitality and made us feel at home while we were in Berlin!

Martin’s flat was great! Perfect location with the train station close by and the flat is very spacious and comfortable with all the amenities you need. Would highly recommend and would stay again for sure!
Convenient location and ok value for money, good for group with up to 4 sleeping places but not much beyond that
Great place to stay-in. Close to all of the historical sites in Berlin and close to the subway and train stations to get to farther places! Martin is super helpful, haven’t ever had a better host
Great location in Berlin! Very clean apartment. Martin is very helpful and accommodating to guests. He offered great tips on restaurants, getting around, and directions.

We travelled with a toddler and Martin’s apartment is very comfortable.The situation is good, near the Postdamer plaz, subway station and bus stop.
Martin is very kind, we spent a great time!
Apartment was so cozy and stylish, with great location, amazing hospitality was more than i could imagine. totally recommend for everyone who wants to spend awesome holidays.

This place is awesome! it has everything from towels to a full kitchen to a hair dryer! close to public transport, a market, tourist sights, a park, etc. Martin is great! he is understanding and fast at communicating!  would stay here again!

Martins studio apartment is great, awesome size for a small group (3 in ours) good amenities, fantastic location, really close to the U and S bahns. Great selection of local restaurants around the corner. Martin answered any queries we had immediately and gave great local advice. Highly recommend Martins studio apartments.
The apartment is in a very good location - strongly recommended. Martin is very easy to communicate with and a helpfull host. We´ll come back!

Martin’s apartment is a great place to stay if you’re looking to do a city break in Berlin. It has good access to several tourist hotspots in East Berlin.
It also has good access to Central Berlin and Alexanderplatz through the nearby subway system. It’s also perfectly easy to walk there within roughly 20-30 minutes.

The apartment is situated really closed to the City center. We were
Able to walk to most places. Even though it’s on the ground level and next to the road, the neighbourhood was really peaceful and quiet, Five star for advising us the 1st timers what to do and how to get around. Will definitely stay there again when I visit Berlin
Martin’ house is much better than I expected.  Thank Tim for the warm reception and clear description.  We will come back again if a chance to Berlin again.
Best Airbnb experience so far,  very nice and comfortable place and a very warm welcome from Martin's son.
The location I'd perfect for all things touristy. We were also given great recommendations to restaurants and navigating the city.
Convenient location, apartment had everything we needed, and Martin was super responsive in all communication. Would definitely stay here again!
Had a very nice and cozy stay . The room was very spacy and had all the equipment we needed for our trip in berlin! Lovely

What a great place to stay! Clean, exactly like the description said, so near to Postdamer Platz, with a really good public transport system and a really helpful host. Definitely a good option to stay in Berlin.

Martin was a fantastic host. His apartment was conveniently situated to several bus and rail stops. It was very quiet and we felt quite safe.  We had plenty of space for the two of us.  Terrific value & location!
Very nice & quiet place. We were there only a few hours, but the place was comfortable & clean. The location is convenient as it’s close to stations.
Martin is a very nice host. The stay was perfect! Everything went smooth and we had no problems! We can just recommend staying at his apartment!
Accommodation was as described and close to public transport. Neat and tidy. Thanks for the stay!

We loved our brief stay in Prenzlauerberg. The apartment is extremely convenient, spacious, and well-appointed. Werner was a very accommodating host, and we appreciate his generous spirit. Highly recommended!

This is a beautiful, well-kept apartment in a great location of Berlin. The host was great, very helpful and when a door became jammed in the apartment, he sent someone round immediately to fix it. The apartment was clean and in a good condition. There are plenty of bars and restaurants within a stones throw of the apartment. A tram line is about a 2 minute walk away and the underground is 10 minutes walk. I would definitely recommend this apartment to anyone staying in Berlin

Werner's apartment is lovely - large, clean and located in a great neighbourhood. Werner was easy to communicate with and so helpful, and I would definitely recommend staying with him if you are in Berlin.
Great location, it was as described, host was amazing sat down with us and showed us some great places to visit, we had an amazing time would recommend this place!

Werner and his place were awesome! He was punctual and very helpful when we arrived. The location was perfect. It was residential and quiet, but a short walk to every kind of restaurant public transportation.  I would recommend this place to any one!

We had a great stay at Werner's apartment. It was perfect for our group of six and the location is excellent. A fascinating neighbourhood with plenty to see and places to eat. Werner was a great host and helped us get to the apartment after the tram was disrupted by a street protest just as we were arriving! He provided lots of useful information and advice and check in was very efficient. Highl recommended.

Werner met us and gave us a warm and informative welcome. The location was perfect and we really enjoyed the local bars and restaurants, as well as the flat's proximity to the transport services. The accommodation was spacious, comfortable and clean, with good facilities. We especially enjoyed and appreciated the coffee machine! :)  For a trip away to Berlin with friends, this was a great place to stay.

We had a wonderful stay in this apartment. Werner gave us some great tips on where to go and how to use public transport locally. We loved Becketts Bar that he recommended! The apartment was clean, well-equipped and in a great location. We loved the local neighbourhood and found it easy to use public transport or Ubers to get into the centre of Berlin. We would definitely stay here again. Thanks Werner!
We experienced a unique week-end in Berlin. Thank you so much for your help and reactivity in the organisation and communication. The flat was very practical and well located with many local plans.

Arrived in Berlin and Werner met us at the flat, he's a funny chap and was kind enough to give us a little intro to the accommodation and city. The flat is clean, on a fairly quiet street, ideal for a group of friends. We were two couples and a single. Coffee machine was well appreciated. The area is great, plenty of places to eat and drink within 10 minute walk. Would recommend to anybody, danke Werner.
It was just great! From the beginning till the very end...nothing to claim! We'll be back! Thank you for your great hospitality!

As a family of 5 travelling to Berlin for the first time, we had a great stay at Werner's apartment. The location is fantastic - Prenzlauer Berg is a safe, friendly neighbourhood - loads of families and children and a great vibe with lots of cafes, shops etc.
The apartment itself is very clean and comfortable with everything we needed for our stay. We can highly recommend - thanks very much.

Fantastic facilities, all decor, space, rooms, showers are first class.
Kitchen was great, with just the right amount of extras, coffee etc.
Excellent location, local bars and cafes were lovely.
Lovely people, we had an excellent long weekend.
I would highly recommend this to anyone thinking about a Berlin weekend.
Perfect!

Very good host, who took time to show us places on the map where to go and what to see. Nice and tidy apartment in a very good location. We stayed nine of us there and didn't have to wait for the shower or toilet since there was two of each.

Our group of 5 thoroughly enjoyed our stay at this apartment! The location was A+ in a very quiet neighborhood, which was very close to the main tourist attractions within a few quick and easy trains stops. The neighborhood is very charming, there are many restaurants, bars (including Prater Biergarten!), two grocery stores,  and parks. The apartment was spacious and offered plenty of room to accommodate our group. Werner greeted us upon arrival and was able to provide lots of great recommendations and gave us a great resource via his personal website directing us to the best places. We would absolutely stay here again.
Werner’s place is modern, spacious and very well located. I would definitely recommend it for anyone who is looking to visit Berlin!

We had a lovely stay in Werners appartment - the location was perfect for exploring Berlin with kids, and the communication, check in and etc. with Werner was accurate and very helpful. We will definetly be back!:)
This is a spacious and well located apartment. The host is very informative and helpful. Located to lots of great bars and restaurants.

We had a great stay at Werner’s apartment! Everything was clean and the apartment had everything we needed. Werner gave us great recommendations at check in and was available throughout our stay. Overall we had a great stay and no complaints :)

I loved this place! Werner was really helpful and provided detailed instructions on how to get to the flat, which is in a relaxed, family neighbourhood with cool shops, parks and some great bars and restaurants. The flat entrance is behind a shutter and was formerly a shop - with a large, sociable kitchen area and big spotlessly clean rooms with super comfortable beds. Ideal for groups having a chilled stay in Berlin. (The only thing I would say is the door lock was a bit of a challenge -  but we got there in the end…😂)
Very nice appartment in the center of Prenzlauer-Berg. Clean, modern and spacious. The host was structured and calm and very pleasant to deal with.
We had a great stay at Werners appartment in Berlin. Easy to communicate and good location to get around in the city. Spacious bedrooms.
Great apartment with very easy access to U bahn and local stores and restaurants. Neighborhood was excellent and very convenient. Host was very helpful booking us an early am taxi which was great.
Werner was a great host and met us at the apartment to get us settled. He showed us how to get around the city and the apartment was close to transportation

We had a perfect stay in Berlin. The flat is nicely located in a quiet street but close to many bars and restaurants. Rooms were large and bed comfortable. Communication with Werner is easy. Nice also to have basic stuff in the kitchen, like coffee and tea. I recommend this flat.
