We travelled with children and stayed four nights. The area is great for hanging out with the family or to have an evening drink without the kids. Good connections with U-bahn and metro. Several grocery stores within walking distance.
The apartment is very spacious, with three large bedrooms and a comfortable and well equipped kitchen and dining place. Werner is a reliable and accommodating host, providing all necessary information as well as tips and recommendations for your visit.
We highly recommend a stay in Prenzlauerberg and this apartment.
Very nice apartment with an amazing library, good location, clean and nice  welcoming! We'll come back for sure.
Our stay in this studio was perfect! I highly recommend it because of an original look, great location and very friendly contact with the renter.

Stefan's studio is very stylish place with the super balcony lots of the plants, full equipment kitchen with the very nice dishware, good shower and absolutely cosy bed from which you don't want to get up. The apartment looks bigger than on the pictures. Celina was very friendly and helpful. Definitely recommend Stefan's place to stay in Berlin!

Very nice and unique designed place. My sixties years old parents stayed at this place and they enjoyed a lot, the bed was extremely comfortable. Close to the park, but the street it self has nothing such as a bakery, cafe, shop etc. The communication was difficult in the beginning but Celina was available and kind for helping us during the stay.

Stefan's studio is truly amazing. It is very central, though in a very quiet neighbourhood. With the U-bahn, you can get anywhere in Berlin in 15 minutes. The studio is beautifully decorated, simple but very cosy. We had a great time and will definitly go back if we visit Berlin again.

Great stay in Berlin! The Loft is cozy and really interesting furniture, all in industrial style! The bed is very comfortable and all you need for a pleasant stay is in the Loft! Host was friendly and gave all necessary information! Highly recommandable

Wonderful studio-flat. A perfect Airbnb experience.
One tiny thing : we weren't able to leave our luggage and had to carry them around all day, a little hard on the back!
A fantastic modern well located studio apartment with a generous balcony. Clean and well equipped this studio is perfect for a short stay in Berlin.
A lovely, modern, stylish and convenient place to stay. And If you'd like to brush up on famous photographers of the last century, you will love the large library of reference books

We had a wonderful stay at Stefan's place. The apartment had everything we needed for our stay and was very bright, airy, & comfortable.  We loved the attention to detail and especially the art and design library that made us want to stay in every night!  Great location with cafes and shops with in walking distance as well as public transportation.  The apartment was easy to find and check it and check out was a breeze.  Stefan and Anna were great hosts.  We would love to stay again next time we are in Berlin.

It was simply such stylish, beautiful, and cleanly kept place just as described in the pictures. Great location. Anna's responses were quick and helpful. Simply wonderful. We're really grateful to have stayed there for our trip. Thanks!

Stefan's place was a nice to call home for a few days. The bed was super comfy and the apartment was extremely stylish. I really enjoyed sitting outside on the balcony to enjoy the Berlin sunsets. The unit was very spacious and perfect for a couple traveling together looking to explore Berlin. Overall there was plenty of places to eat within walking distance, and nearby there is a very neat beer garden/hall which was quite fun as well. The kitchen was well stocked and the shower was great. I would definitely stay here again thanks for the nice stay.

Stefan's place was absolutely fantastic. We had a really lovely time in this stylish studio which is located very close to the U Bahn. We had everything we needed, check in was easy and we would highly recommend this spot to friends and family who are visiting Berlin. Highlights include: the nearby beer garden, washer, great shower, beautiful balcony and comfy bed.

Great place - highly recommended! Beautifully curated apartment conveniently located in the heart of Berlin. Well equipped place that has all the bells and whistles. Great hosts, as well. We had to make last minute changes to our atinuary and Anna and Stefan were very forthcoming about that. Would definitely stay there again.

Our stay here was flawless. We checked in smoothly, and immediately settled into the quaint apartment. Upon exploring a little, we found that we absolutely loved the area, which includes the park nearby and the main street close by as well. The park is very family friendly, and we were pleasantly surprised at how accessible the city is from the nearby train stop. We especially loved the food recommendations mentioned in the guest book on the premises.
Overall it was a wonderful stay in Berlin - would absolutely recommend!

The studio was absolutely beautiful – filled with interesting and unique design details. Felt very spacious for 2 people yet highly cozy in style and ambiance. Amanda was an awesome, super nice and communicative host, especially when we accidentally left behind our phone after checking out and had to rush back from the airport to retrieve it (whoopsie!) Can't wait to return and would recommend 100%! :)
A gorgeous apartment: central, clean, stylish, safe! This is Airbnb heaven. Thanks for having us xx

Such a great find. Stefan’s studio is stunning, artfully designed, and with a lush patio as a bonus. Amanda was super communicative and an all-around lovely host. Will definitely stay here again next time I’m in Berlin!

A perfect stay. The apartment is perfect : cosy, comfortable, beautifully designed and well equipped. The location is great as well, close to the train station and next to a lovely park.
Amanda was a nice host.
Highly recommended !

We really enjoyed our stay at Stefan's place. The flat is beautifully designed and very comfortable. Would definitely stay here again if we come back. The bed was super comfy. The area is nice and quiet so it's nice to hang out in the flat when you're not out in Berlin.
Thanks for having us!

11/10 apartment, if this place is available and you are going to be in Berlin just book it. Location is great, close to multiple U-bahn stations, we walked into the city centre everyday. Check-in was super easy. All the amenities a traveller would need for short or longer stays. Plenty of supplies in the kitchen too. Hundreds of photography books to flip through over breakfast/dinner. We had been travelling all over Europe before getting to this Airbnb and it was by far the best one we had stayed in, value for money is on point.

This was an excellent Airbnb experience. Host was warm and helpful and responsive, the apartment is decorated and maintained with care and love. The space is comfortable, peaceful (quiet!) and so pretty. We felt at home and didn’t want to leave. A perfect base for exploring the city. Many thanks!

I really enjoyed this location as a solo traveler. The space was immaculate and perfect for one or two people. I use the kitchen and washing machine and had no issues
The location itself was very near public transit and multiple neighborhoods I visited frequently.
We had a very good time in Stephan's appartment. It is beautiful and quiet, ideal to relax after a day of visits in the city.
What a gorgeous gorgeous place! Superbly located it had everything we needed and was done up so beautifully. We had an absolutely wonderful time. Will be back!
Great bathroom -- by far the best shower we have we've ever had in an Airbnb. Great book collection! The apartment is nice and cozy. Close to the U2. Enjoyed our stay!

Great location — close to several transit routes and walkable to many sights. Space is as promised, very efficient space. Great homebase for business travelers or tourists who will mostly be out enjoying Berlin. Bet patio is great in warmer months!!

The place is only one step ahead check point charlie, and near tourist bus (sightseeing bus) so it was easy to get anywhere. The thing is, this room located on the rooftop of the building, and the sun get’s right inside the room which is during the summer will be supeerr hor, they didnt have any air conditioning but this room has got a fan, beside that, everything is exactly what i expects ! Thank you.

Great stay! Ece's mom is lovely, made me feel at home.
Home is close to supermarkets and city center.
Walking area with very good train and bus connections.
Schoenefeld airport can be reached in about 45/50 minutes with S-Bahn (change at Ostkreuz).
Very clean house.
Very good WIFI.
Loved it!

Ece and her mother been perfect hosts!
Shower was broken but sometimes bad luck may happen
Recommended!

When I came it's the mother's ece who welcomed me I came a bit in late, she was really nice and smiling the place it's really clean and sweet place I think it's one of the amazing place from Airbnb!!! The room is really sweet and I slept very well if I have to come anymore for sure I gonna return to this place!!! Go there!!!!

Ece's mother was at the flat to greet me even though we did not share any language she made everything clear!

The room was perfect and the bed comfortable.

It was perfect location for as I was attending a convention at a Theatre in the same street
Me and my daughter had a very lovely time at Eces mothers apartment. Top hospitality and location. Recommendations.

Very cute home in a great location! I stayed during a 3-day festival at Alexanderplatz so I didn't spend as much time at my airbnb, but it was a great place to come back to and relax at each evening! The host gave me a set of keys so I could come and go as needed. I love how close this location is to public transportation, it made navigating the city so much easier!

Check-in and check-out were very easy, my room was exactly as expected and this was a wonderful first airbnb experience for me. I'm so glad I got to stay here, it was much better than any hotel!
Ece's place is very clean and in an amazing location, 2 main train stations are just a few meters away and a few stations from the center of Berlin

Ece's place is perfectly located, clean and quiet. It is just next to a metro stop and easy walking distance to the Alexanderplatz and canal towards the Museum Island. The room is also a good size. Ece's mother is the real gem - a wonderful, helpful, and generous woman who made sure my stay was comfortable and I was looked after.
Great location and spotless flat. Communication was great, although I didn't get the chance to meet Ece, since I stayed just for a night. I can totally recommend staying here.
The place is great, clean, spacious and wonderfully located near alexanderplatz, ece's mother is a lovely woman and made me feel at home.
The room is large and comfortable. The apartment is near the center of the city and close to public transport. It was just for one night, in general everything was fine!
Nice clean room. Good location. Check in process was easy and the host was very kind. I would stay there again.

This wonderful accommodation is hosted by Ece’s parents and they were very friendly! The room was comfortable and clean, same with the bathroom and I definitely recommend staying here if you want a central location in Berlin!
Lovely room in a great location. Ece's mom was very kind, in spite of me not speaking a word of German. Would highly recommend for a short stay in Berlin.
Ece's parents were very friendly and welcoming, and the room is clean and in a great location.
It was a nice time! I could totally repeat 😊😊very well received, and treated. I really recommend 😊😊 very good location.

The apartment in general is super clean, the room is cozy with great space, also a desk and a balcony,  you have really close a super market, bus station,restaurant and also a cool and little  underground bar you can see from the balcony, the family is very calm and welcoming. I had a great time there.

I had an amazing time staying at Ece's place.
Her mom was amazing and very friendly. Very thoughtful and always ready to help out.
The place was amazing and very clean and it was fully equipped with everything you have at home.
The location is amazing. Only 15min walk from the TV Station Tower and the city hall. Public transportation is right outside of the place and you can get to the centre of Berlin or the wall in just 10min or less.
There is a restaurant and 2 market stores right in front of the house.
Definitely recommend staying there if you want to be close to the centre but still enjoy the quite time at night.
Will book in the future when I go back to Berlin.
Love this nice flat. Everyone in the flat is so nice and helped me a lot. The room was clean and tidy. Also, it’s convenient to get to any tourist attractions.
Ece and her mom are delightful.  The room is clean and well furbished.  The location is ideal.  Recommended!!

I had a lovely stay! The apartment is very well located and the room is clean and comfortable. The language barrier was no problem and I was able to understand everything despite not speaking German. It was a very nice experience, definitely recommend!
The apt. was perfectly clean and located, the bathroom was very nice. The Host was immediately reachable. I will come back for sure

Overall the place is clean. Room comfortable. But she wasn't polite when I tried to ask for help to find the house. She wasn't home and her mother doesn't speak English - impossible to communicate. Also, I didn't like that one of the rules was that I had to clean the toilet everytime after take a shower. I don't recommend if you want to stay more days. It's annoying.

I stayed with Ece and her mother for two nights while visiting Berlin for a concert. The proximity to Alex is great and WiFi was fast enough to do some video calls for work. The room itself is fine for short-term stays :)

Had an absolutely amazing time here- am now considering moving here after university! The location is super- right next to 2 supermarkets as well as a döner shop that if always open after a night out as well as being right next to the S-bahn and U bahn stations with easy access to the rest of Berlin :) Ece's mum and her friend were staying for most of my stay and they were very kind and friendly. The room itself is very homely has everything you need - I would suggest bringing your own mini fan in the summer months though as it can get quite hot in the room at night- even with the windows open. The bathroom and living room/kitchen spaces are very much shared- but so much better than a hostel experience! Considering how much hotels and hostels can be in Berlin, this place is an absolute treasure and next time I'm in Berlin, I would love to stay again :)
I stayed for 2 weeks at Ece’s place. It felt really just like at home. Very comfortable, clean, and an amazing location. Thanks so much.

thank you for hosting me. it was really nice. feels like you are home.
close to go around. would recommend it
it was great to stay here, nice room which is close to the center. 100% recommend

Really good location, close to a few underground stations.
Very comfortable room as well.

Thanks to Ece’s family for everything. I feel safe, confortable like at my home. Everything is clean. And I would like to say thanks to Elif who shared turkish food with me, it was so cool and kind from her 🥰 I couldn’t imagine better my stay in Berlin. Thanks so much 🫶🏻

The listing of Ece is such a lovely place and her mum Elif is a warm kind and lovely person. Who makes you feel so much loved and is full of warmth. The place very central, convenient and there is an amazing döner kebab center followed by Netto supermarket and also a barber shop nearby. Such a lab amazing accomodation, the room is comfortable and the bed to sleep is good you can sleep well :)) highly recommended if your a single person travelling to Berlin  to book for Ece’s place. Thank you so much 😊
Space was clean, but very noisy, could have used a fan as it was very hot, building was okay except that lobby was dirty, access to kitchen area awkward, owner spoke no English

The apartment is located at the very heart of the city, just 5 min walk to the Alexanderlatz. Right next to the building are 2 supermarkets which is a huge plus. It is well connected with a U bahn station right next to the building and a bus stop nearby.
The apartment is very clean. There is a balcony in the room decorated with flowers. The room is well lit and is very comfortable.
Most of all Elif is such a great host. Gave me a very warm welcome. She respects guest’s privacy. She also cooked me delicious Turkish cuisine. I had a gloomy day checking out from the apartment as it felt like home. I will always prefer to stay with Elif if I come to Berlin again

Conveniently located near the train station for travel around Berlin. Elif was very nice and helpful. Room is as described. Only negative would be that you can hear all the noise outside. Otherwise great spot.

Great location, near Alexanderplatz and public transport! Easy to reach from the airport!
Ece’s mother is a very friendly host, flexible check-in and out was great! Quiet place to stay and clean room and bathroom! I really recommand this place for your trip to Berlin!

Nice appartment, well situated in the northwest of Berlin in a quiet area. Just behind a big park and 2 minutes walking from the closest underground station. 20 min walking from touristic areas, well comunicated by bus, tram, train or underground. Highly recomended, their response is really fast and proffesional. We'll love to come again !
communication with the host was excellent.  always ready for what you need.  the apartment is excellent and very beautiful.  excellent location 👍🏻
A great location for getting around- underground is only a 5 min walk, supermarket less than that and close to some great tourist spots. Very clean, smart flat.

Nice compact little apartment, very convenient location with the U-bahn a short walk away to make it easy to get around. Everything needed for a comfortable stay is provided and worked well. The apartment is up a couple of flights of stairs, but easy to navigate even with large suitcases as they are short flights with large landings for a break :)

everything we needed for our stay in Berlin. Close to the underground and plenty eating places around.
I would definitely recommend.
Location is perfect for U station (U6) and supermarket. There are also some  cafes . Neighborhood is really peaceful and safe. Everything was so good for us.

We had a great stay in this apartment - it was a great size for our family of four and we really liked the location, close to a supermarket, transport and restaurants (check out Hackethals!). Also cool that we could see part of the Berlin Wall from the apartment. We would definitely stay again if we came back to Berlin.
We had a wonderful stay in Berlin thanks in large part to Marcus allowing 2 night bookings. Great apartment met all our needs. Terrific location.  Recommend the place for people who enjoy luxury.

This is a fantastic apartment in a great location. The apartment was clean, spacious, comfy and had everything we needed for a great stay. The roof terrace is a lovely bonus. Marcus was a great host, he met us at the apartment and gave us good tips for the local area, as well as making sure we had everything we needed for our stay. There is a U-bahn station right outside the flat and it's only about a 20min walk to Brandenburg gate.

Great place!  Same as pictured.  Apartment itself very nice and livable.  Quiet and yet great location.  U-Bahn stop directly outside entrance to building; tram and bus stops just down the street; nice coffee shop with good pastries on ground floor; grocery stores just down the street; easy spot to come and go from to reach all major sites.  We stayed in winter, and appreciated the strong, hot showers, and the floor heating system worked well throughout the apartment.  Marcus was very responsive and helpful before and during stay.  Met us promptly as planned; provided good tips and information; promptly addressed needs or questions that arose during stay; always responded promptly wherever we contacted him.  Highly recommend!

The apartment is fantastic it's extremely well furnished and very spacious. Unfortunately it was a cold weekend when we visited but the roof terrace would be a great place to enjoy a cold beer at the end of the day in warmer months.
The apartment was immaculately clean with plenty of towels and all the cooking equipment you could need.
Marcus was very quick replying to emails and check in was a breeze so with a few words of advice on where to go we were off and seeing the sights in no time.
The apartment is right next to an underground station and centrally located so getting around is very easy but it's also very quiet with no noise from outside intruding.
I'd definitely reccomend this place to anyone looking for a central, stylish place to stay in Berlin

Excellent location, clean and amazing penthouse with everything as described. Very easy to connect with for questions and we had an excellent visit to Berlin and loved this rental and would highly recommend!!

Marcus’s apartment is such an awesome space! My husband and I were traveling with another couple and there was plenty of space and privacy for us all to feel comfortable and at home.
The location of the apartment was perfect for our week in Berlin. We could walk to many of the main tourist attractions and the Ubahn stop across the street and incredible public transportation network made it easy to get around the city.
We were so lucky to have sunny weather for our week in Berlin. We had breakfast several mornings on the wonderful rooftop deck and enjoyed hanging out up there with a glass of wine or a book after our days of exploring.
I would highly recommend this Airbnb experience!

Marcus’ apartment was prestine! A beautiful stay with all the appropriate amenities and great communication through out. Everything was so clean and comfortable. Would highly recommend staying at his place!

The apartment is fantastic with all of the amenities you could need for a short or extended stay including ironing board, cleaning supplies, several coffee facilities, entertainment, a fully stocked kitchen and towels. It looks exactly as good as the photos suggest, spacious and really comfortable.
The location for exploring Berlin is perfect with a u-Bahn stop right outside and all the shops and restaurants you could want nearby.
The host was really attentive and communicated with us before and during the stay to ensure we had everything we needed for a great visit.
We would definitely book this apartment again.

Beautiful, centrally located, light and bright modern apartment was perfect for a friends reunion and marathon visit. The place is clean and comfortable,  just as described and perfect for 3 couples. Marcus is a welcoming and gracious host, communication was excellent and timely.

This is a really well appointed apartment in a great location with a fantastic roof terrace.
It’s set in a modern block overlooking a courtyard so it’s really peaceful with no traffic noise even though it’s on a busy street.
This apartment is perfect. A lot of space, very clean, good spot, and very convenient public transportation. We enjoyed our time and recommend this place for a great vacation

The unit was in an amazing location, a huge size, and was well equipped with everything you could need for a family. The washer and dryer were fantastic! And my sons loved the arcade game in the living room!

We had an amazing stay at Marcus's place. It was perfect for our family of two adults and two teens. The apartment itself is gorgeous and incredibly spacious, with multiple outdoor spaces, including a beautiful rooftop terrace. The location is perfect, too. The metro is right across from the apartment, and there's a tram a block or two away. We were able to get everywhere we wanted to go quite easily. There are plenty of nearby places to explore by foot too, like Mauerpark and the Berlin Wall Memorial. Marcus was a great host--responsive, helpful, and accommodating. We'll miss our morning coffees at Karaca Cafe just downstairs, and late night dinners at the doner kebab place up the street. Would stay there again in a heartbeat!

What a great stay.  This place is in easy walking distance to grocery, bakery, coffee shops, and a hundred restaurants.  The metro is literally right outside the entrance.  Apartment was comfortable, clean, and well maintained.   Really appreciated having an Nespresso machine and some pods provided that first morning.  Rooftop was glorious when the sun was out.  Giant bathtub if you’re into that.  The only minor downside is the smallish showers.

Our family of four visited Berlin in June 2023. The flat was easily one of the highlights of our stay. It is large, airy, and the private rooftop was ideal for morning breakfast and evening drinks. The U-Bahn station is literally steps away from the front door of the complex, which is safe and secure. There is a grocery store and pharmacy within a few minutes of walking, as well as Pascarella, an Italian restaurant that perhaps wasn't authentic German cuisine but which we enjoyed anyway (twice!). Our host, Marcus, was responsive and polite, and met us at the flat to show us everything. We would absolutely stay here again.

This apartment is lovely. Well furnished and clean. Everything we needed was there. It was very safe. Great location situated right next to the underground where you can visit many places. The balconies and roof top terrace would have been great in the warmer months. Thanks for having us.

I booked this apartment for me and my 3 adult children. The apartment was better than the description. There was ample room for all of us, plus multiple balconies and a rooftop patio. The apartment is on the 6th floor. There were even power adapters for us to use.
There is a coffee Cafe directly below the apartment, which also serves breakfast. Across the street is a Michelin Star Italian restaurant. We were able to eat there with no reservations.
Thank you Marcus and Elena.
Great host, good communication and an overall very happy experience staying at this beautiful apartment. Will def book again!

My family had a perfect stay at Marcus's apartment in Berlin. It was very clean and tastefully designed without unnecessary clutter, but also extra linens and dishes as needed. They location was stellar! Easy access across the street to the metro, but we were also able to walk to most tourist sites. Plus great restaurant options, but not a loud neighborhood in the evening. Highly recommend for families visiting Berlin!!

The apartment was everything we expected. Spacious, comfortable and exactly as per the pictures and details listed. Marcus was also very helpful and responsive and I would highly recommend this apartment to anyone. Thank you Marcus!

Excellent place! One of the best b&bs we've been to!
Beautiful apartment, airy, well-lit, modern and comfortable, which was spotlessly clean and perfectly located in the heart of Mitte, across from a U-bahn station.
Marcus the host was constantly in touch although there were no issues requiring his care.
Definitely a place I'll come back to

My friends and I have spent a fantastic weekend at this flat. Everything has been perfect and even better than expected. Sören is a very kind and thoughtful host who has welcomed us with fresh fruits, flowers and some cold drinks in the fridge. :) the apartment is even bigger than the fotos look like, super tidy and well furnited/equipped.
The location of the flat is great as well, very quite neighborhood, there is a supermarket in walking distance (5min) and the sbahn is closeby, too.
We will come back... :)
BR,
Carolin

Sören was a fantastic host and has a lovely modern apartment. He is professional, and helpful. When he found out we are more than 4 people (since I booked for 4), he immediately brought more linen and  amenities so that we all are more comfortable staying there. The house is clean and has everything you need for your stay. It is in a nice quite area with a great Italian restaurant next door. It is near the city center. I would definitely recommend this apartment for pure comfort, and because of its location. Whenever I go back to Berlin I will definitely come back to Sörens place.
Sören was great!!! The apartment is awsome! I stayed with 7 other people and we enjoyed it really every thing of it. Didnt have any problem at all. Super recomended!

Great Apartment!
From the first minute on, Sören was the perfect host! A lovely stay, I can highly recommend!
Thanks for the great days!

Sören was one of the best hosts I have ever encountered! The communication prior to our arrival and the check-in was very professional. The apartment is great, very spacious, beautiful, clean, with many amenities. We would definitely stay there again!

Sören is the perfect host; punctual, welcoming, warm, knowledgeable, and generous! He met us at the apartment, told us everything we needed to know and answered a few of our questions about Berlin in great detail.
The apartment itself was spotlessly clean and well furnished with almost anything you could need. The flat is great for large groups, with 2 bathrooms and 2 kitchens, it's easy for everyone to get ready in the morning. Just 2 minutes from the S-Bahn station and around 3 minutes from the underground, it's also in a great location for being able to travel around the city. There are plenty of shops, cafes and restaurants nearby.
I would cannot recommend Sören's place enough; we will definitely be staying with him again should we return to Berlin.

The flat was just perfect for us (three couples). The bedrooms were large and the beds were comfortable. As well the whole flat was well-equipped, functional and quiet. The location was good. Guiet neighborhood and close to the transportation. We 'll spent a great weekend there. Thanks to you Sören!

We were a group of 8, staying for a week during a conference. The apartment was great, clean and specious. The two kitchens and bathrooms were very useful, as we were a lot of people. The location is fantastic, and public transportation was easily accessible. Food and groceries were found nearby as well.
Felix was friendly, responsive and the apartment was as described; centrally located and ideally situated for the Berlin Marathon! We would gladly stay here again if we return.
Great stay. It's a pretty nice apartment at a good location. Nina and Felix are pretty responsive which helped a lot during our stay.

Professional apartment rental. Clean and Tidy. You are not renting someone's home - this could just as easily be a hotel.
Good location. Hassle free communication. all good.

The appartement is very spacious and fits easily 2 or even 3 families giving everybody enough privacy because there are 2 bathrooms and even 2 kitchens. It’s well equipped and nicely arranged. There’s is plenty restaurants, bars and shops nearby and an S-bahn station is a walking distance. We very much liked the self-check in option, travelling from far and with kids we didn’t have to hurry to be on time to pick up the key. The owners are very friendly and easy to reach. Definitely an accomodation we can recommend!

This is a great apartment for families. It is cleverly setup to maximize the available space for functional use (bedrooms, kitchens, and baths). Just what is needed on vacation.
The location was ideally situated for us, giving us easy access to downtown by car, and walking to nearby shopping, cafes and restaurants. A safe and quiet neighborhood.
Perfect location, modern, clean and stylish flat. Super convenient hosts and entry system perfect when you have so many guests.
A large, spotless and well-equipped flat. Great for a large family. Communication with host was completely problemfree and precise.

Very big appartment, well located( S-bahn or U-bahn needed to move everywere, but aptmnt is close to stations, ten minutes to Alexander Platz) and with supermarkets and coffee shops nearby. Generally speaking, good option with one but:
I need to point out that, instead of what pictures may indicate, the walls need urgently a paint, living room cloth chairs are very dirty and sofa and cushions could use a clean as well.
Rest of the house was ok.
Sören and Nina were available to answer any questions/requests we had at any time.

Lovely apartment, spacious and clean - even better than the photos.  Interesting area and very good transport links.  Communication very good and no problem getting into the apartment.  Would definitely recommend
Nice apartment good for group of friends and family. Clean and well equipped. When there is a problem, host responded and solve it quickly.
A fantastic apartment with great access to Berlin. Fast and reassuring communication from excellent hosts. Would definitely book again.

Great place, looks as good as in the pics. Although ground floor apt the street is v quiet so not an issue.
V spacious, clean, and with two kitchens
Highly recommend

Great stay! There were 5 of us and we stayed on the beds and sofa beds.
Two kitchens and plenty of space - nice area. Very clean. Would definitely recommend! We’ll be back :)

Very beautiful apartment. Very clean, spacious, and pleasant. Well-equipped and convenient. The overall comfort is excellent, and we felt very comfortable there. The neighborhood is quiet and a bit out of the way, but it is very well connected in terms of transportation, creating a balance between tranquility and convenience. The host was very pleasant and understanding. They were responsive to our needs. The value for money is excellent. I highly recommend it.

Sören is a wonderful host. Available, friendly and very very accommodating.
We will definitely book through Sören again.

This is a very nice apartment with a lot of space, sleeping beds and double kitchen and two bathrooms. The location is close to subway entrance, bus stops and supermarkets/ restaurants. Would recommend Soeren’s listings.

We had an excellent stay at this apartment - the apartment was very clean and perfect for what we wanted. The location is a block from public transport taking you right into the city (takes about 10 minutes). The rooftop balcony had amazing views across the city and it had all the amenities we needed (cooker,kettle, toaster etc) The Wifi was good and beds very comfortable. Angelika was very warming, friendly and helpful when we needed to book things such as restaurants and taxis.
The host was very kind. The apartment was just like on the pictures. Nice and clean :)!
Thomas and Angelika were great hosts. This was the best BNB I have stayed in yet. Location was very good for all the Berlin hotspots. Will definitely be back!

We had a great stay at Thomas and Angelika's place. It was sparkling clean, well decorated and in an excellent location for cafes, bars, and public transport. The apartment itself was comfortable and airy, equipped with a fantastic rooftop terrace for sunny days.
Communication was great, with Angelika arranging and early check in for us, and even letting us know the clocks were due to go back during our stay.
If you have any mobility issues, it is worth noting this apartment is at the top of the building with only stairs access.
Overall, we thoroughly enjoyed our stay and would highly recommend it.
Great apartment in convenient location and nice local shops close by to wander too. We had a great stay.

Everything in Thomas' House was according to the images, clean, new, and furnished with qualty and style.
100% reccomended

My teen daughters and I had a wonderful stay in Thomas' beautiful, very cool, and very well/generously appointed maisonette. It's close to markets, pharmacy, the tram, and the immediate neighborhood has interesting boutiques and many vegetarian restaurants! It's really a perfect location if you're visiting Berlin and want to be able to stay close but far enough away to get a good night's sleep from the hubub in the more touristy areas. I hope to be back in the not-to-distant future!

Lovely stylish apartment with a lovely balcony. Clean and modern throughout and the area was really friendly and cool with lots of little cafes ( try the little scruffy Thai place on Hufelandstrasse Cheap and delicious) and a supermarket on the next street. 150 metres from a tram which goes directly to Alexanderplatz Bahnhof in less than 10mins and from there all of Berlin is only a U Bahn away. Nice bed, a great shower and a full kitchen...what more do you need?

very clean, sunny and cozy apartments. There are evenings you need in flat( iron,dishes, dryer,washing machine..etc)
great location in good district( many food shops and restaurants around, very quiet)
Angelika answered all questions quickly.
So,highly recommended!)

The place was sparkly clean, well appointed and beds were comfortable. Modern design and a wonderful family friendly neighborhood. There was also a grocery store around the corner we found very convenient.
There is. 4 story walkup so carrying suitcases was hard on the first day but doable for able bodied people.
My son raves about the shower which was strong, warm and had multiple settings. The caretaker was very responsive when we had questions as well.
I would stay here again.
It was a great location and easy to get everywhere. Lots of cafes and restaurants around the area. Comfortable and sparkly clean. Easy check in and wonderful hosts. Would highly recommend!
An amazing apartment in a cute neighborhood with some nice restaurants, shops and great connections to the rest of Berlin. Would definitely recommend this appartement to everyone.
Great place to stay, super close to everything and the restaurants near are delicious. So much attention for detail. You will feel at home in no time. Just be ready for lots of stairs

We had a lovely stay! Highly recommend renting this space during warmer periods to enjoy the rooftop balcony, it is super cosy and everything is very easy to use. You have a lot of public transport options around and a grocery store 1 second away. However remember there is no lift, so know that if you rent this space you will have some excersice to do! But it is worth it. Would love to stay here again when we are in Berlin next.

This is an extremely nice and welcoming place. It’s in a very interesting part of town with lots of good places but also away from too many tourists. The flat is extremely light and airy and super quiet. Highly recommended.

Thank you for letting us stay in your great home. The check in was easy and hassle free. The stair climb was challenging with a big bag but can't complain as we really appreciated the rooftop terrace and balcony views that being up high offered. The flat was great and we had a great stay, very clean and great layout. Great location, we used the electric scooters that are dotted around to ride to locations which was really efficient.

Thomas’s apartment was perfect for our stay. It was clean, spacious and well presented. It was minimalistic with no clutter. The heating on the bathroom floor was amazing during the cold winter days and nights. We were able to settle and be comfortable over the Christmas period like it was our own little home. The apartment was located in a spot very close to public transport into the city and the streets were nice and quiet. I would definitely stay here again.

Lovely, comfortable and clean apartment in a great location. Close to transportation, grocery stores, restaurants, bakeries, and more. Check-in was easy and the apartment has everything you might need.

Had a great 5-night stay @ Thomas’s. I enjoyed every minute of it. The place is just few minutes walk to M4 tram station which would take you to Alexanderplatz in just 7 minutes. Same M4 tram would take you to Berlin Cathedral/Museum Island. There’s a grocery store just right in front of the tram station which is very handy. I would definitely stay there again when I’m back to Berlin.
We had a fantastic stay, it was really clean, spacious, and in a lovely area. The kitchen had great amenities, the bathroom was lovely and loved the roof terrace.

Honestly, such a beautiful space. Conveniently located with trams being a 5min walk and multiple stores/restaurants within an equally  comfortable distance. Host was also accommodating, allowing me to check-in a few hours before the stated check-in time. Would highly recommend if you’re planning a trip and would have no issue staying here again on my next visit.

This was my second time staying with Thomas and Angelika. A wonderful experience just as before. Very kind and friendly host, great neighborhood with lots to do, and a beautiful loft. Did not have any problems whatsoever. Thank you!
We had a great time staying in Leo's apartment. It was perfect for our Berlin stay with friends. Super comfy beds too! Thank you! x

Great neighborhood. Very good access to trains (S- and U-Bahn) and shops. You could have a nice trip to Berlin without even leaving the area. Coordination is through a booking agency, but we had no problem. The apartment is very large, and comfortably accommodated seven people.
Leo was a great host! We had a nice time staying at Leo’s place with our 3 kids. Family friendly, close to transit and restaurants, it all worked great for us.

The place was better than expected: great big house/apartment with spacious living room, kitchen and bathroom, with very nice view on the local street from every front room. The area is fantastic, not touristic and close to the center. Totally worth it and recommended for any future visits in beautiful Berlin.

Leo’s place is in a great location near trains and shops. The beds were comfortable. The street is loud with the windows open in summer heat. The building seems to be under construction and has materials lying everywhere.

For this stay the host was really helpful and responsive over messages making the check in go really smoothly allowing us to check in early even though dealing with our flight delays. The flat was really nice and was in a great location for exploring Berlin with easy access to public transport. Saw the bakery across the road was recommended in previous reviews and can definitely vouch for that! Would definitely recommend this as a stay for exploring Berlin!

It was easy to communicate with Carmen, check in was without any problems and the location was just perfect to explore East Berlin. We loved the place, it was so unique and beautiful. Carmen was super helpful and nice and we can't recommend the place highly enough.

The old horse barn is so cosy and absolutely adorable and the neighbourhood has all the genuine, rough charm that I love about the old East Berlin.
Carmen helped us find our way to her house, and when we arrived, late in the dark October evening, there was a fire in the fire place, and the beds in the large bedroom were so comfortable and cosy. The bathroom was also lovely; beautifully built, lots of clean towels at our disposal, warm roomy shower. My kids appreciated the good wifi so much so it was difficult to make them leave the house. Beautiful experience!
A fabulous find in a quiet street close to two stations and plenty of cafes and restaurants.   Spacious and private with an outside eating area and hammock relaxation which we used most days.

Carmen - described her location as a 'romantic old converted stable' - she omitted to say that it was such a beautiful oasis in such an old historic part of the city! We loved staying in this place and we were so lucky to have such good weather. Staff were very hospitable and friendly! And I personally could have stayed in her beautiful garden all day! We will be coming back later in the year to see our daughter again and as soon as we have define dates I will hope we can stay here again!  Diarmuid
Very comfortable beds, great outdoor area as well. Very well connected by trains and close to local restaurants and shopping.

SO BERLIN!
Amazing place, wonderful garden, clean, cool and best bed ever tried! This house is a jewel.
Carmen was a great host, thanks for everything!

This is the loveliest house to stay at only 5min from the city center by public transport. The venue is charming and quiet. The house is well isolated and stay fresh even during hot weather (we were there in July). You have everything you need in the neighbourhood, restaurants, bar, tobacco, supermarket, club, etc.
You should definitely stay here as Carmen is lovely and helpful, plus the beds are very comfy (especially the pillows !).
Carmyta's place was exactly how we expected. It has a nice Berlin vibe, location is excellent and communication with the host was easy and working. Would definitely stay here again!

Such a fun space to stay. It is such a unique little haven in Berlin. In the middle of a very cool and industrial space you find a renovated farmhouse in the middle of a garden that makes you feel like you are in Provence. Would highly recommend xx
Carmen was a wonderful, warm host. The barn is at the rear of her property, and you will feel very safe in her hands.
This was a great place!  We loved the location and the space.  The neighborhood was great!  Carmen was friendly and very helpful.

Best spot in east Berlin..!
Carmen's place is a gem - as a family of 4 with 2 small kids: place was cosy, well equipped - area felt safe, well connected and Carmen was a super welcoming and communicative host..! Highly recomendable accomodation.
Thank Carmen for the lovely stay! The space was gorgeous, we really liked the location, and the host was helpful and responsive.

A great place in a cool location and a beautiful green garden. Very helpful and responsive host, definitely can recommend. The area has a cool vibe, plus is accessible from 2 Ubahn and Sbahn stations.

Perfect week at this lovely airbnb that was very cosy, and incredibly well situated in Berlin. Lots of restaurants, bars and club right next to the apartment and train/tram stations. Very calm, we slept well. Don’t hesitate to book with Carmen.
it was a pleasant stay . everything was tidy when we arrived. great location. definitely coming again.

I rented the apartment for my visiting family (including 2 young children) and it was absolutely perfect! Marc was very helpful and responsive, particularly to specific requests of my family. Thank you!

The place is perfect for larger groups and Marcus is super quick in his communication. Everything you need for a good stay is in the place and if not then you can find it outside in the area. The neighborhood is full of coffee shops, bodega type vendors and even has a rock bar ( can't describe it well enough, go experience it). If I'm in Berlin with a group of friends this place will again be at the top of my "check out to see if it's open" list
Nice decent apartment in a really good location with lots of nice cafees close by. Easy and friendly communication with the host Marcus. Can definitely recommend :-)

Great space to stay and explore Berlin. Many restaurants, cafes, shops to explore and easy access to transit to explore Berlin within 5 min walk. We were a family of 4 with two kids (ages 17 and 30) so 3 bedrooms was perfect for our week long visit to Berlin. Super clean, all the necessary amenities, loved the kitchen and family room space and we used the kitchen daily for breakfast. Having 2 bathrooms was a nice touch too having teenagers. Would highly recommend for families or multiple couples.

We had a great stay and everything was perfect with the apartment: great communication with Marcus, beautiful and comfortable apartment, all amenities new, good heating system, perfectly clean, well located and quiet, we couldn’t expect any better ! We fully recommend!!

Lovely spacious apartment in a fantastic location, lots of great bars and restaurants in the area and very close to transport links. The check-in experience was quick and easy and everything was explained well, would highly recommend!

This is a lovely, spacious apartment in a super, convenient and safe area of Berlin. Marcus was an extremely kind and efficient host and everything about our stay was excellent. We would throughly recommend this as a place to stay.
A perfect place for a family trip! Well equipped, nice area and just perfect communication with Marcus. We really recommend this place.

The appartement is very stylish and spacious, with a lot of great amenities, in a chill family-friendly neighborhood and Marcus was a great host! That said, as described in the listing, the appartement is on the ground floor and all 3 bedrooms are facing the street, which means there is quite a lot of noise from the street at night, making it difficult to sleep.

Lovely stay in Prezlauer Berg, the apartment was big, confortable with all amenities that you need to spend on your vacations with your family. Love the decoration and level of comfort of all areas.  Thank you  Marcus for your great communication
Great house outside the center of town. Quiet neighborhood but convenient to all parts of town by public transportation. Very clean and well equipped.

Spacious and cosy apartment ideally located in a very peaceful neighbourhood of Berlin.
The host is extremely responsive and helpful making it easy to communicate and navigating throughout the stay.
However, badly insulated windows and children living right above lead to some noise early in the morning.
Both beds in the mezzanine bedroom are absolutely not convenient for adults.

We loved our stay! The neighborhood is cute and has lots of easy transportation options. P’berg also had lots of great restaurants, and it was close to Mauerpark which we really enjoyed. The apartment was really nice and comfortable, exactly as described. Marcus was a great host, very flexible and responsive!! Would stay here again without a doubt

This rental surpassed the description and photos.  Huge, bright, clean and everything worked perfectly.  Marcus is a great host with clear information and communication.  Great walkable neighbourhood near public transport and lots of parks, restaurants and shops.  Would definitely book again.
I would rate the place 5, the host is super friendly and helpful. The apartment and location is perfect. I would definitely book the apartment again whenever I'm in Berlin

We loved our stay at Marcus’ place as a family of 6 including an infant and 4 year old. It was spacious, very clean and in a great neighbourhood, 5 minutes walk from the nearest tram. Blackout shutters in the bedroom were appreciated given the ground floor location. Apartment was warm and cozy with plenty of blankets, pillows and towels.
He offered great local recommendations and was very responsive, including when our arrival was delayed. We would be happy to stay again.

Marcus was great host - very prompt and clear communication. The apartment was very nice, well maintained and roomy. The neighborhood was great - lots of cute shops and restaurants with quiet and safe neighborhood feel.

This is the most perfect apartment especially if you’re travelling with a family - three bedrooms, 2 toilets, comfortable living room  & big kitchen plus easy access to several different public transportation systems and tons of restaurants, bakeries and food markets within a few minutes of walking!   It’s a very family family neighborhood & away from the tourist areas of the city.  You’ll love it!

Accommodation was ideally suited for the 4 of us, the age range being from 17 to 70 so everyone could literally do what they wanted. Everything was close to hand, various restaurants, bars and adequate local shops.
Travelling to local tram was only a few minutes away, allowing from there access to Berlin centre and onwards to our chosen destinations.
The apartment was spotlessly clean, and literally had everything we required for our stay.
Absolutely terrific.

Marcus was a fabulous host - easy to contact and gave us lots of recommendations and advice on travelling into the centre of the City.  The apartment was really clean, had a great shower and was in a brilliant location.  We found lots of cafes nearby and the whole area had a great vibe and was very friendly.  I would recommend Marcus and this apartment wholeheartedly and hope to return in the future.

Great location. Safe neighbourhood. Fairly quiet for ground floor apartment. Host excellent. Close to small supermarket, not much further to Lidl large supermarket.
We thoroughly enjoyed our stay! Thanks!
Thank you for helping us to find this nicely located apartment.  The area was top ten of ten possible. And the conversation with Marcus was super.
This was a lovely apartment, and the neighbourhood was fine. It was convenient for the city centre etc etc. The only down side was that it was very noisy.
The apartment was nice and just as depicted in the images.  The location was good for reaching all different parts of the city, and the host was very helpful with communication and check in.

At our arrival a person was waiting for us on time in front of the building. He guided us through the flat, provided some helpful information and answered our questions. The flat is really adapted for 6 people. The living room is big, the 2 bathrooms are very practical. A nice and quiet place. It is a few minutes walk from Alexanderplatz and very well connected with public transportation. We found cool place close to the flat to have brunch and dinner. A great stay ! We would definitely book this flat again if we come back to Berlin.

Spacious, clean and comfortable apartment. We stayed with 4 adults and our 14 month old daughter. A crib was taken care of. The kitchen is large and well equipped, the terras is great for relaxing in the sun. The neighbourhood is lively and packed with nice restaurants. Public transportation is easily accessible.
I highly recommend this apartment! The place is in a great location and it was very clean!! The host was also very responsive!!

Very calm (courtyard) and well placed right in the middle of the town with very convenient transportations nearby
Children quite active on the upper floor but c’est la vie and normal
Few things quite old/over-used in the apartment may need fixing/renewal but overall very nice place to visit Berlin
Great option if you are with friends. Clean and equipped apartment in a central location. Rooms are a bit small but the common area is huge.

The apartment is beautiful and spacious with great facilities. Check in was made easy with Yannis who was very accommodating. The location of the apartment as a base is perfect, with plenty of cool bars, restaurants and shops in the neighbourhood. We’d definitely stay again!
Lovely place that accommodated our group very well. I was under the weather and was very comfortable spending time as I recovered. Light and cheery main room, good for a group.
Lovely spacious apartment with bonus balcony. Great area with bars, restaurants and shops walkable. Responsive and helpful  hosts

Amazing location that is both private while also being close to everything. Amazing access to public transportation and walkable for everything.
The check-in process was perfect even though we had to change the time of check-in at the last minute. Overall great stay and would recommended to anyone visiting Berlin.
Will come back for sure. Nice area close to the center with loads of activities. Apartment was as sawn

Caterina has a great airbnb. We traveled to Berlin for 3 days staying there.  Everything was as described and my 2 kids were happy to each have their own rooms.  lots of space and tvs.  Wish there was a TV in the living room. We were here for the Euros and wanted to watch the games together that we weren't going to see in person but had to watch in a bedroom.  Other than that the outdoor common area including grass and bike area need to be cleaned up a bit but I totally understand that Caterina may not have control over that though since there are many other tenants.  We enjoyed having lunch at the Italian restaurant downstairs at Mozzarella and Pomodoro and a steak for dinner across the street at In the Bone.  Easy walk to Heckscher Market. Would stay again!

We had a great stay for the Berlin Marathon with our family! The apartment was right along the course, so the family not running could simply go outside to watch and cheer others on. The apartment was very close to both a tram stop/bus stop and train stop. Made it very easy to get around.

Nothing but 5 stars for this property, the location and the host.  Communication was clear and responsive and the apartment was stunning.  If you are considering staying in a really well connected area of Berlin then you should stay here.

Excellent location and great space in apartment for 5 people. Apartment has only basic supplies in kitchen and could have done with a tea towel but made it work. Great heating which worked well in chilly weather. Enjoyed our stay very much. Thank you.
Great apartment for a group. Close to restaurants and shopping.  Great stay in a great town.

Great stay in Berlin. The apartment was more than large enough for our group of 5.
The street is busy, so the front bedroom can be tough later at night, but the building itself was quiet.
Rooms were spacious, and the location is central to all. Plenty of restaurants and night shops are within walking distance.
Biggest downside was the wifi, which was basically nonexistent in the apartment.
Check-in was a breeze and the guys stored our luggage while they turned our apartment over.
Words do not do this place justice. Its exactly how it looks in the picture, gorgeous huge spacious and central to everywhere you want to go in berlin. I know where ill be staying on my return !!!
Fantastic apartment in a great location and a very warm welcome from Antonio. The apartment is very stylish, clean and has all that you need. Would highly recommend  this as a great place to stay.

A beautiful apartment with excellent amenities and in a perfect location. Antonio went out of his way to accommodate our early arrival. The apartment was spotless and check in/out was very easy. Breakfast in the cafe downstairs was a lovely addition to our stay; amazing coffee, great food and excellent service. We thoroughly enjoyed our long weekend in Berlin and are already planning a return trip! Thank you.
This is a really great apartment in a super location. Easy access from wherever you're arriving from. Many restaurants and cocktail bars in the area and also shopping. Antonio is a great host.
Great accomodation with 3 real bedrooms. Clean and well decorated. Great location on Prenzlauer Berg close to public transportation.  Very kind and helpful guest. Strongly advised.

This is a warm and comfortable apartment with great beds close to the metro station and walkable to the Berlin Wall Memorial.
We really enjoyed our stay in Berlin. Thank you.
My family and I had a perfect stay at Antonios place. Great location for getting around Berlin with kids and lots of cool shops, cafés and restaurants. I would definetly stay there again.

Great location, lots of room, good vibes.
Only slight problem was some noise from the main road at night ..

As we arrived before check in, we were grateful to be able to store our bags and start exploring Berlin.  Very happy with the apartment (loved all the plants!) and the location.  Very clean and comfortable, good heat and hot water, and great communication with the host.  Overall, very pleased!  Many thanks to Antonio and his team!!!

The apartment was spotless and a great size for us. Plenty of restaurants and cafes around and the town had a great buzz. Hosts were responsive, friendly and offered recommendations on what was available nearby. We were very happy!
We had a great stay at Saras lovely apartment.. Great communication, flexible check in / out..Perfect location, if you like the Kreuzberg area. We will come back, no doubt!..
Very friendly host and cozy room to stay! All facilities were there. Nearby metro station and a lot of nice bars/restaurants.
Super nice room quiet and comfy ! Sara is a super host, she takes care of you. Spacious room. It was a pleasure staying there

A very good and big apartment. It was very fresh and newly renovated.  We felt very welcome and Jan was very quick in responding to our questions. When it is hot in Berlin this apartment gives you a great resting place with a good temparature.
Clean, bright, spacious place in the Wedding neighbourhood. Near to team and metro station to get around easily. JAn was super helpful and communicative. great stay :)

Jan' s place was very clean and spacious,  convenient for a family of 5. It is equipped with every appliance we could ask for.. We stayed for a week in August and had a very good time.  In terms of location, it was OK, not very central but supermarket, stores and good transportation were very close. Could use blinds or dark curtains in the back room in order to avoid waking up early!

A great apartment. We have stayed with a group of 6 for the weekend and the space was sufficient.Note that the 6th bed is not a mattress but one person foldable sofa and it was OK.  The apartment is very conveniently located on the ground floor that helps if you have bulky luggage. Also the host allowed us check-in one hour before the official check-in. Communication was a bit slow with Jan but after i have called him, thing were going great. We definitely recommend his place.

Robert was an amazing host, and his flat was absolutely breathtaking in every aspect imaginable. He was incredibly helpful, kind and warm, informative, and so hospitable. I will certainly book with him the next time we come back to Berlin. 10/10!

Do yourself a favor and book this room with Robert! I couldn't imagine anyone having a bad experience here. The loft is absolutely beautiful and you have a whole floor to yourself with a private entrance and the most beautiful bathroom you've ever seen. The bed was so comfortable and the AC works great so we felt incredibly well rested while staying here! The best part about this place is getting to know Robert who is an absolutely wonderful person. So friendly and relaxed and full of knowledge about Berlin, we wish he was traveling with us! He gave us tons of good information about places to go and where to eat, and took so much time to make our trip great- he really went above and beyond! The apartment is in a great location, everything is a close walk and he had a beautiful rooftop terrace to enjoy as well. Also, we are in love with his sweet dog Jack. If we are ever back in Berlin we will absolutely be staying here again, thanks Robert!

It was really nice and perfect stay.. The host is so kind and best ever! he even has his own manual book for guests! :)
The room is big but cozy, and has seperate-bathroom. We would like to stay again- recommend for everyone no doubt!!
Fantastic host, beautiful apartment, fantastic location, comfy/cosy room. Would recommend staying with Robert to everyone, thank you for making our stay perfect!

Fantastic host, beautiful and private downstairs apartment in a complex very easily accessible by public transport. 15 minute walk from central train station and Brandenburg Gate. We had an excellent stay; could not recommend more.
What a wonderful, spacey and quiet place! Robert is a very nice man, who cares about his guests, his place and was very helpful with the city guide. Great place to start your Berlin trip.

Absolutely amazing is the only words that fit Robert and his place. I've stayed with Airbnb in 18 countries and this one was the best. I can't say enough how perfect the apartment is and how immaculate everything was.
This place is exactly as described, close to all forms of transport and is one of the best apartment Airbnbs I think you will ever find. Robert is amazing and you will love Jack to pieces!

Robert is the best host I've ever met, a five star house and five star host to be honest. The house is very artistically designed with modern and convenient facilities and the layout is perfect. I enjoyed my own private floor but at the same time, I also enjoyed the hospitality of Robert and his friends upstairs, especially those 2 dogs, they are so friendly and cute which melts my heart, it's so good to look at them play and touch them when I was back from sightseeing, so I rather call it a home.
In addition, I even had a waterbed in my room which is so soft and cozy and I had great sleep.
I hope to go back again.

the place is great (as it can be seen on the pictures). Robert is a very nice host and is happy to give tips and support for his guests.
Close to puplic transport, close the Tiergarten area for those who love to go running, you will reach many interessting locations wirhin less time. Even being that cental you might wonder how silent the place is located.

Such a beautiful home and host!
Very helpful, and full of suggestions!
His companion jack is an adorable added bonus!
Can't rate this place enough!
Robert's space is simply amazing, and the location is ideal for visitors. You can get around easily, and walk through the Tiergarten leisurely to shopping and food. We'll be back!

I would highly recommend staying at this apartment. Not only is Robert (the host) very warm, friendly, hospitable and thoughtful, but the apartment itself is stunning.
Staying here was an absolute pleasure and the smallest of details had been considered by Robert.
Be warned, the apartment is on the top floor of a 4 story building so the walk up the stairs is a bit of a workout!
The apartment is worth climbing every step as it is stylishly converted, comfortable, and has everything you need to make yourself at home.
As an added bonus, Jack the Labrador is always there to receive a stroke, and keeps himself to himself if that's what you prefer.

Everything is perfect in this exceptional apartment. Robert is very attentive and available. His information is precious to organize our stay. To recommend to all architecture lovers. And to people who want to make the most of their Berliner experience.

If there is a Michelin rating for Airbnb, this place is no doubt more than 5 stars.
The flat is spacious, contemporary decorated and full of love from the host. Rooftop offers fantastic view and space for relax.
Walking distance to the park, river and public transportation. Even better to cycle to town (15-20 mins)
I will definitely choose this place again
Robert is a very professionel host, the room a huge so are the apartment. There a at big rooftop that your are free to use. Lovely!

Great host, stylish flat! We will definitely come back!
Thanks for everything, Robert!

Hands-down, Robert's place is one of the best AirBnBs that I've stayed in. Robert was the warm and welcoming from the very first moment we walked in the door. I would highly recommend this place to anyone looking for accommodations in Berlin -- I just wish we had stayed longer!

You won’t be disappointed. If anyone has an opportunity to spend more than a couple of days to explore Berlin this is a great spot and quiet. The apartment was exceptionally private and clean. I can’t say enough wonderful things about Robert as a host. If you wish to have insight as to where to go he is a great travel assistant. Such a great sidekick of a pooch to join him. UnFortunately I visited at an exceptionally hot time of year, but the AC was perfect. Only very minor issue is the stairs. But I had just come from a crazy mountain hike over a week. I was very tired Robert help me with my luggage. Again I have a difficulty in finding anything potentially that I was unhappy with. I hope everyone that stays finds out what a little gem this is cause without a doubt I would return!

Robert's apartment is as wonderful as it looks and sounds and then a whole lot more. Every aspect was perfection including the fact that Robert was only ever a message away.
This was the most fabulous place to stay. I cannot recommend it enough.

we had a perfect weekend in Berlin thanks to Robert. the apartment/bed/shower was so good that we felt a sleep at 9:00 AM on a Saturday haha. the apartment is clean and everything you need is there. it feels like a 5 star hotelroom! Robert respects your privacy and at the same time he is very open for a chat. he can tell you everything about Berlin! I would absolutely recommend this apartment!

Roberts’s place was great for seeing the sights of Berlin, while coming home each evening to a lovely residential part of the city. The walk through the nearby park each day on the way to see the sights, the local cake shop and the stylish apartment space, made this a great stay for us. Robert’s help with maps, directions, explanations and recommendations were such a BIG help in making sure we got the most out of our stay from a valuable local person’s point of view. He also very kindly did a load of washing for us as we were on our long journey away from home.

Robert really was the perfect host - his flat is beautiful, stylish and has an amazing back story. He spent a lot of time talking us through recommendations for activities and was very responsive to our messages. In terms of location, we were able to walk into the centre through the Tiergarten but there's also the option of the S-bahn close by if you prefer to get the train.  Would definitely recommend to anyone to stay here. Thanks a lot Robert!

This man deserves a medal for world class hosting skills. Highly recommend that anyone staying in Berlin choose Robert, it was like staying with a personal guide who was respectful of personal space and knowledgable of hidden gems of the city. He had an amazing home with next level amenities, great value for money complete with a very friendly dog. 10/10

Perfect place to visit Berlin. Near to restorants, museums and public transport. The home is just amazing, every detail and the kindness of Robert and Jack make us feel in home. Robert was very nice to gave us all information for near areas. Definitely we will love to come back to Robert and Jack's home.

We totally loved Robert’s loft. The standard of the room and bathroom were amazing. His loft is exceptional. Robert gave us brill info so we found it easy to find his place. He let us check in early which was great. Robert gave us lots of very useful info on what we could do and great recommendations of places to eat close by. As he’s close to UBann its easy to get around all the sights. The best air b&b we have been in

Beautiful place, beautiful host, beautiful dog. The pictures do not do the place justice. Be sure to know that Rob is an exceptional host who made me and my boyfriend welcome from the first interaction. You won’t be disappointed with your stay!

Robert is an amazing host and his helpful daily  tips meant that we had an incredible first experience of Berlin.  The room is beautiful, Robert is a warm, wonderful host, and Jack the dog is a joy to be around. Thank you Robert for making our Berlin experience such a special one.
Roberts place a set in a gorgeous area of Berlin. Upon arrival he made us feel at home, and even gave us some wonderful ideas on where to go in Berlin. He was a wonderful host!

Robert was so responsive, I'm inclined to think he sits at his laptop and waits for the guests , and prospective guests, to email him.  He is a wonderful host, and gave great tips for places to eat and things to do.  Getting from the airport to the room is always the worst part of traveling for me, and his directions made it 'turn-key'.  He was the best host we have had.  If Berlin in on your list, stay with Robert...and his best friend Jack is awesome, too! ... he never barked once, and loves apples for a treat.

This is the very first time I have booked accommodation via Airbnb and my stay at Robert's loft exceeded my expectations. The place itself is absolutely stunning, super clean and lots of space. The beautiful terrace was an added bonus. I was able to sit in the sun and take in the view of Berlin.
Robert and Jack were fabulous hosts. Robert was so easy to talk to and made my partner and I feel so welcome. Not only did Robert provided us lots of information about the topical tourist areas, but also informed us of some more quieter areas which were lovely to visit.
I cannot recommend Robert enough and I have already decided to arrange to stay at Robert's loft apartment when I visit Berlin again.
We would like to say a huge thank you to Robert for contributing to our wonderful Berlin experience.
Comfortable stay in a funky loft flat with warm welcome from the owner and his dog. Very good location for seeing the sights of Berlin. Thoroughly recommend.
Amazing apartment in the center of Berlin. Robert was more than willing to help us out! If you ever want to visit Germany’s capital, I would definitely recommend this place!

Oh, that "super host" title is so well deserved!! Truly wonderful host. One of those you will definitely want to come back to. Great communication, very helpful, Robert provided us with a super map of local cafes, bakeries, restaurants, and other stuff. Robert's place is HUGE but at the same time cosy, clean and very quiet. We had a great time walking around. Since it's located almost "in the middle of everything" we took a taxi only one time.  Highly recommend!

We had a lovely time at Robert’s apartment. The apartment is super comfortable in a nice neighbourhood. Public transport is close by so you can easily go everywhere you want to. Robert’s a lovely host who will ensure you have a nice stay, and he can give you al kinds of tips. We absolutely advice this place when visiting Berlin!

An Absolutely wonderful place to stay, Robert's loft is beautiful, clean, and huge! The rooftop terrace was a perfectly lovely spot to relax with a cup of tea, look over the city, and just breathe after far too many hours spent traveling, and that magnificent shower was an godsend! The bedroom is also large, neat, and very comfortable, with big windows and nice lighting.
I wholeheartedly recommend staying at the Duck Loft, Robert is kind, helpful, and very friendly to chat with, and you might meet Jack, a very relaxed pup who's happy to get some love!

Such an amazing stay! Robert makes you feel like you’re an old friend coming for a visit. This kind of experience is exactly what you want in a new city. You feel welcomed and looked out for, while being given the space to explore on your own. As directionally challenged folks, we were also very grateful for the map! We would rather stay here than anywhere else in Berlin, and will absolutely be coming back.

Amazing stay in a great location! The room is amazing and offers the perfect blend of privacy and warmth. Robert is a wonderful host and offered so much helpful advice and support on our first visit to Berlin. I would definitely stay here again and I hope to do so in the future :)
Robert is great! Location, the area is everything was great. If you don’t have a problem with stairs then go for it.
Modern and central apartment that was absolutely immaculate and very comfortable. Friendly host and check in came with lots of good recommendations.
The apartment is superb and has a lot of character. Robert was very welcoming and made arrival very easy. It’s worth visiting Berlin to stay in his apartment!
robert was such a great host. friendly and helpful. the space is truly amazing. I hope the next time I come to Berlin I will be able to stay here again.
Robert was a friendly host and helped us with everything we needed for our stay! The bed was so comfortable, shower was amazing, and jack the dog was a big plus!

Robert's place is beautiful and he is a great host. He's really put a lot of work and love to build his home. We felt lucky to find his property on airbnb, a real gem. His place is only a short 20min walk to Berlin central station with plenty of local options for food and drink. I highly recommend staying here.

What an amazing host, very friendly and nice. Helpful for recommendations and finding things around, really flexible, allowed us to put the bags in the place before check in and leave them there after.
The apartment is super modern, clean and well maintained, we loved it and enjoyed every moment of staying there.

We absolutely loved our stay at Robert’s place. He is a fantastic host and generously welcomed us into his home.
We also loved Jack the yoghurt pot licker. The accomodation was amazing a highlight of our trip so far. Highly recommend this place. Touring around Berlin is easily done using public transport from this location. Great river walk and great restaurants close by.

Great location! Robert was nice and friendly.
The apartment is as you see in pictures, very beautiful.
One night wasn't enough, hope to come back!
Stunning decor of a tasteful conversion - many steps without a lift are ok if you don’t have the luggage we needed to struggle with.
Robert’s place was great! Robert was helpful, kind, and easy to communicate with. The location of the apartment was great, accessible to everywhere via metro!

Robert’s place was amazing. His hospitality really made Berlin that much better. The space was private and had everything you need. It is located near a train stop which made it easy to get everywhere with the S train. I would recommend this air bnb to anyone! It was truly a pleasure.
This is my second stay with Robert. Lovely area. Immaculate lodgings. 80 something steps (5 flights) only a problem if you have a lot of luggage.

If you want to visit Berlin, this is the place to be! It is close to the Main Trainstation (10min with S-Bahn), is huge and very clean. This is one of the best Airbnbs I have visited! Robert is ver friendly and helpful! His flat is amazing and our flat had an own entrance and you feel like you live in your own flat!
We really recommend this place and if we visit Berlin again, we will definitely stay at this place!

If I could give Robert's place 6 stars, I would. We've stayed in nearly 40 Airbnbs over the years, and this was the best! He is clear about the stairs, so you will get some exercise coming home at night, but this balances well with all the excellent food nearby, so it allows you to burn some of it off. The bed is incredibly comfortable, and the flat itself is truly a work of art. We stayed in the room on the 4th floor, which has its own interest (so a little fewer stairs) and the most amazing shower room. When next in Berlin, we'll definitely come back to Robert's place!
I had a great stay in the room of Oliver, good / fast communication, easy and convenient check in, nice host.
The place is very nice. But the attitude of host is very bad and threat the guest even small Thing happend. And, the Thing could be solved by communication.

Oliver is a such a nice host. He prepared very well before I entered the place. Also He asked if there were any inconveniences just tell him! The place is cozy and it was enough for two people. The location is also good. It takes only 30-40mins to the Berlin dorm and museums. Also there are restaurants and Rewe near there! I would recommend this place for sure!!
It's a nice place to stay for a few days, the owners answer fast and the place is clean.

Our stay with Oliver and Katrin was absolutely wonderful! The accommodation was perfectly clean, cozy, and had everything we needed for our few-night stay.
