We really appreciated the private entrance directly from the garden. The location is amazing—it's a quiet and safe area, yet it's close to everything important, with great access to the city center and plenty of fantastic restaurants. Parking on a nearby street was also no problem at all. We highly recommend it! Thank you so much!

Me and 6 friends all live in central Berlin and wanted to go somewhere just outside Berlin for New Years. We absolutely loved Sven's place. It was the perfect place for us all to spend time together, great kitchen for all cooking together, and the living room was amazing - the sofa area is really cosy, and there's a big space where we could dance. And the decor is modern and stylish, with lots of beautiful plants. The beds were also comfy. Sven and his wife were very accommodating and let us bring our pet dog too. Location wise - it's in the suburbs, which was great for us as we wanted to get out of the city, but the area itself is not very pretty - it's very residential. It's easy to get into town though, just 15 mins on the tram.
This is a fantastic apartment.  It has a great location. It is super clean.  It had everything you could need for your stay.  Felix is very helpful and answers any question you need.

The apartment is great, modern, clean and very well located.
The neighborhood is very nice. Felix assist on every thing we asked for.
I recommend it.

This apartment is amazing. It is ideally located in Berlin, in a beautiful and peaceful place. It is well found and very comfortable.
We had the warmest welcome from Felix.
I highly recommend this place!

My family totally enjoyed staying in this beautiful and thoughtful set up Airbnb. It's equipped with everything you need - and hearing the yard's fountain lapping while lying in the comfortable beds is absolutely enjoyable.
Felix was a very welcoming host and always available for any questions - thank you very much for that!

It's a large apartment, in a convenient location, with good restaurants nearby.  We especially liked the restaurant on the corner, "Cafe Lentz", for breakfast.  It's nice having a large kitchen and 2 bathrooms.  Philipp is very responsive.

This is a wonderful place to stay in Berlin; great neighborhood, convenient transportation, helpful hosts and a generously sized space that is stylish and comfortable. Consider yourself lucky if it is available for your dates.

Wonderful, spacious apartment in a great neighborhood. Quiet but very close to restaurants, bars, cafes, etc. Checkin and checkout were seamless. Loved this place -- felt like I actually lived in Berlin and wasn't ready to leave!
A great apartment in a great location – we had a few local friends over for dinner and drinks; and we all agreed the place was, indeed, stylishly and architecturally stunning!

Beautiful, clean and spacious apartment in a great location. Lots of restaurants and bars within a 10 minute walk. Hosts were quick to respond and very helpful. I would definitely recommend this place!

An elegant pad in a neighbourhood close to the city. The building in which it is situated is safe, family friendly and has great gardens to enjoy...and is very stylish. Great communication also and fully recommend this great apartment
Perfect apartments with nice quiet garden. Many thanks to Felix, he arranged very early arrival for us.
a huge apartment (you could basically start a family there haha), perfect for hanging out. Perfectly clean and in a good neighborhood.

Overall my partner and I had a great stay at Felix’s place. It is ideally located with plenty of great locations in walking distance and the rest only a cheap ride away. The place is exactly as shown in the pictures and is very comfortable. We had a couple hiccups over the course of our stay, but Felix was always very responsive and quick the fix the problems. I would definitely recommend staying here to anyone in the future.

The apartment is in a very nice, quiet area and the apartment itself is so beautiful and unique.  I loved it.  It was stocked with most everything we needed and groceries, transportation, and restaurants are an easy walking distance away.  I highly recommend.
Beautiful and clean apartment close to an amazing park and some good restaurants. The host was super responsive and friendly.  My family of 4 had plenty of space.
The place was roomy and lovely with comfortable beds and a nice courtyard. Phillip was very helpful with Any questions we had about how things worked. It was a wonderful stay!

Easy location. Liked the double door security. Phillipp was a great communicator and accommodating to our slightly earlier check-in time. The place is a little older and has some quirks to it (eg one of the bedroom door handles come off when closing) but if the point of your trip is less about staying in and more about seeing Berlin and enjoying the city, it’s a great place to stay!
The flat was as expected. We had no troubles finding it and checking in. we had a pleasent stay

We really enjoyed our stay at Mariusz rooftop flat. The apartment is situated in a nice area of Berlin _ central but also quiet.  Because the weather was good,  we had dinner on the terrace enjoying the fantastic views over the city.  We would like to return.

Marius'z place was great - in a good location with some great restaurants just a few blocks away. We loved Prinz and YumCha Heroes specifically! Also about a 5 min walk from the U8 and other public transportation. The place itself has two rooms - a bedroom and living room with a low bed in it (that has a door), along with a bathroom and kitchen. The patio has a cool view of Alexanderplatz.
Mariusz's place is a great location with an awesome view. Mariusz is very accommodating and I couldn't have asked for a better host. I'll be keeping an eye out for his place whenever I'm in Berlin.
Martin was very friendly, helpful and great as a host and the apt was very nice in a great neighborhood, we would definitely come back!
The apartment is bright and located very centrally. Rosenthaler Platz is just around the corner. Great place.
Mariusz’ flat is in a great location to explore all parts of Berlin! The balcony has an amazing view as well.

Really a very nice location! Only a bit exhausting when its hot since its the top floor with no lift, but if your fit, its no problem at all. very smooth communication, nice sitting area & kitchen and the beautiful view!

We really enjoyed our stay here. The apartment was clean, bright and had everything we needed. The rooftop terrace was a great bonus — perfect spot to relax. The location was quiet but still close to shops, restaurants and public transport. Would definitely stay again!

We had a wonderful time at Tatiana's apartment. It felt very homey, and the decor and apartment felt cosy and open. The check-in was flexible, which was appreciated due to our late flight. I would definitely recommend this apartment to other travellers.
Nice and spacious apartment, close to subway and local trains. You can really stay twelve people (eight adults and four children) if you want. Good contact with Werner.

Very fine apartment. We hade a lovely time in Berlin. The location was a bit far from the city centers, however, the u-bahn was pretty close to the apartment. We would recommend the apartment for other tourists!

Werner's apartment is really nice. Lots of space. All rooms are big and clean. It's in a nice quiet neighborhood.
Werner was easy to communicate with and he gave a good introduction to Berlin.
I can recommend a stay in Werner's apartment.

The appartment was huge with everything we needed and more and in good condition.  2 minutes walk from the metro to easily get to any part of Berlin. Werner was an excellent host, very friendly, funny and helpful. I would recommend him to anyone.

We loved to stay in Werners apartment. It is close to a metro station. In 15 minutes it gets you in the City center.
Everything we could think of was available. When we mentioned a small problem, Werner immediately replied and solved it.
On the Ringbahnstrasse close to the apartment there is a great sushi restaurant!
It is always a pleasure to stay in one of Werner'sapartments. He is a super friendly and welcoming host. I will always try to get one of his apartments again. Thanks for the great weekend.

We (4 work colleagues) stayed at Werner's place during a large exhibition. The apartment provided an apartment within and private space for our CEO which was great was very convenient and the perfect facility not too far from the Messe Berlin for all of us. We enjoyed our stay here and would come back.

Amazing place to stay, very welcoming. A perfect distance between the airport and the city. With close transport connections couldnt rate this apartment high enough.
Thanks for a great stay.

Lovely spacious apartment, perfect for a big group. Werner is very thoughtful, meeting us on arrival and providing lots of recommendations about places to visit in Berlin. Apartment was very clean and well set-up for visitors. We had a great weekend, thank you!

Werner was a friendly and enjoyable host with a lovely place for  large groups. The place was clean and  has everything you can ask for. The traffic connections are good. I can only recommend this place to everyone.Vielen Dank für die tolle Zeit!

I booked this apartment for myself and 14 friends. It was absolutely amazing. A lot of space, many bathrooms, all
the facillties you need, perfect location, and above all, clean! Werner is a awsome host. His response time is no more then an hour. He gave us a tour in the apartment, served us coffee, and answered all our questions. We really had a great time in Berlin. It's such a amazing city. If we ever come back it will be in this aparment!!!!
greetz,
Berend

Werner was very helpful, my plane arrived early and he came to the apartment to let me in early. I really appreciated this gesture. The apartment is made for large groups, but for our smaller group it was fantastic, we all had our own room and bathroom. Everything we needed was supplied, as described in the advert. The U and S bahn are close by making trips into the Centre very easy. There are shops and restaurants close by. We loved shopping in The nearby Lidl’s.
We really enjoyed our stay in Werner’s apartment and would book again. Thank you Werner.

Werner was great! The place is also amazing. It not in the center of Berlin but public transport is very close by.
I would recommend Werner and his place to everyone.

The flat is in a great location, close to everywhere and has a lot to offer in its neighborhood Tempelhof.
Especially great for big groups, it offers everything you‘re looking for!

Werner was a great communicative host and was helpful when our arrival plans changed. The flat and location were perfect for us as a larger group, looking for something that was good value, unfussy, and with easy access to the city. Would highly recommend.

We had a great time at the airbnb, it was very well equipped and ideal for our large group.
As well Werner was a very accommodating and professional host
Flat is very nice and well located - wunderful balcony males the deal. Natalia was very kind and easy-going.

The apartment was immaculate, comfortable, and welcoming. Natalia met us upon our arrival and was very helpful and accommodating.

It is pleasantly bright, peaceful and quiet inside but not far from the city's super day- and nightlife: the S-Bahn and trams are only a very short walk away.

We enjoyed our stay very much and would recommend this apartment to all visitors of Berlin.
Lovely modern apartment in great location. Natalia was very welcoming and easy contacted if needed. Would definitely recommend to others.

The apartment is modern, bright and airy.  Natalia communicates very well, and answers all our questions quickly. The bigger bed is more like a queen size (North American standards), but everything is comfortable and clean.  Again, for us North Americans, I'm not used to a five story walk up, but if you can handle that you'll love this place. This is a great base to explore Berlin from!

Natalia was a great host, the apartment was very nice, clean and well accessible with public transport. It is just good to be aware that the apartment is on the uppest floor with no elevator and sometimes it feels a lot of stairs. Otherwise, this is a great place to stay and highly recommendable!

We really enjoyed our stay at Natalias appartement. It is a beautiful, clean appartement. We were really surprised how quiet it was at night. I highly recommand this place. The communication with Natalia was very good.

We had a great stay at Natalia's roof apartment. It was
stylishly refurbished, cozy, clean and equipped with everything you need. And Natalia was really a super host! We would love to come back - maybe in the summer with sunny days and evenings on the terrace.
Quiet and very clean well presented flat with a high standard of fittings and decor. Very nice terrace.
Very nice, clean and stylish apartment with a friendly host. Close to the tram station and cool shops in the neighbourhood.

We had a great weekend at Natalia’s place. The apartment was very clean, and even better looking than the photos. It felt like a proper home, with flowers, pictures, nice small details and a very inviting balcony. Natalia was easy to communicate with, she gave us all information needed in good time before arrival, and gave us a warm welcome. The apartment is in a quiet area without any noise during the night. The only negative thing for us was that there wasn’t an elevator, and the apartment is on the fifth floor.  That’s a lot of steps with luggage or after a day of walking! Else from that we would recommend everyone to stay at Natalia’s place. We will definitely go back sometime!

Lovely, light apartment in a quiet neighbourhood with excellent public transport connections very nearby. Also some good local restaurants. Natalia was very hospitable and helpful and the apartment was super clean and welcoming. Delightful terrace with plants and flowers to relax on after sightseeing. Recommend you travel light, as it’s on the 5th floor without a lift! Excellent place to stay in Berlin - the 4 of us stayed 6 nights and had a great time.

Natalia's space is wonderful! It is in a great neighborhood, and incredibly clean. Natalia was incredibly communicative and clear about check in and out, house rules, and local recommendations. I would recommend this space to all!

This apartment is 💯. Very central to all local transport etc. Its extremely clean and presented with a high quality of stylish furniture and decor. Kitchen was well equipped. Full travellers pack with directions etc.  Host was pleasant and charming. The apartment became home within minutes.  The location is so quiet and very secure. Local shops with everything one needs for a meal plan etc. Berlin left me wanting more than a few days break. The apartment and host was first class.  Look no further stick with this one👍🏼

Three of us enjoyed 5 nights at Natalia's apartment and had a great stay. It's more spacious than it looks in the pictures and was a perfect base for our sightseeing. The apartment feels modern and clean, and had everything we needed in the kitchen (the dishwasher was much appreciated!). It's close to the trams so getting around was easy, and there are some nice cafes and restaurants close by. Natalia was really easy to communicate with and helpful, we'd definitely stay again. You do have to walk up 5 flights of starirs to get to the apartment, although we ended up appreciating the workout after all the delicious meals we had!
A highly recommended guest and place, great communication and the place is really neat for a relaxing time (and the small terrace is waiting for you!).

Really enjoyed fine days in Berlin. Natalia and Jens' place is on the mark as a fine 5th-floor apartment with a nice outdoor area. It is clean, comfortable, and convenient. The communication, reception and overall support is absolutely excellent and greatly appreciated. If we're back in the area, we will be certain to check in again. A fine place and excellent service.

This place was perfect for our family of four. Natalia was there to meet us when we arrived, and she was clearly a warm and kind person. Her place was located near great parks and restaurants and shops (all a 10 minute walk, at most), and was a peaceful and quiet home base for our trips around the city. We would absolutely stay here again if we returned to Berlin. Thank you, Natalia!

Natalia's apartment was spotlessly clean, perfectly situated and very well appointed. Natalia greeted us when we arrived and showed us around. We had everything we needed for our stay, including some electric fans which were very helpful in the heat!
The apartment building and the surrounding area is very quiet but only a short walk away from the necessities and transport links.
We will be more than happy to stay at Natalia's place next time we're in Berlin.

We loved our stay at Natalia’s place, she was a fantastic host and we would recommend to anyone! She gave very clear check in instructions and was there to meet us. The apartment was pristine and looked just like the photos, it was also wonderful to have a balcony to sit out on and enjoy the weather. It is in a good location just a short walk to the nearest tram stop to take you to all the tourist spots. The neighbourhood itself is lovely and definitely worth exploring. There’s a supermarket really close which is so convenient!

We really enjoyed staying in Natalia's Rooftop apartment. It was spacious, clean, nicely decorated and quiet. There are a lot of restaurants and facilities in the neighborhood, but the area is still very quiet. Natalia's instructions were extremely helpful, especially as we were in Berlin for the first time.
We would certainly go back to the Rooftop the next time we are in Berlin!
A+ stay! Lovely and comfortable apartment with lots of light. Within walking distance of all Prenzlauer Berg has to offer. Would stay again visiting Berlin!

Lovely flat, super clean, very very comfortable beds, so quiet at night, very safe. Pretty much perfect! Only downside was that fact there was no lift, 5 flights of stairs can be a lot! Supermarket just 2 minutes away as well which was super useful. Thank you Natalia
I am pretty sure that anytime I go to Berlin, I will book Natalia”s apartment to stay. Highly recommended!

The apartment is on the 6th floor, with a great view of the TV Tower and the east-side. Big windows allow lots of natural light, and they open up, bringing in fresh air.
The kitchen was great, we were able to cook a few dinners for a family of four. Really nice to have a kitchen when traveling, saving time and funds. And keeping kids fed!
The grocery store and fruit stand are just a block away. Really came in handy.
Getting around Berlin was easy. The U8 is just outside the building, getting you to Mitte or Kreuzberg in 10 minutes.
The apartment was clean, the water hot, the beds comfy. Cable TV, WIFI all included. Overall a great place to stay for a week!

My 4 friends and I stayed at Ayse's apartment for 5 nights and had a great time.

Ayse's place was great. The location was a quick train ride away from good food/shopping and tourist things. Our only complaint is that the wifi wasn't very good, it was certainly useable, but there were times when I had to unconnected and re-connect a few times to get anything to load.
Our checkin was a bit messy because I had been messaging Ayse in the Airbnb messaging system and her friend who was there to meet us had responded via other ways that didn't reach me, but we got in touch eventually and it all worked out. It would have been nice to get a response in the usual place from the start though, it would have saved a lot of trouble for both sides!
Everything else was great, the apartment was nice, clean, exactly what we needed for our stay!

Flat is good.
Location might me better but connection is good and you can reach any part of the city easily.
A really great place to explore Berlin. Near metro and train station, close to touristic place. A quiet place ideal for family.

Sven’s place was perfect for our visit. The place is spacious and has great common spaces including a dining room table. The location is great, next to a subway and grocery stores, restaurants, and clubs; but the flat itself was very quiet. The cherry on top were the slippers for each of us guests to use during our stay.

The place was perfect, very clean and well thought out with all the little details. We were met by Caro who was of great help. She took her time to explain all that we needed to know for our stay in Berlin.
The communication was great with Sven.
We highly recommend staying at Sven’s any time.

We spent a very enjoyable 6 nights at Sven’s place in December.
The Apartment is as described. We found it to be clean, spacious and well appointed with everything we needed for a relaxing stay. The beds and pillows were particular comfortable. It was warm and cosy during our winter stay.
The location is excellent - within easy walking distance of U Bahn and S Bahn stations. Shops and eateries are also close by.
Sven was very helpful and easy to deal with. As was Shpresa, who met us at the Apartment and explained everything to us.

It was my first stay in an old DDR building (Plattenbau) and I guess it got renovated in the recent years, as it was not as clairaudient as expected. :-)
The apartment itself is well equipped and its location was really good, as it's possible to reach many cool district by 30 minutes walking or a 10 minute drive with the subway, which is right next to the building.
I will keep the apartment on my list for future visits!
Great spot and communication! The host is very polite, no problems with check in and check out.

Note that this review is only based on the communication with Sven, who is welcoming, easy to talk to and a great guy. We had to cancel last minute, and Sven was very understanding and helped in every way he could. We will look forward to staying at Svens another time.
A great apartment in a great location. Well-equipped kitchen, comfortable beds and furniture. Well located to access u- and s-bahn networks.
Had a good stay at the Airbnb,  super calm neighbourhood close to lots of supermarkets and bakery’s. We really enjoyed our time here :)
Great apartment and location. Sven was very responsive and flexible regarding our check-in. Loved our stay!
Was first time I have been in Berlin. Such a great experience and the place was perfect location and clean. I’m planning to go Berlin again and I’m sure will stay Sven’s house again. Thank you 🙏

This was a really lovely apartment, perfect for the 3 of us. The apartment was clean, spacious, we were kindly greeted upon arrival by a knowledgeable colleague of Sven. Perfect location right near the train station, close to clubs, supermarkets, cafes. Short train to the centre of town. Would highly recommend it to anyone staying in Berlin!

We enjoyed our stay at Sven's place. There was a leaky sink but Sven had it fixed immediately - excellent service. Also Laura (Sven's colleague who checked us in) gave very helpful instructions about the travel from the airport to the accommodation.

We were met by one of the hosts. She showed us how everything worked. She let us know that she would be quickly available if we needed anything. the apartment was spacious and clean. These hosts did my favorite thing. They wrote down everything. How to get to the market. How to do the recycle/trash. How to use the washer. The area is walkable. we enjoyed the stay.

We would happily stay again at Sven’s place. It covered all our needs comfortably: great location for getting around town quickly, well-stock modern kitchen for our cooking needs, excellent heat & plumbing, great internet, helpful information for 1st-time visitors to Berlin, bright and clean rooms and quiet nights for sleeping, easy and accomodating interactions with Sven before and during our stay.
100% pleased with our week at Sven’s.
Great location, especially if you're in town for a conference or event. Most of Mitte & East Berlin is nearby (10 mins).

The apartment is in East Berlin, and looks like a communist era building. It was clean, but the walls could use some paint. Sven and his colleague Hasan were very helpful and communicative. The neighborhood is good, a little sketchy for one block in only one direction. There is a very convenient U-Bahn a short walk away, but this station has no escalator or elevator; another station two loner blocks away has both. There is also a good small grocery store and good restaurants nearby, and lots of fast food takeaway. The apartment building has an elevator that only stops on the first, third, sixth and ninth floors. Luckily the apartment is on the sixth floor. There are four steps inside the building to get to the first floor. The apartment is totally nonsmoking (good), but the building is not and the hall and elevator smelt of cigarettes. We do recommend the apartment, as long as mobility is not an issue.

Sven’s place was absolutely brilliant, the location was great and the apartment was clean and just what we wanted. Would highly recommend Sven’s place for anyone travelling to Berlin. Sven was also very responsive and friendly as a host.

The flat was very clean & comfortable. It is the perfect spot to base your family to visit Berlin. Easy access to all transport links. Sven went over and above to get my family recommendations for places to eat - we have 2 coeliacs & require gluten free food. There is a great view of the TV tower. The kitchen is well equipped. It is near a main road but quiet at night. We had a wonderful time in Berlin, we did a walking & a cycling tour & we even got to visit a lake on a hot day for a swim.  Everything was easily accessible from the apartment and there were grocery stores nearby. I found Sven very accommodating. I would stay here again.
Great place to stay. Luckily we got the apartment much earlier than the check-in time. Has all the amenities you will need and we felt very welcomed by the host.
Place was great.  The location was super convenient - we took the train to sightsee.  Very walkable..  great restaurants and cafes within walking distance

Great place for a fair price. Sven and his team were great hosts. They were great about warly check in and an hour late check out. The apartment is nice and comfortable for 4 friends and has all the amenities listed. Very nice and quite neighbourhood with lots of things to do around. From museums and coffee to walking/biking and. clubbing/having a drink. The only thing we had to add is that the apartment could have been a bit more clean. First day we cleaned some spaces by ourselves because it was not properly cleaned. nothing too much. but not what anyone would expect. overall we had a great stay at Svens place. If we ever visit again we'll probably choose the same again.

Apartment is super connected to everything that you need (and Berlin is rather big), and if you like walking/biking around even better. Pictures perfectly describe the apartment and all necessary and listed amenities are there. In these days where every 2nd AirBnB markets itself with all the amenities that you need, and in reality there are 2 forks, 1 pan, and 1 towel for 5 people, Sven's place actually has everything listed and more. Kitchen is fully equipped so you can actually use it, there are more than enough clean sheets/towels and everything else you'll need for stress-free stay. We greatly enjoyed the apartment and would be happy to come again.
All the recommendations!

Great apartment! It was very clean, spacious and was equipped with everything you needed. The TV tower from the apartment windows was just incredible. The location was super convenient to bus, u-bahn stations, supermarkets, and eating places. All are within walking distance. Sven was easy to communicate and very responsive. I would highly recommend Sven’s place for anyone travelling to Berlin.

We had a peaceful stay in Berlin. The accommodations were clean and what we expected. It was nice to have a BioMarket right downstairs. The breeze kept the place cool and we were able to quickly dry our clothes on the rack. Any minor inconveniences were promptly addressed by friendly service. Would stay again!

We stayed three nights in Sven’s apartment. We loved to get to know this part of Berlin, also the UBahn was a few minutes walking distance from the apartment.
Everything at Sven’s apartment was as pictured. The check-in and check-out was easy and he was very responsive and friendly.
We will book his place again when we come back to Berlin.

The apartment is amazing. We were 11 and it is really comfortable and we felt that each bedroom was very private. It would be great if they can buy a microwave oven. It was everything new and very nice decorated. Although it is not  centrally located, it is at few meters to a metro station. It was very easy the communication with host, we found the check in range time a little bit limited. Overall, I highly recommend this apartment for a large group.

Wow -- this flat was even better than the photos. My group of 10 fit comfortably and there was plenty of places to hang out and chat. It's just steps from the Hermannplatz U-bahn stop and close to Newkoln's amazing bars and restaurants. I'd definitely stay here again. Thanks Trudy!
Gorgeous apartment. Lovely and clean, and well equipped. Thoughtful details like shampoo, shower gel and lots of toilet roll makes a real difference!

What an amazing property! So stylishly decorated, lots of space, sparkling clean and all the amenities you could need. We were a party of 8 and didn’t struggle at all with space. Location is right next to Hermannplatz station so can be in Alexanderplatz in about 10 mins. The area itself is very ‘cool’ and can feel different to other parts of Berlin (in my experience) but easy to walk or jump on public transport to quickly get to sights an other areas. There’s also an Aldi 5 min walk away which is handy!
Great experience thanks Trudy!

We really enjoyed the flat which is beautifully decorated, spacious and clean. Our experience would have been perfect if the host was more flexible on check in/out times and if welcome from host was a bit more warm, rather than a long list of potential charges for not complying with house rules.
This is one of the nicest apartments I have stayed in - period. Clean, spacious and very well located. It even comes with an elevator that opens into the apartment. Just lovely.
A spacious and modern apartment with a tiny garden; we were 5, one per room, and have enjoyed our stay at Trudy’s apartment very much.
Stylish, spacious apartment. Easy check in process and great location. Perfect for a large group. Would definitely recommend.

Perfectly furnished apartment and fully equipped kitchen than has everything you wish for!
The place was super cosy and spacious for us as a group and well located (directly at Hermannplatz) as shops, restaurants and public transport could be easily reached by foot.
The communication with and check-in organized by Trudy was very informative and easy!
We can fully recommend her place and would return any time.

Everything was fine
Nice flat nice location quiet safe cosy clean and safety and enough space for all
Really appreciate !
Thank you Trudy
Super nice place to stay, we have booked with Trudy 4 years in a row now and we are definitely planning to come back next year.

The apartment was very spacious and comfortable for a group of 9, with lots of privacy possible for everyone. Our beds were very comfortable and the apartment had lots of light. Plus, the proximity to the U7 and U8 made it very accessible to get around town as well as to the airport.
Super spacious, well decorated, well equipped. Right next to a subway stations makes seeing the city a breeze
Good location, easy to walk to restaurants and get around. The apartment was lovely and clean too. Would recommend.
It was the perfect place for our family of 5 to spend the holidays! Super comfortable and easy, and in a great neighborhood!

Thank you so much for hosting us in your lovely apartment in Berlin. We had a wonderful stay and really enjoyed exploring the city from such a comfortable and convenient home base.
The location of the apartment was perfect for us - it was within easy walking distance of some of the city's best attractions and there were plenty of great restaurants and cafes nearby. We also appreciated the quiet neighbourhood, which allowed us to get a good night's sleep without any disturbances.
The apartment itself was impeccably clean and well-maintained. We were impressed by how spacious and comfortable it was, and we appreciated all the thoughtful amenities you provided, including the fully equipped kitchen and the comfortable beds.
Finally, we want to thank you for being such a gracious and communicative host. You were always available to answer our questions and provide recommendations, and you went above and beyond to make our stay as comfortable and enjoyable as possible.

Stylish and comfortable.  Location is not central, but easy to find and very close to U-barn and only 6 stops to Alexanderlatz (get a 7-day pass A or AB).  Close to Aldi and other shops. Lots of restaurants near by (walk).  No A/C but lots of windows (that open) and fans.  Check in, check out and layout all exactly as described.  Be aware that WiFi only works well in the front of the appartment.  Small garden surrounded by a larger green space (well kept grave yard).  Would definitely stay again
Nice big apartment for our big family. Clean and newly renovated bathrooms, kitchen well equipped. Next to supermarkets and metro. Only minus the WiFi, that did not work in all rooms.
Location was great for us - we were a family of 7 people staying and were able to commute where we needed to easily. Apartment itself was lovely - spacious and nicely decorated. We had a great stay.

This is a terrific apartment at a very reasonable price for a larger family or group of friends. The layout creates three private zones, which was great for late sleepers, and the common space is perfect for groups to gather. Kitchen was well appointed for cooking and very clean, as were the bathrooms, floors, furniture and linens. We felt relaxed and comfortable and safe, right away. The cemetery behind the building (our view) was very tranquil and lovely and made us feel as if we were in a quiet neighborhood, even though we were in a bustling street. The neighborhood is not particularly elegant (it’s a little gritty, in truth) but we found some great markets and restaurants in walking distance, as well as some charming blocks, and popping into the center of Berlin was quite easy via Uber, taxi or mass transit. In all, this was a great experience and I would highly recommend the apartment.

The place was great, the price for the venue was worth it, easy access to train station, the provided everything we needed for a business trip, toilets were heated well for winter, pantry nicely equipped, host however was very particular about the people checking in and required alot of details which seems unnecessarily troublesome, but would still recommend the place for larger groups for the aesthetic and convenience of the place.

We had a fabulous stay.  The apartment was beautifully prepared for us - including some tasteful Christmas decorations which made the it feel quite homely.  We were two families - 2 couples with 6 adult children so a total of 10 people.  We fitted very easily into the apartment and as there is a seperate dining and living room there was space enough for all.  The kitchen is very well equipped and the dining table seats 10 - so it is a good option to eat in.  Also, brilliantly located near underground and bus stops.  Highly recommended for a large group.
A fabulous place for a family get together, very clean, lovely comfy beds, well equipped kitchen, spacious, very near the UBahn  and we had a really wonderful time! Thank you, it was excellent!

Everything went well, nice appartement, wide spaces, ideal for a journey in family or with friend.
Close to metro station with restaurants and bars in the neighboorhoods.
We would have wanted a bit more flexibility on the check out but understand that others people needed to come right after us.
It was a great journey

we enjoyed our stay. the apartment was even larger and more spacious than the photos. more than big enough for the 7 of us. the living room and kitchen were perfect for us to relax in. we didn't cook but the kitchen was very well equipped. bedrooms were quiet and beds comfy. there were 3 bathroom which were excellent, clean with hot water and toiletries.
the location was great. a few minutes to the underground and supermarkets. we walked to lovely restaurants and bars on weserstrasse. it was handy for the canal.
we would definitely stay here again.
Conveniently located, lovely original features, great for big groups, well stocked kitchen. Exactly what we were looking for.

We could walk to the subway or to the grocery store or to the kebab stand or the burger restaurant all within 3-5 minutes, and the apartment was a peaceful oasis in the thick of the action — really, really cool first experience of Berlin!

I had such a pleasant time staying at Anna’s apartment while in Berlin. The space is really beautiful, clean, and very modern in design. The architecture, the kitchen and the 2nd floor are amazing. It's in a great location near some nice local restaurants and bars. Anna was a very warm host and gave me many recommendations of things to do in the area. Highly recommend this place to anyone visiting Berlin !

Had a great stay with Anna. We were only in Berlin briefly but were able to check in early and had great communication from Anna leading up to and during the stay. Beautiful, clean apartment, restaurants and cafes in walking distance and close to public transport.
Amazing space, lovely bathroom and very comfortable beds. Great communication with Anna start to finish. 10/10 would stay again!
Loved this place! It’s a good location in a quieter part of the east and there’s free parking if you have a car. Place is immaculate and has every amenity you could ask for.

After some plans fell through,  we booked this air bnb shortly before midnight. Phillip and Karolina were not only gracious in accepting our booking, but were immediately available both that night and in the following days for any small question we had. It’s rare to feel so at home that you can both relax and be productive. They built a space that was truly a quiet retreat. A home away from home!
very nice place, well located and great use space. note that it is located on the street at ground level. The host was great, I'll come back happily.

We had a very nice stay. Karolina and Philipp were always available to answer our questions. The location was great, apartment was clean and stylish. We appreciated the presence of the coffee maker:) strongly recommended!

Karolina’s place was great! One of the CLEANEST places we’ve ever stayed too. Convenient location in Friedrichshain on a quiet side street. Very comfortable bed. I would not hesitate to book this place again in Berlin!

Clean and cozy studio with a great location - walking distance to nice cafes and metro stations! It’s equipped with everything we needed and perfect for traveling with friends. We had a great time there! :)

Karolina was very responsive to questions my son and I had during the stay.  The first day we arrived the hot water was working.  It was a general building issue and not specific to the apartment.  Karolina communicated very well until the issue was resolved and even paid $100 euros for the invonvenience.  I highly recommend staying with Karolina.  Amazing experience and great location.

Very nice place, particularly the kitchen. Everything is pretty new and clean. HOWEVER, note that this apartment open directly onto the street, so you need to keep curtains closed if you don’t want to be n display for anyone walking by. This made the place feel stuffy and dark. It can also be very hot at night in mild weather, and there is no way to adjust the temp.

We had a fantastic stay. We were happy to return to the apartment, where we also spent some Christmas days last year. Fantastic location. Nice to be back. The apartment is so nice and the hosts are nice and respond to messages right away.

This was a stylish, cosy, clean, safe and relaxing place to stay. It was definitely worth the money. We loved the local neighbourhood feel, while also being super easy to get into central Berlin. Karolina replied to any query within minutes. I hadn’t realised it was on the ground floor from the photos and so we had to keep curtains shut in the morning, but that didn’t really matter.  I highly recommend this place!

I stayed in this apartment for two months, and I highly recommend it - Perfect location, quite but also close to all kinds of public transportation, restaurants and shopping center are all in walking distance.
Luba was a perfect host, immediate communication, very helpful and super nice!
Excellent place. Enough space for 4 people and convenient location. Only issue is the lack of elevator but that is very minor

Luba’s apartment is very spacious and clean.  After staying in hostels and hotels, my partner and I wanted to stay in a spacious apartment whilst in Berlin so that we could do some home cooking and wash our clothes. Luba’s Place was perfect for this, the kitchen is fully equipped and there is a good washing machine and indoor clothes line. Luba also gave us some good restaurant recommendations, there are some excellent places to eat in walking distance. Thanks for having us Luba!
Luba is an excellent host, very nice and helpful. The aprtment was very clean, at a very good central west berlin location. I totally recommend it.

We had an excellent stay in Berlin. The apartment is very spacious, beautifully decorated, well equipped and close to public transport. Check in and check out were very easy and we really appreciated the helpful map showing all public transport and supermarkets. A lovely place to stay!
Fantastic unique property in a good location in Berlin.  Everything was very clean and worked well, and there was plenty of space for all 8 members of our party.
Apartment is really cosy, tidy and spacious. Location is very good! Noticed some issues which would need a repair, advised these to owner 😀 does not affect to holiday.

We had a wonderful time at the Berlin lofts. Stefan was onsite to welcome us and show us around the loft. And when there was a question about the washing machine, he quickly came to show us the answer. We were very happy with our stay there.  It's a peaceful, well-located oasis.

Had the most amazing stay here. The host was super friendly and accommodating to our needs. The apartment is enormous and located in a lovely quiet, safe area. The apartment is equipped with everything you need and more. The host was very easily contactable. Highly recommend
Great location- easy to get to the center of the city and all the tourist spots. Lots of space. Nice and quiet, especially at night. Very clean.

Lovely large apartment that suited us as a group of 4 friends perfectly. They very kindly let us check in early which was much appreciated. Location is close to U Bahn and a large supermarket. Very clean and had everything you could need - we had a great stay.

Wonderful quiet apartment even though it wasn’t in a main tourist area. Residential, felt safe, people in local restaurants and bars were very friendly. Great kebabs at Yayla just down the road. We would definitely stay again! Loved the building and the terrace with its fairy lights.
Had a wonderfull stay. Everything was perfect. Really enjoyed it. Easy to find, enter and very nice and clean.

Huge space, great outdoor patio, and convenient ten minute walk to the train station. Babett is so nice, she even greeted us with several bottles of beer! She responded to all inquiries quickly. Check in was easy, very secure location, we had a great time. Would definitely stay there again!
Beautiful apartment, exceptionally well furnished, very well positioned in the city. Would highly recommend for any other people visiting Berlin.
Very nice appartement! Well equipped, nicely decorated, great terrace to enjoy a bit of sun (if you have as much luck as us with the weather😉). We would definietely stay there again!
We had a great stay in Berlin and Babett's place is  spotless  and very spacious.  Thanks, we will come back.

We loved the place. It is in a pretty brick building. We thought it is better than the pictures. We loved the ceiling windows. It is a very comfortable place for groups. We had so much fun at the house since it was cold we stayed in somedays. It seemed like Stephan was always there whenever we needed him. It was a little low ceiling so we had to be carefull. But still one of our friend hit her head entering the house from the balcony on the very last day. But the host was very helpful with aid kit and all. The place is a bit far from everything but it is a safe neighborhood. There is a polcestation very close. And it is at the end of mitte so not knowing Berlin, we didnt get that. All in all we enjoyed it. Thanks for hosting us. It was a memorable vacation. They let us check out 1 hour late which we appreciated a lot. Thanks for everything.
Was a lovely place to stay, and communication was great. I have nothing bad to say about our stay in the old horse stables

Beautiful place near the center of Berlin. The appartment has everything you need for a short or long stay. Easy instructions for a late arrival and flexibility for the check out time. Fast and nice communication during our stay. Thanks a lot to the berlinlofts team!
Babette's place was very spacious and was able to accommodate all 4 travelers in our party comfortably. Really lucky to have stayed here!
The hay loft was a great stay. Comfortable, spacious, and a good jumping off point to all areas of Berlin. Would stay again
The lift was spacious and exactly as described. It’s in a quiet neighbourhood and there was quite of travelling to get around Berlin but that was not a problem a good transport links.

This was an extremely comfortable place to stay in Berlin! We were three sets of couples and all felt very satisfied with the space we had and the overall convenience and cleanliness. If we could change one thing it would be the location. It is a tad out of the way from the “cool” neighborhoods in Berlin, but wasn’t a huge issue using public transportation to get around the city.

Stephan studio is great to spend some time in Berlin, specially if a musician, it could be ideal to explore the city while keep working...with a nice Yamaha  piano right at the main room. The space is excellent for one or two people. And, transportation is always good in Berlin, so even if the studio may seems a little secluded, it really is not. This is a really good one for musicians! Thanks Stephan.
The Piano Shed is a lovely place to stay in a great location. The work that Stephan did with its really nice and cozy, the piano is amazing and adds a great vibe to the place.
Excellent place to stay especially if you are a pianist visiting Berlin and need a place for practice. Great location and a nice wooden vibe to it.

Wonderful, musical, warm and cared-for space!
Stephan was very helpful and generous with ideas. We recorded the piano and had lovely results.
Highly recommended for musicians and creatives alike!

Really warm and cozy place in perfect quiet area near city center. Surprise was local beer and chocolate waiting for us after arrival. Communication briliant, when we wanted to stay for one more night. Highly recommend!!!!

The house, though relatively decent location, considering the value for money price of the place, does have  a number of problems, it is extremely cramped, especially the top level, there are wifi problems, and the close proximity to the building's dustbins, does create a slight nuisance. The neighbourhood is nice, though there isn't much of interest for visitors of Berlin.

We had a fantastic stay at Stephan's place. The location is perfect - easy to get to from the airport and quick into the centre of town, with lots of shops and cafes nearby.  The apartment is comfortable with everything you need, and the Yamaha piano is one of the best I've ever played. Couldn't ask for more - highly recommended.

Great, quirky place full of everything you need situated near Treptower Park.
The piano is a joy, the bed is massive and comfy, and the place is spacious and very clean!
Everything very good and comfortable. Bring an eye mask to sleep because there are no curtains and the light is strong especially in summer… the kitchen and the bathroom have everything you need.

I really enjoyed staying at Stephan's place. He is an easy and kind communicator and both The Berlin Piano Shed and the neighbourhood itself are great. The next time I'm in Berlin I hope to stay here again! (I may even build myself a similar space in another city one day... such a great design.)

Quirky, lovely little place. The hof is super quiet, and the space is bright and airy.
Kitchen is compact but quite well equipped. You need to be quite comfortable/intimate with anyone you're staying with as the toilet is very close to the bed and kitchen and it's impossible not to overhear each other if you're both in the space.

What an amazing place !!! This is a small cottage in the city, it is so quiet since there are no neighbors, the building is alone inside of the group of apartment building, very cool! I appreciate a lot all the small things that were available, salt, oil, tea, sugar, etc. I wished that this would be a norm for all the airbnb, these small things make such a big difference in this fast pace life. I would only suggest the host to install a better internet connection, the one which is there now is not that good. I would definitely come back again !

Great place outside of the city centre but easily accessible via public transportation and a short walk through a nice neighbourhood.. excellent facilities in the space everything thats I needed for a comfortable short trip.
There was an issue with the bathroom but this as far as I know has been sorted, Stephan communicated very well.
Great apartment!
I stayed for a few nights alone and I liked it. Besides the piano, I loved the wooden furniture and all equipments in the kitchen so you could truly cook eg salt pepper.

The Piano shed is conveniently located close to stores and public transportation.  Stephan provided clear instructions on how to get access as well as recommendations to local places.  The accommodations are basic but adequate.  The Yamaha piano is awesome although my son and I did not play it much as we spent our days at my daughter’s place nearby.

The Place is amazing with a really cosy courtyard. Everything is super clean and all communication are friendly.
Everything lived up to our expectations and we'll definitely come back if we visit Berlin again.
We had a great co-working weekend at the place. It was quiet and we were able to work really well. Beds were nice and lots of amenities.
Spacious location, very clean. The kitchen has everything you need. It was very calm when we rented it even though there are only Airbnbs around. We had a great stay. We are going to come back.
Great apartment. Very clean and a lot os space.  Very well equipped.  Nothing to complain. I would stay there again.

Great location, and very stylish appartment. clean and well equipped. location is great and very close to public transportation. outdoor area to enjoy the good weather ! host is great and responsive. the stay was very pleasant and highly recommended for small groups :)

A fabulous apartment which was ideal for our Berlin trip. The apartment was spacious, clean and very well kitted out. We loved the courtyard setting which was perfect for eating breakfast or an evening drink. We soon orientated ourselves to the local area. There is a bus stop very close by that takes you to the main train station, or it’s a 15 minute walk to a U Station. To get to the main sights in Berlin you have to change bus/ lines but the overall journey time is usually about 30-40 minutes so very manageable. There’s a Lidl supermarket close by and plenty of restaurants near the U stations. Thank you very much- we loved staying at the apartment!
It was wonderful to start and end the day at Berlinlofts. We enjoyed the peaceful, charming, spacious, clean and well equipped apartment. Looking forward to come back.
We very much enjoyed the stay and place. It was safe, clean and located near transport links. The host was excellent. Our family enjoyed the stay.
Great space for my family of 5. Courtyard and location were great. About 2-3 miles from the major attractions like the wall, museum island. Worked well for our short trip to Berlin.

Very cosy and spacious apartment. They were very kind to allow us early check in because our flight arrived very early in the morning. There is a very nice terrace in front that would be great in warmer weather.
The apartment was truly lovely, spacious, very well equipped and extremely peaceful. We loved being there.
Great apartment and Stephan was very responsive. Lovely courtyard, lots of space & good location. Would recommend!

We loved our stay at Berlin lofts. It is a beautiful apartment, full of character and charm and has been thoughtfully renovated with attention to detail and quality. The hosts were helpful and welcoming and the apartment is spacious and well equipped. We would love to stay again.

Stephan's apartment was just what we needed. It was spacious, clean, homely and very well equipped. From the moment we booked Stephan was very responsive and helpful.
We were able to travel into central Berlin well, and after long days of sight seeing we could relax and feel at home.
I would thoroughly recommend this apartment

Lovely and spacious flat, more like a terraced house in a courtyard. Very quiet, only birdsong to wake you up in the morning. Great to have outdoor patio for breakfast / after dinner drink. Didn't know Moabit although been to Berlin often, and found walking around the streets, along the river, Armenius-foodhall and especially Freddy Leck's eccentric laundromat cafe very charming. Stephan was a perfect host who even helped us a midnight when we accidentally locked ourselves out! Highly recommended.

We had a fantastic stay. The house was well equipped and very spacious, and very stylish. We used it as a base to explore Berlin and it was excellent for this. An easy walk to S and U Bahn and we felt safe walking back, even late at night. Host was very helpful when I locked myself out within 2 hours of arriving!

Stephans apartment is simply amazing! Super well layout. Perfect quiet yard. Easy to park your car. And easy to get around by u-Bahn of buses.
I can highly recommend anyone looking for a GREAT place to stay in Berlin to check out Stephans place.
He’s extremely responsive with all kinds of questions. No doubt that we would stay here again!
The flat was great for a group of three and has everything you will need for a comfortable trip. The hosts were very helpful and friendly

The set up of “The Workshop” was just perfect for two couples visiting Berlin. Private, quiet and in a great area. Within walking distance to most tourist spots of Berlin.
With two bedrooms and two bathrooms it was perfect for us.
Highly recommended and would definitely book again if we return to Berlin.
The apartment was very clean and orderly, everything is labeled and extremely easy to access. We felt very much at home.

Great place that fully lived up to our expectations. We felt very welcome and taken good care of. Plenty of room for 5 grown ups. Nice Living room, kitchen and area outside. Easy access to the city. We will for sure come back:-)

We had a great visit to Berlin with two kids ages 9 and 13.  The place was larger than we expected from the pictures.  it had everything we need to be very comfortable all week.  We would most definitely stay again when we return.

Kathrin's home is sparkling clean, with all the amenities one might need for a smooth stay. It's located around 25 minutes from Alexanderplatz, in a peaceful residential area, very suitable if you want to get a good rest in the evening and be fresh for exploring the city.
Kathrin went out of her way to be helpful and make my stay the best possible, she offered breakfast for all the days, even wrote a small post-it notes to wish me a nice day, and overall made my experience live up to the expectation.
A quiet location and cosy place, much appreciated after coming back from an intense long day. Great hospitality, and Kathrin will make you feel like coming home to family.
Perfect room for a city visit. The apartment was very clean and Kathrin was very kind and willing to help!

Beautiful and quiet place to stay, the courtyard was lovely and it felt like a little oasis in the middle of busy Berlin. Inge was so sweet! And all of the recommendations she pointed out to us on the map the team provided were spot on and perfect for our stay. A memorable experience for sure!

Myself, my husband, and our 2 kids (3+7) went with friends with 1 kid (6).
The apartment was perfect. Just the right size for all of us and with everything we needed. It was lovely and quiet with a lovely safe outside courtyard. We would definitely recommend the apartment and wouldn’t hesitate to book again if coming back to Berlin.
Thank you David, Stephan and Inge.

Fantastic spacious apartment in a quiet cozy court yard. Very well equipped kitchen, very large bathroom with sky view from the bathtub. Very friendly host.
We were traveling three generations together — parents, grandparents and kids.  The apparent was perfect for this. Large sofa, plenty of room for all, toys, guidebook, large fridge, two bathrooms and a nice terrace.
The apartment can be a bit noisy (when staying with kids), but the rooms upstairs are very quiet with the door closed ;) also great if you don’t get up/go to bed at the same time.
Great cosy property, finished to a high standard. Very clean. Attentive host. Easy check in and check out process.
Our stay at Stephan's place was simply amazing. All the utensils were there and the whole place was way spacious than expected :) And Stephan was very communicative and helpful. Thanks a lot!

Wonderful apartment. Unfortunately espresso machine was not working and disappointed to see that you charged for it. I would consider full size blankets for the beds just too small and pillows were horrible. But otherwise loved it
Excellent apartment which is so well connected by all the public transport networks. The local area was fairly quiet but so easy to get everywhere.
Great location in a quiet haven after a busy day sightseeing in the city. Great hosts who communicate really well and quickly. Facilities exactly as described with super comfy beds.

The place was great, perfect for a family stay. Easy walk to the bus and U Bahn, we found the 123 bus useful to connect with the things we wanted to see. The public transport system is very easy and cheap to use. The apartment was very clean and safe, we felt as though it was a real home from home.
Loads of plates and cutlery for everyone and the dishwasher was useful, it meant we could load and wash overnight.
Would definitely stay here again and highly recommend.

Old Blacksmith Loft has everything you need to have a great stay in Berlin.
Everything works great and everything was very clean.
It is very easy to get around in town from the Old Blacksmith Lofts and we will defenitly use this place again, when we come back to Berlin.

The place is even better in person. I normally have trouble sleeping on vacation but the beds were so comfortable I slept like a baby the entire stay. The entire location is beautiful and would definitely book again.

The loft was exactly as described - a great space for a family of 5. Bedrooms were a fine size and the downstairs living area was very spacious. Nice kitchen, well equipped and 2.5 bathrooms. We requested a high chair and extra towels and they arrived in minutes. There are a few nice cafes, restaurants, and shops nearby. Private parking space, which was helpful as we ended up driving into the city most days; while there are buses and trains somewhat close by they would’ve taken 30-60 mins to get to most tourist attractions whereas driving was 15-20 mins. Overall a great find if you want some space in Berlin.

Stephan was a great host, contact was easy and regular.   He shared his local knowledge and some recommendations with us.  The property was lovely with a wide range of equipment.   The beds were very comfy and it was lovely to hear the birds singing outside of the property first thing in the morning.    It is a short public transport ride to most tourist attractions, but the bus stop is 5 mins walk and underground around 10 mins, all public transport runs frequently and regularly.   A lovely place to spend time with my 14 year old grandson and daughter in law.
We had a wonderful stay, and Stephan made us feel very much at home. Highly recommended for any trip to Berlin!

We had a great stay. The property was spacious and clean, and well equipped. Stephan’s team was responsive. There are so many interesting things to do and see in Berlin and it was easy to walk to the Centre. We also enjoyed an afternoon trip to the lake at Wannsee.
"Wonderful place and stay! The flat was clean, cozy, and well-equipped. The hospitality was outstanding. Highly recommend!"
The apartment was very cozy and very well located. Stephan managed to support us on everything we needed!

Fantastic place. From the moment we met Sofi we knew we would enjoy our stayed. Stephan and Sofi are great hosts, they keep the place very comfortable and  clean. The neighborhood is quiet and close to metro. The apartment is a great place to stay. We definitely will come back and we recommend the place without hesitation. Thanks for having us.

What a fantastic apartment! So well-equipped, could easily stay for much longer, just a shame we were only in Berlin for 3 nights. The kitchen had everything you could possibly need and more. The rooms were decent size with comfortable beds and ample storage. The apartment is very spacious and a great space to chill out, or spend a quality evening with family.
Easy access to transport links, and walkable distance to all the major attractions in Berlin. Plus it was great to have a safe parking space.
Would love to stay here again if ever back in Berlin.
Highly recommended.
This was the perfect stay for our group, plenty of space and everything you need to have a comfortable and relaxing vibe holiday.

Matthias is the most excellent host, friendly and extremely helpful. Although he is preparing a half a year trip with his lovely family, he took a lot of time to make me feel like home.
To have a morning coffee on Matthias sunny terrace is what I call the perfect start into the day.
The apartment is stunning, spacious and much larger than it looks like on the photographs.
Located in vibrant Berlin Mitte you can explore the city easily, I would love to come back and spend more time in Berlin and Matthias oasis.
Matthias' house is amazing, big, comfortable and quite close to the metro. He is the perfect guest: always available and ready to help. Thank you Matthias for your house and for your attitude!!!

The location is brilliant and the apartment is even far nicer than the photos. Great if you have children as loads of toys and child safe too! You can feel its a home loved and lived in with a fully equipped kitchen- and nice details- great aesthetic.  Easy in and out, fast communication with hosts and well looked after. This is my goto Berlin spot!

We really enjoyed our stay at Matthias’ apartment. It felt like a friend had let us stay there with all their things still in place. It’s interesting well located with lots of amenities.
If you prefer a more conventionally neutral Airbnb then this place is not for you.

We loved this place! (we are a family of 4 with two older teenagers)
Location: excellent with amazing transport; museums; supermarkets; restaurants outside the door. Famous sites within easy walking distance. very clean location. didn't see many bars at night
Apartment: Gorgeous, massive and very stylish & quirky filled with art, books and everything one would need for a trip away. The view over Berlin is stunning! photos do not show how large and interesting the flat is. my girls loved their bedroom & beds very comfy. The apartment was very homely. only downside is flat wouldn't suit anyone with access issues as on two levels
Communication: excellent as owner kept in touch throughout

We had a wonderful stay at Matthias appartment. Appartment is very big and has a wonderful terrace in which you can share nice moments with family. Location is great and very near transports as well as main sites. During our stay Matthias was very attentive and always available in case that we had a question or needed something from him. Totally recommended if you are going to Berlin.
Lovely apartment in a very central neighborhood. Matthias and his family are lovely hosts and were very responsive.
A lovely, compact house that was close enough to the city to make for an excellent new years experience! Perfect little place to stay if you're spending your time out and about

Awesome place, really close to the tram. Nice and quiet area. Clean, minimalistic and good if you whant to internet detox since the Pavillon is made out of concret. No signal on the mobilephone or on the wifi. Just perfect. 😊👍🏼
Amazing beautiful place, nice and clean! Martin is super nice and let us stay a little longer because we had to wait for a flight. Really good, we will definitely recommend it!

Apartment were better than i expected from the photos. Small, but comfortable enough to stay.
Neighborhood was so-so-so peaceful, nicely built that i would like to stop there anytime i will be in Berlin again. A lot of pedestrian roads, water nearby. Such a beautiful place!

Great little accommodation in a great spot. Lots of kitchen facilities and hot plates for cooking. The hosts were lovely and responsive, even letting us check in earlier due to bad weather. We had a really comfortable few nights :)
The pavilion was beautiful and was very cozy for our stay. Everything was within 20 minutes of each other and had lots of areas to visit.

Ali's place was great!  Check in and out was easy and convenient.  He welcomed us with champagne, a flower and left chocolates when we left.  These were nice touches and Ali was friendly.  The area was quiet and we always found a convenient place to park for four nights.  The rooms were large and clean with one king bed in one room and a very large couch in the living room.  The couch was a bit hard for sleeping but the bed was very comfortable.  We couldn't get the Wi-Fi to work.

We had an amazing stay! It was very peaceful and homey. Farsan and Frederike provided everything one would need for a long stay and were always available with quick responses.We would definitely recommend it!

Andreas has been very helpful and kind.
His flat is very well located nearby Alexanderplatz and in a lovely and trendy area. We recommend it.

Alexander's home is a cosy, spacious place situated just 10 minutes from the eastern city centre Alexanderplatz. It's easy to reach with public transport, either the metro or tram. Even though it's near the centre the area is very quiet and serene. Alexander will give you great tips about what places to visit and will happily share his experiences! Easy kitchen to use, great shower, lots of light in the room, bedlinnens and towels are included, and a living room and dining table are free for use. Great experience!
Nice location, helpful and comunicative housemate. Unfortunately without enough privacy, not so much cosy and pretty untidy. The bed was large and comfortable but the bathroom was terribly dirty.

The house is very well located (~10 min walk from U-bahnhof Bernauer Str. and S-bahnhof Nordbahnhof. Alexander is very friendly and you barely notice that there is someone in the house - besides you. The room is spacious and comfy, and has everything you need to have a great stay. I definitely recommend this place!
Cozy and comfortable room, good host and amazing location. A lot of dust on the shelfs and furniture

Such a beautifully curated space with lots of room! Super clean and responsive and helpful! The house is located near many coffee shops, delicious restaurants, and great parks. Was the perfect place to explore Berlin in the little time we stayed. Would definitely try and rebook with Alexander when I come back!!

Alexander was a great host, full of great recommendations, he was attentive but also gave me a wide berth when I needed to unwind after a busy day exploring Berlin.
The room itself is beautifully laid out, and the house is intuitive.
Overall, great stay. My only complaint is that I couldn’t stay longer! Thanks Alexander.
Great location and beautiful apartment! Alexander gave great recommendations for local pubs and we had all the amenities we needed. 10/10
In a great location, lots of cafes and restaurants nearby and easy to get around Berlin. Room was quite big and comfortable, perfect for a few nights stay.

I felt very comfortable and at home in this lovely apartment.
It is furnished with a keen eye for Art and design.
Alexander is a very good host.
Very nice, artistic place to stay. Alexander is  very chill and the location is great! Definitely would recommend to anyone

We had a short stay but really happy we came here. The place was exactly as described, very welcoming and authentic. The host was extremely helpful and very kind. Wanted to stay again on our return journey but it was already booked!  Highly recommend.

Great location, beautiful apartment. There were several issues with the hot water and electricity, and though the host responded quite quickly and fixed the problem-it still was uncomfortable and caused us inconveniences.

Amazing location and stylish place. We enjoyed our stay with kids a lot. Apartment had everything we needed. Specifically the wooden floor is amazing. There was a lot of light and space enough to host 5 people.
Keep in mind, that it is a pretty high 4rth floor without elevator. But the charms of apartment were worth it ;)
The apartment was great for a week in Berlin. The suburb and location is perfect and the place is nice to hang out in as well. We wouldn’t hesitate to stay in this place again!
we liked the stay, the host was kind,  responsive and hospitable. can recommend and would stay again
If you appreciate art, colours and combination of old and new this is the place. The exceptional apartment speaks on many levels but you need to be ready to listen.
Wonderful apartment centrally located. It is on a busy street but it's quiet at night. Close to everything. Peggy was very responsive! Recommend.

I’ve stayed in at least 10 AirBNBs in Berlin, this one was just super. The old floors are stunning and the walls are beautiful! Tons of natural light flood the apartment from all sides. A beautiful view from the front windows. Perfect location at the top of Mitte and the bottom of PBerg. All types of food in every direction. Very walkable for all ages. Super comfy bed, nice crisp linens. Lots of places to spread out your own things. We used our Netflix account to use the TV. This is an absolute must!

What a nice apartment in Berlin!! Wonderful area and amazing decorations. Can’t find any place bigger than this in the center area and under this price. The host is very friendly and always helps me to solve the problem on time. Thank you!

Fantastic location, and a very large apartment with lots of space. Everything was clean and easy to find. The host responded to our questions when we first checked in, even though it was quite late in the evening. Overall a good experience!
Kristian's apartment was lovely! Great place to stay in the center of Berlin -- it was super clean and had everything you need! A great airbnb

We enjoyed a wonderful stay in this apartment during our visit to Berlin. The apartment is easily reachable by tram/bus, and the S-Bahn station is only a 10-minute walk away. The area is also filled with many nice restaurants, brunch spots, and cafés.

Our favourite Airbnb in all of our Europe trip! Great location, so much room and the place is adorable. So easy to get around with rentable scooters/bikes and tram right out front. We loved this place and will most definitely be back!
Great place great location. Room sizes are plentiful and you still get q good sized living room and kitchen
It was a great place but a little bit noisy for the rooms near the street. Everything was perfect
One of the best place in Berlin! Fantastic welcome, superb apartment, you feel at home. A thousand thanks!

The apartment os everything you can ask for a stay un Berlín. Good location, amazona lightning, big rooms and fully equiped. The communication with the hosts was always very kind and quick. We asked for a late check out and there ese no problem for them to let us do it.
Perfect for big groups.
Very suitable place for group of 12 people. All was in accordance with the description. We had great stay there!  I would definately recommend it 😀.

We came to Berlin as a group of six, and Stayed At the Airbnb for 5 days. We recommend this place to anyone and we're very pleased!
there are five large bedrooms, with comfortable beds, closet space and furniture. also the kitchen is very well equiped and the living room is large, with space for everyone to have a nice night instade. wifi is ok. showers were excellent and bathrooms were clean and roomy.
the location is not right in the middle of all the action, but easily reachable at any hour. also possible to talk all the way to many attractions. there are quite a few local bars around that are very atmospheric and fun, so if you want a more chill evening, it is possible.
the host was quick to respond to every need.
I would recommend this place to anyone, and think it is one of the best airbnb I have visited.
There was some noise from the Street outside, but the apartment was Nice and the host was Quick and helpfull. Big apartment, clean and practical.

Perfect stay in Babett house.
All needed things were there, commucation was clear. Thanks for all.

Very nice place in a quiet location, perfect for a large family or group of friends. Large spaces, very clean with good amenities and everything you need. It has a set of stairs inside the apartment with the living room and kitchen upstairs and the rooms downstairs. Neighbourhood is quiet and not too far from the centre in public transport. There are a few small restaurants in the corner and a large shopping centre with supermarket five minutes away (walking).
Very nice and responsive host. Will recommend this place for large groups if they have no issue with the stairs.

Fabulous clean huge exceptional place. Sofi and the crew were extremely welcoming, hospitable, and accommodating throughout our stay. I would not hesitate to recommend staying at this wonderfully light, airy, and classy apartment.

Great location. It too far from central Berlin but quiet and very handy shops, bars and restaurants - within walking of wild swimming beech bar area.
So worth it! What a place!

My group and I felt extremely comfortable at Babetts’. It was homily and a lovely place to wind down after a long day. It had an incredible smell - very fresh!
Babett was helpful and friendly, leaving recommendations and suggestions.
10/10 would stay again.

What a wonderful place to stay! Plenty of space, very comfortable and a well equipped kitchen. Sofi was incredibly responsive, helpful, efficient and kind.
Photos of the apartment are incredibly accurate. Bedrooms are all very good size with sofas in each. Showers were also fantastic. Supermarkets and all forms of public transport are within easy reach.

This was the most spacious and well-equipped airbnb we've ever stayed in. A bit of a walk to the city centre and the hauptbahnhof, 20-25 minutes, but from there travel around the city is really easy. Buses will cut the walking distance but don't save much time. Westhafen S-bahn is closer, but requires longer travel time to most points of interests. Plenty of bars, restaurants, and supermarkets within 10 minutes walk. Great place, good value.

Beautiful apartment - perfect for a couple. Bed incredibly comfortable and everything very clean and to a very high standard. Easy to get around the city with 2 metro stations within 5 min walk. Host very helpful with ideas of where to go - all the suggestions we took were great! Would 100% stay again if in Berlin for a weekend.
Great apartment! Cosy and really nice! No problem with anything and super happy with our stay! I would really recommend it!

Philipp's apartment is a very cool space, lovely and airy with everything you could need. The area is amazing and we particularly enjoyed going to Federica for delicious breakfasts and the LPG Organic Biostore next door to buy everything we needed.
Will be back!!

We loved Phillip’s place! It’s styled really well...and the BED was incredibly cozy! We had not slept so well in months! The flat is an exciting part of town with plenty of parks, and it’s located near great food and coffee...and public transit! The bedroom opens up into a courtyard which was actually very quiet. And the small balcony was a major plus! We loved our time in Berlin and are already planning our trip back. We would absolutely recommend Phillip’s flat to anyone looking to check out Berlin!

I loved staying here!  Philipp provided very thorough self-check-in instructions which made the process very easy. The space was clean, comfortable, spacious, and well decorated.  The location was perfect and I appreciated the thoughtfulness of Philipp's detailed list of local recommendations. Highly recommended!
very stylish loft located in a beautiful area next to a bunch of awesome cofee spots. the host is very friendly, wit and nice)
We loved our stay at Philipp's place! The apartment was beautifully decorated, very comfortable, well-located and perfect for our weekend stay in Berlin. Would definitely recommend!

The area around the apartment is wonderful and Philipp's incredibly detailed guidebook was a real blessing for our trip. Worth booking for the recommendations! Just so happened that the apartment is absolutely beautiful as well!

Philipp’s place is fantastic, excellent location and amenities, he has thought of everything you might need for your stay.
Thanks philipp
Perfect place! Recommended to everyone. Super nice host, easy communication and simply an amazing place in a great and characteristic location in Berlin! Thanks again for the awesome stay!
The flat was exceptional: stylish, comfortable and thoughtfully designed. The location was perfect and my son and I couldn’t have had a better time. We will book it again when we return to Berlin!

The flat is absolutely gorgeous! It’s in a great location with fantastic coffee right next door and right in the middle of the best area of Berlin.
