The hosts made check in really easy and the flat really felt like our own and was super comfy.

The apartment was very live: bright, tidy and decorated uniquely. Philipp was very helpful host. He gave us Berlin tips and answered to every question right away. We really enjoyed staying in this apartment.

We loved staying in such a stylish apartment while we were in Berlin! The shower was nicer than any hotel and the neighborhood was so hip! The host’s restaurant recommendations were excellent as well! It was also great having an organic market and wonderful coffee shop in the same block.

Super cool apartment in central location. It was clean and spacious with everything we needed. The bed was very comfortable- like sleeping on a cloud! Hosts were gracious, providing a well-organised, thoughtful compendium of interesting local attractions, including restaurants, bars, nightlife and emergency, medical and necessary services. This is really important for travellers who come from a long way away!
Thanks for the great stay and excellent communication Phillip and Caroline.
Warm greetings to Philip and Caroline! This apartments is marvelous. It’s well situated, has everything you can need during your trip to Berlin. I have only positive emotions about this apartments.
Cute home. Easy to check in. Only problem is when I arrived the cleaning supplies were jammed behind a door and cleaning lady was still working when we were checking in

We had a great stay for our short visit to Berlin - the apartment was nice and cosy with all the amenities we needed and Caroline was very helpful and made check in and check out easy. Only one thing to mention is you need to be able to walk up a few flights of stairs but if you’re fine with this then I highly recommend!

A beautiful flat ... up 7 flights of very steep stairs that weren't mentioned at all.
Area - rough looking when you first arrive but then you realise it's NOT threatening.
Berlin is a beautiful city and this was a fantastic flat, fantastic bed and shower, some of the smaller things need fixing - curtains missing on fire door etc but a nice character flat.
Asked for bottle of champagne on arrival - wasn't there ...
Overall a fantastic experience - apart from those stairs.
Highly recommend this flat to you 8/10 rating.

I highly recommend the place, I still want an apartment like that to live. The kitchen has all the necessary (except for an oven, if it is your thing), the kitchen tools have good quality asides the tv, sound system, everything. Location is great and you are nearby a lot of interesting things and, at the same time, with a silent apartment to rest properly.
lovely apartment, would definitely come back! comfiest bed we have ever selept in!!
The apartment was very stylish and spacious with huge windows. The host responded immediately if we had any questions.

apartment is as pictured and described. The location is a little less charming than expected. A bit pricey for what it is, otherwise okay. The communal staircase would benefit from a bit of tlc. Great food locations nearby/in walkable distance. Communication with host was great!

This Kreuzberg loft is the perfect home base in Berlin! Philipp and Caroline were excellent hosts - they went above and beyond to make our check-in process as easy as possible. The apartment is stylish and comfortable (although it is a walk up - not handicap accessible), with all the amenities you need. Easy walk to the train and several restaurants, parks, bars, etc. Overall a great stay!
Great spot in kreuzberg, slept very well here and wifi was plenty good enough for working and streaming video calls.  The neighborhood is lively and fun, tons of food and bars!

Very well located near the u bahn, and nice space for a great stay! We loved the proximity to restaurants ( the chungking noodle and ramen bar next door were excellent). Recommend for a fun stay in Berlin! Phillip and Caroline gave a lot of recommendations too which were appreciated

we were so excited for our stay here, but due to a screw up at the airport we never made it and had to cancel our stay.
the host was incredibly helpful and understanding with this and was very fast at responding.
hopefully we will make it to Berlin some time soon for a stay.
Would highly recommend! Great location, within a 5 min walk to the U-Bahn, everything in kreuzberg at your finger tips. Apartment was gorgeous - we will be back!
This spot is in an incredible location next to great restaurants and the U Bahn. The hosts gave great recommendations and were friendly and responsive. 10/10 would stay here again.

We really enjoyed staying at this little gem in Kreuzberg. The neighborhood is funky and has a lot going on, but the apartment is quiet and lovely. Fun books, comfy bed, cute decorations. had everything we needed!

The apartment is charming and comfortable and the location is convenient. If you have any mobility issues whatsoever you will have difficulty navigating the steep stairs with big luggage. There is a natural foods store on the corner and several restaurants to walk to. Phillip has an excellent book with many helpful references and recommendations. We enjoyed our stay and loved the city of  Berlin.

Funky arty space in trendy Kreuzberg. Perfect space, super comfortable - probably the most comfy bed I’ve stayed in. The area has heaps of trendy cafes and restaurants and Philipp and Caroline’s recommendations were priceless. Just note when you arrive it does feel like a more edgy area, especially if you don’t know Berlin, but it’s all part of its cool - think Shoreditch in London. Would gladly stay again.

By far the best Airbnb stay I have had in Europe! The flat was beautifully designed, and super cozy. Would definitely recommend to anyone staying in Berlin, and hope to stay again sometime soon. 10/10

This is a beautifully equipped and very comfortable apartment. They have really provided everything to make your stay comfortable. It was especially nice to have a coffee machine for my cup in the morning. Check in was clear and easy with the step by step instructions and pictures provided by the host. The location was amazing for all of our touring and plans in Berlin. I would highly recommend.
It’s a beautiful apartment in a great location in the heart of Kreuzberg. Checkin instructions and other communication was clear.

We enjoyed our stay, the location of Kreuzberg was familiar to us and easy for us to travel around from. The flat is described well and the photos were very accurate. Communications were clear and easy and we recommend booking this apartment.

What a cute place! Absolutely loved the shower and the bed - and the industrial vibe of the whole place. Super responsive and helpful with the questions we had. Would definitely stay again the next time I’m back!

This was a perfect place! Sometimes we couldn’t go out because we liked the house very much! It was clean and safe. We got in easly! I highly reccomend this house. Thanks for the Bose speaker by the way. It made us enjoy more

Loved it! Felt like true Berliners for a few days. Wish we stayed longer.
Beautiful space perfectly located near public transport and lots of hip bars and food options - including famous Berlin Doners and a sublime organic supermarket.
And if you love vintage shopping and brunch we found lots of stunning options a short stroll over the canal.
Highly recommend! Thanks for having us 🙏
We had an amazing stay thanks to Philipp & Caroline!  The apartment was clean, beautiful, and much bigger than expected!

We had a lovely stay here! The apartment is so unique. It almost feels like staying in an old cave that has been modernized (in a good way!). The architecture is so unique and beautiful. Bathroom and shower were great, comfy bed and spacious apartment. There are 4 sets of stairs up to the place to keep in mind if you have heavy luggage! Host was very responsive and sent excellent check in instructions. Only downside is that by the time we got to Berlin and figured out where we wanted to go seems like most things were in different neighborhoods, but luckily this place is a short walk to the trains so easy to get around. Organic grocery store steps away and a cheaper one about five minutes away too so it was very accessible to buy food and cook in the apartment.
This is now my favourite airbnb in Berlin and I've bee coming multiple times a year for the last 20 years. beautiful space.
We love it here, second time back and will be back again. Perfect location and lovely clean apartment. Thank you!

Philipp’s place is so much the perfect spot in Berlin! The area is super cool and is right next to the transportation to other areas. The instructions for getting inside were super easy and detailed and the apartment was spacious and very comfortable.
Thanks for a great stay!

We loved staying at Philipps place in Berlin.  The old building has huge amazing windows that let in a lot of natural light and a wonderful breeze.  The neighborhood has countless cafes, bars and restaurants within a 5-10inute walk from your door.

My wife and I brought our dog to Berlin and had a great stay for a week at Philipp's place.
The apartment was conveniently located, clean, cozy and has a great shower and lots of light.
We would definitely stay again!
Wonderful and clean apartment in the most vibrant neighborhood of Berlin. The hosts were very helpful and provided clear instructions and communication. 10/10 would recommend!

Great stay!
A lot of beds, the space can fit a lot of people.
The pictures accurately describe the place and I would recommend if you are traveling with a group.
Good location to explore city from.

Simple but spacious apartment, with a little garden at a perfect location in Berlin. Duc Son is a very friendly and flexible host who lives in the same building. You can also rent bikes at the location, which I highly recommend as *the* method of transport in Berlin.
It was clean and very spacious. It was very good communicated and close to some good restaurants. We found very easy the communication with the host.
Great location! Extremely accomodating and friendly hosts that allowed us to leave our bags before check-in time.

Duc Son’s place was a little basic but clean, comfortable, central and generally pretty quiet. He was incredibly responsive and flexible with our check-in, and we would recommend staying there to others. Thank you Duc!

Carolina and her partner were more than helpful. They let us check in very early for which we are most grateful. The place was exactly as described and very clean and tidy. It is located in a beautiful residential neighborhood with two open air street markets per week.

The house was absolutely amazing. The attention to detail and the interior design make the home a pleasure. Carolina provided great local tips, she was very responsive and extremely kind, especially when our family members required multiple separate check-ins. We loved the neighborhood and local farmer’s market. We really enjoyed our stay and highly recommend her home.

Thank you Carolina, for the super amazing stay. We instantly felt at home  with the warm welcome and the state of the accommodation.  We had everything and even more than we expected. The accommodation is so well-equiped, charming and tidy you wanna move in. Also the location is top and Carolina provided us with tips & advises. Would book the accommodation any time again I am in Berlin. BR, Lynn

Our stay in Berlin was absolutely wonderful! The house was not only spacious but also exquisitely decorated, offering the perfect blend of comfort and style. It felt like the kind of place you'd never want to leave. Carolina and Oliver, the hosts, were incredibly warm and attentive, ensuring that every aspect of our stay was enjoyable.
The neighborhood was delightful, with convenient parking and a welcoming atmosphere. Plus, within a 5-minute walk, there was a vast forest perfect for jogging, biking, or simply enjoying a peaceful time surrounded by nature.
Overall, I highly recommend this Airbnb for anyone looking for a memorable and comfortable stay in Berlin. Thank you, Carolina and Oliver, for providing such a fantastic experience!
Enjoyable stay in a great part of the West End Of Berlin. Amazing host and great place.

The home was a good fit for our group of 5.  The two floors provided privacy and the bedrooms were all very quiet. There was plenty of space for us all to spread out. The kitchen was well-appointed. Our only issue was the upstairs shower has terrible water pressure. So bad that we all just used the downstairs bathroom.  But, a small issue to an otherwise great stay.

This is the 2nd time we stayed at Carolina's place. And again we had an amazing time. The house is beautiful, everything works as described and the neighborhood is beautiful (including the cute farmer's market once a week).
Carolina and Oliver were super responsive and addressed all our questions immediately.
We'd love to stay again!
Awesome service ! Very clean, the host is very kind and arranging ! Best plan for large groups, I recommend 100% !
Werner was a great host, very responsive, flexible and helpful. The accommodation was amazing and spacious, with easy accessible links into central Berlin.

This place is fantastic. It exceeded our expectations it was so good. The location is great with quick and easy access to the city. The place itself was clean, comfortable, and complete with amenities. Will definitely stay again and highly recommend for others.

We had a fantastic stay at Werner’s apartment. This place is perfect if you are a big group like we were.
Werner’s communication was excellent leading up to the stay. He was there to greet us on arrival as well.
The apartment was very clean and looked like the photos. It was well connected and easy to get public transport nearby.
The numerous bathrooms and bedrooms mean that there is plenty of space for everyone. I couldn’t recommend this enough if you are a big group in Berlin! Thanks Werner!
Werner's place was perfect for our large group of 28. It was spotless and had everthing we needed for our three night stay! I would highly recommend to any larger groups visiting Berlin.

We stayed there during a business trip. It had everything we needed. And with questions we could always reach out to the owner. There is also a bakery and a grocery store not too far away. We definitely recommend staying at this Airbnb.

Just as advertised. Excellent place to stay.
Especially liked the partial glass floor on the deck above.
Definitely would consider staying there again.
Only issue was at checkin (due to a same day checkout). The cleaning service packed away some materials while they were wet, and there was a mild odor when those cupboards were opened. Not a major problem though. Probably wouldn't have even been an issue had we stayed over after an empty day.
The apartment was amazing! Spacious, modern, very clean, beautiful building and great location close to checkpoint Charlie. I would absolutely stay here again!

Every apartment should be like this--spacious, clean and modern, with every thing you need for a long term stay. We loved the architecture and the interior design, including the 1.5 bathrooms. The hosts provided abundant storage in the kitchen, bathroom, and bedroom. As you would expect in Germany, everything had a place, and we could completely unpack and really settle-in for the week. The kitchen was well equipped, and we cooked a few meals here. Two notes of caution: Berlin is a big city. Buy an multi-day metro card and plan to start the day with a short ride on the city's great transit system (or spend a lot on taxis.) Also, there were multiple building near us under construction, and they start at 7:30 in the morning. Light sleepers, beware.

The apartment is in a residential part of Kreuzberg. About a 20-25 minute walk to the trendy parts of Mitte and Kreuzberg, but only minutes away from some of the commercial shopping areas and Checkpoint Charlie. The apartment itself faces a common courtyard shared with several families. It is very quiet at night. The neighborhood seems to be very safe, with lots of children and families. We chose to eat in the trendier parts of Mitte and Kreuzberg (about a 10 min taxi ride) so we aren't able to recommend any of the local food options. The apartment is very close to the subway. It is nicely designed and fairly central.  The hosts were very responsive and helpful.
Great stylish apartment in good location. Felt like home. Would br perfect with new bed linen and towels!

Had a wonderful stay at this beautiful Berlin loft! Very modern space with everything you need for a great stay. There’s a Nespresso machine you can use for espresso drinks in the morning which was lovely. You can purchase the capsules for .50 Euros each. The loft is super close to all the major tourist sites in Berlin as well with a subway stop very close by.

This flat was the perfect accommodation while staying in Berlin! It was so centrally located, just minutes from Checkpoint Charlie. It was a beautiful and stylish place, with nice and new appliances and spotless clean. We were very comfortable staying there. The check-in process was very easy and helpful. Stephan met us to welcome us into the place and also give some local tips. I would easily recommend this flat to anyone looking to stay in Berlin.

Great maisonette, clean and comfortable: design and details are awesome. I also liked the large array of accessories (even a Chrome Book and a universal power adapter). It is very close to checkpoint Charlie: an ideal location to explore the city. Communication was smooth.

This is an absolutely lovely home at the heart of Berlin, just steps from Checkpoint Charlie. The location still managed to feel secluded.  The kitchen was well appointed and it was an extra bonus having the living area on a separate floor from the bedroom.
Centrally located, clean & well equipped apartment - exactly as described - with friendly communication. Would recommend!

Great place, only a 5-minute walk to Checkpoint Charlie. Some nice restaurants within walking distance (try Huong Lan). Everything was clean and the apartment is very well equipped. Only the bed could use an update (it squeaks). Communication with the owners is always quick and helpful. I would recommend this place for a city trip to Berlin!

Great place in a perfect location. Close  to all the main sights..Next to a U bahn station. The flat was exactly as desired and described. Great communication with us. We accidentally locked ourselves out of the safe and they were there to help us out! Everything was perfect for us.
If you’re in Berlin for an extended period and appreciate location and aesthetics this is the place.  Great stay, great communication, and would come back again.
The apartment has everything you’d need, it was a lovey place. There’s a great bakery down the road with friendly staff. Great for coffee, breakfast and lunch!

We had a lovely stay at Babett’s apartment.
Babett was very kind and let us drop our bags off early.
There are a number of lovely breakfast places nearby - would highly recommend.
It’s very walkable, and easy to access public transport lines (checkpoint Charlie U Bahn).

I’d recommend Babett’s apartment to anyone visiting Berlin. It was perfectly located for our needs; close to the U-Bahn but secluded and quiet of an evening. The apartment was beautiful, spacious, well equipped and was very comfortable! Thank you Babett for a wonderful stay!
Beautiful flat in a great location. The flat is well equipped and comfortable. It’s close to the U-Bahn and Checkpoint Charlie. Check-In was very easy. 5 Stars all around.
The airbnb was lovely and actually bigger than we thought. It was very clean and had everything we needed. I would highly recommend staying here. Also the shower was the best shower ever!!!
Babett’s place was exactly what we needed as a landing spot to venture out and explore Berlin.
Very cute and tidy interior. Everything we could’ve needed was included inside the apartment! The subway is just a few mins away & it was easy to get around the city from here.

This adorable sleek apartment is nestled into a beautiful little courtyard which allowed us to sleep with the windows open and awake to the sound of birds while still being the center of the city. The flat is close to everything - we walked, took the train or scootered everywhere. Babett was responsive, we loved Berlin and we didn't want to leave!

really nice loft, private courtyard with plenty of space to park your bike. big well equipped kitchen. Close to u-bahn stations. only downside was the bed was not that comfortable! But I would recommend this place still, perfect for a city break!
Thank you Babet, we had a great stay! Location was excellent. The apartment had everything you could need.

Excellent accommodation. Heating took some time to get the place warm. Needed constant attention. It was very very cold in Berlin so that could have contributed. Other than that small inconvenience the apartment is 5 star all round. Stylish, exceedingly well equipped and a delight to be in. Would stay again.

The place has been thoughtfully planned with nice small touches. The mattress is extremely comfortable for a good sleep. It's nice to stay in a place where there is no clutter in the sleeping area, in this case the bedroom is on the upper floor and yet well connected. I recommend this as a good stay.

This home was a fantastic place to stay in Berlin. It was a well appointed loft with everything we needed to cook, clean and enjoy our time. Very close the metro and major sights, this home suited us very well. The hosts were accommodating and wonderful. If you’re invested in a peaceful, lovely stay in Berlin, stay here! We hope to return in the future!

Great apartment loft - very cute tucked away inside a courtyard, exactly as described, perfect for our stay. Nearby coffee shop the Espresso House was a great way to start the morning. Less than 10min walk to multiple UBahn stops

The apartment was exactly as described in the listing. It is located in a quiet courtyard, which was very peaceful. Right outside the door, there is a subway station, as well as many restaurants and bars nearby. I would definitely rent it again for my future trips to Berlin.

Really nice layout, nicely furnished, and well equipped. And very close to the subway, grocery store, and restaurants.
I’m very glad that I stayed here, and would do so again on future trips to Berlin.

Located on the Kreuzberg/Mitte boundaries, this quiet apartment is a great oasis for a trip to Berlin. Very pleasantly laid out and well-equipped the apartment benefits from a small outside space. Very conveniently located within short walking distance of 2 Ubahn station.
This lovely place has a perfect location to walk anywhere in Berlin. Axel met us right on time and gave us some Restaurant ideas and grocery locations. We had just a wonderful time!

Great apartment ideally placed for seeing all of Berlin; everywhere was reasonably close in such a big city and anywhere not was easy to get to due to the transport connections (metro a minute from the apartment). 2 separate rooms would suit friends or family.
Check-in and check-out were as simple as could be and Axel provided some brilliant recommendations with where to eat close-by to the apartment as well as how to spend your time in Berlin!

We had a great family stay here with 2 adults and 3 children. Axel’s place was clean, warm and welcoming. Having a private entrance is great. The place is near all the highlights of Berlin and easy to get around. It’s also very close to public transport. I would definitely recommend Axel’s place and stay here again.

The apartment is in a very good location, within walking distance of shops, restaurants and sites of interest. Axel was very helpful in supplying information before and after we arrived. We were met in a prompt and friendly manner, the apartment was clean and the beds were set up in accordance with our needs. Wouldn't hesitate to recommend.
Axel is very helpful and reactive. We were 4 friends and we had each our own bed. The place was very clean, full equipment and many places around to eat. Our trip was great. Thank you very much Axel!

Axel's apartment is exactly as described. Perfectly located in central Berlin for quick access to all the touristy sights. Axel met us for keys and gave us a map of Berlin. Took the time to share info on surrounding area and the train lines nearby. Apartment was comfortable and perfect size for my family of 4. Would definitely stay again.
It's perfect location for Berlin tour. After a full day of walking, 4 separate beds for 4 different family members provides good sleep.

Dear Maria,
thanks for being a great host, we loved out stay at the flat - it was great being back in Wins Kiez.
We’ll be back.
Best
Ben

We loved staying at Maria’s apartment. Every morning we would go downstairs to the cafe/ice creamery for our morning coffee. (The staff there are awesome, by the way.)  the kitchen and laundry perfectly functional. Bathroom great. Beds and sofa bed perfectly comfortable. The price was good without being exceptional value. The area was awesome with so many excellent restaurants. Thanks Maria, would stay there again. Darian and Andrea, Mia and Isla

Family of four for one week. The apartment was clean and well-equipped with everything you need. We especially enjoyed the balcony on these warm summer mornings and -nights. The street is very lively with a lot of restaurants, wine bars and coffee shops, but it still has a calm atmosphere. The whole area is an attraction with all the small shops and markets.
Alexanderplatz is about a 20-minute walk, but getting around by public transportation is also very easy (we used trams and buses). We would definitely like to come back.

I loved this apartment!  I stayed for five weeks and would be happy to live there permanently. A bright, airy apartment with lots of windows, high ceilings, a balcony and a traditional European feel.  Great residential neighborhood with lots of cafes and restaurants.  Just steps away from several tram and bus lines. Sleeps four adults easily, and a fifth could be accommodated if everyone is cozy or part of a family. Beds and furniture are very comfortable.  Kitchen is fully equipped, except there is no oven -- just a stove top and microwave.  There is a washing machine for laundry and plenty of drying racks. Maria was an amazing host.  She accommodated my meeting time and met me in person.  She had excellent recommendations about the neighborhood.  She was friendly, kind, and very responsive and helpful with all of my questions. The perfect Airbnb host! The only disadvantage is three flights of steps totaling 66 steps, so be prepared for that.

Everything was perfect, the owner met, told everything, the apartment matches the photo. Without a car, getting to the center is far away, and there is an unpleasant smell of water. Otherwise, everything is super.

This is a very large apartment in a beautiful well-kept old building from the time houses were made to last. We were four people, three generations, and each had space to be private and plenty of space to share meals, TV, and to sit and chat about the events of the day and lay plans for the next day. Could not have been better.
We found a safe and free parking place on a quiet side street, so driving to Berlin was fine.

One of the most beautiful apartments I ever stayed at! The pictures are not showing how the place is absulutly amazing! Very spacious, well designed, great location, and Thomas is an amazing host! Will definitely come back to stay at the same place. Highly recommended!

Great space in a superb location. We were able to easily use the metro to get almost anywhere we needed to go. The neighborhood has a good mix of restaurants and nightlife if you want to stay close and the metro station is in easy walking distance. Loved the flat as well as the neighborhood. Thomas was also a great host. Our train had mechanical issues causing a bit of a delay in check in. Thomas was super responsive and friendly in rescheduling the checkin time. Excellent choice!
Great apartment - absolutely huge! Has everything you need, quiet street, well connected, would definitely recommend. Thomas was incredibly responsive and easy to communicate with. Alles gut!

Thomas’s home is beautiful and well-appointed - it was the perfect home base for my small group exploring Berlin. Thomas also took great care in being proactive and communicative throughout our stay. Would recommend to anyone visiting the city!
Wonderful, well decorated, comfortable and very spacious apartment. Would highly recommend!! Thomas also had excellent communication and made us feel at home.

We were positively surprised by Werner's apartment when we arrived; it was very clean and cozy. Check-in was extremely smooth and organised, and the host, Werner was extremely fluent in English. We would definitely recommend Werner's place to our friends!

Werner is a very nice host. He always replied quickly andclearly to all questions before and during our staying. His appartment is very spacious, modernly equipped and located in a safe/quiet area not far from the downtown (8 stops to the AlexanderPlatz by the U8). Several supermarkets and restaurants/bars in 2 blocks and behind a huge green park... The quality and price are well balanced so worthy if you're 6 or 7 persons!

This is a great apartment and, as there were just 4 of us, plenty of space.  The beds are very comfortable and the kitchen area very well equipped.  I would recommend alighting the U8 U-Bahn at Leinestrasse station as it is closer to the apartment.  There is a bakery over the road for fresh rolls and croissants for breakfast - lovely.
Excellent place, wonderful welcome, and located in a pleasant area of Berlin. About 5 minutes walking distance to the subway.

We really enjoyed our stay in the apartement. Werner was a really friendly host and gave us a warm welcome!
The apartment was ideally situated for us- shops, restaurants and playgrounds where nearby. The rooms where really big and clean and the apartement was equiped with everthing- you could almost only bring our own clothes.

Such a nice place, great beds, very nice kitchen, everything is there, you just need to look for it. Kitchen is well stocked and equipped. Lovely little patio, spacious rooms, two toilets, washing and drying.
Area is nice, easy to get into the centre, Lidl and aldi nearby.
Werner is a great host, very straightforward, good dry sense of humour. Will be coming back to stay here when we return for Berlin round 2!

Werner was/is the best.He is a very kind and warm person. He took his time to give us good recommendations about the area. And this even although we were late. The apartment is even better than on the photos. Everything is sooo clean and all the details have been carefully thought through. It was very nice to arrive in the apartment and not worry about stuff like coffee or sugar. THANK YOU WERNER

This place is exactly as described. It is in a lovely setting which is enhanced by getting a glimpse of how typical Berliners live. It is also handy for the underground and so we could easily travel around Berlin. Werner was a great host, explaining the history of Berlin and everything that we needed to know about the apartment and our sightseeing. Highly recommend this place.

The apartment looks way better in reality. Werner was the best host we’ve had so far and I bet that every guest he’s had simply loved him. Thank you very much for your hospitality and kindness, Werner! We really loved staying at your place, everything was simply amazing!

Werner’s apartment is immaculate, which we really appreciate. We are staying in Airbnb’s all over Germany and France and his was the nicest by far. The neighborhood and parking were crowded, but worked great too. Werner was perfectly communicative and helpful and accommodating as well. I would sincerely recommend this apartment and Werner as a host to anyone!

We hired Werners apartment for four days to see the sights in Berlin. It is a very nice apartment, spacious and clean.  We could make use of all the facilities in the apartment which was very nice. Werner was a very good host. He gave us good tips on the sites in Berlin. On the day we would leave we could stay longer in the apartment.  The apartment is near the subway which brings you very quickly into the center of Berlin.
Werner was super responsive and welcoming, and the apartment was clean and spacious. The area is really cool, too! We really enjoyed our stay here.

I absolutely can not say enough about this flat and Werner’s assistance.  He was incredibly helpful and communicated well. The flat has every single amenity you could ever need.  The neighborhood is super cute with great bars within a block.  We will absolutely stay here again!

We were a group of 8 people. We liked the apartment very much and the host was helpful and kind. The location was good, in a quiet area, with the underground nearby.  We would recommend this apartment!
It’s an amazing place if u want to visit Berlin, it was close to a Supermarket and the metro. Could not have had a better place for me and my friends to stay.

Werner’s apartment is exactly how he describes it - very comfy, has everything one needs to have when traveling. His instructions were very clear, communication - quick. Thank you for hosting our group!
A more than professional host. Friendly, and very service minded. Someone who fully understands hospitality. The apartment is large, nice and very well equipped. The perfect place in a perfect city.
Werner, is an excellent host. He is pending if we need some at anytime. Thanks a million Werner
Great flat in a great location and Werner was an excellent host. Would definintely book again.
Werner was helpful and kind, the space was easily accessible with a pram and loved the playgrounds so close.

This rental was exactly as described, and exactly what we needed for a larger group. Convenient to public transit, and in a pleasant neighborhood with lots to do, this will be a great jumping off point for your trip to Berlin. The rental is also well equipped with a kitchen and whatever amenities you might need for your stay, as well as a wonderfully proactive and responsive host.

Werner was a great host and really accommodating. He met us at a time that suited our group and gave us everything we needed to know to enjoy our weekend.
He understood the group and was brilliant, couldn't recommend this place enough. It was perfect for our group
Werner was a great host and his apartment was very clean and within good distance of Berlin City Centre. I would recommend his place to anyone looking to stay in Berlin

Perfect apartment, clean and everything you needed was available. Werner is a friendly host who takes good care of the apartment and the guests. Beds are very comfortable. I would defenitly recommend staying here!

Werner's place is absolutely perfect. Located in a great neighborhood--many bars and restaurants and cafes but still quiet. The apartment itself was spotlessly clean, very large, very comfortable, and wonderfully decorated. I cannot recommend this place enough!
Everything was amazing. The apartment has everything you need for a comfortable stay. Thanks, Raissa and Jonathan! I really hope to return again and again.
Very nice place, comfy, close to the city center. The owners were very responsive and helped us with any trouble or questions we had.

Immaculately clean. Short 15 min ride via the underground to Alexanderplatz. Very lovely view and there is a beautiful church close by. Excellent value. Would return 100% If you're on a budget, this is a great place to stay as a day pass for public transport is only seven euros. :)

The appartment  was very clean and cosy. The appartment located close to a variety of amenities. Train and bus station are within walking distance of the appartment. There are no lifts in the building, quite a few stairs to climb which can be difficult with a suitcase,  good workout going up and down the stairs though. Raissa and Jonathan was very welcoming. I would stay in this appartment again next time i am in Berlin.
Raissa and Jonathan were excellent hosts! They responded quickly to my messages and even let me store my bags in their home since I arrived earlier than the check in time. Amazing location too!

The studio was warm, clean and cosy. Raissa+Jonathan were very nice and discreet, communication was quick and easy. Nice, friendly neighborhood, with shops for everything we needed around, excellent public transport. We had a fantastic time in Berlin and the studio was perfect for what we needed, we would definitely go back!
Wonderful stay at an amazing location with very friendly and hospitable hosts. Thanks for the stay Jonathan and Raissa!
This adorable studio offers comfort and convenience. It was within walking distance to public transportation (which is fantastic in Berlin!) I highly recommend this place for a couple!

wonderful, eclectic little place that feels like you're up in a secret tower. However, with that, I would advise this stay is only for people happy to climb many stairs to reach the studio. Also it is not clear which is the correct floor as they are not numbered so it could make checkin a bit of an adventure. But the hosts are great and communicative, and they are right next door making themselves available if anything is needed. For example, I was having a hard time with the key in the door and Raissa luckily was immediately available to help me.
There is a nice big bathroom and also many useful little things in the kitchenette which made my stay pleasant and peaceful.
everything was great, the room is very cosy, hosts are nice and welcoming. loved my stay there:)

Raissa and Jonathan were extremely kind and always responded within a few minutes. They let us book in later than normal after contacting them, which really helped us during the arrival. The apartment was as described, clean and comfortable to stay in. We could not find the toilet paper so we had to buy a pack but that was the only minor flaw. Thank you for letting us stay!

only good things to say; affordable, clean, & fairly accessible from the main parts of town by foot/transit. the only thing i could find to complain about is that the surrounding doors/buildings/floors are unlabeled and look similar so you might get lost finding the room. Otherwise, the host was genuinely very accommodating and  responsive to any questions/concerns. Was a pleasure.

It’s a decent place with a very spacious bathroom, the hosts are responsive and they live next door so it’s easy to reach out to them when there’s a problem. The area is calm and feels safe, and the connectivity to public transport is pretty okay as well (10 min walk). The kitchen space is limited but does the job. Overall, it was a quite satisfying stay.

hosts are respectful and nice.
the bed and pillows are not comfortable.
neighbors are loud
otherwise all good
Its a private space with a kitchen, bathroom and very comfortable bed, in city center close to metro, train and bus. Easy to check in and out.

The place looks better than the pictures, I enjoyed my stay there! It has everything you might need for a short or even a long stay. I met Raissa and she was really nice. I recommend this place to anyone looking for an affordable place to stay in Berlin.
Perfect accommodation in a quiet part of town. I really felt at home and Jonathan made sure I had everything I needed. Thank you so much! Happy to recommend.

I stayed one week at Raissa and Jonathan place, it was quite and relaxing. It's a 15 minutes walk from metro and SBahn stations thus allowing me to reach comfortably everywhere in Berlin.
Besides there are some good restaurants nearby and bars open all day and night.

This is a great little spot for someone travelling alone. Good access to local public transport, some fun bars around. Raissa and Jonathan were responsive, helpful, and accommodating. Definitely recommend.
Had a lovely stay here! Lovely view and felt very spacious even for two people. Very close to public transport and shops. Thank you for hosting!!
Our stay at Jonathan Raissa‘s place was exactly what we needed. We had a few stores near the area and the train or the bus was never more than 15 minutes away. Would definitely stay here again.

The host was really kind and quick to accommodate me, even when my train to Berlin was delayed and my flight out cancelled. The flat is as described, the neighborhood is quiet and well-connected, and I would be very happy to stay again.

Staying at Ailon house was wonderful! His house is big ang very nice! Everything was clean and we had all we needed! He stayed at home with us but let us all the privacy we needed and at the same time he was always there if we had a question! I would reccoment you to stay at his house! The pubblic transports are just in front of the house and you can reach the city centre in 10 minutes!

Ben's flat was nice and clean and comfortable, with all the amenities one would need for a holiday stay. Dishwasher was an added bonus which I didn't expect :) ! Lots of shops nearby and a well equipped kitchen made breakfasting and dinner time easy and convenient for our family of four.
The accommodation is a bit far from most tourist tracks, but good u-bahn and bus links made commuting relatively painless.
Stayed here for one night in a layover- was perfect and easy. Good stay and bigger than i expected!

We really enjoyed our stay at Ben’s place - it was the perfect base to explore Berlin from. Despite some of the other reviews, we had no problems with the WiFi. The apartment was close by to supermarket and public transport.
check-inn and check-out were very comfortable (key in the box with code and left them inside in the end). Very nice place, there are fully equipped kitchen, lot of clean towels, 10 min from metro.

The flat owners were very friendly and responded very quickly to every question directed to them. I highly recommend 👏🏼 The apartment is comfortable and has everything you’ll need. Please note that the shower is in the kitchen. However, everything was perfect!

The location of the apartment is about 5 min from the subway, there are plenty of shops and restaurants nearby. We found a free parking spot right in front of the house. Apartment was clean and perfectly prepared.
Only negative thing is that the apartment is located on the 3rd floor without an elevator. And we were a bit surprised when we found a shower in the kitchen :)
Communication with the host was fine, the answers were immediate, we also got some tips for our trip around Berlin.
The apartment is great, we found everything we needed for a short stay. It was clean and the beds were super comfortable!

Nice place, very AirBnB. Good price. Wonderful area. Clean, spacious, high ceilings.
Only caveat is a digital lock system, that was a bit tedious and could only be activated on one smartphone.

This place is great, great location to the metro and bus stops, the apartment is really comfortable, however if you’re traveling with several bags, keep on mind you have to take the stairs to the 3rd floor. Additionally we struggled a little bit with the code to open the main door to the building as it was not working properly, someone that lives on the building had to open the door for us to be able to get in, however is good to mention that the host was always responsive and willing to virtually help, but we do recommend to check this point, maybe leave a key to the main door in case that the code doesn’t works.
Other than that, we really recommend this place!

The flat is a bit old and quirky.  There were a lot of instructions before check in. You have to download the key app, register codes etc. There were no physical keys or tags. You have to turn on the gas to get hot water. There is a big, nice park across the street and several grocery stores.

Hridik was friendly and helpful, the flat was kitted out with "high tech" lovely bathrooms and a modern kitchen.
We had a great stay

The apartment is in a great location, very close to everything you would need: restaurants, shops, grocery stores and public transportation, this was fantastic. The check in process was a bit confusing and some amenities were missing, but once everything was sorted out with the host, we really enjoyed the apartment.

Nice apartment for us as a group of five! Close to the famous "Ku'damm", shopping opportunities, shops, cafés and public transportation. The apartment has three big bedrooms and two "high-tech" bathrooms, so perfect for groups to stay in. Communication with Romo was perfect, thanks a lot!

Wow! This apartment is fantastic. If you are to visit Berlin it is the ideal base to explore the city. The location and connections to the transport into all areas of Berlin is perfect. There is also a lovely supermarket less than 2 mins walk away.
The apartment has 3 large double bedrooms and the beds are very comfortable.
You will find everything very clean on arrival and towels are provided. The kitchen is very well equipped and modern, with all items you need.
There are 2 bathrooms, 1 with a fantastic double shower and 1 with Jacuzzi bath. The communication from the hosts was also great at all times.
Overall our stay was Awesome!
Thanks to our hosts!
Amazing apartment. Large & spacious. Comfortable beds. Quiet rooms. Nice area with lots of nice restaurants. Kitchen and rooms have everything you need. Would definitely stay again.

My mum, brother, sister in law and my boy friend went here for an extended weekend. The apartment was a perfect fit with three big bedrooms with good beds. Location is great and the apartment is spacious and clean, as previously mentioned in reviews. We all agree that we would recommend the place for our friends and will come back to this apartment. A great fit for families and friends!
Communication with host is also great, fast responders.
Can also recommend Cafe au Lait nearby for breakfast lovers!
We had a great weekend at Hridik’s place. Location was perfect and the apartment spacious and clean. Everything went just as planned!

Hridik and Romo's apartment was a great place to stay.  Large, clean space in a great location - a short walk away from restaurants, shopping and transit.  Would definitely recommend, especially for larger groups (5-6).
Good location, next to the shopping street, there are many good restaurants nearby. A lot of rooms, very suitable for a big family to stay in Berlin.
We stay near the Messe every year for an exhibition and this property has  been the best location. it's a nice place too - fully recommend and will try to book next year too!

We really enjoyed staying in this very spacious, 3 bedroom,  2 full bathroom space.  It is very quiet, but is close to public transit, lots of restaurants are not too far away, and it included parking.  I do note that the parking garage (as is quite common in Europe) is quite compact, so it may not be suitable for large cars.  We had an Audi wagon, and that was just small enough to make it down the ramp into the garage.

Super clean and practical apartment. We didn’t experience any noise from neighbors or outside during the whole our stay. Everything is functional, nothing is broken, great location. Very high standard.

Beautiful apartment! Very spacious, heated floors, full kitchen for cooking if needed. Convenient parking on site. Local market for groceries, Impala cafe within walking distance as well as great Thai food at Papaya that is also an easy walk.
S and U stations allow access to any other parts of the city for hitting major attractions. The day pass was most economical. Sections A and B will get you to most top attractions. Include C if you are headed to the airport.
Great place to stay!
Amazing place!  Lots of space and very clean.  When we come back to Berlin we are staying with Hridik.

Everything perfect!
Big, cosy house with a nice big balcony.
Excellent communication with the owner.
Easy access and strategic location for the fair.
Always remains our first choice when we come to Berlin on business.
Amazing apartment, ideally located (especially for Messe Berlin), and well equiped! Thank you Hridik!
The flat was exactly as described and Hridik was very responsive. It was clean, spacious, all instructions were clear including inside the flat. Great neighbourhood as well! Thank you!
Had a lovely stay at Frank's. The location is not very central but it's accessible to public transportation. Frank was very helpful made the stay a pleasant one.
One guess described it as a clockwork. This description fits perfectly. I enjoyed my stay and I would use it again.
Very nice and comfortable, Its the 2nd time i am staying at Parwana & Franks and i loved it. I would highly recommend it.
It was nice staying at Parwana & Frank's once again. Looking forward to  my next stay in berlin

The room was tidy and clean, the bathroom was super clean and very comfortable. If you are a light sleeper this might not be the right place for you: we could literally hear the conservation of the people in the room next to us. Apart from that: great place!

Frank is so kind and helpful but place is not good. A lot  of noise all night from other guests and place makes me feel unsafe. Location is far away city center. Unfortunately I don’t like and don’t recommend.
The place is fine for a short visit. It was convenient for public transportation. It was shared with many families but no issue for cleaning, people were quite good neighbors.

Great experience. Frank was very responsive and accommodating.
Highly recommend if you want to stay on this side of the City.

The entrance door needs to be fixed as it does not close itself and you need to push/pull all the way to close. The floor on the hallways and room was dusty and you could feel it on your feed.  Frank was super communicative and check-in was fairly easy.

Easy and super flexible check-in. Place was as described. Cool neighborhood and very clear details for the place. It’s like staying in a small, low cost, cozy hostel with your own private room. Would definitely stay there again.

I had an easy time getting in and out and there were several food and drink options locally. Near enough to many attractions so that walking was not an issue. Many historic sites in the area, including monuments and museums. The space was always clean and the other guests were pleasant and quiet as well.

Very nice stay in a superb location close to Charlottenburg Palace. The stay was easy to find, flexible to check in and Frank provides clear instructions and directions on how to get there.
Will certainly be back soon.
A very cosy and nice place, close to the central bus station and easy  access to central Berlin
Very nice appartment, lovely and calm neigborhood,well connected and quite close to the city center, nice and available host 😊
The accommodation was easy to find and had a quiet area. We always got a quick response and they were flexible with early check in.

Chris is very nice and thoughtful host. He very friendly to meet us, and on time a lot of information about Berlin. The house is very clean and convenient for transportation.
Highly recommended to other guests！

our stay at the Berlin getaway was absolutely amazing!
this is by far the most beautiful and luxurious house we've ever stayed in.
the house is beautiful and well designed , and every little detail is thoroughly thought of.
Christopher was an amazing host and took care of our every need.
we will surely come back!

Great place with touches of home, Chris was very helpful and helped with every question.
Highly highly recommended

The apartment was very nice, very clean, well designed, the hosts thought of every detail and because of that we felt very comfortable like we are at our home. The hosts were very friendly and available, the check in and out was easy. I highly recommend this apartment .

Chris’s place is the best of the best and it made our stay in Berlin more enjoyable. I recommend everyone come to Berlin stay in this BnB. Super location, free parking, supermarket, public transportation all around. The apartment was spotless and comfortable. Chris is very helpful and hospitable and gave us a warm welcome in person! Will definitely stay here again if we come back to Berlin and will definitely recommend it to whoever go to Berlin.

Tastefully decorated and well appointed accommodation in a lovely quiet neighborhood. Easy 1min walk from the tram station or 15 min walk to the Sbahn. The beds were very comfortable. We really enjoyed our stay. Thank you!

Very nice apartment in quiet and beautiful area. Had morning walks in nearby park. Market very near and good public transportation connections. Very clean, good equipment. Nicely decorated just like in photos. Smooth and nice communication and helpful service. Strongly recommend.
A great welcome, a very nice, spacious, nicely decorated and ideally placed apartment. I highly recommend this address!

This apartment is wonderful. The space is large, well appointed, incredibly clean, and Mrs Edler, the neighbor who greeted us and helped us get in was friendly and helpful. We would be happy to return to this flat again.

Fabulous, well-equipped flat in a brilliant location. The apartment was so comfortable it was sometimes hard to leave it and the balcony overlooking the street - but when we did, it was so quick and easy to go shopping, eat out or just take the U-Bahn to get anywhere in the city! I've been to Berlin many times and stayed in various areas, but this was one of the best, so I hope we will come back another time. As a first AirBnB experience it was also great having the friendly key-holder next door to answer any questions. Thank you very much, Hannah.

I stayed at Hannah’s spacious Airbnb for 2 weeks as a remote worker and felt at home right off the bat. The neighborhood is quiet (so you’ll sleep like a baby in the very comfy bed), but the Ubahn is near so you can get anywhere you want super fast. The communication with the host went smoothly. Can’t recommend this place enough and I will most definitely come back.🖤

The flat is great and very clean. The tube is a 5 minute walk from the flat and gets you into the centre of Berlin in about 15 minutes. The check-out time is non-negotiable, but otherwise the flat and hosts are fantastic.

This is a clean, spacious and comfortable apartment in what we thought was a perfect location. Close to many public transportation options and an interesting, authentic, not yet gentrified neighborhood. Easy to get to the best spots in Berlin. We'd stay here again.

This apartment is a really beautiful space located in a chilled and pleasant district, close to the U-Bahn and a short walk from supermarkets, shops, and Strandbad Plötzensee. We had difficulties at the beginning of our stay; the locks on the door are very stiff at first, and the second bed was not set up for us and there were no instructions. We had to make two call-outs to a member of Ben's team but he was very helpful and kind and came straight to help us out. We loved the stylish, open setup of the apartment and the beds were very comfortable. Ideal for dining in but could do with a couple more pans as we were cooking meals for 4! Otherwise we really loved our stay here and would definitely come back!

The apartment was very clean and comfortable with plenty cafes nearby, close to transport and we are so glad we were able to stay there. We had a lovely meal at Saray  the Turkish restaurant nearby and would recommend you give it a try. All in all we loved staying at Ben's apartment
Very convenient location - very clean with good communications.. Very happy to use the flat next time I'm in Berlin !!
It's a good apartment for a short trip to Berlin. Even so it's not on the center of Berlin, the transportations available are good.

Spacious place close to bus and metro links, with plenty of local restaurants nearby. The interior layout and lighting were cozy and made us felt right at home, though the 3 flight of stairs and special check-in method to access the flat may be a little challenging for some.
The apartment was perfect and exactly as shown in the listing. The beds were comfortable, apartment clean with lots of amenities to make our stay very comfortable. Very close to trams and subways.
Very nice place, clean, organized and good location. Just the "cleaning" that should be cheaper.
Helpful and sweet host..Wonderful cabin in the garden, made first time in Berlin a memorable experience would definitely stay there next time in Berlin
We had a great stay and enjoyed the picturesque location! Ulla was very responsive and a great host :)

A great place to explore Berlin, if you like nature and staying out of the city buzz.
It was perfect for us, a peaceful neighborhood, a lake to swim nearby, a great, laid back and private garden, a shop across the street, everything you need.
Ulla was a superb host, making sure we were fine and helping us with everything we needed.
Danke, Ulla!
Most gorgeous place to stay, had a lovely garden and Ulla brought us waffles on the morning of our checkout :)

It is a great flat in the cosy Prenzlauer Berg district, which has everything you need. The apartment is totally new! I loved it very much and want to come back soon. - Thanks especially to Anna for the good and fast communication.

Anna’s apartment was perfect for my trip. She was very communicative. The place is easy to get to and easy check in and out. In a lovely quiet neighborhood and close to everywhere I wanted to be. I would stay here again!
The place was very clean and nicely decorated. It was located close to restaurants, cafes and the train station.

I loved the location and the contactless check-in and access to property.
The host took care of me and followed up with me to make sure that I’m well served.
I recommend this place and karolina is amazing.

Good flat, but be careful it's on the street so many light when night comes and not many privacy but super quiet when windows are closed.
Near ( 800m ) a big U/S bahn station - good localisation - clean, well organised and useful concerning many details - good for 2 friends

Karolina’s apartment was great for a weekend trip! It was super clean and the beds were very comfortable. It had all the essential amenities we needed.
The apartment is on the ground floor so we had to keep the curtains closed at all times but other than that we really enjoyed our stay. Thank you Karolina
Great place to stay for a few days in Berlin! A bit tight in terms of space but not bad. Easy to get around via the S-Bahn or tram. Host was very friendly and quick to respond!

Small but cozy Airbnb! Conveniently located right next to the train, which made it easy to move around Berlin. Loved the neighborhood too. Prenzlauer Berg has a lot of fun spots for food and drinks. Karolina was a great host!

This space is very cleverly put together, the use of space worked well for 3 people and the bathroom was nice and spacious.
It was easy to cook and do laundry, watch tv - it quickly felt like a home.
The location is a doable 20 min ride outside the city center in a quiet area. In the winter, I did wish there was a way to adjust the heat which was automatic. It would get too hot or cold at times. Other than that, we were very happy hear!
Karolina was super communicative
great location, clean and beautiful area, easy access to a lot of restaurants and stores. communicative host and very clean modern space

We are very satisfied with our stay at Karolina’s place. The apartment is not the biggest, but accomodates 4 people without any problem. It had everything we needed. There is good public transport nearby.
It's a very good place to explore Berlin. We liked it very much. Quiet and clean. You can reach the city centre in 25 minutes. Safe area and very nice hosts. I recommend it for everybody!
Very cute and homey place just outside Berlin. It’s a nice place to stay in hopes to see the city without staying inside the busy city.

Andreea and Stefans flat is full of elegant details, very clean and far from the cities noise. It makes living within nature possible while still being near to the city center. They reply fast, are very helpful and have a nice system which makes a very comfortable vacation possible
This was my second stay at the garden house. Again, this is a wonderful place to stay. Andreea and Stefan respond to questions incredibly fast and are really helpful.

I loved staying here. The location is beautiful and quiet but not too far from everything Berlin has to offer.
The Garden House is cozy and has great amenities. I especially enjoyed the espresso machine and the rainforest shower.
Thank you Stefan for being a great host!
Very nice Place with a very helpful host! The apartment has everything you need and a lot of additional information are given. 100% recommended
Martin’s place was clean and modern in a super convenient spot next to everything. He was a great host.
A wonderful place in a fabulous location. Martin was very responsive and the apartment was clean, comfortable, and a perfect home base for exploring Berlin.

We enjoyed our stay here and really liked the location and surrounding neighborhood. We would stay here again.
Pros:
- Good location in a nice neighborhood, close to transit, nice restaurants and cafes
- Martin was very friendly and greeted us upon arrival and provided some sightseeing tips
- Nicely decorated
Cons:
- Loft bed is cool, but inconvenient to go to the bathroom, especially given the stairs are narrow and like a hybrid between stairs and a ladder.
- The noise from the street is moderate, but not an issue. However, it can get quite noisy from the sound of the building's main door opening and closing, as it is right next to the apartment. We were fine wearing earplugs to sleep, so I would strongly recommend bringing these unless you're a very heavy sleeper.
Very nice place, nicely located to visit Berlin. Everything was clean when we arrived. Martin was a great host.
Great location and large space. Comfortable and easy to get around. It was a perfect home base for our stay in Berlin.
Um. We loved it here. Great neighborhood, clean apartment, easy communication, and apartment had all the amenities we needed… laundry washer was a savior. Thank you for the great stay Martin!

Martin, was a great host. He gave me a quick tour of the apartment. He had recommendations and was available.
The apartment itself was very clean, good Wi-Fi and a very comfortable bed, just as photos appeared on Airbnb. It had a small but practical kitchen which I used as I was there about a week.
The apartment is divided into two sections. You enter a small hall- to the left is a kitchen with a loft bed above and on the right side is a living area and small dining table with another loft bed.
The closest U-Bahn/S-Bahn is about a 10-15 minute walk but right outside the apartment you can pick up bus M41 which I used every day and It gets you everywhere quickly which I used every day.
Highly recommend!
Martin’s place is in a great location, close to parks, restaurants and public transport. He allowed us an early checkin and late check out and was very helpful with any info we required. Recommended!

Can't say enough about how wonderful this apartment is. Clean, cozy, convenient to the whole city, and Martin is wonderful to communicate with.
Recommend Albatross around the corner for bread and pastries and Bierhaus across the street for a game of kicker with the locals.
Beautiful apartment, cozy but worked very well for 4 people. Location is excellent. Martín was very accommodating, helpful and a great communicator. Highly recommend!
Really responsive and kind host. Very understanding to changes in plans. The accom was great. Quite loud, but to be expected when living in a busy area. Two big comfy beds.

Martin and Christine were friendly and helpful, our apartment was lovely, just as it appears on the website, plenty of room for 3of us, well equipped and spotlessly clean. The location is quite but close enough to nice bars and restaurants and within easy reach of the city attractions. Highly recommended.

This is a very good place to stay in Berlin. Right in Kreuzberg near the nice hotspots Berlin has to offer. Quiet and beautifully decorated and styled. We can recommend this place to all visitors of Berlin.
Great apartment, exactly as pictures show. Clean and good amenities. Host was easy to communicate and gave great recommendations. Safe and lovely part of Berlin

Martin was lovely and so helpful! He gave us a few local tips and was flexible with our check in as we were driving and encountered traffic. The space was very clean and beautiful. We would certainly stay here again!
The perfect apartment for two friends, or a couple. Lots of space, and a very stylish comfortable apartment in the heart of a great neighbourhood.

Martin is such a great Host and the flat is lovely.
Doner Kebab at the corner is really good and there are lots of nice places around.
BTW, if you were wondering, it is in the former West Berlin.
Martin was such a kind and welcoming host, the flat was great, excellent location and very spacious. Would definitely recommend. Thanks!

We had a nice stay at this apartment. Martin was an excellent host who was very communicative and responded quickly to any questions. I really appreciated that.
The place is clean, quiet and located in a an area with lots of cafes and restaurants.

Amazing AirBnB - stylish, comfortable, incredibly clean, fantastic location and Martin was the most generous host. I had a couple of issues with my booking due to my own complicated travel logistics and he couldn’t have been more helpful!
We had a great stay at Martin's place! Martin was so helpful and gave us a lot of great recommendations for things to do in Berlin.

The apartment was perfect for our stay (and even better than what it looks from the photographs!): nice, large, cozy, very well equipped and organised, pleasant to live and with a modern artsy style. The location is superb, in a nice neighbourhood with plenty of bars and restaurant. Certainly recommended!
Comfortable and felt like home. The area was clean and it had the amenities that you would need for a stay.

Stayed at Martin’s place with a friend for 4 nights and it was exactly what we needed!
Good location a few blocks from the metro. Easy to get around anywhere in Berlin. The area around the apartment is also very lively. Lots of coffee shops and restaurants.
Apartment was clean, spacious, and well furnished. Kitchen was well equipped with everything we needed. We definitely appreciated the washing machine, although we had to air dry our clothes afterwards (no big deal).
Really highly recommend booking this place if it’s available. Martin was also very kind and accommodating. Thanks!
This was hands down one of the most amazing places I have stayed at. The place is huge and super clean and in a great location. Martin was communicative, friendly, and gave great recommendations.
Good location, very stylish and comfortable apartment, nice courtyard. Martin is super friendly and helpful. Would come again!

Martin's place was perfect for our needs. We were visiting family a few blocks away is a lovely neighborhood filled with cafes, shops, beautiful residential buildings. There's a sprawling  local park nearby with paths and a pond where we photographed swans, ducks, and song birds. Also a short walk to a canal and lovely bridges. Convenient to grocery stores, a pharmacy, and all transportation – we visited many museums, galleries, and exhibits. The apartment is nicely designed, located on the ground floor facing a charming courtyard. We appreciated the attention to detail and comfort. Everything was neat, clean, and easy to navigate. Eva met us at the door when we arrived and she was very responsive to anything we needed. Martin provided excellent communication from the time we booked. Very professional team. We would definitely stay again if we return to Berlin!

Martin’s apartment was perfect! Was even better than the pictures. The apartment felt safe and secure and had all the homey touches to make it feel like a home away from home.
The location was great with a bus stop right out the front or a short walk to a metro stop, lots of cafes and bars nearby and lots of parks and green spaces.
I highly recommend staying here and would absolutely stay here again!!

The rooms were very clean, spacious and very well-equipped. We didn't have any problems with accommodation during our stay (5 days). We were satisfied with everything and highly recommend this facility. The communication with the owner was very fast and straightforward. There is only one slight minus. The downtown is quite far but with direct connection by train (S7).
Jan's house was great! The place is clean, cozy and joyful. We really recommend it!
Jan was really helpful in every moment. Big house with all the necessary to spend a week. We cooked without problems and the Tram is just 5 minutes walking from the house.

Cozy house,  clean, all commodities included and well located (15min tram to city center). The hosts were kind and welcoming. They also let us keep our luggage in the house after the check out, while we visited the town one last time.
Thank you for the hospitality and great communication during my team stay. We appreciate the extension as well. We would definitely come back and request the same place.

Great location. Subway station is a couple of minutes walking from the house. They are really great hosts. They respond quickly to your queries. The place is really nice and clean. Walking distance from Berlin Hbf.
The nicest host and hostess I have had and very flexible and friendly...the location is superb!

I have not enough good words to describe Alex’s place and how kind and polite he was with us. We had a really easy check-in, the apartment was such a great deal and so so comfortable.
The location was great, with cafes and retaurants near and the station was pretty near to move easily through the city.
Alex responded imediately being helpful for everything we needed. I would totally recommend it and I would definitely get back to his place.
Thank you Alex! 😊

My Family of 4 , had a great time at Alexander's place.
Alex was very responsive and communicative, suggested to assist and proposed solution for our issues.
The place was as described, very clean, maintained immaculate.
It was a perfect place for our few days tour in Berlin.
Highly recommended.
Great stay, modern, clean, spacious, sunny apartment in a very convenient location. I would definitely recommend staying here

Alexander’s apartment is located very conveniently- the Underground subway stations are less than 200 metres away and just 1 flight of steps below street level! Lot of supermarkets and restaurants and bars nearby.
The apartment itself is decent with a few caveats:
1. The size of bath towels - it is too small!
2. Most storage spaces are filled with the hosts items, so the usable storage space is quite less.
3. The soaps and shampoos did not feel fresh
The positives:
1. Comfortable beds
2. Good bathrooms
3. The apartment complex is a bit off the main road, so it feels quiet.
Overall, I recommend this apartment for short term stays for a small family (3-4 members). My thanks and appreciation to the host - Alexander, for taking care and allowing an early check-in.
Hazemina personally delivered my adapter to me after I had forgotten it at her place. Very nice person and a pleasure with whom to stay.

Thanks we loved the place, will totally recommended to someone staying in Berlin
Very clean nice cozy place
We had the convenience of having laundry to clean cloth after marathon
The metro and bus station was super close

The place was clean & very quiet. Great courtyard to spend time outdoors, and a sweet little cafe next door. There's lots of green space around & it's within walking distance to shops & eateries
Recommend for anyone visiting & not wanting to be in the middle of the city.

Dorthea was a wonderful hostess. She had great info there about the train. She and her puppy, Nucky made us feel right at home. The location is super as it is within a block of the bus. Nice restaurants and grocery stores nearby. Loved it! We also appreciated fast internet.
Doro was an incredible host, very sweet, attentive and willing to help. She made sure in every detail that we were comfortable and we did felt like home!We hope to cross paths agains
A lovely flat, would be very happy to stay again next time we visit Berlin. Dorothea is a delight to deal with, great communication and couldn't be more helpful. Thanks for having us!

Beautiful apartment, pictures do not do it justice. Peaceful, quiet, but centrally located. Jakob was helpful, generous, and flexible. Price-quality ratio is excellent. Would definitely return and recommend!

We would happily stay at Jakob’s place again. The apartment is really lovely - even better than the photos! There are places nearby to visit on foot but also excellent public transport to anywhere you might want to visit in or near Berlin.
Jakob was an excellent, friendly, responsive host.
Highly recommended.

This apartment is absolutely fabulous. What made it even more special was Ester’s flexibility, friendliness and assistance. She went above and beyond to ensure we were taken care of, set up the place for my 1 year old daughter, and made herself available anytime needed, even last minute emergencies. The apartment was beautiful, even better in person. The location was fantastic and we walked everywhere. We briefly met Jakob when he was dropping something off at the apartment, and he was very pleasant. It is clear they both care for the place very much and are proactively enhancing it, where needed. Highly recommend it.

Had the perfect stay in Jakobs apartment. Super cozy place with a lot of focus on details and lovely interior.
12/10 recommend 🙌🏼

We loved staying at Jakob's apartment. It's well laid out, beautiful, spacious, and comfortable. Being across from such an amazing park was a huge plus, too. Our baby son enjoyed the space and neighborhood as well, so it was perfect for us. We would definitely stay there again.

We were on family visit in Berlin. Henry and his wife were very friendly and flexible. The apartment is actually a small holiday house in the Henry's courtyard. Everything is new, clean and nicely arranged. The neighborhood is safe and peaceful. S-bahn station is not far - about 10 minutes walk - the final station of the line S7. Links to the city center are very frequent and simple to use via google map.

The place is great! It's a small guesthouse. it can be perfect for a family/friends comprising of 4-5 persons.
Please note, it's a long way from the center of Berlin. At least 45 minutes to travel from this guesthouse to the center.
Rest, its all good, there is a heater equipment, and there are temperature controls for the floors to be heated.
Just in case if you are willing to get this place for the pool, please note due to winter season, the pool will only be usable from May on wards.
The hosts were great, responsive and friendly.

Birgit und Henry are very welcoming and friendly. The flat is an annex set in a shielded back garden next to the swimming pool so idea for privacy and jumping straight in! There is a covered seating area (veranda) in front of the building ideal for barbecue's (supplied) or chilling in the evening. The flat is fully equipped with all the usual amenities and even a washing machine.  4 single beds, 2 in the bedroom and 2 sofa beds. The S trains run regularly to the centre, (20 - 30 mins) tickets cost 3 euros. (better to get a 24 hour ticket covers all trains / trams) The station / shops are a 5 min walk from there. I can highly recommend to small families or couples who just want to chill or let the kids play happily.
The house is very clean. Everything you need is in the house and most importantly the hosts are nice and helpful. The kids enjoyed the pool. Recommended
This was a really nice place, fantastic with the porch and the pool. Ideal get away after a long day walking in Berlin!!

This a gem of an apartment, tucked away in a quiet courtyard close to both Viktoria Park and all the bustle of Bergmannstraße. It is high celinged and white walled with a large sofa on which one can drape oneself. Long net curtains soften the windows and flutter in the breeze. A deck outside overlooks a small garden at the rear. The kitchen is well equipped to cater for many or just a few.
There is ample living space, two good bathrooms (one with bath!) and the option to use an enviable sound system.
One can simply lounge here, cook, read or step out out to the immediate cafes and restaurants for a breakfast coffee or evening meal. There is excellent WiFi but no TV. Bliss!
In all a fantastic base from which to go exploring.
This has to be one of the most stylish places in all of Berlin. Way more space than you'd expect, bright and airy, and walking distance to great shops and cafés.

We felt immediately at home at this huge and gorgeous flat. We were grateful for the renewal the home provided us between city adventures. The stunning interiors and lush private courtyard brim with creative energy. Being so close to Viktoriapark was wonderful. Thank you for sharing this lovely space with us!

We had the best time at Sarah & Francesco's place. A beautiful haven of peace and creativity, curated with love and artistry. We felt at home. We never wanted to leave. THANK YOU for inspiring us so much. We will be back!!

Sarah and Francesco’s home is incredibly charming and well-situated: one really has the impression of being in the country with all the amenities of a lively, vibrant urban neighborhood. The apartment is decorated with verve and taste, and it was perfectly spacious for three guests. Definitely consider booking with them if you want a central location in Berlin with all the peace and quiet of a country home!

Sarah and Francesco did a wonderful job making their home, our home during our visit.  The apartment is well appointed, clean and tastefully decorated.  The beds were comfortable and big fluffy towels were laid out for our use.  We enjoyed our stay very much and the location served our purposes perfectly.  We'll done guys and thank you for the use of your home.  Cheers
Ulla's place was great - much better than the photos suggested! Very easy communication and extremely clean with a great kitchen. Thanks :)

We had a great time the flat is super cute and clean. Downstairs there is an amazing coffee. The place is central and calm. Ursula is really nice, and calm and she let us treats when we arrived. we recommend !
Ursula hosted us at very short notice. She was extremely welcoming and her place was great - spacious, comfortable and really close to the transport links.

Ursula's was  very welcoming. The communication was easy, he waited up for me when my flight got delayed, and kept my luggage on the last day (even printed a map for me!). The place is big and clean and the subway station is only a few minutes away and direct to alexanderplatz! Overall a great stay!
nice place to stay .there are small restorants and bars and shops aound.very easy for the metro.the flat is very clean.
