The place is very Nice and in a excellent neighbourhood. The room is Nice and she even left us Some drinks and snacks! Thank you for that.
The area is super Nice and there a loats of places for diner and drinks.
The only thing that was less pleasent is that it is very noisey in the appartement. You can really here the neighboors talk and have conversations and the children run next door. Also the upper living people you can here. For us it was not bad because we dont party and wake up early. But if you want to sleep till 11.00 you need to be a good sleeper haha. Overall it is a Nice place and the communication is super easy with ulla.

First off, Ulla is an excellent host who put in alot of effort in ensuring that her guests have a good experience. She was patient despite our transportation delays before check in and took the time to explain some unique aspects of her apartment.
This apartment is cozy and is suitable for short stays. Strongly recommend!!

This pent house is spacious and homely and perfect for a trip away. Check in was easy and friendly and it’s right next to a tube stop so you can get anyway in Berlin!
I’d recommend downloading the app “citymapper”
Definitely would stay here again and recommend :)

Amazing place for a homely experience.
Sweet host and very flexible.
Will come back

We spent 15 days in Ursula's beautiful apartment: large, tastefully decorated with a berlin style touch and equipped with everything. The apartment is located in the nicest neighborhood of Berlin full of bars, green spaces and where you can really breathe a neighborhood life. Below the apartment there is a Portuguese bakery where we had our breakfast every morning and next to the Urusla's gate there is Bar Pilz which was our favorite place for an evening apéro.
Thank you Ursula and thank you Neukolln, I would move to Weissestrasse tomorrow, if I could!
That was perfect! The flat is just what we needed for our one week stay in Berlin. The area is very convenient and it's a thrill to go jogging at Tempelhof in the morning! Thanks Ursula

Ursula is very responsive and very convinient.
The appartment was perfect - clean, really nice neighboorhood.
I can’t recommend enough Ursula and her appartment.

Clean, private and well furnished flat in one of Berlin‘s great neighborhoods.  Close to amazing restaurants, parks, bars, cafés and public transportation (in case you want to visit other parts of the city).
clean apartment in excellent location - we had a nice stay but should note that the building smells strongly of smoke

It was wonderful. Ursula was waiting outside when I arrived and was so helpful. The place was suuuuper clean and quiet!! Too the neighborhood is fantastic… after checking out Berlin it was great to come home to a quiet area that had good low key bars and restaurants. I highly recommend this place! Also, the u Hahn is right around the corner! Perfect!

We had the best time at Ursula's, everything was so clean that looked like new. She thought of all the little details that we might need. Neighborhood is great and quiet and different from city center which we really liked. U is 2 min from the appartment so it is easy to get anywhere. Best bakery "Gorilla" is 2 min also. Highly recommend!

We were warmly welcomed by Oliver. He took the time to show us around the house, and gave many recommendations on which places to visit and where to find supermarkets and public transport.
The house is nicely located in a quiet area, but still very close to all facilities and the centre. It is spacious, and located in a courtyard. The kitchen is well equiped, although the fridge was a bit too small for a group of 9 (it only fits daily shoppings), and we missed a chopping board. The showers were really nice!
If you go to Berlin with a group, we would certainly recommend it!
Great week-end un Berlin thanks to this great house, a lot of space and very Nice host ! Thank you
Very spacious and clean.  Great showers.  Reasonably close street parking and bus stop.  Close to many important landmarks.  Would definitely recommend.
Thanks a great place to stay with easy public transport access into the city centre and good local restaurants and bars

We were a family of five staying in Berlin as part of a summer trip across Europe. Oliver’s place was very clean and comfortable and like a calm little oasis in the middle of the city.
Oliver was also very responsive as a host and made it very easy to check in and out. I would strongly recommend this as a great place to stay.
Loved our stay! Our whole family enjoyed it. My mother in law also really appreciated how responsive Oliver was and how he brought extra pillows for her.

We enjoyed our stay at Oliver’s.
The house was tucked in a more secluded place not right out in the open.
Tidy & clean upon arrival.
Everything was like the pictures.
Comfortable beds.
A few minute walk to the Tram.
Close to the Hauptbahnhof Train station.

Oliver was welcoming and very responsive to requests. One of the AC units needed service and Oliver did so immediately upon being told about it. The location is a couple of stops from the Hauptbahnhof which is a large train/metro station and has a stop behind it for the Big Bus hopon-hopoff bus tour. There is a supermarket and several restaurants nearby. The place has been remmodeled with modern appliances and fixtures. Oliver insisted on carrying our luggage up and down the stairs which was very thoughtful of him.
The only issues we had may have been things that would not matter to other guests and may be expected for European travel. The mattresses were a bit thin. There was only one single duvet for each individual as bedding. There was no soap in the bathrooms. One night we were unable to sleep because the neighbors were up til 3am talking very loudly.

Wa had an amazing stay at Babett’s apartment! The flat is quiet, cosy and very clean. It is also near public transports
I highly recommend!

Nice place, good coffee machine ;) bus lines are near by.
Really good instructions how to get there provided by the company overseing the apartment.
All good. Nice apartments, easy keys management, every detail in the apartment was thoughtful and easy to use.

Our stay was perfect! Babett answered all of our questions almost immediately, the communication was great. It was perfectly clean, the apartment is beautiful, has all you can possibly need and by taking a bus, that is right across the street, you can get anywhere in the city really easily. We have nothing to complain about out stay, we truly recommend staying there.
The apartment was very clean, quiet and exactly as shown in the pictures. The kitchen was small but very well equipped, and the bed very comfy. Totally recommend it
Great apartment! Amazing kitchen with extremely high levels of equipment. Comfortable bed, lots of storage, great shower and bathroom. Would defiantly re book and recommend.
The place was clean and centrally located. It was very quiet and had everything we needed. Would definitely recommend to others visiting Berlin!
nice location very close to central train station, lovely place with lots of things to see close by. good host and good place!
Very comfortable and clean. Very well equipped and within walking access to transport and sights. Managed by responsive and friendly people.
Really lovely little apartment, within a couple of miles of most of the places you’d want to visit as well as being close to public transport. Host gave great instructions and recommendations

The apartment was beautiful and had all of the amenities needed for a great stay. Host was communicative and clear on check-in and was also friendly and helpful. Great kebab shops and cafes in the neighborhood. Public transit was easily accessible as well. Great stay for a great price!
Great place to stay in Berlin. Airbnb was fully equipped with all amenities. Peaceful neighborhood close to public transportation. We very much enjoyed our stay here!

Instructions were very thorough on finding the apartment & how to enter. Host provided list of recommendations for restaurants & grocery stores in the neighborhood. The apartment had all the amenities of home.
Babett & Sofi was so helpful and the place was so clean & gave us home like vibe

Great apartment for a trip to Berlin. The owner gave clear instructions for self-check-in. The apartment is entirely consistent with the description, with all the necessary kitchen utensils. The price is entirely consistent with the quality.
My husband and I had a wonderful stay at Babett's flat. It is comfortable and well-equipped for two people. It is located near the 123 bus stop that takes you to Berlin HBF station. I recommend it!
Great stay at this listing - close to major transit lines, safe neighbourhood and near by grocery stores - will certainly stay at this place again!

Very nice people! Clean, spacious room. The apartment is very conveniently located and gives access to the right locations.
Many thanks!

Amazing location! V Spacious apartment, particularly great kitchen. Oli was very easy to live with. I recommend this place if you want to soak up the area...we had some miscommunications but they were managed well :)

Fantastic location! Really well connected and close to everything you could need. The flat is well looked after and very stylishly decorated. The room is comfortable in size and space and the bed was huge and very comfortable. I enjoyed my stay here a lot and would happily stay again.

Great neighbourhood! Really appreciate the general ease of travel from Oli's place. The grocery store across the street is really convenient, and there's quite a few food places and cafes within walking distance. Plenty of buses and trains around. :)

Everything was perfect. :)
I really enjoyed my stay at his place and if you have any question or need some advice, Oli will help you out.

Oli and his roommate were the chilliest people I've met. Super cool to hangout with and very hospitable. And the place was everything it was advertised to be. Totally recommend it for business or pleasure travelers

Oli's place was clean, spacious and the separate bathroom and shower was a wonderful touch. Oli was helpful and made us feel at home, and his apartment is perfectly located in a very cool and convenient neighbourhood.

I enjoyed staying at Oli's place. Very comfortable bed & good internet connection. Private bathroom is definitely handy! Loads of cool restaurants in the area and nice coffee shops to work from. Strongly recommend to all fellow travelers! Thank you for hosting me Oli!

Lovely flat in a very well located area!
Oli is very nice and make you feel comfortable!
Everything was great and we’re been back several times. Tres magnifique. Great apartment, private bathroom, prime location, excellent communication, exceptional openness.

Stay here if its available!!!
He is super host for a reason!
we hade a really perfect stay :)

Great place - mind the location it is Kreuzberg - great people and an awesome overall atmosphere, perfect check-in & check-out, easy communication
comfortable bed, best shower in the smallest bathroom on earth
Oli is a real super host!

Nice, clean space in a great location! East Side Gallery is within walking distance and the rest of the city is easily accessible through the U-Bahn with Schlesisches Tor (U1/U3) a quick walk from the Airbnb. Oli and housemate were both very kind as well!

Oli’s place is a great little spot for visiting Berlin! It’s very accessible to many cafes and restaurants in the area and super easy to get around! Oil was gone during my stay but still answered really quickly to any questions I had. The street can get loud at night so maybe bring earplugs if you’re a light sleeper. Other than that I had a great stay!
Really enjoyed my stay. Oli was great, easy to contact, super friendly - I understand now why he is a super host! The apartment is beautiful, clean, comfty and in a great location. I’ll be back!
Oli was very responsive. The place was comfortable and as described. The location is great for getting around all the city via the trains.

He’s is a very nice person, the room was exactly like described, i only had one problem on his street with 5 mans following me and I literally had to run in some other direction since those ppl stay basically in front of his building, so if u are a single woman with a night life, i do not recommend the localization,  but all the rest was perfect.

Lovely apartment with great facilities (especially the kitchen), located near to loads of restaurants in Kreuzberg. The street is a bit of a dodgy area but no problems and Oli made us feel really welcome :)
Oil’s house is a perfect spot from where you can discover the lively neighbourhood of Kreuzberg. Everything was very clean at arrival, so nothing bad to mention!
Cozy lovely flat, super friendly flatmates, quickly responsive host Oli, and he would love to help you out with everything when you were staying. Thanks
Oli was great host, the room and bathroom are nice and the location was perfect for us.

Our stay at Anke's place was absolutely perfect! The place is even bigger than we saw in the pictures and is very beautifully organised, very clean and in a calm neighbourhood. This is what Airbnb should always be like!!

We had an incredible stay at Anke's Airbnb. Anke, the host, was exceptionally friendly and easy to communicate with. The house was not only beautiful but also well-equipped, providing everything one could need. It was impeccably clean, the spacious house and the quet neighborhood, offered a serene escape from daily life. Anke's hospitality was outstanding, and we're grateful for our stay. We'd love to return in the future. Gern wieder!
Tony was an awesome host, he really went the extra mile to make us feel welcome and comfortable....pls his flat was fantastic! Great value!

What a wonderful stay! Trudy was extremely communicative and helpful from booking to check-in, and the space was beautiful, just as pictured. Traveled with a group of 5 friends and had a great time. Located close to the train, which made all of our travels to the different areas of Berlin extremely easy. Would recommend to anyone!

We absolutely loved staying at Trudy’s place!! So clean, cozy, and beautiful. And in an amazing, hip neighborhood with many restaurants, shops, and a great yoga studio. We felt so very at home here during our work trip - comfy beds, fully functional kitchen, washer and dryer, lots of light, great restaurant recommendations. Everything was perfect. Would definitely stay here again.

My family had an amazing time. Trudy even decorated the flat with a cute small christmas tree so we felt completely at home. Location was perfect and the flat is even better than in the photos. The kitchen is amazing, with everything you need. Rooms super clean and warm for the winter. The lift comes very handy when travelling from oversees.
The only problem was that the wifi was slow sometimes, but besides that everything went smoothly.

We loved our stay at Trudy’s, the flat is super nice and perfect for a group of 5-6 people. Very clean, everything worked great, the location was good with excellent communications, beds were comfy etc etc. Can definitely recommend and will book again for future Berlin trips!
The apartment is exactly as it is represented.  Very clean, very modern.  Check in was easy.  I would definitely stay here again.
Big, clean and well equipped apartment which felt very modern. Moving around the city from here is easy, especially by taxi. Supermarket is 5 mins walk away. Would stay again :)
Nice and modern with whatever facilities you could expect. Communication worked very good and as long as you don't mind walking a few minutes there is lot to see and do pretty close by.

Everything is catered for. It has amazing stock of tea, coffee, hot chocolate. Really pleased that the apartment had brand new cleaning sponges and tea towels. All linen and towels provided were immaculate.

We were delighted by this amazing apartment. We were a group of three who spent three days in Berlin. The apartment is spacious, comfortable, modernly decorated, super clean and tidy. Nicely furnished with amenities like a hairdryer, tea, coffee, board games, etc. We loved the super cute courtyard on the ground floor.  Definitely worth the money. Would come again!
Visited with a group of friends. Beautiful accommodation, spotless. Beds really comfy and accommodation spacious. Host fab!

Wow.  Simply wonderful.  The apartment and its location are just wonderful.  The area is lively and near an U-Bahn stop connecting one to the rest of Berlin.  Within walking distance are tons of shops, there is an open-air market, and restaurants.  The apartment was simply delightful:  three bedrooms, two bathrooms, and an ample common area.  And a blazing fast wifi that allowed for seamless connectivity.  We simply enjoyed our stay thanks also to having a very welcoming home that allowed us to relax and feel at home in Berlin.  We highly recommend staying here and look forward to doing it again at the earliest opportunity.

The apartment has a great layout and lovely furnishings. It is light and spacious with good facilities for what you need for a short stay. Lovely bedrooms, smart and clean bathrooms and a great living area to hang out.
Friendly reception and quick responses to any questions. Great location near to the UBahn for easy access to the city. Definitely recommend for a city break.
Perfect apartment for a weekend stay.  Lots of room and very well maintained with everything you need.  Would highly recommend for a trip to Berlin.

What can we say, staying at René’s place was far more than just a place to throw your bags and catch some sleep before exploring the city. Whether it’s taking advantage of the modern amenities, efficient use of space in the house or just sitting on the porch to admire the garden and it’s abundance of chickens and duck, even in the evening it offers a chance to enjoy the stars. the house itself has plenty to offer. By far the best part however was René’s outstanding hospitality which was worth the price alone, we were greeted every morning with a breakfast made with the fresh chicken and duck eggs with warm buns as well as a delicious latte macchiato each. All of this contributed to the best value experience we’ve had at an air bnb to date

René’s Airbnb was by far the nicest I have stayed in. The daily  fresh breakfast was a great way to start the day. Everything we needed was available in the tiny house and the garden was delightful. It wasn’t too far from the city center, but far enough that the area was nice and quiet. I would absolutely recommend this Airbnb to anyone who is looking for a place.

Really nice house with really nice hosts, if you want a place in Berlin where you can forget for a bit that you are in a big city such as Berlin (and get a good night sleep) then this is your place to choose. They serve breakfast in the morning with in-house-grown ingredients, it’s luxurious really! I would be happy to stay there again.

A great spot to stay if you are in Berlin for a few days. Lovely breakfast is included and loads of tips for getting around Berlin. Easy route to the city centre too. Great hosts, very accommodating!!!

René and Anja have a beautiful property, and are fantastic hosts ☺️ René was there during my stay and not only surpassed my expectations for kindness, availability, and breakfast, but has also offered to help me professionally with some of my interests! They go out of their way to make your experience the best possible.
Can’t recommend this stay enough.

You can't go wrong with this tinyhouse.
From the quiet yet still central location in Berlin, the peaceful setting in a beautiful garden, the quaint and functional cottage, the tasty breakfast, to the warm and personal welcome by René - we had a wonderful stay.
Don't hesitate, I have no doubt that you will not regret it, but rather find this to be a great part of your "Berlin Experience".

"Tiny House" is realy tiny (maximum for a couple) - and yet, a charming host, beautiful garden, and very tasty, fresh nicely decorated served breakfasts...
Its location suits us perfectly, and it's a pitty one can stay there only on spring-summer time...

Rene and family are offering a value added Berlin stay experience. The memorable breakfasts with home grown elements were a highlight. This tiny house is generously appointed and very comfortable. It is well connected to the tram system which is a nice gentle way to start a day of museum visits. Highly rated property !

We couldn’t have chosen a better place to stay! The tiny home is gorgeous and a great oasis away from the busy parts of the city. It had everything we needed and the breakfasts were some of the best meals we had on our trip!
It was just a short walk to get to the tram which went right into downtown. The hosts were wonderful and very easy to communicate with. Perfect for two students traveling abroad for the first time!
A wonderful little tiny house that feels like a fairy tale cottage! Surrounded by a beautiful garden and run by an amazing host. He even gave us a delicious breakfast!

Ruth is a great host, very reactive and welcoming. Her apartment is very confortable and has a great location, 10mins from a park with a big lake, in which you can swim. Great during the warm summers!
I highly recommend this apartment for friends or a family.
Don’t forget that you have to pay a city tax when you rent an apartment in Berlin. This city tax is not included in the airbnb price.
The apartment has everything you need for a comfortable stay in Berlin. Plus, it's very close to subway and Tegel Airport bus stations.

Professional hosting, friendly and helpfull. I really enjoyed the garden outside, as well as the close proximity to super market, cafes, metro and etc. But also be prepared for some noise during the night if you leave the window open.

Great & clean appartment! Mino is a very nice person. Easy to reach via Airport Tegel (20 min) with bus no. 128 and 2 minutes walk. Underground is 2 minutes walk. In 15 minutes you are at Alexanderplatz. Stable & fast Wi-Fi. Everything what you need is nearby. Please be aware that the street is noisy, bedroom is located on the street side. It was a great visit!

We had a wonderfull stay in this lovely and good located apartment. Easy check inn and check out, good communication and great location just 10 min with U8 from Alexanderplatz. We will defininitely choose this place again for our next visit to Berlin.

The apartment is really clean and nicely furnished. The bed is comfortable and the shower is massive! In the kitchen there is plenty of natural light and there is all the necessary cutlery, pots and amenities to cook almost everything. The host is also really helpful and the communications has been always great. I can definitely recommend to everyone to stay here if yo plan a trip in Berlin

The place is big and charming, the decoration is nice and all the furniture is in great shape, it has everything to feel truly at home. There are many grocery stores near, and the bus and metro station are just a few blocks away. I don't have any complains, the price is fair for the size and location of the space.

Amazing apartment. It is the perfect size of you travel alone or you age a couple. The location is fantastic. Super close to the U-Bhan and it only takes 20 mins to Mitte ( The centre) . Also Mina is always on top of everything. She is super helpful.
Great location, cozy place, all the facilties inside. Easy to be in touch with the host, very helpful answering my questions. I do recommend Mina’s place.

Very nice apartment, and while not dead smack in the center, Berlin is big, and public transport is just around the corner, leaving Berlin open for you to explore. Nice urban area, some traffic noise from the street, but nothing that bothered me too much. I would like to stay there again!

Great Airbnb, excellent communication and very clean. The room is very simple, but you will have everything you’ll need.
4 min Walk from the tube, would come back. Thanks Mina!
Good value accommodation. The appartment is a bit cold even with the heaters on max. Besides that is really cosy and I really appreciated that there was a big sofa to chill in!
mina is perfect home owner...heplful,kindly...apartment is clean,comfort...absolutly recommendation...you have to mina's home because she is very smile...
Very clean, super for two people, good location in Berlin, good price and very nice garden. We would like to go back!

Great location, located in a quiet but accessible neighborhood of Berlin with plenty of cafes and restaurants, a small lake, and right by a U-bahn stop for easy access to the city center. The apartment was nice and clean, perfectly cozy for two people. There is a nice shared garden out back to sit when the weather is nice.
Mina is very friendly and responsive to questions. The price is also good compared to similar airbnbs in the area. I can highly recommend booking with her.

Great apartment in Mitte. The building has a great historic backstory and lots of character. Has been recently renovated and was very clean and modern. Spacious for 4 guests and Naomi is incredibly responsive and welcoming. The U6 is a few blocks away and there are restaurants and a grocery store nearby. With a washer in the apartment and all the other appliances, this place makes staying for an extended trip very simple. Neighborhood was quiet and safe as well. I am looking forward to returning.

Naomi's place is stylish and looks just like pictures! Transportation is super simple and so close to the apartment. There are renovations in the area but it did not disturb our sleep! We would happily stay there again!

Excellent apartament
The host always kind and attentive
We loved staying there. Highly recommended
Lovely place, close to all you'll want to see in Berlin. Very stylish apartment, Naomi was a very attentive host. Would recommend.
We loved the apartment! It was a great location and was beautifully decorated! Would recommend to anyone staying in berlin!
A stunning apartment, definitely has the wow factor. Spotlessly clean and comfortable. Bonus that there is a wonderful cafe with real coffee and excellent breakfast  next door.
Naomi’s place was wonderful. So chic and central. Exactly the haven you need in Berlin. Thank you

the place was gorgeous. reminded me of soho [nyc]- graffiti all over this warehouse type door at the street  but when you get beyond the door and to the building and the apartment, it was amazing. to stylish and modern. had a washer, no dryer and the beds were the most comfortable beds I've ever slept on. seriously- the mattresses were insane. the place was perfect and i felt very safe coming home late at night. they had an amazing vegan restaurant across the street [vietnamese] and a late night gyro spot down the street. a really nice cafe right down stairs. the place and location were amazing. would definitely visit again.
It was great to stay at this beautiful apartment again. Easy access to U-Bahn. Great coffee shop next door. Definitely recommend this place.

The place located nearby central station of Berlin. It consists of two rooms, one living room and kitchen, one shower room and one toliet. The interior and mood were very nice. And each spaces has radiator, so it was very warm even at night. Overall, whole thing was great. While the space looks good, the practical side was lacked much. There was no detergent, kitchen utensils (scissors, knives, etc)  and Wifi was very week.

You will not be close to shopping or a lot of restaurants. But you are only 2 stops away on the train. The underground station is close to the apartment. Currently there are works going on in the courtyard and next door, not sure when they are due to finish.

Gorgeous apartment, excellent location. Close to public transportation, easy to walk places. It was actually 2 bedrooms!! (Most places say 2 bedrooms but they are not). Check in was SO easy! Definitely recommend and would stay again.

Beautiful apartment. Very stylish with a beautiful finish. Comfy beds and a great shower. Excellent coffee shop outside where we had breakfast most days and a short walk to the station. My only grumble would be that the WiFi was very weak. My husband needed to do some work and found it frustrating that the internet was so slow. If I visit Berlin again, I would definitely stay here.

A stylish apartment in a nice neighborhood. Grocery store, pharmacy, coffee shops all very close by. We’ve stayed as a group of 4, easily fit and had space. Had no problems from check in to check out thanks to Stephanie.

A beautiful apartment in a great location. Set back off the street it’s quiet and secure. There is a great cafe  in the building as well as several in the vicinity.  Door to the apartment is tricky until you are used to it.

This apartment was in an excellent location, close to grocery, pharmacy, restaurants and transportation. Walkable to many of Berlin's attractions. It is quiet and clean. The living space is well designed and the kitchen quite well equipped. Because we arrived at midnight we had a challenge entering the apartment. Once we contacted the BKLV management, they gave us a helpful tutorial on the locks. Thanks to the management team of Maria and Dimitri we had a pleasant stay and would recommend the apartment to others.
Perfect location in the city center, nice cafe just next door, stylish apartment and really comfortable stay, I consider it perfect
A fantastic stay at Mia’s apartment! Fantastic location, spotlessly clean and it was great to be able to leave the luggage when we arrived. Would definitely recommend.
Lovely apartment, exactly as described when booking. Lots of home amenities. Entrance was secure, lovely roof terrace. Short walk to restaurants, bars and supermarket. I would stay here again.

Great location. Very cool design. Very large rooms. Easy check in
Mattresses were too soft for us.
Apartment was clean and exactly like photos. Close to U-Bahn & tram. Nice coffee shops & restaurants nearby.

We had a great stay from start to finish. The apartment was exactly as described, very spacious and felt safe and secure. Mia was very responsive when we needed anything. Would definitely return and stay again.

Mia’s apartment was a wonderful place to stay. Set in a quiet courtyard just off the road and ideally placed for the U-bahn 60 seconds away. Trams another 2 minutes away. Cafes, supermarket and restaurants were close by.
Apartment was well equipped and comfortable. Two good double rooms and a nice shared space with sofas and tables.
Very easy to access the rest of the city and a great set of instructions and recommendations provided. Would definitely recommend.
Advertised two bathrooms, only had one. Advertised 2 double beds, only had one. The appartment wasn't very clean, especially the beds and bedsheets.

Great apartment! The communication with Oliver was fast, additional adjustments were no problem for him and the check-in and check-out were very easy. The apartment has a nice view, is spacious, clean and equipped with everything we needed.

All nice and comfortable. Table tennis  downstairs, greenery and playgrounds around which is good if you have children with you. Parking still free on the streets, if you come by car. Swimming hall nearby and some other advantages. Host keeps communication easy and flexible. Loft appt as described. All over very satisfying.
Alex respons in a couple of minutes. That’s very nice! His place was nice aswell. Very clean and stylish. The only bummer was the cold water at the shower after 10-15 minutes.

Beautiful, clean flat in great location. Alex was very helpful and responded to messages quickly. The flat is nicely designed with thoughtful touches. I enjoyed my stay here, would definitely book again!
Alex's place is very cozy and felt like home, a great location with plenty of nice restaurants, cafes, and bars in the surrounding area. Was also spotless when I arrived, would highly recommend.

This is one of the best AirBnB's I've ever stayed in: great amenities, stylish, comfortable, clean, and in a great part of town. Very close to transportation. Would highly recommend, especially for those with big groups. All 7 of our party were able to sleep incredibly comfortably. Next time I come to Berlin, I know I will try to stay here.

We loved absolutely everything about the apartment! We were a family group of 7 and there was so much space for us all!
The apartment is both stylish and practical! And everything has been thought of!
Thanks to Ivo for allowing us to drop our luggage off after a very early flight... We greatly appreciated that!
We wouldn't hesitate in recommending the apartment!!

Great place to stay with a group of 6-10 people. The place looks like two houses that have been joined together, so there are two bathrooms, two living rooms and two kitchens. This is very useful for a group. Location is good, in Prenzlauerberg with a lot of facilities closeby and very near to U bahn station. Would certainly come again!

I rented the flat for the family of
My wife. Although I couldn’t be my self in the flat the communication with Ivo was very easy for the check in and check out. The flat was very clean and had all necessary for the stay.

Thanks for hosting us this past week. We loved our time in Berlin. The location of the apt was perfect - easy access to public transportation which we took everywhere! As there were two couples traveling together, the layout of the apartment was great with each couple taking a “side” and having some privacy.

Hi there! Don't hesitate, the flat is clean and well equipped. Ivo is happy to help and furnish any information you need. Access to city center is pretty easy and the area is quite enough for late sleepers. If you really want pure silence it won't work cause of a family with a running kiddo upstairs, but not sure you'll come to Berlin for that 😉
Nice location, very cosy and  well designed apartment. Clean and well equipped. Communication was easy. What more do you want? Perfect!

A brilliant stay for a party of seven. A perfect base to explore Berlin (and we really did explore all over the city!). Flat was clean, tidy, comfortable, well equipped - couldn’t really ask for anything more. Was close to local amenities and restaurants, and close also to public transport to get into the city centre. I would recommend this place in a heartbeat to any party of a comparable size, if they wanted to explore Berlin, and perhaps wanted somewhere a bit more on the peaceful side (as we did!)

It's an apartament close to public communication (there is in residential area). It was well-equipped and in a great location, very close to Messe center in Berlin (20 min. by foot). That was for me a good two days. A flat is very clean, quit modern and neat. Very good comunnication with host.

Peter's place is an excellent choice for anyone who wants to stay in Berlin. It's located in a lovely neighborhood with plenty of restaurants and shops, while also close to transit to take you in and out of Berlin!
Would definitely recommend!
Excellent location, comfy apartment, great communication. To make it short: Everything you need if you want to have a nice stay in Berlin!

Peters flat was absolutely amazing. Very clean and comfortable. Located in the perfect place with many different amenities within walking distance. Peter was an unbelievable host, he helped me with anything and everything I needed. Definitely recommend a stay with him. I am forever grateful and am looking forward to spending more time there again when I’m in Berlin.
Nice place for single person or a pair. Everything was according to the description. The price was reasonable for the value. Place is quiet but also well communicated with the rest of the city.

I really enjoyed my stay at Peter’s. The space included a kitchen, bathroom, and bedroom which were clean, comfortable, and had the necessary amenities during my time in Berlin. The space isn’t the biggest so it’s best for solo travelers or a two person group. Although situated on a busy street, you cannot hear any street noises which is perfect if you’re a light sleeper. Close to the subway. Definitely worth the stay.

Peter was a great host. Was there to help me check in and answered all my questions.
Great spot too. Very clean and has all the amenities. Also very close to the train station.

Very good location in Charlottenburg right next to the subway but still super quiet. The apartment is very big and has nice amenities, they had lots of coffee for their nespresso machine. Perfect experience I would come back anytime.

Rainer's place is one of a kind - super neat and cosy, situated in one of the most beautiful parts of Prenzlauer Berg. It's on the ground floor, so you can look at street and enjoy the beautiful architecture of the buildings around you. It has lots of thoughtful touches such as an old GDR street lamp or a wooden spoon used as a light switch. Rainer was very kind and communication was great.

my stay at rainer’s apartment was amazing! the property is very close to many transport links, nice bars and restaurants and a grocery shop. the flat is gorgeous and was perfect for my one month stay. rainer is very kind and helpful and was easy to reach if i needed anything! i can’t recommend this place enough!

Our stay in Berlin was wonderful and Rainers Airbnb made it even more so. It’s located in a very quaint and cute neighborhood. Restaurant, bakeries and food stores literally around the corner. Rainer was so nice and helpful to us when we had questions about anything. We can highly recommend staying at his place. I have bin to other Airbnbs and this one was by far the best experience. Thank you so much

Rainier’s place was spacious with good light and well appointed. It had everything we needed for a comfortable stay and would happily stay again. The neighborhood is great, perfect for exploring Berlin with lots of good restaurants and transit connections.

Excellent location, the apartment had excellent appliances, from
Coffee maker to oven! When opening the windows it can be somewhat noisy as it is at the street level .
Thorsten is a great host. He was very responsive and extremely welcoming. We had a great time there. I strongly recommend this place.

LOCATION: 5/5. the flat was located in zone B, was quiet, easy to find, close to tram stations and LIDL supermarket. CHECK IN: 5/5 met personally, first time met a local German, good impression, he gave clear instructions, all amenities were as announced. ROOM: 5/5 spacious, high ceilings, clean bed linen and towels, enough light, heating worked well, was warm inside, the door and the floor did not squeak. KITCHEN: 5/5 all essentials, washing machine was a good plus, enough space in the fridge, clean dishes and cuttlery. OVERALL : 5/5 for good impression, welcoming service and a value for money room.

I really enjoyed my four-day stay at Thorsten’s place. It’s very easy to get from the house to just about anywhere in Berlin. I had a delayed flight which meant I had to check-in past the hour that’s been listed, but Thorsten was very understanding in this regard. Recommended host!

My husband and I had a wonderful stay at this apartment! It was bright and spacious, with all the amenities one could possibly need for a comfortable stay. Everything was exactly as described, and the place felt just like home. The host was incredibly friendly and welcoming, always available and happy to help with anything we needed. We truly appreciated the warm hospitality and would definitely stay here again. Highly recommended!

Rehana&Sina's place is beautiful, clean, and greatly located in the heart of neulkoln and kreuzberg. The communication was very efficient and they are really nice about giving me extra time for checking out. I really enjoyed staying at this lovely appartment, and looking forward to booking it again when i come back to berlin!

We loved our stay in the heart of Berlin. It was very relaxing. Rehana and Sina are wonderful hosts. The place is a bright, clean and
beautiful apartment. We enjoyed the stay very much and would come back any time. Thank you for everything!

The apartment of Rehana und Sina is very cosy. The bedroom is large and we had a relaxing good sleep. Sina is a very friendly, easy going person and we felt welcome. We liked the wonderful kitchen with these large beautiful windows. Also the apartment was so close to subway. Well thank you so much and we definitely can recommend the great apartment and the nice host.

Rehana and Sinas place is truly amazing, the pictures doesn´t do it justice. Super large space, bright and sunny, with beautiful windows. Big bathroom witch is spotlessly clean,  a really comfortable bed and good space to put our stuff.  We really enjoyed the shared kitchen as well, and the living room is beautiful. The area is fantastic, with lots of great bars, cafés and good vibes. It´s also very close to the U-bahn, as well as grocery stores etc. Would´d definitely stay here again!

I had a wonderful stay at Rehana and Sina's place in Hermannplatz: the space was very stylish and homely, and Rehana and Sina were both really friendly to me and open to answer any of my queries. It was easy to find supermarkets, and to move around Berlin as well, given how central its location was, and I'd gladly stay there again.

Since I entered Rehana’s flat I immediately felt like at home. The apartment is cosy. „My“ room was ready and clean. Subway and nice Cafés are in walking distance. The neighbourhood Neukölln is intriguing and worth a trip.
Unfortunately I didn‘t get the chance to meet Rehana and Sina. But instead I met their very friendly roommates. Super-easy check-in and out. Shortly said: I had a wonderful stay.

The appartment is beautiful and the host is very nice. I had a very good stay. The location is great with a lot of shops and restaurants next door, close to the Tempelhof and with the subway you are in the centre of the city in a few minutes.

An excellent, stylish, and cozy place to stay. Bohemian neighborhood.
A friendly and warm way to communicate with us.

location was really close to Tempelhofer felde. and also good to enjoy vibes of neukoellen! it is located main road, so it was easy to get there and felt safe even at late night.
Her airbnb was super clean and able to see her eye for lovely interior! i really loved it! while i looked through her bookshelves, i found some little joke among her books lol you will find out if you stay at her airbnb. there were big windows so rooms were sunny and bright! want to stay again :)
also Rehana was very supportive host! she adjusted check-in time and gave some informations how to use laundries and such things :) highly recommended airbnb! no reason not to stay in here.

We had a lovely stay at Rehanas place. The flat was so beautiful and very well located for lots of restaurants and bars. Rehana was so communicative and was on hand for any queries we had during our stay.

Place: Very well maintained and hygienic apartment.
Location: Can be slightly inconvienent due to the nearest station being very crowded. Rest was good as the place was safe to walk and close to the station.
Host: Rehana was super friendly and very hospitable.

Super cute place with big windows, lots of light, and plants everywhere. The room was really cool and I actually really needed a bath so that was nice to soak my muscles. It was close to a lot of restaurants, U8 connected to everything and was a couple blocks away, and the neighborhood had a cool art walk for a couple days. Had a blast. Much preferred this area to Alexanderplatz where I first stayed. It was the first Airbnb I shared with someone else. Weird at first because I didn’t know that I would be doing that but they turned out to be pretty nice!
Rehana’s place was the perfect base for me in Berlin. The room was bright and cosy, and Rehana was warm and welcoming. Thanks for a great stay!

Bernd’s place is clean, well located and huge! We spend the whole week on business in Berlin and we both had enough private space. Also there are various restaurants and other shops around and the touristic sites are some footsteps away. Bernd is also available 24/7 ! Highly recommend!

Bernd was a great host! He was very responsive and allowed us to drop our bags off earlier in the day before check in so that we could enjoy our day in Berlin without having to worry about carrying luggage. He and his son also showed took us around the block to show us some restaurants, places to shop, and things to do in the area. Apartment itself was very clean and extremely spacious. Conveniently located next to a bunch of restaurants and right next to a metro station. Overall, would definitely recommend.
Bernd was an awesome host with an awesome apartment and great suggestions. There was plenty of space for all of us weary travelers in a great location. Would definitely repeat my stay.

Very pleasant stay in Berling also thanks to Bernd! The apartment is big, the three of us had plenty of space. All necessities in the kitchen and WC are provided and in a good condition, comfy beds. In a lively area but one doesn't hear the street when inside.
Bernd is a thoughtful and friendly host.

Berno’s place was extremely convenient for us, one block from my son’s house and just around the corner from the train. We saw a lot in just a few days!  The apartment was nice and clean and comfortable. Check in was easy and Berno gave us a lot of great advice.

I had a fantastic stay at Berno's apartment in Kreuzberg! The place was impeccably clean and had everything I needed for a comfortable visit. The location is unbeatable, with plenty of bars, restaurants, and shops just a short walk away, plus excellent public transport connections to explore the rest of Berlin. Berno was a wonderful host, providing great local recommendations that enhanced my experience. Highly recommend!
Everything was perfect,  the apartment is big and very comfy. The neighbourhood is great. Berno was very friendly and helpful with us. Totally recommend!
Very nice and clean apartment in a great neighbourhood. Best location ever! We really enjoyed our stay. Really would come back in the future.

Lucie's place was clean, quiet, felt very safe, and is in a wonderful old style Berlin building.   It is located in a fabulous walkable neighborhood filled with cafes, restaurants, and shops. It is close to public transportation.  I would definitely recommend staying there.

Good location, quiet street (a little bit noisy in the bed room with the Stairs and the building entrance door). Quite spacious. However no curtains in the shower so difficult to have a clean bathroom.
And not a lot of equipment in the kitchen.

This lovely apartment is situated in a calm yet vibrant area. There is a beautiful farmers' market nearby that operates every week, along with plenty of wonderful cafes, restaurants, and shops.
The apartment is well-equipped for both short and long stays. Although it’s on the ground floor, the high ceilings and smart curtains create a spacious and private atmosphere.
The design is beautiful, and I highly recommend this place.

Christina is super friendly and kind. She gave me some tips about where to go etc... She even let me leave the luggage after checkout till my flight. The place is extremely clean and the room is so comfortable. It’s a great value for the price. The subway station is just 30 seconds away. I would definitely come back!
Great location! Mitte was a nice experience in Berlin and the apartment was everything we needed to rest and explore around all day. I would rent this place again when I come back.
Perfect location, quiet, easiest check-in which was very important for us (having a 3 yr old with us..)

This house as nice a tidy.
Has everything mentioned, the kitchen is a little small but we made do.
Nice easy check in.
Would recommend.

The best thing about this apartment is the location. It is close to everything yet quiet. The apartment was lovely and warm. There was a problem with one of the beds but Eugen responded immediately and sorted the problem as soon as she could.

Unfortunately we didn’t enjoy our stay. The location was good but the unit was not as clean as it showed nor were there enough towels or toilet paper. There was no common area either. We were disappointed in our accommodations but liked the location.
I came with 3 other friends, the space was perfect for us. Great neighborhood for a local bar at night or brunch in the morning. Would definitely stay again.
Eugen was a great host! Easy and fast communication and check in. The location was perfect and the place was spotless! The beds are so comfy as well, the place was perfect for a group of 4!!

The apartment was in great location near Alexander Plaza. Two rooms, the second room had the kitchen table located. Beautiful high rooms with wide windowsills. Multiple mirrors were useful while we had two women make up at mornings.
Eugens place was great. The appartment is in a great location and it is as on the pictures.
The apartment is in a perfect location. Very spacious and clean space. We really enjoyed our stay!
We had a great stay here, it was nice place and it was in a very convenient location.

Great Airbnb and great location! Not great for remote workers; the WiFi is slow and constantly disconnects during video calls, even when our group of 3 shut down all of our either devices to help me get a faster connection.
The apartment is not as design as you can see in photos. Anyway location is perfect, easy access to the flat, clean place. Fast communication with Eugen. I can recomend it!

the house is well located but doesnt look as good as the photos and is lacking in some aspects:
the bedsheets dont fit properly
some equipment and towels are too old, the washing machine and tv dont work properly
The place was lacking some basic bathroom things
This airbnb is in a great location! It is also stocked with all of the essentials. The Airbnb is cozy, I felt at home.

Really good and smooth stay in a great location. Was fairly dirty though the floor and the rug. And also the cutlery and cups didn’t feel super clean. It’s fairly comfortable though and is in a great spot for going out and catching public transportation.
Suited 4 people for 2 nights. Basic and cramped but good base for a bed. TV broken. Difficult to cook. Would not recommend staying here for more than a night or two.

Eugen was very pleasant to deal with. The unit is compact but has everything you need for a stay. Checking in and out was easy. The unit is in a great location for shops, restaurants and public transport.

The location was very good, as it was close to the metro station. The appartment was clean but a bit small. On top of that, there was noise disturbance at night of neighbors in the courtyard of the complex. That made it hard to fall asleep.
Overall, 4 stars
Great stay, Eugen was very friendly and helpful. Check-in was easy and it’s a very nice location as it has restaurants close by and in a walkable area
We really enjoyed our stay at Frank's appartment, it is well connected with the public transport, close to great green areas and calm neighbourhood.

My dad and I had a very comfortable, pleasant stay at Frank's. He and his son, Anthony, were very friendly and approachable and nothing was too much trouble. We had a small issue with the shower which was fixed within the hour and Frank provided us with two fans to help cope with the heat! The flat was clean and presentable and we would highly recommend a stay here.

This was the best Airbnb we’ve been at! Super clean, stylish, well equipped, and more. It’s proximity to the train and U station made it very easy to find our way in Berlin. The TV had Netflix and other apps, so we could watch what we wanted. The bathroom was amazing and the general style of building and unit was beautiful.

Our stay at Frank’s was great! Very close to the U- and S-Bahn, a nice supermarket is 50 meters away and the neighborhood is really friendly. Frank was very quick to reply to our messages and made sure we had a nice stay. Thanks a lot!

Frank was a wonderful host; responsive, welcoming, polite and helped us with a big last minute request as our friends came to join us in Berlin on their travels.
The flat is conveniently located a couple of minutes' walk from Tempelhof which is a very well-connected stop that takes you anywhere central in Berlin in about 20-30 minutes.
It is a mix of traditional, slightly older furniture and modernities (Smart TV, beautiful bathroom with waterfall shower, cordless blinds, remote-controlled dimmer lights).
There is a view over the garden and it feels very private.
We have to apologise to our hosts because we did not realise that the sound carries a lot, and Frank and his wife live in the flat downstairs. We hope not to have disturbed them!
Overall, we highly recommend staying here for a convenient stay with lovely hosts.

The flat is situated in a strategic position and it is clean, cozy and comfortable. Check in and check out was easy and fast. I raccomand this accomodations for a couple who wants to explore the city.

Great location, near to the Underground station, a supermarket and kiosks.
The flat was very clean. We had a good stay there!
Great location, quiet street. I would recommend it to anyone who wants to stay next to the Tempelhofer feld with an easy access to the public transport.
Frank is a really nice host. He is always available. The apparent is clean and nice and has everything you need. Great location as well. 100% recomendable.
Great location next to all of the transit options you need including a straight shot to the airport. The apartment was clean and quiet and pleasant. Would definitely stay there again.

Frank is a really nice person with a really beautiful apartment in Tempelhof, quite near to the city center (about 10m with the u-bahn).
The apartment is really comfy, nice and right in front of a cute garden..
Really recommend if you want a good stay in Berlin, with a green touch!

Everything was smooth and as we agreed. The accommodation was much worth for this money, with U8 everything is in the near and which is also a good point airport as well. The room was clear and well prepared.

nicely renovated apartment in a private compound, quiet, clean, convenient, and well designed all around! The place is well-equipped, and i felt very comfortable and at home during my week in Berlin. Communication with Mina and her colleagues was great, they were quick to respond, friendly, and helpful all around.

The place is very good, clean and comfortable. Kitchen and bathroom downstairs and bed upstairs - all clean. It has a nice outdoors area as well. It was easy to find, only a few minutes from the station. Checking in was easy with the key and the owners gave me all the information I needed around the area.
We stayed 2 nights in Berlin for Lollapalooza and this place was perfect. Lovely little place, the garden was perfect for sitting around and chilling and the bed was comfortable.
great place. you get what you see and moving around is pretty straight forward.  will visit again.
This place was amazing for its price. The apartment was warm, clean and the caretaker was so friendly and quick in letting us in! For its location, it was good as well as we were very well connected.

This apartment was perfect for my month long trip in November. The kitchen had everything needed (minus a microwave) to be able to cook for myself, the space was small but efficient. Bedding, towels, and basic toiletries were also provided which was great. If any problems arose, Mina was very quick to remedy the issues and was overall fantastic at communicating. This apartment was also very close to the U8 station and was easy to get around. I would absolutely stay here again!!
Great hosts, room, neighbourhood, and amenities, but be prepared to spend anywhere from 40-60 mins travelling to the city centre and tourist destinations.

Iljana was a great host. I dont speak german but she really tried to communicate in english. She was very kind, gave us shampoo, shower gel, coffee and tee for free, and let us check in a little bit earlier because we got there before the expected. The room is super clean and cozy and the neighbourhood is super calm and quiet

Highly recommended place to stay in Berlin. Traffic is convenient and the place is incredibly close to SXF airport. The host Iljana is really really nice! She warmly greeted me in the first place and introduced the whole place to me. The room is sparkling clean and includes everything you might need. Just feeling at home!
We are very happy about our stay here. The host is living right next door in case of any problems.

Everything is perfect at Ijana. The hostess waited for me despite my late arrival and the room is clean and very comfortable.
thank you so much Iljana
After searching for key we were let in. Great location close to airport and loved the complimentary beer.

We chose Iljana's room because it was close to the airport and seemed comfortable. We were not disappointed! The room was clean, warm and cozy, and we had everything we needed - from water to coffee and tea. The bathroom also had everything we needed and was very clean. The area was quiet. Iljana welcomed us friendly and even gave us some great suggestions of places in the surrounding area. We wholeheartedly recommend this place!
Iljana was a lovely host. Her directions on getting into the space were very clear and easy to follow. She greeted us kindly and made sure all was good. I’d recommend anyone to stay with her.
Friendly host who sent us a video of how to check-in, cute! Conveniently close to the airport and nice neighbourhood. Thanks for having us stay ☺️

The place is wonderful. Everything is clean an perfect. The room is huge and really comfortable and cozy, with a balcony where you can sit and take a coffee. The apartment is situated in a very quite street, but the zone is close to everything, well communicated and not crowded at all.
Alan is very kind and generous. Micia the cat is super friendly, lovely and zen.
I felt at home.
Good place for

Great space, well located. A+A where so kind and interesting to talk to!
Close to the metro and grocery store-
recommend!
Really nice host and understanding with our problem of arrival because of train delay. Also a really beautiful apartment with everything you need and even a lovely cat.

Alan and Anthony are friendly and eager to help during my stay!
Micia is super cute cat, she love stay at my room and play with guest :)
The apartment is clean!!
Highly recommend!
We completly recomend Alan´s place. It is a very cute and confortable accomodation. You willl feel like home. And Alan is very kind and helpful.
Our stay was very comfortable. The apartment is modernly equipped (drip coffee maker appreciated ;) ) and feels really cozy.  Alan was always ready to help, so I can highly recommend him as a host.
Amazing place, perfectly situated near a mall and the metro  station, the neighborhood is quiet. The host are kind and we had a great communication! I totally recommend this place!

The apartment is clean and very cozy!
The location is also very convenient, just 5-7 mins to the nearest subway station and around 15-20 mins to the central area.
The hosts are very friendly and always happy to help!
It was a perfect place for me to stay, and I can definitely recommend it! :)

Super welcoming and friendly hosts , the room is super huge with tons of natural night and cool artistic decorations. It felts exactly like being at home , lots of enjoyable cuddling time with the cute cat . The location is very quite , close to everything you need .
Highly recommend staying here

I had a great time at Antonio’s place.
The apartment is welcoming and the cat is adorable!!

The appartment is a little bit off center, but all the rest was 10/10! ( clean, comfortable, perfect WiFi, good kitchen, always enough warm water in the douche... the appartment has everything you need for a short stay ), and Ullf is a warm person...thank you!
Amazing place to stay, lovely area and the host answered messages super fast. Really close to the station so you can travel anywhere with a €30 train pass. Would deffo come back and stay here again.
Me and my good friends Liz and Tom stayed at Ulf's pad for a week. Ulf was a lovely host giving us travel insights and helping us with any problems we had. 10/10 😁😁😁🤠 xx

We have the best time in Berlin.Ulf place is amazing.It has everything you need inside and its well organized and its very clean.Its very close to the public transport station.It will take you only 5 min to arive at the center of Berlin or 20 min walking.It has 2 market 3 min walking fron Ulf place and its in a good neighborhood.Highly recommenden.

We stayed here for a week, the apartment is really cozy, clean and good) Ulf is very friendly and helpful person, our trip was comfortable and interesting, Berlin is great city to visit museums and have fun in the evening, so i can only recommend it to visit.

What a nice and comfortable apartment in a quiet neighbourhood. Everything you need is there . The location is perfect...close to U bahn and supermarkets, a nice park nearby... a 20min walk to the centre.
We recommend the accomodation and if we come back to visit Berlin...we want to stay there again.
Really nice apartment, Ulf was extremely helpful in getting us inside the place. The place is very quaint and perfect for our week long trip

Alexander and his family's home is a great place. The apartment is quiet and big with a very nice and well furnished kitchen. You will find everything you need in the street and the train station is very close ! Alexander was very helpfull and answered quickly.

Really enjoyed our stay here. It's a spacious flat with lots of places to eat around. It's very close to the train station and easy to travel into the town centre. Check in was simple and there were nice touches to make us feel welcome. Would highly recommend.
Great time here in Berlin, the apartment was perfect for our few days away. Great space and location

Very clean, spacious and fully stocked apartment. Alexander was always available to answer to all our questions.
Keep in mind though that the apartment has 2 bedrooms and the living room is mentioned as a third bedroom.

Location, location, location - and amenities. This place has both in spades! Even though we didn’t get to meet the hosts, they made us feel very welcome through quick and attentive replies to all our messages. We traveled with a six-month old and it all went swimmingly!

Nice big flat with perfect location close to public transportation: trains, trams and busses; big cosy cafe & restaurant areas; cool shops with vintage clothes, arts and etc.  Communication great and Alexander replied fast to any questions we had.  Welcomed us with kold Berlin beverages in the fridge and info on the area and transportation/parking. The flat was so cleaned neat and had everything we needed. Second time we stayed in the flat and felt so much at home.

It was a pure pleasure to stay in this apartment. Great location if you would like to discover 'freedom part' of Berlin. All our crew would like to buy a massage chair after this trip. Highly recommend and definitely will be stay here my next time in Berlin.

We stayed in Alexander and Neli's apartment with 5 people, and we loved everything about it. They really made us feel welcome and at home. They're very friendly, helpful and quick to respond to messages. Their apartment has everything you need, and much more. It is spatious, very clean, well kept and in great condition. The location is great too. Honestly I cannot think of one bad thing to say about it. I highly recommend staying here if you have the chance.

Simon was a helpful and friendly host. The flat was beautiful and in a perfect location! It had all the required amenities plus a lovely garden to enjoy the summer weather. It's set back from the street so it feels very private and doesn't get the street noise. It's a wonderful flat in a very cool city and I would highly recommend it to anyone travelling through Berlin!

Simon's place was the perfect base for us for our 3 night stay in February. The local area is full of great cafes and restaurants and within easy reach of lots of Berlin's sights via the transport links. We went out every night to clubs, spent a day wandering around Kreuzberg - through the market on the river etc - and had another afternoon at Templehof Airport on bikes, which we hired locally. It was always nice to come back to the secluded courtyard of Simon's place and the warm, clean rooms. We cooked steak on evening and sausages one morning and ate out the rest of the time. I think it's a great place to get ready for a night out - plug your music into the stereo and one full length mirror each! We had the best time.

A really beautiful place to stay. It's gorgeously designed, uniquely featured and really so wonderfully situated. Simon couldn't have done more and there's so many little touches of hospitality. It is apartments like this which make airbnb special

Fantastic apartment in a lovely, tranquil spot right in the heart of Kreuzberg.
Our flight was delayed and we ended up arriving into Berlin quite late. Simon was incredibly accommodating and changed the check-in procedure so it was easier for us and was also on hand should throughout the night should we need any extra help.

Simon's Airbnb was great! The house was perfect and had lots of room. We really appreciated the maps and recommendations of places to go in the neighborhood, they helped us explore Kreuzberg and find some amazing food! There were also some nice touches that were greatly appreciated like coffee, milk in the fridge and soap/shampoo in the shower. Highly recommended!

Great location, large space, and friendly host.
Simon was really helpful and communicative. He greeted us at the place and gave us some great advice on delicious places to eat.
The place itself felt like home and looked even better than the photos. You’ll find all the things you’ll need to get comfortable when you arrive, including some breakfast food.
Would recommend to friends and book again.

The place was perfect for me. I stayed there for over a month and felt like home. Simon and his family are extremely friendly and accommodating. The place is super quiet and cozy and you can’t be better located than that in Berlin. Would book it again anytime!

Top apartment and great location! The property was very clean, well equiped, pretty and cozy. The host offers flexible check-in, recommendations, the communication was very fluent... I can't think of a single thing that could be improved!

The stay at Simon's residence was great. Its location is excellent and it is exactly as described in the ad. The house was perfect when we arrived and it is like an oasis in the backyard of the building. Simon was a great host. He received us warmly, always responded to us quickly and made himself available for any eventuality. I highly recommend it.
We had a great time staying here. The house had everything we needed and more. Hope to come back again!

Great place to stay if you want to be near restaurants and the subway. Incredibly quiet detached property, just over 5 mins walk away from a nice, we'll-stocked supermarket too! Simon was a great host too. Would definitely recommend staying here.

Simon was a fantastic host! The place was clean, comfortable, and just as described. He was very helpful and quick to respond to any questions. The location was great, and I had everything I needed. Highly recommend staying here—thanks, Simon!
Loved the location. Simon is so flexible, kind and generous. Really lovely stay and place with many thoughtful touche for travelers.

The location of the apartment is fantastic. Very central and close to various tube stations. Shopping street, supermarkets and a weekly farmers market are in walking distance. Huge choice of restaurants close by (e.g. Japanese, Italian, Turkish, Lebanese etc).
The apartment is a modern and spacious studio flat with separate kitchen and bathroom. Really comfortable king size bed and sofa in the living area. Fully fitted kitchen with excellent oven for people who enjoy cooking. No washing machine in the apartment but an excellent launderette is located just opposite the building.
The apartment is facing to the inner courtyard and is very quite. I stayed for 2 months at the apartment and I really enjoyed my time there. Dirk has been an excellent host and I would 100% recommend this apartment and would stay again.

Dirk’s apartment is a great place to stay for LGBT travellers especially as it’s right in the Shoeneberg district with many gay bars and shops around. We had a lot of fun here!
The space itself is a little rough around the edges but it is a great stay especially for the price.
We were happy with our decision to choose Dirk’s apartment. We enjoyed our stay because Dirk was responsive, the location is good & apartment is nice & clean.
The appartment was good enough for a short stay, near to a couple transports, you are on the city center very quickly. Communication with Dirk was easy and clear.
A fantastic place to stay in Berlin. Dirk was very responsive and quick to answer questions or queries. Checking in and out was very easy, would stay again if we came back to Berlin in the future!

Convenient appartment in great area: restaurants, caffeés, public transportation, supermarkets, but quite calm too. Everything needed for a short stay and a great host that helped me solve an inconvenience in a very quick way.

Dirk is very nice and very responsive, quick reply and always there for you when you need help. Even last minute before leaving. 😄
The apartment ment is very clean and bright, spacious, bigger than in a photos. You can have a good sleep. Location is good in a peaceful and safe neighbourhood. 5 mins walk to main line U2 which brings you directly to the Podsdamer Platz and Alexandre Platz in 10-15 mins. To Zoo station in 10 mins. You can easily go to any mains spots in Berlin. Very practical. 10 mins’walk to Nollendorf Platz where there are plenty restaurants and bars to hang out.
I give 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟 for the apartment and for host - Dirk, and really recommend this place. I’ll be back and stay here again soon.
Max's place was a perfect place to stay while exploring Berlin. Great central location with transportation nearby.

This apartment is in a great location and is very cool. The hosts were very helpful. The apartment is a one room studio with its own bathroom on the second floor of a building in a great central location. We recommend it!

Max's studio has everything you need for an excellent trip to Berlin. it is well located in a quiet street but very close to the centre, transport links and lots of local bars, restaurants and shops. Communication and check-in was seamless. Recommended
Great apartment!!! Super cozy and with lot of style! We really enjoyed the stay there and the communication with the host was very easy and efficient.

We really enjoyed our stay at this high ceilinged studio flat in a great area . It had everything we needed : a good bed with reading lamps, a hot shower, a basic kitchen , a table , a sofa and an  uncluttered , modern décor . We could get to everywhere we wanted to visit on foot or by U Bahn. The hosts gave us very clear instructions to the flat and helped us promptly to sort an early Wifi problem. Alles gut!
Had a lot of fun. Great place in an amazing location, and Max was quite responsive to any of our questions. Thanks!

Walking distance to amazing little neighborhood restaurants, cafes and shops. The apartment itself if beautifully decorated and the bed was very comfortable. Highly recommend Max's place for a trip to Berlin!

Loved staying at this place. The apartment is of great taste we loved the interior. There were all the amenities needed, good wifi, comfy bed, nice bathroom, Bluetooth speaker and stuff for making tea/coffee. Close to public transport and nice restaurant/cafes nearby.

This is a really nice place to stay .we will definitely come back. The Appartment is at the backside of the complex. So it is not too hot in summer and there is no noise at all. The neighbourhood is great!
Cozy, well-made accommodation with old-school high ceilings and large windows, great view. Location itself is good, groceries around the corner, tram and etc. Communication with host was quick.

The apartment is located in the heart if Prenzlauer Berg. It is close to Museum Island and many public transportation stops. The apartment is in a quiet building with sunny courtyard views. Max was easy to get ahold of, though I had everything I needed while staying in the apartment.
Beautifull, clean apartment in a very cosy and trendy area! Everything was just as described.
The location of the apartment is very good, easy access to transport. a quiet area, and nice big apartment.

Lovely, clean apartment. Conveniently located near transport links to explore the city. Enormous bed! TV with Netflix was a nice addition. The apartment had everything we needed for our short stay. Thanks!

Quirky furnishings and great location add to a very clean and comfortable place to stay. Near bars and restaurants and shops - and only a short walk from the U-Bahn too. Really enjoyed our visit and would go back again. Excellent communication from the hosts as well.

Centrally located, clean studio apartment great for 2 people. After it appeared Berlin Airbnb inventory was pretty dry for a while during our planned stay, we were fortunate enough to be able to book Max's place. It's walking distance from public transport and several cafes/restaurants. I'd definitely stay here again if it is available.

Great place to stay, easy check in process as the hosts provide lots of details online, and it's plenty warm enough in the flat which we were worried about! The bed is not very comfy (and the pillows were super flat, with a spare in the cupboard with no cover) but otherwise we had a pleasant stay. The shower is not the best but the bathroom is really nice otherwise and it's handy having a hair dryer. The kitchen is stocked with all the equipment you might ever need. Cleaners came before our check out time to start preparing the flat for the next guests which was a bit annoying as we were just about to leave and didn't appreciate being rushed. Otherwise lovely place, good location, I would recommend!
Great location - near bus, tram and train station. Great quiet area and great self check in instructions. Place is as described. Only negative was the pillows which were extremely flat

Overall a lovely stay, excellent location and easy to initially enter. No hassle with getting to lots of restaurants & bars. TV tower is a 15/20 min walk. Sheets were very clean, TV was a handy asset to have music and Netflix. The water pressure in the shower was great. Could do with an extra pillow on the bed but overall an great stay, would highly recommend.
Excellent air bnb. Perfect for our stay. We really enjoyed everything about the apartment. Thank you!
We loved our stay at Max’s apartment. It was such a great space. Close to the tram and easy to check into. Communication was great. Would definitely book again.

This apartment was perfect for me and my friends week-long stay in Berlin. Although it is essentially just a one room studio apartment it had a huge bed and everything you need and was laid out beautifully so we felt spacious and comfortable. The decor was also great and made the stay that much more enjoyable. Max was great with communication and brought a replacement hairdryer within 24 hours when we let him know it wasn’t working which was so appreciated. The location was fabulous - close to public transport and a grocery store just a few minutes walk away. We would recommend this stay for anyone looking for a stylish and practical base to explore Berlin by.

This appartment is absolutely ideal for a short stay in Berlin, we loved it.  The place is charming and comfortable, clean and welcoming.  We found the location to be great, so central we could pop back easily between visiting places and there were nice places to hang out round the corner.  Highly recommended.

Mina was super nice (even I didn't met her in person) and the communication with her was great!
she also recommend me a lot of places like restaurants and supermarket near the apartment, and her advices were really useful! I really recommend the apartment :)

Mina's apartment was so nice!
All was clean and the location is not bad. It's near to metro station.
Definitely, Mina is a recommendable host ;)

The apartment is very clean, comfortable and bright with a nice garden. The location is easily accessible by public transport. There are shops nearby for daily shopping. It is definitely recommended for a short stay in Berlin.

The apartment is exactly as described, big , bright, clean & comfortable, for  me the best thing about it was the location, around there are lot of different restaurants and cafes, the underground train is 2 minutes away. Suitable for holiday or work trip. Highly recommended.
We were happy with our stay - the apartment is spacious and light. All the facilities were good and the room was quiet at night. Thank you !

The place was exactly like the pictures and was perfect for us! A quick walk to the train station made getting into the city center so easy. Mina was very quick to respond with any of the questions we had. I would definitely recommend this place!

Had a wonderful stay.
The apartment is big, the wifi is strong, you have all that you need.
Exceptional communication with Mina, who address any issue super fast.
Great location, extremely accessible to everywhere in Berlin. Mina and her staff very helpful & friendly. Very responsive with messages etc. would stay again.

The apartment is really clean and nicely decorated. There is no flexibility whatsoever regarding the check in and check out process and they do not allow you to leave your lugagge. The kitchen has the basic stuff. They do not leave you water, tea or anything. The area is not nice but it is close to the subway.

Very nice apartment! As others said, the location is not ideal if you do not like walking across dark/quiet roads at night. Also you are about 40 minutes away from Berlin’s city center if you include this walking part. A solution for both would be to go by car and/or to have a bike available.
Pretty solid location if you are looking for short trips to various night life spots. The place was very clean which was nice.

Overall, I had a great experience with the trio apartment…..staff was incredibly helpful, and the amenities were great. The room was wonderful, clean, and perfect to celebrate a birthday weekend……I had a problem with my car and they even allowed me to check out at 11:30 am….I highly recommend this place.

The apartment had everything you needed to have a comfortable stay. Links to get into Berlin city center were great and frequent. The area didn't have anything special about it but felt safe. The apartment itself uses the limited space very well. I would say this would work for a solo traveller or a couple. Communication with the host was great and quick. I was happy with my stay.
