Isabella is a lovely and kind host! The room is peaceful and inviting, with an amazing patio to sit and relax on! Close to public transportation and to a local grocery store.

Isabella's home was exactly as described and very lovely. She lives in a quiet neighborhood and her place is spotless. Isabella herself is warm and helpful and you will not struggle to understand each other. I would love to come back and stay at her place again!

I enjoyed my stay at Isabell's very much, the neighborhood is quiet and green, yet close to the central parts of the city, the communication was friendly and hospitable and the room was pleasant and comfortable, I highly recommend it!

Best host I have ever met, understanding and very sweet. The place was nat too far from the city, and it’s sooo easy to get there. The room was clean and amazing, the zone is quiet and relaxing and the house was so cozy. I highly recommend it! 😁
Susanna is a friendly and supportive super host, her place was like a second home for me, recommended for future accommodations for sure 👍🏻

It is a very comfortable and affordable one-month stay in Berlin. The host Susanna is a warm, and welcoming person who made my stay felt like home. The best part is that the neighbourhood is very quiet and close to nature. There are two beautiful lakes just 15 minutes walk from the house. But be mindful that there’s no kitchen available and you’ll have to share the bathroom with another guest. I’ll highly recommend it!
Susanna was a great host, the area is beautiful and very well connected to the city center by public transport. Would surely book again!

Stunning and spacious apartment, which was perfect for our young kids. Lea went above and beyond to help us with everything from local recommendations to travel to and from the airport. The location is amazing! Highly recommend!

The apartment is really beautiful and very comfortable. It's conveniently located close to the Mauerpark, Oderberger Strasse with many great restaurants, and public transport. The street itself is noisy, but the windows block the noise well. A great place to stay!

Lovely Place to stay!
The Appartement is a perfect place to stay in Berlin. Everything was clean, nice decoratet and the communication was quick ans easy.

This loft is absolutely incredible, maybe the nicest airbnb rental I have ever experienced. So spacious, great for nights in or days to lounge around, especially if the Berlin weather disappoints! Very quiet building, felt super safe and comfortable. Both Julia and Christian were very accommodating. Looking forward to staying here again, and again!

Most wonderful Airbnb I have ever stayed at. So beautiful and thoughtfully designed.
The hosts were also extremely friendly and helpful.

Magical loft in an up- and coming trendy part of Berlin, with heaps of character and style. Host Julia was lovely and super helpful with recommendations for my stay. Definitely will stay again when I‘m over in Berlin again!

A really beautiful and spacious apartment which felt bigger than it looks in pictures. Julia and her team were very communicative and helpful, there was a minor hiccup with the heating not coming on during the first 24hrs but Julia figured out the issue remotely and was very helpful and apologetic. The bathtub hidden under a bench in the living room was a particular highlight!

We had a wonderful experience with this apartment! We were five adults and one child, five years old, on a family vacation. The apartment was clean and had all that we needed. The location was perfect and very close to the center and a subway station. When we arrived they helped us get an early check in and also explained us about Berlin and the transportation in the city. It was a great experience and we were very happy with this apartment. The only thing that was a bit hard for us was that it was located on the third floor and with the trolley it was a bit hard every time to lift it up in the stairs. Other than that, perfect and comfortable and great hospitality! Will be back again for sure!

Aside from the odd layout (as described by other reviewers), OTA-Berlin provided us with about as much as you can ask for in an Airbnb. The apartment was both clean and conveniently located, with responsive customer service to boot (thank you Nathan!). Couldn’t have asked for a more pleasant experience.
We loved staying in the appartement. It was very clean and pretty! Location was great. Hosts were very friendly and flexible.
Nice and clean apartment in a good location. Check-in and check-out are easy without any problems.
Central location and a good property spoilt by the noise from the bars and strip club below the property

We stayed at this location with 6 adults and found it to be spacious and comfortable. Communication with the host was great and they gave us specific check in directions prior to arrival. The location itself is in a safe, lively, and walkable area with many restaurants and bars around. We really enjoyed our visit and would stay here again!
The hosts were great and very attentive, and the space was immaculate. Very easy to walk to attractions and restaurants around the property, and overall great place to stay.
Great location for our first visit to Berlin.  Our family of five was quite comfortable.  We would likely stay here again if visiting the city.
This place was great! Big open kitchen, comfy beds, clean. Perfect for our group. The only negative is the stairs but it keeps you fit 😂 I’d definitely stay here again.
The place was spacious, quiet, safe  and offered all amenities you need for short trip to Berlin. Check-in was very easy and Dimitrina always responded very quickly.
Well-located for transport, bus right outside door, U2 line close by, walkable to major stations, on river and near some good restaurants.

Great apartment. Cosy and well equipped. In front of the Landwehrkanal (with a nice path where one can walk from Tiergarten to Charlottenburg Schloss) . A 245 bus line stop just next door, very convenient to reach Hauptbahnhof. Dina was always fast to answer my questions.
So glad we decided on n Dina’s place!  Everything was exactly as described.  Really close to a grocery store and the bus line.  Very quiet and comfortable.
Unfortunately we had to shorten our stay due to some unforeseen events. My parents however were very happy with the apartment, the location and everything.

Ben's place is in a great location, very close to restaurants, 2 metros lines, and you can easily get to anywhere in Berlin. Apartment was also very clean and spacious. You can hear people talking/walking by late at night, so just something to keep in mind if you're a light sleeper. Other than that, the apartment is great and has everything you need! Check-in was also very easy.

Great location in a cool, diverse & comfortable neighborhood.  The apartment was clean and functional. The central location and proximity to the U-Bahn made getting around the city easy.  There’s also a bike rental shop a block away.  I‘d  definitely stay here again.

Place is on great location, clean and stylish. Could be warmer and the responses from the host were a bit slow.
Anyway, nice experience.

Appartment, clean, cosy very pleasant.
Subway very closed and several good restaurants also.
We had a good journey in Berlin and we will come back soon.

Great place with all the comforts. Clean, always hot water and heating! Close to a metro station that helps you move around the city! Nice location in general with many places to eat or drink around.
I can easily recommend it to anyone!
We had a great stay. The flat is very well located. Clean and has everything you need for a great stay. Ben was great!
Cozy apartment in the wonderful area of Kreuzberg. Lots of nice restaurants just around the corner. The apartment is small (1room and a separate bathroom) but has mostly what you need for 2 people.

Ben's place is in a very good location. It's clean, the communication impeccable. Very agreeable bathroom, very good heating. If you look for a place for sleeping only, it's great. But it is a small, dark souterrain apartment (on the photo it looks brighter and larger), not ideal for hanging out (especially if the couch is used as a bed in order to accommodate more than 2 people). Taking that into account, I found it a bit on the expensive side.

Amazing place, so well kept. I will say that if you are taller than 5’10’’ (1.78m) be careful in the hallway between the room and bathroom as the doorway is very short. Im 6’2’’ and I hit my head a few time. But the shower is very tall people friendly which I find is rare for rentals. Great neighborhood for a young person and so close to a U-Bahn station that will quickly get you to many connecting stations.

The apartment is wonderfully modern and has everything you could need. Clean, spacious and easy to use. The neighborhood is only a few short steps away to a wide variety of restaurants and stores. Plenty of food choices and nightlife just down the street. The apartment sits between two convenient U-Bahn stations for ease of mobility and seeing everything Berlin has to offer. Ben is a great host with fast communication. Hope to return soon!
Cute apartment, simple and comfortable. Small bed, but we’re spoiled with huge beds in the states. Good value for the price. Great communication from Ben, and location was excellent.
It is a nice apartment with an excellent location in Kreuzberg. I can fully recommend it for a stay in Berlin. I appreciate that Ben clearly and promptly communicated.
Really nice place, great shower and bed, perfect for a short stay. Kitchen full of useful stuff, host very easy to communicate with, I can recommend to everyone :)

Great location :)
but when i was there beside building noise is discomfortable. i guess this my bad luck.
Great stay! Ben was very responsive when we encountered some problems, the place was beautiful and clean, I'd definitely recommend it!

My partner and I stayed at this apartment twice so far. The flat is ideal for a couple and it's located in our favourite kiez with lots of great places to eat, parks, cultural venues, bars, yet the street where the flat is located is not loudy at night. Bus and u bahn stations are very close. Ben is a great host, he was always responsive and kind.

Very nice place in Berlin! Recommended!
Ben was super responsive before and during our stay, resolving all our doubts.

What a great little place. Ben was very helpful and sent a list of all the local spots to try out. The neighborhood is quiet yet lively and just a few blocks from great bars and restaurants. The studio is comfortable private and quiet. I highly recommend this spot as a great place to stay in Berlin.
Ben was a great host! He was so accommodating to me and my needs. The apartment is in a great neighborhood, felt very safe and close to many good shops and restaurants!

We really enjoyed our stay here - it was a great base for our activities in the city. Ben gave great advice for getting to the apartment and about close by shops and food. Sadly we did not have the chance to explore the local neighbourhood as much as we could have but it had a great vibe and easily could have spent our whole trip just nearby. Would stay again.

We had a great time in Kreuzberg the most interesting area in Berlin.
Ben is an excellent and discreet host and his place was spot on for exploring the city.
I am certainly going back again and will be recommending Ben and his apartment to all my friends and family.
Thank you Tallana for your hospitality! I will suggest your apartment to my friends who are interested in visiting Berlin for sure!

A great pad to explore Berlin. The flat is spacious and comfortable, amazingly quiet for the city with lovely views over an expansive one-city block large courtyard and garden. Didn't use the balcony as it was a cold week in April, but it looked enticing. Fantastic neighborhood with shops and food, great transportation options but we walked everywhere as it is fun and easy to do. Phillip is an excellent host, quick and generous to communicate and made everything easy. He also has some useful tips for food and drinks nearby.

Philipp’s place is great, very stylish and comfortable. The balcony is super nice, and lots of green to look out on. A very good location in a nice neighbourhood. It’s also very close to the U-Bahn. Communication with Philipp was great, he was very helpful in giving us tips for nice places to visit. Would definitely recommend staying here!

This apartment was great for our recent Berlin stay. The location is excellent - we love the neighborhood (having lived there previously for 5 1/2 years). The apartment looks out on a very nice, quiet inner courtyard. The inside was well laid-out and spacious. We were pleasantly surprised that it stayed relatively cool despite a few days of hot weather during our stay. Philipp was a very good host, very responsive. We would stay here again!

The apartment was lovely, spacious and very peaceful. Philipp was a very responsive host who provided brilliant communication and recommendations for places to eat. The apartment is within walking distance of Berlin (also next to a subway). A perfect calm location to retreat to at the end of the day.

Philipp was a great host and the flat was fabulous; spacious and very light (so it helped to have an eye mask in the morning)! Very close to public transport and had everything you could need. Definitely would recommend.

Philipp is a great host: friendly, responsive and interested.  The apartment is everything and more than the description and photos. The location is perfect for a visit to this great city: charming neighbourhoods, restaurants and bars, parks and easy access to the whole city.  We would definitely make it our base on another visit to Berlin.

This spot was perfect for me. I would definitely stay here again. Well within walking distance to shops and transportation.  Philipp was great with communicating and check in and check out was flexible and smooth. Philipp was there to answer any question or help with anything that would come up.
Philipp’s apartment is perfect if you want to stay in Prenzlauer Berg area and Philipp is a perfect host. Would always recommend!

Philipp’s apartment is a real gem - it does look exactly as the photos describe however the photos don’t do it justice. It’s a big, airy, cosy and stylish space and one I could happily have stayed in for longer. Philipp himself was an excellent host - so friendly, responsive and also flexible on both check in and checkout. 2 mins walk from the U Bahn and lots of great amenities in the direct vicinity as well as within walking distance. Easy to get to anywhere across the city. I would recommend this place to anyone looking for a good base for a weekend (or longer)  in Berlin.

We had a very pleasant stay at Philipp’s apartment. Communication was very good and check in went smooth. Philipp was very helpful with good tips on restaurants around Berlin.
The apartment was just as on the pictures and very cosy and in such a nice neighbourhood. We were two adults and a toddler in the apartment, and it worked really well.
All in all we can warmly recommend Philipp’s apartment, and we hope to be back again soon.

We loved the neighborhood and had lots of our best times right “at home”. Many cafes and cool stores, convenient and beautiful all in one. It was walkable but easy to rent bikes too, if so inclined. People were helpful and friendly. A great oasis in a great city.

Philips place was way more than I expected.   It was bigger and more beautiful and peaceful.  The neighborhood is fantastic - the coop is across the street and the place so central to everything but also feels quiet and peaceful.  The apartment has an incredible relationship to the back garden so you feel as if you are staying out of doors.  The sounds of nature are right there.  I loved the spare ness of the architecture and truly appreciated phillips generous communication.

Beautiful and clean house to stay!
Jürgen is very helpful and kind person, we had a great stay :)
Highly recommend!
Jürgen is really kind and his house is a peaceful place. Our room was perfect !
We spent a great moment at Jürgen's  place. Everything was fine and Jürgen is very helpful.

We stayed at he’s house with huge satisfaction. He’s house is fully equipped, literally everything in it.
10 minutes walking distance from local market and bus station.
It is a bit away from the hart of berlin, but it is quite and chillin. we had really enjoyed to stay at he’s house. we definitely recommend someone who head of berlin!
I would come he’s house next our trip in berlin.

Jürgen is a very friendly and nice host, the room is cozy with TV and fans and a candy. The house is located in a tranquil area, with 8 mins walk to the nearest bus station. The public transport in Berlin is very convenient and cheap, 1 hour to the city centre. Overall, it was a very good experience , very recommended

We stayed 2 nights in Jürgen's Place.
Everything was really organized and cleaned, the room and bathroom were comfortable as seem in the pictures.
It is a great opportunity to see a different part of Berlin, also the transportation is always running so there is no complication to get there at any time of the day or late at night.
Jürgen is a great host, he is kindly and speaks English 👌
We had a great experience, and will definitely go back if we have the chance.
Highly recommended place.

Jürgen was a very good host, he keeps the accommodation spotless for his guests. The room, the bathroom, the kitchen and common areas, everything was in optimal conditions for his use.
My friend Edison, who accompanied me on this stay had the opportunity to talk a lot more with him. Unfortunately I did not have many interactions with Jürgen, but I found him to be a very friendly and good-humored person.
Thanks for everything Jürgen,
Regards!
Great Airbnb- clean, tidy and smooth checkin and instructions. It is quite far out of central Berlin but public transport is fine. Overall recommended stay!

The way Jürgen prepares everything to welcome you makes you feel like if you were going to a friend's home who has been missing you for a long time. Everything is clean, and his instructions are clear, I slept in a really comfortable bed, and it was really easy to get there. I would stay there again without doubts.

One of the best Airbnb places I've ever been. Very organized, tidy and clean. Jürgen was very supportive and helpful during our staying at his place.
The shared bathroom was always clean. Thank you, Jürgen!

Accommodation is in a quiet district with a good connection to the center of Berlin (the bus to the S-bahn station is approximately 200 m away, goes every 10-15 min). The room is perfectly clean. The beds are convenient. Nice clean bathroom and toilet.
Jürgen is a great and welcoming host, open and ready to help. He shared with us his own kitchen! We felt like at home.
very clean house, kitchen, bedrooms, exceptionally comfy beds - I slept like a baby :D well recommended!

We really enjoyed our stay at Jürgen’s place. Everything went smoothly, the place was exactly as described with everything we needed for our stay. Our host was very responsive and friendly. If you don’t mind staying a bit further away from the city centre, i’d recommend staying here:)

Lovely place in a peaceful and beautiful neighborhood. While it's a bit far from the city center, that's quite typical for Berlin.
Everything was spotless, and Jürgen was incredibly responsive. Highly recommend for a short trip!

The place is in a nice neighbourhood and the cost is low, but compared with what you used to be able to get with airbnb in Berlin (before it got illegal) this place is kind of depressing. Its not someones home, its a empty flat with bare minimum of the essentials and I lacked the personal feeling you get when renting through airbnb.
If you just need a bed and nothing more this is a great place, the beds and linen and toilet were very nice. But the livingroom/kitchen really lacked some love.

Our stay in Berlin was well suited for our group and the apartment was in an awesome location.
It was nice and roomy which gave us all space and had a bit of an outdoor area.
The apartment definitely could have done with a good clean though.

Very well located, neat and practical flat.
It was perfect for a weekend between friends.
Very good location, house was clean in good condition, attractive price, no problems with check in and check out. Everything was ok.

Great location and modern apartment with an inviting terrace. The bedrooms face the pavement of a busy street and are a little loud. However, I'd expect the same of any comparable apartment in the area. Communication and check in were smooth. Baby crib and high chair are available which are a plus for any young family. We were happy and recommend.
Exactly what I was looking for. The host was very accommodating and responsive. We were six of us staying here and everyone was satisfied with the stay.
For 7 of us the apartment was perfect. Easy to find and easy to access the trains etc. One bathroom was tricky at times with 7 people but for a few days it was fine.  Thank you for a great stay.

The stay in the apartment was super nice! What really stood out was the central and nice location and the cozy terrace which gave you a place of privacy and relaxation although the apartment is located in a tranquil area.
Would definitely recommend!
the walls and ceiling was very thin and loud, making it hard to sleep and can here others in the building as they enter the building. there was also mold in the bathroom
ElPilar's place was conveniently located and amenities covered our needs. We appreciated having multiple bathrooms and bright spaces.

So close to a variety of restaurants, and two grocery stores right across the street. There are busses right across the street and the tram / train station was the 5-8 min walk which takes your right the the city center.
The apartment is very basic as to what's included, but with the store across the street it was not a big deal.
Only real down side is the bed was really hard.
We had a group of 4 and we had a great time!

Clean, nice, spacious place in a great neighborhood! Owner is very responsive.
However, would not recommend it for families. Apartment is in a house with other apartments, rented by young people, so very noisy at night.
The apartment was very nice and cozy. Wonderful energy!! The neighborhood was great, many shops all around, close to the metro Station!
The kitchen is quite basic. No real oven,  not much pepper/ salto/ sugar . No cloth, only 1 small sponge. The rest is ok

prepare yourself that the kitchen is not equipped at all.
There is a coffee machine but no coffee. The water boiler is so dirty, you cannot cook or drink .
other than that the place is so nice and convenient, Bedrooms and bathrooms are so comfortable and clean
The location was ideal for walking around and exploring the neighborhood. There were lots of restaurants and plenty of shops to visit.
Comfortable flat in a convenient location, ideal for a family of four. Good transport links, shops and restaurants nearby. Excellent base for exploring Berlin. We'd happily stay there again.
A great spot in the heart of the City. You can walk to everything. The apartment was better than the description and the hosts were great.
Great place and location was good - easy to walk around or catch transport. Apartment was nice, clean and comfortable.

In a group of 5 family members, spent 5 nights in Only ElPilars. There was sufficient room for all 5 of us. The rooms are well furnished. We enjoyed our privacy; nobody bothered us during our 5 nights stay. The kitchen was well equipped but meals that require an oven cannot be prepared.
If there is something, I would request Only Elpilars to change is the availability of a TV set. I know this is not vital but some evenings we wanted to spend in the flat idling around. The TV did not help here. For English speakers, the available programme - actually we were only able to receive BBC World Service Europe - was a waste of time.
Apart from that minor but somehow important factor, the stay was great.
Next time I am in Berlin, I will definitely check up availability in Only ElPilars.

this place was really great,  clean and comfortable as described. good communication with the host. in a good spot with plenty of restaurants, shops and transport links close by. There was a fair bit of noise from some of the other apartments in the building but it wasn't too inconvenient. would stay there again

This apartment was an excellent place to stay, it was clean and spacious with excellent amenities nearby.
Five of us stayed and it had plenty of space for us to spread out.
Host was communicative and helpful and I would definitely recommend!
Great spot! Mooeve was very responsive prior to my stay and during.  The apartment was very clean and spacious and a great location.

Very nice apartment with listed amenities. The apartment itself was clean a and perfect for a short visit
However the noise detector in the common room kept going of - even if we were just talking at a normal volume. We kept getting automated calls and messages even though we were not being noisy. One time it went off in the middle of the night while we were all sleeping

Had a great stay here, everything as advertised and good value. Great location, 5 minutes from Ostkreutz Station to get to city centre and airport quickly lots of places for Vegans in the area too and next to supermarkets.
All very convenient! Thanks!

Fabulous location & easy to reach on public transport. The only negative was a part across the road which went on quite late but not something in control of the property. It was a weekend, but not sure whether this is a regular event! The accommodation was spotlessly clean & well maintained.
The location is great, not far from the train station and a lot of great bars and restaurants nearby.

Very clean place, enough space for us, good intact facilities, just like on the pictures, easy check-in, and awesome location with supermarkets, bars, restaurants, shops and cafes, public transport and bike sharing station just around the corner. We slept well and it was quiet even with the windows open - and I'm a light sleeper! Note that the whole building seems to be rented out by airbnb, all rooms seem to look the same. Even though some people were partying downstairs and next door one night we did not hear anything through the walls. We were very happy with the place.
Great stay for an entire week. The appartment is spacious and very well located. I would recommand for sure

Thanks a lot, the flat is really handy and in a really nice neighborhood, full of restaurants, cafe and bars.
We had a lovely stay.
Best regards.
Great place to stay, have nothing bad to say about it good location. Would recommend if in Berlin for a few days.

The apartment is good, but for us it was too difficult to enter the apartment with the system of all the codes.
And the system of control sending different documents was too annoying.
Nice airbnb, but it was very disappointing that there were not enough pillows and blankets to accommodate all of the guests that we had listed on our reservation.

The overall stay was amazing. The whole building, including our apartment was taken care of !
The only small points that we had was that the bedlinen was a bit thin & small for a colder city like berlin & that there was only a microwave, not a combi. Also that there was only one pan to bake things in.
For the rest I can’t think of anything else, if someone I know now goes to berlin I would immediately suggest this apartment !
Cheers ElPilar,
Until the next one.

We really liked the apartment! It is exactly like how the host had described it and was quite big for us. The host gave very detailed instructions and was very responsive always. The apartment was well equipped with almost everything that we needed. It had comfortable beds in bedroom, clean bathroom, very big living room, functional kitchen and a balcony. Located in a very lively locality with lots of restaurants, cafe etc. Fantastic connectivity by public transport.Multiple Bus stops and tram stops within few minutes (some of them are even within 100 metres) and train station is some 700m away.
Only downside was that the internet was quite shaky throughout our stay and we could only use it in one of the bedrooms. The lift lands between two floors so we had to lift our baby stroller and luggage a few flights of steps to the nearest landing.

Nice apartment in the Friedrichshain area. Host was really responsive and helpful :)
Didn't enjoy so much the full apartment as we were in a business trip, but without doubt in our list for future bookings.

The location was great. There are many supermarkets around the house. Also the apartment is big and spacious. It is a reasonable option for accommodation with more people. It is close to East Side Gallery and also if you are going to attend concerts or sports activities at Uber Arena, this apartment is great choice.

first of all Hanna is a FANTASTIC host who goes over and beyond with truly thoughtful touches, she is a true host always offer help, advice and fresh fruit :)
I have yet to meet such a generous and kind host !
secondly, the apartment is so chic, so hip, so classy (better and much bigger than on the pictures) high ceilings, great sound proofing, fresh breeze through the apartment..plus everything is so clean and well organised, it was a real treat to get the chance to stay there...
i would definitely go back and strongly recommend it ! especially if you have a dog, the park across the street just cannot. be more convenient

I had an absolutely wonderful stay at Hanna's place in Berlin. Hanna made me feel right at home and went above and beyond in terms of hospitality. The room was stocked with snacks, fresh towels, and toiletries. I was traveling with my dog and Hanna even provided bowls, treats, and a tennis ball! The flat is clean, beautifully decorated and in an awesome location right on the corner of Kreuzbergstraße and Bergmannstraße. Victoria Park is just across the street. There are great shops, cafes, and markets nearby so the location is excellent. Easy access to the UBahn just a couple blocks away.
I cannot say enough good things about Hanna. She was warm and welcoming, friendly and generous. I hope that I can return for a visit soon!

staying at Hanna's home was so good, she's a great person her house is gorgeous and the location in the area is perfect.
Thanks again :)
Cool place to stay and great area. Close to Tempelhof, with great Italian deli, cafes and places to eat really close by.

Hanna's place is meticulously clean, organized, and wonderfully decorated. Our room was also stocked with snacks and travel-sized toiletries.
She is very communicative and responsive, and even took care of a misbooking issue by calling Airbnb for us. The check-in was super quick and painless. When we got there, she greeted us warmly and gave us a few tips for the area.
The area is as lively as she describes in the listing. We spent a night out at Kreuzbergstraße alone, and went to a few places she recommended. There was also a cheap hourly/daily paid parking lot within 5 minutes on foot.
Overall, it was a marvelous stay.
Been here for the second time and would definitely recommend it. Hanna is a lovely host and always helpful when you need to know where to go in Berlin.
Hanna is a great host, one of the best I’ve stayed with at airbnb. I can recommend her place highly.

The house is clean and superb, the place is wonderfully located on a street that has everything - from amenities to great food, coffee, and alcohol. And Hanna is probably one of the nicest hosts you ll ever get to meet - she ll always do her best to answer your questions and requests. So if you want to make your Berlin stay super cool, convenient and awesome, just come here!
Staying at Hanna’s was like staying with a good friend. She made Berlin a very enjoyable experience.

I had a wonderful stay with Hanna. The apartment is just as shown in the pictures and the room had everything I needed. Hanna even provided fruit and water which was a nice detail. The apartment is in a really great area, close to the ubahn for travel around Berlin, and many good restaurants, bars and shops very close by. Hanna was a great host, really friendly and made me feel very welcome, with lots of recommendations for places to visit. I would definitely recommend this listing and would hope to stay again the next time I visit Berlin.
I'm kind of jealous of this apartment after staying here ;) Felt right at home! Lots of stuff to do in the neighbourhood and easily reached by public transport

Absolutely Fabulous !
I really enjoyed the Berlin trip.
Hanna is extremely welcoming and hospitable. She had lots of recommendations and ideas that were all spot on.
The location is ideal and very easy to get to with several public transport options.
Plenty of choice of shops and café’s close by.
Check in / out was simple and flexible.

Really easy to check in, hanna explained the apartment and neighborhood perfectly to me. The area has lots of great food options, and is very nice to walk around in. The flat is really pretty and the bedroom has everything you would need for a short stay.
Great apartment in a really good location, perfect for a weekend in Berlin with my friends. The apartment was clean and we had everything we needed.
We had a great stay, the apartment was really nice in a good neighborhood and we received impeccable guidance during our stay from the team!
It was an amazing appartment for a group of friends😊 and very great service by OTA. My highest recommendations👍

It was all great, having the office onsite and being able to drop our bags was really helpful. The guys in the office were also very helpful and friendly. Would recommend. That was my first time using Airbnb and was much easier than I had anticipated. Thanks

Perfect for group trip away, lots of space as described!
Only down side was the noise but that’s expected.

Loved our stay! The pictures and description matched the listing. The place was bright and spacious, with two bathrooms which was perfect. All the necessary amenities were found in the flat. Recommend!
The place is on the 3rd floor with no elevator if that helps anyone. We only had carry on’s so we were good!

We (family with two children) had an awesome stay at Majas accomondation, everything was clean and the communication was always helpful, quick and friendly.
We really enjoyed the tips Maja gave us to get to know the city and neighborhood.
I can really recommend a stay at Majas accomondation.

From start to finish everything was great - good communication, beautiful apartment in a beautiful area (with lots of restaurants) and very clean. Being able to bring our dog with us was the cherry on top, and I'm glad they allowed that to happen! I definitely recommend it for anyone going to Berlin.
One of the best airbnb’s I’ve stayed ! Everything was so well prepared & organized.. will def come back again  💌

Such a beautiful apartment in Berlin! We loved especially the green plants – they made the place feel super cosy and like a home away from home. Communication with the hosts was great, and the location couldn’t be better – a nice neighbourhood full of great cafés and restaurants. We had a great stay and will definitely book this place again when we travel to Berlin again.

We had a wonderful stay at Maja’s apartment in Berlin. The place is spotlessly clean, cozy, and thoughtfully designed. We especially loved the high-quality sound system, fully equipped kitchen, and the comfortable working space—perfect for both relaxing and getting things done.
Check-in was smooth and straightforward, and communication with the hosts was excellent throughout. Maja were incredibly kind and even allowed us to stay a bit longer on checkout day, which we truly appreciated. <3
Everything was just perfect. We felt right at home and would highly recommend this apartment to anyone visiting Berlin!!!!!

Ingmar was a great host and went out of his way to accommodate us last minute. Our original plans fell through and we were travelling with a small child, so it was much appreciated. He made us feel welcome in the space and made sure we had everything we needed. Space was clean and modern.
Great place at a great location. Having the option to park your car right next to the flat makes it the perfect place for a family with small kids. We had a great time and can’t wait to be back!
Lovely apartment! Great and attentive host! Kitchen was well supplied with all the necessary appliances. Very clean! Close to public transport and a large mall & supermarket two blocks away.
Great location, we got much fun in Berlin. Ingmar feedback our questions fast and the place is very clean and comfortable... We really recommend this place.. thank you so much...

If I could give more than 5 stars, I would. Ingmar was a wonderful host. The apartment is located in a perfect spot, the communication was steller, and there was nothing additional needed to feel like we had our own home away from home. Thank you Ingmar!

Very peaceful and quiet apartment, just like in the photos.
Nice neighborhood, only 7 minutes from the U Bahn. (And Uniqlo:)
Ingmar is very nice and communicative.
I truly recommend his place.
Small but practical apartment for two travelers. Steep stairs to get to the beds but not a problem for most people. Check in and communication went smoothly.

the place is great for a stay in Berlin
near the underground, it id easy to reach any areas in Berlin
the prices is low compared to other places
nice surprise to discover a small market next door on monday and thursday
the supermarket next door is very handy
lots of places to eat and drink around

We enjoyed our stay in Berlin, the apartment was clean and easy to check in. Communication was also very good.. the only thing that could’ve improved our stay slightly would’ve been if there were coffee pods available to use with the coffee machine. Other than that, we would stay again as it was a reasonable price for the apartment as well as a lovely location in Berlin.

Had to move to another room. The first one was a complete mess. All the walls were dirty, the bad was dirty and so on.
The host was very helpfully after I show it to him. Then he moved me to another appartement. Between my room and another room was just a broken door. The neighborhood is quite difficult and very loud specially at night.

The apartment is well situated in Berlin with bus and tube wihtin a couple of minutes walk.
Entry to the flat took a couple of minutes as you need a code for the entrance door, the door to the appartments and the door to the flat but in the end we got used to it. We liked the fact that there was a luggage locker so we were able to leave our luggage. Apartment was clean and quiet. We had an enjoyable stay.

great location, clean and very responsive host. Studios are all part of 1 large apartment but fully independent. Check which flat you rent, some have a bed on the ground floor, others on a mezzanine which with low ceiling
ok, good transport and lots to do nearby. The building doesn't seem very secure, but we had no problems
Greta stay! Comfy bed and it has all the appliance you need. Would definitely stay again and recommend to others.

It is clean and nice. Have in mind that it is about a flat, which they divided in several apartments. So the bed is in at the mezzanine. I expected something bigger for the pic that I saw and more private.

Staying at Ferry's place was very nice and allowed us to explore Berlin easily.
Ferry's place is clean, cosy and easy to access. Highly recommend it

All in all its okay, but the accommodation is not an apartment, it is just a room with a small kitchen in it, so I think it is a bit overpriced. I would not recommend it for 4 people. The area is well connected

Staying at Ferry’s was very comfortable. We spent a long weekend in Berlin and the apartment was close to lots of shops, bars and restaurants but still located in a quiet neighborhood. Just a few minutes walk to the U, which will get you anywhere you need to go in Berlin. Perfect location, quick responses to our questions and a nice cozy apartment. Would definitely stay here again.

Perfect place with U subway nearby, nice for walking around and exploring city.
Apartment itself is a part of hotel or hostel, where there is one common corridor with 7 or 8 mini apartments. It's clean and nice inside. Everything you need for the few days stay is available.
What can be better:
- Bathroom seems a bit too small with a lack of racks and shower gel / soap. It would be nice there to have some towel for feet to step on a dry stuff instead of wet floor.
- Entrance is absolutely roaming and phone dependent. If your phone is uncharged, stolen of you don't have roaming, you can't get inside. It would be valuable to simplify the entrance procedure.
- The distance between a bed and a ceiling is too small. It's difficult not to hit your head.
Great place. Do note that the light for the kitchen is somewhat hidden :) once you find it there's bo problem.
The best location for exploring Berlin. Great place to stay located right above a lovely Italian restaurant. You will not be bothered by the noise.
the emergency calls answer from 2 to 6 its bad for people who want to hang out at night.

The AirBnB of Ferry is with modern interior, well located and equipped.
All in all a great accommodation to spend a few days in the center of Berlin. The only negative point is the complicated check-in with three pin codes.
The apartment is good, and the host is friendly. Me and my friends spend a good time in Berlin. Thanks
Good value, great location. All flats are part of one large apartment, but built independently. some have a bed on the ground floor, some on a mezzanine - overall comfortable and clean

Very helpful and friendly host, checked in with me if everything was ok and to my liking.
The apartment is in a great location with public transportation right around the corner.

Ferry helped us when we were having difficulties with checking in and was very responsive and kind! The place was nice and right next to a train station so it was easy to get around, I would recommend!

So you do run the risk of ruining your trip to Berlin by staying at Janna's -- because you won't want to leave the apartment! The apartment is as gorgeous as it looks in the photos and you will wonder if scrolling through Instagram while sprawled on Janna's sun-drenched couch, or sunning yourself on the deck with a glass of wine, is enough to tell people you've "seen" Berlin... The apartment was extremely comfortable, well-located and very beautiful (an interior designer's dream!), and Janna and Robert were easy to reach and very communicative, we couldn't have asked for more.
Great apartment great vibe and energy. The design and furniture was very inspiring. Location is central couldn’t have asked for more

Modern and beautifully decorated apartment that felt like home to our entire family -- including our three- and six-year-old children. Two absolutely marvelous terraces were the highlight of our stay. We highly recommend Janna and Robert as hosts and their apartment as a home away from home.

I recommend staying at Maria's apartment. Great location, great facilities, clean, stylish and much more. Walking distance to most important things. Easy check-in and check-out. Maria was friendly and helpful.

Maria's place was great! It's a quick walk to the Ubahn and metro stations, close to coffee shops and a grocery store near by.  The place was just as described and had everything needed for a great stay.  Would definitely stay there again!

Maria's apartment was very centrally located, within walking distance to many top spots, and a great spot to relax after a long day. We loved walking up and enjoying a German breakfast out on the patio.

Maria's apartment is in a great location near tourist locations, some great restaurants and close to public transport like trains and trams. Its VERY quiet and secure, and the top floor location allowed us to open the windows and let the fresh air in. I would love to visit again the future.

Excellent location and specific check-in instructions.
Overall a good stay, but here are few details about our experience that may be helpful for others: we had to empty the dishwasher upon arrival, the shower head has too much buildup for adequate water flow and the shower has standing water when in use, and, as a follow-up to a previous review, the dead plants are still on the terrace.

Great location (so central for public transport and walking around). Quiet, clean and functional. You’re on the top floor, but lift is enormous by European standards. Very roomy and everything works. Comfy beds and furniture. Plenty of eateries and places to buy groceries nearby. Don’t let seemingly complicated check in procedures put you off. It’s really quite simple. Communication great and very helpful host.

Great apartment! Super clear check in instructions, and the location was amazing! Many cafes/restaurants on the street and a grocery store just a couple minutes away! Almost walking distance to a lot of things, but otherwise a simple train away. Would definitely stay again!

The space is what the ad says; you rent a (very clean and neat) room within an appartment , the common spaces (kitchen/bathroom) are shared and also extremely clean and tidy. The place wasn't finished yet when we were there, so it felt a bit cold and empty but they will add some nice personal details and paintings of their home country. We had a lovely talk about their homecountry and arrival and communication was all very quick and easy.
Had a little trouble finding the building and the right door, you have to walk down the stairs next to the road to end up at the right door.

A lovely place to stay. A really short walk to a train station and opposite a super market. The apartment was very clean. The beds were comfortable. The curtains were blackout curtains which was fantastic.

good location ,only 100-200meters to the subway station. and a big supermarket near the house . beautiful balcony wonderful community and new, clean, room. the pillows are the best we ever had ！and heater is powerful ！ Hien is helpful and warm！ a wonderful place ！the whole house smells great
A very nice room with all things you may need. The location is very convenient, near to the subway station, so you won't have any problems to get to city center
The room was very clean and was near public transportation. Me Hien responds quickly to messages and was a very polite host.

Room in a spotless flat. An easy if a little long commute from the centre once you have worked out the ticket to buy. Not cold when we visited in December. Check-in was easy and the host prompt to respond. At full power the shower is very temperamental but keep the flow around 50% and no issues. One shared bathroom so a little queue occasionally. Nice small kitchen which gets used and has everything you expect including a kettle.

It surprised us how well Me Hien organised all this. She was there on our arrival and explained everything. You can't go with your shoes around the apartment. She will give you flip flops instead. I have never seen such a clean flat. I believe she comes there everyday to ensure that everything is fresh and nice. I got anwsers in rapid speed whenever I have any questions. You can leave your luggage there and a camera will watch your stuff. It was really one of my best experiences on airbnb. I recommand it to everyone :))

Very nice and clean place that is near the train station (5 minutes walk)! Even though the bathroom is shared with other people, it is still clean and easy to use. We enjoyed our stay and had a comfortable 3 nights here :)

Good place, 20-30 min to get to the center by S Bahn, has a good store across the street and a few restaurants but they were closed when I was there also has a couple of kebap places but they accept only cash.

We made the booking for 2 people and 1 baby and the host claimed they didn’t know we had a baby even though I showed them the original listing which clearly stated such. They tried to get us to cancel the booking because they don’t allow babies so I contacted Airbnb to do so. However, they refused the cancellation when Airbnb reached out to them so this took 2 more days of back and forth with customer service until they finally agreed to let us cancel. We could have been out of the apartment much sooner and booked a hotel elsewhere if they hadn’t harassed us. These people were really terrible and should not be hosting anyone!

It was great! Easy to find and good access to public transportation. Besides, the accommodation was super clean, even with the shared bathroom was not a problem at all!! Really recommended to spend the night with comfortable and quiet. Would definitely choose again! Danke :)

Great place to stay, very clean and easy to find when we arrived - host gave easy to follow instructions.
Excellent public transport links close by.
Would definitely recommend to others.
Thank you!

Me Hien is a great host and a great communicator.
I think it is important to know that you are sharing one toilet/shower with four rooms and it can be a problem.
Me Hien is very upfront about this in her description of the room. The apartment is super clean and two minutes from a major SBahn station

the whole flat was very clean and tidy. Me Hien came in every day to clean the apartment, replace toilet roll etc which was very kind. she was very hospitable and although the flat isn’t located in the centre, it is very close to a train station and it’s really easy to get anywhere. everything was amazing and very affordable, so we highly recommend Me Hien’s apartment!!

it was clean although the bathroom was shared with three other rooms.
the Balcony was a nice addition to the room. it was very quiet but using the bathroom in the mornings was a bit of a waiting game. besides that Me Hien was really lovely, gave us really detailed instructions and was quick to respond. We would book again

The room was very clean. The host is very responsive. The kitchen and bathroom was also very clean. Although it's a bit far from the city centre, there are public transportations within walking distance. I would definitely recommend for a short stay in Berlin.
Great and very cosy apartment. Easy to find and very clean! I would reccomend it without a doubt for up to 4 persons.
Great hosts. Instructions were very detailed and clear. The property was very clean and spacious. Situated in a cool area and close to all transport links. Would definitely stay here again.
Room was clean and tidy. Wifi inside doesn’t work sometimes. But the room is located in the area which is one of the most dangerous places in Berlin.
First impresion it's a dark neighbourg...but in our experience completly safe in any time. Cool apartment. 100% recomendable!
Everything was smooth, Stella did a great job communicating all the details and always being there to answer all our questions. The area is definitely interesting and full of character

The apartment is great! Loved the decor and had everything we needed. It was a perfect location for us next to Gorlitzer Park and surrounded by lots of local bars and cafes. The key code system made it so easy to check in and out and communication with Stella was fantastic. Thanks for a brilliant stay in Berlin!

Had a real pleasant stay the place is in a quite area and the host always responded almost immediately when I contacted her, the only problem was that the u,s-bhan stations were far but it was a 5-minute walk to the nearest bus stop so it wasn't much of a problem.
Had a great stay at this appartment. Great location and good communication with the hosts. Would recommend for a small group. Hope to visit again!

The apartment is located in one of the best areas of the city.
Plenty of restaurants and nice spots, this place is right in front of gorlitzer park.
Stella was a great host and offered an upgrade to a bigger apartment since the one we originally booked was out of order.
However we encountered a few issues like many out of order plugs, a crappy and not secure entrance door, a extremely little kitchen and the bathroom located in front of the dining table in the living room (just imagine) and no privacy . the overall disposition of the apartment wasn't confortable for a longer stay.

Such a unique experience! The bunk bed set up gave us all a good laugh, but the space was a little tight, so be mindful of that depending on how many people you’re traveling with. Location was also pretty far from all of the sights. Looking back, I don’t think this accommodation worked well for our group, however the value of it was amazing!

Small but perfectly formed and perfect for groups of 4/5. Super cute decor and in a really good location for lots of bars, cafes and restaurants. Easy to get to all the main attractions with an S-Bahn station a short walk away. Super easy check in as well which was good!

The Apartment of Stella is vert nice. We liked the decoration with attention to every detail. It is small but very comfortable. We were five and we had space for all. Stella answered very quickly to all questions.
Had a great time at a the place, enjoyed the extra touch of having a coffee machine in the kitchen. Good Value!

Stella and her team were super friendly and responsive. However, the shower wasn't working when we arrived which was super annoying as a group of 5. They took care of it while we out in the city. The whole apartment - but especially kitchen and furnishing - is quite worn already and you can hear every sound your neighbours make. However, as the location is quite central it's a good place if you're looking for a place to sleep in Berlin.
Lovely apartment, perfect base for our stay in Berlin. Hosts were very helpful and responded quickly to our queries. Would definitely stay here again. Many thanks!
We really enjoyed Stella’s place. She was a fantastic host, always responsive and the place was spotless.
The apartment was great for my 5 friends and I. The only thing is the locks are a bit difficult to work, but the hosts were responsive and gave us tips on how to use them.
Great apartment right by Görlitzer park. Also keyless entrance, so you dont need to worry about who has the key. Perfect accommodation for 6-8 guests.
Great and very comfortable apartment, with two balconies and excellent location, close to many restaurants, Museum Insel etc. Tram and U-Bahn just a few steps away

Very comfortable flat for our 3-week stay. Extremely sunny, decently stocked kitchen, great bathroom, nice views from the two terraces, well-located for trams and walking , and one of Berlin’s best bread bakers on the ground floor. Marissa is a gracious host, very responsive.

Marisa is absolutely lovely! We didn’t get to meet in person but she was communicative and responsive. Her place is lovely and very conveniently located near public transportation and really good healthy breakfasts, pastry shops,  and a dedicated gluten free bakery.  We stayed for a bit longer than two weeks and would definitely go back again! If you’re looking to feel like you’re in the city center without the bulk of tourists this is a great location. It’s a very fun neighborhood to wander around.

My 14 year old Grandson and I spent 2 weeks in Marisa's flat and we LOVED it. It is located in a proper urban neighborhood where people eat and shop and work. Everything we needed was right there, including all options for public transport. And Marisa was very responsive the couple of times I needed some guidance. I hope to be able to return in a year or two and stay again. I highly recommend this listing to anyone who wants to step into Berlin urban life.

Marisa provides a wonderful home away from home. The location is excellent. Although on a busy street, the double glazing is effective. Cafes and restaurants are everywhere and only a few steps away. Marisa provided us with great recommendations. We only had time to try one of the restaurants she suggested, and it was superb. The layout of the apartment is ideal and everything you could possibly need is provided.
We hope to return to her home when we are next in Berlin!

Excellent location , bright and sunny apartment.
easy check in and check out. Thanks !

This flat was cozy and charming, reflecting our host's unique personal (artistic!) taste. We appreciated the two convenient bathrooms, comfortable bedroom, good ventilation, and two balconies with wonderful views of the Fernsehturm and our lively street. Our only surprise--and this was not our host's fault--is that the elevator had suddenly stopped working the day of our arrival, and the building's management refused to fix it for the entire stay (almost two months). Our host graciously offered to refund our money so that we could find another place to stay, but we loved the apartment, and didn't want to go to the trouble and expense of scrambling to find a new space during such a busy summer when housing was going to be in high demand. We didn't mind taking the stairs, but if future guests definitely need an elevator, they will want to make sure that the lift is functional.
Great location with restaurants and everything you could want within walking distance.  The apartment is wonderful, clean and has all the amenities you could want. Loved our stay

Marisa was a great host and her apartment was absolutely perfect for us. Great location with plenty to walk to & also incredible access to the tram, U, and S lines. Will try to stay here again on our next trip to Berlin. Marisa even was able to accommodate us for an extra evening after our flight was canceled. Very kind and super responsive. Thanks for an awesome trip!

This was one of the best experiences I’ve had at an Airbnb.  Marisa was so helpful through our whole trip.  Would definitely recommend staying here if you want to be in a great neighborhood with lots of options.

A fantastic find in a great location. The location of the apartment was excellent, with public transport links easy to access the rest of the city (bus, U and S bahn) and only short walking distance away from the East Side Gallery, great places to eat (Burgermeister) and a park on your doorstep. The apartment itself was extremely clean, spacious and very well furnished with everything you could possibly need. Stella was a very welcoming host, provided us with lots of information on how to get into the apartment when we arrived and was always available to answer any questions. A great list of handy suggestions of places to eat, drink and visit were also left for us which we made good use of! The stay was also great value for money with 3 guests.
All in all, an amazing place to stay with lovely hosts-will definitely be returning next time we visit the city!
This place is a brilliant base to explore Berlin as well as for any events at the Mercedes-Benz Arena. Everything you needed to chill out after a busy day exploring!
Clean, bright, great location, smartlock means there's an easy check-in, fast replies when contacted.

The apartment is stylish and has everything you need. There was an iron and a fan which was great. The neighbourhood though is great for parties but I would not recommended for a group of girls as it is a little bit scary.
This place is exactly as is shown in the pictures. It is clean, and everything you need is at your disposal. Stella is also very quick in het communication.

Good apartment, everything was well indicated and the access is very practical. All was very clean and the communication with Stella was easy and quick.
I would recommend this place to others.
Great value for money. Amazing place to sleep and cover basic necessities when you are tourist if around Berlin.
Stella was very communicative and helpful! The apartment was so cute and perfect for our girls weekend away! Thank you :)

Very good location, we had all the information prior our arrival. It made everything very accesible and easy.
thanks again

Host is very helpful and responds quickly if there is any problem they will help you with everthing. Beautiful premises, great for group accommodation.  Everything was great.  Calm and quiet surroundings.  I highly recommend.

Great price, apartment perfect for 4 people, maybe even 5. Clean, mattresses were extremely comfortable and nice dining area.
Hosts responded immediately to texts and were so helpful in all aspects. Area was 5-10 minutes from Warscher Straße station (extremely convenient location) and good amount of food options close by. Supermarket 2 minutes away as well.
Be aware in the night time, groups loiter on streets and often try to call you to come over to them, but nothing ever happened so it seems it could be harmless.
I definitely would stay here again and recommend for any small group looking for a convenient stay! Thank you to the amazing hosts

The apartment was great, the location a nice 20 minute walk to the S bahn, less for the U. Plenty of amenities nearby.
The coffee machine is a Tassimo so needs specific pods.
Massive amounts of bed space, easily sleep 6.
Stella’s place is very central if you’d like to experience berlin’s nightlife. Ideal for groups who want to spend time togheter.
Super clean apartment, host was very quick to respond to any messages. Would recommend for any groups visiting Berlin! Thank you x
Stella gave clear instructions on how to get in. The apartment was clean and ready for us.
The apartment is located in a very nice part of Berlin! It was perfect for our short stay and a good base close to many nice bars and restaurants. The communication was great too! Thanks
It was an amazing apartment, great value and very modern, in an amazing location so close to the best pubs and clubs in Berlin. Highly recommend

Great stay
The location is perfect, the appart is exactly as on photos :)
Stella is really Nice and she helps you with a lot or adresses
I recommand it !!!
Very clean, very friendly hospitable host, a great practical layout of the flat. Fairly central with good access to great restaurants and bars, very good value and I deeply enjoyed my stay there.

This is a lovely quirky place in a good location. We had 6 staying in here and there was more than enough room for everyone. The bathrooms are very high spec and the showers powerful. There isn’t any cooking facilities as such (just a hob so bear in mind if you wish to cook) but we didn’t mind that. The location is right next to the park and only 10-15 walk away from Watergate club and the East Side Gallery.
Stella was a brilliant host who made us feel really welcome during our stay by recommending loads of good places to eat, drink and sites to see which was a real help when none of us had previously visited.
I couldn’t recommend this place enough, it’s exactly as the pictures and probably bigger than we expected. Will definitely return on our next visit!
A perfect place to stay in Berlin! Highly recommend this cute little apartment. Stella is quick with response and the space is remarkably clean. Cheers!
Great place to stay, Stella was a fabulous host and the apartment was lovely and clean. Great place for a group weekend trip. Thank you for a fantastic weekend!
Great base for exploring Berlin! Key code entry was perfect for our large group so we didn’t have to worry about keys.

The appartement was very well located, in good conditions and as expected on the pictures.
The places comes with code system rather than keys,what is really convenient as a group, anyone can go home when they wish.
In addition since the booking Stella had been proactively reaching out to offer various options (early check-in, late check out, cleaning) and was always very responsive.
Highly recommend this place to stay.

Good location and apartment was as described and spacious enough. However, we found the kitchen utensils and the showers dirty, which is disappointing and unacceptable - especially considering the cost and the cleaning fee.

stella is a good hostess and was very helpful with everything. However we found that there was room for improvement. the place was clean and tidy but unfortunately quite dark and dim with automatic lighting. We also were not able to use the heating in either rooms. The showers did not have doors which resulted in the bathroom getting flooded each time we took a shower.  Finally, the wifi was very weak and we did not have service either.
The location is good, but the Quilty of couch mattresses, showers are all cheap and have issues, mainly the mattress we left with back pain …
Great place to stay for the weekend, good location for bars and food. Not far from all the sites you want to see and plenty on lime bikes to jump on and get around.

Great airbnb. Host was happy to help, check in was very easy with clear instructions. The apartment itself was nice, looked exactly like the photos and was good value for money. Overall a very pleasant stay. Would highly recommend.

The area has lots of good restaurants and is also within great taxi range from a lot of cool places. It's a little shady, especially at night, but definitely not dangerous. We really enjoyed our stay and recommend it.
However, the apartment gets very moist since the showers are leaking water. This water leak has damaged the doors so you cant close the doors to either bathroom. Judging by previous similar comments on here it seems to have been this way for at least a couple of years.
Also the door to the apartment can be really tricky to get into. Our best tip is to push the door upwards and to the left.
This is a top place for the money,  we can warmly recommend to anybody..🙏👏

The apartments is perfectly clean, very modern/designed/conformable/has everything or even more than you can expect (body lotions, real flowers, treats, wine, tea/coffee/coffee capsules/slippers). You will feel like at home, defiantly the apartment is better than any hotel. Supermarket - next door; Cafe with fresh bakery and coffees - next door.  A lot of restaurants next to the apartment. Tram station - opposite the building. Perfect location - 4-5 stops by tram to Alexanderplatz. You won't regret if you stay in this apartment! WE LOVE IT VERY VERY MUCH! Thank you Doerthe!

This apartment is extremely quiet in an convent and prime location. It’s near so many shops and restaurants and it’s also just across from the tram. She was so thoughtful to put out small touches that really came in handy during my stay. Oh, and the bed is amazingly comfortable.

Amazing apartment with an amazing location.
Extremely functional and his all the necessary amenities.
Communication was also very easy and fast.

Good public transportation at your door, but because the apt is behind the yard, one does not hear any noise. Lots of restaurants, bars and bakeries nearby. Cute space with lots of light in living/sleeping space. Safe neighborhood.
Great- big apartament with great location. Everything is same as on photos, And The hosts are very nice

The apartment is a great size, has all the amenities you could need and is on the ground level. Couldn't ask for a better location, plenty to see and do in the neighborhood and is a short walk to trams.

Very nice place and everything was clean. Very detailed pictures to find apartment.
It was very kind also to leave some gifts for hosts
One of the best Airbnb experiences we’ve had! Elisa was responsive and flexible — super helpful in getting us set up and checked out. The neighborhood is great and the apartment felt super safe!
This area was recommended by locals, and we are glad that we followed the recommendations. The owner made us feel right at home.

This is a comfortable place in an excellent location.  We were steps from a tram that gave us access to Berlin's wonderful public transportation network.  And we were a short walk from a lovely neighborhood with excellent restaurants.  Elisa was very responsive to the few questions we had.  I would stay there again.
Great host in a very nice appartment in lovely schillerkiez. Very helpful and responsive on sms. Great stay
Good location and nice piano. Place wasn't clean, apparently due to the Corona situation. Yet Alex was nice to refund the cleaning fees as a gesture.

I stayed here for 1 month in order to work. Communication was clear and quick, check-in and check-out was simple, the apartment is in Schillerkiez next to Tempelhof, he owns a beautiful piano and was kind enough to allow me to play it. Loved my stay there and our ability to communicate well. I would easily visit again!
Beautifully located apartment, in quiet back yard. I had a great stay and check in was easy.

Alex gave me accurate instructions about self checkin. Flat was cozy, clean and functional: balcony for chilling, spacious room with lots of musical instruments, a lot of useful amenities like washing machine, iron, hair dryer, etc. It was really nice to live there. Also many thanks for shampoo, shower gel and tooth paste :) couple suggestions: I didn't find chair for table and it would be nice to have a little bit more space for clothing. But these are minor things, overall flat is great.

It was great to stay at Alex's place.
We were able to prepare food at home and for us it's part of what we're looking for in a place. Also the piano was super helpful as i could practice. The apartment looks very much like in the photos. It is quite and there is a balcony. Alex was super responsive and helpful. It was very clean and the check in went smoothly. There are sweet bars around, Templehoff park, and it is closed to U8 station.
We hope to visit again! Thank you Alex!
Seriously one of the most special places i have stayed at, the neighbourhood is great, very close to the UBahn, and super easy to find

The apartment is bigger than what it looks in the photos and has everything you need (with a piano which for me as a musician was an added bonus). Very good wifi if you are planning to work from there. Alex was very responsive and even let us check out a bit later which was really appreciated. About 8 minutes walk to the U Bahn which gets you to the main station in about 25 minutes and anywhere else you may need to go too; we loved the area with a lot of restaurants and coffee places within a 5 minute walking distance.

Great host - messaged back very quickly to all questions and provided clear info.
The flat is lovely, well looked after and in a good location. Didn’t use the kitchen fully but it was nice and clean and seemed to have everything.
Shower worked fine but temperature control was a bit difficult using separate taps. Towels, line and everything very clean and miniatures (shampoo, soap, toothpaste) were provided.
The area is great, bustling outside, with lots of cafes, bars, restaurants and green space nearby but fairly quiet in the apartment, particularly overnight.
Would definitely come again.

The room was very clean and exactly as shown in the photos.
Everything in the space was thoughtfully selected and beautifully arranged, creating a very comfortable and stylish atmosphere.
There was also a wonderful piano, and I really enjoyed being able to practice during my breaks.
It was a truly relaxing and inspiring stay. Highly recommended!

The flat is very close to City Centre. It is very clean and have everything you need. Ivos made us feel very welcoming by showing places to visit in Berlin on a map. It was also very kind of him to provide filling for the coffee machine and to treat us with some chocolate. Ivos is very friendly and caring host! I would definitely recommend to stay in his apartment!

Perfect! Location was great to get around Berlin, just opposite a supermarket and transport just next door - while you can easily walk to many attractions, as well as bars and clubs too. The apartment was nicely decorated and cosy - it was everything we needed. Ivos was the perfect host as he was very friendly and informative, and went out of his way to help us. I will definitely be returning to Berlin and staying here again in the future :)

I stayed here for two weeks, everything I needed was prepared in the room, and Ivos is very friendly and helpful. The location was great, you can walk to Alexanderplatz and Museumsinsel, and buy food in the nearby supermarket. I hope I can come back in the future.
This Airbnb is a great place for young people looking to explore Berlin. There’s a subway station very close by and most tourist attractions  are within 20 minutes. Ivos gives great recommendations!
The flat is compact but it can easily accommodate three guests. It's clean, tidy and equipped with all the necessary items. The location is greate, the Metro station 3 minutes away.

Ivos is an excellent host. Very responsive and helpful.  Location is very close to the rail line and simple to get there from the airport.  It took us no time to get orientated.  Suggest that you get a Berlin Welcome card at the airport giving you access to all transport. Take the add on cost to museums. Loved the Reichstag tour but book this lots of time in advance. Way better than just going up the viewing dome.  Potsdam is well worth a visit. Again just hop on the train 150m away.
Ivos' place is at a great location to enjoy the city's nightlife and historical monuments. He is kind and provides many tips for interesting locations.
Ivos is very helpful and house is best location in Berlin! So if you wanna sightseeing and best night life,should stay here!!!
Beautiful view from the rooftop! The apartment is very near to Alexanderplatz, makes easy to reach every places in Berlin!
Great place to stay, close to the train station, Ivos is a great bloke and if you want him to, he will provide excellent advice on where to go during your stay.
Ivos was so kind and friendly. The check in was so easy and he explained us some places to visit. The house is very hospitable and tidy. I recommend it.
The flat is in a great location for exploring the city, the kitchen is stocked for cooking, wifi was fast and stable, bed is comfortable, and communication with Ivos was great. Thanks for everything!

The apartment is perfectly located, a few steps from U8 metro line, and short walking distance from S Bahn, where S9 train takes you straight to and from the airport. For those who like to walk, city centre is 15 min away.
Apartment is modest, with all basic amenities, excellent for people who come to enjoy Berlin and be outdoor all day long. Supermarket is nearby.
Ivos is a great host, open for adjusting check in and check out hours, willing to help.
I would highly recommend this apartment - hospitality, location and value for money are 👌

The apartment has everything needed in order to have an enjoyable stay in Berlin, we recommend it 100%. The apartment is really comfortable, we felt there like home. It was clean and really well equipped  (both toilet and kitchen), even for long stays. Ivos was always really nice and careful. The views are great, to the landscape of East-Berlin, giving a great experience. The location is amazing, 10min walking from Alexanderplatz, and really near to the nice areas of the city. The neighbourhood and the surroundings however are really chill and quiet. Well connected to the public transport (S-bahn/U-bahn Jannowitzbrücke). There are two supermarkets just in front of the building. We will repeat.
we spent a lovely week in Berlin. Ivos' apartment was perfect for us, very close to the venue where we had to go. It is very well deserved by public transport too, easy to access from Berlin Hbf.

Very easy to check in and described exactly as the description. Very clean and had all the needed amenities. The only downside is that it is not very close to any attractions but there is a train station close by. I highly recommend.

Great location for access to local transit to get around Berlin, and near to two supermarkets, and a kebab place. The place was clean, and as advertised. I enjoyed my time in Berlin staying here.
Ivos was very responsive, and I’m sure would have been helpful if I had any issues. But did not experience anything I needed whilst staying.
I recommend Ivos and the apartment 😊 Ivos is friendly and replays fast! Location is excellent!
Ivos is a great host and a very nice person, the apartment modern and bright, in walking distance to many tourist sites and Ostbahnhof.

We had a great time, the home of Julius and Tanja made our stay in Berlin really great. After being out in the city their house feels like a oasis of trancuility in a intensive city like Berlin. Well located in moabit. This side of Berlin is not so touristic and has easy going vibes. Parks all around and good food not far away. We can recommand your stay in their home.

Great stay spent in the apartment of Tanja and Julius. Tanja did everything to make our arrival and departure go in the best conditions. Regarding the apartment, the decoration is just sublime and there is everything to feel good. The area is very quiet, there is a metro nearby as well as a large supermarket. There is also a bus line just below the building and is very convenient. Thank you for everything Tanja and Julius, we wish you another happy new year!

I absolutely recommend Claudia's room, I felt very comfortable both in communication and the level of privacy. The room is very cozy and warm, the shower is new and clean. Claudia took time to answer my questions on some local tips, which were really very helpful, I was able to discover the real Berlin atmosphere, which is not that easy in a big touristic city like that!

Claudia is cool! She also has a nice apartment with a beautiful view over Berlin.
Claudia is very easy going and easy to communicate with. Fun, interesting, caring and full of spark. The room is very comfortable and I slept very good there. Felt like home! I want to stay there next time to beautiful Berlin. Thanks Claudia

The place has a lot of style, is clean and Claudia is a great host, if you have big bags the place has not elevator and is the last floor but is not a big deal, the stairs are wide and spacious. All great, I recommend it!

This place is absolutely great: huge kitchen, nice living room, great external balcony, and a good sized room. The apartment itself is situated very close to an amazing natural grocery store and a metro stop that is one stop away from the line that leads you right into town. Claudia was great with communication and even though she wasn't there, she gave us two different contacts in the case of an emergency or questions. The only negative thing I can say is that there are a lot of stairs to get up to the apartment, but there is no one to blame for that. Otherwise, it's a great space that I would recommend to anyone visiting Berlin!
Lovely  and  very helpful host, big, clean and quiet room, comfortable bed, good wifi connection. I would definitely recommend!

The place is super nice and reserved. Claudia has a large apartment, so the room and the toilet are quite separated from the rest of the house, you feel super comfortable.
Claudia is extremely nice, super flexible with me and her reception and communication was outstanding.
I wish I could see her more, she seems to be a great person :)!
I had a great time in Berlin at Claudia’s house. She was very welcoming and the room was great. Thanks for a great stay!
