Had an absolutely wonderful stay at Claudia's lovely apartment home. Centrally located in the city of Berlin, close to unlimited resturaunts and access to public transportation. Claudia is a most welcoming host; warm, friendly and a delight to talk to! She is no stranger to travel and understands how to make one feel at home when away from home.  Her apartment is comfortable, spacious, bright and airy.  I do hope to keep in touch and visit again with her, or possibly welcome her when she visits my part of the world!
I got into Berlin late due to a cancelled flight and Claudia and her son were very accommodating. Nice airy room and clean bathroom perfect for a couple nights stay. Would recommend!

This is a beautiful and comfortable room in a gorgeous flat in the very heart of Kreutzberg. Everything was comfortable and worked well. Ben was very helpful to me whenever I was confused. I recommend this place 100%!

The apartment was very beautiful and clean. I really appreciated the private fridge, desk, and hanging rack in my bedroom. Claudia was such a kind, accommodating host and gave me tips on using public transportation. I'd definitely stay here again next time I return to Berlin!
Very nice clean room with private bathroom. Great area of Berlin with easy excess to all parts of Berlin. Claudia was very helpful and making me feel welcome.
Claudia was a terrific host and her place was in the perfect location for us. The apartment is clean and comfortable, and Claudia was very gracious and fun to talk to. I'd happily stay here again.
very nice and simple two-storey apartments, has everything you need, host fast and effective, everything is simple and to finish the location is fantastic
Convenient accommodation to travel around Berlin. Checkpoint Charlie is about 10/15mins walk away. Trains to central Berlin approximately 20mins.
Amazing stay for the three of us. Really nice flat with everything we needed during our visit to Berlin - thank you!
Great apartment, great location, great price, excellent service. Would certainly to a friend looking to visit Berlin.

Pascal's and Dennis apartment is a great choice for a stay in Berlin. It's clean, quiet, bright and well connected to public transport. There is  a supermarket nearby. The communication with the host was excellent.
Pascal was friendly and responsive, and the place was well located, clean, and nice. Easy 5/5

A great stay! Very comfortable and clean and very well connected, whilst being quiet and off major roads.
Would definitely stay again!

The best Airbnb I’ve stayed at on this Euro trip. The host was so accommodating, working with us to check in/store our things early. The place was so beautiful and clean. Great amenities including a blow dryer. Would definitely stay again!

Great place. Near the U-bahn Hallescher Tor which take us easily to mainly points of Berlin. The apartment was perfect, very comfortable and clean. Pascal answers very fast, being always efficient. I recommend this place.

Pascal’s place was ideal for us. a family of 3. It’s really cozy and clean. Within walking distance to the Bahn. Only challenge for us was the flight of stairs we had to climb with our suitcases. Everything else was awesome!!

Great place, great location.
Communication was excellent and the facilities were clean and all worked well
Great shower too.
Thanks Pascal

We were staying there 4 people and apartment was excellent, room for everyone, since its not super small apartment. Everything was nice and clean, just as in pictures. There was also coffee, tea, and spices, dishes and everything you need for make your own meal there, what we really liked. Location good, it was literally 20 min walk from Brandenburg gate and also metro station really close. Close shops, restaurants, nice neighbourhood. Also I appreciate self check in - it is super comfortable that you can check in by yourself at whatever time it is. We are totally recommending!

A great stay in a wonderful city. Apartment was a perfect base for us to enjoy!
Thanks

Absolutely worth it! Check-in was smooth and hassle-free, making the start of our stay super easy. The location is perfect—right in the heart of everything! You can reach all the main attractions in less than 20 minutes, which made exploring so convenient. The apartment itself was spotless, well-organized, and had everything we needed for a comfortable stay. It felt like a home away from home. If you’re looking for a clean, cozy place with an unbeatable location, this is it! Highly recommended!
Pascal’s apartment was a great spot for us to stay, comfortable and affordable with good connections to other spots in the city. Would definitely consider staying again!
We had a very comfortable stay.  It seemed odd at first not to have a lounge area, but we managed perfectly well.   The apartment was well equipped and quite well situated.
Great location. Apartment is very nice as described, equipped with all you need for a great stay. Host was very responsive as well. Highly recommend :)

We had a great stay! The place was very clean, the perfect size for our needs, and located in a super walkable area. It was easy to access and close to lots of attractions, restaurants, and shops. Would definitely stay here again!
I visited Berlin on business trip. It was good to be very close to the place that was scheduled to visit. It is close to the airport and has excellent accessibility.

Staying at Gelfo's place felt like staying at home - it's not one of those Airbnb apartments that has been built just for Airbnb or renting out, it's a real family home that you are allowed into, and it's absolutely lovely. The kitchen is very well equipped, there are two balconies and the beds are very comfy. The location is right next to plenty of metro stations so getting anywhere is easy. Many shops and restaunts around. Great communication with the hosts as well. Would happily stay again.
The apartment was beautiful, high quality, and had lots of restaurants and public transportation nearby! I would love to stay there again!

The flat was large and comfortable it was with the bonus of the balconies. It was well provisioned, with all the tech and very comfortable beds. Situated very near travel links and shops, & in the exact neighbourhood we wished to explore, &
the weather could not have been better.
We loved our time in Berlin, & would highly recommend this property & host.
Thank you, Gelfo & Nazgul, you made us feel very welcome.
Great apartment with nice views of the skyline, close to the metro or Uber to city centre for when you’re more tired

We had a good stay in this nice and spacious apartment. The apartment has a nice view over the city and we enjoyed it several times while sitting on the balcony. Location is good and close to several U-Bahn stations. Communication with the host went very well.

The apartment is beautiful, huge rooms , high ceilings. Green area.
Only issue was the luck of elevator which I didn’t notice at the description. So the 110 stairs could be a problem for some people .
Else, kitchen is full of appliances , coffee , etc.
Definitely a good host
Beautiful apartment and all is as described. It was such a great place that I extended my stay! Thank you, Gelfo for everything!

Very nice place to stay when visiting Berlin. Metro and Bus stops near by, shops and places to visit nearby. Great for visiting with family as the apartment is spacious. Also accross the street is beautiful playground. Only thing to consider is that the aprtment is at 5th floor with no elevator. As the ceilings are high in all apartments then it feels like walking at least 7-8 floors 😃. Regardless, I would visit again, because Gelfo and his wife Nazgul are so welcoming, apartment is lovely and spacious with nice sunny balcony. There is everything you need and beyond. I stayed there with my family and parents and we loved it. Everyone had enough room and comfortable sleeping arrangements. My 5-year old loved the house bed and the indoor trampoline ☺️. Thank you Gelfo and Nazgul for wonderful stay!
Gelfo’s place was perfect for our stay in Berlin, great location, U Bahn close by, plenty of shopping, and restaurants all within walking distance. A private and peaceful apartment.

We had a week's stay at Gelfo's apartment in Berlin. The location was very convenient close to 2 underground stations and within a short walking distance to restaurants and supermarkets making it very easy for our stay. The apartment is in an an impressive period apartment equipped with all modern appliances and kitchen facilities. We were able to use the apartment as a base to visit the main sites in Berlin, as well as take it easy on other days to recuperate. Gelfo's response to our queries prior to our stay and was prompt and helpful. The listing on AirBnB is as shown in the photos and description.

Nice simple place in a perfect location surrounded by interesting places, good eating. A short walk to Mitte centre, U-bahn stop directly outside the house. Very easy interaction with host. Wifi signal and big bathtub and bed quality and heating are all great. Perfect for tourism. Good for a work trip. (Now has a third bed rather than a proper sofa, so a bit awkward for sufferer from a back pain who has to sit carefully.).

I went to Berlin on a work trip and this apartment was perfect for me, due to its location and its comfort. It is small but it has everything you need.
Also, I was supposed to stay, and had already paid, for two weeks, but my company cancelled the second one due to the coronavirus situation and Airbnb and Renny gave me some of the money back.
I will visit Renny’s apartment again if I come back to work in Berlin.

please please do not go anywhere else, Kristina's place is THE BEST air bnb I've experienced. It was more worth the money me and my friends paid. They were so prepared in everything you could think of form check in, cleanliness, snacks and kitchen utensils (toaster, coffee machine, microwave etc, more variety then I have in my own home) and even noise prevention stickers in between rooms! Me and my friends have been travelling to 3 countries at this trip and yet Kristina's place is the best of all. I really think she should own herself a hotel!
Kristina’s place was great – a little out of the way and the sofa bed was a tad uncomfortable, but overall would definitely recommend. Very easy to get to via public transport.

It’s very clean, new looking and spacious space! It’s a bit far away from central Berlin, but the German public transportation is on point and you can get to places easily. Little snacks left for us were very much needed after long days of walking!

Great spot, very reasonable priced and comes with a lot of hotel-like amneties.
Kristina is quick in responding and very friendly - much recommended.

With transportation and a good supermarket on the doorstep and a really good grillhaus within 5 minutes walk what more could you want.
Kristina’s place, completes the picture.
Download BVG APP and buy an all day pass and Berlin is at your doorstep.
We really enjoyed our stay and highly recommend Kristina as a host.
Amazing clean apartment, close to tram stop, 15 minutes by tram and you are in center of the city. Thank you Kristina for hospitality and for sweets ☺️

It was a nice studio!!!! I was really relaxing during my trip! And there is super clean and cozy especially bathroom and bad I loved here😘 Also the host responded quickly thanks to that, I could stay comfortably If I will travel Berlin again I would like to stay here again :)

Everything was super easy with Kristina, we got our keys before the check in time, the place was very clean and had everything necessary for a few days in Berlin. Kristina also left some freebies and some snacks. All in all, good bang for the buck.

Good apartment, very clean and exactly how it looks in the pictures! The location is pretty far from the city center which turned out to be pretty inconvenient for us. However, the tram station  is only 2 min walking away! Overall, very nice place.

Kristina has literally thought of everything a guest might need! The apartment is comfortable, clean, and very well appointed. She even left snacks for us.
I highly recommend this place.
We really enjoyed staying at your apartments, close to the u bahn and city center, many shops in the area, pretty neighborhood
Thank you for a nice stay in this amazing apartment!! Good price and really nice host. I would 100% recommend this one 😊
Perfect place to stay in Berlin! Near by tram station, market. Wish to stay here again.

A spacious studio with hotel-level hygiene! We also had a private kitchen which was nice to cook ourselves. Sergue also offered a free crib since we have an infant, which is very thoughtful and proactive! There were also free snacks and basic kitchen stuff (spices, utensils, cutlerries, etc) which was really nice! Aso relatively close to public transport. Would definitely stay here again next time we visit Berlin!

We had a very nice short stay here. Everything was very clean and it is great value for what you get. Located in a quiet area and lots of public transport nearby. Very easy check in with the lock box too. Was the perfect place for us for one night. No complaints, can only recommend. Thanks! :))

Ok, for a day or two, quite small bathroom and the bathroom door can’t be kept closed, keeps opening.
Practical for 1 or 2 people at max.
this is a nice little studio. it was clean and warm and quite at night. the location  is good and it's great that you can leave luggage before and after checkout.
The studio is really pretty and comfortable, It is a little far from the center but the tram is close so it’s not a problem.

Matthieu’s place was spectacular! Very safe entry/elevator to get to the top floor. He met us there. Explained everything- gave us tips for Berlin.
Apartment was so cute- new open kitchen with balcony. Very peaceful.
It was very close to the trams- very easy to navigate to places.
We would totally stay here again! Xo

Matthieu has a wonderful apartment. Quiet neighbourhood and well connected but takes some effort to get around. The apartment itself is clean and well designed. Good selection of records for good music through the day. Would definitely stay here again.

This is a great place for anyone looking to stay in Berlin and experience the local life. We loved the balcony and sunny living space. The kitchen has everything you need to cook some basic meals. Would love to stay again anytime.

If Matthieu's place is available, request to book as soon as you can!  The location is very accessible, the space is beautiful and well cared for, and it is well worth the money to rest comfortable and easy. Thank you Matthieu for a wonderful and chill stay.
Matthieu is a very nice and responsive host. The flat is very clean and stylish, and it is located a few minutes walk from a tram station. I enjoyed staying at his place!

Matthieu’s place is exactly as it looks on the pictures. The apartment is conveniently located and very close to public transport. It was fantastic to have a supermarket right under the apartment as well as several others close by. Matthieu is very friendly and responsive and we could not have asked for a better host or place to stay. The coffee machine is excellent too :-) Highly recommend this place to stay in Berlin!

We had a fantastic week at Matthieu’s place! It’s very well located being a short bike ride or tram to the action of Friedrichshain and Prenzlauer Berg but quiet and peaceful at the same time. The apartment was spacious, has a great kitchen/living area/study space, lovely balcony and a good bathroom with a washing machine if needed. Usually if staying somewhere for more than a few nights I like to put my clothes away in a wardrobe/drawers and not live out of my suitcase. But while I couldn’t do that here as the apartment is usually lived in, I didn’t mind at all. Their home was incredibly welcoming and we would definitely stay again! The photos don’t do it justice.
Matthieu was also super helpful, quick to communicate and helped us with a late check out which we are really grateful for. Thanks for having us and see you next time!
Awesome stay! Swimming pool is really nice and had a great time. Lovely hosts and really unique spot/style

Anica’s and Maxim’s place is very tidy and has everything you need. The location is very quiet and shops and public transport are around the corner. I only had contact with Maxim, but he was very friendly and the communication went smoothly.

Anica and Maxim’s place was lovely! Incredibly clean, bright and very cozy.
The apartment and neighbourhood were very quiet and was a great place to return to after a busy day of exploring Berlin.
Transit into the city was super easy to navigate.
Thanks again to our lovely hosts!

This is my second time staying here and I enjoyed my second visit just as much as my first. The airbnb is super clean and cozy, it was a really nice place to stay for what I needed. I would recommend this airbnb!
Anica and Maxim were great hosts. The apartment was also great, exactly as shown on the pictures. The hosts were responsive to any kind of questions! We highly recommend that place.
A very nice and cozy apartment in a quiet area. Close to public transport. Host was very friendly and helpful 🙂

The place was well situated close to U+S Bahn stations as well as tram lines, and is within walking distance of key attractions and in the vicinity of some great food and drinks options. The place was clean and stylish, with everything you need for a short stay in Berlin.
There were three of us staying in the apartment and as a single large room (studio) it would be uncomfortable to have more than that in the room given its layout (although the room itself is well sized), and with the beds in the room there is little area to sit comfortably, which was disappointing for the price.
However, overall it was a comfortable stay in a good location, and would recommend to couples but not ideal configuration for groups of more than that.
10/10 would stay here again. Host was very responsive, place was as pictured, and had all of the amenities to make our stay comfortable.

Matthew was very helpful, giving lots of information regarding the property. They also provided us with information for things to do around the area.
Overall very satisfied with this stay. Would definitely recommend to anyone 👍🏼
The place is very clean, new, and cozy! Right next to a tram that takes you straight to Alexanderplatz

This place was super clean, and all the amenities with snacks provided. We really like that place. It’s took us around 25 minutes from central but easily accessible by tram. Host was very responsive and helpful. Definitely recommend this place
All perfect - would recommend this place for everyone who’s looking for a nice place to stay in Berlin :)

The apartment of Kristina, was very nice, clean and had everything you need, coffee, milk, olive oil, she took everything in consideration and the stay was really pleasant.
I will recommend this place to have a nice holiday in Berlin.
There are also Bars and Supermarkets in the area.
Thank you Kristina for everything. See you soon!
Great apartment along a quiet street close to transport. There were goodies and breakfast available on arrival. The room itself is small hotel-like, but has everything you need.

We had a pleasant stay at Kristina's. Definitely recommended. Clean and pleasant apartment. The snacks she provided were really helpful after the long hours of our journey. Just a few things to be noted.
-there is an ongoing road works in her area which made it difficult to find a parking near the apartment. GPS was not helpful given the situation
-the filter of the shower floor drain was full/clogged. I had to pick it up and clean (it was gross) to avoid water overflowing from the shower cabinet. It would also be ideal to have a hand shower holder as it is quite uncomfortable to hold the shower head during bath.
Thanks again Kristina.

Kristina is a good host. The flat is small but it’s totally enough and it looks even better in real. It was clean. Kristina was very kind and let us leave our luggage in the flat when we needed. I would recommend this accommodation. Thank you.

The apartment is conveniently located, 2 minutes away from a tram station and from a supermarket. Checking-in was very easy, the place was clean and furnished with everything needed. Going to the city is quick and simple form there. Would definitely recommend!
Everything is good.Only one thing is that our room locates near the street,and it is a little noisy

The studio is perfect to visit Berlin few days.
The tram passes very close, what it's a little disturbing.
The studio we got was so exposed to the street.
There were biscuits, sweeties, coffee and tea to have lunch, that was a great positive point
Location was very good.

There was everything for staying, even coffe and sugar. And there was candy for my kids ,they love it.
Little bit noisy because tram is very close and drive all night.
Shops are very close.

Sergue is a great host! The room is small but perfect for a short stay. The pillows were rather huge though. The lighting in the room could be improved with more light near the cooking place.
The room is located close to tram stop Friesicke straße. Easy connections to U bahn.

perfect place for a sleepover. not wow but has a parking spot and a kitchen. the altbau building is renovated to a surprisingly cosy small and clean studio apartment with some nice features like a kitchen corner. some small things are to be desired like better lighting (e.g. no light in the kitchen) or more things to do in the immediate vicinity.

it is a nice place and enjoyable stay. really nice to have some basics supply's like coffee, sugar, salt, olive oil, in the room and in the communal kitchen. The outside toilet is dedicated to the room and we'll maintened. Also a huge shout out for the housekeeping lady, she looks after the place and guests beautifully.
Public transport in a drop of hat distance as well as the supermarket Netto.
Recommended
everything was really perfect: the hosts, the flat, the location. most definitely recommend!! thank you, Thomas :)

Very cosy apartment in an excellent location. Great access to public transport and other amenities.
The apartment has a great balcony to relax on.

Stayed in Thomas's place for about a week with my partner during December. We absolutely love the area and think the apartment is charming - Private and plenty of space but still close to restaurants, cafes and shops. The balcony is also a lovely area that we were still able to use despite the -8 degree weather. We definitely stay with again!
Great place to stay in Berlin close to cute restaurants and the tram line. Thomas was very responsive and helpful during our stay.
the place matched the description. Good location. The check-in/out were smooth. The host was quick to respond. However the kitchen lacks equipment and the ones we found were dirty.
Great place to stay! Felt at home from the first moment. Communication was very good and proactive. Can only recommend!
Dina was amazing to work with, she made sure we were comfortable and gave clear instructions on check in and check out. Her home was beautiful and comfortable and perfect for our stay.
We had a great stay, the location is great, Dine is wonderful, and the space is absolutely amazing.
Dines apartment is extremely nice. Perfectly located and Dine is an excellent host. Looking forward to come back and stay at Dines place.
Great stay in Dine’s place! Super nice apartment in a great location. Dine was great and super helpful during our stay, definitely recommend this place!
Great spot as advertised. Spacious apartment, easily accommodating two couples. Good neighborhood. Thanks Dine!

Dine and her apartment are both lovely. She was beyond helpful befor, during and after our stay and the flat was gorgeous and well styled. We stayed for 4 nights and could have stayed for months. The neighbourhood has lots of great bars, restaurants and cafes. 10/10 recommend.
Fabulous place, lovely host, great location. The one thing is that the floors are extremely creaky - very loud throughout the apartment. Otherwise perfect - would stay again, thanks!
Great location, bunch of small markets and restaurants nearby. Feasible walk to train station. Apartment matches the description. We would stay again!
Nice and cozy appartment. Everything was clean. Good location. Probably the single problem is the noise (cars and voices) from the street. Consider it if you a light sleeper.

Kristina's place is very conveniently located -- about 30-45 minutes from any major spot in downtown Berlin and 25 minutes away from the central bus station (ZOB). Its about a 6 minute walk from the subway and a 4 minute walk buses that connect you to the S in a quiet and very safe location.
The home itself is a beautiful little space (very modern and chic) with the nicest touches (fresh flowers, coffee, great selection of snacks, and toiletries). We were fortunate Kristina's place had an opening during our time in Berlin. Upon return, we will definitely return again.

Great location very near downtown. 20 minute bike ride or uber to any attraction you want to see.
Simple room kept organized and clean. Great spot for solo travelers or couples.

Would highly reccomend Kristinas place it is perfect for a stop over in Berlin. Such an amazing use of such a small place! She had also left us treats and toiletries both of which were greatly appreciated. Communication was great all my questions were answered quickly. Check in was simple using a lockbox and code.

Best airbnb 've stayed so far in terms of what was provided for us in the apartment itself. I was so amazed at the amount of snacks - from different types of tea, coffee, even milo, cereals, pasta, salt, pepper, sugar, chocolates on the bedsheet - to the point that we can literally cook in there! And the host was so thoughtful to provide different types of toiletries to suit our needs (shampoo and conditioner for BOTH guys and girls, deodorant for both guy and girl, and 2 types of toothpaste, hand lotion etc)!
Really enjoyed my stay even tho it was really short .:)))) Would defnitely consider coming back here again if we go back to Berlin!!

The studio is on the small side, especially the bed that's near the roof (I'm 1m68 and I couldn't stand). But, we found everything that we needed ! Be it chocolate for the breakfast, snacks, salt, etc... It was really nice !

Kristina's place was very cozy and nicely located. There was self check in that was easy to navigate. There is no TV so bring your own entertainment if you are going to be in the apartment for a long amount of time. Kristina left out breakfast snacks for us- a thoughtful touch. We had a great time!

My stay was great! Transport was relatively easy, checking in/out was a breeze, and it was a perfect location for the Weihnachtsmarkt at Schloss Charlottenburg.
There were a few small inconveniences which did not detract from my stay but could negatively impact others- namely sound from the street and folks on the other sides of walls, light from the gas station across the street keeping the studio pretty well-lit at night (I could see to go down the stairs with no issue), and being unable to stand up straight on the platform the bed is on (I'm 5 foot, 7 inches tall). All was easily dealt with, but others may take issue.

This was a lovely place to stay. Well-stocked with what you might need, and located in a very nice place in Berlin - close to Charlottenburg palace. However, for the ‘main’ attractions of Berlin you may have to consider public transport, it took us about 45mins to walk to Brandenburg gate from the apartment - depends on the type of person you are!
Fabulous location and great value. Clean, safe, quiet. Fantastic host very welcoming. I really enjoyed my stay here and would stay again and have recommended it to family and friends.

Mostly we weigh price-quality-location when it comes to a review.
In this case it suits very good, the studio was indeed cosy and well equipped. The host had some snacks waiting for us at the arrival and the place was clean.
What you do need to know is that the ceiling upstairs is pretty low (1,55) and the water from the tap and shower are not very hot (35 degrees i guess). All in all we had a pleasant stay for our time in Berlijn. Its not far from the underground station so the location is Good too. We didn’t see our host Kristina but it was well arranged that you can pick up the keys next to the studio in a key box and leave it there again when you leave.

The place is very clean and has all the equipment you'll need. When walking out of the apartment you'll walk right into the street, but the neighborhood wasn't too noisy so we slept okay. Would recommend :)
Lovely place, definitely recommend. location is amazing and really good quality for money. Will be staying again next time I’m in Berlin
Small apartment, but has everything you need. Clean. Comfortable bed. Safe area, few shops and restaurants nearby. 400m walking to nearest U-bahn station.

A great place to stay when exploring Berlin! A super cosy ground floor apartment which had everything we needed during our short stay. The host left us breakfast and treats which were very much appreciated! :) Easy access to bus, S + U bahn to bring you everywhere you need to be! The host also allowed us to leave our bags after checkout which was very helpful. Would definitely recommend and would love to stay again!

Thank you for the apartment! Everything worked well. Location was good; it was easy to get downtown with U-bahn.
And special thanks for letting us to bring our luggage there before checking in!
Place is fine. Nothing fancy or spectacularly comfortable. Its good and you get what you pay. Serge is great host.
quite creepy main door, few sockets (mainly in the bathroom), noisy neighbors, otherwise cleanliness, accommodation process and owner's communication good
The airbnb was very easy to find with a metro station nearby for easy access to the city.
The stay was pleasant. The apartment looked like the photos, it was clean and in a convenient location. 🥰
The apartments are great located in Berlin/Kreuzberg. Super place to stay in if you are travelling in a big group.

Perfect for a big group looking to be in the heart of one of Berlin's best areas. Booking was really easy, Stella super communicative and helpful throughout the process. Beds were comfy and the amenities all worked well. Friendly neighbours. Nothing to complain about at all.
We had a great stay with a large group of friends! The location is excellent, Stella's tips and communication were very helpful and everything was really uncomplicated. Highly recommend it!
Really lovely place to stay, ideal for a big group of people, and well-located with lots of cool stuff near and easy access to the railway.

This place was perfect for our large group! Lots of beds meant everyone got there own space to sleep (no need for uncomfortable sofa beds!), and having the separate apartments gave us plenty of space! I was worried it might feel cramped - but certainly not the case.
The plants around the apoarments made the space feel welcoming, while remaining uncluttered and minimalistic.
Excellent location with a cash point directly outside, and walking distance to some great bars & clubs.
I look forward to staying again!

We had a great time staying at Berts place. The neighborhood is beautiful with many great places near by. The house was nice and well equipped. As a host Bert was really helpful and welcoming, he gave us plenty of advice about Berlin, since it was our first time visiting and he also came and picked us up from the train station. We genuinely enjoyed our trip!
Fantastic place and location at a fantastic price. Very comfortable beds, cozy kitchen, and the shower had great water pressure. Would stay here again.

Clean place, good value, good location.
There are all of the necessary utensils for cooking and baking. There's a washing machine and a microwave as well.

Great location, easily accessible from Brandenburg airport via train. Bert was an amazing host, and was very attentive to all concerns and questions I had. My friends and I thoroughly enjoyed our stay in his flat!

This trip in Berlin was improved thanks to the great quality of Bert's airbnb (and exchanges with him) as much as its location close by Berlin's lliving places and transports.
Thank you Bert for this moment !
Some min from station of U5. Nice alternative area. Very clean Appartement. Ideal if you need a good place to sleep and enjoy Berlin during the day
Nice appartement and really good location. It has everything that you need. Would book it again!

Great place. Kitchen is great for breakfast but could be a little crammed for dinner. We went out for dinner, as there are plenty places in the neighborhood (and the rest of berlin) where you can get great food.

Our stay in Berlin was great and the flat perfect for our family of five.
We had in there everything's that was needed, the instructions very clear and effective.
As the flat is on the courtyard it was very quiet.
Great location and easy communication with Bert. We would definitely recommend this place to 2 couples who want to experience staying in a lively and cosy area.

We stayed with 2 adults and 3 young adults. Each with their own space. Everything is very clean. The kitchen is small but big enough to eat with 5 people. We used the washing machine and the host even provided soap.

We had very nice days in Berlin. The location of the appartement is very good and easy to reach with public transport. Nice neighourhood. The appartment itself is really minimalistic and needs some maintenance, especially the kitchen. It’s really small for 5 persons and was not clean.
The accommodation was fine was a bit tired, but was adequate , We arrived late in the evening a welcome pack for a cup of tea or coffee would have been greatly appreciated.
Apartment and host is good. We only faced parking issue. Other than that everything is fine.

The stay was perfect for me. A very nice house, a big and comfortable room with a private bathroom. It felt like having the whole 1st floor for myself. The host is helpful and unintrusive. Highly recommended.
This was a very large room in a private home. Beautiful and quiet neighborhood. Hostess was extremely friendly. Highly recommended.
A wonderfully calm and quiet corner of Berlin, with easy access to the city. Renate is incredibly welcoming, with an impeccably styled and decorated home. Heartily recommended!

We had a very good stay at Gritt's place. The house is very clean, very well equipped and very comfortable. It is about 15 mn walk from public transportation as mentioned on the site. Gritt was very responsive when we had questions. We will definitely book the house again in the future when we visit Berlin.

A wonderful house to stay in a beautiful suburb of Berlin. The house was spacious and comfortable and provided everything we needed. We were out during the day, but it was a lovely home to cone back to and relax. Less than 15 minutes walk to the S bahn station and then only 20 mins to Central Berlin, perfect.
I would highly recommend staying with Gritt

Very nice house in a quiet and cozy area of Berlin. It was big enough for 4 adults and 2 dogs, the 2 bathrooms are a great advantage as well. Also very nice garden with grill. We enjoyed walking with the dogs in the area. you can get to the city centre (Brandenburg gate) in 20 mins with S-Bahn, although the train station is a bit far (20mins walk), it is more comfortable if you have a car. Altogether, highly recommended!

Got wood fireplace but host did not provide fire logs or allow us to use their firelogs at the wood shed. Couldn’t find any firelogs on sale at nearby grocery store.
Spoiled my Christmas dream of sitting by a fireplace during Christmas.
No shower gel or shampoo provided as well.

We received a very warm welcome from Gritt and some good advice on where to eat etc. The house was great with plenty of facilities. Due to the inclement weather we were unable to dry our clothes after using the washing machine. Generally a great house that suited the group.
Highly recommended.

This is a great apartment and Annette is a great host.  It is an easy entry, first floor apartment.  There are three floors with two nice, large bedrooms on the top floor, the kitchen is on the main floor and the bathroom on the bottom floor.  If you have mobility issues this apartment may prove difficult to navigate.  The shower was great, stocked with soap, shampoo and conditioner.  The kitchen had tea, coffee and snacks.  There was also a huge container of gummies and fresh flowers.  We ate at restaurants and did not use the kitchen for much more than morning beverages.  The beds were very comfortable.  WiFi worked well.  The neighborhood is quiet but full of restaurants and shops within easy walking distance.  The tram stop is very close as well.  Our host, Annette, was very responsive.  We highly recommend this apartment and would love to stay again on our next visit to Berlin!
We have enjoed a perfect hospitality. The very stylish apartment offers a very comfortable living in the center of Berlin. Looking forward for returning.

A very nice apartment, ideal for both work and rest, located in a quiet area that is still close to most things. I can highly recommend this accommodation! Very nice host, very communicative and flexible.
We had such a great time staying at Anettes place! She is such a sweetheart and the apparent is beautiful and clean! It only took us 15/20min to get to all the hotspots in Berlin! We loved it

The apartment is very well located and was recently renovated. Additionally, it is located in a lively area in Berlin, with proximity to shops, bars and cafes. Annette is a great host and  is very responsive & flexible. Definitely recommendable to the community - 10/10. Thanks for having me.

Fantastic clean and cool apartment in a great location.
Superb communication from a great host who just wants to ensure everything is perfect for the stay.
My friends and I can’t wait to stay there again in the future.
Fabulous place beautiful apartment . Perfect location, close to transport, restaurants. Quick contact throughout from host ,would definitely highly recommend.

We really enjoying staying at Annette’s flat - it looks even better in real life than the photos, was super clean and easy to live in. The area is lovely and it’s really convenient for getting into town. Would definitely come back again!

Annette and Rita were super easy to talk to, communication was easy and fast. Apartment was amazing, I loved the old charm it had. I could imagine the stassi placing surveillance wires in the walls. Lol
The apartment is in a wonderful neighbourhood with excellent public transport links to tourist sights in the city centre and the airport

It was a marvellous airbnb experience.  It’s a very clean place and completely representative of the description here. Proximity of many S and U Bahn. Neighbourhood is very beautiful and vibrant, many restaurants and stores. Communication with Annette during our stay was perfect, she care about her guest and answer very quick. Thank you again and again :) Marc-André und Carole.

Great location and great facilities. Very friendly communication and super flexible check in (I was a bit late)! The place is much bigger than it seems, the main bedroom is huge. Very cosy and quiet, with excellent high speed internet! Fantastic spot for this part of Berlin! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

wonderful little flat in Prenzlauer Berg, the whole city felt very accessible. lots to do nearby.
the flat itself was clean and comfortable

The location was amazing. Very easily connected to the entire city via transit, and the neighbourhood itself has everything you need for restaurants, groceries and green space. Hosts were responsive and helpful, as/when needed. The space itself was excellent.
Annette was a very helpful and communicative host. She went out of her way to provide recommendations for our visit and let us stay past the checkout time due to a late flight home.

Annette is an excellent host, responding really quickly to any queries. The accommodation is vey comfortable,
well equipped and very well located. I would happily return.

Annette was lovely and the place was great. We had a great time there. It was kid friendly (watch out for the stairs with small kids). Annette even had some kid books and toys. So close to the tram and other public transport a 5 - 10 min walk away.

Great location and lovely little bakery just across the street. The appartement was very clean and a great size for us two. Public transport is in walking distance as well as several shops and great restaurants.
Self-check in was also very much appreciated.

Lovely apartment with spacious bedrooms (rolling shutters present) and fully equipped kitchen. We stayed there when temperatures outside reached tropical levels but the apartment itself was amazingly cool. Everything is easily reachable, both tram and metro are nearby. The neighbourhood itself is attractive and very enjoyable. Smooth communication with Annette, who was very responsive and pleasant to interact with. Definitely recommend a stay!

This place is a gem! Could easily fit up to 4 people. Annette’s place was clean, stylish, had clear instructions, and felt so comfortable. I really loved this place and would love to come back in the future. About 30 minutes away from city center but not an issue if you’re looking for a quieter place with easy access to public transport and want to get a local feel of Berlin. Annette was a lovely host and very responsive. The shower was amazing and we loved the heated towel rack. Thanks for a great stay!
Annette’s place was lovely and thoughtful. She let us check in early, had great recs, and tons of amenities to make us feel at home.

Excellent apartment, with everything you need for a wonderful holiday. Information on arrival was provided in the most detailed and brief manner. The hosts also shared excellent recommendations for supermarkets and restaurants in the area.
Definitely recommend!
Had a great stay. Apartment was close to tram and train stops which made exploring Berlin easy. It was clean and comfortable. I’d stay there again.
We enjoyed our stay at the apartment and appreciated having such a friendly and responsive host. Nice neighbourhood and a great part of Berlin to stay in. Would return!

Loved our stay in Simones place! Very clean and tidy everything you need. Can watch Netflix on the tv. Good communication and we got given flowers picked from their garden! Beautiful lake at the end of the street. Would stay again
Wonderful apartment, very friendly hosts.  Outside of the bustling city and right by a very nice lake with beach.
Beautiful, charming, and peaceful oasis located close to walking trails and the lake. Very friendly hosts who have created a serene naturescape.

Very nice apartment in a very nice location, i'd love to come there again. Just be careful if you take a cab from the airport, cause there's another street in Berlin with the exact same name, make sure you picked the right one :)
Lovely newly refurbed apartment that has everything you need for a stay in Berlin. Well located, really clean and a host would good communication. Will stay here again on our next trip. Thanks

Alexander is a great guy with great communication. I would recommend this place to anyone however the shower didn’t work properly, and I would not suggest leaving your car in the front lane as my friends car got hit and ran away. I feel like it could have been a better price.
Don’t let that discourage you however. The view was beautiful.

Alexander was such an amazing host. He kindly welcomed us to the place, and showed around the flat. He was always easy to reach out.
The place itself also looked awesome. Spacious kitchen with living area and dining table definitely contriubuted to a cozy feel. Bedrooms were cleans and also spacious, and bathrooms had all necessary amenities and some compilentary toiletaries.
The place is right next to a bunch of clubs and bars, so we were always 5 min away from some action.
Goes without saying that cleaniness was at the highest level.

Alexander is a friendly and very helpful person. He offered us an earlier check in, greeted us and took us on a house tour. The apartment has everything you need and in an excellent location, the train and bus are in walking distance. Thank you for a great stay Alexander!
We had a very nice stay here! Lots of vintage shops and vegan restaurants  in the neighboorhood!

Great apartment with everything you would need and a fantastic patio with street art mural. Perfectly clean and very well located. Very green, nice and quiet neighborhood. Big supermarket just 5 minutes away. And our host was extremely helpful and friendly.
Great little apartment, everything you need to stay in, or only a short walk to many restaurants and the S-Bahn. Check-in was a breeze and the owner was very accommodating.
Nice place to stay with a full range of amenities. The host is very friendly and accommodating. Highly recommended!

The Seven Olives apartment is great! The apartment is a good size, its clean and well-stocked, the bed is comfortable and the shower is great. There's also a nice patio and satellite TV if you want to hang out at the apartment. Stephan is a great host - very friendly, helpful and professional. The location is in a quiet, safe neighbourhood. Its very easy to get to central Berlin (and beyond) by bus/train, or by using one of the many scooter and bike sharing options available in the city. I mostly used scooters, which was fun and a great way to see the city. Its about a 15-20 minute scooter ride from the apartment to the Brandenburg Gate. I would stay again!

Beautiful apartment! Spotlessly clean, everything seems very new and there were some cool gadgets.
It is about a ten minute walk from the nearest subway or bus stop and the street is very quiet.
Has a cool outside area with a mural.

We had a great stay here. It's relatively close to public transport links, buses/metro etc in a nice quiet area of the suburbs. It is almost silent at night. Security is excellent and the apartment is behind a key locked courtyard door, and then a further key to enter the apartment itself. Great for privacy and those wanting a little extra space.
Excellent location. Perfectly big enough for two people and very well equipped. Loved using the terrace after a hard day’s tourism
Babett’s property was the perfect location for our Berlin trip. Public transport was easily accessible from the apartment. The apartment itself was clean and comfortable. We would stay there again!

I loved staying at this Airbnb! It was a beautiful, peaceful home with a wonderful courtyard to relax in. I wished to explore Berlin as much as I wished to stay here all day.
Berlin is a huge city spread apart, and I would say this location is a bit away from the heart of the city. But despite that, it’s not difficult to walk a few blocks and find some hidden gems such as Wafele, a yummy waffle spot and Moa, a café about a 20 min walk away.
I would totally stay here again, and it had many amenities that were so helpful for the 2 nights we stayed there. Thank you!
Nice apartment and good value place to stay, area is slightly bland and would have preferred something more central however there is good public transport around

We had a great time at Babett’s listing. The place was very comfortable and quiet. We had access to everything we could possibly need and the host was really helpful with check in  and recommendations.

The unit is well placed for local transport. Supermarkets are close by. The kitchen facilities are extensive. It was very quiet as it was not on a street frontage. We were happy with our selection and would recommend this for a visit to Berlin.

Nice clean space, comfortable, very easy in and out being ground floor. Plenty of room to spread out. Nice light but being on ground floor i didn’t keep the curtains open a lot for privacy. Communication with hosts was very friendly and responsive. Wifi was just ok.

Great apartment that was easy to find and clean. Babett was super friendly and gave lots of local information that was helpful. Lovely back patio to enjoy your coffee in. Would definitely stay here again and recommend to others!

We had a lovely stay, the place was perfect - spacious, private and had everything we needed for our trip. It’s off the beaten tourist path a little but very well connected with local bus and tram stops in walking distance.
The map provided with local recommendations and public transport was also very helpful, and there’s a Lidl within walking distance too.
Highly recommend Brühgruppe Kaffeebar just around the corner, lovely coffee and croissants and even lovelier staff :)
Thanks for having us, we had a wonderful time in beautiful Berlin.
We had a great stay and loved the apartment and the area. Make sure you try the Arminiusmarkthalle nearby for bars and food. A real treat.
Cosy and just what we expected! We had a great time and location was very safe. Check in and out was very easy and clear, thank you!!

Great place, nicely decorated. Perfect for a stay in Berlin. We loved the terrace.
Thank you for a lovely stay.
We just had a completely faultless stay and I would both recommend the space to anyone and happily return myself. Thank you

A lovely characterful apartment with nice outside space. Quiet, peaceful and great facilities. Nearby bus 123 gets you to main train station in 8 minutes. Really enjoyed our stay and so much to explore in Berlin.

We had a wonderful stay at Babett and Stephan’s place. Location was very central to everywhere we wanted to go. Train station was just around the corner on the way in. Very private, quiet and clean location. Hosts were very responsive and helpful!
Thank you Babett and Stephan! We look forward to staying again when we come to visit Berlin in the near future!

We had a fantastic stay, thank you so much!
The apartment was spacious, bright, clean & well designed.
The amenities catered for all of our needs & it was great to sit outside & enjoy the garden.
Welcome message was a lovely gesture 😊
I would definitely stay here again & recommend to others!
Great place, great location. Clean unit and comfortable bed. The only problem was being on the fifth floor and having to walk and carry luggage up those steps.

The apartment is nice, clean, has everything you need and the location is very good - close to a lot of shops, cafes, public transport and a big park. Our host was very responsive and accommodating of our late arrival.  Thank you again for the hospitality Filip!

I stayed one month at Tim's place, and everything exceeded even my most hopeful expectations. The studio is wonderfully furnished, full of lovely touches, and incredibly clean. It also has everything that one might need, and it's very conveniently located. On top of that, Tim and his friends are outstanding hosts. I absolutely recommend staying at this Airbnb.
Tim's place was great in every way.  It is very clean and very comfortable.  The location is very accessible to public transportation.  I hope to stay there again on my next visit to Berlin.

I really recommend Tim’s place! The place was perfect! It has everything you need to have a comfortable stay. Tim thought of the smallest details: from fresh flowers to coffee & tea, from different spices to extra towels/blankets and actually so much more. Anything you need to live in the apartment like it’s your home.
The neighbourhood was also a top location. With several public transport stops around to corner you can get anywhere. On top of that, many great locations are reachable by foot.
Tim is also a great host. He is super friendly, sweet and was really reactive when you ask him questions.
Will definitely rent the place again when coming to Berlin!

This is a little gem! The apartment has everything you need to stay comfortably several days. From toothbrush to vacuum cleaner! . The host had flowers and fruits to greet us. Everything worked perfectly!
Just a couple of blocks away to the tram.
Thank you guys for making our stay in Berlin super pleasant!
loved my stay here, I can't recommend it enough. the location was perfect for everything you'd want to do, and the accommodation felt like home. absolutely no complaints

Tim's apartment was perfect for me.  It is nicely updated and very tastefully furnished.  It had everything I needed, and was quiet, and close to public transportation.  I was there for three and a half weeks, and I would have been very comfortable for an even longer stay.  Tim was a very responsive host, replying quickly to answer the few questions and needs that arose during my stay.  I would rent the apartment again in a heartbeat.
Tim was a great host and the apartment was a absolutely amazing. I will definitely come back. Highly recommended

Quiet, spotless clean, good communication, and a major plus: blinds! I spent a longer time at the property for work reasons and it was perfect for what I needed. I will definitely consider coming back in the future.
Lovely facilities in a nice location. The "bigger" room was spacious and stylish. We would recommend the Stayery!
Very basic, pillows and mattresses are very uncomfortable. Only microwave, no oven. Service is very good.
This small apartment has everything you need, it's very clean and modern. I would surely come back there. :)

Stayery is a very beautiful and clean spot to stay in, the pictures don’t disappoint because it’s just how it’s shown there!
The staff was so nice and I’ll definitely come back there!

I absolutely loved this place pretty close to everything super quiet and the staff is really friendly my room had plenty of amenities and being able to open the window is a huge plus it’s right outside a tram station so it’s convenient to get anywhere you’d like to go and there’s a lot of app enabled scooters/bikes around as well I’d definitely stay here again

Amazing location, really close to Boxhagener where there's lots of shops. Really nice sleep and we had everything we needed in the room. The window connecting to the bathroom was a little bit funny and not very private but bar that it was a great room!

Stayery was perfect for our 5-day stay in Berlin. Neighborhood is super cool and the property is conveniently right across the street from a grocery store and the tram. Only about a 10 min walk to the S-Bahn. The lounge downstairs is lovely and has a coffee machine, beer, toiletries, snacks etc. for sale. We'd definitely return to a Stayery on future trips to Germany.
I had a very pleasant stay at STAYERY. Everything was the way I expected - it was clean and the room had a homey feeling to it. I can definitely recommend this place!
Amazing stay. Great location for public transport into the city. Clean and tidy and a nice space!
very nice place to stay. close to train station. very clean and easy to access. just a bit hot in our room & our window wouldn't stay open

Had a great time here... was perfect for a short work related trip :) Amenities are quite good and wifi is really fast! Though wouldn't recommend cooking proper meals (kitchenette is quite tiny and few utensils and each room also has a smoke alarm... so have to be careful) Other than that, coffee in the common area s also good and reasonably priced. The area itself is quite nice and has supermarkets, food places and public transportation at walking distance.
Amazing stay. We loved it! Great price, great room and great location. We’d stay again. Bed was massive and super comfy. Apartment was clean and really cosy. 100% recommend to anyone.

The hotel is great. The only thing they didn't think is that Berlin weather is getting hotter and hotter and rooms have no air conditioning. So I wouldn't recommend it for hot days. I opened the window, but it wasn't enough and the tram stop was just below. Besides, great solution

Cosy studio in a hipster neighbourhood with lots of nice cafes and eateries.
Highly recommended if you want to stay out of the city centre

The apartment was cozy and a good use of space, it was about the size of my own apartment but felt way bigger! Extra points for the make-up mirror with lights and we found the peekaboo-window in the shower funny. The location is excellent, so many nice restaurants within walking distance and a tram stop right in front. The kitchen was well equipped (except for a cheese grater!) but the flat got pretty hot after cooking. The self-service fridge in the lobby was a great addition and there were decent games in the common area. In the mornings the kindergarden next door woke us up. The tv could have a chromecast-option, because in Germany everything is dubbed :D

The hotel rooms are lovely small apartments, with kitchenette. Perfect if you want to stay for a couple of days or longer. Great work-space downstairs. The hotel staff is very friendly and helpful, communication is clear. The location is also good, near the Boxhagener Platz, with lots of (coffee)bars and restaurants. A bit far out of Mitte, but Friedrichshain is a great neighborhood. I totally recommend Stayery.
Not quite the same unit as pictured in the listing, but not bad. Good location, good check in experience, and clean.

Had a great stay with Stayery, nice apartment and welcoming staff. Location is good and we love the area.  Regarding noise from the tram, it is definitely right outside the building. It didn’t bother us since our window was facing the back yard but I imagine it’s quite noisy if the window is facing the road.
Great stay close to lots of cool bars and cafes. Transportation is super easy since there is a metro stop right out front. Highly recommend! The concierge Max was very helpful as well. Thanks again.

Nice little place, good layout and location and design. Self check in is super easy and convenient. Only complaint is internet wasn’t very good, kept cutting out our whole stay so we couldn’t rely on it. And our room was quite dark compared to the layout featured in the images. Bed was super comfy and some clever design use of space. Would recommend

The staff(maybe) went inside the room without knocking the door. We were still inside and we didn’t put cleaning sign outside. Other things about the room are good, clean and comfortable, convenient location

The Stayery is a large shared apartment block in Friedrichshain, Berlin - a great neighbourhood with a fantastic array of different restaurants within walking distance and close to multiple forms of transport to get around Berlin. Self check-in and -out was super easy but staff are on hand to answer any questions you may have, including by text. The room was different to the photos on Airbnb but extremely clean, comfortable and well designed - although be aware that the kitchen is quite basic. There is also a shared work space downstairs which we made use of. The Stayery has a lot to offer, but it is costly staying there; there are definitely cheaper places you can stay in Berlin but whether they would include everything that the Stayery has, is another question. We would recommend the Stayery for a short city break in Berlin!

Nice place, I was a little disappointed though that the pictures advertised on Airbnb were not photos of the same unit they placed me in. Was not overly upset because Me and my wife didn't plan to spend much time in room. However, I booked this place because of the photos and the space I thought we would have. It did have a great location thought

STAYERY was great for what we needed. The lobby area had self serve vending machines which was great for grabbing drinks when we needed. The room was clean and nicely laid out. The location was ideal and there were trams and buses readily available and shops very nearby.

I had a super pleasant stay at Stayery, starting from getting there a bit early but being able do drop my bags anyway and the reception staff checking if my room was avaliable to check in earlier. The room I stayed in wasn't exactly the same as in the pictures but had the same kind of stylish vibe. The location is great, everything you need is close by and everyone I talked to who worked there was SO helpful and friendly. Great experience!

The tram stops just in front of the building and the U5 underground line is within 15 minutes walk. The neighborhood is very lively and full of bars, restaurants and cafés and yet there is no disturbing noise. The room is spacious and clean. People working in the building are nice and helpful. We only wish there was an espresso coffee machine in the room but that is not a serious problem. Highly recommended.

Very nice place located in a central part of town.
Check in was very easy. I will definitely stay here again.

Very clean and cozy. My room was facing the road so the tram caused some noise, but it also means that it is easy to travel by tram and bus. The check-in code was wrong so I could not get in at midnight. Fortunately, the security came and helped me.

Our host was very friendly and helpful. The place is brand new and the design awesome. The location is great, Friedrichshain is definitely the place to be if you want to enjoy a tasty but inexpensive meal while people watching. The apartment was just a bit too expensive for what you get and the kitchen stuff was not very clean.

this was really great , in general I had a very good experience.
I just have two comments , thw first one is that the photos they have on airbnb are misleading, although my room was really nice it was nothing like the one they have un the photos.
The second thing i that checking in was really difficult, there was a system error with my reservation and the only way to get in touch with somebody who could help me was by phone. I don't have a German number, so I couldn't call them and I had to wait for another guest to help me out.
other than that this was great and I totally would stay there again

Was nice apartment, few stains on the walls. Only issue was house cleaning in the morning came before 10 just said “when you leave”, no hello nothing more was very rude. Other than that nice location and room.

Clean, confortable bed, confortable shower with good pressure. I like the smell of the soaps.
Very quiet to rest as you expect.
The only thing I miss, is the possibility of buying more food than just pasta on the vending machine.
They did very good and quick assistance as in person as by phone.

The stayery is for travel workers. At check in they charge %5 more for leisure travelers. Make sure you check the work tripbox at check in. insulated we would have to pay more as tourists! No AC they put us on the first floor with windows opening onto public space. Good location but I would be WAY more specific with my room request next time.

Absolutely loved my stay at Stayery Apart Hotel! From the moment I stepped in, I was impressed by the sleek, modern design and the overall vibe of the place. The automated features were a great touch, making everything from checking in to adjusting the lights and temperature incredibly easy.
I particularly enjoyed the spacious and well-equipped apartment, which was ideal for both relaxation and productivity. The working zone on the ground floor was a lifesaver for catching up on emails and getting some work done.
Thank you for a wonderful stay! I'll definitely be recommending Stayery to all my friends
Highly recommend to anyone visiting Berlin for both business or leisure. Good size studio, great design and feel.
Great concept. Easy place to stay. Good access. They helped with storing my luggage for my check in day which was really helpful.

Everything was straightforward and easy at Stayery and the hosts were always friendly and helpful. The room was quiet and well-appointed so sleep was good!The room furniture was metal and noisy, and felt more for outdoors, but for just a few days it wasn’t a problem.

I stayed at Stayery for the second time and it was just the same (which is a good thing) everything clean, silent environment, helpful staff. It's not located in a touristic place, so you can enjoy local culture of Berlin. Transportation is just easy.
We could check-in an hour early (thanks a million for that!) but check-in time is a little bit late, it was earlier last time which was better i think.
Thank you for your hospitality, i very much enjoyed my stay again. A definite recommendation.

Perfect spot for a "workation" in Berlin. The room is very cozy, small kitchen, a place to work in the room + a shared coworking space in the lobby. So basically everything you need to both work and rest. I really enjoyed my stay and would undoubtedly book in again.
It was very nice, very clean and easy to get to, the only issue we had is that the tv wasn’t working properly it only worked with your phones screenshare
The appartement we stayed in was super tidy and really nice. We started our holiday here and it was really comfortable.
I had a great few days here. The studio had everything you need for a  city trip and was super conveniently located. Would definitely stay here again!
Very nice concept and very easy to use check in and check out. Loved the common spaces. On the minus side, the wifi was spotty in the room and there were several fire alarms during our stay.
Good location very near the cafes and parks in fhain. Bit noisy in the property due to guests slamming doors.

Good place, only issues: during checkin machine said it was out of keys so had to keep trying until suddenly it gave key
Also tram is on the street and it has loud sound
Great stay here in a fun area of Berlin. It was spotless when we arrived and friendly people. I’d recommend here to anyone looking for places in Berlin.
It was like being in a hotel but with the privacy and check in of an apartment. We will return for the ease of check in, great amenities, and the bed was so comfortable!
It’s a clean, cozy and safe space, perfect for short and solo trips :) Very easy to find the location, polite and nice stuff and convenient check-in and out. Thank you for your hospitality and care.

We really enjoyed our stay at the Stayery. We chose this AirBNB as a place to stay with our friends for separate rooms. What really stood out was the common areas where we could reconvene and catch up over a hot drink or a beer from the fridges on site (paywall). The hosts on site were extremely helpful and flexible when it came to looking after our luggage on the last day of our stay and providing helpful recommendations in terms of what we should prioritise in terms of food spots/sights etc. Overall, a very enjoyable stay - would highly recommend!
It’s good for business travelers. Nice co-working space in the lobby, and plenty of things around so you can grab takeaway food and/or groceries.

Stayed just one night to see a concert at the velodrom. Quick train from the airport to the studio, walking distance from vintage shopping areas, cafés and restaurants. Hosts were super friendly and made us feel at home. Bed was super comfy and clean. Lobby coworking/lounge space super convenient - nice playlist on when we arrived :) Would love to stay here again next time I’m in Berlin.
Very good place to stay for a few days in Berlin. Really clean apartment, everything you’d need for a few days, easy to get around the city. Highly recommended!

Excellent!! A perfect house in the perfect location! We are planning our next trip to Berlin and we will absolutely choose Hardy's place again!Super hospitality and great neighborhood-totally recommended to discover kreuzberg!

Hardy's place was the perfect stay for our visit to Berlin! Kruezberg is an amazing location with a really good vibe. Hardy was great from start to finish and we did not have any issues. Place is nice and open and stayed nice and cool. Would definitely stay again!

Hardy is an amazing, very friendly and communicative host, it was a massive  pleasure to be his guests. Check in and check out were swift and easy, the apartment is exceptionally clean, cozy,  equipped with everything you might need and conveniently located in the lovely Kreuzberg. There is beautiful selection of books and magazine which was a pleasant add-on. Would definitely consider staying again in Hardy’s place, it is much recommended!

Incredible apartment in the best area in Berlin! The apartment was a lot bigger than I expected and very beautiful. It was stocked with everything you could possibly need for a short or long stay. Hardy’s local tips were spot on and he was very friendly. Thank you for a perfect stay.

This beautifully designed studio apartment is the perfect place for a couple in Berlin. Great location, right in the middle of whatever nightlife you choose. Hardy is the perfect host, warm and welcoming. We felt immediately at home.
Hardy is a great host which made this Airbnb experience very positive. The apartment is stylish and well equipped, located right next to the canal.

Very recommendable, the place is in the best possible location in Berlin right at the Kanal in Kreuzberg, the flat is super stylish and equipped with everything you possibly need (especially the kitchen). It's super clean and comfortable and Hardy is super kind and easy to communicate with. 10 out of 10.

Incredible apartment even for longer stay at Berlin. Especially the location - it is in the heart of Kreuzberg with cafes and bars next door. And it is sided on the channel, so you can just take a coffee cup every morning and enjoy your time next to the water or have a joyful morning run.
Hardy was extremely nice and communicated super fast.
Really do recommend this place for anyone!
We had a wonderful stay at Hardy’s place. It’s extremely comfortable and well stocked and the location is great. Will definitely stay there again if we visit again in the future.

Stopped at Hardy’s place with my husband for 1 week.  Absolutely superb accommodation - spotlessly clean with absolutely EVERYTHING you need for a comfortable and relaxing stay!  Location was perfect as so close to the underground, supermarkets, restaurants and bars! Right by the canal where you can spend the day / evening relaxing and taking in the fantastic atmosphere and vibe that is Kreuzberg! 1 million out of 10 and we would find back in a heartbeat! Thank you, Hardy!

It was such a house, everything had been thought of down to the smallest detail. The house was furnished with great taste and of the finest quality. The high ceilings were especially impressive. Hardy was a wonderful person, attentive and kind, both before and after my arrival.The  location was one of the best places in BerlinThank you so much for a wonderful month. I was very pleased with everything.
Cozy and clean flat ideally located for visiting Kreuzberg and Neukoln. The hosts are very responsive! Recommended!
Christiane has an awesome place to be in Berlin. The house has everything you need and she was always quite supportive and responsive.
We enjoyed staying at Christiane's apartment. Clean, cozy, spacious and well-located place.
Second time to stay at Christiane's, and we are already looking forward to the third time. Great place. Clean and quiet neighborhood. Close to bus and train station.

this place reminds me of what AirBnb used to be when it first came out and before capitalism turned it into all profits. This place felt like HOME. Everything you need: coffee, amazing comfy linens, stocked kitchen. high ceiling, large living area and table for working.
helpful responsive hosts, and i felt right at home. location is perfect for going out to parties or out to the park. 100% would stay again. Thank you so much

This is really good location to commute to everywhere in Berlin as the subway station is just 2 mins. Especially, you can walk to Bonanza coffee by walk!
Also, they do professional cleaning service so it’s cozy and clean.
And thanks to Sven again for the quick responses.
Highly recommend to stay here.

The house is great, very comfortable and clean, fast WiFi, good location, well furnished. They also provide baby chair and bath tub for our children, which is very thoughtful. Sven and his colleagues are fast reply. I would strongly recommend this place for family stay.

We had a fantastic time in Berlin, it's a genuinely great city. This was enhanced in no small measure by where we stayed. The apartment was superb, spacious, light, spotlessly clean and incredible well equipped - nothing had been overlooked. The location is perfect for all the main sights and conveniences - supermarkets, restaurants and bars within easy walking distance and the neighbourhood was leafy and green. We walked everywhere.
Sven is a great host, communicative and attentive. We had no issues at all, only a great break and a genuinely positive experience. I wouldn't hesitate booking with Sven again

The apartment is absolutely top in any way possible. the location is very convenient, 3 minutes walk from the U station from there we could get anywhere in no time. Sven and his team made sure we find the place and that we have everything we need. The contact with sven is always immediately answered. There is a great supermarket 4 minutes walk from the apartment. Over all i truly recommend svens apartment to anyone that wants to live in comfort and feel like a true local in berlin!
Hope to come again on our next trip😁👍
Nice inside the apartment and friendly welcoming. Bit surprised that it was a block house but that’s on me for not researching.

All the home comforts we needed. A lovely clean apartment to use as a base for our trip. Such a great location. Lots of transport links, local shops and a family/community feel to the area. Would stay again.
We had a great stay, thank you!  Very easy to get around and we appreciated good communication and the recommendations.

The location of this flat is perfect: right next to a subway station (but you don’t hear a thing!) and only a few hundreds of meters from another metro line. A small supermarket downstairs and several restaurants too. The flat is very bright and looks onto trees, just like on the pictures. A little spartan but very clean! Everything you might possibly need is there.

Location was perfect, in front of a Subway station. You can walk to the museum island (10 minutes) and 15-20 mins to Alexanderplatz.
Sven very communicative and proactive.
Well stocked kitchen, perfect mattress in bedrooms. Lots of space to move, comfortable. Reliable wi-fi and TV has Netflix. All in all would recommend the place.

Great location.
20 min walk to the center or by metro less than a minute walk.
We had everything that we needed and Sven and Juana were very supportive
Thanks
So peaceful, and clean. You could hear people outside, but that's because of the great location and didn't disturb our rest. The a/c was wonderful on the hot days. Really cute decor.
Beyond words! really well thought, spotless clean, free sleepers, multiple keys, location is great! Keep doing the good job!

We were met by a member of the team at the gate where we had our reserved parking space.  After parking we went to the apartment which was 1 floor up from the ground floor. Apartment was very clean and well equipped. Access to the metro was just around the corner and brings you to every corner of Berlin. Lot of shops, bars, restaurants and take-aways close by. We stayed 5 nights and had a wonderful time!

A great apartment with the U-Bahn very close, but also very easy to walk into the centre (approx. 25 mins walk to Alexandplatz.) Very quiet and peaceful. Great recommendations for restuarants etc and clear instructions for things in the apartment. There is a lack of street lighting if you walk from the apartment to the main road; the area felt safe but just something to be aware of as it is a quiet area.

Great location near transit and groceries, apartment well appointed for light cooking. spacious rooms except bathroom a bit small- good hot water for showers and nice tub though :). We enjoyed our stay!

Sven is a great host. He communicates effectively and is responsive to any questions we had. Juana saw us into the apartment and gave us some useful info.
The apartment is very well equipped - probably the best any of us 4 adults had seen in an Airbnb before . It’s easy to walk into the heart of the city if you enjoy a walk- we walked many different ways and enjoyed the one from the cathedral best of all- but the u bahn is so close too.

Really a great location for exploring Berlin - U-Bahn stop is next door - the restaurants and bars of Oranienstrasse are a short and beautiful walk away. The apartment was very clean though somewhat spartan with big windows, a view of trees and a nice dining area. The kitchen was well supplied for cooking. The hosts were very communicative and responsive. Thank you.

Very cool apartment in a great location.  Some construction work close by which wasn't a problem with noise but more about privacy but that will improve in about 3 months when it's finished. In saying that we could have closed the curtains and blinds!! The location is very handy to public transport and some historical places. Communication from Matthew was AAA+. We would definitely stay here if we visit Berlin again.

Matthew's apartment is in a great location within walking distance of great restaurants and many historic sites.  The apartment stayed cool during the hot summer nights we stayed.  It is in a quiet area of the city on a park.  There is a wonderful coffee shop just a block away.  Parking was not a problem but plan on finding street parking and making use of the app to add you payment.  The flat is small but has everything you need and is a great stop to rest after touring Berlin!  Matthew was very responsive and provided clear directions for checking in/out.  We had a lovely stay.

My partner and I had an excellent stay at miniloft. There was plenty of space for the two of us — room for him to be working while I was doing schoolwork, and very comfortable accommodations. I loved the location, and it was easy to hop on the train to explore the city.

Really nice place for a short weekend in Berlin! Perfect architecture and design.
Close to Kreuzberg, Mitte and a lot of other places. Very cute coffee places just around the corner. Thank you!

We loved staying at the lofts! The space was immaculate and the view of the park through the massive windows was beautiful. Right in the center of Kreuzberg, the lofts are just a few steps away from coffee, delicious food and museums. We stayed here with our six month old and the hosts were able to provide us with everything we could need (a crib, a tub, a high chair) which was so appreciated. We would absolutely stay here again when visiting Berlin!

Great place, cozy apartment. Minutes to Checkpoint Charlie. Walking distance to most attractions in Central Berlin.
Only set back is there was no shampoo and shower gel. And pillows were too soft… :)

We had a great stay at Matthew's place. The bed was comfortable and the room felt very spacious. There's a lot of natural light with the big windows which made it feel very homely. The only downside to the location is there isn't  many places to eat or shop nearby, but the public transport is very easy to access.
