A great location for exploring Berlin on foot and via public transport. The apartment was quiet and clean. Matthew was quick to respond to questions and sent helpful instructions for check in.

Really beautiful space, exactly as described. Amazing building and apartment. Superbly furnished, very comfortable bed.
It was unfortunately very dusty during our stay. Cleaning has to be more thorough.
Very nice stay at Matthew's place. The building is very modern and high tech. Very secure. We all felt comfortable.

The apartment is located in the trendy Kreuzkolln area, there is an ice cream shop right at the entrance to the apartment. Also close to many supermarkets and cafes/restaurants.
The check-in process was smooth, and communication with Bibiana was excellent. We did not meet Bibiana herself, but everything about the apartment was explained when we arrived.
We loved the living / dining area (spacious but cosy), balcony and large bathroom.
Only things to be aware of - the shower does not seem to have consistent water pressure so we found it difficult to keep the water hot for a shower (it would switch between hot and cold every few minutes). Light sleepers should also know that the blinds in the bedroom do not completely block out light, which may be an issue during summer and cause you to wake up early.
Otherwise, we had a comfortable and enjoyable time in the Kreuzkolln area at this apartment.

I really enjoyed my stay at Bibiana's place. There are amazing cafes and restaurants nearby and the Uban station was so close. There was a convenience store just down the street and a new grocery store with lovely fresh produce right at the station. I was able to walk to Check Point Charlie and the East Side Gallery. At first I thought the area was a bit rough but as I interacted with people in the shops, etc., I found everyone very friendly. The streets were not super clean but once inside any restaurant and especially Bibiana's place it was like an oasis of cleanliness, comfort and coziness. Berlin was an exciting city and Bibiana's place is perfect for a long term stay with plenty of room and one of the most comfortable beds I have ever slept in. I recommend this place highly.

Annie’s Airbnb was so beautiful, we felt like home immidiately. It is really clean, and the furniture is really lovely. It’s style is adorable. The location of the flat is also great, about 25 minutes walk to the center. Annie was really kind to us, the communication with her was flawless. I can really recommend her place!
I can recommend Thomas’ place. He was very helpful, communicative during my whole stay. I got response quickly every time I need something. Also, the flat is clean and pretty near to everywhere.

I stayed 2 weeks at Thomas and Annes places and it was a pleasure. Thomas (who was alone those 2 weeks) is very friendly and is great at recommending things in the neighbourhood. The location is very good and the price is extremly fair.

This place is amazing! The location is great, close to the tram station, walking distance to shops, restaurants and supermarkets. Close to Kino International where I watched a film and Karl Marx Alle, which has a nice view of Berlin particularly at dusk. The hosts are super friendly and responsive. They even provided me with a bike to cycle around, which is very convenient cuz central Berlin is great to explore by bike. I would definitely come back again if I visit Berlin again!

Anne and Thomas were extremely wonderful from the beginning. I had booked my stay months in advance, and a couple of weeks prior to my stay they got in touch regarding my arrival time. Unfortunately, my flight was very late, but Thomas accommodated for my needs and stayed up until 2am to let me in.
His helpfulness and kindness was evident from the beginning and he continued into my stay.
I really appreciate everything, and I would highly recommend both Anne and Thomas.
Hopefully we meet again during my next visit 😁
All the best
Rumen
Thomas and Anne are great people and I really enjoyed staying at their place - just felt like home. Thanks for everything, Thomas!

I thoroughly enjoyed my stay here! The room is incredibly spacious and light, and the apartment overall is clean and comfortable. Anne and Thomas are friendly and accommodating hosts, and I felt that I had a lot of privacy here as well despite it being a shared flat. The area feels very safe, walkable, and well-connected to public transport. I loved having coffee every day at Nonna Cafe across the street, and exploring the nearby Volkspark Friedrichshain. Definitely recommend, and would happily stay again!

Rehana's place is lovely, very well equipped. The room is very big.
The neighborhood is also super cool with lots of nearby food, drinks and entertainment options.
Highly recommended !
Rehana was super friendly, apartment is really nice. The street in front of the room is super noisy, so if you have a light sleep consider oropax.

Beautiful stay, lots of natural light and space (both private and public) for you to enjoy the apartment. Strong wifi and a full kitchen. Perfect for solo travelers or couples. I would stay here again!

Really enjoyed my two-week stay at Rehana's place! She maintains a very lovely and clean space, and my room was spacious with lots of natural light. Enjoyed chatting with her as well about the area, life, work, etc.; very thankful for her hospitality!

Rehana’s apartment is soo soo gorgeous. It feels like a dream ✨
And on top of that, it was super clean :)
The room is large and very light (but also at night and in the morning…). So if you’re sensitive to sound and light, prepare your earplugs/mask.
Communication with Rehana was very smooth, from the booking until the moment I left the apartment.
Thanks!

The apartment was very clean, comfortable, and a lovely space to back to after time spent seeing the sights of Berlin. Triana let us drop our bags off before our check-in time, which was a great help. She was a great co-host. The host, Rehana's instructions were really clear and easy to understand.
Located a few minutes walk from the nearest train station, with easy access to all the places in Berlin we wanted to visit.

Rehanna has rightfully earned the badge of superhost on Airbnb with her friendly demeanor, beautiful house and responsive communication. A great place to stay with fantastic restaurants serving world cuisine in walkable distance to the place. Would recommend to anyone visiting Berlin who wants to live in a home and explore the city.

I had a wonderful stay. The space is beautiful, full of light and authentic Berlin home details.
The place was clean and organized which makes it a calm place to return to in the big city.
The room is well isolated so the sounds from the street are quite muted. Public transport is close by.
Rehana is a super friendly host, giving me advice on what to do in the area. Open for conversations, but also in a calm presence. I felt really welcome and comfortable moving around the house.
Thanks for having me Rehana, I had a great homely stay!
Very modern house in a very good location, at the center yet away from noise. Bus lines and metro lines are 4 to 8 minutes walking distance.

Great apartment, had everything we needed, very clean & nice location!
Good communication of the host as well 👍🏻
The most wonderful stay with Minilofts Kreuzberg. The room was perfect. Beds so comfy. I will be staying here again when i’m next back in Berlin. Great communication from Matthew, thank you !!!

This apartment is great- the location is very central and it looks just like the photos. It was very clean and the bed extremely comfortable! Matthew was very clear with his communication, would highly recommend!
Perfect location, very close to a supermarket and easy to go to the main street by walk. Spacious and clean
Loved our stay at Matthew’s place - the apartment was warm, the bed comfy, and the balcony was lovely to enjoy the sun. Thanks!
Very nice studio with comfortable bed and a nice terrace. Easy self check-in. The apartment is located close to a coffee shop and supermarket. Walking distance to the metro station.

My stay was lovely, the apartment is exactly as described and looks in the pictures. Great location, really easy to get around by foot or public transport. Matthew was a great host, he was very responsive and checked in with me after I had arrived - he even offered me to check in early as my flight arrived very early in the morning! I really appreciated that and highly recommend, I would love to stay at Miniloft again when I next visit Berlin 😊

Such a lovely Airbnb! Beautiful views and natural light in the apartment and in the perfect location - easy to get everywhere without the noise of being in the main area. There’s a lovely roof for coffee and views of the city accessible to guests. Matthew was easy to reach when needed. Would recommend staying here!

Matthew was all very informative and replied to any queries promptly.
The studio flat was clean and at a great location next to checkpoint Charlie at Koch Str.
Good times!
Nice place, very practical for short stays. The location is well connected to U-Bahn and easy to get around

The loft is matching the description and images. The location is good, quite central, and close to the metro.
The apartment was clean, and warm, with large windows. We particularly liked that there were a lot of kitchen utensils ready to use.

Very beautiful room design-wise, great location, very accessible to the centre as well as other neighbourhoods for bars and night life.
Also super cozy in general, with the floor heating.

The room itself is beautifully designed and very comfortable—no complaints at all in terms of cleanliness, aesthetics, or amenities. It’s a great choice if you're prioritizing a relaxing and well-kept space. However, the surrounding area is on the quieter side, with limited options for entertainment or nightlife. If you're hoping for a livelier atmosphere or more activities within walking distance, you might want to consider a different location. That said, it's perfect for those seeking a peaceful and calm environment.

Susan is a great host and her apartment is a secret gem. It is very open, spacious and homely. We instantly felt at home. It is equipped with all facilities you need for a comfortable stay. There are many great restaurants and shops in the street and a night-shop next door in case you need some late supplies.  Under the apartment is a bakery with great coffee and freshly baked goods for an easy morning. I will certainly try to come back on my next trip to Berlin.
Amazing apartment!  Even better than the pictures.  Susan was very accommodating when our flight was delayed.  She also took ample time to explain to us how to make coffee!!!
Had a wonderful stay in Berlin at Susan’s place. It was so cute and well decorated and we had a wonderful time!

The accommodation was very well furnished, spacious and clean. Susan responded quickly to messages and was extremely helpful.
In the evening it was unfortunately noisy because there is a restaurant under the apartment.
Overall, I can recommend the accommodation for everyone who wants to explore various places to eat and drink, enjoy nightlife but also nice walks in the evening, or searches for somewhere to stay during a work trip.
Susan was very nice and welcoming! The apartment is big and beautiful - even more than the pictures! The best location, hope to visit there soon again:) thank you for lovely stay!

Susan’s place was wonderful! Huge, high ceilings, comfortable, and the location was perfect - close to transit, an easy walk to Museum Island and other major sites, and next to the Prenzlauer Berg neighborhood which we really, really enjoyed. We couldn’t have asked for anything more and I would absolutely love to be able stay here again when I travel to Berlin in the future!

Overall this was a great place to stay! One thing to note: one of the bedrooms isn’t a full bedroom but a living room/bedroom. The (extra wide) sofa is the second bed. We made it work for our family and no issues but it might not work for everyone.

It’s a beautiful apartment, the pictures really don’t do it justice!
We felt very relaxed and at home, the location is excellent and Susan was a wonderful host. We’d absolutely recommend and stay here again.
Very nice apartment in a lovely neighborhood. Close to the metro. Susan was here when we arrived. She was very nice and gave us good tips. We will come back 😄

We felt at home at Susan‘s wonderful and beautiful place right away! As we had to change our travel plans on very short notice, we were very glad that Susan replied quickly and was very helpful. The place looked just as shown on the photos and the location right in the middle of Berlin is just great. We definately want to stay there again!
Susan apartment is really breathtaking. It is in an excellent and beautiful location. We felt like at home. We only can recommend it!

Amazing flat - very clean and tidy. The place is very cozy and spacious. It had all that we needed for our stay in Berlin.  Close to Alexanderplatz and many restaurants and shops in the area. Susan was super friendly and helpful in many ways. Thank you it was a great experience ! I highly recommend 👍🏼

Lovely apartment. Spacious and furnished quite well
Noisy at night with people hanging out
Lovely big space with a lot or character and very nice host! She got me a yoga mat on request! Details are much more like being in someone’s home than a short-term rental.

Location is amazing!! Close to all the great landmarks  in Berlin's city center and the neighborhood has endless food choices and shops. Susan was wonderful to communicate with and always super helpful and quick to respond. The apartment was very spacious and it's awesome being right over the bakery for breakfast every morning.

We had a fantastic long weekend in Berlin and arriving home to this beautiful residential neighbourhood added an extra to our experience.
Everything as described by the listing and the other reviews.
The fireplace indeed is a great feature :)

We really enjoyed the neighborhood: beautiful villas and tree lined streets, nice stores, cafes and restaurants and an easy train ride to the city center.
The apartment is very spacious with a nice big kitchen.
We had a great time during our visit. :-)

We had a wonderful stay, beautiful apartment, easy travel to the main attractions.  I asked a couple of questions and the hosts were very responsive and friendly. We had long busy days and it was lovely to come back the apartment and cook, everything had been thought of. Thank you Ariane & Henning 🥰
Great location close to tram. Stylish spot, clean and clear communication. Small problem with key on check in was quickly resolved. Thanks!
Appartment soooo stylish and beautiful!! Amazing!! Stella is very polite and nice:) All the best!!

Stella is a very responsive and helpful host. Spacious family apartment is in a perfect location to explore the nice area of Prenzlauerberg and Volkspark Friedrichshain, but also Berlin in general. A lot of nice restaurants and shops within walking distance.

The stay at Stella's was perfect. Very effective communication and check-in/check-out. The place is neat and clean, calm and has nice amenities. It is close to nice areas in Prenzlauer Berg and has a great parc for running close by. Stella even provided us promptly with some extra kitchen utensils. Great for family visit or with friends.
What a beautiful apartement on a top location! We had a wonderful time. The host was very friendly and reacted very quickly on our messages
The communication from Stella and Philipp was flawless. They’re place was cosy, clean, and beautiful. I would highly recommend it! Thank you for a wonderful stay.
We had a really lovely stay here! The place was as described in the listing, clean and in a great location. When we had any questions Stella was easily contactable, I would definitely recommend!

Overall a great stay!! We had a good time! The street it’s on can get a little noisy and you definitely can listen in on the upstairs neighbors but the place is definitely cool for groups that don’t spend the majority of their time inside the residence :)
Wonderful little apartment in Kreuzberg. Close to shops, cafes and great restaurants. Perfect for a short stay in Berlin, definitely recommend !
Very clean apartment, the bed is super comfortable and the location is perfect. I definitely recommend the place!

The communication with the host was excellent, and they responded very quickly when I reported a light bulb issue in the bathroom. The Wi-Fi worked well. The ground-floor room didn’t get much sunlight and was a bit cool, but overall I had a pleasant stay.
The apartment is as described.It is spacious, centrally located and the bedrooms are on the backyard so it is very quiet. We enjoyed our stay!

We (3 people) had a pleasant stay at this home. The space is large and clean. The beds were comfortable, and the shower worked well with high-pressure water. Peter was very responsive when I forgot the key at the flat, and I was able to get back in fairly quickly. Highly recommended location, the flat is right next to the S-Bahn (which faces the front room & kitchen, not the bedrooms, so the train cannot be heard from the bedrooms). Thank you for a great stay!
Great location in terms of being so central and close to sights and eateries. Easy to find - not so easy to get into!
Great roomy place with lots of sunlights, friendly hosts, amazing view and location. WIFI is very fast as well. I can totally recommend Peter and Denis’ place!
Fabulous location in Mitte. The appartment is huge, perfect to room a family. Beautiful vue from the balcony. Definitly recommand Peter and Denis, thanks for the welcome.
The location is super central and the apartment has all the basic needs! It was really easy to get around the city. There's also a small Edeka nearby for any grocery needs.
Nice apartment. Very central and Hackescher market was a nice place to stay at for two nights.

Great location but the apartment itself had issues. The apartment was not clean when we arrived. There were issues with the shower and toilet. In general cleanliness was an issue throughout the apartment. There was insufficient dishes/cutlery in the kitchen and a lot of them were dirty.
Only one set of keys were provided, which when you have a group of 4 or 5 makes it inconvenient to get into the apartment if you split up as a group.
Incredible location, very spacious and easy elevator access made the apartment my favourite on our entire trip!
Beautiful apartment with incredible artwork, in a great location. Peter and Denis were really responsive and helpful, perfect place for a weekend in Berlin.

We’ve had a great short stay here in Berlin with the family.
The apartment is in a brilliant location with a well connected station right by and yet there was no noise disturbance at all. Our hosts provided great recommendations and were very responsive to all of our questions too.
Great central location, so expect noise at night. Good soundproof windows if you want less noise from the plaza.

Beautiful, bright and spacious appartement. Checkin and checkout instructions were very clear and accurate.
The host is very responsive and nice.

I think this place is the best quality/price deal you can find in Berlin.
It is extremely cosy, very central location, insanely tidy and good for chilling and having a glass of wine. The skies and clouds paint a very artistic view from the balcony, a thing that not many rental places have.
I totally recommend this place and I would totally book it again if ever in Berlin.
All the necessary information was given when check in, therefore, we had nothing missed out or misunderstood.
Great location! Directly across from the train station and a beautiful market. If you keep the windows closed, noise is not an issue. We would definitely book again when we return to Berlin.

Great spot, and close to everything… restaurants and trains. Bedrooms are in the other side of the apartment so you can’t hear the trains. The apartment has heaps of space, perfect for our 2 couples. We’d definitely stay here again.

What a fantastic place to stay and enjoy Berlin. It was the perfect place for us to stay for our family of four with two older teenage children. The apartment had everything that you could possibly need and what a fantastic view, that was great to enjoy from the enclosed balcony . The apartment was very well set out and the paintings made the apartment feel so special.
I would recommend this place to everyone.

Highly recommend staying here. First of all, we appreciated the location and the cleanliness throughout the apartment. We stayed only one night, but we felt at home. The apartment is really well equipped and well maintained.

Great location and good value. Would have been nice if there were more than one set of keys as there were three of us and even if there was someone inside the house, you wouldn’t be able to let someone else in without getting locked out. Other than that, it was a great stay with super helpful hosts.

A modern well-outfitted apartment in the middle of the action. Close to Museum Island and fantastic transportation connections. There was a nearby grocery for the well stocked kitchen and an incredible choice of restaurants just outside the door
The apartment is located just besides the Hackescher Markt station which is very very convenient. The host is nice and easy to communicate.

Staying at Monika's place was extremely relaxing and nourishing.
Monika is friendly, careful, attentive and with an easy and clear communication, I enjoyed interacting with her.
The house is beautiful, cheerful, with a lot of daylight. The room is spacious, clean and comfortable. I also enjoyed the neighbourhood, so quiet and easy to access by public transport.
I would totally recommend her!!

the apartment looks exactly as in the photos. it really is sparkling clean. so clean you think you're the first guest there ever. the place is super cozy, you have all the basics you need. there's a supermarket nearby, a few cafes. there's also a cute pond. the whole neighborhood is very cute. it's peaceful too.
and the bus stop is close enough. from there you can ride the bus to the "city centre". the hosts prepared a folder full of route maps, which is really thoughtful. i think this word describes Jörg and Katie the best. they are extremely thoughtful. thank you very much!

My stay was smooth and easy.  The apartment is exactly as described, well organized and clean. Communication with the host was fast, simple and efficient. A good solution for those who have to stay in Berlin for a short time

The stadt team is great. They resolved all queries and were quick to respond. The bed is great. Orthopaedic ones that has remote to adjust the bed. Very clean and modern. It has good connection to public transport. Tram stop is less than a min away and cafe and pizza shops next block. Overall great stay.

Nice modern apartment with everything you need! The bed and couch were perfect to sleep on, kitchen well equipped and a Tram station right outside of the apartment. Grocery store is also around the corner. Totally recommended, thanks a lot!
Great customer-oriented hosts and their responsibly attentive interaction and support for our unique visitors’ needs, made this trip for a great stay.

I recommend this place, patrick is a very good host, quick answers and nice attentions to his guests.
The place is very clean and in a good location.
So book it and enjoy!!
I recommend Patrick’s house. Well located, recently renovated, fully equipped kitchen, clean and tidy. Patrick was very responsive to our requests
Patrick’s place was really great, clean and looked even better than on the photos. Communication with Patrick was really good and he was extremely helpful. I would definitely recommend this place.
Had such a wonderful time at Patrick's place. We literally enjoyed our days in Berlin. The bikes were very nice to move quickly across the city ! Thank you Patrick
Perfectly well situated apartment, equiped with bicycles. Very clean and modern, it is adapted for 3 to 4 travellers. Discovering Berlin from there is really easy.

I stayed here with two friends and found it to be a great fit for our group. The place was very comfortable and was conveniently located. It’s not next to the main tourist attractions but you can get around well on the nearby train or lime/tier scooters with minimal effort. I would stay here again.
Very tactical position to move with public transportation, in a nice spot of Berlin. The flat is very clean. Totally worth it
Close to the station and a shopping district, much bigger space than seen in the pictures and as it is on the bottom floor  next to a kindergarten, there is no fear of being too loud.

great location with a vegan shoe store out front and a biomarkt at the corner. comfortable and clean, close to many of the best parts of kreuzberg while still being nice and quiet at night. minimal layout but not to its detriment. recommended.
Great location, clean and very cozy room. Make sure the boiler at the kitchen is turned on (if you need hot water later).
Very comfortable bed, super clean and easy check in since it can be done at any time. Location is amazing.

We loved our stay here! This AirBnB is very cute and has everything you need. The bed was amazing and the place itself was very clean and neat. The AirBnB is in a lively neighborhood but the street and building were quiet, exactly what you need after a day in busy Berlin. We had some troubles with our train and had to arrive a day later, Ulf and Caroline were very quick to respond and super helpful! We appreciated that a lot. The instructions on the keys were elaborate and clear. I would definitely book this AirBnB again!

A very nice location and super easy to check in. The apartment is clean and big enough for two with everything that you need.
Thanks again

wonderful place, larger than expected, and very, very clean!
walking distance from the subway, super easy to get to major attractions, we highly recommend this place!

The apartment was clean but very small and fairly spare. It is a ground floor so a lot of noise from a kindergarten or something across from courtyard. The internet went down a few times although was good when it worked. Good communication with hosts.

We really enjoyed our stay at Ulf’s apartment. It was very clean, had everything we needed and the bed was SO comfortable - we finally got a few good nights of sleep we needed before holidays :) overall, I liked that there were a lot of very nice restaurants around (host provides you with tons of recommendations upon booking as well), but next time I would not go for Kreuzberg again, as it doesn’t feel 100% safe. You should know the area before you decide for it.
The warm water in the shower is enough for two people to have a quick, warm shower after one another, but it’s not enough for two long showers for sure. You need to wait until the water heats up in the boiler again.
Great stay overall, would recommend:)
Studio apartment. Clean, standard interior, all basic utilities you need, comfy, big bed, nice neighbourhood. We didn't see the landlord, but the communication was quick, clear and uncomplicated

Ulf and Caroline’s place is a great find, its in a great location and easy to get to all the main sites in Berlin. The apartment its self was very clean and spacious and had everything you needed for a short stay in Berlin. Ulf and Caroline were fantastic at communicating and gave some great recommendations. Would definitely stay here again and would love to come back! Would also happily recommend this place to friends and family.
This place is perfect! It’s a great location, super clean, and cozy! Would totally stay here again.

communication with the hosts was excellent, the apartment was easy to get to and in a quiet courtyard. We stayed for five nights and there is not a lot of storage so I would say this place is better for short stays. The surrounding area is quite sketchy and I feel this is something to be aware of for solo travellers. Overall, it is a decent apartment with a comfortable bed to crash in.
The room was perfectly clean. Good location with lot of restaurants and cafes around. Big comfy bed and very cozy room!

Very nice cute little studio apartment. absolutely perfect stay for a weekend in Berlin. Kevin was very helpful and responsive. we originally planned our trip Friday to Sunday but due to German train strike we could not arrive until Saturday. Kevin changed our booking to saturday-monday right away without any additional cost. highly recommend!

Kevin’s place is such a fantastic spot for a stay in Berlin. Super easy to locate (closely located to the S-Bahn) and access, this cozy accommodation was great for a few nights, and a perfect base for exploring the city.

I always choose this little apartment when I return to Berlin. It fits my needs perfectly and is always clean and welcoming. I miss the little natural grocery that's a minute away when I'm not in Berlin!

Excellent location, accommodation easy to access and in a safe location. Very well equipped kitchen, apartment is close to supermarkets, train stations, bus routes etc.  Great local area with plenty of very good restaurants and bars.  Kevin provided superb information on where to eat and drink in the local area and also detailed instructions to access the accommodation.

Kevin’s place was fantastic. We felt very comfortable. It was comfortably big enough for the two of us and our belongings. It was in a good location to two different train stations and was easy to find.  Having a kitchen and fridge was very helpful too

Airbnb was clean and as pictured. Bed was really comfortable and appartment was easy to use and practical.
Two downsides:
- Appartment is in quite an old building, so can get a bit cold inside (radiators available though).
- tricky neighbourhood, especially at night. Drugs dealers and strange people lurking around.
It was such a nice stay, just what we needed for our getaway - and great area. Hosts were very friendly, would def book again!!

Liliana was a fantastic host. Our luggage was lost delaying our arrival, she was very accommodating with our super late check in. She was also extremely helpful while we were waiting for our luggage delivery which can be trick when staying in an AirBnB. She owns/works at delicious Greek restaurant right next to the AirBnB the food was fantastic, really recommend future guest to check it out. The neighborhood is cool and hip with many restaurants, coffee shops, and cool shops. The AirBnB is right across a metro and a tram stop making moving around in public transportation super easy.

Fantastic location nearby to a station and some shops. Clean room. Slightly strange check-in, was surprised to be met by someone working at a restaurant nearby and led to a section of an apartment block that looks like a hotel.
Great location in Premzlauberg, U2 ubahn station just outside the doors. Tons of restaurants, cafes and things to do all within 10minute walk. Room was very nice and cleaned. Would recommend!

Very nice location, surrounded by nice cafees and restaurants. A nice room with lots of privacy. There were a few cons, such as the windows not being able to close properly, which the hosts tried to fix with tape. Furthermore the toilet was running and the bed consisted of two seperate mattresses that kept sliding apart. Its not big issues, but it impacts the overall impression. With that being said we had a very nice stay and we were definitely pleased with the room!

A great room ! Everything you need for a few days in Berlin. The room was clean, modern, and had an ideal location, near the city center and in an animated neighborhood (bars, restaurants, parks…)
The check-in and check-out went very smoothly.
Just a little note : the curtains let the light go through in the morning, and the sound isolation is not great.
I would recommend it !
Really nice place to stay, very clean and exactly as described. Bed and bathroom were comfortable and there wasn't any problem with noise at night.
Incredible location in a hip neighborhood. Great stuff around!  Room was simple but clean and practical

Great location and good price for the spot.
Accurate with pics.
Communication could be way better though. Not very responsive but still nice location for metro, coffee shops and stores
good location, very minimal and not valuable for the price. it's ok for a short stay but don't expect anything :) also some broken things
Clean room, well- located right by the metro. Quiet at night. Easy to check in and out and willing to hold our luggage prior to check in. We would definitely stay here again
Location was very close to the train station and within walking distance to a lot of great restaurants. The bed is fairly uncomfortable so might not be best for long stays.

Helpful host.
Location good for transportation for sight seeing.
Walking distance to many food shops/bakery/restaurants.
Secure rooms and hotel area

Great air bnb! We stayed here for one night during are trip to Berlin! It was very very clean, well decorated and felt very safe!
I would definitely recommend and would love to stay again!
The location was good, we used trams to get to the centre which where around 5 - 10 mins long

great communication with the host beforehand and during my stay. one of the most unique airbnb experiences i've had. great views all around. i would stay again and would recommend it to others as well. thanks joerg!

Joerg was a great host, he accommodated me really well and explained everything about the BANGA really well. The views from the terrace are amazing and the overall vibe of the place is great! If you are looking for an interesting stay in Berlin, this is definitely the place.

great location, interesting building and all functional as described. The building is undergoing renovation, but does not effect the stay. Rooms are basic but very functional decorated with even a dishwasher. All good.

Ronald met us when we arrived, was very helpful and very flexible in getting us settled in.  The public transportation was very convenient from his place and easy to use. His place was private, quiet and comfortable. Ronald is an excellent host.
Staying at Ronald's place was a great experience! The place feels like home and the neighborhood is quite and very nice.

The apartment is lovely, super clean and in a perfect location. We had everything we needed for a couple of days. The shower was great, and the bed super comfy. The hosts also sent through amazing recommendations before our arrival and check in could not have been simpler. There are a lot of stairs up to the apartment so if you have any mobility issues this unfortunately wouldn't be for you. Overall would highly recommended staying here!
Great location, very clean, easy self-check-in, comfortable bed & linens, hosts were super responsive - even last min, and had everything you need for a short comfortable enjoying stay.
The best apartmant in Berlin 🥰 very big and clean! I like the styile so much! Next time i wanna came here again! Caroline the best host in the world ☺️🙏🏾

This is a fun, clean, modern and well-equipped apartment with a super easy check-in process and a beautiful view. The hosts were super fast to answer any questions.
Keep in mind it is several flights of stairs up (worth the view in my opinion, and I had a large suitcase!). Conveniently located near the fun but still quiet, with stores nearby for whatever you need. Recommended.
Well located, many nice restaurants around, the place was well equipped and clean, not cozy, cold (but the owner tried to solve the problem).
Lovely apartment in an absolutely great location, minutes walk from bars, cafes, restaurants and the canal. Would definitely stay there again.

This is a great apartment, very light and spacious. The bed is comfortable and we didn't hear any noise coming from outside. Plus the location is fabulous -- great bars and cafes in every direction! And the hosts were quick to respond to any messages and super friendly. Would definitely recommend

Very clean! Comfy bed, minimal space. The rug has a corner that wouldn’t stay down so tripped over that a few times, and the neighborhood felt a little unsafe sometimes at night but overall not a bad stay — perfect for a 2 day trip.

Only stayed for one night but the apt is great
The apt is in a good location is a cool space and well designed
The Instructions and communications were great
Would def stay again

Loft style space with some nice views over looking a school. We enjoying our stay very much!
although we didn't intend to stay in kreuzberg it was a very quiet option considering the neighborhood. And close to ubahn stops etc
The kitchen was bare bones of whatever other guests left behind and the bathroom had zero amenities

Really enjoyed our stay at Ulf & Caroline’s apartment. Hosts were very helpful with lots of good recommendations. Great location, check in and check out was smooth. Everything you need for a stay in Berlin.
Very cute spot in central location! Slightly sparse on its furnishings but cute nonetheless and was a great launchpad for us to see Berlin for 4 days.

Ulf's apartment is perfect to spend a good time in Berlin. Kreuzberg is super, great bars, restaurants and you can get to the other parts of the city quickly by train and Uber.  I highly recommend the apartment and would come back anytime.
Recommend this place highly! Had one of the best trips of our lives and the place was perfect. Our hosts were wonderful with communication.

Kevin's place was a gem! Felt right at home, like a local. The only problem is
the stairs that lead to the third floor especially with heavy luggage. Great location and the house is beautiful and spacious. Thank you!
Excellent location. Danziger is busy street, but new windows blocked all noise. Very quiet for sleeping. Nice to have open air of the small terrace.

Nadine's lovely apartment is a beautiful, stylish, and special place, centrally located in Prenzlauer Berg. My favorite part of this apartment was the design and feeling, and the great location. The apartment is very clean, comfortable, and welcoming. There's also a health food store practically downstairs, and a great coffee shop, which was very convenient. I appreciated how kind and communicative Nadine is, and would recommend anyone to stay here for a relaxing, convenient visit to Berlin. Thank you Nadine!

Your apartment was the best ever in Berlin. Thank you for letting us stay in it. Very comfortable and your speakers are unreal.  Very lovely and amazing location with friendly cafes nearby and a tasty doner spot

The apartment is fine, nothing more. The check in is overly intrusive and over the top. Hated that. Also the check in/check out times are crazy in my opinion. The overly corporate feeling of this airbnb ruins whatever good experience I may have had inside the apartment. There are better options out there.
had a nice stay here, great location that was easy to find. clean apartment and suited our needs perfectly. we stayed there with a toddler and there was an elevator for our stroller
A lovely place to live in Berlin! Lots of good restaurants nearby and close to bus & tram stations. The apartment is clean and cozy, my friend and I had a great time there. Highly recommended!

Great Airbnb! It’s in an amazing location, near many restaurants and coffee shops but not noisy at night! Simon and his team were very communicative, following up to ensure I received my access code before I arrived, and left very nice personal notes once we arrived. They were also overly accommodating for my infant daughter! Once we were there, the team communicated with us to check that we were comfortable and left a list of recommended places for us to check out. I cannot recommend this place enough to anyone looking for a spot in Berlin!

We had a great, short stay at the apartment. It was perfect for us as a group of five – two couples and one friend – as the three bedrooms and two bathrooms provided more than enough space and privacy. The apartment overall is very nice, we especially liked the big kitchen and table where we shared breakfast. It's in a nice, quiet location with many walkable restaurants and quick access to public transport. I highly recommend it!
It was great accommodation, we had everything in the house no need to bring something and location was good actually , also important one communication was good with Madflats.

Great place at wonderful location. It’s very stylish and comfortable. Would recommend it to a couple though or if your company is more than two then very intimate friends only, because wc and shower are right in the room behind a semi-matte glass wall, which some might find a little less private than they wish

Thanks we had a good time at Belforter Straße, it really was an ideal location for us in walking distance to Mitte and with Kollwitzstrasse and Wasserturmpark as well as a tram station around the corner. One small thing we missed was a toaster as part of the kitchen inventory. And because of an early train connection we had requested an early check in at 2pm instead of 3pm, which unfortunately we were told was not possible so that we had to wait until 3pm for the door code to get released. Apart from that we were very happy with the stay.
This is a lovely, well equipped apartment in a quiet leafy neighbourhood, perfect for three of us for a few days.

The location and cleanliness of the place was amazing. Will be back!
However, the sofa bed is slighly slanted so not as comfortable as the main bed, so probably best for 2 peiple instead of 3 or 4, but not that big an issue really. Also there were some technical errors with the website upon check in and unlocking the door, however as they have an amazong 24/7 support the issues were resolved super fast.

Our stay was very nice. Building has very interrsting design. Apartment was super. Location great.
Only issue we had, we couldn’t find extra bed sheets, and their support was first only the chatbot that couldn’t answer it. They did properly answer only after I was gone and didn’t the sheets anymore.
Other than that, all perfect! Thank you!
We had a great stay in Jens’ place. It an incredible location, right in the city center, easily walkable and with great transport links. The apartment felt very homely and perfect for a city break.

I highly recommend this place! The entire apartment is gorgeous with really new and modern furniture and decorations. The hosts are really thoughtful and fast with their responses. There are easy USB wall plug-ins, which were live savers when I charged my phone. The hosts also provide local recommendations on sights/restaurants/cafe/etc. on a tablet. The location is wonderful and in a safe neighborhood. It’s also near several public transportation stops! Highly recommend for your stay in Berlin!

Simon was a great host, the apartment is beautiful and well located!
We would only recommend pointing out that one apartment (ours) is not reachable with the elevator. A friend who was pregnant had a bit of trouble with her luggage on the stairs.

This place is perfect! Amazing location, super simple and accommodating communication with the owners, and seriously the most well stocked apartment I ever stayed in!!! It has everything you need!! Shampoo, dish towels, laundry detergent tabs, coffee, a yummy welcome wine bottle, a sweet snack for the journey home, etc etc etc. We felt so well cared for! I can’t recommend Ben & Simon apartments enough. We had our baby with us and they provided a crib and high chair. Only thing you need to bring is your own black out shades! We forgot ours and it was a bit too bright in the bedroom.

We had a nice stay at Ben & Simon's apartment, which was clean and spacious. The street is one of the most charming in Berlin, you will literally be close to everything but still experience the local charm of the area. The layout of the apartment was a bit surprising, we wouldn't recommend it for more than two people as the bedroom is very far (seperate by a hallway) from the livingroom, and the livingroom doesn't really feel like a livingroom. The kitchen is very minimal, but quite functional. As it's serviced apartments you will find this similar to a hotel, and the decoration corresponds as such. Minor issues such as shower not working great and could use a proper clean, but overall a fine stay for a few days, and great communication from the hosts.
Very nice and well situated apartment. We enjoyed the stay and the area with shops, cafes and restaurants just outside the door.
Really great place! Very clean and awesome location. The host Simon was also very helpful and responsive.
This was a very nice appartment in a good location. It is well equipped. Everything was there. Even coffee, tea, sugar, olive oil etc..
First time in Berlin and this was a great place to stay. Simon was a great host. Very easy check in and check out process. The neighborhood has lots to offer! Highly recommend.
A nice cozy place to spend a couple of days close to the metro station. Very clean apartment with a lot of auxiliary things. The communication was very friendly, and host sent small gifts every day.

We loved Tanja’s apartment. The location was fantastic. The apartment is  very centrally located and on a main road but inside the apartment is very quiet as it faces away from the road and toward a park to the rear. There are some great restaurants nearby, we would recommend Pirouette! And very near to a few u bahn stations and tram stations for visiting other areas.

Cozy and sweet flat! Most of equipments were in place, so it was possible to make meals easily. Tanja is really sweet and she checked our message so fast when we asked something to her. The most impressive thing is that she offered laundry service to us, so we could save our time and budget! We highly recommend this bnb to ppl who want to live berlin more than 2weeks.

Everything good, Tanja & her husband always responsive. House is on the main road, very easy to find but no noise because it looks to the backyard. It is located in a cute district walking distance to Alexanderplatz
Tanja and her husband Gerald were excellent hosts: communication was always clear and they were quick to respond to any queries. I would happily stay with them again the next time that I’m in Berlin.

Tanja's apartment was a great place to stay. It looks out onto Leise Park and so is very peaceful.
Tanja made it really easy to check-in and -out. Communication in general was very easy.
It's a very comfortable flat that's well located and had everything we needed for our stay.
Thanks!

Tanja’s place is in an excellent location. Very close to a major train station and has a tram stop just outside of her apartment. Lots of great restaurants and cafes nearby without being in a loud or crowded spot. Highly recommend this gorgeous little apartment.

Tanja was an awesome host reaching out to me prior to my arrival to share the check in instructions. She gave recommendations as well on what transport pass to use and was super responsive and kind in letting us check in earlier and check out later.
The location is amazing. There’s a tram stop right outside your front door and also a Netto up the street for any conveniences you require. It’s a quick walk from key locations like a Beer Market, Primark and many local eateries.
Thanks Tanja!

The apartment is in an excellent location, the metro stop is literally 1 minute walk away. This meant we could get to any area of the big city really easily and allowed us to get a lot done in a day. The bed was very spacious and comfortable and the apartment had everything we needed for our 4 night stay. Would recommend !

My husband and I enjoyed our time in Tanja's apartment. It was a perfect location! So close to public transportation and fun restaurants/bars. Tanja was great with communication. Would definitely recommend staying here.
Really good location and lots of nice places very close by. Everything was really easy and Tanja was very responsive and kind. Can recommend for an affordable place to stay! Thanks :))

We loved staying here. Small, but all we needed and SO convenient.
M2 Tram right outside the door took us right to Alexanderplatz where you can catch multiple subway lines.
Loved two local restaurants. Italian right across the street and a wonderful German pub a block away.
Good little grocery (and wine) store across the street and up one block.
We highly recommend staying here.
excellent stay! Perfect location close to the tram. Very tidy and well stocked apartment. Tanja was very friendly and helpful. Would stay again!

Nice place in Berlin. Overall everything was fine - the communication was great, check in was OK (a slight delay on the meeting time and wait in the rain, but no big deal). As for the place:
- Clean
- Good location (close to public transport, restaurants, etc)
- Relatively small
- Ground level & street facing (so it does get a bit loud)
- Missing bathroom amenities
Overall fine place to stay for a short duration.

We had a very nice stay at Alan&Kasia’s place.
The appartment just looks like the pictures and is very comfy. You can acces to the public transports really easily and the main areas to go out clubbing or grab a beer at the bar is accessible at less than 30 minutes.
People in charge of our check in were very understanding, we were late for the check in but they still waited for us.
We recomand you to stay there if you’re visiting Berlin for the week end!

We really enjoyed our stay in this wonderful flat ! It's a really comfortable place.
Nice location. We were closed to the subway and it was very easy to go to the center of the city.
Really quiet place. Thanks for everything !
We had a great stay! Alan was super responsive and helpful, and it was grea to have access to their guidebook to Berlin! We loved the neighborhood as well!
For the amount of space, the amenities, this was worth the stay. A bit far from center of the city and still accessible via tram and s-bahn but we appreciated the extra space and washer dryer!

we had the best stay. easy to check in, fully equipped and sparkling clean. the hosts were incredibly kind and helpful, always with clear and efficient communication. the neighborhood is amazing, full of great restaurants and shops, great for young people and full of families so very family friendly too. thank you, we'll happily come back!

My daughter and I had a very pleasant stay in the apartment of Alan and Kasia. It has enough space for two persons, it’s very clean and good facilitated. And also important: the place in Prentzlauer Berg is perfect. Alan and Kasia are very kind and helpfull hosts.
So, it’s worth to go back again!

Alan & Kasia offered very clear instructions and made it a breeze to check in. Apartment was clean and spacious. Neighbourhood is great with loads of coffee shops! Public transport is fairly frequent into the centre of town and easy to navigate. Recommended!
We stayed here for 6 nights. Absolutely everything about this place was perfect for our needs, and it’s in a beautiful location with lots of great restaurants nearby.

Thomas himself is a very kind person who was very accommodating to us during our stay. He pointed us in the right direction for some sights and activities and helped us on our way out (which was greatly appreciated, we had been traveling to USA & Canada for +1 month and had two heavy suitcases with us!).
His Airbnb is located literally right on the bus line- perfect to walk out and grab a connection into the city. He’ll help you with whatever you’re trying to get out of your time in Berlin. It’s a great price point- if you’re a couple or a couple with one small child and you basically just need a place to rest your head at night so you can spend your day running around the city, this is a great place!

Top location, top host. To find free parking was not a problem at all. Although we arrived before the official check-in time, Thomas made early check-in and flexible check-out for us possible. Would definitively recommend him.
Thomas is a very good host that answers quickly and has a very clean and great placed appartment. Would definitely reccomend!

Perfect place for your stay in Berlin. The flat is quite small, but really cozy and well located. The neighbourhood is calm and nicely green (great for walks) but still just few mins away from the lively and cool river area. The area is well connected by buses and trains.
Thomas is a great host! He would rapidly answer all our questions and try to make everything to go as smooth as possible for us.
Overall great experience and I can only reccommend.

A cute little place with good train links to central Berlin.
Nice neighborhood .
Thomas was so accommodating and really nice.

Thomas's flat is great for a stay in a beautiful neighborhood of Berlin. It's so quiet at night yet with lots of life nearby and accessible by public transport. The flat had everything we needed, WiFi was decent and the apartment was clean. Thomas arranged the key collection and gave us a great recommendation for lunch. Overall it was a smooth and comfortable stay!
Super convenient and comfortable space! Thomas was highly responsive and flexible when we needed to extend our stay.
Thomas was a great host, very responsive and gave great instructions which made it very easy to find the room. I thoroughly enjoyed my stay!

I've spent 7 nights at Thomas's place. It is raised ground floor, with just 8 small stairs to climb - so no worries if you have luggage. It is facing the courtyard and you can hear the birds in the morning. It has high ceiling, which I liked. But the most amazing thing is Thomas's hospitality...it's amazing...it's beyond my English, to be precise. All in all, I recommend this room/apartment in the most sincere way.

Nice, clean, basic flat. Shower was super powerful, the local area had a lot going on. Thomas was great at making suggestions for pubs/restaurants and super accommodating to our late checkout request.
Bed wasn’t the comfiest and curtains didn’t block all the light so if you like a darker environment maybe bring an eye mask. But overall a decent stay.

Thomas was very friendly and welcoming. He recommended some good restaurants and bars around the area. The location is perfect, and we enjoyed many good restaurants, cafes, pubs, and clothing shops. I’d like to stay here again.

I really enjoyed staying here. It’s calm, peaceful, and has everything we need around such as supermarket, park, cafe, restaurant etc.
And I wanna appreciate to Thomas because he was caring and made us feel comfortable. He is friendly, easy-going and humorous. We were kinda nervous after arriving Germany but his welcoming help ease the nervousness.
I would definitely wanna come back to Berlin and wanna stay here once more!

Tina and Karsten, 2 hospitable and sociable people. Together with my boyfriend I had a very pleasant stay in Berlin, in their apartment, which is located in a quiet and easily accessible area.
We will return soon, with the next occasion when we visit Berlin! :)
We had a fantastic stay at this beautiful, spacious flat in a very pleasant neighbourhood in Berlin. The flat is well decorated and the two bedrooms were extremely comfortable.
Great central location, beautiful apartment, very clean with great facilities. Lots of local recommendations and instructions provided for the stay.

Lovely apartment with high ceilings and all modern comforts. Near Tiergarten and many of the interesting sightseeing spots in Berlin.
The hosts responded quickly both in written and on the phone when we hadn't read the checkin instructions properly.
All in all we were very happy with the apartment, the hosts and the city!
What a beautiful apartment. Clean and spacious. A small issue with checkin but it was very well handled.

The apartment is beautifully decorated and very comfortable. It has everything you need for a pleasant stay. Everything is spotlessly clean and of high quality. The apartment is within walking distance of several metro stations, so you can easily visit all the sights. Communication with the host is very clear, with valuable tips and useful instructions. You really get an authentic feel for what it's like to live in the city as a Berliner. We absolutely loved our stay.

If you're looking for a quiet location a bit removed from the city, this is your place!  There are two train stops within walking distance and the airport is just a short ride away.  The cottage was clean and cozy and fully equipped to cook a full meal...note, there is also a grocery story within walking distance.  I was a solo traveler, but there is plenty of room for kids and plenty of things for everyone to take advantage of...games, books, toys, table tennis, etc.  Katharine was very helpful with answering my questions prior to my trip in a very timely manner and I'd recommend you checking it out!

I would absolutely stay here again (and likely will). Exactly what one needs for a week in Berlin. the bed is comfortable, the kitchen has all you need, the shower is hot and the place is close to the metro. Daniela is a great host and super friendly.

My partner and I stayed for a week and Daniela’s place helped make it a great holiday!
A really excellent location, close to plenty of local amenities (coffee, groceries, bus and U Bahn) and within walking distance of some very lush parks, and all the way to Tier Garten and Brandenburg Gate.
Daniela (and Darleen, co-host) was very responsive and checked in regularly to see if we needed anything extra.
Great host, great place!

Daniela has a beautiful apartment in Berlin, cozy and comfortable, big and with all services, Daniela is very kind and polite, strongly recommended, Thank you very much Daniela for everything, hope to see you again soon!! Pablo, Argentina.

Daniela is a great hostess, and her place is spacious and quiet.  It is also centrally located, and you can get anywhere in Berlin quickly due to the great public transportation connections.  I definitely enjoyed my stay!
Great place if you want to stay for a little workcation. Daniela was very nice and helpful and even let us check in early.

Daniela made an effort to support our arrival and check in although she had to unexpectedly be out of town. She also checked with us about our onward travel plans after we had explained earlier we may be subject to flight cancellations due to industrial action. Reference material for sightseeing was helpful to have in the unit. Terrific proximity to 2 railway stations and  bus making it easy to get to the major tourist sites.

The office apartment was as described and is setup well.  Daniela  met me to check in and run through everything.  There are multiple restaurants and public transportation stops nearby along with grocery stores.  She even had a couple of bikes available for use.  I would recommend staying.

Dietrich is a well communicating host, he provided all information one might need. Access to the accommodation is easy to find, parking is free around (in the green zone thus environmental plaquette is needed), public transport is on stone throw distance, city bikes all around. The accommodation is clean, well equipped, nicely furnished.
Worth mentioning is that the accommodation is in fact a shop on a busy street which means the only window is a large display window facing the busy street. Not to take part in a reality show dark grey curtains need to be shut also during daylight. There is only a small slot close the ceiling for fresh air inflow which is totally insufficient, there is no air circulation possible despite 2 fans in place. Size of the accommodation is comfortable for 2. The sofa is small, hardly for 1, definitely not for 2 adults for sleeping (despite diagonal, my feet were stretched in the air).

We had a great time at this spot. The tram was about 2 minutes away from us. That made it really easy to get all of the places we wanted to visit. The space was comfortable and the temperature settings were remote controlled which was very nice. Dietrich was also great at communicating during the check-in and check-out process!

Had a great stay at Dietrich’s apartment. It is small but brilliantly decorated and has all the amenities you need for a short stay in berlin. It was very clean and communication throughout was great. Location was fine, easy to access all main attractions via public transport.

Nice decor, small and quaint. The location is unbeatable, close to transportation, park and lots of restaurants. As the previous reviews say the walls are quite thin which we disregarded because we think we can sleep through anything, and we were quite lucky that though the walls were thin the talking/noises stopped after a certain time. Note, this apartment is on ground-level and close to the street but if you're looking for a quick place to crash with access and proximity to everything around Berlin then this Airbnb is for you!
the apartment was very nicely designed and very comfortable.  everything I needed was in it.  I highly recommend it if someone would like to stay.

We have had A Nice stay in the apartment. It was complete furnished. Unfortunately we Did not meet the owner but it was All good. The tram station was right on front of the house, so easy to reach the city center.

Very good location and links to the city. Tastefully decorated and safe. It's a ground floor with windows to the street but well insulated when windows are shut. Quite small, perfect for a couple. Very good communication and host very receptive.

Easy to find, close to public transport, and close to the UFO Velodrome (we were visiting Berlin for a concert there)
Beds were comfortable, shower had great pressure and temperature. I’d recommend this place to other travellers.

The apartment was just as described, the bed confortable, the kitchen very complete, bathroom nice. The host has been very kind all the time. The apartment is right next to the street and it can be a bit noisy but we had no problem and slept really well. The area is quiet, a big beautiful park just crossing the street and there is a big supermaket 5 min walk. It is well connected with public transport. I would recomend it and go back next time.

I stayed in this flat for 3 nights, the room was very clean and even if it is not very big it was perfect for 4 people. The only thing that we didn’t expected is that the apartment is at the ground floor on the street, maybe this can affect privacy and noise but it was ok.
Dietrich has been clear with the check-in and checkout instructions and he was very kind.

Dietrich’s place was exactly as advertised. We really appreciated the easy access to public transport - this made our stay very smooth. Excellent hot water and water pressure for the shower was also appreciated.

Dietrich’s place was just as described, in a quiet neighborhood, close to public transportation and many good cafes and restaurants. Parking in the area was very easy as well, I was able to leave my car in the spot nearby the whole time with no issue. A cozy place for a weekend stay in Berlin, would come again.

Had a good stay at Dietrich’s place for a city break. It is just like the photos and has a very cosy bed. Great host who is responsive and accommodating. Easy and hip location with good transport links. I will certainly stay here again next time I’m in Berlin :)

It was a cozy, clean and trendy apartment. Super close to tram stations and a beautiful park across the road for nice walks. The road outside and trams were really quiet even if the window was open. Everything on the apartment was in working order. Would definitely recommend. And me and my partner would 100% stay there again when we visit Berlin

The apartment is in a good location near Public Transport so it is very easy to get around.
It is also a comfortable and has all the amenities you need. Would definitely recommend it.
This is a great flat and in a perfect location. There is a lovely park across the road and a tram stop in between. Nice and clean and Dietrich is a great and very responsive host. Thankyou

Apartment was very nice, in very good location so traveling around town is easy. Also there was air conditioner so it was a relief after long and hot day in town! We stayed during weekend so there wasn’t too much noise from the big street outside the apartment. Would choose again!

We stayed at Dietrich’s apartment in Berlin with my friends and had a great experience. The apartment looks exactly like the photos, the air conditioning works perfectly, and the location is excellent, very close to public transportation, which made it easy to get around the city. There’s also a huge park right across the street, which was a nice bonus. Dietrich was kind and responsive to our questions and requests. I definitely recommend this apartment!
A nice, clean, small and cozy studio apartment. Ground floor and a bit dark, but very nicely decorated with a cool touch.
Thanks for your wonderful apartment! The pictures are like the reality. We loved it and would love to come back when we are again in Berlin.

The Place Is extremely well located with easy access to transport to go to any part of the city. The huge park literally in front of the property is a big added value.
Overall a more than pleasant experience

This is a really stylish and relaxing apartment to stay at! We really loved the soft bed/sleeping nook area, and the apartment is cozy but makes great use of the space. There's also a beautiful park across the street, and easy + free street parking in the area, which is great if you're driving. There are also places to eat in the neighborhood - about a 10 - 15 minute walk away. Though we were only there for a night, we had a nice and comfortable stay here and would definitely come back again for our next trip to Berlin!
Nice place, very accessible only complaint is that the apartment is really warm. there's a small air conditioner though.

The flat is beautiful and clean. Great communication with Dietrich, he gave me some good addresses in Berlin.
Thank you for this stay !

Excellent apartment for a stay in Berlin.
Very clean and Dietrich is always on hand for any questions.

Dietrich is really communicative and always available in case of questions! The apartment is really well located, directly in front of the tram with really easy access to Berlin public transport. Parking the car nearby is also really easy and free, great for a city like Berlin! The apartment was really clean when we got there and that was a great point for it! It is directly at the street level, but it has nice curtains that makes it comfortable and cozy to stay in and sleep. The Shower was also really good after a long walking day! Thanks Dietrich!
This is a cute and cozy place to stay close to the heart of downtown Berlin. Close to public transportation and across from a nice park, it also has many restaurants available, also.
Very pleasant apartment. Easy to reach with public transport. The host is also easy to reach and quick with his response. We had a great stay.

Dietrich’s place was great, we had a very pleasant stay here! It is stylish just like the photos and all the decors were quite neat! Whole place is clean and tidy, bed is comfortable, and well equipped. Very convenient access to multiple kinds of public transportation, yet very quite at night and feels safe at night.

Great apartment in a lovely quiet neighbourhood, got everything you need to enjoy a weekend in Berlin.
Dietrich was a great host. There was great communication and he was there to help with any issues we had. There was some building work going on outside which was noisy, and without any hesitation we were provided a partial refund as compensation.
We would definitely stay here again, and will encourage others to.

We stayed here for a few nights to explore Berlin. The apartment was great and Dietrich was a great host, providing us with flexible checkin/out times, a helpful guide with lots of tips for things to do and see and eat/drink. The apartment felt like a home away from home and we loved the quirkiness. Dietrich is very responsive and we appreciated all the helpful messages leading up to and during our stay. The location is great, we walked everywhere but it is in a very accessible location for the metro and tram too, if you prefer to use public transport- and easily access from the airport. The road outside the apartment was also very quiet and didn’t disturb us at all during our stay. Overall a great find, would definitely stay here again!

We really enjoyed our stay at Dietrich's place! The location is fantastic, the whole of Berlin at your fingertips with the tram stops right outside. Also, we slept brilliantly with this super comfortable bed and sheets.

Dietrich is a great host! The whole place was clean and well kept. Easy access to heating and cooling at the place.
2 callouts, the bed unfortunately is quite uncomfortable and loud. The other is that the area has one wall of pure windows, on the 1st floor as a storefront to the main street. So unless you want passer bys looking in, the blinds must be shut constantly
Everything else was great, close to a Rewe and plenty of German restaurants
The stay was great, had an easy time getting there, no problems with free public parking.  The apartment was very clean and extremely nicely furnished.

We thank Dietrich for his friendliness and hospitality, we had a great time in his appartment which is equipped with everything you need. We found everything to be very clean and nicely decorated. The Tram Station is within 100m and connects you with all major places of interest.

This place was a perfect cozy spot for our trip!  Pictures match the space exactly. We traveled with our 3 year old child for her first international trip, and we couldn't have started in a better space. Literally steps from the tram, we traveled easily through the whole city and loved our days in Berlin. We really appreciated the extra touch of the sofa bed being pulled out and ready for our toddler....she saw it and immediately claimed it as hers and made settling her in super easy.  Would definitely stay here again and would recommend to others.

We had a great time at Dietrichs place, it was very modern and stylish, the price was great, and the local transport links and amenities were excellant.
It's a great base for exploring Berlin.
Great please to stay for a 2-5 nights in Berlin. Has everything you need and great transport links. Dietrich was really responsive and helpful via the AirBnB chat too.
The accomodation was great. We really enjoyed our stay. The apartment has great access to public transport. Would highly recommend to anyone visiting Berlin.

Very nicely decorated apartment on ground floor. The area is not as pretty and vibrant as some other areas in Berlin and the apartment is on a main road but we quickly realised that it was just 10 minutes on the tram to two of the coolest areas in Berlin - Friedrichshain and Prenzlauer Berg - and the tram stop immediately outside the apartment is very conventient and makes travel to these prettier areas really easy. Dietrich was responsive and kind. Would recommend.

I had an enjoyable stay here. The location is great, short walking distance to the Metro M10 line. Perhaps a point to improve: the pillow is very nice a soft, perhaps if it is a little more firm it would even be better.

Very nice apartment, original design. There is everything you need for a great vacation. Good location allows you to effectively use all public transport. Quiet area, next to the park. There is a supermarket within walking distance. The owner is hospitable and attentive. We recommend!

Had a lovely stay at Dietrich's place, very well connected with the M10 tram right outside, and plenty of shops/resturants nearby too. Good amount of space for me and my friend, the flat was clean and matched the pictures :)

Michael’s studio is in a perfect location for the Olympic Park/Waldbuhne.  There are two U-Bahn stops within an easy walk and bus stops very nearby. Lidl is approx 8 mins walk. The studio is beautifully furnished and has great artwork. We loved the private outside space for breakfast/lunch. Good shower with plenty of hot water. Comfy bed and Michael is a great host.

The place is amazing, pretty clean, and I like the location near for my meeting place. Michael is really nice and meet me personally to give me the key, it is really neat to the bus station and supermarket. I will come again:)

Pros: very clean, suitable for working remotely (workspace, good WiFi), patio to chill outside, great location near park
Cons: lack of kitchen. There's only fridge, coffee machine and electric kettle

A lovely bohemian ground floor apartment for anyone seeking rest and peace from worklife. Loved the interesting book collection and stereo set, pieces of art, and the beautiful old furniture. Unique and simply lovely setting in green and tranquil neighborhood. Bus M45 provided easy connections to a multiple of S- and U-Bahn stations.
What I missed was a proper access to the patio - it'd been nice to sit and read on it. Unfortunately the patio was much neglected and untidy with ants marching at the shabby garden table. Pity.
Should I ever travel to Berlin again, I'd choose this lovely apartment again.
Michaels place was in such a beautiful and peaceful part of Berlin. Close to the train easy to get around. Definitely recommend. Thank you!

An amazing place u def want to visit again!
We loved the apartment really much. It's in the quiet area of Kreuzberg. The palace is amazingly stylish (your Instagram followers will be jealous 😂😂), and thought out! Nothing is missing and everything is on it's place.
The host is sooo friendly that u fell like u visiting your good friend, who just left house.
Def recommend 🙏

My boyfriend and I stayed three nights in this appartment and we loved every second of it. The vibe is very relaxed. Everything is really clean and the decoration makes it feel like home. Since Carsten was out of town, his daughter Pooja checked us in. She was very kind and showed us around.
The communication with Carsten was very good. He responded very quickly when I send him a message. I would definitely recommended staying here!
Great apartment with a cool style, comfy bed and what you need for a good stay. Nice location and good communication from hosts :)
We had a wonderfull time at the appartement of Carsten! we received a warm welcome and the communication before and during the stay with Carsten went very well. We will definitely come back!!
I highly recommend Carsten’s place. The apartment is at a great location, clean and comfortable. We enjoyed it, and had everything we needed!
This place is every bit as it looks, namely great! The hosts were very kind and always providing information and checking in on us. Highly recommended and would definitely go back!
A lovely apartment in a very cool area of Berlin. Very friendly and helpful hosts! Facilitated an amazing stay in the city for our honeymoon!

Carsten's home was a cosy haven for us during our stay in Berlin. Carsten and Pooja was super friendly and helpful in making sure we feel welcomed and at ease. The place itself is as magical as the photos look and for those who want the option to eat in, there's also a small portable stove that you can cook with. Location-wise, it's close to a few bus stops and is an 8-minute walk to the U-bahn station, Prinzenstraße.

Beautiful apartment centrally located in Berlin. The neighborhood was safe and conveniently located to a variety of restaurants.
The apartment itself was adorable! So many custom touches to it and the hose wrote a very helpful guide to the city with recommendations on where to eat and what to see/do.
Perfect hide out in Berlin. Great neighbourhood and lovely place. We had everything we needed. We will definitely try to book this place again for a next visit.

Jessica and Carsten’s place is in a wonderful location for exploring Berlin. It is extremely clean and comfortable with kitchen facilities if needed. It is close to public transport but also walking distance from some of the city’s main attractions. Both Jessica and Carsten were extremely helpful with checking in and offering suggestions for places to visit. I would highly recommend this as a place to stay to anyone visiting the city.

We had a great stay at Carsten and Jessica’s place! The location is in a cool part of Berlin (Kreuzberg). There’s a lot to do around you, so have a wonder around the streets :). You’ll find it’s a very different vibe in the evening/ weekend. Everything transforms and comes alive! The apartment has VERY easy access to trains/trams. Definitely use this to get about.. that and the electric scooters are great fun. The apartment is clean, warm and very cosy! It resides inside a bushy courtyard, full of chirping birds and friendly neighbours. Carsten and Jess are quick to respond to any queries and are both helpful in dishing out recommendations.
All in all, a great stay, thanks

We really enjoyed our stay at Carsten’s place. We were two friends so one of us slept in the lower bunk and another one in the actual bed; the apartment worked well like that too. The neighborhood is really nice.

Nice smaller one room-apartment in the heart of bustling Kreuzburg. Clean and comfy with everything we needed for a Berlin- Weekend. Easy and friendly communication with Carsten and Jessica. While not cheap this was the best offer we found for our 3 days in Berlin.  With two good beds its a fair deal for travelling friends.  Great with refrigirator and a coffemaker in the apartment.  Close to many restaurants and the U-Bahn.  Free parking outside though we had to look around a while to find a spot.  All good on our stay.

Carsten was a friendly and communicative host and we enjoyed our stay at his apartment. The location is awesome and very central to kreuzberg area and to get to historical attractions. Check-in was flexible, which i appreciated! I would stay at this Airbnb again if we were in Berlin.

Great accommodation and location, couldn't fault it. Very tastefully appointed with lots of local information provided. easy access to city centre and local areas.
Be aware there is no parking on Premises as listed.
Due to building work extra parking restrictions are in place.
On arrival we were greeted by a third party, new to Germany and a non driver as it turns out, we asked for clarification on our parking and were assured it was okay as several other cars were also parked in the same clearly restricted area. Unfortunately it wasn't and our car was removed by the police which resulted in a hefty fine.
The third Party was not to blame.
We feel that had our hosts not delegated this would have been avoided.

Very clean and cozy place in a quiet courtyard. I appreciated all the instructions on travel to the apartment and how often they checked in to make sure everything was good. Would very much recommend for a solo or a pair of travelers and will be looking here again on my next trip to Berlin!

- The apartment is super super clean and well furnished!
It is on the ground floor and the windows face to the main entrance so you need to keep the curtains down for the privacy so the apartment remains a little bit darker but it is not a big problem.
