- Nice equipped kitchen but with no cooking hob.
- Confortable bed.
- Close to a supermarket and bus station.
- The area is very quite.
The stay was very nice, the apartment is higly reccomended! ✅
Carsten's property was a really great space, really comfortable. the location was perfect for us, about a 5 min walk from the underground stations, so very easy to get anywhere. would recommend.

Carsten's place was quite comfortable, as I hoped it would be. I felt as if I were a visitor, not a "tourist." The neighborhood has much to offer. I had planned on buying a multi-day BVG (public transport) ticket, but there were so many things to do within walking distance that I only needed tickets to and from the airport.

Such a great place! Loved staying here, beautiful area that the flat is located and the flat is so cute. Communication was great and Jessica made sure everything was perfect. Would definitely recommend to anyone staying in Berlin :)

The apartment was in a good location where we were able to walk around to places or take the metro elsewhere. We had some difficulty and inflexibility with check in where our ETA was off by an hour due to unforeseen circumstances which made it confusing with check in where we had to coordinate with a friend of the owner. Otherwise we enjoyed our stay.

Jessica and Carsten are great hosts, very friendly and flexible, they kindly allowed me an earlier checkin. There’s everything you need in their place. Wifi was great for remote working. The location is very nice as it is central but in a quiet area.

Wonderful stay in Kreuzberg! The Airbnb was very cozy and had everything we needed, including being conveniently located by public transportation. Will definitely be staying here again on our next Berlin trip!
A great place to stay in Berlin. Quiet neighborhood, close to trains and subway. Beautiful view from the window. And most importantly a wonderful host. Sigrid, thank you!

I really enjoyed my stay at Sigrid's. Her house is perfectly located, just 15 mins walk from the Sudkreutz station. She was a very nice and respecting host, even helped me with my luggage on the staircase. Highly recommended to everybody!

Mina is amazing and attentive. She will make sure your stay goes as well as possible. The AirBnB is perfect for a couple. Has an enclosed and locked courtyard, which makes you feel safe. Very close to the U-Bahn, which makes this an accessible stay to anywhere in Berlin. Highly recommend for first time travelers to the area!
I was able to experience a clean accommodation at a reasonable price. Thank you for your quick response! I recommend it
The location of the house was very nice. Mina replied quickly. It was very helpful. The house was very clean and spacious. If I come again I would stay here

Mina’s place was great, about an hour 15 minute walk into the city centre but still in a lovely area. The apartment we had everything we needed and the outdoor area is lovely, would definitely stay again :)
We had a good stay at Mina’s place. The place was comfortable and nice. We had some extra requests and that was taken care of right away. We are grateful for that.

Very basic but adequate. Great for the price. Transit was very close and easy to use. It felt safe walking to the grocery and transit at dark. Mina was very responsive to my questions. I would recommend staying here if you are on a tight budget.

Mina was very responsive and understanding.I stayed here for Boston Marathon weekend.The place have a calm and relaxed vibe.Great night sleep.
Being only 2 mins from the UG train station made it ideal to explore different parts of the city.
Highly recommend and would definitely recommend
Quick shout to Rumi was very helpful made check in and check out seamless
Thanks Mina

We stayed two nights and had a great time in Berlin Neukölln. Taissa was a very friendly and helpful host. The apartment is great and lovely furnished, with a great sense for small details. The place has good access to shops, restaurants, cafes and public transport. We were able to walk most places. Thanks again for having us!

Jan's place was fantastic. it was well stocked & was in excellent proximity to restaurants, friendly locals & close to public transport
definitely a place to consider for those wanting to visit Berlin.

We felt right at home at Jan and Taissa's place.  Their friend met us when we arrived earlier than check in time and showed us all around the apartment.  It is a very comfortable place and off the rear garden courtyard, so it was very quiet and felt safe, though on the ground floor.  The apartment has a big kitchen (with high counters - great for taller people) with most everything you need, though we didn't cook as we ate out every night.  The bed and linens were perfect.  We also were able to check out late because the cleaners were coming the next day.  We would happily stay here again.  Thank you, Jan and Taissa, for a wonderful stay.

Comfortable and perfectly maintained room for 2-3 guests with a private well equipped large kitchen, bathroom and terrace. Location at the city border close to the airport, bus connection and plenty free parking spots available. Host Petra is absolutely charming and helpful, we enjoyed our stay!

My stay at Petra's home was very good. A very nice place to stay in, very confortable, with lots of love and attention to detail everywhere. Perfect for disconnecting from the city for a few days. There's a cute forest only a block away, which was gorgeous to visit in this time of the year. You can even go to the lake walking!
It was also pretty accessible from the city. With just an U-Bahn and a taxi I got there from the city center in 45 minutes.
My only observation is that the rented house is behind the owner's main house. They both share the same front yard entrance, with some distance between the two houses but no private garden for the back house. It was a little different from what I understood from the pictures and the translated description. With that said, it wasn't really an issue, I didn't see the owner or their family at all.
The small house was great and very clean, we enjoyed eating breakfast with the birds whistling outside :) There were bus stations nearby, which made it easy to get to the S-bahn and Berlin center.

cozy and comfortable house
near to the airport
Petra was so friendly
we enjoyed our stay here

Lovely and peaceful little place for a romantic getaway. Place was really clean and kitchen very well equipped. Would be perfect for longer stay, but was also lovely for the weekend we spent there. Thank you Petra!

A beautiful house behind the host house in the garden. They set up some trees to isolate the environment so you won`t trouble each other. I really recommend this property if you prefer a peaceful life.

It was a pleasant stay in Petra place. Easy to check in and the place is clean and beautiful with nice garden. For one additional point, Petra was so kind to arrange the pick-up for the suits I forgot to take away. That was much appreciated.

Very good quality mattress, great layout of the apartment, excellent sound proofing of the windows. Location is a dream, so well communicated with U-bahn, S-Bahn, Tram. Staff at reception is amongst the friendliest and most helpful I ever met on all my travels. Great selection of restaurants, breakfast places, suggested by the host.
Availability provided, I will definitely look into staying here again on a next visit.

Modern and stylish interior design with a great view of the park and Berlin Tower. The apartment is right at the hub of subway, train and tram which facilitate the visitor to get around different places in Berlin.
Very cute little space within a quick uber or ferry ride to the main city. We loved the free laundry access and being able to explore the Noord neighborhood.
A very good place for a short stay.The location is also very very good connected.Very quite and comfortable.I enjoyed staying at Dirk's place and i'd pretty much recommend it.
Really nice location! The communication went well and the appartement was really clean. Had a really nice stay
Location Great, Dirk Great!  Too much long hair in bathroom and sinks and bathtub drain very slow, hated standing in my shower water.  Elevator! Location! Dirk!  Great

This Air BnB is better in real life than the pictures! So light and spacious, perfect for two. We enjoyed dinners on the balcony and hot baths in the evening - bed was comfortable and large, and would not hesitate to stay here again. Located near many restaurants and cafes. This place had all amenities for a comfortable and dare I say slightly luxurious stay!
Had a great stay here! Dirk gave very clear instructions for check in and we found the location to be a perfect balance of close to transport/attractions but also quiet and comforting.

Very nice high quality apartment with a very good location (e.g., S-bahn station, Bahnhof Nord on the opposite side of the road) shops and restuarants nearby. The reception was manned everyday until 5 p.m. The was a bit of rumble (noise) from the U-bahn below the building. However, we quickly adjusted to this.

A very clean and well equipped apartment which is very close to the train station and trams so it’s easy to get to all of the main sites . Good restaurants close by , we’d definitely recommend Cho Chu a lovely reasonably priced Vietnamese restaurant .
The only slight downside is that there is some noise from the trams
Great location, access to public transit. Room is clean and in style. Our family enjoyed a good time during our stay in Berlin.
Great aparment, nice, very clean, as described. Will defintley consider coming back when in Berlin.

Fantastic modern apartment in Mitte Berlin. Right next to a couple public transportation lines so getting around was easy! We also utilized the parking pass option, and that was easy as well.
Recommend if you are wanting to stay in Berlin!

The Downtown Apartments are modern, spacious and extremely well designed. The fit out is exceptional and the whole apartment very well equipped. We just loved it, very comfortable and homely. The attention to detail can’t be faulted. A 10/10 from us. We highly recommend the properties. Cheers Darren, Karen, Madison and Ebony.

Modern apartment close to downtown. Nice building, location, amenities, but beware of staying in the summer. Only one of the bedrooms has air-conditioning, and we found the non-air-conditioned room to be very hot and with limited airflow, even with a fan. While you can open the door/window (which welcomes in mosquitoes), the smell of cigarette smoke and noise from the bar compounded to make it pretty difficult to sleep in the evenings.

Everything here is super.  Clean, efficient, friendly.  The apartment / studio has everything you need. Small but very modern, very comfortable and tons of storage space.  Fully equipped kitchen.  Great location.  Check in staff super friendly and helpful.
Another amazing stay at DT Apartments. This was our second year in a row there, has consistently been great and we will be back again!

Beautiful home and space. I had a great stay and would definitely stay here again if I come back to Berlin! the check in and check out process was smooth and hassle free. lots of good food around the apartment.

very convenient location, modern flat with comfortable beds and well equipped kitchen, when we were missing something, staff got it within hours. Great amd friendly service, super communication and easy to reach by car or public transport. Clear recommendation!

Very good stay. Apartment is beautiful, big, clean, very comfortable e has everything you need. Exactly like the photos. The location is good, close to the public transportation, markets and some restaurants. Staff very nice too.
We loved the apartment that was clean, and didnt have a single flaw. we loved stating there. only minus was the area it was located in but it was still worth the nice appartment

What a great property!  The apartment was very comfortable and had everything we needed for a great stay.  In a culturally diverse neighborhood (with a good bakery), the links to transportation were wonderful and we were able to get to locations all over Berlin in minutes.  We even made it to Potsdam.  There is a grocery very close to the apartment and the rail line!

Our group couldn’t be happier with our stay. The accommodations were spotless with thoughtful amenities throughout. The unit was stylishly designed and very comfortable. We appreciated the blackout curtains, the balconies and all of the space for our group of four. We would love to stay again.

lovely apartment like new.
A bit a walk the city but the train is easy to use and just around the corner.
Nice walk to restaurants.
could do with an ice cube tray!!!
Great accommodation and really helpful! Allowed us to check in late and also allowed us to keep our bags there whilst we explored on our last day! Shower and bed also super comfortable!

My husband, 7 y/o son and I stayed at Downtown Apartment in Wedding. We had a comfortable 12 days stay, my husband working from the apartment with good working WiFi, the apartment had everything we needed for our stay. Modern amenities, laundry in the basement and friendly staff. Wedding was for us a perfect location supermarket close by, the S/U Bahn are very accessible that we were able to go anywhere see/visit families and friends within minutes including easy connection to Flughafen Express! Definitely an option for us to stay at on our next visit to Berlin. Highly recommend.

Mathias and his family are extremely friendly and attentive. Mathias always willing to respond quickly and help with everything. The space is small, but extremely clean, practical and comfortable. The neighborhood is friendly and familiar,  the location is very convenient also for tourists. Obrigada!

Small but absolutely wonderful apartment and very kind host. The neighborhood is gorgeous and there is so much to do and see. Restaurants and cafés nearby as well as shops and supermarkets. Definitely recommend this apartment and host, you will have an amazing time! 😊 Absolutely coming back!!
The location is phenomenal, and the flat,  while a bit small, was perfect for our stay.  I will definitely look to stay in the future!

This could be a 5 stars stay (location is great), however, although there is a bed in the apartment, we could only use the sofa bed which was highly uncomfortable and there was no decent pillows.
We consider this apartment too expensive for what it offers.

Mathias was a very helpful host and really paid attention to us.
The restaurants in the neighborhood were all so good - we did not even have to commute to eat amazing food!

We had a really good time. Mathias’ place is situated in a quiet area of the city but there is lots going on. We also found it easy to get around, using the superb public transport system. The bars and restaurants in the area were extremely good. We loved it!

My friend and I stayed in Berlin for three nights. We were out for the days but spent our evenings in the apartment! It was a beautiful apartment, that was a walking distance from the city center. The apartment had everything we needed. It is in a safe area and the host was very reliable!

Maria was very accommodating, helpful and communicated regularly.  Apartment was very bright and airy and very much as advertised; very near shops and cafes of Prenzlauer Berg and tram to Alexanderplatz outside the door.

We stayed for 3 days and 2 nights at Michael place and we have also traveled with our dog. The place is new and there is still work in process, it has a really nice bakery close by and also the train station is 5 minutes walking and the trains are running all the time. The staff was really friendly and gave fast solutions when asking for help. All in all the place is good value for the money.

There was a hiccup when we arrived. Our 3 person room was given to another person. However, Michael was very quick in arranging for us to have other rooms temporarily before we get our originally booked room the next day.
The room was exactly as pictured. However, the towels and blankets were rather dirty (found hair).
The place has no lift, so it was rather inconvenient for us as we had multiple luggages. Would be more suitable for those who have light baggages.
A very clean and comfortable option, close to the metro station (either S-bahn as well as U-bahn), good price-quality relationship and all the features worked really great.

The place is situated close to the U-bahn going directly to Alexander Platz. The room for three was well equipped with a kitchenette, very comfortable beds, quilts and pillows. The bathroom was great. Everything was clean and the owners and staff were friendly and helpful. There was very little noise from other rooms, although the road next to the place was noisy when the windows were open, as could be expected. Great value for the price.
Great place to stay at! Beautiful and spacious, and Jurgen and his son are great hosts.
This stay was ever better than I expected! Really amazing from every Aspect! Jürgen is very welcoming and very nice :)

Our experience at jürgens home was incredible. Jürgen helped us with checking in as we was delayed at the airport and the communication was great with the host. The apartment was beautiful and in the best location. It was clean and comfortable. The energy was great and I highly recommend staying here for everyone especially couples. Thanks for a wonderful stay.

Jürgen’s place is awesome, very comfy room and your own bathroom! Jürgen is super responsive and a friendly host, and gives you privacy too. The neighborhood is beautiful and really well connected. I recommend it!

A beautiful building and apartment. Jurgen was easy to communicate with and always responsive to messages.
He was there to welcome us and made us feel at home. A very comfortable bed and a bathroom next door for our use only.
It was a quiet and safe neighbourhood with easy transport links all over the city.
As we had a late flight, Jurgen very kindly let us leave our bags there until late afternoon, which meant we could enjoy our last day out.
If we visit Berlin again, we would certainly feel happy booking again.

We were warmly welcomed at Jürgen's home. The room was large, modern, spotless and very comfortable. The bathroom was very clean and modern. We knew the neighbourhood had great restaurants galore and was why we selected the area as well as its proximity to all Berlin has to offer. We would definitely stay with Jürgen again!
Thank you Jürgen! It was a beautiful place. We love Berlin so much and this beautiful home! Everything is very clean ☺️ Good location too! Delicious bakery nearby the home too!

I had a really good time in Jürgen's lovely apartment - a hidden gem. The communication was clear and fast and the apartment clean and cosy. I immediatelly felt at home. Jürgen is an amazing host and an insightful and open-minded person to talk to. There is a nice view from balcony and the neighborhood is great: quiet but many nice restaurants, cafes and markets close by.

Jurgen is a most welcoming and helpful host who made us feel right at home. He communicates very well and quickly, and has plenty of suggestions as to where to visit and where to eat. His home is in a super location handy to everything.

Gorgeous home very welcoming to all. Grateful to stay in such a lovely building and location. The place had a very homely feel to it with a beautiful balcony terrace. Heaps of cafes, restaurants and bars just walking distance from the apartment. Would recommend.

i absolutely love my stay at jürgen's place! it was a 10-15 mins walk to kadewe (one of the most popular malls in berlin) and 20 mins or less to the historical landmarks of berlin. it was also located in a safe residential area which made me feel very safe walking at night. the house was gorgeous (especially with the christmas decorations), and i had my own private bathroom. the room was spacious and had all the listed amenities. i would 10/10 recommend this place and would stay again!

Jürgen’s place is defo one of the best bnbs I’ve ever stayed. I like the calm area, and you got everything you need during your stay in Berlin.
Jürgen is very helpful, always responsive, cared about the guests needs :)
Great place! Amazing owner. We would love to come back! Highly recommend it to everybody👌👌👌

Everything was as presented on the pictures. Our host is very sweet and caring person, who responds always & quick. We felt very comfortable and can absolutely recommend Penelope and the flat. Thank you very much for a very pleasant stay.

This is a really well located place in a very quiet neighborhood, just a few blocks from a major bus route. There is a vibrant neighborhood with lots of places to eat and drink, and a grocery very close and smaller markets.
The apartment was perfect for the two of us, and we really appreciated the kitchen for breakfasts and having a washing machine. It was very close to our daughter’s place. We had a very enjoyable stay!

Great host, very helpful.
The use of space is awesome. We had everything we need and then some 😁.
The garden/patio is lovely.
The location was great for exploring Neukölln and Berlin in general.
It was the perfect fit and I hope it's free next time we're in Berlin.

Great Airbnb and host! Penelope was super clear and helpful! The apartment is comfortable and completely beautiful (we're seriously in love with the sofa). Everything was perfect only the bed is not very big/the mattress is a bit uncomfortable (too used in the middle) and the toilet wasn't super well cleaned.
Thanks for everything!

My parents were very happy staying at Penelope's house. The place was great and felt as relaxing as home. Communication was attentive and clear. Thank you, Penelope, for hosting us. We would love to come back!
Penelope was a great host. Always responded quickly to questions. The apartment is very comfortable and stayed cool even on very hot days.
Very professional and responsive! And made sure we had everything we needed and specially paid attention to cleaning as requested! Highly recommended

Daniel's place was exactly like the photos, the location was great and the amenities were wonderful. There was coffee available for our first morning, there was shampoo and conditioner available, the hair dryer worked well and the location was walkable. Daniel was very responsive to messages. We decided to rent a car at the last minute and I messaged Daniel about parking. He responded promptly with information. We will definitely stay here again when visiting Berlin!
Excellent location and a very quiet, relaxing apartment! So pleased we chose this place for my father, me and my son!

The appartment was great, clean, more stylish than I expected, located in a vibrant part of Berlin. There were many cool coffee shops, bars, small parcs close by. The host replied very quickly to any questions.
Unfortunately there was one downside - even though the flat was located in a quiet part of Kreuzberg, the neighbours were quite loud at night (music & loud conversations) which made it very hard to fall asleep.

AMAZING!
Brilliant location! Close to cool quirky bars! Easy to get around everywhere on foot.
the flat is great, spacious, fresh, beautiful colours and atmosphere!
So safe and secure - check in was easy!
Caroline also gave us a huge list of bars, clubs, restaurants, and cool places near and around Berlin. This made our trip!
Apartament was nice and clean. We enjoyed our stay. Great communication and service. Thank you for everything definitely I’ll be back 100% recommend

Nice small apartment close to the U-bahn.
Check in and check out worked very smoothly.
this apartment is on a very nice location and it's very big and clean. Would love to stay here again sometime!

The apartment was fantastic, in a great area, clean and perfect for a stay. Ulf was very welcoming and provided lots of useful info and recommendations and was extremely helpful. Couldn’t recommend more. Thanks!

Ulf and Caroline were very accommodating hosts and their property is in a very young and vibrant part of the city. The apartment is on the top floor and has great views over the skyline. However, it’s important to note that that means there are four floors of stairs you will need to climb. Overall I had a very good stay and would recommend this property.
Caroline and Ulf were great hosts! Very communicative, responsive, and flexible. We appreciated our stay in this lovely apartment and lovey neighbourhood. Made for a memorable Berlin trip!
Very nice appartement in great location! I reccomend to stay there everybody who want to spend some quality time in Berlin!

Great stay - definetely recommended.
Perfect location, very close to a lot of nice shops, restaurants and bars in Kreuzberg + very stylish and spacious place.
In addition the communication incl. check-in/out instructions were super smooth and clear.
We really enjoyed our time.

Ulf’s place was really nice. The check in process was very well communicated and I had no problems, the location in the absolute best in Berlin, and the place itself was very comfortable, clean, and quiet. So good I booked it twice!
Stayed at Kevin and Caroline's for a long weekend with my partner. The space was perfect for the 2 of us and the location was in the center of everything we wanted to do. Can't wait to return.

Kevin and Caroline are nice hosts. The apartment was very spacious, very clean and located in a nice neighborhood close to public transport. There are also cool record stores, vintage shops and restaurants closeby. Would really recommend this place in one of the best parts of Berlin.
Great air bnb, in a peaceful and quiet and trendy area although still walking distance to the hustle and bustle. Easy check in and check out with clear instructions. Would reccomend!

One reason we picked this location was because of other recommendations which said that the bed was very comfortable, so we were happy to find that it was! Slept wonderfully. Occasionally it can be noisy outside, but it rarely lasts for long. We loved the neighborhood, which was near public transportation and lots of great pubs and restaurants.
Amazing location!! Great place to stay in. Attentive and responsive hosts. Would recommend.⭐️😊😊

Definitely in a great location and a typical Berlin apartment. Loved the comfortable bed! The bathroom didn’t smell too wonderful, and guests shouldn’t expect anything ‘upmarket’. I found it exactly as expected, but  then I know the area rather well and have often stayed in similar Altbauten.

Kevin and Caroline were very kind and responsive hosts. They made our group feel welcome and made the check-in and check-out process really easy!
Their place was also beautiful!

Kevin was a great host! The place was clean and as described in the pictures. The communication was through Caroline; who was very responsive and clear with all matters about the apartment. Thank you both for a lovely stay!

We had a lovely stay and the apartment is perfect for a couple.  Light and airy with a very comfortable bed.  Great location in the heart of Kreuzberg, easy to get around and a Bio supermarket on the corner.  The apartment provided everything we needed for our stay.
A great stay in central Berlin. It was a perfect location. The accommodations were clean and comfortable.
Great apartment in a great location.  We were a little Concerned about it being attached to a hotel, but that ended up being a non-issue and we loved it.

It was a very nice apartment with a lot of privacy because of the seperate entrance for the apartments (its part of a hotel/apartmentbuilding). It is spacious. Both rooms have their own bathroom. Also with a big kitchen!
We stayed in a 2 bedroom. For the price you pay it is worth it. They sent a welcome gift, housekeeping speak little English but they do what you ask. Facilities are super.

Very good experience. Friendly staff and great location. The apartment was absolutely clean and had all the things required for a short family stay. We had our dogs traveling with us and everyone was super friendly with them as well.

This is an exceptional BnB.  It is located within a hotel so you have ALL the benefits of a terrifically private BnB AND the amenities of a hotels staff 24/7. The BnB is very modern, exceptional clean (with daily maid service), a TV that gets many American speaking channels. I could go on and on. Suffice it to stay we would ABSOLUTELY stay here again should our travels take us to Berlin.

We would give this property 4.4 Stars. It’s a 2-bedroom hotel room with a kitchen and washing machine (detergent not provided). While there is not the charm and character of a “personal” AirBnB, it’s an efficient, comfortable place to stay, and the benefit of housekeeping is great. It felt like a quiet, residential neighborhood, and getting to and from the apartment with our car was easy. Note that the Air Conditioning is turned off by the building once it determines that the “summer season” has past. It was unseasonably warm when we visited, and we had to contact AirBnB to help us get the AC turned on. While there is not an abundance of kitchen supplies, we managed to cook basic meals with the tools provided.

Lovely place. Really clean, a good size, quiet and cosy. The most useful local station (Zoologischer Garten) is 15 mins walk away but that wasn't really a problem for us. Delicious food in the restaurant and friendly (multilingual) staff. Would happily stay again.
Probably the most impressive AirBnB I've ever been to in this price range! Perfect apt. with a gym, sauna and pool on premise, I will definitely return when I'm in Berlin again!

A great and practical stay for families and dog lovers. Great location and facility (access to the pool and sauna is a big plus), easy to walk to the next U-Bahn station/public transport, great restaurants around. The place has all you need for a pleasant and comfortable stay. We'll be back for sure.

The residence is part of a hotel.  It worked perfectly for my colleague and I while we attended a conference and was a much better value than nearby hotels.   The rooms were clean and the location is very convenient.  We'll likely stay again next year when we return for the same conference.

We have just returned home from a 2 nights stay in Berlin. We lived in an apartment with 2 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms. Everything was very clean and organized. Was a little bit disappointed that the coffee maker was not a Nespresso as written in the description. But we bought some instant coffee instead and survived 😉 All the personal we talked with was very nice and helpful. They even let us eat breakfast even though the breakfast time was over. They also had a nice option called a green card. If you skip cleaning for a day you get a EUR 10 which you can use in the bar and restaurant.
All in all a very nice stay at SANA Berlin. We will come again next time we visit 😊

Nice apartment. We enjoyed That it’s in a hotel so you get the amenities and room cleaning that an Airbnb doesn’t typically provide. Just know they will charge you a tourist fee when you leave that’s not included in your Airbnb price.

Great location, Schoneberg adjacent, 1 minute walk to 1 metro station and 4 minute walk to another metro station. This is actually a hotel and they AirBnB these 2 bedrooms, 2 baths apartments. there's housekeeping everyday, washer/dryer combo, fridge, dishwasher, etc. Great AC, very quiet as the facilities are new. the beds are comfortable and clean. Great experience. Would def stay again. SANA is also a chain hotel based in Portugal they told me.
We had a lovely stay at Sana Berlin Residence. The appartement is very spacious and quiet. You can rent a bike and explore Berlin by bike.

the best of both worlds!  A fabulous apartment with the facilities of a great hotel!  The apartment was a brilliant choice for us an our adult son, loved using the 7th floor small pool and spa facilities and found the reception staff very helpful.  The area was fab with only 10 mins walk to tiergarten and great bars.  Its a lovely walk into berlin through the tiergarten - about an hour or the public transport sytem is fab, we got a tybe into the medievel town of Spandau.  All in all a great stay, many thanks

Great location and great service from the staff.
Only thing is that there are limited car parking spaces.

We stayed here very recently.
The reception staff were incredibly friendly and helpful.
The hotel was within walking distance of fantastic transport links to Berlin.
Overall, we had a wonderful stay here and would highly recommend SANA Residences.
Sana is best, close to everything you need. The place feels like home. Everything is perfect.

Extremely comfortable and convenient in all regards.
Benefits of an apartment with the amenities of a hotel.
Close to many restaurants and easy to get around.
Definitely would recommend and repeat.
Rented a spacious space, it was perfect for relaxation, especially liked the spa and the 2 bathrooms in the suite.

Fantastic apt, just like in the pics and the pool/sauna/gym were marvelous additions! It is not managed by a person, but by a company - kinda unlike the 'usual' airbnbs, but no complaints. The only things that bummed us was collection of a city tax at the end, albeit a small amount, but was only mentioned in the house manual once (and that too not the exact price) and you wouldn't see it if not looking for it.
My stay at the Berlin accommodation was fantastic. The place was immaculately clean and beautifully decorated, providing a comfortable and enjoyable experience.

We really liked the 2 bedroom, 2 bathroom apartment at the SANA Hotel. Great location, walkable and only 1/2 block to the subway. Berlin has so much to see.
We had a great stay - the staff were always pleasant and helpful.
Very spacious for the price, good location near restaurants, shopping, and transit, comfortable beds. Nice for an extended stay!

Great place to stay for the following reasons:
1. Clean, and quiet, apartments
2. Good transport links nearby
3. And finally, the real stars of the show, the staff. Whether it's the morning, afternoon, or evening shift, you're greeted with a friendly smile and all the help you need.
The area is a bit non-descript, but that shouldn't worry you because it's easy to reach the 'Berlin vibe' very quickly on the transport system.

This was a generous sized suite within a hotel, and was well priced for 2 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms, and came with all the hotel amenities (which we didn't have time to use).  The location is close to many forms of public transport so easily commutable to other neighbourhoods.

For our long weekend in Berlin with our niece the apartment at SANA was perfect. It was quite central and the staff were always available, friendly and helpful.
We do like a nice bathroom and the apartment did not disappoint.
As the weather was exceptionally nice, we also appreciated the air conditioning.

I highly recommend this accommodation for travelers coming to Berlin.
The accommodation was really spacious and clean. It was enough for 3 people to stay or big enough for up to 4 people.
The receptionists were very friendly and had no communication problems. Although the pool was a little small and didn't feel clean, if you enjoy swimming, try it.
There was a subway within 10 minutes, so it was good to move to the center.
There are marts and restaurants around the hotel. If I come to Berlin next time, I will stay here again !!!

beautiful appartment close to shops and restaurants. walkable to train and underground. only dissappointment was pool was very small and TV had limited englush channels. i was unavle to screen share on my phone either. receprion were really helpful and friendly.

This is one of the best Airbnb places I have stayed at. It's a hotel listed as Airbnb. The room is spacious, the staff is super friendly and the bathrooms look very modern. We came around Christmas time, so there's a Christmas market within 15 minutes. It's close to metro stations. The staff was so friendly and offered us a sample of mulled wine one night. I highly recommend it.
Great suite in a hotel. Has a nice pool and sauna area. Also has a nice workout area. Not too far from the subway so easy to get downtown. We enjoyed our stay and would recommend!

We had a wonderful stay at Berlin SANA Residence! Everything was great. Clean, modern apartment to the friendly service. The location is absolutely amazing! Close to everything yet quiet enough to relax. We truly enjoyed our time here and would definitely stay again. Highly recommended!
Great stay to visit Berlin with the Family. Very clean apartment. The communication was proactive. Very close to many sights. Anytime again.
Excellent stay. Very spacious accommodation with clean comfortable bedding. Toiletries included were lovely. Would recommend to anyone.

Apartment within a hotel, best of two worlds. Squeaky clean and daily service. Reception is available for any question. Breakfast (very good) is available if wanted.
Unlike many Airbnb the kitchen has limited basic supplies for cooking. It didn’t bother me at all as had no intention of eating in.
The apartment is very very warm even with the heating fully off.

Lovely accommodation and a super staffing team, cleaners thourough and reception and bar staff really friendly and helpful.  Easy access to public transport.  very clean and safe.  Would definitely stay again.

This accommodation gives you the best of both worlds, with a fantastic apartment and then all the services and convenience of a good hotel. The apartment was spacious, modern, comfortable, had fantastic showers, and was spotlessly clean. The hotel is very smart with a nice bar and friendly staff. Multiple transport options nearby, and quiet leafy streets around. Was really pleased to have picked this accommodation, and would definitely stay again!

Stayed in a 2 bed apartment with teen son. Excellent all round - well equipped kitchen, super clean with housekeeping each day,  easy to get everywhere either by walking or metro opposite.  The pool and gym were a great bonus.  We didn’t bother with breakfast which seemed expensive at €25pp.  Lots of places nearby, and a REWE supermarket for groceries.

Was even better than expected. Spacious rooms with ample storing, cleaned every day. Only 50 m from the next Metro station. The apartment is part of a hotel and hence you can use all their facilities.
Great place to stay with a family for our stay in Berlin. Conveniently located to subway stops for full access to the city.

We loved our stay, after a few weeks of travelling it was nice to stay in a hotel but with all the benefits of an apartment. We found the rooms clean and agreeable, the two bathrooms were appreciated and loved that we could bathe our toddler in the bath. Close to trains, and the pool was lovely. Would return!

Excellent 2 bed contemporary apartment as part of an apartment hotel so has the convenience of check in etc. Apartment is spacious and clean and pretty quiet. Location is close to metro station for easy access to all downtown tourist locations.

My stay at SANA Berlin was really great, enjoyed it! The staff were super polite, friendly, and always ready to help. The room was comfortable and spotless, which made the stay even better.
Would definitely come back next time I’m in Berlin! :)

This was for my mom and I, which was perfect as we both had our own rooms and bathrooms. The kitchen was great for breakfast and lunches. We went out for dinners each night which is 5/6/7 min walk from the hotel. Italian/ Spanish and Turkish all great meals - good food and service.
We had drinks in the bar first night.
All the staff were friendly and helpful.
Very quiet room, slept very well.
We will book again.
Great place to stay- it’s the coolest neighborhood in Berlin, and I had a great time there.  Would definitely recommend.

I had a great stay at Andreas’ place. It is very well situated in Neukölln, in a very lively neighbourhood. The place in itself is very quiet as it is on the back of the building. Be prepared for lots of steps though but it is worth it :-)

Andreas is a lovely and helpful host who accommodated us very well. We really enjoyed staying in his modern and trendy apartment. We found the location great and enjoyed the bars / restaurants and bakeries nearby and it was easy to get the metro whenever we needed to (5 min to walk to station).
Thanks again for having us Andreas!

I stayed for almost 12 days and loved this place! It was nice having a private apartment, with plenty of space, a nice view, and lots of quiet. The location is perfect, walkable to a ton and close to U Bahn lines.

We loved our stay at this beautiful mini-apartment in a cool & lively neighbourhood--a great base from which to explore Berlin. Andreas was so communicative and helpful with local recommendations. Thanks Andreas!

Perfect for our weeklong stay! The apartment is in a very nice part of Berlin, with lots of good restaurants nearby. Andreas gave us a list of tips, with which we could've filled our entire vacation. 10/10 would sleep here again!

Loved our stay at Andreas’s loft! Super clean, nicely decorated and very comfortable bed.
Funky area we felt really safe in! Lots of cool bars and really great restaurants within 2 minutes walking distance.
Public transport also super close by which was important for our time in Berlin.
There are 11 flights of stairs to get to the room - which, no real bother to us, but may be worth considering if this might be difficult for you!
Would absolutely stay again!
Kathrin was really warm and welcoming. The space was very homey and clean, even in the shared areas, and the location is great.
Very cozy and never meet a hostess like Kathrin so friendly so open so nice! Definitely recommend

My staying was perfect. Kathrin is a very good host, she is kind and she is attentive to her guests, she gave me suggestions about the city, where to have italian coffee, where to go for a walk...
The hostel is very clean and I love the care for details both in the room and common spaces. It is the perfect staying if you travel alone. Hope to come again.

Kathrin’s hostel is an absolute dream ~ the location is perfect, any kind of food or drink you could want within a five/ten minute walk. The local area is beautiful and made us feel right at home as soon as we got there, plus you can get anywhere in the city easily with a U-Bahn station less than five minutes away. The hostel itself is wonderfully decorated, feels light and spacious and is a great spot to have your morning coffee. Kathrin is an amazing host, super funny, friendly and full of great tips for spots to visit in the city, she made us feel so welcome ~ we were so sad to leave (thank you!). Also really recommend Kissho Sushi just down the road from the hostel for fab sushi and chilled vibes!

Always a pleasure to be hosted by Kathrin! Every room is highly personalized and furnished. Great dedication to details to satisfy any guest’s need. It feels like being at home. Definitely I highly recommend it!

Great place near metro and S~bahn connections, easy and fast communication with host who was super friendy. The hostel was clean and had everything u needed. Other people were friendly too.
I will totally book this for my next visit also. 6/5 recmmond for everyone.

Brilliant place, room, location. Kathrin is so friendly and welcoming, and it is a unique experience of a visit to another country or city because it is like an Airbnb mixed with friendly hostel. Everyone there is very friendly, quiet, open. I will definitely want to come again and recommend it to friends/family to go to Kathrin’s when they visit Berlin. Thank you Kathrin!

Great experience :
- Kathrin is very welcoming and available, it was a pleasure to meet her !
- The hostel is incredibly located in Kreuzberg, near the Spree !
- The hostel is small, with only a few rooms, so it really felt like an apartment !
I warmly recommend it to solo travellers like me :)

Kathrin is a wonderful host, I immediately felt right at home. The common room is sober but tidy and peaceful, the bathrooms are simple but clean, and my room was light and quiet. Everything I needed for my stay in Berlin, a place to settle down and rest after a long day exploring.
I 100% recommend staying with Kathrin, and will definitely book again myself the next time I visit Berlin.

The place was great! Exactly as advertised and Kathrin is a super friendly, forthcoming and helpful host. The location is fantastic as well. Definitely keeping this place in mind when I come to the area again, cheers!
Great location, charming place and a really nice host that will make you feel most welcome! Highly recommended!

The hostel was lovely and clean. the room was perfect for my needs. Kathrin was a friendly and hospitable host - and her son (?) spoke fluent English which was great as my German is very limited.
would highly recommend
Best hostel I’ve ever stayed in and far better than many hotels. Beautiful place with gorgeous and thoughtful features. Really spacious. Wish I could have stayed longer.
If You need a room to feel Berlin's mood - this is a good option. Kathrin is very nice. It's a pity that the room was a little bit dark and not 100% clean.

Great gem in the heart of Kreuzberg. Awesome location. The decor is quintessential Berlin. Comfortable and cozy bed. Our room faced the courtyard overlooking the greenery and was quiet. Kathrin is a great host. Very attentive and responsive. We enjoyed our stay a lot and hope to be back soon!

I would absolutely stay again! Kathrin was so kind and is absolutely worth talking to about the city, chatting with her was a highlight of the visit.
Do yourself a favor and grab a mate from the fridge and people watch for a bit, I had a great time.

Kathrin, our week in Berlin was unique by the sum of many different things on wich Lekkerlaub is fundamental.
We felt like being at home on this unforgettable time.
Thank you for your attention, your contagious smile and for being such a perfect host.
Mariana and Raúl.
Had a great stay in hostel Lekkerurlaub! Kathrin was very friendly and open for questions or a conversation 😁. I loved the neighbourhood and would definitely come back here. Thank you!!

Cecilia and Jarl were fantastic hosts ✨ From the moment we arrived, they made sure to make us feel right at home, as they took the time to show us around the flat and were always available to answer any questions we had throughout our stay. We were offered a very long list of personal recommendations, from places to eat to bars to areas to explore 👌
The accommodation itself is really nice, our room was comfortable and clean, and the view from the 5th floor with the large balcony really makes up for a unique experience in the center of Berlin 🐿️
Finally, Mayo is a touching little creature that will make your heart melt at first sight... We already miss him, and you probably will too if you're as much of a dog lover as we are 🐶

Super nice place! Very quiet neighbourhood yet close to everything, the room is fantastic and the flat is really amazing! Everything was absolutely perfect, the hosts were very attentive and friendly, always available for anything.
Amazing place close to train station and the city center. The apartment is clean and cozy. Cecilia, the host, is really friendly and attentive. Highly recommended!

It was such a pleasure to stay with Cecilia and yaarl. They were so warm and it felt like home away from home ….. we had a great time and definitely feel we also made friends.
If you’re looking for a warm , local experience with value for money with really lovely people then it would be cecilia’s place.
Cecelia and Jarl were the best hosts. We felt like we were visiting friends. Cecelia had the best recommendations of places to eat and things to do. We can't wait to come back and visit them again.
She is so kind and helpful. House is big and clean the bad also very comfortable 10/10
Comfortable, clean and good location for travelling to and from the city centre. Would highly recommend here for your stay in Berlin.

Very spacious, modern, and comfortable apartment - perfect for families and larger groups.  Nice thoughtful touches like the tablet with local recommendations.  Neighborhood is a little scruffy, but has good access to public transportation and not far from Berlin’s central train station…
It's great located place (7 min to metro), with everything you need and more, clean, big and beautiful. We really enjoyed our stay. Hugely recommended.
We had a great stay at the flat. It was exactly as described and very clean. A couple of minor queries were dealt with very promptly and satisfactorily. Thank you!

Great apartement in a good location, provided you use cabs or public transport (which, in a city like Berlin, is unavoidable). We stayed here with 5 guys and had all the comfort we needed. Would love to come back!

Perfect location and nice big apartment near everything you need and very central
Dusan was lovely and very easy to communicate with!
the stay was great. me and my friends stayed here for a week and we liked it a lot. the communication with the host was great, and we didn’t meet any problems along the way.

It was super great and everything was clean and organized, they were both really nice they even told us places to visit and about the best train tickets for tourists. The apartment it’s also very well located.

Dusan was a fantastic host all round, the Airbnb was very clean and had everything we needed; it was exactly how it was described. Sandra, the lady that welcomed us at check-in was very lovely, answered any questions we had and gave us some great recommendations for restaurants and places to go around Berlin.

We had a great stay! The Airbnb was spacious and everything we had hoped for. It was great location from the train station and only a short drive to the main streets in the city. Would definitely recommend
Lovely place, Dusan was very helpful and always available to answer any queries. Would definitely stay again.
Lovely stay in the centre of Berlin with great transport nearby. Airbnb was lovely, felt very spacious and had a nice terrace. Check in was very easy and communication was great!

Great stay in Marlen’s charming apartment. It was spotless and Marlen was a great responsive host, and even organised a flexible check in late at night, which i was very grateful for! Would gladly stay with Marlen again for sure 👍
The air BnB was clean, comfortable and very conveniently situated; exactly as described. Frank provided helpful check-in instructions. We really enjoyed our stay in Berlin!

The apartment is as described. It has all the necessary things to spend a couple of days. Check-in was very easy and the neighborhood is really nice. Metro station is around 6-7 minutes' walk from the apartment. It has a supermarket just 2-3 minutes walking distance as well.  I would recommend it for 1 or max 2 people.
Very nice and clean appartement in a quiet street but close to lots of nice restaurants, bars, supermarket and public transport. Perfectly located to visit Berlin and the bed is really comfortable!:)
the place was just as described and fitted our needs for this trip perfectly. close to public transportation, and very easy to get to the center. it was a lovely stay!

My partner and I have stayed in Frank's place before and we were were glad it was available for our trip this year. We would definitely stay again. Clean, convenient area, friendly communication. Thanks again Frank x
Very beautiful and cozy apartment, great distance from the metro station and walking distance from great restaurants and bars.

we spent 5 days in Berlin, Leo's room is perfect to explore the city. clean, cozy, quiet, very comfortable and next to tram train and subway station. communication with Leo is quick and helpful, check in very easy. I definetely recomend it!!!

This place is very suitable for a couple or two close friends as the place is small, however, very nicely decorated and clean. It is possible to walk to the city centre and if you don't want to do this, the subway is close by.  Thanks for the prompt and clear communication Leo.
Leo’s place is awesome, it is exactly as pictured and really conveniently located. Leo is a fantastic host and is very quick to respond to help with any questions.

Fantastic location, close to transport and very walkable. Flat was exactly as described. We were lucky enough to find a parking for free, and only had to wait a few minutes. Quick tip: spots should be easier to find on Saturday morning, as there were tons available when we left. If we return, we would be happy to stay again.
Leo and Alan were really kind! The apartment is small but very cozy and super clean! The location of the apartment is perfect to get around Berlin. Definitely would stay there again!

Nice and clean apartment. The area was quite and easy to reach the U Bahn.
Leo was good at communicating before, during and after our stay

We had a great time at Leo’s place! It was very clean and comfortable, and it was close to metro and tram stops. There were a lot of nice restaurants and bars close by and it was fun to stay in a less touristy neighborhood to get a better feel for Berlin.

Perfect for a quick trip to Berlin. Conveniently by transit (U5 will get you to many tourist spots), restaurants/cafes, and a park that has a farmer’s market and flea market on the weekend. The sink pressure was a bit strong and the power went out for a few hours (not in anyone’s control), but all things considered I would absolutely stay here again. Leo is great host!
We really enjoyed our stay at Leo’s place in Berlin. Was close to a metro station which made it easy to get around, and it was also within walking distance to nice restaurants and bars.
Nice small apartment - perfect for a visit of 2-3 people in Friederichsheim.
The space was very chill and had a very central location. Richard was very easily reached and patient even when I locked myself out of the flat.  Terrific spot all in all

We loved this apartment! It is walking distance from Checkpoint Charlie. It’s the apartment of a musician with guitars on the wall, and keyboard in the corner. The apartment is very sunny with a nice patio. And Richard is awesome! We arrived a little earlier than check in so he allowed us in a little early and out a little late. Everything was nicely decorated. Even nicer than the photos in my opinion. Would definitely stay here again!
The interior space is amazing but outside it's quite scary, also the window room it's too close to the waste place, so everyday by 7am there are too much noise. For a short stay worth it.
Location is good. Slow/no internet. Bedside TV doesn't work. Can be loud as noise isolation is not that good. Overall okay and good value for money!

Great stay in the apartment in Kreuzberg, Berlin. Close to the U-bahn station and to cozy shops and restaurants.
The apartment was perfectly cleaned at the arrival.
It is a very loud apartment, and you can hear many noises from the hall and street, also during the night. Otherwise there is nothing bad to say about this Airbnb.

The place is really lovely, clean and tidy high ceilings and very unique!
Had a few problems with check-in but barhbain was very helpful and answered all our questions with great communication!
Good location!
We are very grateful for service, the flat was comfortable and clean. Not far from the apartment are many restaurants, cafes and public transport.

Airbnb is located in good area, nearby are bars, restaurants, cafe, which is great. Everything was fine expect the noise on the street, but we were aware of it based on the reviews. Honestly it wasn’t as bad as we  expected. I recommend.
Great and very tidy and clean apartment! Everything you may need is already there. Checkin and checkout are perfect, Wibke is always available. Enjoyed our staying in Berlin!

Had a wonderful stay! Location is really great if you don’t want to be dead in the middle of the city, it’s roughly 15/20 minutes train ride away which is perfect. The place itself was very very clean and tidy, we found there was everything we needed. Communication with the host was excellent, very quick to reply, provided us with all the information about check in/out that we needed and was there to help. Would highly recommend!
Wibke was super accommodating and extremely responsive. Super generous with his space and helpful in every situation. And awesome space too!
This is a lovely apartment in a fantastic location! Wibke was very helpful and the check in/out was great. We hope to stay again soon!
The Apt is very good, clean, modern and with an high range quality/price. It's well positioned, near metro and centre town. Wibke is an excellent host, always ready to suggest and solve your problem.
Everything went great, check-in was easy and Problem free, the apartment was tidy and clean. The guest was great and very friendly.

This apartment is great to stay in Berlin! Clean, cozy, very nice and has everything you need. Wibke is a good host with clear communication. Instructions how to get in the apartment were good to follow. Would definitely recommend!

The room is very cozy and nice. I like the balcony. The sofa bed is good for one person. Everything else is good except the bed is a little bit uncomfortable for two. Anyway, we had a good time there and enjoyed it.
the house was great and was at the best  location! it is near of all the key areas of Berlin! for sure I will book it again!!

Nice studio apartment that was far superior to booking a hotel. Location was especially nice with an awesome Biergarten and subway station about two blocks down the street. The kitchen was great to cook in. Thanks Wibke!

The room matched the ad and was clean, as was the house. It is a very beautiful and well equipped house. Angelika puts guests at ease and although she doesn't speak English very well, she was friendly, patient and instructive. We had a great stay, highly recommend.
Angelika was welcoming and very nice. The housing was lovely and well situated near the common transport. We had a nice stay. Recommended.

Clean, fresh design, smooth check in. Getting help over whatsapp or phone was super easy , the team was very helpful. Plus - all the extra services in the room (coffee, team, soup) were on point. I like that the coffee was from a local brand.
Greta location, super easy check in and out. Great communication from the team before and during stay. Balcony has amazing views of TV Tower!
Lovely place. Clean & comfortable. Great location for the city, but quite loud as we stayed on a Saturday night.

We loved our stay at Numa’s place!! It was so comfortable and spacious! Everything was super clean, bathroom, bedding, etc. It was the perfect location to walk to everything in Berlin. We couldn’t have asked for a better place to stay and will definitely be back again in the future!

Fantastic studio/flat in a great location in Berlin. Numa's check in and check out process is entirely automated and works very well.  We were given our entry code bang on time and this gained us access to the proeprty and room with no human intervention.  The only people we saw during our stay were a couple of room cleaners - otherwise everything appears automatic but none the worse for that. Queries were sent via what's App and dealt with promptly online. I liked the whole set up it worked very well and the space was terrific. I would definitely use other Numa outlets.

location is just so great, 5 min walking to the museum island and some very interesting markets. room is clean and tidy. the very big terrace is such a plus！you can view the Berlin skyline from the terrace. best place to stay for a beautiful city.
only thing I want to add is the washing machine, if you could provide an English manual or just a paper telling the travelers how to operate it, it would be best
My priority was getting a good rest following an intensely hectic time at home. The spaciousness of the apartment and features such as  automatic fan / cooling system  made my stay pleasant.

Our stay at Numa was nothing short of exceptional. From the moment we arrived, I was captivated by the prime location that put us just a few minutes' walk from Berlin's most intriguing points of interest. The apartment itself was exactly as described—modern, clean, and welcoming, providing a perfect retreat after a day of exploration.
What stood out to me was the seamless blend of comfort and convenience. Whether we were in the mood for a quiet evening or an adventure in the city, everything we needed was right at our doorstep.
I would highly recommend Numa to anyone looking for a memorable stay in this vibrant city. 🤘

It was a great stay for 3 nights. The apartment is in great location with public transportation nearby. Very close to Museum island and Alexanderplatz.
The apartment was clean and kitchen had all the basic amenities. The best part was the amazing balcony. Overall, nice stay.

Great place as a base for exploring Berlin within good distance of supermarket and metro. Got a decent kitchen so can stay in and cook if want. Overall, worked out well for our group and nothing bad to say.

I stayed here with my family and it was perfect for us. Three spacious bedrooms, nice kitchen and two big bathrooms with showers. Great location for some sightseeing and close to Ubahn and other transportation. A pharmacy across the street and 80 meters to a great foodstore. Perfect for us and I would definately stay here again!

This was in a great location with heaps of public transport options but also most areas within a 30min walking distance. We were there for New Years and it is a bit of a uni neighbourhood so be conscious of that! It was surprisingly quiet considering though. Christina was there for our checkin and she was very funny and informative :)
Place was near an awesome strip of little shops and nice community around. Loft is very modern and organized.

Very nice and cosy place with a great location. Cleaners started cleaning half an hour before check- in even though I asked several times for a check-in a little earlier. But other then that a great place to stay with 2 to 4 people. I recommend it!

We had a wonderful stay in the middle of Prenzlauer Berg - the apartment was clean and very neatly decorated. The location is amazing - tram and U-Bahn are nearby. Restaurants, Cafés and Shops are all around the apartment. Would definitely recommend! Thank you, Polina 🤗

Very nice flat. Confirm to the description. Very clean and well equipped, renewed. Self checkin so maybe missing human contact. Location is so nice, close to public transport and a lot of good restaurants. Quiet street.
Just be aware that the isolation is poor, with the other apartment on the same floor but also above (we hear a lot the steps). I really recommend.

Lovely apartment in a delightful part of Berlin. Easily assessable from other parts of Berlin, bike stations, Metro all nearby. Polina was responsive and quick to resolve a request that we had on arrival. The apartment is well worth the money.  Thanks Polina
This was a really cute space in a great neighborhood full of great cafes and restaurants. Only complaint is that the pull out couch was uncomfortable but everything else was fantastic. Thanks!

Communication with Polina was super easy and she got back to us very quickly. We were able to store our luggage even before the check-in - that was really helpful.
The area in Prenzlauer Berg is absolutely beautiful and we loved it. We recommend the location!

Place is really lovely. My only criticism is that being on ground floor we had to keep curtains pulled whilst changing etc in the mornings.
Only other issue was of our own making that I had not realised there was a second door lock code in the photos sent to us so we had a slight delay and brief panic at getting in.
Nice location but if I was to go again I would choose somewhere a little closer to the centre but it was very nice nevertheless.
Overall a nice stay and nice flat. Thank you
Super home in centre of berlin, the neighborhood it’s really cool. Polina was super available to our request :)
very pleasant stay lovely apartment 😊 very happy with the location 😊 just add microwave to the kitchen and it will be 10/10

Thank you for a very nice stay. The apartment was very cozy, and the neighbourhood was charming.
Also the communication was great and the host replied super fast.
Would stay again☺️

Love the neighborhood, lots of nice restaurants and a grocery store nearby to stock up on essentials, I also felt very safe. It’s quite literally a stone throw from the tram, which I was able to use to access everything. It was very clean.
Entranceway was dim, but I just used my iPhone flashlight to light the path.

This is a very nice small apartment accessible via the inner yard. The description of how to find it is brilliant, and the flat is spacious and nicely furnished. Great bed, well equipped kitchen and a nice shower. Everything is labeled so it's easy to navigate the place. Super quiet because windows go to the courtyard. In the heart of Prenzlauer Berg, lots of great restaurants across the street in Kollwitz Kiez, and a Lidl supermarket next door. I'd happily stay again!

Great airbnb! Don’t hesitate to book.
Area right outside is lovely, prime PrenzlauerBerg with coffee shops, restaurants etc. Metro is legit right outside. Grocery store right next door, kitchen has everything you need. Hosts are extremely responsive! They even helped me coordinate getting a piece of mail delivered which was very kind. Would recommend 10/10.
Thank you Project A!!! Have a great one.

A spacious apartment in an excellent location. The ‘fresh’ renovation was definitely a few years ago, a little TLC would be useful, especially in the bathroom - be careful, because the shower door doesn’t close properly and will flood the bathroom AND the hallway, too.
Also FYI, while the check in pictures show a dried flower arrangement, it’s actually a metal sign on the door now, I wondered around for 5 minutes, wondering if that was the right door or if I were about to attempt a breaking-and-entering…
Beautiful apartment. Without a doubt the apartment has the best location although the street is a bit noisy.

Nice area
Property could do with some attention
Blind in bedroom is broken meaning security light outside wakes you up
it was so Nice place in the middle of Berlin as location is Great the place comfortable clean and the price was suite of what they offer
I had a wonderful time staying at the place. The staff especially were super helpful and friendly. I will definitely be coming back during a vacation. Thank you so much!

Nice room, very clean, and very convinient !
The checkin and checkout are easy.
The location in berlin is perfect !

Very cute room! Huge windows for lots of air and sunlight. We received free snacks and drinks. The check-in and -out procedure is very simple. Location is perfect as it’s only a 2-Minute walk to S-Bahn and U-Bahn and right in the Berlin city center.
good location but awful service and they force you to pay for an extra day instead of allowing an hour late checkout. overpriced. avoid

Everything at this place is great and it is super close. Check in process was easy, room was clean, nice and quite! I stayed for 3 weeks and also worked from there. The room had great space with big desk/table. Staff was always friendly and helped on the spot. Also you can use the washer and dryer for free and again location is PERFECT! Everything you need is right around and in walking distance well connected. Would always stay again!

Host, which is a hotel business, was very communicative. Check in process is outside the scope of AirBnb, but not difficult. Host provides a PIN on the day of arrival which is used to access the building and the room. Very easy. They provided flexible check in times.
Apartment itself is as described and shown in the pictures. It is a hotel room, so expect such. Everything was clean and comfortable. Easy walking distance to many locations and public transportation stops. I would stay here again.

The perfect location with all the needed accommodations. It was easy to find, access and take advantage of all that Berlin has to offer. The room was spotlessly clean and had everything we needed. Numa was very communicative. Great value for the money. We’d happily stay at a Numa run property again!

We had a wonderful stay at numa’s Nook. The location is great: close to S-Bahn and U-Bahn stations and a quick trip to Berlin train station. The place itself is very clean and well run; free laundry in the basement is a great perk as well.

This is our second stay at Numa Berlin Nook. We enjoyed our stay due to it's close proximity to the museums and public transport. There is some street noise if your room is facing the diner, but it helped lull me to sleep. Numa Berlin Book provides ear plugs in the laundry/supply room if you need them. We will probably stay here again when we come back to Berlin!
the location was brilliant with plenty of public transport to get you to the heart of Berlin. it's also only a short walk to the river or the plaza. the price was worth it for the location.

Absolutely fantastic apartment. Great location for all sightseeing due to tram being so close. Really good open living space for socialising, and comfortable sleeping arrangements. Would love to return in the future!!

This place was awesome! The panoramic view from the apartment and balcony was beautiful. Plenty of space and seating for our group of 5.  There were two bedrooms with one double bed each and another double bed in the living room. There was a room with toilet and sink and another with sink, shower, and washer/dryer: not exactly 1.5 bathrooms since only one has a toilet. The dryer didn't work super well but it was nice to have.

No tv and no internet despite advertising wifi and internet.  Messages sent for assistance were ignored. Socket hanging off the wall for tv. Apartment surface clean only. Lovely big apartment that has sadly been neglected.

The only thing that would have been helpful was that there is no information about the local area. There is a great area with shops and restaurants within easy distance of the bnb and a market just downstairs.
Only problem we had was that one evening we couldn't get the heating on and we were quite cold.. It came on later in the night.
Spacious and clean flat as advertised. Easy to take public transport from. Responsive hosts for check-in.
Excellent stay with no issues at all, let us check in early and communication perfect. Thank you so much.

Leonid and the team were professional and responsive!
The apartment is spacious, clean and well-located with lots of restaurants and activities nearby.
Lars was a great host! And we especially loved the location of the apartment with a nice park nearby ☀️

Lars apartment is located near all the transportation, so is very easy to access other parts of Berlin. Also, we loved the neighbourhood - clean, quiet, parks nearby, more of a family neighbourhood, but exactly what we needed. The apartment is big enough for four people and it has everything you need for a short stay. We recommend Lars's apartment to everyone who comes to Berlin and is searching for something cosy and with great location.

Our stay was GREAT.
Lars is very easy to communicate with.
In the middle of our stay we asked for some extra towels and he brought them with no delays.
Wifi works very good and place is cool and fresh during peak heat season.
Very calm neighbourhood and well connected to multiple restaurants and parks.
Definitely recommend lars and his apartment.
Nice and spatious place. The communication with Lars was on point and pleasant. We had a very good time at his place. Thanks Lars!

A great stay in a great location. The place had everything we needed, plus was clean and comfortable. Close to the everything we wanted to do, as well as a train station. Lars was helpful and we enjoyed our stay. Would stay again.

Had a great experience with Lars. He was very responsive and accommodating and provided great local recommendations. The apartment was exactly as advertised and was comfortable for our stay. Would recommend!

This is a great location with an amazing park out the back and easy access to great transportation (many lines at the nearest station).  The apartment is spacious and clean with the necessities all there, but minimal linens and towels.  People should know that this is a semi-basement with good light, but no actual windows looking out.  They are frosted.  So there are no views out.  Otherwise great and recommended!
great location, walkable to a lot of the main attractions, close to shops and a brewery  would def recommend

Lars is a very friendly and responsive host. His place is amazing - cozy, clean, spacious and quiet at night. It is such a unique place, very easy to find too. Everything is just as described. Check-in and check-out were super easy. We really had a great stay!
Lar's place was clean and nice! it's close to ubahn station and it makes it easy to commute around the city!
Very good host, responsive. The apartment is nice and clean. The pillows were a little low for our taste. The location is close to a metro station and a 15 min walking to Brandenburg Gate.

The flat is below street level and was in a residential area near the train station It was clean and tidy.Cooking facilities are limited but it was easy to prepare breakfast or a snack.Good supply of hot water.A house book with instructions for the cooker and TV would be helpful.A map of the area with indications of where the supermarket or shope were would be good also.
Lars was very helpful all the way through the process. Lots of space in the apartment, and close to U Bahn station, restaurants & shops, as well as parks. Highly recommend.

An amazing property for a stay in Berlin! Right around the corner from everything you need, and near some amazing transport links!
If we return to Berlin, we’ll definitely come back here!
The staff at Apartmenthouse Berlin went above and beyond to make our stay a special one. I would highly recommend staying there and renting bikes from them to ride around the city.
My family enjoyed the stay and it was located in a pretty hip area ;) communication was easy and made things easy

If you're going to Berlin by car you better book this place :)
Good location from where you can reach any place in Berlin quick by car or public transport.
The apartment is clean and good for a family with 2 kids. Everything you need is there and the staff is very friendly.
We did have a great time!
Thank you

Great apartment, easy to check in and no issues while staying there. Was easy to find and the apartment was ideal for a short stay in Berlin. The area, particuarly in the park felt slightly unsafe in the evening, but fine in the day.

This space was perfect for a week in Berlin. A large and clean space good for a group of friends or a family. The building is very safe and secure. A short walk to many nearby restaurants and bars. The transit system is close and efficient. Not the best area to stay in if you’re with a family looking to be close to the historical sites.
Nice and clean apartment. We would definitely recommend! Location is okey, Uber’s/Taxi’s are great and the public transport is also near the apartment!

The park beside the accommodation was a bit unsafe with obvious drug dealings going on.
The AC in the accommodation was just two plug in fans which at times made it difficult to cool down the room.
However, the size of the accommodation was exactly what we needed as a group of four. There was a nice sized bathroom with a washing machine and a well set up kitchen with a small fridge.
The accommodation owners were easy to communicate with prior to the visit and were very accommodating once we arrived.

We had two couples staying at Apartmenthouse Berlin for a long weekend. It was an ideal location for sight-seeing as only a short bus ride away from the city centre. Clean and comfortable and great value for money.

the apartment differs a bit from thepictures and seem to be smaller than on the pictures, but other than that it was a good stay.
Thank you to the hosts for quick replies

Nice apartment with everything we needed travelling as a Family with two small children. Nice neighbouhood with good restaurants nearby and right next to Görlitzer park and several good playgrounds.
Only downside was that the apartment was really warm.
Great location and very comfortable apartment with everything needed (including a kitchen). Easy check in and could borrow umbrellas from the front desk which was very nice.

The check in process went smoothly and the apartment matched the pictures.
When we first got there we took the train. The apartment is sort of far away from the train station, so it was a long walk with luggage. Coming in I would definitely recommend anyone to take the bus instead. The nearest bus stop is just at the end of the street.

Very clean and perfect space but the area is just super noisy 24/7 and we did not sleep well all week. Other than that its about 10 minutes walk to very busy kreuzberg area which was good and host very responsive and kind 👍

What made this property so special was the meticulous thought that went into every inch of the space, particularly the art and photographs that filled the walls. We found ourselves getting lost in our curiosity, wandering around the place like it was an art gallery and wondering how we got so lucky as to call this place ours for the weekend.
As for the host, Frank was probably the most proactive and accommodating we've ever had on Airbnb. Not only did he allow us to shift our dates after booking, but when the time came to check-in, we received a comprehensive package that not only made our lives easier but also helped us familiarize ourselves with the city and our neighborhood.
It is clear that Frank takes pride in where he lives and delights in providing others with the chance to experience it in the most comfortable and welcoming way possible. If you have the opportunity to spend a weekend in the area, I can not recommend this property enough - especially for the price.
Nice apartment, not far from the centre. Beautiful view from balcony. Grocery store around the corner.

Maggie was proactive and responsive, and on time for our meet up. She made recommendations to us for things to do and see and answered all of our questions! The apartment is small but perfect and had everything we needed. Very close to the subway station so it was easy to get around the whole city.
Thanks for a great stay!
- Juliet and Alison

Really enjoyable few days in berlin made easier with this ideal apartment. Clean space - A Big bed, a clean bathroom and an equipped kitchen - really good location too as long as you’re comfortable using the U-Bahn system you can get around the city really easily and even walk to Brandenburg gate area if you’re up for it!
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ 5* would stay again

Great place for short stay. Super convenient location, 5 min walk from U/S bahn. A very spacious balcony is also a huge advantage…
Hosts were super friendly and easy to communicate with.
Highly recommended !
