Such a great find!!! Small but beautifully airy and perfect for us. The neighbourhood is lovely with lots of coffee shops, bars and restaurants. You are also very close to alot of the tourist spots. Walking distance to potsdamer Platz. Lidl is just around the corner. Would definitely book again

We had a great stay. The apartment was clean and had everything we needed. The host was very friendly and helpful. The only problem was the elevator; sometimes, mostly at night for us, it got stuck somewhere, and we had to use the stairs.

We had a wonderful stay! Punktie was an amazing host, he showed us some restaurants and the nearest supermarket. He also reacted very fast with messages to our questions!
The bed was very comfortable! The only small inconvient thing was that the fridge smelled bad. But would definitely recommend!!
Comfortable apartment to enjoy Berlin! The building can be a little loud at weird hours, and the wifi wasn’t really working, but besides that everything was good! Thank you!
What a terrific apartment. We loved the perfect location, the space, washer/dryer, and amazing communication by the host!

Very clean flat and nicely set up to accommodate a couple people! Great location to explore East Berlin, and get connection to public transports. The hosts were very helpful even on the weekend when we had a problem with the keys and they solved the issue immediately.

This apartment by Holiday 33 was perfect for us. It was clean. The check-in process was easy and the host provided all of the necessary information. We even luckily found a nice parking spot around the corner and used the EasyPark app for the couples days that we stayed. It was reasonable for city parking. The neighbourhood is really nice, with many cafes, restaurants and some bars all around. The neighbourhood is also relaxed and quiet, with parks within a short walk. I would definitely return.
Excellent communication. Well located place. We had a little problem the internet connection and it was solved immediately! We will back again!

We spent a nice time during the last weekend, in 7 friends from Italy.
Apartment was very clean and suitable for our needs. Good location and services around the neightbours (supermarket and public transport especially)
Communications and instructions by the host clear and simple.
I recommend it!
Carmelo
Great location, good neighbourhood. Very close to transit and having the Lidl right around the corner was very convenient. Lots of space for our family of 6.

Nice apartment for a maximum of 6 persons, not more. Maybe even four. The apartment has no real living room which means that you can only sit at the dining table which is next to two of the bedrooms. The location is ok. The tram stops in front en brings you in 10 minutes to Alexanderplatz. The communication with holiday 33 is really quick so that’s a plus!
We enjoyed our stay at the appartment. There was a tram-spot close by, a Lidl around the corner and some restaurants. The rooms are nice and roomy. The kitchen is also very nice to have breakfast in.

The apartment was pretty good! We thought it was a bit bigger (like it looks on the photos) but it was nice!
We‘d return to that location!
Lovely apartment in a cool area, great public transport connections. Check in and out was smooth!

we enjoyed our stay and felt at home. it was a good spot to explore Berlin. I believe I left my jacket and was not contacted, but this is my fault for leaving it! we had no problems during our stay. thank you for having us!
Had the best stay at Holiday 33! Check in was so seamless and the area was perfect for me and my friends! Tram is right outside with tons of restaurants and cafes around as well. Highly recommend!

Very accessible by tram, the station is maybe a minute walk that brings you right to Alexanderplatz, very close to most the sights in the east city. On problem would be the broken elevator as there is alot of stairs. Kitchen was fully furnished and had everything you would need. As well with the bathroom, perfectly clean and stocked up on towels and toiletries.

A super stylish apartment in a cool part of town! The bed was super comfortable, the kitchen has all the essentials, and the apartment is very spacious. Plus it feels very Berlin-like :) Would stay again for sure! The LPG Biomarkt store on the corner has all the grocery essentials, and I would recommend  La Maison (bakery) and Annelies (brunch), both walking distance.
Amazing cozy place in the heart of Kreuzberg. Felt at home from the first moment. Ulf and Caroline are pleasant and very responsive hosts.
Ulf's apartment is exactly as advertised. It is clean, has all the basics, and is in a perfect location. I had a great stay there!

Fabulous location. Our hosts offered great recommendations as well to get the most out of the neighborhood and our time in Berlin.
The flat itself is spacious and in a quiet courtyard. We’d definitely stay again.
We had a great stay - great apartment in a good area. Would recommend it highly. Communication was very good with auld & Caroline
The place was awesome — even better than I was expecting. Ulf & Caroline we’re quite responsive, and gave very clear instructions regarding check-in/check-out. Would gladly stay there again.
Modern place without any clutter. Tall ceiling and open space make the place really comfy. The apartment itself is located inside a courtyard so there is no noise coming in.

My friend and I stayed at Kevin’s place in December to tour around Berlin . So central for us . We did almost all the Christmas markets . Love the old brick vibe and couldn’t believe how quiet it was . I totally recommend his place .

The location was great, walkable to busses, u-bahn and s-bahn. Many great coffee shops and restaurants nearby. I liked that we were within a courtyard that was behind a gate.
It was nice having a kitchen table and the ability to warm up food on the 2 burner stove top and to make coffee. I wished there were a microwave, but we did fine with the stovetop. Design is very ‘cool’ and minimalist—an industrial look with exposed brick. If you like a dramatic minimalist look, this place is for you. I enjoyed pulling up a chair to the open window and looking out at the sky. We visited in late June and found it can get a bit humid in the apartment. One wall has 2 very tall dramatic windows, but that is the only wall with windows.
Great space in a very well connected part of the city. We had a very enjoyable stay and would definitely return. Highly recommend
great place, lots of light and quiet even as it is in the middle of everything Kreuzberg has to offer. definitely would use it again when visiting Berlin in the future.
wonderful hosts. they helped us with everything we needed throughout our trip. also a beautiful loft

Spacious ground floor open plan apartment in a gated court yard. Quiet and very comfortable. Note we were there with gorgeous weather and didn't need to use heating or ventilation. Could just open the windows. Cool neighborhood with bars, restaurants, parks, shops and public transport all nearby, be it also with some rough edges. Communication was flawless. Great deal all in all.

I needed a place for a quick recovery over night, so I found this little treasure in the middle of Berlin's Friedrichshain district. Communication and check-in was all virtual and everything worked out fine. The room was equipped quite stylish and I really enjoyed my stay there.
Sketch is perfectly situated in Friedrichhein. Despite it’s central location it is quiet and easy to access. The room was spacious and clean and we enjoyed our stay very much.
The place is clean also the staffs are really friendly. The location also easy to reach out to the tourist area. :)

Great location, comfortable beds and a lot of privacy.
I would def mark Numa as a place to come back to.

Great "Airbnb Hotel". We loved our stay here from the very simple self-check in (everything is conveniently automated), to the handy communal workspace (Wi-Fi handled all meeting calls just fine), and to the really lovely decor in our room and throughout the building. Location was perfect too, felt right in the heart of the lively neighbourhood (one block from boxhagener platz). Will stay again next time we're in Berlin :)
the staff were extremely responsive and helpful when I had a problem with the stove. the place was clean and cosy and well located. easy to check in and out

at check in, the code they gave us didn't work but it was resolved quickly by texting customer service. the customer service was very responsive and helpful when the guests in the room next to us were being too loud.
the room was spacious and clean, but it did get very stuffy without AC, especially since the window faces an enclosed courtyard area so there was absolutely no breeze. we resolved this by using small tabletop fans. the shower is also really tiny, but the showerhead is nice (-:

Pros: The room was spacious and nicely decorated. High quality blackout curtains allowed me to sleep in and the extremely comfortable bed gave me great nights of sleep. The pillows and blanket felt brand new. The fridge is spacious. There plenty of room with a desk and table with two chairs, so it is easy to work from here. There is also I nice communal space at the front and lots of desks to work at. The music was relaxing in this area.
Cons: The first two nights my PIN code did not work to get into the lobby of the hotel . The last nights it finally worked. The elevator in the back got stuck and had to be opened by an employee. Both elevators seem on the verge of breaking.

Lovely clean room & bathroom - looked just like the photos - treats in the room which is always nice after travelling - location pretty good for what we had planned. Would stay again.
Thank you!!

Staying at Numa was excellent! Nothing was missing + you are practically in the middle of everything. Amazing restaurants, flea market just around the corner, great bookshops and brunch options. Good connection (M10 3' walking distance). We slept very well (you can make the room dark and quiet). Lockers for luggage are useful (just be early enough to get a free one) and common space feels welcoming. Would recommend it.

Stylish airbnb in a great location that has heaps of cool bars and restaurants. It’s also well connected to public transport and easy to get to the airport & central station. Only drawback was the room wasn’t sound proof, so you could noticeably hear noise from the hallway and adjacent rooms.
Walls are a little thin so could hear others in their rooms but overall it was great! Great location, easy to get in and it was really well kept and clean.
Comfortable,  well located, clean and had all the necessary amenities. Great value from money, I will definitely stay again!

Great location with easy entry instructions. Beautiful co-working area. Clean and well-decorated room, although smaller than it appears in photos. Air conditioning setup was faulty — it worked to some extent, but we had to keep the curtains closed so hot air did not enter through the space in the window. Overall pleasant experience!

An absolutely lovely quiet apartment though situated next to the party street with hundreds of bars / restaurants.
We will definitely return when next time in Berlin.
Nice and calm place next to the water and within a 5 minutes distance to the next train station! Recommended!

A great spot for a short stay. The flat is located in a residential street, noise levels are minimum. Even though the beds are adjacent to the front door, I felt safe and secure. Super easy check in/ out; swift communication with the hosts. The space itself was very clean and well organised. Local supermarket is a stone throw away. Really happy with my stay. Thank you Eli :)

The place was very nice! It’s in a great neighborhood and very close to an S-Bahn station. There’s a park right outside and it’s very peaceful and safe.
The place is small, but a good deal for its location. Our only big issue was a mildew/mold smell from the bathroom, but it aired out with the back door open.
Great stay, very cozy and exactly what we needed for a few days in Berlin! Well connected to public transit. Comfy for 3 people staying there together.
Clean and cozy apartment in a peaceful neighborhood. Bus and tram stops are near and train station is a couple minutes away. All around a good place to stay a few weeks/days.

can recommend this place. it is a cozy area. the room is perfect to sleep at night and having a busy day in the big city. especially famous clubs like Renate or Sissy are in walkable distance. Sadly the WiFi didnt Work and some Problems with the back door

Laura’s place was nice for myself and two friends staying for 2 weeks. It was very clean, the beds were comfortable and the area was close by to a supermarket and a tram.
The only major point of concern was the heat and ventilation of the studio. There is only a back door to open and the entire front of the studio being entirely glass. There is an electric fan but wasn’t very effective.
Besides this Laura was welcoming and considerate. Thank you Laura!

It was amazing staying at alexanders place. Affordable and clean.
He is a great host and provided nice company.
Also, Thanks for the drinks alex!

Thanks to Alexandra for kind of room. Very nice location near to U train and bus 125 and 221 go Kurt Schumacher Platz train.
A lot of cookware that easy for make dinner. May be will see you in a next holiday....
A cosy room (especially during the winter) and accessible to bus/metros etc.  Alexander was very sweet and a great host, I highly recommend this place to anyone looking to sta for Berlin :)
Alexander is a nice guy, and the apartment is very clean. There is a supermarket near by, finding foods and grocery is not a problem.

Alexander was a great host, I had all the information I needed to find the place and to check in.
He’s super responsive and very friendly!
I would definitely recommend his place to
visit Berlin 😊

noI had a fantastic stay at Alexander's apartment! The location is perfect for exploring Berlin, with easy access to public transportation and key attractions nearby. The apartment itself is stylish, clean, and incredibly comfortable, offering everything needed for a relaxing stay. Alexander is an excellent host—responsive, friendly. I truly felt at home here. I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a great base to experience Berlin. I’d gladly stay here again on my next visit!

We really enjoyed our stay at Alexander’s! The entire place was really clean and modern, Alexander made sure the check in was easy and smooth, and there was even complementary coffee at the kitchen which we can use. Alexander was very friendly and recommended all sorts of places we can visit. The place is located a bit far from the city centre, however there is a bus stop right outside the apartment building which made taking the U-Bahn very convenient. Overall I would recommend this place!

One of the best Airbnb’s we’ve ever stayed in!  Above and beyond our expectations in terms of the beauty of the apartment, the location (right in the heart of things; great restaurants and bars nearby), check-in, communication, and overall experience. We were sad to leave and wish we could’ve stayed there longer! I would highly recommend Janice’s place to anyone visiting Berlin!

Janice's apartment was the perfect place for our stay in Kreuzberg. The apartment is even better than in photos -- it's spacious and beautifully appointed. Janice and Noel were extremely responsive and helpful hosts. Strongly recommend.

Lovely place! Really styling and an especially cool basement bedroom with relly awesome lighting.
The check in and check out was completely plainless, and Sam was always incredibly quick to respond whenever I had questions, once even quite late in the evening.
A really nice place with everything I needed, in a lovely location.

New, comfortable and clean apartment.
Great web line.
Relations with Sam were simple and effective.
Recommended

The worst experience we've had on AirBnB.
We got a 2 months contract. We were kicked out after 3 weeks with a 3 day notice. While the landlord says he didn't know about the renovation beforehand, first of all it is still his responsibility, and second of all he could have been informed before but just forgot about it for all we know. We had to find an expensive new place (paid €500 more for the same period), order a taxi to move, and got a lot of stress and time wasted with moving apartments. This is a long-term stay and we had A LOT of things to move. We requested to be paid for the damage and the ask was refused.
So, stay at this place if you want to be kicked out at any moment without any compensation whatsoever.

It was a lovely stay in Sam‘s apartment. The design of the apartment is great and the bathroom is newly made. Overall the apartment is very clean.
Plus point:The apartment is close to public transport.
Sam is a great host who answers within a few hours.

Sam is a very warm host and communication was easy. The apartment is located in a lovely area of Berlin, and has everything you need for a short stay. The furnishings are modern and pleasing to the eye. The check out of 10am is a little early, an extra our would make leaving less hectic, but that aside l would recommend this apartment.
We had an awesome couple of days in Berlin. Great appartement, great communication with the host.

We really enjoyed our stay in Berlin and coming back to Sam’s place felt super cozy. Overall he’s flat is really clean and easy to use. We didn’t used any public transportations at all because everything is in a walking distance.
Thanks Sam for your wonderful place

Firstly, Sam’s apartment is ideally situated just a short 5-minute walk from a U- and S-train station, which is a significant advantage. The apartment is comfortable and located on a tranquil street with little traffic. It features electric exterior shutters on the doors and windows for complete privacy. The accommodations provide ample amenities for your visit.  Overall, enjoyed my stay there.

Sam’s space was clean, comfortable, and appeared exactly as advertised. It was optimally located in a great neighborhood near the S-Bahn and U-Bahn. Sam was communicative and provided all necessary information and utilities for a comfortable stay.

So pleased we stayed here for a 4 night stay. Sam - our host- was great- and the little flat was a great base for 2 friends to explore Berlin. The simple layout was clean and tidy. The main bed and the sofa bed were really comfortable. The shower was particularly good too.  And, if you need a lie in after a late night exploring Berlin, the blackout shutters over the doors and windows were very welcome. Would happily stay here again.
Caroline is a very nice host, I arrived very early in Berlin, she’s flexible on the check-in. Love her artistic house full of greens and others. She’s always sweet and love to talk.

I had a great time by Caroline. The flat is big, in a great neighbourhood, the room is huge. Caroline and flatmates are the kindest, nicest persons. I was really like home, on my own when I wished, and when we wished we also had very nice talks and interactions.
I recommend this place without any hesitation.
It was wonderful to stay at Caroline‘s place. I felt right at home. She is an incredibly interesting person. I feel very happy to have found this unique space.

Caroline was friendly and welcoming and shared helpful pieces of advice with me. The room was pleasant and clean, and the surroundings were peaceful. I felt safe and well at Caroline's place and hope to return.

SUCH a great place  to land in Berlin. Carol was so lovely, friendly and easy going. felt like i had slipped into an alternative version of my life in which i actually i lived in Berlin. exactly as described. perfect.

It is a splendid and very large traditional Berlin flat with large rooms and high ceilings.  There is a nice parquet floor throughout and the flat feels very homely and well-lived in with shelves piled high with books and art works here and there.  Both of the lady hosts are very relaxed and helpful and only too happy to have a chat.  However, they are also very happy to let you do your own thing.  It was a great base to explore Berlin and felt like a real home from home!  Other guests come and go and somehow we never seemed to get in each other's way. What I liked about the kitchen is that everything is hanging on open display so you do not need to spend ages searching for things in cupboards and drawers! The only drawbacks is that the flat is on the fourth floor and there is no lift and using the key to open the main door of the building takes a bit of getting used to.
A very nice place located near Bundesallee and yet very quiet. No problem with communication. Huge room. Good value for money. Overall a nice stay!
Such a lovely apartment, super clean. Right outside a metro station so it was really easy to get around Berlin.

The stay was very good, the balcony and the view was nice. Close to train station which was very convinitet for travelling around Berlin. Very nice modern flat & area around. The things we didn't like are the number of rooms in description says 3 rooms, but 2 were locked and only one bedroom available to use plus living room (which was counted as a additional room), also the communication on the day of arrival was complicated since Fabian had voice mail when we arrived to Berlin and we didn't know how to check in, and he responded in last minute. Other than that we enjoyed the stay in Fabians place.

Very nice apartment in the center of the city, close to restaurants and bars.
Close to bus and metro stations .

Nice place my only remark will be on the checkout at 10 that I found super early especially when the check in is ask to be done around 15 and 18 the check out should have the same flexibility and at least give a 10 to 12 option.
Clean, comfortable apartment with a great view. I can recommend it either for short and long stay.
Good location, nice apartment. But no comunication outside of workingours, so if you lock yourself out it would bea problem.
I can totally recommend this apartment for weekend in Berlin. Location is near a bus stop and cozy room
Comfy, equipped and good located in Berlin, perfect to stay a few days in the city, the communication was really good and I love the apartment (Modern and clean)

We had a pleasant stay,  only it was like 30 degrees when we arrived, the floorheating was on the maximum level and we could not turn it off the first night. So we had to sleep with the window open which was very nodig. After that, it was turned off and it was better.

Great location, clean rooms, friendly reception staff, reception is meant to be manned 10 to 6 but we had to wait 30 minutes before someone arrived with no nite to say when they would be back and it was often closed well before 6 and no welcome pack with appliance instructions and local areas of interest
Nena Apartment were great, especially because they allow pets! Bed was a bit uncomfortable but over all it was a nice stay :)

Thank you for our stay the room was in a good location for us to explore Berlin.
The reception staff were very helpful and even tried to see if we could check in earlier. They gave helpful advice on how to get there from the airport.
The only things that were not as great was the pull out bed appeared a bit broken and slipped on the hinges a couple of times. The fridge also could have been a little cleaner but other than that we were happy enough

Lovely place, great location for accessing the city. Direct bus (M41) from central station and several U/S bahn stations within  10 minutes. We tended to walk everywhere with central Kreuzberg around 25 minutes away and a great walk via the landwerkcanal. The Jewish museum is close by and free and well worth a visit, you do have to book online though but it is still free. Checkpoint charlie is a 20 min walk away. The apartments are modern, clean and bugger rhan I expcted, we had three in ours and it was fine. The bathroom and kitchen areas are excellent. Underneath the apartments are a grocer, a baker and a 24 hour store which is very handy.
All round no problems at all. Communication and check in were especially good. Everything in the room was perfect however the sofa bed wasn’t great

Everything was great but didn’t really like that third bed it was soo uncomfortable,
The floor had some sand and dirty.
Other then that everything was great.
Paid extra for early check-in between 8-10, however, when we arrived at 11, the room was not ready and we had to walk to the city. For what I paid extra, I don't know.

A beautiful room for three people with comfort, clean and ready to get inside with everything. It was like in description and in the photos. Self check-in is a great idea if someone arrives late to the place for getting the keys. The price is really good for the position of apartments ( in centre of Berlin) and for what we get. I recommend Nena Apartments in Berlin.
The apartment was absolutely gorgeous and very spacious. Was within walkable distance of the restaurants and shops and easy access to the subway. Would 100% recommend.
Great place near S-Bahn. Great service, and the apartment is extremely clean and well taken care of. We hope to be back!

I had the pleasure to stay 6 nights at Klaus' apartment and it was worth the money.
The apartment is spacious and has all the amenities you need for a pleasant stay. Apartment is more spacious than according to the photos.
Beds were comfortable for a good night sleep. It can be light in the apartment, so for light sleepers a sleep mask is recommended. Apart from this minor issue, it was more than perfect.
The area is calm and safe to walk around at night.
Close to the apartment are a number of restaurants and supermarkets. S-Bahn and Trams are on walking distance if you want to go to the city of Berlin (approx 30 min by public transport, which runs very frequent).
Would defenitely recommend staying here!

The apartment was squeaky clean & exactly as described. Bright & spacious, the kitchen & bathroom were super clean & so was everything else. We had a small issue with the drain in the shower but it was solved the same day thanks to Klaus' great communication & fast response. The apartment is a little far from the centre of Berlin but the connecting train station is close & can be easily accessed by foot in about 5 mins. Bus & tram stations are also within walking area. The area is pretty quiet, there's multiple options for food/grocery shopping & even pharmacies. Overall a great experience, definitely recommended!
The place was as described, but the pillows were paper-thin and there were no black out curtains in the room, which made up for an uncomfortable night for sleeping.

Spacious apartment in a very good location.
In addition, Görkem is a nice person :)
My family had a wonderful stay at Görkem's place. The host is very respectful and communicates clearly. Would highly recommend ;)

Görkem’s place is very good to stay in. There is all what you need for your stay. The neighbourhood is one of the best in Berlin, and the flat is authentic. Görkem is easy to communicate with. The only one thing I think could be slightly improved are towels and bed sheets. Thank you for hosting us.

We had a very great stay and felt like at home. The place is even more spacious than in photos.
For the car owners:
I parked in the Arkaden Parking. It’s just 10 mins of walk from the apartment. 5€/day and it works on Sundays (do not believe go0gle reviews)

Görkem’s flat was perfect for me and great value for the price.
It’s a one bedroom but very large and suitable for a tall solo traveler like me that finds most places in Europe about 50% too small.
There was tons of natural light and great views from every window.
The desk and chair in particular were the best I’ve had in all my stays in this price range which is vital for a business traveler.

lovely, cosy apartment in a great area.
I stayed for 6 weeks and was very comfortable the whole time. Görkem is a great host, friendly and gave lots of nice recommendations :)

Except for an a bit confusing check in, perfect experience! Incredible location, honestly was in Berlin 3 times and this was the first time in p-berg and I can confidently say that this is the best neighborhood in Berlin:)
Huge apartment, beautiful design, and has everything inside the apartment for every need. Stayed with a friend and had a beautiful time!

The apartment was ok for staying a couple of days at a reasonable price. The communication with the host wasn't so smooth as he only sent messages in German and the translation of Airbnb didn't work well. Also, the apartment wasn't so clean. The bed linen was so old and bad-looking. Also, during the day I heard loud dog barking sounds from the hallway. It was so difficult to concentrate on my work.
It was a very nice stay at the Airbnb from Peter and Denis! The flat is big and has a very good location in Berlin!

everything from the arrival till the end was great.
the apartment is big and cozy with lots of arty details. the location is wonderful and you can go walking to any point of interest or either rent a bike which Berlin has plenty.
also, it is close to FriedrichStrasse Station, which helps a lot when going to the airport.
definitely recommend it and will go back on our next trip to Berlin!

Loved the feel of this apartment - the art, paintings, sculpture and lights adorned with birds. Also the balcony, overlooking the trees.
The location is wonderful.

Great apartment in a very good location. The host were helpful and responsive. The apartment was clean and spacious and even better than expected. Even though the trains run close by, it was quiet with the windows closed. Would definitely stay here again.
The space was amazing and it’s created with an emphasis in the details,amenity-wise and design-wise. The hosts were amazing and really helpful !!
This place was great! Super clean and very clear instructions about everything. The location is also very walkable

Had a wonderful time here! The location was great, right next to Museum Island and the subway. A short walk to great restaurants and stores in Mitte. The apartment itself was very clean and spacious and very comfortable to stay in. 100% recommend this place!

This space was exactly what we needed to end our short trip abroad. The apartment was clean and beautiful. The art was gorgeous and the rooms were HUGE and spacious. The location is pretty central and we really enjoyed the surrounding resources. If we are ever in Berlin again, we hope this listing is open as it was one of the most relaxing Airbnb experiences we've ever had.

Nice large two bedroom apartment in a great location. Train station and trams on your doorstep. Still not a sound at night. Place was clean with all you need for a stay, just like a hotel! Only point was there was only one key - not ideal for a group

Great comms with the host team and the location is perfect - minus the trains.
Unless train noise makes you sleep, you need top flight earplugs. And on weekends the night club across the street is active and loud with EDM.

The apartment is spacious and has everything you need. Let me stress that the S Bahn train travels just outside the apartment and even with earplugs it was loud. The weather was cool enough to keep all windows and doors closed but to have fresh air, you needed to yell at each other sometimes when there were lots of trains going by. Also, it’s customary to leave cold water and some basics like cream for coffee and a bottle of wine in the fridge for guests. This apartment did not. Tap water is okay to drink and there was a Nespresso coffee maker with pods. Overall, we had a nice stay, comfortable beds and linens.
A beautiful spacious flat in a very good location - would look to stay here again for future visits.

Maybe it was the jet lag and because it was nighttime, but we had a hard time locating the lockbox. Aside from that, everything was great. Spacious, clean, and nicely decorated flat. Definitely a place I'd return to.
It’s a nice little apartment. The apartment nr. 6 is located to the backside of the building and therefore it was nearly silent.

Nadia’s apartment is very comfortable, well located and quiet. Problems setting the thermostat were quickly resolved with a FaceTime phone call. The kitchen is well stocked with good appliances and cookware. The bathroom has a nice shower with plenty of hot water. Good grocery stores and interesting restaurants are plentiful within minutes of the apartment. You will be very satisfied with the location and value of this stay.
Neat apartment in a nice location of Charlottenburg District of Berlin. Nadja was a wonderful host.

Nadja has a lovely little apartment in Charlottenburg. It's quiet, is in a fantastic location and is great value for money. The contact with her was very relaxed and easy. I thoroughly enjoyed all aspects of my stay there.

Really beautiful home. Even more stunning than the photographs - much bigger and full of light!
Nadja was a wonderful host, and really helped me with recommendations for transport. She was very friendly and I would definitely recommend her home.

Nice place in a real neighborhood , yet close to everything a tourist would want to see. Place is clean, bed is comfortable and the kitchen has everything one would need to prep meals at home should the outstanding restaurants in the area not do the trick.
Great place to stay for a few days, everything clean and as expected. Would definitely recommend. The apartment was always very warm (heating was off) which may be an issue in hot weather.

We couldn't meet Nadja during our stay, but it wasn't a problem at all. She always responded quickly and seemed friendly throughout our communication. The flat was very comfortable, and everything we needed was there. *The cutlery is in the first shallow shelf in the cupboard in the kitchen :) Yes, we also struggled to find them, but I had found them successfully! So, you can cook and eat meals at their flat if you want.
I really liked an organic bakery called "Brotgarten GmbH in Charlottenburg" near her flat, where you can get excellent German bread.
We hope to come back there again! Thank you, Nadja and Alessandro.
No complaints - check-in was convenient, the apartment was clean and no different from the pictures, Michael was fast to reply to any questions.

Michael’s apartment is well located next to U Bahn station Wedding, and the arrival and communication with Michael were very simple. Furthermore Michael was very flexible for our departure, we could stay a few hours more than 11 the day we had to leave. So I recommend you this apartment with no doubt. Thank you Michael !

We loved staying at Michael’s place. The flat itself is perfect for 2 people with everything we needed, and is located on a quiet street. Despite that it’s only a 10 minute walk to the nearest station (underground and overground) and so we easily got around the major landmarks and areas we wanted to see. Michael himself was friendly, responded promptly to messages, and was flexible with our check in and checkout timings. Would recommend!

We had a comfortable week in Michael’s apartment.  It is located in a nice residential area, close to transit, shopping and a great bakery (Hansis Brot).  We spent mornings and evenings out on the balcony.  The ceiling fan in the bedroom let us sleep comfortably, even in very hot weather.  We were grateful for the washing machine.  The only thing we missed was a filter coffeemaker.  We would gladly stay here again.
Great appartment, beautiful location and easy to access everywhere a few minutes away. Will for sure book when I return

A very cozy apartment, the photos correspond to the announcement.
The kitchen was perfectly equipped. The instructions to get there were simple and clear.
Michael offered us a portable bed for our baby but it wasn't necessary because we have our own.
We hat great time in Berlin.

We had a great stay! The flat is cozy, with a comfortable bed and a bath tub which was really nice after a long day. Breakfast on the balcony with all the swallows dancing through the air... it was lovely! Easy to find your way around the city, by bus or by U (underground) or S (overground), only 5 minutes away in Wedding. Very good info and friendly host!
Awesome, beautiful apartment - quiet Innenhof and well equipped. Lots of clever storage for longer stays. Askan was super responsive and everything was smooth, can’t ask for much more
Fantastic place, looks even way better in reality. Quiet, central location, highly accessorized and full of personal touches! Will definitely stay again!

Would highly recommend this apartment. In a great location, had all of the necessary amenities for a two week stay, and Askan was incredibly accommodating & communicative with the check-in / check-out process.

We had a great time in Askan's apartment.
Great terrace and fun area. Lidl supermarket is just nearby.
Askan was very responsive and helped us with a special request we had.
We highly recommend staying in his studio.

There is nothing that Askan hasn't thought of!!! We had all the amenities you could wish for and more. We felt totally at home and looked after and nothing was missing. The bathroom supplies (shampoo, hairdryer, handwash etc) were high quality and felt luxurious. The way the apartment has been set up is brilliant, from the positioning of the lighting (including motion sensors on the steps) and the little fan attached to the bed. Thank you for hosting us.

The apartment was very comfy, well-designed and super clean. Also big advantage is having outdoor terrace, where you can have chill time after busy day.
Location also very good - it near sub way station, and within walking distance to all great places and spots of Kreuzberg district.
Askan as a host was very responsive and kind, he provided detailed check in instructions, also gave useful recommendations for his favourite places in Berlin.
We really enjoy our time in Askan’s apartment! Highly recommend it.

We enjoyed Askan's place so much -- it's a small but efficient studio in a central location.  Opening up the glass doors, we were able to feel part of Berlin even as we spent the morning hours of our vacation working.  Askan was flexible and available for our very late check in and our very late check out, and he was responsive as needed throughout the stay.  We would love to stay again next time we're in Berlin.

We highly recommend this apartment, it is beautiful, with a very original and minimalist decoration, it is very well equipped, and the subway is only a few minutes away. Lucia was very kind and always very attentive!

Lucia's apartment was even more beautiful than in the photos, and very comfortable. It is very close to the station so it's easy to get into central Berlin. Lucia kindly gave me a list of places to see in the area. The check-in and out was very easy. I would highly recommend this place!

Lucia's apartment is great, I really recommend it, it is very clean, it has all facilities needed and the bed is really confy. I love the area where it is located because you can enjoy many great places (bars, restaurants, stores...)a great place to stay in Berlin
Such a beautiful apartment with everything we needed! It truly made our Berlin-trip wonderful. Lucia was so sweet and hospitable!

Thankyou Lucia for a wonderful stay! We loved the apartment. It was clean and in a good location, very close to the subways/train links.
We appreciated Lucia’s recommendations for the area as well. 10/10, would highly recommend staying here ☺️

Lucia was so helpful and accommodating during our stay. We had a list of recommendations to help us get settled into the new area which was so thoughtful!
The flat is gorgeous and well kept, super clean, and well equipped with the essentials. The Neukölln area itself is very trendy with easily accessible shops, cafés and restaurants. The train station is a 5min walk away meaning this is a perfectly located flat for all your Berlin itinerary. Highly recommend!

Amazing space, makes you feel comfy away from your home.
Lucia had some amazing recommendations about restaurants and sightseeing.
Even though the house is not in the center of Berlin, it is placed real near the sub-bahn and the u-bahn station and it has stores, supermarkets, coffeshops and restaurants near. Makes you experience a different kind of Berlin too.
Recommend it 100%!

Lucia and her mom was so kind for the check in, and the room was beautiful with a mood!
We truly enjoyed the stay, keen to be back again once we have chance to visit Berlin next time.

Lucia is a great host and made us feel right at home. We arrived later than expected and she was still there to welcome us. The house has all you need in a nice neighborhood! The only little thing that woke us up earlier than we would’ve liked was constructions in and around the building. I’d love to stay here again and would recommend to anyone that wants to stay in Neukölln!

Lucia's Artist Studio was the perfect place to stay while I was in Berlin (part for a conference, part for a personal trip). The space itself is clean, comfortable, and inviting--the artwork throughout is incredible--and it's in a perfect location for both public transit to anywhere and close walks to wonderful neighborhoods (Rixdorf, Neukölln) and sites (Körnerpark). This was my first time in Berlin, and it certainly won't be my last--and I hope to come back and stay again at the Artist Studio.
Awesome flat in a great cultural area. Lucia is a great gost and will give you the best suggestions on local places.

We had a wonderful stay at Lucia’s beautiful apartment! Everything was very clean and neat. Especially the balcony is very nice to sit and relax, have breakfast or just chill after a day of exploring the city!

Fab place to stay in a quiet neighborhood of Berlin. City transport is a short walk away and the apartment is spacious, high ceilings and has everything you need. The style was lovely. We enjoyed our stay!

We absolutely loooved staying here and would definitely recommend and stay here again! The location is great, Ubahn is a few minutes away and it is close to many cafes and shops and restaurants. The place is super interesting and cosy and spotless clean. One of our best stays:)

Superb apartment that felt like a home. This is what you what from airbnb, even the plates and kitchenware felt like they were chosen with care. We felt directly at home and no hazzle what so ever. Will recommend to friends! :)

Thank you Lucia for a great apartment that was close to everything we needed. The flat is very nice and has everything. Lucia also communicated really well when we had a slight problem that was not her fault.

This is a gorgeous apartment located in such a cool, vibrant neighbourhood. The host was so helpful in allowing us to check in late and also in providing a list of recommended local restaurants and bars. This place is a must book!
Very charming, clean, british style house in a very good location. Hosts are very friendly and easy going. 100 % recommendation!

Perfect! Building is noisy but the emplacement is perfect for going out at night and is really clean!
David is a nice host and give all the information needed :)
Will definitley check if this is apartment is avalible the next time i go to berlin. Great price, perfect for a couple or two and great placement!

David’s place was well equipped with all that we needed for a weekend. Very clear check-in instructions and spacious, clean space. David was very kind, attentive and very quick to respond. Would definitely recommend!

Great location, close to local amenities. Fantastic host, accommodating and helpful. Would highly recommend for a break away, had everything you could possibly need for either short or long term stay.

Great location! The apartment is clean and spacious, well located in Berlin. Next to a supermarket which made my life easier. David was very kind at all times and communication was on point! We’ll definitely recommend

David’s place was very conveniently located. The nearby train station could take us directly to the airport and also central Berlin. We had a very early flight and the location of the Airbnb made getting to the airport extremely easy and stress free.

David’s place was fantastic. Walking distance to Ostkreuz which is very close to the airport, and also walking distance to the Friedrichshain neighbourhood which has lots of great cafes and restaurants. The apartment is spacious, simple and clean - that’s all we needed. It’s also next door to a supermarket. David is very responsive if there’s anything else required, would definitely stay here again

David's place was a very nice stay, we felt right at home. Everything was exactly as described and very tidy. The subway stations were a bit of a walk for Berlin standards and the windows were non see-through because it was on the ground floor but nothing too problematic and perfect for a nice Berlin-trip. We would recommend it.

Amazing Airbnb, super clean and high tech. I loved the DeLonghi espresso/coffee machine, you can make delicious cappuccinos with it! Great desk, chair and 2nd screen setup in the main bedroom which is a great work space. I would definitely stay here again

Jan and his wife are extremely hospitable hosts. The apartment was fully ( and this means fully ) equipped with anything you could imagine you would need during the stay. Jan was quick to respond to inquiries, very caring and friendly. Apartment itself is very spacious yet very cozy. Kids loved it too ( especially the climbing wall ;)

Jan was an EXCELLENT host, and we had a great time staying in Berlin. Upon arrival, Jan actually met us at the train station - a welcomed greeting after a long day of travel. He gave us a tour of the neighborhood, orienting us to nearby shopping, dining, and transportation. Jan also gave us a thorough tour of the home, including things not so common to non-European travelers. The location itself is beautifully renovated and centrally located, with eco-friendly appliances, making an extremely comfortable stay. Absolutely recommend Jan and this location for your next visit to Berlin, 5 stars all the way!

Great host, good location for business porpuses, direct communication downtown with the metro.
The house is like on the pictures, extremelly clean, the kitchen is super well equipped. You feel like at home. 100% recommended.
It was a very comfortable stay. The hosts helped a lot and were very accommodating. Would definitely recommend to my friends and family

Jan's place is architecturally beautiful, nicely decorated, and well maintained. The neighborhood is very peaceful and excellent for walking. There are quality restaurants, bakeries, and grocery stores in the neighborhood within walking distance. Jan's place is also within walking distance of U-Bahn, S-Bahn and other transprtation means. A+ in all aspects. I will revisit Jan's place when I come back to Berlin.
We had an amazing stay, Jan and Sally welcomed us warmly and the flat is very very nice!

The place is lovely and everything was super clean! Supermarket at 5 min by walkg and Uban / S / tram at 10 min.
The only thing was that 2 shutters out of 3 were stucked up and we couldn't close them for the entire stay. I'm sure the owner will have them fixed for the next stay. But apart from this, we really enjoyed our stay there!

Everything was adequate as posted, host was always accessible and very helpful. I’m more than happy to recommend this one to anyone!
Thanks for everything, Georgy

We had a great time in Georgy’s appartement! Great location and the apartment has everything you need. The only thing you need to consider is that the apartment is on the ground floor so there may be some noise from outside. Other than that the apartment is great!

A great place to stay in Prenzlauer Berg. It's newly refurbished and nicely furnished without too much deco stuff. The kitchen is well equipped and the bed very comfortable. Super clean, I felt very comfortable. Would definitely book again with Georgy!

The place is suitable for a short stay for two people. It was clean and had a nice shower and good heating. There were some main necessities missing from the kitchen such as a frying pan, and we didn’t have an iron. After trying to contact the host about bad wifi connection, we never received an answer from him. The next day though, the wifi connection was up and running again. Overall, a nice place.

Georgy has a nice, well functioning apartment in a very cosy neighbourhood . It is very clean and comfortable.
He is answering your questions fast.
There was only one problem in my opinion:
I am very sensitive to noise and there was noise from the street.
But five stars out of six.
Nice little apartment. Just noisy because of the street directly in front of the flat. But for a short trip for four it was absolutely fine!

The location is convenient and close to all the essential places one needs. The apartment itself is good enough for a short stay. The door is on the road, so it gets noisy at night, with loud people around, making it difficult to sleep. Also, the curtains are not blinds, so there is a lot of light, which is a problem if you are a light sleeper. It is recommended for a short stay but not a long one. The check-in instructions were wrong, and it took time for the host to respond to correct it
Everything was good except exhaust in washroom which after few times smells alot other than that all good.
Great location and ideal for our trip to Berlin. Host was great at answering any questions that I had.

I stayed in the place with some friends and we totally enjoyed the apartment: very beautiful and cozy and the communication with the host was easy and timely. Additionally, the neighbourhood was super nice and vibrant! Definitely will consider again to book this apartment when I will plan to come back in Berlin in the future.
Sandra is a great host! Beautiful home! Perfect location! My daughter and I loved our stay. Next time that I’m in Berlin I would definitely make every effort to stay there again.

Sandra's place was perfectly located for us. It was very close to my brother's apartment and it's in a neighborhood with more restaurants and cafes than you can possibly ever visit. It was great for travel with a toddler since there are so many parks near by and the apartment was equipped with a pack 'n play, highchair and even toys. Communication with Sandra was easy and quick. We hope to stay here next time we visit!

Sandra’s place was cozy and everything we needed for a week of traveling and working remotely. She was also very accommodating when I added a guest last minute. The neighborhood is really lovely, away from the touristy stuff and has great coffee shops and restaurants. At the same time, it was easy to get around by walking or taking the U-bahn and S-bahn and trams.
This apartment is really valuable. Everything was exactly like in the description. I really recommend it! The bus station is a five minute walk away from the apartment.The host is a awesome person!

It is the best Airbnb I ve ever stayed at. It was clean, communication with the owner was fast and efficient. The price was also really competitive and affordable. The apartment is perfect for 1, 2 and even 3 people.
Cute apartment. There's a tram station nearby, a few restaurants, bakeries and cafés. The river "Spree" is also just a short walk away. Villiam was responsive and friendly. Would stay there again.
Villiam was a great host, always responsive and very helpful. I would definitely recommend and will come back if available for booking! Thank you for everything

The apartment is beautiful, comfortable, clean and had everything what we needed! There are coffe shops, restaurants, super markets, etc.. all around it. It is only 1,5 km from Check-point Charlie and many other sightseeing in Berlin. Uta was very friendly and told us we could contact her if we need anything else. We really felt at home and would love to come back to the same place! Thank you very much Uta.
The apartment was beautiful and everything was nearby!  Uta was an amazing host, highly recommended!

Very nice and clean house, we feel at home! The apartment is near to underground and public transports. Potsdamer Platz is 5 minutes walking from it.
Description of apartment and pictures are accurate.
I strongly recommend this accommodation.

This place is perfectly located for exploring everything Berlin has to offer. Most of the main attractions are about 20 minutes walk away.
The apartment is roomy (2 double bedrooms), a large dining / living room, kitchen, and a bathroom with a great shower!
Uta was very welcoming and willing to provide any help needed.
We would definitely return to this place.

We had an amazing time! Uda is so nice, responsive and friendly.
The place is well located, I would come back without any hesitation ☺️

Uta's place was  excellent.  the rooms were spacious and tidy. the kitchen was spacious and functional. The washer/dryer was a great benefit. The location was superb. Easy walking distance to S-Bahn stops and key sites in Mitte. Would highly recommend this AirBnB to anyone traveling to Berlin.

An amazing location, ridiculously close to the station and tourist spots such as Checkpoint Charlie and the Brandenburg Gate. Building work going on early in the morning was annoying but a really lovely, central location flat

We were very happy staying at Uta's apartment. It was everything we hoped for and needed. Good location and transport links. Uta was very friendly, flexible, communicative and helpful. I would certainly stay there again and I would recommend it to others.

Uta's place is well thought out for those travelling. As a family of 4, we had plenty of space, even with 1 kid (14) sleeping on the giant couch. The location is close to bus stops, train stations and tram as well. Shops are all close by and it was quick and easy to get to all touristy places.
The apartment is spacious and has everything we needed. The large shower was also lovely. One of the best stays we've had in Europe and would certainly stay there again next time we come to Berlin.
We had some issues with our airline on our arrival, and Uta willingly offered to allow us to check in early.
Uta was very kind and was always available to help us. The apartment is spacious, modern and comfortable. Everything works perfectly. Without a doubt we would return!

Our flat in Berlin was the perfect location for seeing all the major sites and directly by a station for the S-Bahn. Very close walk to Potsdamer Platz and Mall of Berlin as well. Bedrooms are large and comfortable. We slept very well. Nice big screen to watch movies at night. Fully equipped kitchen, big bathroom and very handy washing machine. Uta is also an excellent host and was very quick to respond and answer any questions. She communicated very detailed instructions for both checkin and out. We would book again if returning to Berlin.

Uta was a great host. A few weeks before our stay, she reached out to help us figure out directions to the flat. She checked in with us throughout the lead up to our stay and while we were in the flat to ensure any questions or needs we had were met in a quick helpful fashion. The flat is easily accessible and walkable to the SBahn as well as restaurants and grocery.  I would highly recommend this flat to a family or small group visiting Berlin.
Beautiful apartment with an amazing shower and comfortable beds. Great base from which to explore Berlin and Uta was very responsive. We highly recommend staying here!

Quiet location and easily accessible to the city. Spacious, comfortable and clean apartment.
Great host who answered any questions promptly and helped with any advice needed.
Would recommend this place to stay.
Very communicative and friendly host. The apartment is well-located near Postdamer Platz, easy to connect to the rest of Berlin. Comfy beds and good shower - would recommend.

The location was fantastic, great transport links and a lovely area. Flat was really attractive with good facilities. Kitchen was well stocked and had all what we needed.
Our only negatives were that the sofa bed was uncomfortable for sleeping, but fortunately the double bed was very spacious and comfy so we all slept in there.
Also cleaning equipment e.g. vacuum cleaner would have been nice for keeping the flat clean as we were there for almost a week.
Joana’s apartment is lovely - very clean, comfortable, spacious and well equipped. A great place to come home to. Joana is quite attentive and helpful she is truly a super host!
The apartment is beautiful and cozy! Check in was smooth and the apartment was very clean. I would gladly stay here again, there are tons of great restaurants and cool things to do in the area.
Absolutely loved our stay in Berlin! The house was so comfortable and in a great location. Joana was super helpful and gave a great list of recommendations!!!!
Great location and amazing place to stay while in Berlin. Joana was super responsive and provided tons of amazing local recommandations. I would book this place again in a heartbeat.

This was one of the best airbnbs I have ever stayed in. spacious apartment with excellent decoration. the apartment has everything you might need. also located in one of my favorite neighborhoods in Berlin.

Zack's apartment is very nice and well connected. You can have all the necessary for your holiday and live in an artistic atmosphere.
The area of Tempelhof is quite nice and calm, plus you can arrive in very few time in the center and places like Kreuzberg and Neukölln.
Zack has been kind and present for al my requests.
I really recommend this place!

Zack was very friendly and proactive in his responses, also flexible when it came to checking in. The flat is as advertised, very close to subway station, in a quiet side street! It's very cozy and unique, the real Airbnb feel :)

I've spent a wonderful couple of days in Zack's cosy little apartment close to Tempelhofer Feld. The place is nicely decorated and well equipped. I was even able to use the washing machine. The flat also has a nice little balcony. Zack was very friendly and reactive throughout the entire stay. I will definitely come back!

Great staff, very amenable, and very friendly.  The main downside was no AC, but luckily much of my stay was during a strange “cool” week in the Berlin summer so it wasn’t so bad.  I don’t have any complaints about staff, cleanliness, location, etc.  I think because the hotel seconds as an AirBnB it was WAY OVERPRICED, but this is not the fault of the staff or management and to be fair was on the low end of other properties available at the time for the good quality of accommodation.  They did very well and it was a pleasant stay.
The location is perfect and the staff were super kind and helpful. The rooms were very spacious and clean. I recommend this place 100%. Thank you for everything.

I really enjoyed my stay at Living Hotel. The kitchenette was incredibly useful, and was relatively well-stocked. They didn’t have any non-wood nonstick friendly spatulas or cooking utensils. The bedding was very comfortable, but felt a little musty. The furnishings are dated, but pretty well-maintained. The location is great, very close to the Märkisches Museum U-Bahn stop.

I really enjoyed my stay. the room though old, had quite a lot of charm. it was spacious and had everything i needed, including cooking essentials, it was very clean, and no parts of in were unfunctional or broken. located right outside metro station that connects to all of berlin.

The place looked exactly like the photos, although it seemed bigger in the pictures. In reality, it was smaller than we expected, but nothing unbearable, we got used to it quickly.
The location was perfect, right in the center, with both a bus station and a metro station nearby. You could even rent bicycles for the day, which we found really helpful. The neighborhood was peaceful, and the kitchenette came in handy since we were able to cook breakfast whenever we could.
Once, our door got stuck and the key wouldn’t work in the lock, but the hotel staff responded very quickly within about 15 minutes they had it fixed and helped us get back in. We really appreciated their prompt assistance.
Overall, a great experience.

A gorgeous apartment in a great central location in Berlin. Close to the metro, but we also were able to walk to a lot of places! Beautiful artwork in the apartment and unique architecture.
Maria was very nice and we understand we were staying over the holidays, but she was a bit unresponsive to our messages on airbnb. Later she said she could get back to us if we messaged her on WhatsApp so that was a better form of communication.
Overall, we were very pleased with our stay and would recommend this beautiful place to others!
Great apartment with a big terrace, nice beds and very close to u-bahn.  Lots of nice restaurants nearby as well, would recommend a trip to Spandau!
Large, modern, well-appointed flat in an excellent location. Walkable to many sights and transit is very close. Spectacular terrace! Hosts were very helpful. We had a great time staying here!
a spacious well equipped apartment in a very central location near to a huge range of amenities, including seconds away from the metro ... perfect for exploring Berlin

We had a lovely stay in one of the most gorgeous buildings in Berlin! The apartment is spacious, private, quiet, and the terrace deck is a real treat. Communication was very smooth. A few things could be improved such as issues with bathroom and shower drain (leaking and clogged), door from livingroom to terrace is semi-broken/cannot open, and the check in is a bit tricky to figure out how to actually open the door - make sure to watch the YouTube tutorial rather than read instructions. Although there is room to improve, I would certainly stay here again!  :-)

The apartment was visually lovely as was the terrace. Beds and sofa comfortable. But however functional, the apartment has a few issues.
The sound system would not connect and the TV isn't listed but apparently you can use your Netflix subscription. Lucky for us, we took our own small speaker but couldn't figure out the Netflix. Worth noting, the shower leaked and the knobs to turn on the water flow need to be turned on in the WC first. The hob works but the oven does not.
Mia was very quick to respond to questions and offered up the advice about the TV and Netflix.
We had a great stay in Berlin!

Amazing apartment in a great location!
It was very clean, and I would surely recommend it

This is an amazing loft type apartment with two big double bedrooms, in a fabulous location close to the underground and / or walking distance of some great bars and restaurants as well as the major sights of Berlin. The host was fabulous and responsive to communications and lovely terrace which was fabulous for a relaxing drink in the evening. Rooms were big and beds lovely and comfortable.
The only slight downsides (and they were quite minor) were the access to the apartment, through several locked doors with a very tricky last lock on the actual door to the apartment(virtually impossible with hands full!), there were also minimal instructions as to how the ‘high tech’ gadgets such as blinds, roof windows and the most high tech kettle I’ve ever seen worked although lots of information on the recycling.
Also be aware there is no music system / TV access at the property is just for your own streaming (there is a TV but no channels).
Overall highly recommended.

Thank you very much for accomodating us in your wonderful apartment. It was clean and tidy, close to transport, shops, restaurants and nightlife. I highly recommend your property and would love to stay again.

Amazing deal and beautiful apartment - looks ever better in person. Spacious, clean and private. The place is central to everything with lots of great restaurants surrounding it.
Would recommend to anyone! Mia was an great and responsive host

We, a family of two kids aged 11 and 14, and two adults, had a comfy and convenient stay in the apartment. It suited our needs very well and we had a great stay! We had breakfast on the balcony and liked that the apartment is close to the u-Bahn. I can highly recommend it!

Fantastic location excellent transport links Easy to walk to Central Areas.  Very comfortable beds and a lovely outside area to relax.  Historic place which captures the heart of Berlin.  We were unlucky that the lift didn’t work and we had to climb a lot of stairs.  We turned this around and stayed out enjoying the sights of Berlin.

Great apartment in an ideal location for central Berlin sights and public  transport.  Well equipped, spotlessly clean, everything working as described. An Edeka supermarket just 50m up the road for any supplies needed.

Lisa is an excellent host. I really enjoyed my stay at her house. It is a lovely and very clean place to stay. To share the house is a very cool setting, makes the whole stay very comfortable and feeling like home. I liked this a lot.
Thank you Lisa 😊

I loved everything about the place and Lisa is very accomodating to most questions I have. She would also help to make coffee and breakfast if she's available! Do note that Lisa is taking care of multiple kids, the house and working as well, so please do not expect her to keep everything spick and span like a hotel. It is as clean as a regular home is so I'm sure that's not an issue with most people. She has lovely kids so if you don't mind some interaction, it's a nice family to stay with. Hope to return again!

Lisa’s apartment is beautiful and of great value! We were just 15-20 minutes from city center which was convenient by tram or taxi. I came with my family for the Berlin marathon and we enjoyed our stay very much. Would recommend!

This place is outstanding! Everywhere you look there’s a design detail, the space is welcoming, with character and super comfortable :) - the location is superb!  great coffee almost next door, plenty of restaurants and cool places to hangout around, this neighborhood is so lively yet  quite and so close to the metro/train station that getting around  was super easy. It’s been one of my best stays in Berlin. Thanks Alexander for your hospitality as well

Alexandr's place is at very good location. Near subway ect.yet it is calm and quiet neighbourhood. Alex is a very nice host. He answers questions quickly and he is helpful. The flat is just right for two people. The kitchen is very tiny for some basics bit there are lots of restaurants around.

A great place in Berlin! Alex was lovely and very helpful with check in and recommendations, and even went a step further and left us some drinks in the fridge! We loved the area so much, there were many great restaurants and bars nearby and it was very easy to get to the train station!
A great place, comfortabele, not to small, big enough for the two if us. Classic and  modern design, just the place to rest while visiting Berlin. Hope to be back one day.
Wonderful host, good neighborhood, great studio apartment. We had no plans on cooking so it was perfect for us.
Great stay. The apartment was in a very nice location and well connected. Alex was super friendly and responsive. Would totally recommend!

Location location location, Alex’s place is situated at a perfect spot with many restaurants bars and fun places to go to within several minutes walk. The building is quiet and the space has its own unique character. Would love to go back next time!

I enjoyed my stay at Alex's apartment. Very comfortable, clean, great neighborhood. Alex is a lovely host. He met me upon my arrival and carried my luggage. Apartment is up one flight of stairs. I would stay there again. Many thanks, Alex!

Alexander’s Airbnb was very nice! The location is amazing, right next to a bunch of restaurants and cafes and with a big U Bahn stop just 5 mins away. The place itself was cool and unique, with beautiful high ceilings that make it feel very big and a comfortable bed with nice sheets. Alexander was also very accommodating with allowing a friend to stay with us for two days of our stay. Overall we loved it and would definitely stay there again. The one thing to note if you are going to be staying there is that there is not that much privacy for the bathroom. It is closed with a folding screen right next to the kitchen area and it is open at the top, so I wouldn’t recommend staying here with someone your not pretty comfortable around with the usual bathroom bodily functions. But in general, it is a great little apartment in a fantastic neighborhood.

Alex’s place was a lovely place to stay! Located in a very convenient location in Berlin, super close to Tiergarten and public transportation. Alex is a super responsive host and has recommendations if you need it. The only thing we weren’t aware of is the bathroom situation (no door and isn’t separated from rest of studio). Just be prepared to get comfortable if you’re staying with a friend!
Excellent place to stay. Very well equipped, very peaceful yet very well positioned. Host extremely helpful. What more could you want?
Great small studio in beautiful old Berlin apartment with high ceilings and view of courtyard.  Great location. Alexander was very helpful. Would come again.
We had a great stay at Alexander's, the apartment was very comfortable and beautifully furnished and the neighborhood pleasant and interesting and very well connected to the rest of the city!

Very clean, convenient place. Location is ideal for tourism, surrounded by awesome restaurants and good ambience bars.
With all the basic appliances, you will need to bring nothing with you to spend quality time at the apartment.

I had a great stay here. It was located in a prime location, walking distance to public transportation, restaurants and bars. The only negative part of my stay was that we had to walk up and down multiple flights of stairs in order to get to our room. Besides that tiny inconvenience, everything else was great.

Nice little stay in a beautiful neighbourhood. you can reach whole berlin from there pretty easy.
the rooms are small but enough for a short stay for 4
Great! Eugen a great host. Very easy to communicate and the place was just like the pictures and very clean. 100% recomendable

Eugen was great!  We even managed to lock the keys inside (note—just because you have to lock the door with the key on the inside, doesn’t mean it isn’t partially locked if you go out!)—he fixed it, thanks, Eugen!

poor communication, fuses blew tried to call and got nothing back for a long time. Stains all over pillows,  bathroom smells ( think there’s some drainage problem). good location though and easy check in
Place is well suited for 4. It only has a kitchenette but enough to make basic meals and prepare for breakfast. great location with walking distance to many shops and restaurants.
Nice place, responsive host.  It's a fairly basic apartment, and the 4 floors of stairs are hard work - not suitable for anyone who has difficulty with stairs.

The apartment fits the description and pictures shared on the ad.
It is really well located, we mainly visited Berlin walking. The apartment was really quiet and beds are confortable.
We did not meet Eugen but he was answering our messages in a timely manner.
We had the opportunity to store our luggage in a separate room before check-in and after check-out.
We enjoyed our stay in Berlin.
Great location, windows to inner yard, no street noise. Eugen is great host, really quick and friendly.

Lovely appartment that allowed us to spend some quality time in and around Berlin with our family.
Communication with Eugen has been very easy. Definitely recommended!
Eugen's appartment is very well located but also very quiet. We had a very nice week in Berlin, I'm happy with our choice ;-)
Location perfect. Apartment tidy and functional. 101 stairs was a challenge on late nights/early mornings.
Great apartment in front of the u-bahn. Great location, Well equipped and comfortable beds. We were two families of 4 and fitted really good. We would repeat!

This flat was great! We were a group of friends that went for a weekend in Berlin and This place suited us perfectly. Clean, fresh, easy to contact the owner.
If I have to mention something that we didn’t like, is that it was only one mirror (in the bathroom) that was not suitable for makeup cause you stand far away. So a big advise! Get a full body mirror somewhere in the flat and it will be all perfect 🙏🏽👍
Very nice apartment, clean and well equipped. We had some problems with the key box and the code, but Holiday 33 was quick replaying and found good solutions.

Loved the accommodation and would definitely book again! Clean, great location and great communication with the host. We were with 6 and I think that is the max to have a comfortable stay there. The bathroom had great amenities, and the kitchen was stocked with anything you would need. The beds were very good and had multiple blankets and pillows. Rooms were bigger than in the pictures, so we were very pleased. The hosts have a wall with all kinds of different recommendations. The apartment is right next to the U-bahn, S-bahn and bus. The only remarks are that the wifi connection is very bad and the terrace is very small (max 3 people).

Good flat .  The place is quiet.  There is everything you need for a comfortable sleep.  Communication with the owner and availability.  It is a pity that the flight was postponed for a day, so we would have stayed longer and did not find the war in Ukraine.

Simon was happy to answer questions both before and during our stay and was flexible on arriving earlier and staying a bit later the location is quiet and the beds were really comfortable it’s well situated near a tube station and you can reach Alexanderplatz within minutes, locally we found a nice cafe too for breakfast. I would recommend this location for a stay in Berlin.
We had a great stay! The location was close to the metro into town and the place was nice overall.

Such a great host, had a few issues with our flights and Simon was so helpful and accommodating, we couldn’t ask for more. The apartment was perfect for what we needed and had very good transport links. We would highly recommend the pizza place just along the road!
Amazing Airbnb, was spotless and had everything we need, loved the Kitchen + was actually much more spacious than the pictures. Thank you so much Simon!
Simon’s place was beautiful and so spacious for two of us. Had everything we needed for a few days in Berlin and access to the shared courtyard was an added bonus

We were given very thorough instructions for check in, which really helped. The place itself feels nice and private with everything we needed for the week. We checked in a little early, but Miriam (the cleaner) was lovely and let us put our stuff in after our long journey to get there.
The place is super close to the U6 line, which gets you in to the centre of Berlin really easily, so you don't feel too far away from everything.
We felt safe and comfortable for our stay, which is invaluable in a foreign country- we would definitely stay here again next time we're in Berlin!
Nice little apartment, that had everything we needed for a few days in Berlin. The area was quiet, and the apartment was close by U-bahn and busstops.
Great location, right next to a park and close to public transport. There were grocery stores nearby, and the neighborhood was quiet and pleasant. I definitely recommend it!

This Airbnb was an absolute gem and a delight to stay in! The area is great and convenient as it is close to both the Hbf and a U-Bahn station into the centre, and cafes, a supermarket, and a pharmacy are also close by. This apartment is particularly cute as it leads directly onto a courtyard and is next to a park (but not accessible from the park). It’s also slightly off from the other apartments in the building so feels private and away from the street. It is a perfect space for 1-2 people, with cute and functional kitchen and bathroom, and felt like a home. I would definitely recommend for solo travellers or couples looking to stay in Berlin!
The flat was in a great location and very spacious for a company of 6 - can highly recommend!
lovely flat right in the centre of the action. Very clean, communication perfect, check in super easy. Thank you.
Great place for a group! Clean and not too far away from restaurants etc. Not all rooms have dark curtains

Great AirBnB for a weekend trip with your friends with an amazing location! The hosts were responsive and the check-in easy and flexible. The only 'downside' was the one bathroom for seven women (but that's personal preference).
Perfect place for our family. Easy to get around thanks to Berlin’s amazing transport system. Lovely accommodation thank you

We had an amazing time and we loved the apartment. It is perfect for 5 persons. Super spacey and clean. There is everything you need for your stay.
The neighborhood is really nice and there is a tram just crossing the street, which is perfect to move around.
Thank you for the amazing communication and for being our hosts.
Would highly recommend!
I had a great stay at this apartment !! Right next to the metro so it is extremely easy to get anywhere you want to go !! Such a cozy space and great hosts.

Fully equipped apartment and everything works well. Host is responsive and helpful. Cooking stuff like live oil, salt, tea bags, etc. are provided, which is nice for short-term travelers. Two bedrooms are in different floor levels so won't disturb each other. Neighborhood is a lovely bustling area. 4th floor can be exhausting for people who have knee issues, but for people who don't mind, I definitely recommend this apartment!

The apartment was as described and very spacious. Communication with the host was friendly and fast.
The kitchen is well equipped, perfect for a longer stay.
We felt comfortable, would highly recommend

The location is great right in the heart of Berlin mitte with fantastic restaurants and shops around. The flat looks better in the picture than in reality everything is a bit used and less “shiny”. Flat is quite dark but has a nice little terrace and sunlight in the afternoon hours. basically a nice apartment you pay for the location and commodity to be in the best spot of Berlin. Communication for checkin and check out was very clear and Anja was always very fast and responsive. She let us leave our bags longer the last day which was a plus.
Really recommend this apartment. Right in the middle of everything but the flat is back from the street so no noise. Lots of space and having a little balcony is really nice.

Anja's flat is right in the middle of Berlin Mitte, on a very trendy street with individual shops, cafes & restarants. Although it's a main street, there isn't much trafic (the apartment isn't facing the street). It's a large, bright apartment and we enjoyed the chilling out space after a lot of activities in town. Since it was very hot week, two large fan on each floor were very helpful and the provision in the kitchen was good as well.
