Museum Islans and Hackescher Markt are within easy walking disctance, with 2 large supermarkets nearby. The noodles at Dump Ling, next door restaurant, was surprisingly good that we went there twice during our stay.
Anya and Linda were very kind to allow us to leave our luggage in the apartment until we left Berlin, which was so helpful:)

The house is lovely and spacious. There are 3 bedrooms and also a sitting area, a kitchen, a balcony and two separate levels except that it is the fourth floor without an elevator and that the light at the entrance was flashing. Everything was perfect Thank you for the warm hospitality.

Most airbnbs feel pretty generic, but this space has a unique and artistic touch that makes the space so relaxing and pleasant to be in. The location is great—just steps away from many restaurants, bakeries, and the underground. In a lively part of mitte, not the office-y vibe part. It’s 5 flights up, no elevator, so we got our exercise too!

If you’re looking for a comfortable place in Berlin to stay, definitely give Anja’s place a try. I enjoyed my stay there immensely. The only thing I didn’t really like was the teeny tiny bathroom (it was totally serviceable though so no complaints about that). Check-in (via a lockbox) was without hassle and the instructions given by the host couldn’t be more clear.
I’d love to stay there again on my next visit to Berlin.

Impeccable location and spacious accommodations were the highlight of this apartment. The beds were comfortable and the shower had great pressure and temperature. My family of four felt right at home here during our stay. I highly recommend.

We had a lovely stay in this apartment. We were travelling for work and the place was the perfect balance, offering confort and space in a very nice neighbourhood.
Access was pretty easy and so were the exchanges with the hosts. I can only recommend it and than them for a great experience!

Had a lovely stay at Anja's place! Her co-host Jenn was very proactive, reaching out to make sure I was okay when I forgot to alert them that my train was delayed - the instructions given for getting in were very clear as well. The place itself is very nicely decorated, with some unique Berlin charm to it - it actually felt like I was staying in Berlin rather than a standard non-descript hotel room - always a positive in my opinion.
I didn't stay inside very much as I was here to get out and about as much as possible, and on that front the apartment is a winner. It's within walking distance of pretty much everywhere you would want to go, and for places a bit further out the transport links are also fantastic.
I would definitely stay here again if it is available next time I'm in Berlin - thanks Anja and Jenn!
Great location and beautiful bright flat. I was able to work from home for a few days very easily.

Great appartment with restaurants, supermarket en icecream (my children loved that) in proximity. Though on busy street; we had no hinder of streetnoise. If you use 4 bedrooms, you dont have a living room (1 rooms serves as a bed/living room). Appartment is perfect (altough a bit worn out), spacious rooms, good beds.
We had a great stay with no problems at all. The check in was very easy and clear.
Tidy, well-kept apartment space, very accomodating for larger groups. Close proximity to transport, restaurants and shops. Great spot

Ana Maria’s place was PERFECTION. Easy check-in, she was super responsive and helpful, especially considering it was my first time in Berlin. Place was clean, spacious, and in a beautiful location. I felt right at home. I even locked myself out at 12 at night and Ana helped me get back inside immediately by calling local door opening services. Would 100% stay here again and recommend to anyone looking to stay in Berlin in extreme comfort.
I had a great stay, room is spacious and clean, could really get my rest! Host was very friendly and kind.

Host was extremely lovely and welcoming.
Rooms was very comfortable, and the space was really nice, absolutely loved it. I wanted to stay in the room more than go out and about exploring.
Great price for the room, absolutely worth it and would go back in a heart beat.

Lovely stay with Kerstin, she was a wonderful host and made me feel very welcome and looked after!
Would highly recommend it and would stay again.
Great stay in Berlin! Comfortably fit nine people, easily accessible by public transport and in a good location.

Absolute wonderful experience. Communication with Lennard was wonderful. Everything went absolutely smooth, responses always came very swiftly and kindly. The Apartment is beautifully designed and put together. Everything you need, I found the location great to, easy to get around and so many good places in Friedrichshain in general, plus this must have been the stay that was the quietest location in Berlin so far.
Very enjoyable and a big recommendation.

My partner and I were in Berlin for work and we stayed 9 days at Lennard’s and Michelle’s. Their place is lovely, light, comfortable and cozy. It has plenty of public transport options nearby. Lennard and Michelle at very friendly and they showed us around when we arrived. We had a wonderful stay and I wholeheartedly recommend their place of you’re going to Berlin!

Lennard's apartment is full of light, and faces a square with trees and green grass. The flat has everything you need, even for serious cooking :) The location is quiet and calm. Food stores are close and so is access to public transport. Lennard is a friendly and polite host. Warm recommendations!

This place is beautiful and perfectly located. Lennard and Michelle were wonderful hosts that went above and beyond to make me feel at home. I'd recommend this place to anyone who is looking for a central location with a local vibe and modern luxury aesthetics
This apartment is beautiful. Very nice neighborhood. I would absolutely book with them again. Very nice and helpful hosts

Lennard was an excellent host! He was a clear and quick communicator, and he went above and beyond to ensure we had a good stay. The neighborhood is fairly quiet - between two more busy neighborhoods with restaurants and bars. With that said, there was some tasty international cuisine nearby. It was family friendly and very accessible. We were able to take a few train lines within a 10-15 minute walk. We enjoyed hanging on the deck and exploring the neighborhood on foot. I would definitely recommend this space!

Petra’s place is awesome — it’s in a great area and is super clean and cool. Petra was really friendly and made everything super easy for us (like letting us leave our luggage etc). We would definitely stay here again!

This place was cute, in a great location, and the host was super friendly, accommodating, and sweet. Lots of construction noise (so not great if ur a light sleeper or have a little one). Loved the little cafes around and the little area serving drinks and grilled cheese.

I definitely enjoyed my stay! Petra and her mother are very kind and approachable hosts. The room had everything I needed and was clean and comfortable. The common areas (kitchen and rooftop terrace) were also very comfortable and tidy. As a female solo traveller, I didn't always feel 100% comfortable walking in the neighbourhood by night, but by day time the neighbourhood felt very vibrant and hip!

The B&B is located in Neuköln between two underground stations with which you can explore easily Berlin. Nearby is plenty of shops, restaurants, cafes and supermarket. The Kaliburni Hotel has a common kitchen fully equipped. Our room was extremely clean, comfortable and simple in a positive way. I really enjoyed the animal paints on the walls that if you like you can buy. Also the balcony in common is great: you can have a nice view of the city. I also appreciated that the owner allowed us to make check in early. In general excellent value for money.
It was a very cozy place and petra is an amazing host! The supermarket and metro station is in a walkable distance. Thank you for the stay!
great accomodation in a hip environment. so truly Berlin it hurts. the museum across the street is great, the hood is pure Neukölln.
Lovely and cozy home in a beautiful area, ideal location for an extended stay. Will definitely look to stay here again during my next visit!!

This was a nice stay. A clean space, location was fine. There was a big problem with the key/ lock system, as they are unusual door handles that were difficult to use. Also a fair amount of noise from the office below in the mornings. The space had everything you needed, and the courtyard was lovely. Great local recommendations too

Really cool place! Super quiet and cozy, clean, had all the useful kitchen and household bits. Jan was really helpful.
Enjoyed my stay and would book again.
We had a great stay at Jan’s place. A beautiful apartment, walkable area, and easy access to all of downtown Berlin. We’d definitely stay here again.

My stay at Jan's place was effortless! There were no doubts or issues from check in to check out, which is such a relieve when traveling. The place itself is honestly one of my favorite Airbnbs yet, super cozy attic loft which i found to be quite roomy with tons of natural light from the skylights. Exactly as described and very well kept. Jan was polite, prompt replies, quite clear with instructions and offered everything you may need to feel at home. 10/10 recommend to anyone.
A super cozy place in a great neighborhood. Even though I was traveling it sure did feel like home 😍
The place is exactly what is offered and it is really confortable. Kreuzberg is a great area and you will find nice bars and restaurants nearby
Super cute little space. Very cosy and comfortable. I loved staying here and will definitely be back!
Great stay in a quiet, quirky and interesting part of Berlin! Host was very responsive and helpful, and the place was as described. Would definitely stay again!
We stayed for a weekend there and it was amazing! Very comfy, not loud, pretty easy to access, i recommend !
I love that place and there are restaurants, markets, cafes all around and close to my fav areas in berlin
We had a great stay, highly recommend for a short trip to Berlin, close to public  transport and tourist attractions.
An absolutely lovely stay! Felt very homely and was so nice and clean 🙏🏼  Anca was so wonderful, very helpful with suggesting local spots and always responsive. Would definitely recommend!

This location is perfect for a stay in Berlin. Close enough to just about everything most tourists are after from Berlin either by foot, or a very short train trip. So much to do, see, eat & drink within the immediate surrounds. Definitely recommend & will aim to re-book for future visits. 😊

Don't let the fact that this amazing studio is a little further out of Central Berlin put you off. It's worth the extra time and distance to enjoy this unique studio in a amazing industrial setting. The owners obviously take pride in their place and everything is beautifully curated. It has everything you need, I was extremely grateful for the laundry facilities, and it's absolutely private and peaceful at night. The hosts were extremely responsive and helpful and provided great advice and recommendations. We'd stay here again in a heartbeat and recommend it to any other couples, especially creative types! Thanks Jürgen and Julien.

Jürgen and his team were super responsive and helpful during my entire booking and stay, that was much appreciative. I would also add that the pictures and descriptions are very accurate. If you looking to stay somewhere that’s outside of the Berlin center and experience a more local neighborhood, then this place is for you. But if you are looking to be in a more central location, or if you’re traveling alone, I’d make sure that this experience works for you. I’m glad I had this trip here as it helped me learn Berlin even more, but I had to get used to being a bit off the beaten path.

Looks exactly like the photos pretty easy walk to train station also it’s easy to order uber pick up’s . Unit is very stocked up on little essentials that were not expected was very pleased and the coffee maker is the best I experienced at Airbnb . Super quite and safe area felt at home
The energy of the place is top shelf. It takes an hour to get to where the action is but the neighbourhood is quiet and quaint. The studio itself is a hidden gem

Awesome apartment! Love the interior. Right in the heart of one of Berlin’s main hotspots. The night was busy but once you shut the windows I personally could sleep just fine - wasn’t as noisy as I thought it would be. Spati next door, everything is so close! Amazing location and had a wonderful stay.

Markus was a great host and the location was very convenient for getting around the city! The apartment was the perfect size and just what we needed for not staying home too often! Highly recommend :)

The apartment was lovely, it is in a great location and is really easy to find! The host gave really clear instructions and made sure we had everything we needed.
Kitchen was small but useable and bathroom, shower and beds were all perfect.
Would recommend!
Room was not cleaned yet when we arrived but the host reacted quickly and made sure everything was fixed!
Good for 2 ppl, tight space if you have 3. No mirrors in the unit besides small bathroom mirror. Very easy to find and get in. Comfortable space.
Great host but room did not match pictures and towels were rough and crusty but at least he provided them. Door locks were a bit of trouble but nothing bad.

We got to a nice apartment in a nice place. Unfortunately,there was a problem with the hot water in the shower. We were asked to wait another day for the company to come and check the shower - which is really unexceptable. We asked Mara to check us out after one night, found a different apartment in Berlin where we stayed for three more nights. To our surprise, Mara refused to check us out when we left, and insisted on charging for the whole four nights we ordered. Thanks to Airbnb we got our money back. This is not a way to treat guests!
Great apartment and location. Communication was very good. Nice touches like slippers, toiletries and extra blankets.

The apartment is very well located in a quiet area, with all the shops nearby.
The beds are of very good quality, the housekeeping is well taken care of.
Perfect for a weekend in Berlin.
Thank you

We had a great time in the appartment of Mara and Brigitte. It is spacious and well equipped, we immediately felt at home! The street is quiet, and public transport, supermarket, bakery and some nice restaurants are around the corner. The best place to relax after a day of sightseeing, musea visits, strolling through Berlins neighbourhoods and shopping.

We had a great stay in Berlin, the apartment was perfect for our needs and the location was very convenient. Mara was a fantastic host and was very helpful throughout, she even gave us fruit and water for our stay. One of my best experiences so far.

Great apartment close to station and in a residential area which is nice and quiet at night, although close to all the nightlife of Berlin. Two of us stayed there for 5 night for work and we found the apartment excellent. It was impeccably clean and had all the essentials for our stay. I ended up extending the stay by one night and Mara was super responsive and helped me sort that out. Can't recommend it enough. We'll definitely be coming back in years to come.

* Beautiful, quiet, well maintained apartment
* Had everything you could think of that you need
* Comfortable beds, pillows, high quality sheets and towels
* Great location, in walking distance to East Side Gallery and to public transport at Warschauer Str
* Super nice and responsive hosts
We thoroughly enjoyed our stay.
Great stay, loved the place and Mara was so helpful and responsive to any messages. Beds are very comfortable and the location is handy, thanks

Fantastic location - very close to many bars and restaurants, a big supermarket and the U Bahn. New ikea fit out. No real “living” area as I assume the original area has been now made into the second bedroom. We are two couples and we would have preferred somewhere with a lounge/living area. Great for a short stay.

This is the perfect location. Close to many eateries, coffee shops, bars and only a 15 min walk from the train station. The only issue I had was the response time via messaging, other than that the unit itself was perfect.
The apartment was great, clean and with a good location. About 7min walking to the nearest station and within a short walking distance from supermarkets, pharmacies and restaurants.

Nice, quite and clean place in a pleasant neighborhood. Probably too small for 6 people. Perfect for four. Not far away from Gesundbrunnen station.  Attention: the entrance to the flat is in an internal patio. Nice terrace
Good Airbnb. Location is nice, lots of cute cafes around. Pretty tight for 6 people but doable. Probably better for 4. Otherwise, good Airbnb! Patio was a nice addition.
Amazing stay. The place was nice and cosy, very clean, checkin was smooth, no issues with the place or service at all.
Great flat, about 15 minute scooter from the city centre but plenty to do within walking distance. Quality of the flat was perfect.
Very good value for money as long as you are aware that this is a fairly noisy neighbourhood (and building).

I really recommend this apartment, especially for people who want to stay in a quieter part of Berlin. Tom was a very good host, replying quickly for minor questions along the way. Access to central Berlin takes place easily, but more through buses than through trains.
The apartment provided what it advertised, so I recommend it.
Great area, the apartment was clean and exactly as described.  Tom was very friendly, helpful, and informative

We had a great stay at this apartment in Berlin Mitte. The location is fantastic, close to restaurants, shops, and public transportation. The view was incredible, and the apartment itself is stylish, spacious, and well-equipped with plenty of natural light. We would definitely stay here again and recommend it to anyone visiting Berlin.

We absolutely loved staying here!! It was a great location and the host provided lots of information on where to eat and what to do. The apartment was extremely clean and the bed was very comfortable. Would definitely stay here again!!

Really handy location in central Berlin. And the apartment looks exactly like the photos. As others have said, it’s pretty noisy. But if you wanted peace and quiet you wouldn’t be looking in this area of Berlin. Great apartment!
Terrific apartment in prime location. Great communication with the host. We were very comfortable and check in and out were very easy.

Myself and my partner loved staying here. The apartment was easy to find, easy to check in and just as described. Close to local amenities with several train stations within walking distance, we were able to easily find our way around. Helpfully there were recommendations written down in the apartment, and books to help you find your way around Berlin which we used both of.
The apartment was comfortable, cosy and had everything we needed. I would highly recommend this host to anyone wanting a local Berlin break!
Great apartment with everything you could need for your stay, Fantastic communication and instructions from the host. Great location near transport and walkable from other nice neighbourhoods.

The place was very clean and comfortable. The only thing that was a little difficult was finding the apartment. I would recommend using the koordinates and not the address, because the address leads to a grave in the graveyard next to the apartment complex
Perfect location and easy check in made this a great place for us on our recent visit. The hosts were really responsive and really went out of their way to help us out in a pinch, too.
Lovely apartment very clean, very cozy and 2 minute walk to the subway to get you round the city
Very grateful that I chose these apartments, cozy, clean, was everything that needed for staying. Great location, feeling safe and hosts answer really quickly if there is any questions.

Loved this place. Great vibrant part of town. Plenty of great places to eat and drink all within walking distance. Handy to airport and two well connected metro lines and even a direct bus from main train station. Fantastic. Apartment was easy to access (no internal stairs) compact and tidy. Local recommendations much appreciated too.

Very nice apartment, perfectly sized room for a Berlin trip to explore the city. The place is very close to the U-bahn which was amazing. The street is quite busy, but we didn't mind. We loved the recommendations about the cafe's and restaurants!
Gorgeous apartment and very private. I would definitely stay again. Thank you for a lovely holiday in Berlin
Micro’s place was very beautiful, located in a quiet neighbourhood, perfect distance to bike into the town (15-20 mins) and near a gorgeous river to walk along as well!
Mirco was a great host and the accommodation had everything we needed! Big plus for having a dryer.

Very clean apartment in a very quiet and safe neighborhood! If you're looking for a place in the heart of urban life, this is place is not for you. This place is excellent for those who are looking to stay at an area where you can enjoy peace and silence in the nighttime. Also, it has all the important amenities such as a washing machine and drier, so it's a good place for a longer stay also.
The only negative thing was really the fact that it's not very private. There's a straight visibility to the backyard terrace from a lot of apartments, and the kitchen has a huge window that the neighbors pass by constantly. Also, no desk or any other kind of table suitable for working.
All in all, Mirco was an excellent host! He was very helpful and friendly and made sure to keep the customer posted on all things needed!
A great apartment in a peaceful neighbourhood…although we didn’t eat in, the kitchen is very well equipped. Easy to access public transport links and Mirco was very easy to communicate with.

Very nice and comfy stay. Communication with Mirco went really well.
The bed was very comfortable and nice to relax in after sightseeing.
Modern and good isolated.
Beautiful place! Mirco, the host, is so flexible, friendly, helpful and available. Everything was as we expected, and we would recommend it to anyone.

Staying at Mirco’s roomy and stylish apartment was very relaxed, and the location is ideal if you’re looking to be in range of the city’s most colourful areas. The bay is minutes away - have a stroll or simply enjoy the view. There is even a full-size supermarket 5 minutes away! Simply a gem.

We loved this apartment.  It is close enough to transportation to get you anywhere in Berlin at any time of day.  It had all the amenities you need, plus an Aldi in walking distance to really make it livable.  We would repeat our stay in a heartbeat.  Beautiful, convenient, quiet, comfortable, and more.
Mirco's Airbnb was spacious and very clean, and it was just a short trip from the train station.  Mirco was very friendly and helpful with any questions I had. Overall, I had a very pleasant stay.

We enjoyed the place very much. Very good public transport connections.
I would recommend.

We had a wonderful time during our stay at Mirco’s lovely Airbnb. He was so friendly and accommodating and made sure we knew how everything worked upon arrival. He even provided shopping bags for the local Aldi! The flat was spotless and nicely decorated. We couldn’t have asked for more!

The house was nicely decorated and was quite large. My toddler had a lot of fun and was quite happy with the garden and the kids room. The neighborhood felt same and calm.
On the down side, the house could be a bit cleaner. The neighborhood is not very close to the city center, takes about 20 minutes by tram, so depending on what you’re looking for, that may be an issue.

Vincent’s place was very new, very clean with modern accessories.
Very responsive host, matched the description well. The apartment was very comfortable.
Note it’s on 5th floor so a few stairs to navigate.
Good place to stay! We're a group of 6, and the place were as described and very spacious! Host provided good instructions and we had no problem at all! Recommended! ✨
Thanks to the host for being so helpful! and we really enjoyed the apartment. the entrance just from the street was great too and very comfortable with a kid!
Clean and cosy apartments. Host is friendly immediate response. Was really comfortable to stay for our family.
We truely had an amazing stay in Claudia’s appartment for a week, it really felt like we were are home in Berlin for a while!

Nice place not too far from the central station. Around 25-30 minutes on an S-Bahn. Checking in was easy. Has about everything you’d need for a comfortable stay. I’d add a pan and a chopping board for when you’re too lazy to go out for a breakfast. ;) Otherwise, would totally recommend.

Lovely studio at the heart of Berlin’s one of the coolest neighborhood!
30 seconds walk to the canal and local bazaar on Tuesday and Friday!
Mandel is very kind and great communicator. 🙏🏻
His Studio flat is very stylish, spotlessly clean and very comfy bed with a high standard bedding :) ♥️
Best value!
Highly recommend it, i would definitely like to book this place when im back to Berlin!
Best
D

A very responsive host. We had trouble working the tv and he came by as soon as possible to fix it for us. The space was extremely clean and well located next to transit lines, convenience stores and restaurants. Would absolutely recommend staying here.

Sebastian was very responsive and pro-active with communicating clear directions to the apartment 1-2 days before our arrival in Berlin.
The apartment is cute, clean, warm (needed this when temperatures were below zero), and in a very central area of kreuzberg.
Thanks a lot, Sebastian!

An amazing and central place with plenty of room. Lots of amenities; especially the washer was useful.
The door can be a tad difficult to open and it’s small, but it’s a minor problem at most.
Definitely would stay again!

Great place located at the centre of one of most lively parts of Berlin. The apartment was very nice, clean and spacious and Sebastian was always happy to respond to any of my questions.
Highly recommended

Great location. Apartment was close to local shops and markets. Mandel was a very responsive host and responded to all of our questions.
Would definitely stay again.

This space is perfectly located. It’s close to an u Bahn station which will take you across to any point in the city in 10-20 minutes.
Very spacious and comfy beds. Definitely worth the price!!!

Great location, a few minutes walk from the underground and lots of cafes, restaurants and bars. It’s a basement flat so once you’re in you’re quite cut off from the outside world. Comfy bed and great shower

Pros:
- Mandel is an excellent communicator and helped me feel secure as I planned for my trip.
- We felt it was located in the best neighborhood in Berlin. Location is top notch!
- The apartment was clean and tidy.
- Beds were very comfortable.
- Apartment was spacious.
Cons:
- towels were really small and as so, not easy to use.
- There’s only one key and the locks were hard to use. If you’re a group who does independent things, it’s hard to split up with one person home and the other outside the apartment.
Ultimately, we really enjoyed our stay and would recommend it to anyone!
This place is a hidden gem tucked away in Kreuzberg! Clean, spacious, and very comfortable. And Seba is also a wonderful host! Would definitely book again given the chance.
The unit was clean and quiet, and was an easy walk to many great bars and restaurants. A great option for those looking for a comfortable, no-frills stay in Berlin.
The appartement was cozy, clean and quiet! Ideally located. The host was very reactive, flexible and lovely. Highly recommended, I’d be pleased to come back again! :)

I stayed at Steve's for a couple of days in May. Although the walls (and ceiling) were thin, the neighbours did not disturb at night and I was able to sleep nicely. The location was very convenient for my errands (a Rewe supermarket open till late at night is only 3min away) and commute. Everything squeaky clean.
Thank you again for the lovely stay!
Very nice, clean, and cozy stay in the part of the city we needed it to be in.

Great place to stay, beautifully decorated and the perfect pad for a short city break. Instructions and directions were spot on and access was very straightforward. A great location, centrally placed with plenty in the way of places to eat, drink and socialise. Lively but not noisy and relaxing when needed. I would definitely return and can highly recommend.
Alex

We had a great stay! The apartment is very clean and contains everything you need. The shower and bed were amazing! Also, the neighborhood is nice, with many nice restaurants and shops nearby. Would definitely go back here :)

I had a lovely stay at Steve and Linda’s place! It was exactly as described and looked like it did in the photos. Great location close to public transport and so it’s a great base to explore Berlin. Communication was great and checking in was easy. Would recommend!

Laura’s apartment is absolutely beautiful, has amazing sunlight in the morning, and the decor makes you feel like you are staying in a well-loved home. The location in Mitte is also great—close to two U-Bahn stations and quite walkable to many places in the Innenstadt. Would definitely recommend to anyone!
We had a great stay in Berlin. The apartment is spacious and cozy and in the best possible location. Remy did our check-in, and she was very friendly and communicative. Highly recommended!

Our experience, mine and my family´s, was great. Remy´s apartment is very new, clean, with all we need to stay comfortable in it. Remy is such a nice person, very gentle and kind, answering all our doubts and needs very fast. The neighborhood is awesome, with restaurants, pharmacy, Coffee shops, everything to make our experience even better.
We will for sure, look for him in another period in Berlin.

If you're looking for a great place to stay in Berlin, do not hesitate to book this apartment.
Great location in the best neighborhood in berlin with great vibes peacful and quiet but with a lot of resturants and bars near by.
The apartment was conveniently situated near reliable and efficient public transportation options. This allowed us to effortlessly navigate the city and reach all the major attractions.
The apartment exceeded all expectations, with its impeccable cleanliness, stylish decor, and comfortable furnishings.
Remy and Waldo were friendly and provided valuable local recommendations. the communication with them throughout our stay was excellent. they were responsive and very helpful.
The apartment was fully equipped with everything we needed for a comfortable stay. The kitchen had modern appliances, allowing us to prepare meals with ease. The bed was comfortable and the bathroom was very spacious.
We had a great time, thank you!

We had a brilliant stay!
Clear and easy instructions and great communication from the hosts. The place was spotless and welcoming. The location was brilliant, really near loads of booming restaurants and bars and easy for transport to get far and wide.
Highly recommend.

An excellent place to stay - the space was spotlessly clean and stylishly furnished. Check in and communication was excellent from the host/team managing the property, really appreciated the communication and being allowed to leave a bag before check in. Property had all the mod cons you'd need for a pleasant stay. Clever use of technology for accessing the apartment also made it easy to get up and go without worrying about sets of keys. All in all, a very professional set up and a cosy property for a stay in a lively part of Berlin!

My partner and I really enjoyed our stay at Remy's, the check in process was quick and easy. The setup with the scanning or barcode for instructions was super helpful. The bathroom was a dream and the best thing of all was the location for us. For the price point, we had access to all the places we wanted to visit. Thanks 🙏

This place felt like a home a way from home. Our toddler loved staying there and the area is very well suited for a family. The apartment is a classic old school Berlin apartment with everything you need to feel right at home. The bathroom is lovely. Especially the bathtub. Remy and her husband went above and beyond to make us feel comfortable and help us whenever they could. It’s clean, it’s homely, not too far from public transportation and a big supermarket.

Remy and team were always very responsive and easy to reach. When Lufthansa failed to load our bags on a connecting flight they offered to bring extra bathing supplies to help out. the flat was spotless and comfortable just as advertised. Even though it was at ground level it was very quiet and the building and neighbors were very quiet. The neighborhood is filled with bar and restaurant options and you can easily walk to a great bakery and several markets, including the huge Rewe mart with its large variety and good prices. public transportation is handy, one of the trams passes by next door. Good base for exploring Berlin.

Me and my brother spent  a week at the appartement  to Remy and really enjoyed the stay. It was super clean, light and just as cozy as on the pictures. There were several suggestions of restaurants, brunch places, bars nearby. The communication was great. You will have a great time choosing this appartement for your Berlin stay.

My husband and I loved our stay at Remy's place!! Remy was available if we needed anything. The apartment was very clean, cozy, and comfortable. The location was great with lots of restaurants and shops in the neighborhood. The bedroom was very quiet at night. We would definitely stay at Remy's place again!
My second stay here, lovely apartment at a great location. Only slight downside would be that one of the bedrooms has no window. Other than that, awesome place!
Great place to stay in an excellent location!! Communication was always very good and we found the folder of recommendations very useful. Would definitely recommend staying here.

My family of 3 had a nice time staying here. The property was spacious, well-equipped, and we felt safe. The flat is located in an awesome neighborhood; if you love food of all sorts get ready to EAT because there’s so many great restaurants nearby. We rented bicycles as our primary mode of transportation, and were easily able to get around the city from this location. We had a few minor issues while staying there and the host was friendly, immediately responsive, and proactive. Enjoy Berlin!

A very well appointed place to stay. Great neighborhood lots to eat and see and do. Easy access to the train, the street car, the underground, the bus, everything you need transportation for. Beds were comfortable,shower was amazing. My nephew loved the bathtub. It was very clean, and easy to figure out

We really had a wonderful time in this cozy apartment in the middle of Friedrichshain. Everything was even better than our expectations. Super clean, spacious apartment in the best area of Berlin! We hope to come back in the summer!

Awesome location. Close to u-bahn and m-bahn. Grocery store and liquid stores really close by and lots of restaurants in the area.
And despite that, the area is really cozy and quiet.
The apartment itself is really nice and good for both 2 persons and 6 persons. Nice and clean, and with everything you need for at relaxing holiday or a quick getaway to Berlin.
Dusan is a great host. Really fast communication, reliable and very friendly.
Our best recommendation for both the apartment and the host.

The apartment was clean and the location was very nice. Dusan was very friendly and answered messages quickly. However, the apartment was uncomfortably warm (probably because of the previous week in Berlin had been very hot), and even though Dusan was kind enough to bring us a fan, the situation didn't get any better. Also, it would have been nice to have another mirror in the apartment in addition to the one in the bathroom.
Great space and location, Funda was super helpful and made our stay that much more enjoyable. We hope to be back very soon!

We had a great time staying at this location. The area provides almost anything you could think of doing and it's walking distance to most of it. The Airbnb itself was very clean, the host provided som snacks at our arrival and was super quick at responding to our questions!

Funda is a great host! Super responsive and helpful. The place is advertised correctly and is pretty clean. You’re definitely getting what you pay for, not a ton of frills but it was perfect for our week in Berlin.
My main complaint would be the beds are very hard and a little scratchy.

Everything went perfectly well and the accomodation was easy to reach with public transport.
We enjoyed staying there for a few days and didn't have any problems regarding space even though we were six people.

Lovely place. I would say perfect for 4 people. Clean and fresh. Lots of additional little items included (washing tabs, dishwasher tabs, chocolate, bottle of sparkling water)… We really enjoyed our stay here.
Lovely host, very good communication and helpful. Lovely and clean and good location near train station and by a lot of clubs. Had a very enjoyable stay. Thank you!

For us the apartment was one of the best Airbnb experience. It was in great location, had everything we needed - was calm at night, had a good bed mattrace and wonderful kids room.
The flat is full of Light, plants and space - really beautiful!

My friend and I absolutely LOVED staying here - it actually felt like we were borrowing a friend's apartment. Super comfortable and beautiful with high ceilings and great light, the apartment was a joy to be in, even / especially during summer rains.
The location was incredible - super quiet at night, filled with school children and families during the day and two blocks off from everything you might ever need.
I hadn't realized that one of the rooms was indeed a child's room, but again, lent to the "just staying at a friend's place" vibe....
They were super flexible with us and check-in / check-out times and were very receptive and communicative, even while they were on family vacation.
Thanks again!

I'm on Airbnb already many years, and this Apartment is the best among all variants I saw before:
- wonderful location
- exceptionally clean
- incredibly cozy
You just feel at home, especially if your home is far from here...
Stephan always helps with all questions, very quickly, and is very supportive!
I wish this home just the best and kind visitors!

We had the best time at Stephan’s place and absolutely didn’t want to leave! The location is perfect, quiet yet still within easy walking distance of plenty of lively neighbourhoods and  the city ‘centre’. There are also great public transport links to and from the airport and for exploring further afield. The flat itself is beautiful and all furniture and fittings are of a really high spec. I actually enjoyed the 80 plus steps to the front door but it’s something to bear in mind if you’re not great on your feet.

We really enjoyed staying in Stephan’s place for 4 nights. It felt like home away from home and would highly recommend staying there. It’s easy to get to and the apartment block is safe and quiet. Everything was as it was described and even more spacious than the photos show. Very cute apartment! Danke
Beautiful apartment! As others have said, there are many, many stairs. Loved the space though and neighborhood is perfect.
Really great place for staying. Host always responsive with clear instructions. The apartment is beyond expectations, very clean, beautiful and cozy. It is highly recommended to stay at their place.

Loved the neighborhood, able to walk everywhere, two subway stops within walking distance. Great park across the street, all the stores and cafes you could want. The apartment is spacious and breezy, we were able to spread out and relax. The balcony is amazing, especially in the evenings. Two bathrooms are super helpful for a family. It would be helpful to have darker curtains in the bigger bedroom, especially in the summer, but it wasn't bad. Get your workout in with the stairs!

What a great location to stay! Stephan’s apartment is a hidden gem in Berlin. It’s spacious, has a ‘more than you can wish for’ equipped kitchen, superb beds and, it’s quite… while its around the corner of the best area of Berlin. We’ve stayed in Berlin at many other locations already… yet this place was truly the best!

Great place to stay for a trip to Berlin. Wilken was a great host, very friendly, and flexible. The apartment is located in walking distance to Ostkreuz and to the many restaurants and pubs in the area but still calm for a good night's sleep. 10/10 recommended.

So delighted to have found the perfect spot for my trip to Berlin. The location in Friedrichshain was perfect for me. So many great restaurants, cafes, bars nearby. I was spoilt for choice. It was only a five minute walk to the train station too.
The apartment itself was beautiful, spacious yet cosy and had everything I needed.
The Nuki app for locking and unlocking the door was very handy!
Thank you for a great stay!

Great host that was very responsive throughout the stay. Wilken was able to accommodate some special requests for late checkouts and some minor repairs efficiently. Apartment is walking distance to great bars and restaurants and not far from kreuzberg and other nightlife venues.
The apartment is very cozy and homey. Lots of light from the windows. Close to U Bahn and RentABike44 which made it easy to get around.

Marilyn’s apartment is stylish and extremely well located - we loved sitting on the terrace and exploring the neighbourhood.
The only downsides were it does get quite warm on summer nights, and is on the fifth floor with no stairs. But otherwise it was a perfect place to stay in Berlin!

Marylin was a great host who was easy to
Communicate with.
The apartment is located on the fifth floor & is super spacious with a cute rooftop.
I would recommend staying here for sure!
Karolin and Philipp were friendly and reacted quickly to all messages. The flat is beautiful and very cosy. The location is great, with several nice restaurants and directly at a subway stop.

I loved this place so much! Spacious rooms, lots of light, super central yet quiet, amazing and quirky and loving decor, a consciously stocked kitchen… check in and check out was so easy and Ronen was super helpful and kind. Location unbeatable. Top score.

one of the best Airbnbs I've ever stayed in, truly 5 stars. the BEST location in Berlin and the place is MASSIVE. Jacuzzi tub, projector TV and awesome sound system make it great.
host was great and incredibly patient after I mixed up the check-in time.
this will be the first place I look at when I come back to Berlin.
This is a great location for your visit in Berlin. Everything is closely, only 10 minute walk from the S Bahn.  Stephanie is very helpful.
Great place to stay in a fun neighbourhood in Berlin, hosted by really nice people. 100% recommend!

Easy communication. We enjoyed the available bikes. Close to train and metro station. Nice to have the garden to sit outside in the sun. Some things are a bit unpractical because it’s a small space e.g. a closet on the wall would be more helpful than in the floor, you easily splash the room when taking a shower.

Had an amazing time at Maja and Mark's listening. It was just perfect with everything you can ask for. Well equipped kitchen, cozy bedroom and a clean bathroom/toilet.
Maja and Mark were quick and responsive in terms of check in and out. Rest the bnb was fantastic, 2-3 mins walking from a big station, close to everything. Highly recommended for any Berlin long term and short term stay.
Amèlie was really helpful, we had a nice stay at her place. The recommendations were top tier (Try Wen Cheng ).

This place was super clean. The bed and duvet were very soft and fragrant. I have a sensitive sense of smell, but this was the first time I've been to such a comfortable and well-washed lodging. Thank you!

Great micro apartment in a lovely area. Amelie gave some great recommendations which we checked out and loved including Crossroads Cocktail Bar and Van Hoa Vietnamese restaurant.
the apartment was exactly what we (a couple) needed for exploring Berlin. perfect for public transport options across the city.
Wonderful little place! In such a gorgeous neighbourhood filled with shops and bars and cafes! Clean and homely! Thanks so much for such an enjoyable time in Berlin! :)

Me and my friends stayed for 2 nights, and it was the best experience ever. The underground was literally a 3 minute walk to the berlin centre. We had a great time and there wasn't any disruptions around us. Will definitely recommend.
Really nice apartment for comfortable stay, kitchen with needed equipment, apartment is close to U-bahn station

Cozy little place, super clean, great coffee, close to restaurants, bars, bakeries, and shops.
The only thing that could have been better was the lock that was difficult to use to open the door to the apartment.
Overall an easy and nice stay with limehome, thank you!
Good location, though a bit noisy and without air conditioning a bit to warm. Interior was nice and clean.

Easy check in, the place is very modern and looked like the pictures. Very well located walking distance to main attractions, shops and restaurants.
Only negative was that we found some hair in the bed, but the bathroom and rest of the place seemed clean.

Remember to request early arrival soon if you want to check in before 15:00 or else you have to wait for the code until then.
Theres no elevator so if you have the apartment on third floor and have heavy luggages then good luck.
The room is really cute but the wooden floor is extremely squeaky. It is very hard to walk without making any noises.
Otherwise, great location and cozy place.

Elisas apartment is lovely and the room is spacious and beautiful. also bathroom, living room and balcony were available for my use.
The area is great and it's easy to get around. Elisa were really helpful and nice, I warmly recommend this place!
Great place to stay not far from Estrel Conference Center. Elisa was super friendly & a wonderful host.

Elisa's room is exactly as described. It's large, airy, has great light and it has its own bathroom. The kitchen is well-appointed. Elisa is a great host who communicates well, and allows you plenty of space. The area is well connected, and has lots of charms of its own. I'd be happy to stay again.
Super nice host and warm, homely flat. Unfortunately I didn’t get much of a chance to chat to Elisa or her son, but they seemed like lovely people.
Great stay at Patrick's flat, which is very conveniently located, especially if you want to explore Kreuzberg! Patrick was very welcoming, and recommended restaurants and places to visit.

I stayed a week at Patrick’s place, the apartment is huge, full of light, and very comfortable.
I had a serious issue with the shower during my stay, but Patrick was super responsive and took care of it quickly. Really appreciated his help and would happily stay again!

Me & my nieces loved this apartment we instantly felt right at home. On arrival we saw that Kathleen had left snacks and a bottle of bubbly for us which was really sweet. As a host she was great, always replied to messages and was helpful when we had questions. The location was great and very close to the East Side Mall, Mercedes Benz Plaza and the East Side Gallery which is the longest surviving section of the Berlin Wall. It's also walking distance from some great cafes, bakeries and restaurants. The apartment is decorated beautifully, every little detail of the place is amazing - we loved it!! ;)
Property’s location is super convenient. It was clean and well equipped. Snacks/tea/coffee was complimentary which was a nice touch. Thanks so much for hosting us

The apartment was functional and very nice – clean and in an excellent location. The host was professional and provided all the necessary information. The only downside was the very early check-out time. Otherwise, we were very happy with our stay!
Kathrin was such a great host, incredibly responsive and accomodating! Place looks just like pictures and in a great area
Ulf is a really nice and friendly person. He’d make tea for me every morning by a simple question. It’s a quiet and nice place to be.

Location is conveniently placed near s-bahn, tram and bus station. It takes about 30minutes to get here from the main train station with a single a-bahn. There is also a convenience store and a couple of restaurant nearby.
My hosts were super welcoming and friendly. The apartment is SUPERBLY clean and well looked after. The room I was staying at is spacious with a very comfy bed and a desk you can work on.
I would absolutely recommend it to anyone visiting Berlin :)
Terrific place! Ulf and his partner are the nicest people, and the room was very comfortable and conveniently located. I would definitely stay there again!

Amazing host who made me feel very comfortable with my stay and was very welcoming and caring.
The airbnb itself was just like the pictures and described. It was also located at a nice place with not being too far from stuff to explore.
Next time im going to Berlin im definitely staying here again so i fully recommend this airbnb!

Ulf and his partner are great hosts. We felt like at home, very accommodating. I would highly recommend his place for future travellers. It is very close to transportation and grocery store, everything you need is within reach. I’m very happy. Thank you for making our stay enjoyable and safe.

Ulf and Huibao were warm, welcoming and lovely. The room was faithful to the description and the whole flat was very clean. You can find a grocery store nearby (and it closes late, good for late night snack). The S-bahn (metro) is a 3 minutes walk with a train every 3 to 4 minutes until late. I enjoyed my stay there!

Ulf and Hui Bao were great hosts who were always happy to help out and chat. The room was large and the home was close to public transport for convenient access to the centre of Berlin. A nice stay overall.

Location, location, location. This apartment was close everything we wanted to see in both the old East and West Berlins.  It was only up one small flight of stairs, easy to get into and easy to get out of.  Having the washer was great and the kitchen was adequate for our needs. However, it was very hot the week we were in the city and it would have been nice to have screens on the windows.  Regardless, we highly recommend it for those wanting to see the best of Berlin!
We had a fantastic stay. Loved this place, great location great host and comfortable bed. So accommodating to allow us to drop our luggage off early before check in. Highly recommend.
The flat is in a lovely area, which is also convenient for local transport to other attractions in the city. We would love to stay again!
The apartment was a perfect base for a trip to Berlin. It was very easy to get to on the train from the airport and was in walking distance to the main sights in Berlin.
Good place in Berlin Mitte for sightseeing and tourist activities. Very well equipped with everything you need. Only small drawback was that the apartment was pretty dark in the back house.
Great location in Berlin and removed just enough from the downtown action for a peaceful setting. Had all the amenities needed and a nice loft for a second sleeping area.
Mia's place is very well located in the Mitte neighbourhood, at wakable distance to major Berlin's landmarks like Bundestag, Brandemburg Gate and Isle of the Museums. Peaceful apartment.

Swetlana and family were fantastic hosts for our last two weeks in Berlin. We loved the quiet, clean, and comfortable apartment - and also being close to the beautiful Mexikoplatz area and swimming at Schlachtensee. We were very close to the S-Bahn for convenient access to other parts of the city, but on a calm street where it was quiet enough to leave windows open at night. We enjoyed getting to know Swetlana, and the bunnies were a bonus for our kids! Would definitely recommend for a family to stay in a less busy part of the city and enjoy green space and small-town feel that is special about Berlin, while also being connected to the big city sights.
we had a lovely stay at Svetlana's place, cosy and comfortable. Svetlana is a great host and a very nice person, always helped us with everything. I highly recommend this place, would visit again!

Better than home from home! The apartment was spotless, stylish, equipped with everything you could wish for and set in a wonderfully quiet, leafy area with easy access to transport.
Svetlana and her daughter were lovely- friendly, kind and caring but maintained the perfect balance of being accessible but never intrusive. Their local knowledge was invaluable.
Altogether a 5* place to stay to explore Berlin.
The hardest thing was leaving but we look forward to coming back. Thank you Svetlana.

Svetlana is a warm and welcoming host. Her place is in a quiet and pretty neighborhood on the edge of Berlin a short walk from the train station. Her apartment had everything you need to make you feel at home.  We had a great stay!

We had a wonderful stay at Boris’ apartment. Everything was very clean, comfortable, and well prepared. The check-in and check-out process was super smooth, and we especially appreciated the instruction book with all the details – very helpful! Highly recommended, and we would be happy to come back again.
One of the best Airbnb I've stayed in - a big room with all the amenities in a pretty neighborhood with an amazing location to tour Berlin and great hosts!

Sebastian has been a kind, polite, considerate and communicative host.
The appartment was as advertised, clean, homely and nicely located inside Berlin just outside of the hustle and bustle of the very city center.
With two supermarkets around the corner, a bakery a stones throw away and perfectly located in relation to the public transport network of Berlin (bus and metro/tram on walking distance), it was the ideal resting place from which to explore Berlin and all it's treasures.
I can wholeheartedly recommend staying with this host.

Our family had a great stay at Sebastian’s place.  We have two small children in our family (ages 5 & 1) so we really appreciated that the apartment is family friendly.  It was also nice to have the playground on the premises.  Sebastian is very helpful and he is very responsive in his communications.  The apartment is an easy walk to the S-Bahn station.  We really enjoyed our visit and are very appreciative of Sebastian’s help and responsiveness.

This apartment is a great base to explore Berlin: very easy access to various public transport lines, that bring you to the city in no-time. The place itself is spacious, quiet, well equipped, and very clean. Great place for a family to visit Berlin!

This place is fabulous!!!
The apartment is super spacious, very bright, modern and comfortable. Honestly one of the best AirBnB spots I’ve stayed at. The cleaning was immaculate. The host was extremely responsive. There are two supermarkets only a few minutes walk away. The unit is also close to a train station, and it takes about half an hour to get to the area where all the tourist attractions are. Highly recommend!

Very clean, very tidy and a lot of free stuff like a beer and crisps.
Thanks for the good stay and see u soon again!

Great location. Easy to check in and out. Any problems dealt with quickly after online conversation. Had problems with first room (window didnt close, bathroom shower seemed to floor the floor) but was quickly moved to another room after speaking with the helpful team.

I stayed here for more than 7 days, which was a memorable stay.
There are many reasons:
(1) Room heating system was out of order
(2) Wifi connection is so slow and unstable (even slower than free wifi in a cafe)
(3) The staff of the noma just entered the room after knocking once while I was in bed (so creepy)
(4) Elevator was always out of order
(5) On the 6th day, the emergency evacuation announcement came out, and all the hotel passengers were evacuated at 2:30 am.

After booking by mistake they refused to give me a full refund and kept almost everything i paid though i canceled the reservation. This is simple indecency to make profite out of people's innocent mistakes as i'm sure the room was quickly rented shortly after

I had one of the more nice rooms, with high ceiling and balcony with street-view. Very nice. Only downside was that it was dirty under the bed, but that's something I would expect from a regular hotel too.

Great room and very clean.
Nicely decorated. Bathroom was clean and fresh. Near checkpoint Charlie and public transport.
Truely teriffic space in the heart of berlin i felt safe in the area and the room was truely top notch!

My one need when booking was a place to do laundry as I was in the middle of a 13 day work trip - the main reason I did not book a regular hotel. This place exceeded my expectations and I would consider staying here over a hotel next time!  The kitchen was stocked with complimentary snacks and drinks upon arrival, a nice touch. Also the floors are wooden not carpet, which I didn’t realize I actually prefer in a transient space.

Numa is very well located without being noisy, ideal for frist time visitors, right next to many sightseeing locations. Also close to the metro, we walked everywhere. The room itself has everything you my need, a good bed and shower, mini kitchen, very nice shampoo, conditioner and lotion. We highly recommend it ! ☺️
Apartment styled hotel with very convenient amenities. Quiet and clean room. Good location, just right beside the checkpoint Charlie metro station. Would recommend to first time tourists.

This is actually a real hotel. There are no staff on site, all communication is via text message. I didn't have any issues which required me to contact their support staff.
The room was quiet and comfortable. The location was great on Friedrichstraße, a few steps from the U-Bahn.
Hallway lights were on motion sensors, and it was quite dark at night. The laundry room requires a phone app to use the washer/dryers, which was a little cumbersome, but ultimately worked just fine.

I know Berlin well and am by all accounts considered a snob when it comes to places to stay. This place was so much better than staying in a normal hotel and cleaner and easier to deal with than a typical Airbnb that someone else lives in. The mattress is extremely comfortable, the pillows and duvet are down, the hair dryer is nicer than the one I have at home. Very well equipped kitchenette, right next to the u-bahn, a great cafe, and a pretty good grocery store. The host is super easy to get ahold of via text (within minutes), which they proactively used to contact me. Overall and exceptional experience.

Impressed by how easy and quick it was to book a stay at Numa's. My place was ready for me in less than 24 hours. Great location between East and West Berlin and bonus to all the free treats you get in your room!

As described and a good deal for the neighborhood and if you’re looking for a hotel-like facility without all the hotel services on site. It was very easy to get it, communication was clear and quick, clean. Some Berlin nighttime noise on some nights. Would stay again.

Great location, great room/space and amenities. The downside was that it took them 24 hours (out of a 48 hour stay) to fix my wifi access. Most amenities (eg laundry) rely on internet access so this was really a downside. I'm still not clear what the issue was but hope this is fixed for future travellers.
incredible experience staying here... the host was extremely responsive and accommodating. the room was very clean, luxurious, and comfortable. I would stay here again, for sure!

The stay was perfect… LITERALLY… everything was taking care of, so clean, all necessities are there, location good, staff wonderful, costumer support very helpful and responsive… I wait for my next visit to Berlin so I could stay in Numa xD always will stay there, 10 stars out of 5 XDD
Numa is a good option in between a hotel and apartment. Ok location, very secure and good amenities in the room e.g kitchen and fridge. Very enjoyable stay!
We enjoyed our stay at Numa. Really cool place, would like to come back! 🤲🏻😊

This was one of the easiest places to check into! I love how clear their system is. Basically like a hotel room with everything you need, without having to talk to anyone. They sent helpful messages, too! Love this system and I would use their location again.

We had a fantastic experience during our stay at Numa. The accommodation's location in the city was excellent, making it convenient for us to explore. The place was impeccably clean, and the check-in instructions were clear and straightforward. Moreover, they were accommodating enough to allow us to check in earlier than the standard time of 15:00, which was incredibly helpful. Without hesitation, I highly recommend Numa to anyone looking for a pleasant stay in the area!
I really liked the place, very clean and pleasant, perfect location and super safe. 100% recommendable!
The location was amazing, we got the top floor that had nice view and overall was great experience.
room was very efficent, not huge but had anything we needed with good kitchen, location is great and was great value for money

Everything was nice. Apartment exactly like on the picture. Subway just five minutes from building. Good communication. Nice laundry and dryer inside in the building, 3€ washing and drying.
Just one thing: AC inside in apartment not worked correctly. We put minimum temperature on display, but it’s still stay too hot inside.
I reported about this thing and management promised me to return 10% from my purchase.
Everything else was good !

Spot on location, literally a stone’s throw from the underground opening up the whole of Berlin more or less. Place was spotless but I think the floor in our room needed  a better vacuum otherwise all ideal for a few days stay. Staff nice and friendly.
Great location and very responsive. Air conditioning was broken, but they were very responsive about the situation and provided an extra fan. Would stay here again!

Great area, easy to access, and the messaging was a great way to communicate. I got recommendations when I asked. I will definitely recommend Numa to my friends and family and stay there myself on my future endeavors.

The location of this rental is amazing for Berlin. It's on one of the most popular roads, Friedrichstraße, and just a 2-minute walk from Checkpoint Charlie. The price was a bit on the expensive side, but this was expected since I was there during Euro 2024. I was able to get an early check-in, which was fantastic since I flew in early.

Location is a little touristy but very close to the subway. Quiet at night. The room is very nice and modern. Easy to check in and we can come in and out at any time of the day or night. Place to leave our bags before we had to go to the airport was such a plus.

Great location for a trip to Berlin with a great parking option if you are driving. Easy access to anything you could want
It’s an automated check in which worked really well and we booked the parking when we arrived late at night at it was available immediately
Check-in was very convenient. Clear instructions. The apartments have everything you need for both short and longer stays. The location is excellent.

Had a great stay at Numa! The location of the building is fantastic, with easy public transport, groceries, sights and more all within walking distance. The facilities of the building are great, with easy laundry facilities, kitchenettes in the rooms and lockers for bag storage. I was on the top floor and the room was extremely hot, as the A/C wasn’t working. The hot water in the shower was also very temperamental so had a few cold showers. But besides these things the room was great with a comfy bed and modern design.

Numa Arc Rooms was a lovely little apartment to stay in with my partner and toddler, I requested a cot bed which was there and put up when we arrived. Perfect location and extremely clean. All amenities needed for a 3 night stay were included within the building. Upon arrival our code did not work to let us into our room, however a quick conversation through message and this was dealt with quickly and efficiently, issue was solved within 10 minutes. the only downside is the overly sensitive smoke alarm system which went off twice during our stay, causing us to evacuate, once in the morning and once at midnight, this was not particularly ideal with a toddler. However I would stay with Numa again in the future. Very well priced for what it is.

Americans staying in Germany!
Our flight came in early and Numa was able to put us in a room right away. They also have central air conditioning which was a plus. This location is walking distance to check point Charlie and has a U Bahn station right out side. 5/5 would definitely recommend.

Was great. The shower flooded the bathroom a little bit but nothing you couldn’t handle. Unfortunately it was pretty warm and outside it was too loud to open the open the window. Other then that the room was super clean and practical. The beds very comfy. The kitchen had everything it needed.

Only book if you are happy communicating through your phone! We had a great stay here, had a few hiccups with the tv but they sorted it out via phone very quickly. The bed is the comfiest I have ever slept in and the essentials closet is an amazing idea! Would definitely stay again

We very much enjoyed our stay at Numa Arc Rooms. The location is fantastic as you have access to the U-Bahn practically outside of your doorstep. The room was fantastic. We loved that the room had AC. It definitely helped on the hot summer days in Berlin. We will definitely be coming back next time we are in Berlin !!

Looked just like the photos. Everything was clean and the place offered additional stuff like a laundry room or a luggage room which you can you for the rest of the day after your check out. Close to several public transportation stops.

The Location is close to Checkpoint Charlie and it's easy to take public transport to anywhere you want to go. The apartment was nice and comfortable. It's very clean but we did run into two or three little bugs.
Overall, It was a nice stay and we'd like to visit again!|
location is perfect for travellers with the metro 2 minutes walk away and there's a brilliant bavarian restaurant 10 minutes walk down the road
We had a great stay, will 100% book again when visiting Berlin. This was beautiful.

Numa have got it right and our stay was perfect. The room was comfortable, warm, quiet and clean. There was plenty of coffee, tea and milk, even moisturiser and conditioner are surplied. Fixtures and fittings are excellent quality so you get a bit of quality at a very reasonable price. You can leave your luggage in a locker until 8pm on the day you check out free of charge. There's a laundry, yoga mats and car parking and staff are available if needed. I would definitely choose to stay at a Numa in big cities in the future.

kitchen could have done with more implements. could not get the stove to work but used microwave instead. Rather alot of construction noise which  was disturbing in the morning. otherwise a good place. would use again when presumably the construction work would have finished.

I really enjoyed my stay at numa! It was incredibly comfortable, and I felt right at home from the moment I arrived. The location was absolutely perfect, making it easy to explore and enjoy everything the area has to offer.
I would highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a cozy, convenient, and enjoyable stay. Thank you for such a great experience!
Alroght for the price, location isn't incredible but nice enough cafes and what not. Room was nice

Excellent location close to the center and subway. Flexible and easy self check-in/check-out. It is a company so if you are expecting any personal touches this is not for you. I would book again with Numa next time I go to Berlin.

I spent a week in Berlin and Numa made my trip perfect. The location is great, I could walk or use the metro station in front of it to get to wherever I wanted. The accommodation was clean, quiet and safe. If I were to come to Berlin again, I would choose this place again.

Numa apartments was a pleasant surprise. Well located near restaurants, supermarket, and train station. Also, very close to Checkpount Charlie.
The fact that the TV is only in German (no SAP feature) and also the glass shower which is too small (the whole bathroom gets wet when you’re taking a shower) could be improved.
great location, great automatic check in system, overall far above my expectations for that price. great work!

If you’re lucky and everything goes smoothly, it’s a good deal. Unfortunately, I had a terrible experience.
Wrong Door Code
When I arrived, I was given the wrong door code and couldn’t access my room immediately. It was a frustrating start.
Clogged Bathroom
The shower in my bathroom was completely clogged. Water overflowed onto the floor every time I tried to shower.
Terrible Service
Customer service is nonexistent. It’s all done through What*App with automated messages. I reported the bathroom issue right away, but they never fixed it. It seems they don’t have staff to handle problems on-site.
You get what you pay for. If you run into issues, don’t expect any help.

My stay at Numa was truly wonderful! From the flexible check-in process to the impeccable cleanliness, every detail was perfect. My business trip was made even more enjoyable thanks to the comfort and convenience of this location.
The proximity to public transportation was a huge plus—I barely had to walk! Nestled in the heart of Berlin, it was the ideal base for both work and leisure.
I would definitely recommend booking this place again and look forward to my next stay!

Perfect if u want to stay for a few days, it was close to a lot of things and u also have a station train in that zone.
I Recommend this place.

Had a great stay with Numa Arc Apartments :) super quick and responsive hosts. The room was great size and clean, location is super good, easy to walk to places and easy transports links. Definitely recommend staying there and will defo book again when back in Berlin! thank you <3

Numa is super close to the u-bahn, so it is very easy to travel around the city via public transport. The location itself is not very central, which is a pro because it’s pretty private and quiet there, and con because all restaurants and attractions is 30+ mins walking from the hotel. There are a few cafes and fast food shops very close by.
All in all, we were extremely pleased with the value for the money! The room is very nice and clean, the bed is super-comfy and the instructions are clear and easy to understand. Would definitely recommend to stay at Numa!

We had an excellent stay. The location was good for us and the room was great. A free baby crib was provided for us during our stay, and free luggage storage was provided for the rest of the day after checkout. The only issue was getting the baby stroller up and down the half flight of stairs between the street entrance and the interior elevators. If there was some way to avoid this, it was definitely well hidden. Still, the place seemed like an incredible bargain for Berlin on short notice! Would definitely stay again, but with a lighter stroller.

The neighborhood: very convenient area with many transportation options and many things to see and visit around.
The building: very nice, fresh and modern building with nice communal space. It felt really vibrant with nice decoration and music.
The room: comfortable, cozy and nice atmosphere. The bed is really good and the pillows are AMAZING!!!!!!! I really enjoyed sleeping there and it's also very quiet.
It was not perfectly clean to be honest, without saying that it was below standards. I am mentioning this as the whole experience was great and above standards and this was the only thing that bothered us a bit. The wifi was really good and the technology used was really helpful. Moreover, the communication with the Numa team was great, consistent, personal and attentive. Last but not least, the kitchen was well equiped.
Very clean and new apartment. Perfect for a hotel like stay. Not character full like staying in someone’s home but perfect for a quick city break. They made it all very easy.
heating was broken. Changed my room with one equiped with an electric heater. Had to deal with customer service online (no real people in hotel to speak with). Awaiting some refund.
V good location but no daily housekeeping and when things needed fixing it was down to you sort it. Nice concept but pricing should probably be a bit lower considering lack of services provided
Great location, clean room, nice bed. Basically like a nice hotel room. The only bad thing is that the room was a bit dark and had very little natural light.

4/5 stars. Great place, easy to check in/out. Very clean. However, communication was lacking, you are often speaking to a robot instead of a person which makes it difficult when you have issues you need to discuss, often times the issues won't be dealt with until the next morning. The wifi was HORRIBLE! If you stay here make sure you have a good service plan because the wifi could not be used for any phone calls/web searching.
Easy to transit around.

thank you for a fantastic stay. Ilford someone travelling alone it was safe and comfortable.
i just had no duvet on the 1st night but they soon sorted it for me.
very accessible and easy to understand access.
thank you

Great place for a great price.
Stayed here for 4 nights, definitely worth the money, very clean and very close to train stations.

Located at the center of the city, close to public transportation and at walkable distance from interesting landmarks of Berlin. Clean and comfortable rooms. A nice place to stay while on busyness or just visiting the city.

We had a wonderful stay at Numa. The facility was modern, brand new, squeaky clean, spacious and convenient. We would love to stay with Numa again in the future.
10/10

A great stay! There was a small issue with the fridge not being fully cleaned (some items left from previous guests), but the host was incredibly responsive and took care of it right away, which I really appreciated. Otherwise, everything was perfect: the room was spotless, the bed super comfortable, and the amenities excellent. All in all, a wonderful stay. I’d happily return.
Numa was everything we hoped for. If you want a well stocked, lovely space close to checkpoint Charlie. This is it. We’ll be staying at numa properties whenever we can!
Fab. Lovely little space. Very cosy and homely. Bed was very comfortable and shower was clean. Right next to the u bahn so made public transport very accessible

A really lovely building and room with great amenities and more space than we thought we would have. We did have some trouble gaining access to the building and also a problem with our shower. However the host did respond quickly
Clean, easy, and able to do your own thing.  Close to market, coffee, and several tasty restaurants, in you stay close by. Prices go way up the more you get towards the mall and whatnot.
There was a construction site that made our room very noisy, I requested to change the room to the other side of the building and the customer support was very helpful and we could change the room.

The room looks like the pictures. The room was clean and the area is quite with no noises during the night. I had a few issues with the room like the shower being clogged but as soon as it reached out to management via their messaging system this was resolved without delay.

Nice place to stay! Centrally located near the metro and a lot of places to eat. It is across the street from a police station, which can make you feel safe or uncomfortable, depending on your stance on police. The area felt very safe, and I had no problem walking the streets late at night. I highly recommend staying here
Location is across a police station. Rooms are dark . Kitchen is not compleet. Fire alarm went off at 22 PM we needed to wait outside for more than 30 min.

The apartment was exactly as in pictures. The heater provided was essential for November weather. Is 20 min walk to museums, public transport is within 5-10 min walk , depending of the lines needed.
We had a good stay for 5 nights.
Lana’s place was wonderful! Great spot for restaurants and a friendly atmosphere. I would recommend to anyone that’s looking for a great Air b & b spot!

Sybille’s bnb is homey and cozy. The kitchen is well-stocked with supplies, and the bed is really comfortable. The M1 tramline is right around the corner and it’ll take you to the centre of Berlin, and there are grocery stores at walking distance. There’s a cute kitty running around in the yard who likes scratches and is very friendly.
Sybille is a very helpful and welcoming host!
Would definitely recommend :))

Nice quiet getaway from the city.
Very cool and shady.
Everything you need is there and host was helpful.
Perfect home base while visiting my daughter nearby.  Lovely, light-filled space in a quiet neighborhood. Sybille was a great host! Thank you!

We absolutely loved Alexandro’s place and he was the best host! The apartment is beautiful and peaceful. The location is great, so many great shops cafes and bars close by. We couldn’t have asked for a better host, Alexandro met us at check in and helped out with great local suggestions. We would absolutely stay here again and would recommend it to all our friends and family. It is one of the best airbnbs we have stayed at!
Alexandros has been a great host, welcoming and helpful. We loved his cosy appartement, with a lot of light and quietness, located in a wonderful area, with many options for breakfast and dinners.

This was one of my best Airbnb experiences. What an awesome spacious apartment.  Classy, and full of character.  Alex was great: made the whole stay so easy and pleasant. Location was right near funky restaurants. And so close to the U5 underground. Really convenient. I loved it!!!
excellent host, place is great. clean, roomy. we stayed with small child, there was no problems
Thomas is a nice host and his place is quiet, calm, clean, spacious, handy, and in a great location. Highly recommended!

We had great stay at Franziska’s place. It was just as she described it. It got plenty of lights with nice balcony. It was a full moon during our stay and we got to see it directly from the bed 😍.
