The flat was very clean and spacious and in a great location with some bars and restaurants where locals go. Franziska was also communicative throughout our stay. So overall, we were very satisfied. Thanks again Franziska for letting us stay at your place.
We had a great time staying in this very beautiful central apartment. Franziska was very helpful and the roof terrace is lovely !!

My stay with Vincent was a truly wonderful experience. his deep knowledge of the area allowed me to find the best local restaurants for the type of food I was looking for. get a reservation here if it's available. you won't be disappointed

Vincent was an amazing host! Great local knowledge, very accomodating and absolutely wonderful to chat to. He’s also easy to reach if anything happens when he’s not home. It also helps that he’s just an all round lovely guy.
Vincent’s place is an absolute gem as well, perfect location and in walking distance from basically everything. Even though the train station across the street was out of action during my stay the next closest train station was a short walk away.
The room is large and neat with a comfortable bed and everything you need. I would be more than happy to stay here again and would highly recommend anyone else stay here as well!

Vincent's place is amazing. Right next to Gorlitzer U station, lots to do around. the house is big and Vincent is a great person to talk with.
Would definitely book again 😁
Vincent was kind, knowledgeable about the area, and very easy to room with. I was there for 1.5 months and felt right at home! 10/10 would recommend you stay.

Vincent's house is located close to Görlitzer Bahnof station. So convenient, and in a very lively neighbourhood. If you are seeking a quiet neighbourhood, this is not be the area for you.
The communication before and during my stay was excellent, almost always got an immediate reply. Vincent is an interesting and nice guy, an excellent host. His house is nice and warm, the rooms are spacious and clean. You can use the well-equipped kitchen and bathroom.

Had an amazing stay! The place is beautiful and has everything you need. It's in a quiet and lovely neighborhood, surrounded by lots of parks, great cafes, and charming shops.
I would highly recommend it and would be happy to come back again.

Stefan's apartment was something else. We loved every single minute we spent there. The furniture layout, the balcony, and the private rooftop were all exceptional. Stefan went above and beyond to make our stay easy and comfortable. When we asked for an additional desk for my colleague, he seamlessly delivered it. The apartment was incredibly clean, and he even allowed us to use his PS4 and BBQ if we desired. We are truly grateful for his hospitality, ease of communication and would like to extend our heartfelt thanks to Stefan for making our stay truly memorable.

Great apartment close to Tram lines, grocery stores, and restaurants.  Very quiet building and neighborhood.  Very clean and has everything you need for a great stay.  The private outdoor spaces are awesome if the Berlin weather cooperates!  We will definitely stay here again when we return to Berlin.

A well deserved Super host title : you really feel at home with Saskia.
The place is charming in a traditional Berlin flat and you can enjoy space, a super clean place and an ideal location to visit Kreutzberg and to commute to other districts.
The place to be to experiment Berlin's vibes!
Saskia is a really nice and open person, I felt right at home in her beautiful apartment! Would love to stay again.

Saskia is an incredibly gracious host. Kind, generous, and communicative. She was always available for assistance and recommendations if needed and she puts loving care and attention into hosting.
Her home is tranquil and tasteful with beautiful design, art, and natural light. I always felt at home and the bedroom is great, with a nice private balcony for sitting. The location is amazing.
The apartment itself would be amazing, but honestly it was Saskia's warm demeanor and kind spirit that really made the stay special. You definitely have space and privacy as needed, but any encounter with Saskia is just lovely.
Between the location, super cool apartment, and great vibes from host it was easily one of my best AirBnB experiences. Consider yourself lucky if you can book!

Saskia is a lovely and generous person, who opens her home as a home away from home  for you with clear and kind communications. The living spaces are creatively designed so you can retreat to self and even share the space with a feeling of comfort for all to roam through easily.  The bedroom which is private to you is very open, with a balcony facing the courtyard. Plenty of room to unpack and settle in for your visit! I was especially grateful to be able to cook in the fabulous kitchen while I was in town for a training with long days. The location is fabulous; great restaurants, bar, markets, the canal to walk down and access to transit to get anywhere else. If you prefer a space to sip in intention, grounding, art, yourself + Berlin —this is it!

Saskia’s place was beautiful, everything is well thought out and very comfortable. Saskia was extremely warm and welcoming, I enjoyed having a coffee with her in the morning - so kind! The place is perfectly situated, on a calm street near bustling Kreuzberg and the Kanal. I highly recommend!

Saskia and her place were absolutely lovely. I told her  before booking that I was coming in on a late flight and she was very accomodating. I came in for the Berlin Marathon and her place was in a perfect spot to get to the starting area as well as all other Berlin attractions via public transportation. I had never stayed with someone while Airbnb-ing so I didn't know what to expect, but I couldn't have felt more comfortable. It felt like I was staying with a roommate or a friend that I had known for a while. We were able to chat about the city, culture and the marathon. She had everything I needed for the weekend and made everything comfortable and easy. Saskia is a fantastic host and offers a wonderful place to stay. Highly recommend!
Saskia is super nice! Even though we did not meet each other in person, she was always super friendly and responsible. Her appartment is beautiful. Each single space she created is beautiful 😍

Staying in Sam's accommodation was lovely! It was well maintained and had everything I needed. Sam as a host was very helpful and quick to resolve any issues I had! The location was nicely located about a 2 minute walk from an S-bahn station and 5 minute walk from a U-bahn station, very practical!
The Airbnb is really cozy and really quiet, at only two minutes from the S-Bahn, with detailed informations for the self check-in and check-out. :)

The place is close to public transportation, restaurants and grocery stores. Nice bathroom. It is clean. The host is slow to respond. We had issues retrieving the keys from the lock box. The host tried to charge us for tourist tax a few days prior to our check in which we did not experience from our stay in other Berlin Airbnb.

Good experience, near to train station
But the bed has terrible smell, other than that, everything is fine.

Super easy to find and in a great location. Sam is a very friendly host and gave us some local recommendations. The place looked just like in the pictures and I‘d definitely go there again.
Thank you very much for having us!
The Communication with the host was exceptionally good. Well prepared  and nice cozy apartment. Will visit again!

Our stay at Sam’s place was very comfortable. The place is as described — private, quiet, and within couple minutes walking to the U-Bahn, S-Bahn, and several bus stations. Super accessible and in close proximity to some great restaurants — Heuberger (German food), Stumari (Georgian food). The bakery (Ploetz) right next door to the apartment has some fantastic pastries as well.
Overall, great location and a very responsive host. We would stay here again.
We enjoyed it so much we decided  to come back! The second stay was just as fun as the first, this stay is high on our recommendations list.
Good area for clubbing and night life, the room itself is basically perfect, it's clean and as described, and you can check in any time because it's automatic.
Good place to stay in Berlin. The only disadvantage is surprisingly in-depth on-line check-in, which demands again your personal details and scanning your ID. The appartment was fine, as described.
Everything was good, the only problem I had was that it was so hot in Berlin, so it was quite hard to sleep

We really had a wonderful stay in Berlin! And the apartment was just perfect! Just what we needed for a citytrip: a very good bed, clean kitchen and bathroom, relaxing and in a fantastic neighbourhood! Very very nice!

The place is well located and clean, in what used to be an Hotel.
Our only complaint is that other guests were quite loud and partying as we were trying to go to sleep :(
probably a fine place on weekdays but not ideal for weekends
Stayed for one night, the place was excellent. Many food places nearby and a very walkable area. Mini markets and pubs next door!
Flo was great. Quick responses & easy luggage storage both before check in & after check out.  Good neighborhood with so many bars/ restaurants nearby.

Everything was really nice! Cool location with a lot of nice places nearby.
When we had a problem- got an answer really quick. We would like to come here again
Very nice AirBnb well located near transports. Check-in and check-out instructions were very clear.
The room was very clean and nicely decorated, and the building was quiet and had a great location.
The room is so clean, tidy and nice. Public transportation is so close to the studio. Every host is super helpful. We got a very good stay there.

place was beautiful stunning design and location ! absolutely spotless so so clean !had everything you could possibly need made our stay extremely comfortable and peaceful ! great communication and clear information from host ! couldn’t recommend more ! it was perfect !

Aleksandra is a wonderful host. Friendly, accommodating and proactive.
The place is very cute and centrally located. In fact, we are staying with her again just next week!

3 of us stayed here for Berlin Marathon.  Nice, clean and  quiet place just 20 min train ride to and from main event. train station is just 2-3 mins . Lots of nice places to eat ( suggest reservations). Aleksandra met us in person and handed over the keys and gave an overview of the place.

I can’t say enough about how restful and comfortable this space was and how communicative Aleksandra was, from getting me where I needed to be after a late-arriving flight to her son helping us with our bags as we left. The space itself was so comfortable—the loft bed is like being at summer camp.
Everything you need is within walking distance and coffee, tea, laundry facilities—all provided. I kind of didn’t want to leave—thanks Aleksandra!!!

We loved our time in Andrea's flat. The location is perfect. Really cool neighbourhood for bars and restaurants. Within a few minutes of the tram and 5 mins of an underground station. Also, part of amazing history of Berlin. The wall was within a few hundred metres of property so the free wall tour (don't know the official name) is 1 minute from the front door. The flat itself is beautiful, lovely rooms and great outdoor space looking out over the rooftops and trees. Andrea was the perfect host. We would definitely choose to stay here again if we are back in Berlin.

This was a gorgeous little apartment right in the centre of Berlin and right on the Berlin Wall!! Public transport was very easily accessible so it was very easy to travel around the city and see the sights. The apartment itself was very clean, spacious and very well equipped with an excellent kitchen (which if there wasn’t so many excellent restaurants near by we would have used). This apartment was perfect for our short three night stay but would have been great for a longer stay as well. The only things to note is make sure you have wifi or data before arriving as Andrea did text us with a change in instructions on how to get in 15 before arrival and this apartment would not be suitable for a physically unfit person due to the large amount of stairs required to reach the apartment (however this did provide excellent views!). We will be back!!
Everything about the place was wonderful and it was close to the center. The only issue was the parking but you can find free parking places around 1 km from the place.

A very nice flat.  Clean and tidy, as described.  Quiet inside.  Worked well for four friends.  Joshua, the host, sent clear instructions and some useful tips for food, pubs, clubs and things to do.  Good area, and flat very close to U-Bahn and S-Bahn stations.  Overall we were very happy with our stay.
Joshua was a great host - responsive and communicative.  His place was great for us as close to our son who lives in Berlin. Overall a fab stay.

The apartment itself is really lovely. Very peaceful quiet clean. Josh was extraordinarily helpful and lovely. I hadn’t realized it was such a busy street and personally I would have preferred a quiet street so if you’re looking for that, the entrance to the apartment is on a very busy street  aside from that very comfortable beds and a very peaceful time once you’re inside the gate and inside the apartment.
Great place to stay! Lovely and clean and as described. Martin was very helpful with checking in and nice host
Friendly and responsive, trusted us in the gallery alone whilst he was away- we had no problems at all

Really great apartment in the central area of Berlin. The place was really cozy, spacious and Martin was really communicative and flexible. Definitely worth the price, considering the location and size of the accommodation!

Martin’s place was perfect for a getaway to Berlin as everything was so walkable - along with public transport and grocery shops just around the corner.
We loved the gallery that was just above the Airbnb with beautiful artwork, was a unique experience to stay somewhere like martins for so cheap.
There’s no service in the Airbnb but very reliable and fast wifi so wasn’t an issue.

Pleasant stay.
The appartment is well decorated and well located.
Martin is very responsive.

The house is beautiful, on a quiet street, clean and well-kept. Martin was extremely welcoming. He answered all our questions sincerely. We recommend.
Thanks for interest.

An absolute gem in an amazing location in Berlin. If you are looking for a mixture of great food options, beautiful scenery and fantastic transport connections, this is a great place to stay.
Martin was responsive to our needs and highly accommodating - would definitely stay again!

This is a lovely, idiosyncratic space that Martin has clearly put a lot of care and love into. No TV, which I was very grateful for. We enjoyed the art on the walls and the sense of staying somewhere just a little bit unique. Also very comfortable to come back to.

Martin was an excellent host who was always quick to respond to any queries.
His accommodation is well positioned relative to public transport connections and is a walkable distance to lots of museums and places to visit. I would certainly recommend it if you're visiting Berlin

Martin's place was beautifully decorated and right in the central area, walkable to all main attractions and lots of restaurants nearby. The fact that it is in an art gallery makes our stay even more memorable. Martin was very friendly and accommodating the whole time. We truly enjoyed our stay.

Unique place to stay under a little gallery. The apartment is decorated lovely and very cozy.
Location is very convenient too.
Made our Berlin stay very special.

A great little apartment in central location. As described it’s below a gallery in the lower ground floor so no big windows, but this didn’t matter to us as we were only there first thing and late evening. Martin was out of town but his friend met us and let us in at an agreed time. The beers left in the fridge were a great German welcome!
The only thing to consider is that our daughter said she found the second bed very firm indeed - I guess it depends what you’re used to. Overall a great base for our trip.
Unique apartment inside an art gallery. Wonderful location and safe location, can walk to many if the main neighbourhoods from here

Wonderful stay at Martin’s place! Full of life and beautifully laid out. Super cozy and clean. Perfect for 3 people.
Martin was very helpful and gave us very clear instructions. Respectful, helpful and very clear.
The location is perfect. Close to main sights and of course close to all kinds of public transport.
I highly recommend a stay in Martin’s place.

Our train was very late due to technical issues and Martin was super accommodating and waited for our arrival to help walk us through the apartment. Our stay was short but great in Berlin. Thank you, Martin.

Martin has a  wonderful peaceful apartment located close to lovely cafes and restaurants. It is so easy to locate and it feels safe and comfortable. Martin himself is definitely a superhost. Friendly and charming. We loved this special stay and I will return with my wife

Ulrike and her family were very friendly and welcoming. They have a lovely home which is very good located. It is very central but still a quiet place. She also had a lot of nice recomendations and really knows Berlin.

Would highly recommend a stay here: Ulrike is a very welcoming, friendly and enthusiastic host. The location of the house is ideal: close to everything you need, with lots of brunch spots and restaurants around. The room and bathroom were very clean and the house (especially the rooftop) is amazing. Ulrike also provided us with lots of valuable tips to make our stay even better.
Ulrike and Ralph’s place was in a great location, super close to the train and tram and lots of spots to eat. The room was super comfortable, we really enjoyed our stay. Thanks!

I stayed four nights while visiting the Berlin office of my employer and exploring the city. Ulrike’s place was quiet and cosy, with a guest bathroom and comfortable bed. The surrounding district has much to offer if you are looking for either history lessons or a decent bakery. I appreciated local tips on favourite places Ulrike and her family regularly visit.

We have good time to stay with Ulrike and her family for 4 days to browse around Berlin city. The location is perfect. She responded swiftly to all our queries👍
Thanks for all her attentive arrangements, allowing us to have early check-in and providing us with all the valuable gastronomic (host guidebook) & tourist advice (conversations with her family)🙏🙏🙏

Great location - it is in a cute, quiet and walkable neighborhood of Berlin. The bedroom was bright and cozy, and the bathroom was well-equipped. Ulrike was very helpful and nice, and I enjoyed my stay!

This was a wonderful place to stay. Ulrike and Ralph were so kind and helpful. The room is clean, comfortable, and beautiful. The location is amazing — walkable to plenty of hip bars, restaurants, bookstores, as well as historic sites. The neighborhood is beautiful and quiet and felt safe. I loved staying here and would absolutely stay again next time I’m in Berlin.

Jonas’ place is smack in the center of Mitte- the location can’t be beat. It’s a basement apartment, so it was a bit damp inside. If noise doesn’t bother you (we struggled with the nighttime plumbing noises and loud voices in the early morning) the location alone would make this place worth it for you. Easy walk to great food, museum island, memorials etc.

An incredible bottom floor flat right in the heart of everything in Berlin! Great restaurants around this area. Super walkable! Host was super responsive and gave clear instructions for our stay. Bed was super comfortable and the shower was updated and very beautiful. Would definitely come back!

A very welcoming host that leaves very clear instructions on how to find and get into the house. Also gave many recommendations for places to eat nearby as well as transport links.
Location wise it is perfect: close to the centre (Alexanderplatz and the museum island) but still a very peaceful area with lots of nice coffee shops and places to eat nearby.
Nice apartment which was clean, and had all the essentials. General living space is limited as was space to cook and store food, but this is all clearly visible from photos so as expected. It is also worth noting there is limited natural light.
For the price and the location you can’t ask for much more, and would recommend for people who just need a base to sleep and explore the city from
I stayed here for the Berlin Marathon and it was a nice place. Close to restaurants, supermarket, and public transportation.
We had a wonderful stay — everything was great! The beds were very comfortable, the house was clean, and the location was excellent. Highly recommended.

Roman and Iryna were wonderful hosts. The apartment was very clean and safe. The bus stop right out front got us instantly on the terrific Berlin transit system. Beautiful walking neighborhood. Loved our stay in Berlin. There is a Lidl grocery store a 5 minute walk away. And a few stops on the bus brings you to Steglitz Rathaus, the old city hall which has a very large modern shopping mall surrounding it.

The apartment met all our expectations and was very well located for public transport which was literally just outside the front door. Probably one of the best showers we have ever used in all our Airbnb travels - hot and great pressure. Roman was a great communicator and we were well looked after in that part of the trip. a great spot for a short 3 day stay in Berlin as we did. We would use it again without doubt.
Excellent apartment and location - exactly as described and at a great price. Eugen was a very responsive host and was an absolute pleasure to deal with.

It was amazing stay with my team of 13. Multiple rooms , clean bathroom, kitchen and linens.
Easy to find .
Host Eugen had been very communicative and responsive.
Totally recommend this.
Lovely apartment to stay in with friends. Good sized social space with kitchen. Bus stop across the road and tube 10 minute walk. Perfect for a short stay.

Great location - short walk to the Berlin Zoo and underground train station. The apartment itself was very spacious and easily accommodated our group of 14 people. Would recommend Eugen’s place to anyone traveling to Berlin!
We had a great stay for our group of 9.  Lots of room to spread out.  Easy to get around. Awesome host!

We had a family group of 14 and it worked great for us. There were 2 bathrooms and the rooms were a good size. The couch was large for a big group and there were 2 tables. It was located close to a grocery store and a bus stop, very central to lots of activities.

Walking distance from the train station, several restaurants, and shops. The building stayed cool and was easy to locate and check in. There was also a cool surprise feature in the rooms that my kid enjoyed a lot.
Great place and a great deal. we enjoyed our stay very much. There was enough privacy. We loved how clearly me hien gave the instructions for check in. Would love to visit again
Beautiful accommodation in a very nice neighbourhood. We really enjoyed our stay (big family with 2 small children). I would highly recommend it :)

Amazing clean place with everything you need. The beds where absolutely amazing.
Close to a station that will get you anywhere in Berlin. Friendly host who always responded really fast.

My month's stay in Berlin was elevated by this ideal accommodation:
Location: Centrally situated with cafes, restaurants, and supermarkets at your doorstep. An excellent starting point for either exploring or residing in Berlin.
The Space: Ample room, spotless, and outfitted with all necessities for both brief visits and extended stays. The beds ensured restful nights.
The Host: Warm and hospitable.
Would undoubtedly return and strongly endorse this place.

I cannot praise this wonderful apartment, the area of Prenzlauer Berg  or Elisa as host, enough. The apartment is really comfortable and stylish with everything that you could need for an enjoyable stay. It is right in the heart of things with amazing restaurants, cafes and bars very close by. The apartment itself is very quiet and peaceful and you wouldn'tknow that you were in such a vibrant area. The public transport is excellent, close by and so it's very easy to get around. We had a wonderful stay and fell in love with this part of Berlin and Room 22!!

The apartment was comfortable and very clean. The beds were comfy, it was nice to be able to wash clothes in machine during our stay, close to public transportation and had a wide choice of cuisines within walking distance. I appreciated the kitchen had Nespresso machine with coffee pods to enjoy a leisurely start to the day. Grocery store a few blocks away to pickup some snacks. This apartment wonderful.

We had a great time staying at Beyza‘s property! It's very good located and is easily accessible by metro, as well as other areas of Berlin.
The property is beautiful and well-kept, and Beyza was always very quick to respond to any messages.
Highly recommended for your next Berlin trip! 🌞
The girls thought the place was great and were really happy with the way the minor issue with the water was sorted so quickly. Recommended.

The location is amazing. The apartment is clean, new and everything was just like in the pictures.
Check-in could be better, they make you come within office hours to just sign a few papers, which you could definitely do electronically if they had the option. But they don’t. if you are short of time and in Berlin on business, you normally can’t afford an hour between 9 and 6pm. That’s why you’re paying for a service.
But honestly that’s my only complain, which means the place is great and I would definitely recommend it to anyone traveling to Berlin.

The apartment is just as described and the location is great. Lots of restaurants in the same building on the ground floor but the apartment is quiet at night. It was spacious.
My only issue was having no water for a whole day due to maintenance, this apartment is part of a large company who manages multiple apartments so it probably could have been avoided, we were given another room to shower in for that day. Also the pillows are not good. They are lumpy and square and not bed pillows at all. Other than that I would recommend the unit to people wanting somewhere convenient and easy.

We enjoyed our stay and found that the space and facilities all matched the listing. The check-in process was very simple and we received good communication in advance of arriving. The bedroom is very spacious with high ceilings, helping keep us cool during a warm summer week. The road (and building) was very quiet so we noticed occasional noise, but otherwise we were able to rest well and enjoy our stay. Thanks again!

All in all it was fine. But you should note that the front is a huge window facing the street (it likely was a store some time ago) so there can be some noises and the curtain does not block all views.
Thank you Philipp! The stay was great, a good space in a nice and quiet neighborhood. Close to Trams which keeps it well connected.

Really great stay! The place was clean, well-equipped, and just like the description. Everything went super smoothly, and the host was always available for questions – really friendly and easy to communicate with. The mattress was a bit worn out, but the host let me know it will be replaced soon. Still an easy 5/5, I’d definitely book again!

Pleasant and quiet area with excellent access to metro and buses. A grocery store is next door and several excellent and reasonably priced restaurants and cafes are very close. Try Bobsek burgers, yum! The apartment is cosy but worked well  for 4 of us for 5 days. Espesso machine is a bonus but bring beans! Hosts are responsive.
Was a pretty easy stay, nice place, host was friendly and communicated well with us throughout the stay. Thanks!

We spend 4 days here over the weekend to visit Berlin. The apartment was nice and quiet and was close to the center of the city. There were also some nice cafes close so breakfast wasn’t that complicated. Checking in and out was painless and the host was very responsive.

We really enjoyed our stay! The place was very clean, and communication with the host was excellent. Just a couple of things to note: the photos are impressively well done - so much so that they don't fully reflect the actual lighting in the space. It’s darker than expected, but given the fair price, we didn’t mind at all. Also, we noticed something green in the shower - likely just a small oversight, and we’re sure the host will take care of it. Overall, a great stay and great value!

Great flat, as advertised. 2 large bedrooms and fully equipped bathroom. Shower/bathroom was clean. Quick and easy self check in and out. flat is located far from major attractions but public transport is a few min walks from the flat. neighberhood feels safe and quiet.
Lovely place in a calm part of town. Met all of our needs for a nice weekend getaway!

Clean and spacious apartment. Everything was new. Clean bedsheets and very comfortable mattress, soft but not to much. Nice location. A bit far from the city centre, but easy to get. Calm and clean area. Worth it’s money! Recommended!
Was very impressed with the check in and check out process , was very clean and modern. Easy access to supermarkets

We had a lovely stay at Nena Apartments! The host was responsive and even let us check-in earlier - much appreciated 🙏🏼 The place is very cosy, perfect for 2-3 people. Kitchen well equiped.
Thank you!
Nice apartment for a couple days with a small kitchen and some Spätis nearby. Also very calm.
Everything very good. We spent 4 days and everything was ok. New apartment with all the facilities and latest technology.

It was a clean and very modern room. Mentions accommodation for 4 but is good enough only for 3 max. There was a delay of 50 mins to get the room. Good points- an elevator and a fan. River flows close by. There was enough to make 3 cup coffees and 2 cups of teas in the kitchen. Quiet area.
The station near by is 8-10 mins walk. Google took us through a very shady route but thankfully there were a few more people. The return to that station was a bit confusing as the station wasn’t showing on the ticket vending machine, but that issue is on the railway authorities.
The near by (Grocery I assume) stores were closed on Sunday. Overall good stay.
The unit was very close to bus and train stations. The unit was also clean. Just climbing on the stairs on the 4th floor was a bit challenging, but overall was very good.
The Best in Berlin! You will feel as you are staying in your dream home. Thanks to Thomas.

Thomas’s place was perfect for our needs. The apartment was very comfortable and had everything we required for a comfortable stay. The location is fanatic. Very close to several train/subway stations with lots of restaurants and things to do right nearby. Easy walk to museum island. Thomas was very responsive and friendly! Highly recommend!

In the photos the rooms looked much smaller. They are in fact bigger which only an upside. Location was perfect to go to other clubs. Thomas was ready to help with questions. Big recommendation to book this airbnb

Great stay in Berlin close to the metro stations and great cafes around for breakfast. The entry and stairs to Thomas apartment are authentic old Berlin which are a bit of a surprise. The apartment is incredible though and exceptionally finished and cleaned. It is 3 flights of stairs so keep that in mind. Thomas is more than happy to recommend places and is very responsive. Overall great stay would recommend.
We had a great stay,  the apartment was amazing, clean, well equipped and perfectly located for exploring Berlin.
Really stylish apartment with everything you would need for a comfortable stay. Host responds quickly to any questions you might have and is on hand to help.
Spacious apartment, quick walk to metro and was exactly what was described. Would definitely stay again!

The inside of the apartment is just lovely and matches the description and photos.  The outside graffiti and the inner hall downstairs is a little off putting.  The apartment had everything needed for our week stay and was in an ideal location for using local transport and had lovely eateries in close proximity.

Thomas is great, very responsive and readily shared his local knowledge about local amenities, public transport travel etc . The apartment is amazing and exactly as described. We did struggle a bit with the 4 flights of stairs as we were travelling with a toddler, pram etc however overall a great stay
Whilst the outside of the property was a little startling - we had been warned in advance.  The flat itself was excellent, very clean and comfortable and well situated to explore Berlin.
Wonderful stay! The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. Great location and Thomas was super responsive and welcoming. Would definitely stay again!

We enjoyed staying here, it was close to the Museum intel, close the the underground and some nice cafe's just around the corner.
Thomas was very responsive and even sorted out the weather for us, sunny skies, good times!

Very happy with our stay. Beautiful apartment with lots of light and perfect for winding down and relaxing after busy days and nights in Berlin. Valentin was a welcoming host and everything went very smooth.
We really enjoyed staying at Valentin’s apartment. The large windows, 2 balconies, well equipped kitchen and comfortable beds were wonderful. The location is great too.

Valentin’s place was spacious and bright. We were very comfortable during our stay. The place was close to the train line, grocery stores, pharmacy, bars, restaurants and close to the clubs -if you are looking for a night out. Public transport was close and easy to use.
Valentin was a great host, super responsive and helpful. We loved staying at his place.
Valentin’s place is in very good location. Closer to everything you need and super safe. Valentin was great at communicating with us. We’d love to be back!

Valentin's place was perfect for our stay. Right by main transport lines, great food spots and positioned perfectly so we still had peace and quiet when needed. The apartment was spotless, cosy and so much better than the photos! Valentin was a great host, communication was seamless, check in was flexible and all info was clear and available. I would definitely recommend this place.
We had a great stay! This spot is close to train stations, a convenience store, and a pretty park. We loved it!

This place is good for a big group, nice to cook and eat around the big table. The inside is much better than it looks from the outside. lovely tall ceilings, comfortable beds, nice new furniture . Modern feeling. Not really a living room for lounging as a group, mostly big kitchen space and table. Location was good to get to everything on public transportation and bike rental nearby. Would stay again. Ludger was a great host.
Spacious place, clean, great location, speedy communication, perfect for my birthday event that hosted 8 people. I would definitely come back again!

Was great place to stay not too far from everything was walkable.
Place was well kept and host was attentive.
If visiting berlin in a big group must stay here.

Absolutely flawless stay here! Highly recommend for larger groups. I loved having the big central dining area to bring everyone together. The beds were all really comfortable and the kitchen fully equipped. Love the surrounding area too and right next to a tram stop. Thanks for a fabulous time!

Had a wonderful stay at Flattering Apartment. The apartment was as described in the photos. Location was convenient as Lidl and Penny are just round the corner. Additionally the bus stop and the U bahn station was very nearby. Communication was quite friendly and responsive with clear instructions about check in and check out. The kitchen was also well equipped to cook our meals. Some local recommendations for restaurants or places to visit would have been a cherry on top.
Nice apartment, well connected to transport links and shops. Good communication with the host and clear instructions on how to enter the property.

Zoe’s place was perfect. It was SO quiet for being right in the city, centrally located, clean, and had the BEST aesthetic ;) Zoe was a super responsive host (I don’t understand these other reviews), and was extremely flexible with check-in (and descriptive, too). I would come back to Berlin just to stay here - haha - I loved this place!

Great stay overall! The apartment was clean, comfortable, and had everything needed for a smooth visit. The check-in process was easy and communication with the host was straightforward. Would recommend to anyone visiting the area.
Daniil was really helpful and when I had a problem with warm water he promptly came and solved the problem. Thank you again!

The place was great to stay in, great location. a 15 min walk from Alexanderplatz or a short tram ride. Bhavna even proactively asked if we wanted an additional bed set up in the bedroom for our child so she could be in the same room and we could enjoy the loungeroom at night. A great experience.
Only thing I noticed was the shower bracket was loose and the showhead kept falling down. It was only a mild inconvenience and didn't ruin our stay. When I mentioned it to Bhavana, she apologised and said she will get it fixed for the next people.
It was a quiet and cozy place he was very attentive and made sure I had everything and checked to see if I had any questions! Would recommend!
Daniele is very pleasant, kind and helpful. He was very flexible with the check in and check out. The room is nice located and easy to reach. Nice stay even for mobile working with good WiFi.

Daniele's place has everything for a traevelers need. 10-15 min walk from main station and things about house is just as described. Daniele was also so kind all the time. The place is definetely a winner considering the price and location.

Great place to stay — central location, and clean rooms, with all needed amenities. Nice staff — very mindful, very demure.
I also loved the website app with easy access instructions. Good job!
A great stay! Very close to the Ubahn. Room was perfect for what I needed. Super clean, private, and cozy. I look forward to my next stay here.
the bed is amazingly comfortable and clean. Bob and the team are very kind and supportive:) I will definitely choose the Bob again if I travel to any place in the world with Bob.W

This spot was perfect! Super clear instructions, easy to find and easy to access. I knew exactly what to expect, and the flexibility with check-in and check-out made it the ideal stay when I experienced unexpected travel delays. The area was nice, with plenty to do and see within walking distance. I would stay here again in a city Bob W has a location and I have already booked another stay in Berlin.
Thanks!
Great quick stay! Perfect location with lots to do. The room was outfitted with everything I needed. Love all the branding details all around the room too. A+!

Great stay! Was able to do laundry and clean place to stay. Please be aware the rooms are not soundproof and everything echos up and down the building, especially if you are in the rooms by the stairs. The Bob team was great and checked in daily to see if I needed anything. The texts were also entertaining!

This stay was great for a solo traveler! Also great if you like to go out to nightclubs, Kit Kat nightclub is a block away and still located on a quiet street! Great coffee and restaurants walking distance. Also two metro stations are within a 5 minute walk from the building. I would definitely recommend.
Andres was really friendly and helpful. Didn’t have any problems, the flat was clean and in good place
Great location, just outside the city centre. Great communication and help from Andres. The apartment had everything we needed and it was an all round wonderful stay.

Absolutely fell in love with Berlin and this apartment! Wedding was a beautiful place: a cheap beach nearby and u-bahn just around the corner!
Andres was very kind and everything was was equivalent to photos in Airbnb-website. One thing that left us concerned was that at one point we totally lost contact with Andres, since he only answered to our messages on the first day.

Nice apartment. Easy to go to city center.
It provides all the kitchen equipment so it was nice we can have breakfast at the flat before we go out!

A truly wonderful place to stay, especially with kids: great location, quiet and peaceful, easily accessible, beautiful and spacious apartment where you instantly feel at home, nicely decorated and the kids had great fun. Kind and responsive host. Highly recommended!

We really liked the neighbourhood where Gottfried lives. It’s right next to all the public transport you could need. The area has lots of bars, restaurants and delightful little squares. Gottfried’s apartment is very quiet and peaceful - no noise at all. He was very welcoming and hospitable and gave us some great ideas for things to do in Prenzlauer Berg.

Initially a bit of a treasure hunt to find key & exact location but added to the fun. Gottfried was on hand to answer any questions & was very welcoming. Everything was provided for my stay, including a hairdryer (I'd forgotten mine). Ideally situated with everything needed practically on the doorstep. Very recommended.

Quiet apartment with old world charm, lovely floors.  Bed on a one inch platform so basically on the floor as picture but as seniors we would think again about this place, otherwise right next to excellent public transport and many exceptional restaurants.  Enjoyed our stay in this clean quiet oasis

Very close to UBahn which makes transportation very easy.
The room was super clean and big.
I would recommend this to everyone!

awesome location literally at heart of Kreuzberg. the team is really good and the rooms and shared bathrooms are clean. coffee machine and coffee are missing. generally there is nothing much but the room so a bit more love would make it 5 Stars.

The apartment was very spacious! Beautiful big room with a very comfy bed. Located in a bustling area with tons of restaurants and takeaways and very walkable to lots of different stations. Definitely would recommend if you like Turkish food too!

The apartment is close to public transportation and is very easy to find! Self check-in was a breeze and it's in a great, quiet location that is close to public transportation, food, bars, cafes, and grocery stores! The place was well stocked and had pretty much everything you would need.
Toni was a great host, he provided all the information you need for an awesome stay in berlin, big up. I can only recommand this place, it's very convenient to travel from there.

I visited Berlin to see family and friends and Toni's place was just perfect. The studio apartment is located in a nice neighborhood and in walking distance to grocery stores, parks, cafés and restaurants. The U-Bahn is 2 minutes away and Ku'damm, Zoo & Tiergarten, Savignyplatz, - all is practically down the street. Although parking can be a challenge during the day, Toni can recommend close-by places where you can park for free. Again, if you are in Berlin to explore the city, this is the perfect hub to stay and start your excursions. I highly recommend Toni's place.
We enjoyed our stay at Toni's place. There are some good restaurants and supermarkets nearby and the transport links are superb.
Toni is a very kind and good person, he is answering very fast. The place is clean and the location is perfect
We really enjoyed a six night stay in Toni’s apartment. The location was perfect for accessing everything we wanted to see in Berlin and Toni was extremely helpful and responsive.
Loved to stay there. I would advise to anyone who’s planning to stay in Berlin for a few days or even more!
Every things is great and I enjoyed with accommodation. The location is so close to people Blichers transport and the room wa tidy. I highly recommend this place to book!
Just a really lovely apartment, place was really clean and incredibly accessible (no keys, you just use a specific code to get into your place). I really loved my stay here and would recommend it!

we had a great stay at numa berlin boxer!
the place was spotless, modern, and looked just like the photos. check in and check out were super easy thanks to the clear instructions, which made everything really stress-free.
Him and his partner were helpful in answering my dumb American questions on a first trip to Berlin. Great experience, highly recommended. 🙂

Hendrik and Isabelle are absolutely wonderful! They are so kind, generous, and welcoming, and their apartment is private, clean, bright, and super conveniently located. It’s right by public transportation stops as well as the most bustling parts of Prenzlauer Berg. I so enjoyed my stay at their apartment, and I will absolutely stay at their apartment the next time I’m in Berlin. Truly the best Airbnb experience I’ve ever had!

Perfect location and very nice typical old appartment house. It is like a flat on it's own and bigger than it looks in the pictures. Newly renovated and very fresh bathroom, very comfortable bed.  A big wardrobe is available. Practical with a small fridge and possibility to have a tea and a snack at home. Would be very happy to stay again!

Perfect stay. Very large and comfortable bed, great shower. Desk available for working. Beautifully decorated. Everything very clean. Super quiet surroundings, right in the middle of nature. Recommended to escape the hustle of the city. Philip was very friendly and accommodating, thank you for the pleasant stay. We would love to stay again!
Great Airbnb unit, everything is perfect except it is on the top of the building and required good walk up
Lovely spot. My friends and I stayed two nights. Erik was very easy to communicate with and the place was very bright - bathroom and beds very clean.

We spent a very nice time in Erik´s department. Nice place, clean, new and comfortable. All looks as pictures shows. Near access to many public transport. The department is in a very nice environment. It is highly recommended. Thank you Erik for hosting me and my family!!
Erik offers a good place to stay in Berlin, with 10mins walk to 2 different subway stations, at a very affordable price
The airbnb is located in a nice neighborhood, the instructions to check in were clear, the host allowed for earlier check in. The apartment was clean and new.

The place was perfect for doing some tourism around the city. We were barely home and the apartment had everything we needed. Maybe the biggest inconvenient was that it’s a 5th floor with no elevator. Apart from that, it’s a simple and modest place to stay.
A small but comfortable place that is great if you plan to spend a lot of time exploring the surrounding neighborhoods and the city. Easy check in and very clean Apartment.

The tiny apartment was as described. Although it is very small, everything is there. It is a great experience to live in such a small space. Everything was clean and worked perfectly. The apartment itself is on a quiet street that leads to all kinds of restaurants and activities. Communication with Florian was great.

This is an apartment as small as it gets. Be aware, that it is right above the entrance, so you hear people come and go, you might need earplugs, if you are sensitive to banging doors under your bed. Otherwise it is very well located and a pretty good deal compared to other places in Berlin.

I stayed at Florian's place for two weeks. The apartment is as described: (very) small but well-located and clean. It is a good choice for travelers who are mostly out and about, visiting Berlin's many attractions and museums. I would definitely stay again at Florian's place.

Five stars all the way. Styley apartment close to lots of things we wanted to do, walking distance to Hauptbahnhof. This apartment is perfect for a short stay in Berlin, lots of restaurants close by, a good Ubahn line and the Hamburg Bahnhof gallery. Superbly designed space that had everything we needed. Thanks.
Very clean and cozy place. Very nice location. Helpful host. We enjoyed our stay very much.

Matthew’s place has all the basics you need for a great stay in Berlin. It is well connected, the main bed is super comfy and he is a great, communicative host who went over and above to make our stay comfy, such as dropping over extra towels. Thanks Matthew!
Great location, very clean, sleek and modern design, very new appliances, in a perfect area. We had a great stay.
Gorgeous flat in beautiful location well with reach of central Belin. The local area is beautiful with lots of restaurants and a local play park for the little ones. Amazing stay!

Polina's apartment was absolutely perfect for our stay. The apartment is located on a lovely street close to lovely restaurants and bars. It is extremely spacious, clean and comfortable. I would highly recommend.

Absolutely beautiful apartment with a super helpful and accommodating host. Everything was spotless and exactly as described- if anything EVEN BETTER! Will definitely be coming back, what a beautiful area ❤️

The location was great, and the hood also. But the apartment  is not sound proof the up stairs neighbor’s toddler starts tapping at 7 AM each day so it wasn’t easy to sleep in also very sensible to put music because the noise woke up the kiddo.
Nice location and pleasant street. Neighbours were tolerant to small noises which was fine. Nearby stores, restaurants and metro station with a few minutes walk.

Very quiet in the backyard, beautiful neighbourhood close to Friedelstrasse, Maybachufer and well connected to public transport. It was perfect for me and my daughter with two separate rooms and bathrooms. Thank you Yara for the very kind communication!
Very nice, attentive host, and very good place. A walk up, which would make it harder for older people, but otherwise a very nice apartment with plenty of space and good amenities.

Would definitely recommend for a short stay!
I didnt stay longer either: was basically there for Saturday night, but I really like it
The check-in was very nice: even though my train was very late, but it wasnt an issue
Dominik and Mathias met me personally, showed, and explained everything, also gave a few tips for coffee places etc
I also like that check-out at Dominik place was later than usually it is

Best place in Berlin hands down!
You can't go wrong with Dominik and I highly recommend his spot.

Excellent stay! Location was amazing; just outside busy plazas to avoid the noise, but easy access to plenty of restaurants and less than a five minute train ride from the nearest hub (Alexanderplatz). Dominik was FANTASTIC. Friendly, accommodating, communicative, everything you could want in a host! Highly recommend.
very beautiful apartment with lots of space. Great location with shops close by. I would definitely stay here again.
The place is amazing, comfortable and quiet, although very close to some very busy areas. Their responsiveness before and during our stay was also very good. Place is highly recommended.
Great location, easy access to explore Berlin. Flat was lovely. Would definitely recommend if coming to Berlin.

The location of the apartment was excellent, however, it got quite noisy at night with different bars and restaurants around. Also, the bedroom facing the street got a lot of noise from early deliveries to the stores around.
The place was lovely, beds comfortable and host very responsive.
Otherwise a beautiful large apartment.

David and Lilit were responsive and flexible hosts. The location of the apartment in Berlin Mitte is amazing, with close proximity to landmarks, great shopping, tons of restaurants and cafés and different transportation options (tram/streetcar, S-Bahn and the central train station). Although it's so central and located directly at the famous Hackesche Höfe, it should be quiet enough for most people - at least the two bedrooms facing the courtyard. The apartment is very spacious and full of interesting books on design and architecture. The check-in and check-out process was smooth. For a short - or even longer - trip to Berlin, this is a super apartment.
We had a lovely time in this space. It was right in the middle of a wonderful area with plenty to do within walking distance in each direction. We would definitely stay here again.
If you are a book loving family or group of friends with style, go get that apartment, you won’t regret

The floors were so squeaky that we were afraid to walk at night. Also some linens made us doubt if they were washed as they smelt bad. Apart from that, it was as described, spacious, great location, and clean. Thanks

The facilities in the apartment were very good,although we did have problems with one of the televisions as we couldn't tune it in.
Good location with good transport links into the centre. Lots of lovely cafés and restaurants close by. Very enjoyable stay considering it was our first time using Airbnb.

Limehome Berlin is quite nice airbnb, walkable from city center.
The place is suitable for a weekend stay. However the price paid is too expensive for the standing proposed.

Amazing stay!!!
We visited Berlin for the hyrox and when communicating with the host if it is close by it was perfect distant. Great communication!
Lovely location, plenty to do in walking distance. Would definitely book again.

Nancy was very accommodating and friendly.  The home was spacious, clean and included all required facilities for a family with kids. My family and I were very happy with our stay and would definitely come back again.

Marie has a lovely place. Very homely and lovely interior. Loved her plants and the little balcony with a comfortable sitting. Easy to get to location from central train station, one bus to catch. Number of restaurants around and few bars to enjoy.
Very nice stay at Marie-Antonia's place. The place is very nicely decorated, we felt like home!
Very cosy place to stay, perfect for a couple of days/Weekend in Berlin! Would recommend every one to stay here if you like homey vibes!

Really impressed by its pretty and quiet location. Kitchen was well prepared, host even catered to our specific needs. Bathroom and bedroom very clean. Thi Xuyen genuinely care for his guests. Really make the place feel like a second home.
The house is generally good, but the sewer in the shower room is blocked and there is some bad smell.

We loved the apartment which was spacious and bright. The location was excellent with bars, restaurants and shops very close at hand; lovely brunch in the restaurant next to the entrance. Anna was really responsive, helpful and a top host. Would highly recommend Anna’s place.
A very cute apartment to stay in Berlin. The unique roof window makes it cosy & relaxed. The area is super. We would come back here.

The location is perfect—close to major attractions and public transport, yet tucked away in a quiet, charming neighborhood. The flat is bright, beautifully decorated, and spotlessly clean. The living area is spacious and comfortable, the kitchen is fully equipped, and the bedroom is a peaceful retreat with a very comfy bed.
The hosts were fantastic—responsive and helpful with great local tips. This flat is a true gem, and I highly recommend it for anyone visiting Berlin. I can't wait to come back!

For my first time in Berlin, this was a perfect place to stay. Matthias was available, but not overbearing. Highly recommend this to anyone looking for a charming eclectic vibe, that’s close to transit with walkable spots. Vielen Dank Matthias!
Really loved this Airbnb! Matthias was a great communicator and host, location was perfect, home was very nice - highly recommend
Spotlessly clean, peaceful and comfortable. The location was great! The apartment was stylish and the hosts were helpful and friendly. Would highly recommend this beautiful apartment.

Matthias’s place felt like stepping into a hidden gem, beautiful, soulful, and full of character. From the moment we arrived, he was a generous and thoughtful host, helping with our bags and sharing a list of local spots that made our stay even more memorable.
The roof windows were awesome, flooding the space with natural light and fresh air. As a designer, I was also captivated by the decor. Every detail felt intentional, like the home had been curated with love, not just styled.
The location was also wonderful. Tucked among flea markets, indie boutiques, and charming little restaurants. If you're from Melbourne, it has that unmistakable Fitzroy/Collingwood energy, creative, laidback, and humming with local life. Thank you Matthias, we loved our stay and will be back for sure.
Great apartment, very clean and the kitchen was very well equipped. The host met us in the scheduled time and we had no problems with the accommodations.

We had a wonderful time staying here! The house was very cozy and had all the charm of a true Airbnb home, which always makes us feel at home. The location was fantastic, close to everything we needed. Overall, a lovely experience. Highly recommended!
The place was clean and cozy, easy to get to and has good transport links, but it would have been better if there’s Wi-Fi and hairdryer.

Entering the space was easy. You can check in whenever and there is no need for meeting any host. The apartment itself was very limited. Almost no kitchen stuff, no coffee machine, no spoons. The blankets on the bed were not blankets, it felt more like a thin sleeping bag. When we asked for other blankets the host responded with that it was not possible and that we should turn on the heater. The apartment was very small, about 12 m2. The space needs a bit of love in order to rent it out to people. This is easy money making for the host. But great location!
The apartment is perfect for a city break, great location and I would say better in person than in the photos!!
Perfect. The photos don’t do the penthouse justice. We were comfortable, central, and had great amenities and support from the team. Can’t recommend enough.
Lovis place was absolutely beautiful and a perfect location in walking distance from the park and lots of amazing restaurants.

We had a great stay at Lovis’s apartment- it is in a fantastic area close to many restaurants, shops, cafes. The supermarket across the road is great and the train station is just down the road. The apartment has a really authentic feel with large, light filled rooms which are thoughtfully furnished and feel very spacious.
It’s located on the second floor and as there is no lift it can be a bit of a hassle with suitcases.
As there are lots of cupboards that are locked with the owners things, it would have been good to have some drawers/ cupboard space for guest storage.
It was a heatwave whilst we were in Berlin but the apartment stayed nice and cool.
Thanks so much for our stay!

Nice apartment with a fabulous location.
The area around the apartment is very lively, full of good restaurants, cafes and shops.
Leon is a friendly person and easy to communicate with.
Best Airbnb experience I’ve ever had. Everything was immaculate and even better than photos. Thank you!

The apartment is very nice, located super close to the metro but is also quiet and Max was helpful and responsive. Only thing was the shower pressure that was very low and we didn’t manage to fix it, but we were able to have hot showers nonetheless. So all in all very recommended

Great host
Lovely apartment, is bigger in real life
Comfy beds
Clean and modern
Great stay
Thanks!

Villiam’s place is just perfect for your Berlin experience. Nestled in a bustling area, it’s located in a peaceful building perfectly furnished. You will feel right at home! It was the 4 of us and there was room for everyone. The kitchen is equipped for all your basic needs. Beds are super comfy. Natural light through the windows makes the room beautiful.
Villiam is nice and kind. He speaks italian perfectly and knows how to welcome guests. He was available for any info and request.
The area is well connected and you’ll be able to live the city vibes at walking distance.

We had a fantastic stay at Villiams place. The flat has a lovely vibe in a lively neighborhood. Although the flat is quiet during the night. Villiam is very friendly and a super host. Would definitely book again!

The coolest host, super helpful and nice, with a super nice and chill flat in one of the most vibrant and really authentic hoods of Berlin. There where the real life of Berliners takes place. We will definitely come back. Thank you!!!

The apartment was very good and matched our expectations. Villiam, our host, greeted us in person and provided all the essential information upon arrival. He’s a warm and welcoming person, which made our stay even more pleasant. The location is great — very close to the metro, which made getting around easy.
One thing to note: two of the beds are located in the same room, which isn’t entirely clear from the photos.
Overall, I recommend staying with Villiam — he’s a great host and his apartment is a solid choice for a city stay.

I highly recommend Villiam’s place. Beautiful apartment with nice high ceilings in a great location. Villiam always reachable and helpful, all went very smoothly. Thanks for sharing this great place with us for a few days.

It’s quite different as pictures, but that’s not a big deal. This apartment includes everything you need. The only thing is when we lived there the central heater was not working, it’s really cold during winter time. Hope they gonna fix it soon
We stayed at an awesome, modern apartment in a great location. The home was large, clean, and had everything we needed. Communication was easy and straight forward. Great stay overall.
Pierre was a great host, and we thoroughly enjoyed our stay at this prime location in Berlin. I highly recommend this property for anyone visiting the city.
The apartment was terrific. Walkable to a train station, bus lines nearby, and right by the East Side Gallery and Berlin Wall Museum.  Two nice cafe’s in the building. We enjoyed our stay.

Although the apartment was different than what was advertised, the host immediately contacted me to let me know and share videos/ photos of the Apartment we would be staying in. The Apartment was clean, great location, and very reasonably priced. Perfect for visiting Berlin. I can absolutely recommend it.
Perfect hideaway in peaceful and beautiful surroundings, yet close to everything. Ville and Poly were the best hosts, always there to help if needed. Highly recommended for anyone in Berlin!
Such a great place to stay for a central location in Berlin! Elisa is very responsive and helpful :) the place is cozy and homey. Thank you again!

We had an amazing time at Elisa’s place. It was just as the pictures showed and, while small for 3 of us, it didn’t matter as we could walk anywhere we wanted and there were numerous restaurants and cafes (literally) right outside the door. A perfect base for us to explore family history and the amazing sights of Berlin from.

Had a great stay at Elisa’s. Great location - walking distance to major stations, lots of restaurants around. Once you are inside the place, you can’t hear any noise coming from the streets, which was great. Place is big enough for two travellers. Clean and tidy all around!

The accommodation was nice and cozy. There are shops and bus stations near by. Free parking on the streets. The owner is nice with good vibe. She was helpful and fast answering.😊
We enjoyed cat’s company, but you don’t have to let her inside, if you don’t want to.😊

Ilona was very kind, quick to respond to questions and was very flexible with the check-in time. She gave us great recommendations for cute coffee shops. The place is on the smaller side (but exactly like in the pictures), very well and efficiently furnished while also giving a homey feeling. The airbnb is a little in the outskirts of berlin, in a residential area but there is good connections with public transportation (buses, subway). Thanks for all :)

This is a beautiful, clean, well-maintained apartment with a large spacious balcony, fully equipped kitchen, spacious and clean bathroom, and quaint views. It has a great cafe on the ground floor and laundry right outside the unit. We had a comfortable stay and loved the apartment. Highly recommend.
the apartment is beautiful the location is great with meteo train supermarket and restaurants in a walking distance. the host was very interested in us and is fully recomended
The place is ok for a few nights. The wifi was not working the whole time and the bed duvet was without a cover so it did not feel clean...

The room was clean and tidy.  I found it cosy and very quiet even though it was opposite the train station.  The room was located at the back of the accommodation.  Bath was dated but clean.   My only criticism was the show head holder was broken.    Something obvious that should be fixed.    I found the room warm enough and a blanket was provided on the bed.

The room was really good. The shower had amazing pressure, it was really clean, and the bed
was amazing. We did thought that the address could have been better explained, but the hosts
were simply amazing and guided us pretty fast. In the topic of the hosts, they were really nice,
they always answered our messages fast, and helped accommodate a few of our needs. We'd like
to highlight that the house is a bit far from the tourist stuff, but you have a subway and a tram
station right outside the house that come really often, so it ended up being no problem for us.
The house is also really close to a lot of restaurants, so we had a lot of options to eat near by
needing to go to the main part of the city. Overall, the stay was really good and we'd definitely
recommend.

This was the best stay we had in all of our Europe trip. Extremely clean and felt at home! The hosts were lovely, very nice people and their house is beautiful. Would love to stay again! Absolutely loved it!

The place was fantastic! It looked exactly like the photos, which was a great relief. The host provided all the necessary information in advance, making everything so easy, and was always available to answer any questions I had. Highly recommend this spot for a comfortable and stress-free stay!

Very very good. It’s my first time choosing a room near the airport. Normally I choose the city centre.  But the place is also good. The bus station is close to the apartment and it is also convenient to go to the city centre. The place is quiet and the room is pretty. Good
Hans is very organised and communication was easy. We found the place of the rbn really nice. Thank you!

Secluded courtyard in busy Prenzlauerberg, spacious, lots of soul. Kitchen with dishwasher, washer and dryer, big fridge, more than enough cutlery. Two bathrooms, one really large with both huge bathtub and shower cabin. Marcus was super friendly and responsive.

We appreciated the cozy atmosphere of David's home, which served as a comfortable base for our family trip. However, we did notice some areas for improvement regarding maintenance and cleanliness. Despite these minor issues, we had a great time overall.
David's apartment is a great place to stay if you are planning a trip to Berlin. It is very spacious and well-located, close to public transportation and supermarkets.

The flat was perfect for the five of us to stay for a week! The location was close to busses and trains and the windows faced the inner courtyard which was serene and quiet. We loved the location and David was extremely accommodating and responsive to all our questions and needs. We couldn’t imagine a better experience visiting Berlin! If I could give six stars and would! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Really enjoyed our stay in Prenzlau Berg and would definitely return. The apartment was clean, matched the description and was easy to access. Close to the couple of train lines we used every day (S and U Bahn). Close to supermarket and had a well- stocked kitchen in which we cooked.

Our tenth year visiting Berlin and this is one of the best Airbnb we have stayed in.
Price : Great value for money.
Location: Near S+U Bahn and Tram. Walkable. Near some late night Spati and Kebab. And early morning coffee at the corner. But do not go to Pizza Miranda. That one was not so nice.
Apartment: Very much as described and very spacious. As a family of 4 (2 adults and 2 Teenagers) we have enough space to have privacy and also sit together for late night suppers. Our favourite is the big butcher block counter top.
Access and Communication: David and Francesca was very accommodating and detailed with their instructions.
Thank you so much for making another memorable stay in Berlin for us.

David’s place was excellent. Good location and close to the station. Very nice neighborhood with supermarkets and coffee shops nearby as well as places to eat. The place was very warm as it was very cold in Berlin and super clean. Spacious and very beautifully decorated. Everything we were looking for. David and Francesca were very helpful with everything we needed and always responding on time. Definitely coming back to stay when I come to Berlin again. Totally recommending this.

A recomendable place where everything was tip top.
Large rooms, two bathrooms and a fully furnished kitchen.
We would certainly choose the place again.
With gratitude,
Robert O. and kids

We had a great stay. The apartment was very cosy and in a good area :)
Thank you!
Boris was a great host for our short stay in Berlin. He is responsive, friendly, and made us feel very welcome!
Nice stay, place matches the pictures. The shower was a little dirty and there was no shampoo or body wash.
Derek's place was easy to locate. It was about 5 minutes to the U5 line. the place was quiet, warm in cold Berlin nights and clean. Overall we had a good experience.

Stella was an excellent host! We had such a great stay in Berlin. The accommodation was everything as described, very clean, comfortable and beautifully decorated. We were given many great recommendations for food and activities. Definitely recommend a stay at Stella’s accommodation in Berlin.
This place is even cuter in person. I would definitely stay here again with everything being so clean and spacious and comfortable.

Stella's apartment was lovely and had a 'cool' feel about it. Our only disappointment was that there was a plastic bottle lying on the floor beside the coat rack and quite a bit of dust on the plug sockets. Not a big problem overall. The self check in was simple and the area was really nice and easy to get around. Overall, a great apartment, even if it was more than I'd have liked to have paid but I guess that is Berlin prices.

had amazing time here, place for 5-6 people. amazing location close to subway and tram, with lots of bars and even shopping mall nearby. host was responsive even on the 1st of may(Labour Day) holiday.

We loved our stay at this very stylish flat. The living room is really large, including a massive very comfortable sofa. There was plenty of space for the 5 of us staying to hang out.
The area is very trendy with lots of nice cafes and bars nearby. Good public transport connections for getting around to anywhere else in the city. We mostly cycled which was also great with Berlin’s great cycling infrastructure.
Stella’s apartment was a lovely place to stay in the heart of Berlin. Great neighborhood and easy access to trains/restaurants nearby.

I had a fantastic stay at Stella's apartment. The accommodation was exactly as described: clean, comfortable, and in a great location. The host was very responsive and attentive, which made my stay even more enjoyable. I highly recommend this place and wouldn’t hesitate to stay here again on my next visit to Berlin.
This place was a gem to find, we loved our time staying in Berlin. Stella, the host, communicated very nicely and reached out many times. Highly recommend this place to all

Photos don’t do justice how large the apartment is. It was so spacious with lovely high ceilings. Fitted 3 adults and 2 kids brilliantly.
It was super clean and well equipped. We’d definitely stay again. Loved the location too…great transport links.
The only minor downside was that the apartment got quite warm (understandable given the high summer temperatures); but because there are no opening windows on the front of the apartment, we couldn’t get a through-draft to help cool it down at night. A couple of fans for the summer months would be an excellent addition.
Stella’s flat was easy to find and check in, and was clean and comfortable. The location is well connected in a nice area, and would recommend to anyone wanting to explore Berlin
A trendy and comfortable place to stay in Berlin! Such a lovely space and the kids loved the bunk bed!
Place is as described, clean, good location. Only one bathroom can be a problem for bigger groups. Somewhat too expensive. Otherwise all good

Perfect for six "individual" guests as there are six single beds. Bathroom rather small for six guests. Nice dining table. Well equipped kitchen except for no soup/cereal bowls. Both local bars within 5min walking are smoking bars which is a bit disappointing and negatively surprising. Would come again though!

Pleasant, clean, spacious ground floor flat in great location in Kreuzberg, with good transport options within easy walking distance. Everything was in good condition.  Very comfortable single beds and nice bed linen.  Good WiFi. Kitchen easy to use. In the bathroom the shower was slightly small and slightly difficult to climb in and out of but there was lots of hot water. Ventilation in the flat could be improved. There are supermarkets nearby and a laundrette a short metro ride away which we used because (as advertised) there is no washing machine. Would heartily recommend the flat.

Many thanks Pascal & Dennis - facilities and location 10/10 - perfect spot if you just need a hub for exploring central Berlin. Anyway, you didn’t go there to sit around in your AirBnB, right??! Get out and spend some money locally - support the community!

Pleasant stay. Good location. Easy check in. Would have liked a later checkout. Only one bathroom which was ok for four people, this accommodation can sleep six so not ideal. Quiet in evenings, clean with all amenities. Hosts always responded. Overall I would highly recommend staying here. Thank you Dennis & Pascal.

Thanks Dennis, great place for our family to stay while we explored Berlin!
We were particularly grateful that you allowed us to leave our bags in the flat until lunch time, so we could be out and about without luggage. Thank you for a lovely stay!

We spent a weekend at Werners Apartment with 8 people and were totally satisfied. From the communication before arrival, the reception on site as the care during our visit, everything was excellent. The flat was clean and well equipped, we felt very comfortable. The value for money was also outstanding. Thank you very much, Werner! We would love to come back.

We stayed here for a total of 3 nights and overall, it was great. It's very spacious, easy to park, and walkable to many restaurants. It's also fairly close to the metro and across the street from a large beautiful park. As many have previously mentioned, the home does not have wifi as noted. We messaged and were told they were working on it, but never heard anything further. Only a bummer as much of the home is sub level with no phone service.
Shy of that, it was an excellent stay and I would absolutely stay here again when I return to Berlin!
it was hard to get in because of the lock but the place is big and nice the owner is also gracious with our request
had a great stay! Marco went out of his way to accommodate us.. would highly recommend, made the stay in Berlin even better

Mia's place was above and beyond our expectations.  Really easy to find and get in, close to the train station, in the middle of Berlin close to restaurants.  High ceilings, bright and airy, super clean, comfortable beds.  I wish we were staying for a week!
A great apartment, exactly as described and like the photos. Excellent location short walk from breakfast stops and train station. Would use again and recommend to others.

Our stay in Berlin was great. Apartment was really spacious. Mia was a really good host, she responded really quickly to our questions. We also used the opportunity to park near the building where the apartment was for a fee.

Easy to find just a short walk from train stations. Apartment has very large bedrooms with plenty of space. Very clean apartment. Easy to get to all central locations in Berlin as is close to train station. Recommend this location.
Great place and just like shown in the photos, if not nicer  - great stylish appartment.

I absolutely loved my time at this Airbnb! The apartment is spotlessly clean, beautifully decorated, and has everything you need for a super comfortable stay. From the moment I arrived, I felt completely at home.
Freddy, Maya & Sienna were amazing hosts. Friendly, quick to respond and very thoughtful.
The apartment is in a lovely neighborhood, and everything is easy to reach. Shops, restaurants, and public transport are all nearby.
Highly recommend — I’d definitely stay here again!

Its a really pretty modern apartment in a traditional old building and I think it also could serve a longer stay because the kitchen is fully equipped. In case you want to work remote for some reason, there is a height adjustable table.
Its also super clean (coming from someone with sensitive skin, who is reacts immediately allergic when dust is not wiped).
Downside might be the slight brittle floors and squeaky doors when vastly opened and closed but only when you are a *very* light sleeper. The floor suit the vibe of the apartment and in comparison the environment itself is pretty quiet though.

Everything I needed and more, really was a wonderful location for my stay in Berlin. The room has all you can need and it’s quite cozy! Loved the decoration, also the hosts are super attentive and were easy to reach !! Will definitely book again for my next Berlin trip !

Max’s home was beautiful and very comfortable to be in. The neighborhood did not feel super welcoming with many things to do however it was very close to the U-Bahn  which made it worth it. Max was always very helpful and responsive even after my flight was delayed by 5 hours. His flexibility with checking in was very much appreciated.

Had a lovely stay at Max’s place - lovely neighbourhood, a spacious and well curated and designed apartment. The check in was easy, and the apartment had all the necessities for the stay. Would love to stay again!
