Such a lovely place. It kept cool in the blazing heat. Max has very good taste, it was nice being around so much lovely furniture and objects. We found the subject of the big painting above the sofa a bit confusing (potentially disturbing). Would definitely stay again!

Max’s apartment is a beautiful and calming space, located on a quiet street full of trees and parks. Brand new interior and construction, the space shows exactly as the photos. The balcony is a particular highlight - a very nice spot to relax.  It is a short walk from the U Bahn, as well as to a very cool neighborhood in Schillerkiez which has great coffee shops / restaurants, and also very short walk to great parks to hang out, go for runs, etc. (Tempelhofer and Kornerpark)

I apologise for a delay of  my review. Thank you for providing us with the marvellous experience. All of them were perfect, if I’ll have an opportunity to go to the country again, I’d like to utilise this accommodation.

When you travel to Berlin there is no better neighborhood to stay than in Charlottenburg.
And when staying in Charlottenburg, there’s absolutely no better place to stay than Andre’s apartment.
Tastefully appointed with sumptuous bed linens and a terrace, Andre’s place is next door to dozens of restaurants including the famous Paris Bar, shopping and close to almost everywhere you want to go in town.

We felt right at home at Andre’s place. The flat was absolutely spotless and tastefully decorated. All the amenities provided are excellent, we really appreciated the high quality bedding and towels, as well as the Nespresso machine and the good selection of capsules. A plus was finding a yoga mat! The location is amazing, we found everything we needed in the surroundings, good bakeries and restaurants, supermarkets, bars, boutiques and even a great jazz bar. Communication with Andre was seamless, he ensured our stay was comfortable from start to finish. Highly recommended!
Where amazing vacation apartment was great location was great and the host was wonderful. I’m totally recommend.

Andre’s listing was fantastic! It’s a nice modern flat with comfortable beds and linens, easy to find and get into, and super convenient to anywhere in Berlin via its excellent public transportation. The neighborhood is very nice and walkable, with tons of bars and restaurants nearby. The hosts were super responsive and proactive with recommendations. It really was a pleasure - thank you!

This is the ideal place for 2-3 people to stay. Super close to transport networks and there is a supermarket close by to pick up any essentials you need
The studio was beautifully decorated and very clean, it was a pleasure to stay there. If we’re ever in Berlin again we would definitely consider rebooking this place!
Brigitte is also very helpful and offers speedy message replies :)

The owner was very helpful and nice. Nur welcomed us personally. The apartament was very clean and had everything we needed in the kitchen and in the bathroom. It was a bit cold in the living room, but it was warm in the bedroom and bathroom.  The apartament is very close to the underground (metro) - 5 minutes walk. We felt safe in the neighborhood (Near and Middle East district). People there where nice. There are many shops, bars and kebab-places in the main street Karl Marx. The bakery is on the corner and a bigger grocery market "Penny" is 7 minutes away. We recommend this place.

Hi,
Our stay was very nice, and exactly what we needed.
We were 4 people so 2 of us had to sleep in the "couch bed" in the living room which was a surprisingly good bed!! It were good matrasses in both rooms + nice pillows (for me important!).
It was also a good shower, we could shower with 4 people with warm water.
Overall good accommodation for a weekend Berlin !! Close to the metro station.

Great place, ideal for big groups. Only downside was that the flat was very hot, especially given the amount of people. Other than that it was the perfect stay and the host was super responsive host. Thank you!
Great comfortable clean apartment. Located close to central station and city center. Several supermarkets nearby. Clara was very kind and allowed us early check in. Recommend to everyone

10 mins walk from hauptbahnhof, good location for exploring berlin.
some good local restaurants.
lovely light apartment with balcony. very private and safe.
basic amenities and could do with some updating inside.
we enjoyed our stay.
The place is well located off public transport, Douglas was very responsible and flexible with us. It’s right off the street so it can be noisy but hard to beat the location.

A nice cosy apartment fit for 4-5adults
One shared bathroom and a decent sized balcony
Location is central and easily accessible- a 5minutes walk to and from train/bus/metro stations
Self check-in instructions were clear
Would definitely recommend

The property was very clean and comfortable.  The location is perfect, walking distance from many interesting places and lots of restaurants and bars. The internet connection was rather slow and only accessible in few places within the apartment. If that is not a problem we highly recommend this place for enjoyable stay in Berlin.
Spacious and tidy apt in excellent area. Host was very responsive.Only issue is the wifi which comes and goes and is unreliable. If you must have wifi think again.

Fantastic location in the centre of Berlin’s Mitte district and a stone’s throw from the Dom, Unter den Linden and Alexanderplatz with its famous TV tower, wonderful Christmas market and S-Bahn link to BER airport. As a group of 4 adults we had plenty of space in this airy, clean and well provided for apartment. Lots of shops, eateries and transport links within a very short walk.
Or host, Douglas, was very responsive and helpful and this flat was exceptional value for money. Would highly recommend for a family or group of up to 5 and will definitely look to stay again.

The stay was good and the place is very accurately described. The only issue we had is that you could hear a lot of the noise from other apartments in the building. As we stayed during a weekend this led to a lot of noise as there were some parties being hosted and the hallways even smelled like weed.
For the nights during regular week days, it is was way calmer and we could all sleep very well.
The location is absolutely amazing, you have everything on walking distance, can walk to so many places easily and is perfectly connected by public transport to reach any place you want.
While sleeping wasn’t the best experience on a couple of nights due to the noise, I would still consider this place for a potential future stay if not staying during a weekend.

A brilliant location to get around.
We visited the Christmas Markets and it was all easily accessible. Apartment was very clean and had everything you need.
Would highly recommend.

Great place to stay. Very easy to walk to different highlights and otherwise public transport is close by.
Good kitchen and bathroom.
Beware, no living (yes great dinner table), 2 bedrooms (1 with masterbed and 1 with 3 single beds). Which you cannot make up from pictures.
But, based on price, location, cleanliness of the place and available facilities absolutely a good place to stay.

This is my third time in Berlin, and I always thought it was better to choose a more distant location to reduce costs.
This time, I chose a more central spot, and it really paid off — the neighborhood’s vibe, the proximity to the train station, the entertainment venues, and more were all worth it.
Above all, Douglas was kind and responsive to every request and question.

My wife, dog and I spent the month at Clara’s place in the heart of Berlin. The complex was lovely, the location was in the middle of everything (shops, restaurants, public tran, and grocery shopping) and we felt right at home and our dog loved the courtyard.
Clara was always very helpful and responsive. The doormen were also great to provide that extra bit of service.
The only issues was the refrigerator was a mini fridge in a closet, which took some adjusting for a long stay. Also, several of the complex washing machines were not working and were not fixed during the month.
All in all, this was a great base to call home for our month in Berlin.

The place was perfect for the time I spent in Berlin. The location in Berlin is really great and central! Clara was always reachable and helpful. The place was a little home away from home. Thank you Clara!
Clara’s apartment is very nice and is in a great location. Clara was extremely communicative and helpful which made check in and check out very easy. She’s a great host and I recommend the apartment!
Great location in the center of Berlin! So easy to get everywhere using public transportation. We loved the huge patio during our stay!
The location is really good, bad is comfortabe and Clara is helpfull. In the other hand, furniture is old, dishes were dirty and some things were broken and out of use. All in all, it is ok.
A very nice apartment with all equipment that you need. Close to Bernauer u-bahn station.
All recommendation from ourside. Location is perfect and metro is literally in front of the door. Place is cozy and super clean. Host, thanks for wine bottle and Haribos. 10/10
Excellent location, beautiful apartment, very friendly and responsive host.  Highly recommended.  Thanks Philipp!

Phillip is a Super Host. We arrived late at night and due to local internet issues in the area Phillip was unable to let us in remotely but as soon as we contacted him he came over and was so gracious about it. He was warm and welcoming and the apartment is beautiful with every convenience in mind. We were only here for one short night but would definitely stay here if we need to return for longer. Thank you Phillip.

Amazing place for your groups, everything are clean, only little problem that all bathrooms are basement ,no clothes hanger in the rooms.
Apart form that everything is perfect.

This is the perfect spot if you are a large group and want some pea e and quiet from the city.
Everything is easy here.
We would stay again 👍🏽

Very spacious apartment. Nice area with cafes and restaurants nearby. Liked the bath! Communication was clear and timely. Only downside was a damp smell downstairs where the toilets and showers are located.
We loved this place! It was an easy late night check in and great amount of space for our large group. The church bells in the morning were also very beautiful.

We had a great stay with my parents. The check in was easy and accommodating as we could come early to leave our bags. Th host was very responsive and answered always in a short time. The flat is well stocked and well equipped with a lot of lights and big windows.

Very central, brand new, clean house... Walking distance to museums and Alexanderplatz. There are many restaurants around the house. Besides, Douglas was very responsive, sent all the instructions on time. Highly recommended :)
This is a great flat in a fantastic location. Only downside is the noise and the lack of a fan (as we we’re there during a hot spell)

Had a great stay at the apartment. The location was perfect and very centrally located. However this great location meant that the street outside was very loud throughout the day and night. The apartment was also incredibly hot (and there was only 1 fan for the two rooms), so we had to choose between open windows for a cooler temperature or closing the windows for it to be quieter when we slept.  A second fan could have helped with this. Overall would definitely stay again.

Very nice apartment! Perfect for 4 persons.
Only negative is that the beds are really hard and if you have the windows open there is a lot of noice from the outside during the night
Super friendly and great host. We went with 4 friends and had a great time, amazing kitchen as well!

The location was excellent! Easy to get anywhere, even by foot. Great restaurants nearby. The place was very nice and clean, and the bathroom was super! Very easy check-in with the smart lock, which was very convenient for us as we arrived late. The accommodation was exactly what we expected, the only minus was that it was listed in the amenities that there is coffee available, and we were very excited about it, but in the end there was only 4 capsels and we were 5 people so not enough for all of us even for one morning. Anyway, overall we were very happy about our stay and could definitely reccommend it!
Great location, close to many places. Host assists/responds very quickly and provides good local recommendations. Also, host provides storage for the luggage after check-out, which is great!
Stayed here during the marathon and it was perfect as it was easy access to both the U2 and U5. Does get noisy during the weekends but location is great and close to tourist attractions.

The place was great for 7-8 people. Everything needed was provided for us and our stay went smoothly. The only downside was that the neighbours were a bit loud at times. Overall we were really happy about our time at Ruslan’s appartment.

We had a great time in Berlin. The place was clean and very centrally located which made it a great launchpad for exploring many parts of the city. The configuration of the building can contribute to noise issues as windows open into an open courtyard directly facing neighboring windows. High temperatures and loud neighbors made one night in particular very difficult.

Good location for transport links. I was disappointed with the accommodation. The rooms were cold, water for showers were also cold. The bed in the master room squeaked, most room doors did not close easily, more pillows and towels were needed and there was not enough cushions on the sofa ( pictures on airbnb showed more cushions. The TV remotes not working despite changing batteries. Noisy neighbours, accommodation needs sound proofing… floor and skirting boards needed attention. One bathroom contained a small
Amount of damp on ceiling.

Decent property on the edge of Kreuzberg for a group. Bars and restaurants etc within walking distance, although generally this property is in a very quiet residential area. U bahn station very close by. Property itself is fine although a little dated in terms of decor, and dark due to being lower ground floor (to be fair this is advertised).

We had a wonderful time in this Airbnb, the hosts are very responsive and accommodating.
The flat was perfect for 8 people, having 2 bathrooms was great, it was spacious, clean, and central. (We loved the Jederzeit Café, 10 minutes away from the place for a big brunch/breakfast!). The beds were comfortable and the place was warm and comfy.
Would 100% recommend!

Florian's place was excellent for a week of work and creativity. The area is beautiful and well connected, you really get to experience the best Berlin has to offer! I had several guests stay and everyone had a great time with plenty of space, so I'd recommend it if you're after something for a larger group.

Excellent little apartment. Clean and tidy. Check in was very easy, although the electric door code access to the apartment itself was a little tricky to get used to the timing of turning the handle whilst pushing the door.
Apartment is within a few minutes walk of a main tram line offering easy access to central Berlin. There's also a lot of excellent restaurants and coffee shops within walking distance.
Highly recommended.
Very quiet and peaceful place, since it is located in a basement. Perfect if you need privacy and a place to rest.

The flat is c.a. 10 min walking from Alexander Platz. It is very well located with plenty of options of restaurants and caffes. The apartment is well equiped and was very clean. We were 5 people+ 1 baby and everybody were well accomodated. Douglas was very kind and replied my questions quickly. I would book again for sure.
It has a great location, a clean house, and a fully equipped kitchen. I totally recommend it. The only downside was an unstable Wi-Fi.

Overall it was a fine place, but the area didn’t have much to it, and it was quite empty. The large price is not worth it with it being 800 for 2 nights. I believe you can get better locations and places for a lot cheaper if you look around. I recommend being in West Berlin or more near the nightlife area to the east.

We had an amazing stay. The flat is gorgeous, exactly like the pictures, and well kitted out for a group of friends enjoying the city. We loved being next to the beautiful park and enjoyed the 10 min walk to the train station. A very peaceful stay. Would definitely stay here again!

The flat had only a few windows therefore it was quite dark and the lights weren't stong enough. there were a lot of fake plants in random spaces.
the bathroom was very nice and the table was very big.

Very nice appartment in a lovely area - right next to Treptower Park. The only thing that I could say about it is that the dining area is a little secluded from daylight, but other than that it was a lovely stay.

Nice location, some noise from the road, but didn't notice it. Large and nice apartment, clean.
Minus: the stove in the living room turned off automatically in the evenings, it got very cold in the apartment.

Nice new Place. All equipment new. Great towels. Top bed perfect, sleeping on the sleeping sofa okay. The road outside pretty busy, the park
Behind amazing, bus stop right there!

This is a great place.  The apartment in Friedenau is spacious, in a quiet neighborhood and conveniently close to the subway, restaurants, shops....Ulrich is a great host who always responded immediately when we needed something.  We would definitely go back the next time we are in Berlin.  Highly recommended.

Ulrich's place was amazing. We enjoyed staying there. Everything that we needed was available. It was also very easily accessible by public transport. Supermarkets are close by too. Although we did not get to meet Ulrich in person, we faced no difficulty at all. The building itself is a little old, but it has a certain charm to it. The tall ceilings make the rooms nice and spacious.
All appliances we needed were available. We were even able to do our laundry and make a couple of meals at home. There are pleanty of restaurants nearby too.
We really liked Ulrich's place and would surely come back some day. Thank you Ulrich for making sure our stay was comfortable.
Nice location and good for a short stay. The place is rather neglected and could use a thorough cleaning and some renovations

I enjoyed staying at Amine’s place! A bit pricey, but worth the money. It’s a spacious apartment with an amazing balcony and a really nice view. Amine was always reachable on the phone, and his partner checked me in and showed me the place. Recommended!

Philip's flat is charming.  The neighborhood is green, quiet and well connected to other parts of Berlin via public transit.  The flat is extremely well equipped and comfortable but not cluttered.  The compact space is well designed so that it feels spacious.  Our grandson spent a few nights at the flat with us, and loved the nearby play ground.  We recommend this flat for any couple or family with 1 child visiting Berlin.

The place was very well equiped, super clean, spacious for a family, easy to reach with public transportation. The kitchen had all the necessary for cooking for a family. The hosts were very polite, discreet and friendly. Great hospitality, we recommend it 100%!

My parents visited me in Berlin, they were rested there, the place was very nice and quiet, the hosts were very nice and friendly. Very recommend to people who want a quiet place to enjoy their time in Berlin.

We just returned from a wonderful family trip to Berlin and stayed at this great Airbnb. Traveling with my wife and our two kids, we found the apartment to be a great choice for our needs.
Even before we arrived, the hosts were incredibly welcoming and attentive. They provided us with helpful local tips and allowed for early check-in.
The apartment was clean, making it a comfortable home base for our family. It was conveniently close to public transport, allowing us to easily connect to the city and visit all the major attractions. Plus, there were plenty of good restaurants and parks within walking distance.
A huge thank you to our hosts for making our stay so enjoyable!

Philip and Katrin were excellent hosts. The location of their place worked so well for us, with close proximity to grocery store, restaurants, wine store and ice cream stop. Especially worked for us, as the location was near family that we were in Berlin to visit.

We had a wonderful stay at Philip and Katrin’s place in Berlin.
The apartment is situated in a private house on a charming, tree-lined street in a peaceful residential neighborhood. It was spotlessly clean, exactly as described, and thoughtfully equipped with everything you might need.
What truly made our stay exceptional, though, were the hosts—some of the kindest and most considerate people we’ve ever met. Katrin even went out of her way to offer me special bandages for my blisters, which was incredibly thoughtful.
The location is also excellent—just a short walk to public transportation, great shopping, and fantastic restaurants.
We highly recommend this property to anyone visiting Berlin!

We really enjoyed staying at Hilda’s place this past weekend. It came it equipped with everything we needed which facilitated our trip to Berlin. Hilda even went out of her way to provide us with cribs for our twin babies.
We will definitely book her for our stay again if we ever find ourselves in Berlin.

Hilda responded immediately when I asked and provided very clear instructions, making it easy for me to check in. The room was very clean, tidy and beautiful, and the transportation was very convenient. It was a good choice for accommodation in Berlin!
Highly recommend this place surrounding with great cafe and restaurants. Easy to commute. Well maintained stay and a great host to provide all instructions clearly.
A great location, close to shopping and the U-Bahn. Hilda was incredibly responsive and helpful.

Very nice stay.
Raphael and Leo were very nice and they took care of averything.

it was one of my best airbnb experiences :) the apartment was great-clean, nice view,enough spaces for 4 grownups with everything you can feel like home. it has an elevator which is grateful for tourists with big luggages.
