This apartment was very nice, clean, quiet and super good location. Rapahael was very attentive and a great host. I would definitely stay here again.

Raphael and Leo were great hosts! Communication was excellent. The apartment was really lovely, stylish and well set back from the street so very peaceful too. It had everything you need to cook your own meals if you want to. We really enjoyed our stay- thank you! 😊
Great place in a wonderful location. Raph was super friendly, helpful and answered all of our questions immediately. I would totally recommend staying here and we will for sure come back!

We had a fantastic stay at Raph and Leo’s apartment. It was really smart and comfortable, and perfect for exploring Berlin, which is an absolutely stunning city. The beds were luxuriously comfortable and the living room area was cozy too. Perfect for snuggling up and watching a movie after a long day of sightseeing.
Beautiful and peaceful apartment in a very good location. Several restaurants and stores are within walking distance. The hosts are super friendly and helpful.

We had a wonderful stay! Leo was incredibly friendly and went above and beyond to make sure we were comfortable. The apartment is clean, stylish, and spacious, with a cozy feel and a quiet atmosphere at night.
The location is excellent, close to buses, trains, grocery stores, and a wide variety of cafés and restaurants (many with outdoor seating). The kitchen is well-equipped with everything you’d need for a short or longer stay.
Overall, the perfect base for our trip, we’d happily return!
Great location just 7 minutes from the S line station and 10 minutes from the tram. Host always available. Clean, new and comfortable accommodation for 4 people.

Great apartment for a shorter visit in Berlin. Quick and accessible connection to public transport to visit key landmarks of the beautiful city of Berlin.
The apartment is neatly located in a decently calm neighbourhood. Perfect after a long day on the busy streets in the city central.
There is a fan inside, however, ventilation is a bit poor. Gets really hot. Therefore, I’m recommending opening the windows during the day to ventilate.
Whould absolutely consider staying here again.
I enjoyed staying in Isabelle‘s place. The location was perfect and she was very friendly and responsive recommend to stay there and try the restaurants and walking around the area.
Very nice location and flat. It’s very spacious and cosy. It was a bit dirty in some places, but overall look was great. I recommend to visit it.

The apartment can be found in the center, so it was quite easy to go around in the city. The nightlife is loud on the streets until around 2am, so be aware of that.
We were a group of friends, therefore this place was a great choice.

Great location, easy to get to public transport. Parking downstairs was tight to get into, but very convenient. Lots to do in the area, easy to walk to many sights, and lots of restaurants nearby. Try the currywurst down the street and a scroll at the shop next door. Hackescher Markt has lots of great options for food and drinks. Highly recommended.

My friends and I had a great stay at Douglas’s apartments, which are centrally located and close to Alexanderplatz. The owner is very helpful and friendly, and the apartments are comfortable and clean. Highly recommended!
we had a wonderful stay. the place was immaculate and conveniently located close to public transport with easy access to down town Berlin

We very much enjoyed our stay at Oliver's place, located right across the street from a peaceful duck pond. We particularly appreciated the host's attention to detail, the artful interior design, the luxurious bathroom...and the heated toilet seat (purrrrr).

The flat was very modern, 100% clean and very spacious for two people. Everything worked, very good Internet and there was also a washing machine and dryer.
We would definitely choose this flat again for a future stay. Thanks, Oliver!

My kids and I loved the apartment very much. First of all the location: peaceful, quiet area, park view, nice playground in two minutes walk. Lots of parking lots free of charge. Quite a few supermarkets 1-5 min walk. S-Bahn 5-9 min walk or can get by bus.
Apartments on the first floor with nice terrace, private entrance, felt safe.
Stylish, big space, very well equipped, meet nothing to add.
The host professional, easy to reach.
Would love to come again next year.
Good communication from host who swiftly dealt with issues. accommodation next ro a Club which was noisy all night at the weekend
great apartment, and great location for exploring the city. Next to a nightclub and beat of the music can be heard more in the back room but wasn't too much of a disturbance.

My only regret is that I didn’t have more time to stay here! The apartment was really big and in a great area with tons of restaurants and bars nearby. The wifi was fast enough for video calls for works no problem and the beds were very comfortable, highly recommend!

Everything was excellent, cozy, clean, and very tidy. It looks just like the pictures, new and well-maintained. The host was amazing, helpful, responsive, and always there for us. We will definitely come back to Bevo!

He was a very understanding and good host. The house was beautiful as in the photo, only a little expensive. Still, I recommend it to everyone.
Thanks Berat

Berat was super helpful and responsive. The flat was very homely and comfortable and very clean. Amazing location for what we were after and had everything we needed 😊 would definitely stay here again.
This is a beautiful apartment with nice paint of Olaf Hajek, room is very clean and well equipped, bed is comfortable, can see the nice sky…

An absolute gem in Berlin - this space is beautiful, making it the perfect place to pause, explore, and soak in the atmosphere of the city. Every detail feels thoughtfully designed, and it offers a sense of calm and charm that makes you want to linger. I couldn’t recommend it more highly, and I’ll definitely be returning on future visits to Berlin!

Very clean and well situated apartment in a great and busy area with lots of transportation options. Has the basic amenities. Great shower and comfortable bed. Super high ceilings give this small unit a bigger feel. View is onto interior courtyard which is quiet. Great cheese shop next door!

Aryan’s suite is small and cute and in a fantastic location. There were some minor issues but Aryan was quick to respond and find solutions. It’s a quiet suite given how bustling the neighbourhood is. I'd happily stay here again.
Great location for a fun stay in Berlin! Comfortable and perfect for two people, and I liked the fact that there was a washing machine. Easy and flexible check in. Would definitely stay again!

The neighborhood is one of the best in Berlin. Everything is very close by – lots of bars and restaurants, and the area is absolutely beautiful. The communication with the host was excellent, and I never had to wait more than 3 minutes for a reply.
The apartment itself is tidy and feels pleasant inside, although it’s rather dark and the air is stuffy due to the small window. Good coffee and all necessary utensils are available.
However, I believe more attention should be paid to cleanliness. Unfortunately, there was an unpleasant smell mostly from the bathroom that affected my stay and didn’t go away throughout the visit.
I paid a relatively high price, so I’m trying to make sure my review reflects that accordingly.
Thank you and best regards.

Very convenient spot, well connected for transport. The host was very responsive and helped with requests like an additional cot, a mislaid iron and clarification of check-out times. The room was clean and modern- if a little cramped once a travel cot was added. But it had everything we needed. My only other remark is that the room smelt a bit damp despite having the window open at all times and in the very high temperatures this week, it was difficult to get air flowing through the apartment (although a fan is provided).
The little house in the back of the garden has everything you need! We really enjoyed our stay there. :) I would recommend it to friends and also book it again.

While being a bit away from the city centre, the apartment is perfect. The location is super peaceful and quiet. Inside it might look small from the first glance, but there's enough space and it's very comfortable. The outdoor garden has seats and a table, and there are edible berries growing. Totally recommended!
The apartment and place matched the desciption. Easy to communicate with the host and not too far from good restaurants. Our daughter had a lot of fun with the playgrounds in the area.

Tariq's apartment is super good. the location can be regarded as golden, several minutes walk to bus stop(120）and u line station(u6), M23 tram stop is under construction. a lot of cafes, canteens nearby. the room itself is also good, very big and well equipped. the price is not expensive. everything is good. if i visit berlin again. i will book this room again.
Wonderful stay for a short time period. Very close to the train station and lots of nice restaurants nearby. Quaint apartment and it was the perfect size for 4 guests.
We had a very pleasant stay at Anthony’s apartment! A bit far from the train station, but still fine.

The stay at anthony´s apartment was excellent. The place is extremely clean and it is exactly as described. We loved this place, as it was ideal for our needs (really minimalistic and all). It has a small kitchen with all the tools to cook quick meals, or prep a quick breakfast (we really enjoyed the coffee press!). I think it is an ideal location for travelers who pretend to explore the city during the day, and have a peaceful rest during the night (or if you like to go out and have a drink or two at locations close to the apartment). There are excellent restaurants close by (I would totally recommend Bistro Barnesto at Helmholtzstrasse 39, 10578). Anthony´s place is at a walkable distance to bus stops and it is well connected with other means of transportation to the center of Berlin and all other touristic attractions.
It was a great, comfortable stay! The apartment was clean and roomie, also the check-in instructions were detailed and easy to understand!
This apartment met my needs perfectly.  Quiet area. Great water pressure, bed, and being on the ground floor..,these were features I appreciated.
Fee Apartment 2 was ideal for me, close to where I needed to be in Friedrichshain with its many individual shops and markets. All very clean and functional.
The stay is above the owners house, but has seperate entrance which is easy access. Has everything you need. Nice greenery around, makes looking out the window an amazing experience.

Johannes's apartment was amazing! It's a place that one would expect or ideally want even staying in Berlin. It was quirky and peaceful, tucked away beneath an umbrella of foliage. Inside was a little magical and also extremely clean, cozy, comfortable and well-equipped for making dinner. He was also a very personable, fun and pleasant host. We would absolutely stay here again when we return to Berlin.

Dmitrij was a super welcoming host, very easy to communicate with! We stayed in the Saunahouse for about 10days and everything was as expected. The value for money in Berlin was great. The saunahouse had all necessary equipments and was conform to the photo and description. The environnement is super calm and in the nature. You can access the city taking a direct bus to the main train station or combine several transport (bike, bus, train, underground). Thanks again for a nice stay!
Great host, very accommodating and kind. The place was very clean and as described. Highly recommend ☺️
Laurent flat was very cozy and nice. Best location, near the canal, very close to great restaurants, bars, cafes and train station. I highly recommend Laurent place and I hope to come back soon.
We had a great experience with the appartement.  The place is beautiful, the area is vibrant, and Andrew is a great host. Would definitively book again.
It was a very nice stay, clean modern and pretty. The location was perfect as it was close to so many things even on walking distance!
Very much liked the hotel – functional, well-thought-out, and very clean. The only downside was that the lockers didn’t always open, and I had to call and ask for help with that
Nice room, good location, tricky check in with additional registration in separate service and payment only by card online, without applePay

This very private little place is the way of the future. Fully automated check-in process made it super simple-no waiting at the desk just follow the prompts. Great facilities. Fridge is perfect size for two with supplies.
What a great find this was.

mmnt is very well located, close the lots of the public transport and the S9 which goes straight to the airport. The shower was good and bed was pretty comfortable. Room is definitely cosy but generally enough room for two. Sparkling water tap in the kitchen is a nice bonus!
Checkin was largely smooth. If you are arriving early you can leave bags at the Adina next door, but this wasn't communicated upfront. We had already purchased luggage locker access before we messaged mmnt and they let us know about the Adina. The luggage locker is not big enough for two bags but you can only book one per booking, so it's not very useful for two people. Overall it was a great place to stay, would probably stay again.

the most pinterest perfect hotel i’ve ever seen, you will be blown away as soon as you walk through the door ⭐️
room has everything you need, although we were missing a hairdryer - but truly the attention to detail in design makes the stay feel so special and unique!
everything is controlled through the phone (can make a physical key card once inside) so make sure to have some data and battery before arriving
Jeremias was very responsive and super friendly. The apartment area was exactly as described in the post. It’s very clean and cozy.

We enjoyed staying at the apartment, the hosts were welcoming, friendly and flexible. The location is good for the city with U2 metro station within 2-3 mins walk - the inner city is around 30 mins ride. We found the apartment location peaceful and quiet, ideal for resting after a long day of walking around tourist attractions. All in all, a very good stay in Berlin made easy by the hosts, would definitely return in the future.

We had a lovely staying at Jeremias’s place. Everything was perfect and well organized with all the necessary items we needed for our staying.
Once again thank you for letting us stay pay your beautiful home.

We stayed at Jeremias and Sigrid’s place for two nights and had such a lovely experience. From the moment we arrived, we felt genuinely welcomed and completely safe. The hosts were incredibly kind and went out of their way to make sure we were comfortable—helping us with little things like medicine, rain jackets, and other thoughtful gestures that truly made a difference. It’s rare to meet people so caring and attentive. We’re very grateful for their hospitality and highly recommend staying with them!
My family had a great time at Jeremia‘s place. He is very friendly and helpful. The apartment is beautiful and the location close to subway and train stations for exploring town. Highly recommended!
Beatrix’s apartment is just lovely, full of beautiful things in a beautiful neighbourhood. She is a wonderful host. I couldn’t recommend her place more.
Great stay! Super nice and spacious apartment! We were there with our two kids and they were very kind to wait for us with baby beds and baby chairs 🥰 also flexible and attentive contact ! Thank you!

The apartment is great — located in one of Berlin’s most charming neighborhoods. It’s easily accessible by public transport, surrounded by amazing restaurants and bars, and just a short walk from the river, making it a perfect spot to both explore the city and unwind.

The room is spacious and sunny with a balcony from which you're looking into the trees. The location is definitely 10 out of 10, inside a vibrant quarter close to everything you could need. Our communication wasn't 100% easy from the beginning, but when I was there, Olivia was very nice and everything was fine.
Olivia was a friendly and warm host. The room is large with a nice balcony. Area is also great, with loads of cool places toneat and drink nearby
This was an excellent place to stay for an extremely good price, and there were a lot of fun things to do nearby. The room was very clean and comfortable, as well as spacious.
Great place to stay for a solo traveler! Felt very safe. Comfortable bed and it was very close to transit. Would stay again!
This place has a great location and is reasonably priced. I can definitely recommend it; it has everything you’ll need.

We were the first guests to Vincent place so everyone was new.  The unit is spacious and cozy and cool.   The location is fantastic as it is close to the main train station.   A few things were missing but Vincent was very responsive to get them to us quickly.   We had a great stay and would gladly return and recommend to friends who are visiting Berlin.
Vincent is a great host and the place is amazing. He is very flexible and communication was smooth. The place is really well located and comfortable.

We loved our stay at the studio! The space looks beautiful, it is super clean, the area is quiet and the location is good for exploring the city.
Vincent is an excellent host, friendly and responsive, I definitely recommend staying at his place.

Vincent offers a comfortable, very spacious, with a nice high ceiling. This place is super convenient: very central yet relatively quiet. During the day the friendly next door artist will be working. Would definitely stay again.
For cyclists: you can easily park your bicycle(s) inside.
VERY GOOD PLACE TO STAY, really near to the central station and Vince nice guy always kept an eyes on us!
The place was clean and as described. You need to park your car on the street. The dishwasher and WiFi didn’t work and we got help from Airbnb.
the place was really nice .toilet was good and big floor so nice in short it was perfect

The place was very nice, but ventilation was very bad. not good for kids or asthma patients. hope they fix it soon as the place is very good. unfortunately, my wife had asthma and i had 2 small kids with me so faced a lot of problems.

Can is very responsive and helpful especially he agreed to help when we asked to keep our luggage after check out at the entrance of the apartment. Otherwise, we do not know how to manage our luggage as we have late flight back home. The place itself is clean and well organize as a home. You have everything you need in the house. The location is convenient, close to restaurants, cafes and metro stations. We enjoyed our stay there and highly recommend if you are looking for a place to stay in Berlin

As a family of 4 we had a lot of room for our luggage, the girls to run and play and to make dinner in the well equipped kitchen.
It was perfect for us and definitely better than a hotel.
Everything was super clean and Noam and Max were really responsive to our requests.
Wish it was a bit closer to the U station but that’s not a big deal.
Very helpful and kind hosts. The place itself is immaculate, warm and homey. Would definitely stay again.

a magic place😍 in a bucolic quiet garden, not even 10 min by foot from a public transportation hub that gets you anywhere in the city. but you‘ll be very tempted to stay there and just relax, watch the tomatoes, pumpkins and quinces grow.
super friendly, helpful, reactive and flexible host.

Fantastic Berlin apartment! Close to Pankow U-Bahn so it is a quick trip to city center. Area is nice and feels very safe. Lots of small restaurants and shops in the area. Vincent was a very good host. Would book again next time in Berlin!

We had a great stay at Vincent's place. The apartment was very clean, had all the amenities we could have asked for, the beds were super comfortable and Vince himself was absolutely lovely.
We will definitely stay there again.

Svenja is a lovely host that provides all the necessary information. The room is spacious and bright, with a beautiful river view. It is situated on the apartment's upper floor, so it is very private and quiet. The apartment itself is very well located, within walking distance from the Ostkreuz station.

Marcel's apartment is in the perfect location, between Kreuzberg and Neuköln, steps away from a metro station and surrounded by great restaurants, cafés, shops.
Marcel is a fantastic host -- friendly, helpful, sweet — and his family is a delight to be around.
The room is perfect for one person, and has lots of windows and plenty of sunlight

It was a super stay with Marcel et his family
I just can recommend you go there and see it with your own eyes
Marcel is a friendly, very kind and gracious host. He made me feel like home and I would definitely stay there again! 😁

Marcel and Sasha were friendly, flexible and easy-going hosts. Their place matched the description except for the fact that I didn’t find it loud at all, which was a pleasant surprise. Considering the location, this is a great deal for a solo traveler. There are some nice neighbourhoods in walking distance and there is also a metro station nearby allowing you to get around the city easily.

We had a gorgeous stay at Rafael and Sandra’s. The place was everything we wanted and more. Great location in a vacation-vibe area outside of Berlin, with amazing surrounding restaurants. Rafael and Sandra were so friendly and generous with their help and invitations to join BBQ. The apartment was spacious and had all the necessities and extras. Cats were friendly and welcoming, and we will definitely be back when we are in Berlin again! Thank you deeply Rafael and Sandra.
We loved our stay in Germany. Rafael and Sandra's place was so beautiful out of the city with a big green garden. We loved playing badminton, relaxing in the garden and patting the cats!

Stayed here for over a week, and it made a such a great base for both work and touring! The train station is super close if you want to got to the city, and the garden is lovley if you just want to chill at home with the friendly orange cat.
The kitchen has everything you need for an extended stay, and I particularly appreciated the inclusion of laundry detergent for the washing machine.
Overall a great place, would happily stay here again.

Thank you Rafael and Sandra,
You made us feel very welcome in your amazing home. Friendly, responsive and incredibly helpful. When we return to Berlin, we will definitely love to stay with you again.

We had a great stay at Philipp’s apartment as a group of 6 friends around New Year’s. The apartment is in a great location with lots of good restaurants and bars nearby, and access to Tempelhof just down the street. We found the apartment clean and comfortable, and Philipp was a responsive and accommodating host.
Do note there is only bathroom/toilet, so larger groups do need to coordinate with each other a bit, but the apartment worked very well for us. We would definitely recommend it!

Besides the cleanliness and beauty of the place, Marcel was an incredible host!
He was always very concerned to make me feel comfortable, gave me useful recommendations, and helped me find my way around the city.
If I ever come back to Berlin, I would be thrilled to stay with him again!

Me and my partner had a great time to stay at Marcel's place in Berlin. The location was easy to find, Marcel was welcoming and responsive, provided lots of recommendations in regards of restaurants and where to spend time in Berlin. The place we stayed in was stunning: clean, spacious and beautiful - you can clearly say that an artistic person lives here.
Thank you Marcel!

The apartment is great, very good location in Berlin. The staff is very helpful.
The TV is a problem: only Netflix, no regular programs.
We add a good time un Berlin thank to this appartment, really good place, the Subway is really near so you can go anywhere easily.
Very responsive and easy to deal host. Couple of issues during the stay were promptly addressed by the host.
The good place in a good area. Very easy to go anywhere with public transport. Different metro lines around. The place is very spacious and with a lot of light at daytime

Such a great stay. Listing looks exactly as pictured. Host was easy to communicate with, and kitchen had everything you could need! Apartment is sandwiched between great park and accessible transportation….easy for bikes too!
Thanks again!

An excellent place to stay - convenient location; a modern flat with a big bathroom and full kitchen. Overall, the place is very "Berlin" in ambience!  Bob is a helpful and cheerful host. I would be very happy to stay at his flat again.

Quietly on 4th floor of 2. house from the city street = absolutely QUIET! Excellent acommodation: 120 cm bed, high ceilings, tastefully decorated and all well thought of. Appealing bathroom & kitchen, squeaky clean! Doorframes with sound-absorbing sealing strips show how much care Bob has taken! A really comfy retreat away from home in a stimulating city with a very kind, helpful, thoughtful and knowledgeable host. THANKS!

My stay with Bob in Schöneberg was a great experience. In addition to being a very kind and respectful person, his apartment is also one of the most beautiful and thoughtfully decorated I have seen yet. The surrounding area is quite convenient in that many of Berlin‘s trademark sights and museums are within a walkable distance, and I can only highly recommend choosing this place if you get the chance.

Do not recommend! We were very much looking forward to our stay in the apartment, but the host never answered us on the day we arrived. Thus we did not have the code for the key box or any other way of getting in to the apartment. I tried calling and sending messages but they never picked up. Very frustrating! Luckily Airbnb helped us to book a new apartment. This did however take several hours, so not an ideal situation for six people with luggage and everything.
We had a wonderful stay at Sebastian’s place. We felt really welcome & there was a lot around to explore! We would definitely recommend it !

We had a great time staying at Sebastian's place. Schillerkiez is an up and coming location with lots of great bars and restaurants and being so close to Tempelhoferfeld is especially handy during summer months. Sebastian was very easy to communicate with and responded swiftly. We were five people staying there and the apartment is spacious and very hip.

My family and I had a wonderful stay. The apartment was just perfect for 5 adults and a small child. We had plenty of room to relax and chill at the end of the day. We cooked most days and the kitchen was more than adequate and functional. Location was perfect with the metro a minutes walk away. Phillipp was amazing and really flexible which was really appreciated. Would definitely stay again.

Lovely apartment and well done with respect to decor, which makes for a fun stay.  Relatively quiet considering it was located on the ground floor.  So happy to have a coffee machine in the apartment and all necessities were available.  The neighborhood had plenty of grocery and restaurant options.
Lovely, clean apartment. Well located and easy to get train or tram into the centre. Easy to check in with keypad. Has everything you could need.

Loved staying here! Right in the center of Prenzlauer Berg, so it’s super easy to get anywhere you need. Brandenburg Gate, TV Tower, Berlin Wall Memorial are all one train-ride away. Small, but just the right size for a couple for a week or two. Would definitely stay here again.

A great little flat in perfect position very near Eberwalderstrasse Metro station and many shops. Small, modern and immaculate. It had everything we needed - in an attractive and accessible part of Berlin. Just across the road is an easy stroll through attractive streets towards Prenzlauer Allee.
Amazing place, super clean and tidy. Comfortable bed. Lovely experience with hosts. Always nice and responsive. Def recommend !

Laura's place was just perfect and I would happily stay again. The rooms and kitchen in particular are spacious with everything you'd need - you can tell a lot of thought has gone into this place and Laura really cares about the experiences of her guests! Communication is excellent too.

I did extend my stay for another week because I had few more things do in Berlin and obviously because I loved my first week at Bonnie’s.
Definitely it worth every penny :)
(please read my first review)
A very nice option for Berlin. It was clean everywhere in the Airbnb and the host was very communicative

Really enjoyed my stay at Numa Berlin Torstraße. Super clean rooms, great location with easy access to everything, and solid amenities that made the stay comfortable. Perfect spot for exploring the city!

We enjoyed our stay very much. The location was exactly what we hoped; close to the U-bahn (Rosa Luxembourg Platz) and easy to access trams (the M8 was very close). The property management team brought over a toaster, coffeemaker, and a water kettle to welcome us.  There are no laundry facilities in the apartment but there is a WaschSalon nearby (in Rosenthaler Platz). Each room has individual beds (total of nine). It was a little hard to initially find the apartment once we were in the courtyard. Overall, excellent location, clean and welcoming space, in the heart of Mitte.
Great spot for a large group! Comfortable beds and in a prime Berlin location. Easy access to shops and public transit. Would stay again!
Excellent host, beautiful house, lovely location...in all it was a great place and a great stay!

Great place to stay, with good transport links for getting into the city and back to the airport. Only downsides is the lack of lighting in the building at night. Not ideal climbing 3 flights of stairs in the dark at night. But overall good value for money.

Ghislain was an amazing host and very responsive! Great recommendations as well. His place has impeccable style and I felt right at home. There was a bit of noise from the neighbors that was a little audible, however, given the quality of his place I was able to easily overlook it and enjoy my time there! Would stay at his place again next time in Berlin.
Lovely stay and would highly recommend. Lovely apartment and very peaceful. Well suits a traveler enjoying the Berlin Summer!!
Everything was as in the description. Ghislain is a very nice and helpful person and host.
Phillip's place was a fantastic stay with so many thoughtful and unexpected amenities. An added bonus was a list of recommendations which was really useful.

Philip and his wife were wonderful people to talk to. They spent a lifetime in the area and know all about the area. There are two Airbnb units downstairs separated by a hallway so you don’t hear anybody from the other unit and there’s very little noise from the family living above.  Each room looks out on greenery.  The refrigerator is medium size and the kitchen is large, in fact the TV is in the kitchen because the other two rooms are the bedrooms.  You have your own completely separate stacked washer dryer unit. The neighborhood was very quiet and two streets over is the commercial area with two grocery stores and restaurants. About a mile and a half away is a large shopping district with three multi story malls. Also about a mile away is the botanical garden, which is beautiful and expansive.  And there is the S ban U ban Transit station. The owners were very responsive to any concerns we had.  The beds were all comfortable.  We will definitely stay here again.
Carolin’s place is a large bright, comfortable one bedroom apartment in Templehoff.  Great restaurants nearby and a very friendly host knowledgeable of the area.

Really enjoyed our stay with Carolin. Great location next to public transit and lots of restaurants/parks. Carolin was very helpful with recommendations and would recommend this place to anyone visiting Berlin!

we had an amazing stay at this Airbnb!
The location is absolutely wonderful, making it easy to explore the area. The apartment itself is beautiful, spotlessly clean, and well-maintained—truly a home away from home. Anca, the host, was fantastic—she was very responsive and provided us with great recommendations that made our trip even more enjoyable. I would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting the area!
Lovely Air Bnb! Anca was really clear how to get in as well as its in a private complex in the city. Really great location with only a five minute walk to the train. Everything was really clean

Linda was such a wonderful host!!! She was very understanding of my (super) late check in and offered to extend my checkout time a bit as well.
She made me tea with honey when she heard I had a cough, and treated me to a wonderful conversation. She is very kind and I would love to stay with her again!
Beautiful clean apartment in a peaceful neighborhood with lots of cute restaurants. Easy to get around the city. Linda is lovely and a great host. Thank you 🙏🏼

The location is great but you do not get your money worth. The owner just ignores you too whenever something is wrong. I had a moldy pillow and as replacement a pillow with a hole in it. And pee stain on the bedding and nothing has been done about it until i reached out to airbnb themself
It feels like a renovated office building not an apartment building. No kitchen. A but odd but a checker location close to public transportation

Christian was very proactive and helpful. He left a set of advice and helpful instructions. The apartment was very clean, and felt very homey. The kitchen and the bathroom had everything we needed, the living room is spacious and the green trees across the large windows gave a very relaxing view. It is a very quiet residential area.
The apartment was great - it looked exactly like the photos and Christian made the check in really easy. I would recommend staying at Christian’s apartment.

We had a lovely stay at pranzlauer berg, the tram is right next to the apartment, great neighborhood.
The apartment is well equipped with amenities.
there were a few glitches, the wordrobe had a lock and was unavailable, no extra trash bags.
We did get a compensation for the inconveniences , but communication during the stay was very slow.
All in all, lovely, comfortable little apartment, in the best location.
I recommend it for a short or long stay.

Great appartment and 5 star location in Berlin.
Novi was an great host, always responding and trying to help out.
simply perfect! we needed a comfortable and central place to stay for the ITB. Your place ticked all the boxes. great neighborhood. good service and very nice and comfortable apartment. thank you!!

Novi’s place was perfect for our little hen party group to stay. Easy to find, clean, and a great vibe for groups to hang out. Well connected to all kinds of parts of Berlin, with culture, parties, or calming parks- depending on what you need. Novi was responsive and helpful even when I was asking silly questions! Doorman is very helpful for leaving luggage. Would recommend!
Great place for a group of friends/couples. Near public transport and lot of cafes/restaurants.

Place looks exactly as shown on the pictures. Really nice design and amenities. Only minor flaw would be the shower temperature and water pressure adjuster. The water pressure can be insane and for the temperature to be warm enough you have to put water pressure to the lowest setting possible. The location is good and youre pretty well connected to everything.

Very happy with our recent stay, it was writhing walking distance of all the places we wanted to visit and for those further away the transport was very close to get to.
Very peaceful on the evening and room was very inviting, we have had a lovely time.

I had a fantastic stay at Numa's and would definitely recommend to anyone. Potzdamer Platz by itself is not the most interesting spot in my opinion but everything is well connected and you can get everywhere very easily. I had a beautiful view at Martin-Gropius-Bau and the Welt balloon.

A wonderful stay, in a great location. I don’t have much to complain about, maybe other than the AC not working unfortunately, but the windows opened completely (I was actually surprised they were able to considering the height/safety!). Other than that, I’d probably look to stay here again as first choice when in Berlin - absolutely excellent

We really enjoyed our stay at Numa! The room was spacious and had all the basics we needed for our stay. The bathroom is beautiful and the bed was comfortable. The area is quiet and not a lot is open late but very close to public transportation so it was totally fine and easy to get around.

Wonderful stay definitely 10/10! Helpful services easily accessible online, don’t need to meet any stuff, great location close to Anhalter bhf and Potsdamer Platz, very elegant decoration exactly the same as pictures, room is very big and super clean, has everything you want, the shower is very comfortable, there is even a nice gym. Much better than most of hotels but with reasonable prices! I would definitely go there again!
I like the the place, very good location, great bed however AC was not working but overall I would stay again.
Lovely accomodation, central to a lot of restaurants and walking distance to shops and tourist attractions. Numa staff were very friendly and fixed an issue we experienced within hours.
Place was nice and clean,  well decorated, and cozy balcony. U-Bahn station right in front. Supermarket and bakeries close-by. Valentin was responsive and helpful.
We had a good stay and enjoyed the peaceful surroundings, despite the bed being a little uncomfortable to sleep.

Beautiful place, lovely quiet location which was ideal for our two children. All the amenities were there and it was a great location to the nearest u-bahn station. We needed to reach Niovi the evening we arrived and she was very responsive and helpful. Would definitely stay again!!!

We would definitely stay at Novi’s place again. Our group of 3 were very comfortable and Novi was helpful as this was our first time in Berlin. The neighborhood was perfect, full of cafes yet peaceful with parks and families enjoying the day.

The apartments looks just like the photos and it is clean.
There isn't really an ac- but some kind of a thermostat that didn't do anything. It is a little bit unventilated- the apartment was on street level so we didn't feel safe to sleep with windows open.
Thank you Vincent for the hospitality and offering your great place for travellers. Really great experience for me.

Had a great stay at Vincents place. Perfect communication, everything very easy to get into apartment and extremely nice place when we got there. We had five nights, very comfortable bed, spotlessly clean, very well equipped with everything, bottle of wine and beer in fridge on arrival, very quiet through the night as well. Would have no hesitation in staying at Vincents place and can thoroughly recommend....Thank you Vincent.

I love how the host solve my booking problem, the price is reasonable and everything you need is there, from bathroom, kitchen, even washing machine! I'll definitely come back again if I have a trip to berlin
Everything was great. Public transportation conveniently placed. The streets were a little dirty and crowded but i did not mind that much.

This location was as described. We experienced plenty of parking spaces, and the convenience of a gas station, market and ice cream shop nearby was greatly enjoyed.
We did not feel too far away from the heart of the city thanks to the electronic scooters.
All good, to loud because of the tram, No hand wash or shower Gel but fairly clean and tidy and upto the pictures

I had a pleasant stay at the studio. The apartment was clean and well-maintained, with modern furnishings that made it feel comfortable. It’s also in a good location—just a 5-minute walk to the tram station. I also appreciated how easy it was to access from the street as well as the smartlock, making check-in and check-out simple.

Karl is considered and helpful .
the place is soo peaceful, gives you a home feel like.

Phillip and Nabil were excellent hosts as they made us feel comfortable in the apartment. They gave us all the information to check in and out easily, clean sheets and towels and the pin code made it easy for everyone to get in and out the Airbnb. Would recommend!

We very much enjoyed our stay here. It perfectly fit our entire group, was in a great location, and was an excellent landing place for our trip to Berlin. The beds were very comfortable, the dining and kitchen space was open and very large, and the living space was great for our group of seven to comfortably relax together.
Lovely area and very well connected to the rest of the city. We really enjoyed our stay there and had ample space to lounge around.

Nice little flat, right next to the Metro easy to connect and get around everywhere in town. The area was nice by the lake, food and laundry right around the corner. My flight arrived very late, but the host was helpful and responsive and I found the place easily.
Great place to stay as a solo traveler. The rooms are spacious and decorated and feel peaceful. There’s a little space to do work.
A nice apartment just 3 mins from the subway station and within walking distance from the city centre. The room was big, the bed comfortable and the owner is friendly and welcoming!
We had a great stay. The flat is beautifully decorated and spacious. Great contact with the hosts. Not far from shops and metro. We would come back again!

Our stay was perfect! The apartment is beautifully decorated, super comfortable and had everything we needed. The location was wonderful, just a short walk to the shops and public transport. The neighbourhood felt very safe also. The hosts were incredibly helpful and responded to any questions we had almost immediately as well as providing local recommendations which was very appreciated. I cannot recommend this apartment more, we will definitely stay again!

Baeutiful, spacious and private apartment in the center of Berlin. Easy to reach from public transportation and within walking distance of many excellent restaurants. The apartment is well-furnished in an interesting, funky style, and it is very peaceful and quiet. It is in a larger building but there was no sign of any neighbors or traffic into or out of the building. I greatly enjoyed my stay and will be sure to be back in the future.

We stayed with Fabel for four nights with our two children. Having lived in Berlin ourselves for many years, we know the city very well and enjoyed the mix of the typical Berlin home feel in an apartment building and the vicinity to the lively places of Berlin's west. Our hosts were fantastic, super friendly, proactive, and responsive. We'll definitely try to stay here again on our next Berlin trip.
The door lock system is a bit finicky and I had to call arbio to get it fixed but after that all was well!
Our stay was lovely! Lukas apartment is so pretty, we stayed in touch whole stay. Recommend🥰
We loved our stay at Luka's place. Loved the high ceilings, the decoration and how spacious it was. The location was also perfect for us. Would definitlely come back!

We had a wonderful experience staying here! The place was exactly as described. It was clean, comfortable, and thoughtfully prepared with everything we needed. Great location. The public transportation (tram + Train) was super easy to use.
The host was helpful when we asked her questions.
We really like this cozy place with beautiful flowers in the balcony.
I would definitely recommend this Airbnb to anyone looking for a great place to stay near Berlin.
Responsive host; we had to delay by a day and the host was very accommodating. Clean room and in a fantastic area of Berlin.

The room was really beautiful and quiet.
The system to get in was super easy, only one door in the floor was a bit hard to open.
I would definitely recommend it or come back by myself. 💟
Great location, super easy check-in and everything you need. Perfect for those looking to explore Berlin at a reasonable price.
Good place, almost everything should self to do, but there are the clear instructions you can follow, so no problem with it.
Numa Berlin Friedrichshain was terrific! Nice clean, quiet room in a great location near many restaurants and places to go.

The apartment is bright, well laid out and nicely furnished. Although a basement flat, it has many windows offering lots of light and fresh air.  The kitchen is as described and user-friendly. The bathroom is small but works well. The lounge is very comfortable and complemented by the small, round dining area. In addition, the hosts were  welcoming and responsive. The surrounding area is also very dog-friendly.  Strong recommendation.

Cosy apartment with a special design, located right in the center, close to the train station, easy to find. Many restaurants around, on the ground floor an excellent cafe for breakfast. Very communicative and helpful host. We liked it a lot, we felt very good here, this is our home in Berlin from now on.

We had a wonderful time in the apartment. It was spotlessly clean and beautifully decorated.
Jeremias was incredibly helpful and friendly, always thinking along with us.
Highly recommended to stay here!
The apartment is very nice, bright and stylish. Jeremias was super friendly and always helpful. I recommend!
Wonderful host who is very friendly and super helpful. Flat is in a good location that is easily commutable. Only downside was the Trainline right outside the two bedroom windows. Can be very loud

It was a nice n Tidy place.
We enjoyed our stay. Communication was super good.
Will come back again.

Beautiful and functional apartment with nice location. Worked perfectly for us (2 couples) because of separate good size bedrooms. Lots of nice bars and restaurants in lively neighborhood.
Communication with Matt worked out well, he answered all the questions quickly and was allways friendly.

This is a very unique place to stay in Berlin, and the most amazing apartment I have stayed in! Both the apartment and the building itself are very beautiful, and the location is ideal.
I had actually not grasped how amazing the view would be from the pictures on airbnb, and it was such a great pleasure to sit just in the living room for a while and enjoy it. Our hosts were very friendly and responsive, making our stay an altogether lovely experience. Thank you for opening up your wonderful home, we had such a memorable stay!
Warm regards,
Karen
Airbnb was very pretty, big and nice furniture, everything you need. Neighbours were pretty loud.

Extremely clean and comfortable apartment with lots of space.
Located near great transport links to get around the city.
Good walking distace from alexanderplatz. Clean. We missed a chair or couch to relax on. The current status is no couches but two beds in the living room. Daniel is a nice host. Clear instructions.
Very responsive and professional host. Instructions were very clear. Communication was easy. The place was clean and cosy. Definitely recommend it!
Well located, clean and spacious. It was a great place to stay. Check-in was easy, everything is modern and they are very responsive for any queries.
Great place to stay. Super private, easy to check in, very walkable, stress free. Recommended 100%

It’s great location, nice service and easy to check-in&out.
But unfortunately there’s unpleasant smell from the bathroom, which is next to the bed…
Great location! Easy and clear instructions. Room was larger than the picture and very clean. Will definitely stay again next time I’m in Berlin!

The check in process and location make this an ideal place to stay for travelers with flexible arrivals. The location was an easy walk to many restaurants and points of interest. I was able to stay in Berlin without ever using public transit though I imagine that is also very accessible from this location.

Great place for a city break. Was able to work there as well. Nice and clean place with good bedding. Nice roof terrace! Super easy to get around as 5 minutes walk from the S-bahn. Efficiently managed using automated messages etc. And needed to contact support and got to a human super fast. Would go back!

I had a fantastic experience staying with Numa Properties. From the moment I arrived, everything felt effortless thanks to their smooth, contactless check-in process. The apartment was spotlessly clean, beautifully designed, and equipped with everything I needed for a comfortable stay.
The bed was incredibly comfortable, the Wi-Fi was fast and reliable, and small touches like quality toiletries and thoughtful interior details made a big difference. I also appreciated how quiet the space was, allowing me to relax and unwind after a busy day.
The customer service team was responsive and friendly, always ready to assist with any questions. Overall, Numa delivered the perfect mix of modern convenience and home-like comfort. I’ll definitely choose them again for future stays.
Numa is a great choice to stay in the Mitte. It is a self-serve hotel with good facilities.

The only drop in star rating was due to there being a heat wave for 2 nights and the air in the room was too hot to sleep, and no fan to help cool.
Otherwise the hotel is looking new, clean, fresh and exactly as pictured. Good location to many sites. Easy to check in and out. Would recommend!

This place is super convenient with great transport connections—perfect for travelers. It’s simple, clean, cozy, and welcoming, which made me feel comfortable right away. The staff were very friendly and always willing to help solve any issues. I would happily stay here again on my next trip to Berlin.
Very well situated and affordable.  I recommend it for anyone who is looking for an affordable place.

The room was great - clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The location was awesome. Just a short walk to Alexanderplatz and only a couple of minutes to the nearest U-Bahn station, which made getting around Berlin super easy.
Check-in was smooth and hassle free. The building had an elevator and convenient on-site laundry facilities, which was a big plus. Overall a great stay and I’d recommend it to anyone visiting Berlin!
My husband and my first time in Berlin - location was great, had a lot of shops, restaurants, and bars nearby. The room was exactly as described - we'd definitely stay again

Wonderful stay! Lots of things and places to eat within the area and easily accessible. The host was extremely helpful and friendly with quick response times. Great place for a little getaway, would definitely recommend!! :))

This little apartment was in a great location, had a really comfortable bed and great sheets, is immaculate just like the pics. The bathroom was so clean and new. The water pressure wonderful. The window big and light with great darkout curtains. The host was responsive and everything was easy. However I would never stay here again becasue the walls and ceiling are like paper and I could hear EVERYTHING happening around me and above me. One of the things I look forward to in vacation is sleeping and that was compromised becasue the person above me walked around till 1am and it is just soooooooo paper thin and I'm too sound sensitive for that. It almost felt like someone was IN the room with me.

We had an amazing stay at Numa. The place looked beautiful and felt very homey. It was incredibly easy to check in and out as well. I loved that there was a lot going on in the area (it was very quiet in the room though - the street where Numa is on is not a crowded one) and it was easy to get to other spots in the city as well. Would highly recommend :)

Great location to stay. More like a hotel than an airbnb. Easy remote checking in and out with their code system. They are responsive via their phone  no (they don't respond on AirBNB platform).  Amenities all present and working. Made it easy. Thanks.

Hello this place was great! I loved the bed and space. The easy check in and easy laundry room. The place had a great vibe and fresh. One issue I had was with the chrome casting. Somehow other guests kept jumping to my TV from their rooms castings on my tv it was annoying and made a nice relaxing evening harder

This is a really cute hotel in a wonderful area. Friedrichshain is by far the best part of Berlin to stay in, from art and restaurants to clubs and nightlife, its all within walking distance.
The apartment itself is beautiful, big windows and lots of natural light, nice decor and a great bathroom.
Kitchenette works perfectly for cooking a meal when you want to stay in.
Highly recommend this place, already miss Friedrichshain so much. Will be back!
It was my first time at a Numa. They have a smooth check-in and a little of everything to make it easy (kitchen, coffee, yoga mats, washer/dryer).
it all works well, decently priced and the room was good. Never speaking to anyone in the hotel and having all contact with a chatbot (!) feels a bit dystopic though.

Super clean, tidy, easy check in
And was super impressed with the oat milk minis!!
Ana is a wonderful host, responsive and very helpful. The apartment is beautiful, clean, bright. Brilliant local bars and restaurants, easy to find, definitely recommend!

I had a brilliant time in Berlin and the flat was exactly what I needed. The neighbourhood is fun, trendy, very accessible and felt very safe. The flat itself was wonderful , it had everything I needed and a bit more.
I visited during a heatwave and the host was proactive and provided a fan mid-stay, that was a great touch.
No doubt that I’ll be staying there again in my next visit, it was just perfect!
Great place to stay, right in the middle of a cute little neighborhood…lots of restaurants and cafes around.

Appartment is good for families or bigger groups. House is quiet and our family slept very well there. The place has good simple kitchen, so it's easy to make breakfast and so. Bathroom, kitchen and beds were clean. The floor was a bit dusty, but i think the owner of the place will notice this after we mentioned about it. Chatting with the owner went well. Trainstation Bornholmer is near and also Gesudbrunnen is not far away. Our family liked the place and would come back again.

This is a quiet and comfortable place to stay in Berlin.  Yes, it is a bit far from the central part, but it is not far from several train and U-Bahn stations which take you to the main sites quickly.  Comfy beds, amazing bathroom - perfect!  Also some great food in the immediate area - Turkish breakfast not to be missed!
Stayed at Jörgs place with colleagues doing work trip. Beautiful and very spacious place. Everything we expected, super clean and and perfect location.

Everything was nice and clean. Check-in went smoothly. Really good and easy to commute but not many interesting things to do in close neighborhood.
Recommend!
A very nice place, and very easy to enter, it is further out but it is right next to the trains which take 5 mins to get into the centre, overall I was very happy

Good apartment next to Wedding S-Bahn/U-Bahn station, so it's quite easy to get around the city. There is a small kitchenette, but I wouldn't say it's that suitable for cooking, as you don't have any ventilation and only small stove etc. But they do provide the essentials and having some olive oil and salt etc. is always great. The bed was a bit too soft for my liking, but overall everything is as described and it's a good place to stay for couple days.

I had a great time stayin at Anna’s place. The apartment was spotless clean, communication always on spot and responsive. Very well organized apartment with everything you will need for a perfect and relaxed stay. Would definitely recommend

We have had a fantastic stay at Anna's place. The location is perfect to explore Berlin. Safe and quiet neighbourhood, public transport in easy walking distance. The accommodation is private, quiet, clean and newly renovated with a innovative touch. The beds are comfortable and we felt right at home as soon as we arrived.

We had a great time staying at Marija’s apartment while in Berlin. Marija was very helpful with finding the apartments and gave some nice recommendations for bars/restaurants. The apartment is well located, clean and comfy - overall a great place to stay.

Marija was a great host and communicated clearly and promptly. Marija greeted me when I arrived, and gave me a good rundown of how everything worked in the unit. They also gave me really clear instructions for how to find and get into the unit.
The unit itself was as described: clean, well-maintained and offered a feeling of seclusion. Everything was clean, and it was so nice being able to use the combination washer/dryer to wash my clothes. The outdoor patio was very pleasant to sit on (it was sunny during my visit in mid-May). The internet was also fast and reliable!
I didn't spend too much time in the area around the AirBnb itself, but it was very easy to get to via public transit, and a very cozy place to come back to after long days wandering around Berlin.
I had a great experience here. Thanks Marija!
- Doug from Chicago

We had a fabulous stay at Marija’s place. It’s comfortable (bed and pillows in particular are so comfortable) stylish and quiet, located in the heart of the city close to major museums and historical sites. Marija is a welcoming, warm, responsive host who went above and beyond. Highly recommended!

Marija is very kind, attentive and responsive. The airbnb is beautiful, just like the pictures. On top of that, the location is amazing. It is so close to the best spots in Berlin and transportarion is very close. I would definitely come back to this airbnb. If you look for a place to feel like at home and in the heart of the city then this is your sign to book this place💓.

The apartment is very cozy and I literally felt like being home (even better). Close to Checkpoint Charlie and Postdamer Platz (meeting point for many tours) and to metro stations, so it is really easy to get anywhere in Berlin. Many good restaurants and markets nearby; only thing to be aware is that the apartment does not have full kitchen equipment (like pots or potato peeler or corkscrew). 5 starts for me, I will come back again for sure 👍

Cesar’s place was great! Awesome location close to transit and lots of local bars and restaurants. The flat is a bit minimal on amenities, but makes up for it in charm and aesthetic. Berlin was a super cool city, thanks for having us Cesar!

This place offers really good privacy for a group with different schedules, with the three bedrooms in the back and two common rooms (kitchen and living room) in the front. All rooms had doors between them.

Lovely place to stay, very pretty, in a good location and has plenty of restaurants, shops and facilities nearby. Eric provides alot of the basic amenities you would need which makes it super useful for a larger group. He's also responsive and provided a great list of recommendations for the area!
Overall, would recommend!

Parking is very limited but common for the area.
Check-in instructions were very clear and easy to execute.
The apartment was smaller than expected but doable for our family of 5. The windows are huge but looks out to a construction site. The walls are pretty thin so expect to hear guests from the other apartment above. The water tank does not produce enough hot water for our showers but we managed.
Overall, a nice, clean and modern set up in an area that's walkable with conveniences nearby.
For us this was the perfect location. It was nice to have a balcony with trees as a view.  It is a very well equipped if small flat.

Exceptional. The place felt almost luxurious in a way that we didn't expect. Everything was very clean and things worked properly. Even though we were only there for one day, we could easily imagine ourselves comfortably feeling at home in this accommodation for an extended period of time. Emil is an excellent host: welcoming and very accommodating. We had a perfect stay at his apartment and would highly recommend it.

We really enjoyed our stay at the airbnb, communication was clear and well organised. The Airbnb had all you need. The nearest tram / public transportation stop is a 15 min walk (through the park) so be aware of that! Thank you!
The location was perfect, cafes and supermarkets close by. Apartment was spotless. We received clear instructions by the host on how to access the apartment. 10/10

I had a great couple of days in this really nice apartment. The hosts were fantastic in their communication – I really appreciated their proactive approach, while also not overwhelming me with too much information at once. It felt thoughtful and well-balanced.

The apartment was large enough for our family of 4. The kitchen was very large and coffee pods were provided. There was also a washing machine but we couldn’t find any laundry detergent. It was close to Lidl. The apartment had high ceilings and it was nicely decorated with interesting light fixtures. Although there was no ac, each room had a fan and we all slept comfortably. Somehow we couldn’t get the TV to work-maybe a problem with the remote control. Although it was close to the train station, the neighborhood was questionable. Overall the place was large and it was easy to access.
Lovely stay! Miriam & Thiemo were super communicative. The location is perfect with many amenities.
Nice apartment and close to U2, which makes it easy to get downtown. Very good communication for the check in and check out

This apartment is a great find, especially for a solo traveller who wants a quiet, calm living space that's still close to great restaurants, bars, parks, and other attractions in Pberg! I had to do a bit of work during my trip, and the apartment was a comfortable place to do so effectively. The neighborhood is quiet and walkable, close to several parks (including Mauerpark). The apartment is also super close to multiple tram lines, making it a great option for exploring the rest of Berlin. I stayed for a week and had zero problems. And Killian is a responsive and friendly host, always ready to answer any questions!
Nice, place with a good finish. The biggest + for us was that the appartment stayed nice and cool even though outside it was 35+ degrees.
Samuel the host isgreat- positive, welcoming and responsive. Flat was equipped well. Eventhough the building is under construction and has noisy mornings, we got a great value for money for the stay.

This apartment was a wonderful option for my friend and I to spend a long weekend in Berlin. Very walkable to the public transportation options, it’s a great base for a trip of exploring. The host was responsive and even sent some restaurant suggestions. The apartment felt brand new and spotless!

So glad to have found this space on a last minute dash back to Berlin - comfortable, peaceful and walkable to everywhere I needed to be. The communication with Maximus was always prompt, friendly and informative, and I was so impressed with how clean the space was. I'll absolutely be back for another stay 😊
We had a wonderful stay in a very nice place. The communication went very smoothly! An ideal place to enjoy the city in peace.

Cute apartment with everything you need. The bathroom is amazing and super clean, we were so happy to relax there after long journey.
The hosts are very friendly and kind, did everything for our comfort and safe stay! Thank you, we are definitely recommend to stay here.

Robert is hands down the best host I’ve had in Berlin! As someone visiting the city for the first time, his warmth and kindness instantly made me feel at ease. From the moment I checked in, he treated me like an old friend, and the place didn’t feel like a temporary stay at all—instead, it felt like coming home, cozy and welcoming.
The room is huge and surprisingly clean; you can tell he puts so much care into every detail. I had such a wonderful time during my stay, and I can’t thank him enough. Highly recommend him to anyone visiting Berlin—you won’t regret choosing here!!

Great place to stay if you are in Berlin as tourist. The host is great with prompt support at all times. The flat has a great bathroom especially in the underground and looks better than the pictures.
The place is newly furnished and has everything you would need for your stay.
It’s walkable to the city centre and has great connectivity by bus only 350metres walk to the nearest stop.
Definitely recommend anyone going to Berlin to stay. The area is also very safe and has a lot to do. We were a family of four and could easily cook a meal if and when we wanted to.
Thank you fabel team for making it memorable!

We had a wonderful stay! The apartment was very clean and cozy, and the atmosphere was peaceful. Trains do pass by, which can be a bit loud at night if you keep the windows open. On the other hand, the train station is very close, which makes it super easy to get into the city center. Definitely coming back!

Liza's apartment is a bit away from the tourist areas. We wanted to stay an additional evening in Berlin and happened across Liza's place. It fit the bill well for us as we had left our backpacks at a Hostel storage and checked into Liza's place in the evening after our site seeing. The neighborhood had some really good restaurants. The pizza place right next door was fantastic, and the cafe/pastry place across the street was awesome (great cinnamon roles).

Felix’s flat was perfect for our weeklong stay in Berlin: it has a sense of simple elegance, well appointed with espresso machine, toaster, stove and hot water kettle, complete with dishwasher for the stoneware dishes. We slept deeply here and enjoyed beautiful hot showers. Access to the flat was easy to understand, and our host Felix and colleague were very responsive and especially gracious. Directly across the street are trails, perfect for a stroll, run or bike ride through one of the most beautiful green spaces a city could host. Gorgeous surroundings. We felt very safe, at home, and welcome. Easy access to bus, S-bahn and U-bahn trains. It was perfect for our daily excursions throughout Berlin. Neighborhood restaurants are not to be missed! Thank you Felix & colleague  for a wonderful stay.

I had an amazing stay here and it truly exceeded my expectations. The apartment is beautiful, with high ceilings and lots of space. Everything feels brand new, with stylish furniture and very comfortable beds. The host was extremely friendly and always responsive, providing clear instructions that made everything super easy. We didn’t have any issues at all. I would definitely recommend this place to friends and would be happy to stay here again!
Apartment is very nicely renovated, very clean and smelled great when I arrived. Had everything you might need for a few days stay
